en.description: The most stable signal is colons in titles and fields, especially as subtitle separators or in time formats. There are also word-initial Th fragments and assorted title, abstract, and file-format fragments, with insufficient evidence to attribute them to the same mechanism.

patterns.name: Title separator after a colon
patterns.context: A colon appears in a title or phrase, separating the topic from a subtitle, explanation, or following content; the colon in [6] has weak activation.
patterns.domain: Primarily PubMed titles; also structured Enron fields

patterns.name: Colon in a time field
patterns.context: A colon occurs in a time field, with the field name or numeric time format providing structured context.
patterns.domain: GitHub file records and Enron electricity-trading emails

patterns.name: Lowercase th-initial word in a title or phrase
patterns.context: A word at the beginning of a title is split into fragments beginning with Th, forming Thinking and Thyroid; there are only two examples and no shared meaning is apparent.

patterns.name: Other sporadic structural or formatting triggers
patterns.context: Examples involve abstract lead-ins, title openings, path/version/date formats, and line breaks; apart from colons, there is insufficient evidence of a shared trigger pattern.

10_19.description: 最稳定的信号是标题、字段中的冒号，尤其用于副标题分隔或时刻格式。另有 Th 词首及若干标题、摘要和文件格式碎片，证据不足以归为同一机制。

patterns.name: 冒号后的标题分隔符
patterns.context: 冒号出现在标题或短语中，用来分隔主题与副标题、说明或后续内容；[6]的冒号激活较弱。
patterns.domain: 主要是 PubMed 标题，也见 Enron 结构化字段

patterns.name: 时间字段中的冒号
patterns.context: 冒号位于时刻字段中，字段名或数字时间格式提供结构化上下文。
patterns.domain: GitHub 文件记录与 Enron 电力交易邮件

patterns.name: 标题/短语中的小写 th 起始词
patterns.context: 标题开头的词被拆分为以 Th 起始的片段，分别组成 Thinking 和 Thyroid；仅有两例，未见统一词义。

patterns.name: 其他零散结构性或格式触发
patterns.context: 分别涉及摘要导语、标题开头、路径/版本号/日期格式和换行；除冒号外没有足够证据表明是共同触发模式。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、GitHub 文件记录

en.description: All fragments mark capital Th at the beginning of a word, while subsequent activation varies across words; the content spans papers, medicine, biology, and encyclopedic text, with no stable thematic or semantic condition apparent.

patterns.name: Word-initial Th subword fragment
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a word, usually followed by one or more subword fragments continuing that word; this token is marked in all 10 segments and has the highest intensity.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; including paper abstracts, medical and biological texts, film entries, and Wikipedia titles

patterns.name: Subsequent fragments of Th-initial words
patterns.context: «Th» is followed by fragments forming Thinking, Thyroid, Thirst, Thin, Thirty, Thoracic, Thrombolytic, and Thalidomide; the specific continuations of different words are all activated.
patterns.domain: General English and medical and biological terminology

patterns.name: Title-style word-initial position
patterns.context: Capital Th at the beginning of a word appears in titles, entries, or sentence openings; this form also occurs in Wikipedia titles.
patterns.domain: Paper titles, abstract openings, and encyclopedia entries

10_19.description: 所有片段均在词首标记大写 Th，后续激活随不同词而异；内容横跨论文、医学、生物学与百科文本，未见稳定的主题或语义条件。

patterns.name: 词首 Th 子词片段
patterns.context: 出现在词首，通常紧接着是一个或多个延续该词的子词片段；该 token 在全部 10 段中均被标记，且强度最高。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；包括论文摘要、医学与生物学文本、电影条目及维基百科标题

patterns.name: Th 开头词的后续片段
patterns.context: «Th» 后接续组成 Thinking、Thyroid、Thirst、Thin、Thirty、Thoracic、Thrombolytic、Thalidomide；不同词的具体延续均有激活。
patterns.domain: 一般英语及医学、生物学术语

patterns.name: 标题式词首
patterns.trigger: «Th» 后接词语或标题内容，如 «Th»«ruxton»
patterns.context: 词首大写 Th 出现在标题、条目或句子开头；维基百科标题中也有此形式。
patterns.domain: 论文标题、摘要开头及百科条目

en.description: Activation primarily falls on colons after titles or label phrases, and also sporadically appears at title-initial words, proper nouns, medical terms, intra-word subword fragments, and webpage line breaks; all-caps press-release labels and math-problem formats also occur.

patterns.name: Colon in a title or subtitle
patterns.context: A colon appears after a title or label-like phrase, often followed by a subtitle or body heading; activation concentrates on the colon itself.
patterns.domain: Paper titles, webpage titles, email subjects, and math problems

patterns.name: Word fragment at the beginning of a title
patterns.context: A word at the beginning of a sentence or title is split into multiple tokens; activation falls on the initial fragment, with varying strength.

patterns.name: All-caps press-release label
patterns.context: An all-caps organization or section name appears at the beginning of a short press-release headline.

patterns.name: Proper noun or brand-related word in a title
patterns.context: A title begins with a proper noun, section name, or brand-related word, activating its word fragments.

patterns.name: Line breaks after a subtitle
patterns.context: Consecutive line breaks follow a webpage title or update notice heading, activating the newline token.

patterns.name: Line openings and relation symbols in math problems
patterns.context: A math problem introduces a setup with a line break and Let, then uses a colon in a question to introduce the objects being compared.

patterns.name: Topic terms and punctuation in paper titles
patterns.context: Topic words, hyphens, periods, and other internal title elements occur in medical paper titles, with sporadic activation.

patterns.name: Intra-word subword fragments
patterns.context: Compound or longer words are split by the tokenizer, with some internal tokens activated; no stable semantic condition is apparent.

10_19.description: 激活主要落在标题或标签短语后的冒号，也零散出现在标题词首、专名、医学术语、词内子词片段及网页换行；另见全大写新闻稿标签和数学题格式。

patterns.name: 标题/小标题中的冒号
patterns.context: 冒号出现在标题或标签式短语之后，常接副标题或正文标题；激活集中在冒号本身。
patterns.domain: 论文标题、网页标题、邮件主题及数学题

patterns.name: 标题开头的词片段
patterns.context: 句首或标题开头的词被分成多个 token；激活落在词首片段，强弱不一。
patterns.domain: 论文标题或标题式文本

patterns.name: 新闻稿大写标签
patterns.context: 全大写机构或栏目名出现在简短新闻稿标题开头。

patterns.name: 标题中的专名或品牌词
patterns.context: 标题开头为专名、栏目名或品牌相关词，激活其词片段。
patterns.domain: 体育与饮食相关网页标题

patterns.name: 小标题后的换行符
patterns.context: 网页标题或更新通知的标题后出现连续换行，激活换行 token。

patterns.name: 数学题中的行首与关系符号
patterns.context: 数学题以换行和 Let 引入设定，随后在问句中用冒号引出比较对象。

patterns.name: 论文标题中的主题术语及标点
patterns.context: 医学论文标题里出现主题词、连字符或句点等标题内部成分，零散激活。

patterns.name: 词内子词片段
patterns.context: 复合词或较长词被分词器拆分，部分内部 token 激活；未见稳定语义条件。

en.description: Activation occurs mainly in expressions of thanks and epithelial-related word fragments; it also appears in specific words such as registered, New, material, and Of, as well as terminology and punctuation in a genomic-island paper. The examples span domains and lack a unified semantics.

patterns.name: Expression of thanks
patterns.context: At the beginning of an expression of thanks, often in an email or direct acknowledgment; may include a hyphen, line break, or following salutation

patterns.name: Epithelial-related words
patterns.context: Occurs within epithelial or nonepithelial, referring to epithelial tissue or cells

patterns.name: Forms of registered
patterns.context: Occurs in a compound describing preregistered nursing students

patterns.name: New in a place name
patterns.context: Capitalized as part of a street name
patterns.domain: Wikipedia entries about places and churches

patterns.name: Legal language of judgment
patterns.context: Occurs in a court's legal statement about the relevance of evidence

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Of
patterns.context: Introduces patient counts or sample statistics in medical research

patterns.name: Genomic-island terminology
patterns.context: Discusses predicted genomic islands in bacterial genomes and figure references

10_19.description: 主要在致谢语及上皮相关词片段中激活；另见于 registered、New、material、Of 等特定词语，以及基因组岛论文中的术语和标点，跨领域且缺少统一语义。

patterns.name: 感谢表达
patterns.context: 感谢语开头，常见于邮件或直接致谢；可带连字符、换行或后续称呼

patterns.name: 上皮相关词
patterns.context: 出现在 epithelial 或 nonepithelial 词内，涉及上皮组织或细胞

patterns.name: registered 词形
patterns.context: 出现在描述预注册护理学生的复合词中

patterns.name: 地名中的 New
patterns.context: 作为街道名称的一部分，首字母大写
patterns.domain: 维基百科地方与教会介绍

patterns.name: 法律判断用语
patterns.context: 出现在法院对证据相关性的法律表述中

patterns.name: 句首 Of
patterns.context: 医学研究中引出患者数量或样本统计

patterns.name: 基因组岛术语
patterns.context: 讨论细菌基因组中的预测基因组岛及图表引用

en.description: Activation concentrates on the English initial fragment multif (multifocal, multifactorial, multifaceted), and the stem constit in constitutions in legal contexts; these occur across medical papers and legal texts, respectively.

patterns.name: multif in forms of multifocal
patterns.context: Medical text describes a disease, lesion, or intraocular lens as multifocal; activation falls within multif

patterns.name: multif in forms of multifactorial
patterns.context: Describes a mechanism of action as multifactorial

patterns.name: multif in forms of multifaceted
patterns.context: Describes a drug's multifaceted therapeutic potential or a multifaceted research approach

patterns.name: constit in forms of constitution
patterns.context: Mentions state or federal constitutions, common in legal discussion

10_19.description: 激活集中于英语词首片段 multif（multifocal、multifactorial、multifaceted），以及法律语境中 constitutions 的词干 constit；分别跨医学论文和法律文本出现。

patterns.name: multifocal 词形中的 multif
patterns.context: 医学文本中描述疾病、病变或人工晶体为多灶性；激活落在 multif 内

patterns.name: multifactorial 词形中的 multif
patterns.context: 描述作用机制为多因素的

patterns.name: multifaceted 词形中的 multif
patterns.context: 描述药物具有多方面治疗潜力，或研究方法多方面

patterns.name: 宪法词形中的 constit
patterns.context: 提及州或联邦宪法，常见于法律论述

en.concept: Word fragments and local lexical triggers
en.description: Activation is distributed across several word types: words containing per, such as perceive, self-perceived, repertoire, performed, and hamper, as well as end-stage, hallmarks, caveolae, and facial; contexts vary from medical papers to literature and technical discussion.

patterns.name: self-perceived
patterns.context: In the compound self-perceived, strong activation falls on the split per subword fragment; it refers to people's perceptions or assessments of their abilities.

patterns.name: repertoire
patterns.context: Repertoire in the medical immunology term TCR-repertoire; strong activation falls on the per fragment.

patterns.name: performed
patterns.context: The past participle performed, beginning with per-, appears in literary narration about a play being staged in a theater.

patterns.name: perceive loudness
patterns.context: Explains that the frequency bands of audio equipment focus on loudness as perceived by the human ear; perceive is linked to the object of perception.

patterns.name: end-stage
patterns.context: Describes end-stage renal failure caused by complications of a disease; activation hits end.

patterns.name: hamper
patterns.context: Explains that missing information hampers understanding of disease pathogenesis; activation is on the final per in hamper.

patterns.name: hallmarks
patterns.context: Epigenetic changes are described as cancer hallmarks of tumor development; activation is at the beginning of hallmarks.

patterns.name: caveolae
patterns.context: Mentions a lack of caveolae in asthma and fibrosis research; activation covers the beginning of the technical term and subsequent subwords.

patterns.name: facial aesthetics
patterns.context: Describes receiving facial aesthetics training after a traumatic experience; strong activation falls on facial, with no apparent shared word-form pattern.

10_19.concept: 词片段及局部词汇触发
10_19.description: 激活分布在多类词项中：perceive、self-perceived、repertoire、performed、hamper 等含 per 的词，以及 end-stage、hallmarks、caveolae、facial；语境从医学论文到文学和技术讨论不一。

patterns.name: self-perceived
patterns.context: 复合词 self-perceived 中，强激活落在被拆分的 per 子词片段；分别指人的感知或能力评价。
patterns.domain: 社会科学、心理健康研究

patterns.name: repertoire
patterns.context: 医学免疫学术语 TCR-repertoire 中的 repertoire；强激活落在 per 片段。

patterns.name: performed
patterns.context: 文学叙述中，per- 开头的过去分词 performed；提及戏剧在剧院上演。

patterns.name: perceive loudness
patterns.context: 解释音频设备的频段关注人耳会感知到的响度；perceive 与感知对象相连。

patterns.name: end-stage
patterns.context: 医学中描述疾病并发症导致的终末期肾衰竭；激活命中 end。

patterns.name: hamper
patterns.context: 说明未知信息妨碍理解疾病发病机制；激活位于 hamper 的词尾 per。

patterns.name: hallmarks
patterns.context: 表观遗传变化被称为肿瘤发展的癌症标志；激活位于 hallmarks 的词首。

patterns.name: caveolae
patterns.context: 哮喘与纤维化研究中提及 caveolae 缺乏；激活覆盖该专业术语的词首及后续子词。

patterns.name: facial aesthetics
patterns.context: 描述受创经历后接受面部美学训练；强激活落在 facial，非明显共享的词形模式。

en.description: Activation is distributed across common structures such as infinitives, definite articles, email whitespace, and line breaks, as well as medical terminology, place names, biological genera, legal language, and political phrasing; no single stable semantic theme is apparent.

patterns.name: “to” and following infinitive constructions
patterns.context: Appears before a verb to form infinitive constructions expressing purpose, ability, plans, or intention; surrounding topics vary.

patterns.name: “the” and following noun phrases
patterns.context: The definite article appears before a noun or noun phrase; highlighting is relatively strong in these examples.

patterns.name: “of” linking a proportion and a population
patterns.context: Appears after the proportion “15-20%” in the population description “among women of reproductive age”.

patterns.name: Words related to tidiness and organization
patterns.context: Describes a person's tidiness habits; later text discusses kitchen clutter and food. The word may be the cross-token phrase “tidy person”.

patterns.name: Word fragments in a travel destination name
patterns.context: Appears in a sentence about whether to travel somewhere, forming the place name Foz do Iguaçu across multiple tokens; activation concentrates on the name fragments and following whitespace.

patterns.name: Whitespace or line-break boundaries in email body text
patterns.context: Activation markers fall near spaces or line breaks, commonly at sentence, quotation, or formatting boundaries in email; the marker location does not always identify a single function.

patterns.name: List item markers in a numbered list
patterns.context: A list of positions begins after a colon, with activation near the colon and parenthesized numbers.
patterns.domain: Legal records, Q&A, or testimony transcripts

patterns.name: Word fragment in nasopharyngeal swab
patterns.context: A consecutive word fragment within “nasopharyngeal”, modifying swabs; no clear shared syntactic trigger can be confirmed from this single example.

patterns.name: Word fragment in a mosquito genus name
patterns.context: Forms the genus name Coquillettia, followed by mosquitoes; later text concerns viral hosts and test results.

patterns.name: Date or subsequent time phrase in text
patterns.context: Segment 1 refers to the sixth day after transplantation, and segment 6 to next Friday; these may be local activations near time expressions, but evidence is limited.

patterns.name: Damages language in a legal dispute
patterns.context: “treble damages” appears in an account of a legal dispute involving a contract and interference with business relations; this is a single example of one word fragment.

patterns.name: English inflectional or intra-word fragments
patterns.context: Activation is scattered across a presidential abbreviation, plural suffixes, and verb endings or forms, with no shared context; these may be local word-fragment effects.

patterns.name: Discussion of an issue and passage of an amendment
patterns.context: Describes the political process of passing an amendment and committing to later revisions; this is a single example and cannot establish a specific political-term trigger.

10_19.description: 激活分散于不定式、定冠词、邮件空白与换行等常见结构，也覆盖医学术语、地名、生物属名、法律和政治措辞；单一稳定语义主题不明显。

patterns.name: “to”及后接不定式结构
patterns.context: 出现在动词前，构成目的、能力、计划或意愿等不定式结构；周围上下文题材各异。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的普通英文语法

patterns.name: “the”及其后名词短语
patterns.context: 定冠词位于名词或名词短语前；高亮强度在这些例子中较突出。
patterns.domain: 医学、政治讨论、普通邮件

patterns.name: “of”连接比例与人群
patterns.context: 出现在比例“15-20%”之后，构成“among women of reproductive age”人群描述。

patterns.name: 整洁与收纳相关词
patterns.context: 描述人的整洁习惯；后文谈厨房杂物和食物，词语可能是跨分词的“tidy person”。

patterns.name: 旅行目的地名称中的词片段
patterns.context: 出现在讨论是否去某地旅行的句子中，跨多个 token 拼出地名 Foz do Iguaçu；激活集中于地名片段和其后的空白。

patterns.name: 邮件正文中的空白或换行边界
patterns.context: 激活标记落在空格或换行附近，常见于邮件中句段、引用或排版边界；标记位置并不总能据此确定单一功能。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件及邮件格式文本

patterns.name: 编号列表的项目标记
patterns.context: 冒号后开始列举职位，激活出现在冒号和括号编号附近。
patterns.domain: 法律记录、问答或证词转录

patterns.name: 鼻咽拭子词中的词片段
patterns.context: 作为“nasopharyngeal”的连续词片段，修饰 swabs；没有明显共享的句法触发条件可从单例确认。

patterns.name: 蚊子属名中的词片段
patterns.context: 组成属名 Coquillettia，后接 mosquitoes；后文是病毒宿主和检测结果。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、动物疾病研究

patterns.name: 文本中的日期或后续时间短语
patterns.context: 段1为移植后的第6天，段6为下周五；可能只是时间表达附近的局部激活，二者证据有限。

patterns.name: 法律争议中的损害赔偿措辞
patterns.context: “treble damages”出现在合同与干扰商业关系的法律争议叙述中；仅为一个词片段的单例。

patterns.name: 英语屈折或词内片段
patterns.context: 激活散落在总统缩写、复数词尾以及动词词尾或词形中，缺少共同语境，可能是局部词片段效应。
patterns.domain: 邮件中的普通英文文本

patterns.name: 议题讨论与修正案通过
patterns.context: 描述修正案通过以及承诺后续修改的政治过程；单例，无法确定是特定政治术语触发。

en.description: Activation is distributed across body and medical vocabulary, prostate terminology, fist gestures, migration narratives, plot language, bibliographic fragments, and code punctuation and examples; there is no unified semantic theme that adequately covers all the material.

patterns.name: Body / human-body-related words
patterns.context: body combines with compound suffixes, referring respectively to virtual-character body parts, body image disorder, and body in a radiotherapy term
patterns.domain: Virtual worlds, diet and health, medicine

patterns.name: Prostate medical terminology
patterns.context: prostate and terms formed from it, such as cancer and resection terminology, recur

patterns.name: Structural boundary markers in code
patterns.context: Syntax punctuation such as colons and right braces is marked in code examples; another code snippet is triggered near a mapping assignment

patterns.name: Gestures and fist bumping
patterns.context: Describes replacing handshakes with fist bumps; fist appears twice in the same segment

patterns.name: Persecution and expressions of possibility
patterns.context: Describes people from multiple countries, some of whom migrated because of persecution, followed later by could build a...

patterns.name: Behavior and justification vocabulary in a narrative
patterns.context: A character tries to make up for past wrongs, using threats such as foreclosure to force the town's villain to do the right thing

patterns.name: Compound words for fictional abilities
patterns.context: Lists surreal abilities that characters in a virtual world may have; the same sentence also lists spellcasting, flight, and others
patterns.domain: Patent background text discussing virtual worlds

patterns.name: Bibliographic and German-title fragments
patterns.context: Introduces an author and their work, followed by the beginning of the German title Handbuch

patterns.name: Mapping syntax in code examples
patterns.context: Explains processing dictionaries with map() and reduce(), and gives a Python-like example

patterns.name: Hash-table access example in code
patterns.context: Shows a nested hash/array structure and an example of accessing its keys

10_19.description: 激活分散于身体与医学词汇、前列腺术语、拳头手势、迁移叙事、剧情用语、书目片段及代码标点和示例；没有足以覆盖全部材料的统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 身体／人体部位相关词
patterns.context: body 与复合词后缀相连，分别指虚拟角色的身体部件、身体形象障碍，以及放疗术语中的体部
patterns.domain: 虚拟世界、饮食与健康、医学

patterns.name: 前列腺医学术语
patterns.context: 反复出现 prostate 及其构成的癌症、切除术术语

patterns.name: 代码中的结构边界标记
patterns.context: 代码示例中，冒号和右花括号等语法标点被标记；另一个代码片段的触发位置是映射赋值附近

patterns.name: 手势与拳头碰拳
patterns.context: 描述以碰拳代替握手；fist 在同一片段出现两次

patterns.name: 被迫害及可能性表达

en.concept: Misfortune and involvement in historical events
en.description: Primarily occurs in historical accounts of damage, casualties, or misfortune, and also in expressions of participating in or becoming involved in events; there are also local triggers such as “the same” and “confessed to the facts”.

patterns.name: Being ... or suffering a major blow
patterns.context: Historical accounts describe people, buildings, or institutions suffering destruction, casualties, or other negative events; related verbs often appear in prepositional constructions with by, from, in, or during.

patterns.name: Participation or involvement in events
patterns.context: Describes people or groups participating in or becoming involved in an action, practice, or conflict, often in constructions such as involved in, engaged in, participated in, and embroiled in.
patterns.domain: Historical accounts, religious anthropology, and older letters

patterns.name: Specific phrase ‘the same’ and its emphasis
patterns.context: Refers in an argument to the same behavior as mentioned earlier; nearby context compares moral failings across groups.

patterns.name: to followed by facts or information
patterns.context: In an account of a criminal case, confessed to is followed by the facts being admitted; activation falls on the consecutive phrase “to the facts”.

10_19.concept: 历史事件中的不幸遭遇与卷入
10_19.description: 主要见于历史叙述中的受损、伤亡或遭遇不幸事件，也见于参与或卷入事件的表达；另有“the same”和“confessed to the facts”这类局部触发。

patterns.name: 被……或遭受重大打击
patterns.trigger: [2] “destroyed by”；[6] “destroyed by the forces”；[7] “damage from the earthquake”；[9] “killed by being shot down”；[10] “killed in … an assassination”；另有 [3] “injured during a patrol”
patterns.context: 历史叙述中，人物、建筑或机构遭遇破坏、伤亡或其他负面事件；相关动词常出现在 by、from、in、during 等介词结构中。
patterns.domain: 百科全书式历史、生平叙述

patterns.name: 事件中的参与或卷入
patterns.trigger: [4] “engaged in a Duel”；[5] “practice involved spiritual appeasement”；[8] “participated in several actions”；[10] “embroiled in Chinese internal politics”
patterns.context: 描述人物或群体参与、卷入某种行动、实践或冲突，常见 involved in、engaged in、participated in、embroiled in 等结构。
patterns.domain: 历史叙述、宗教人类学及旧式书信

patterns.name: 特定词项‘the same’及其强调

patterns.context: 论述中指称与前文相同的行为；附近语境比较不同群体的道德过失。

patterns.name: to 后接事实或信息内容
patterns.context: 刑事案件叙述中，confessed to 后接所承认的事实；激活落在连续的 “to the facts” 上。

en.description: Activation appears primarily in accounts of major events such as war, violence, injury, and disasters, and also in medical descriptions of eye burns and conviction information in biographical entries. A common thread may be event severity or negative consequences, but evidence is insufficient to reduce it to a single lexical pattern.

patterns.name: Physical conflict or violent events
patterns.context: Describes specific assaults, fights, injuries, arrests, or assassinations; words may be distributed throughout the event description and do not always refer to the same kind of violence.
patterns.domain: Legal cases, biographies, or historical narratives

patterns.name: War and military operations
patterns.context: In accounts of military figures, wars, or naval history, describes combat, battles, operations, casualties, or atrocities.
patterns.domain: Military history, war history, encyclopedic accounts

patterns.name: Damage, injury, and disaster consequences
patterns.context: Mentions eye burns or severe damage caused by an earthquake; this pattern partly overlaps with military violence but also covers non-war injuries.

patterns.name: Follow-up proceedings after a case or disaster
patterns.context: Event accounts include subsequent actions such as conflict, arrest, prosecution, and expulsion; this may be a broad trigger for event-based narratives, but the boundaries are unclear.

patterns.name: Significant event-based experiences
patterns.context: Describes people or things experiencing a significant event, action, or consequence; beyond examples overlapping with war or disaster patterns, no shared trigger condition can be identified.

patterns.name: Eye-related medical procedures
patterns.context: In the context of using a Morgan Lens, mentions eye irrigation, medication administration, or burns.

patterns.name: Negative criminal information in a biographical entry
patterns.context: A list entry identifies a person's conviction after their name or occupation.

10_19.description: 激活主要出现在战争、暴力、伤害及灾害等重大事件叙述，也见眼部烧伤的医疗说明和人物条目的定罪信息。各段共同点可能是事件的严重性或负面后果，但证据不足以归结为单一词汇模式。

patterns.name: 身体冲突或暴力事件
patterns.context: 叙述具体袭击、斗殴、受伤、被捕或暗杀等事件；词语可分散在事件描述中，并不总是同一种暴力。
patterns.domain: 法律案件、人物传记或历史叙事

patterns.name: 战争与军事行动
patterns.context: 军事人物、战争或舰船战史中，描述参战、战斗、行动、伤亡或暴行。
patterns.domain: 军事史、战争史百科叙述

patterns.name: 损伤、伤害与灾害后果
patterns.context: 提及眼部烧伤或地震造成的严重损害；此模式与军事暴力有部分语义重叠，但也覆盖非战争伤害。

patterns.name: 涉案或灾难的后续处置
patterns.context: 事件叙述中出现冲突、拘捕、起诉、驱逐等后续行动；较可能是事件型叙述的宽泛触发，边界不清。

patterns.name: 强烈的事件性经历
patterns.context: 描述人物或事物经历了显著事件、行动或后果；除与战争、灾害等模式重叠的用例外，无法确定共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 眼部医疗操作
patterns.context: Morgan Lens 的使用场景中，提及眼部冲洗、给药或烧伤。

patterns.name: 人物条目中的负面罪行信息
patterns.context: 人物列表条目在姓名或职业介绍后附加定罪信息。

en.description: Covers causes of death, deaths from wartime violence, legal offenses, and medical head injuries; the shared theme is contexts involving death, injury, or serious adverse outcomes, but trigger phrases and styles vary.

patterns.name: Cause-of-death phrases
patterns.context: When describing a person's death in a biography or category, activation concentrates on “from” and may extend to the following article, cause-of-death term, and related words.

patterns.name: Violent deaths and wartime casualties
patterns.context: Narratives of deaths and injuries caused by war, persecution, or group violence.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia military history and historical narratives

patterns.name: Criminal convictions and offenses
patterns.context: Jury verdicts, convictions, or charges appear in legal texts; activation concentrates on offense lead-in terms and the crime names that follow.

patterns.name: Medical complications and head injuries
patterns.context: Perioperative complications following bleeding or head injuries are discussed in medical abstracts; activation is prominent on “head”.

10_19.description: 覆盖人物死因、战争暴力致死、法律罪名及医学头部损伤；共同点是死亡、伤害或严重不良后果相关语境，但触发短语与文体各异。

patterns.name: 死亡原因短语
patterns.trigger: “deaths from influenza”、“death from a heart attack”、“died from battle wounds”、“died of cancer”
patterns.context: 人物生平或分类中描述死亡时，激活集中在“from”，并可延伸到后接的冠词、死因词及相关词。

patterns.name: 暴力致死及战争伤亡
patterns.context: 叙述战争、迫害或群体暴力造成的死亡和伤害。

patterns.name: 刑事定罪与罪名
patterns.trigger: “guilty by a jury of the charge of aggravated assault”、“guilty of second degree murder, kidnapping, and felony false imprisonment”、“criminal offense of procuring a female for a house”
patterns.context: 法律文本中出现陪审团裁决、定罪或指控；激活集中于罪名引导词及其后的犯罪名称。

patterns.name: 医学并发症及头部损伤
patterns.trigger: “complications are common after subarachnoid haemorrhage or head injury”
patterns.context: 医学摘要中讨论出血或头部损伤后的围手术期并发症；激活显著落在“head”。

en.description: Primarily responds to serious violent and lethal crimes and related criminal-justice narratives; also covers duels, wartime combat, and atrocities against civilians, and responds to procedural and boilerplate language in judgments.

patterns.name: Violent crime and criminal justice
patterns.context: In legal judgments, indictments, crime reporting, or crime narratives, often adjacent to crime categories, convictions, victims, or violent incidents; activation may also fall on subword fragments within crime terms.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, news, and historical/biographical narratives

patterns.name: Duels
patterns.context: A biographical narrative describes a duel in which an opponent is killed and the duelist flees to England; criminal-justice vocabulary does not appear directly.

patterns.name: War and military atrocities
patterns.context: Narratives of war, sieges, or military actions against civilians; involving combat casualties or atrocities.

patterns.name: Boilerplate and procedural language in legal texts
patterns.context: Standard formats and procedural narratives in court judgments or legal arguments; often co-occurs with crime-type terms, but also forms a salient context in its own right.

10_19.description: 主要响应严重暴力及致死犯罪、相关刑事司法叙述；也覆盖决斗、战争战斗与针对平民的暴行，并对判决书的程序和模板用语有反应。

patterns.name: 暴力犯罪与刑事司法

patterns.domain: 法律文本、新闻及历史/人物叙述

en.description: Activation covers death, fatal incidents, and criminal-justice narratives, and also appears in narratives about streptococcal infection, domestic-violence homicides, and plots involving extramarital affairs; the shared thread leans toward negative events, but content types differ markedly.

patterns.name: Narratives of death and fatal incidents

patterns.name: 暴力犯罪、凶杀与严重伤害
patterns.trigger: “bloody gang war”“rape, murder, and child molestation”“Mass murder”“Mass shootings”“rapes and murders”“assaults”“atrocities”
patterns.context: 出现具体暴力犯罪、袭击、谋杀或严重伤害的叙述、列举或分类；不限于单一罪种。
patterns.domain: 法律、犯罪新闻与百科条目

patterns.name: 战争及社会冲突背景
patterns.context: 历史叙述中描写战争爆发、群体迫害、驱逐或针对群体的冲突。

patterns.name: 灾难与死亡事件
patterns.context: 提到重大灾祸，或个人因疾病、意外等原因死亡；与暴力犯罪模式并不完全相同。

patterns.name: 创伤类型与成因
patterns.trigger: “high energy trauma”“car or sports accidents”“inadequate trauma”
patterns.context: 医学语境下对骨折及其创伤机制、成因作区分。

patterns.name: 感染及疾病名称列举
patterns.context: 医学语境中介绍细菌感染及相关疾病；可见激活落在疾病名称及其局部上下文。

patterns.name: 类别标签与格式化标题
patterns.context: 百科分类列表中出现犯罪类别或与枪击、凶杀相关的分类标题。

en.description: Activation is distributed across medical terminology, accident and death narratives, building incidents, wartime conflicts, and sporadic local subword fragments; “cell”, causal-context phrases, and war terms stand out, but there is no unified, reliable trigger rule.

patterns.name: “cell” in medical terminology
patterns.context: In medical contexts, “cell” appears when describing infection, disease, or immune mechanisms, especially in terms such as cellulitis and cell-mediated.

patterns.name: Phrases describing causes of events or injuries
patterns.context: In accounts of accidents, trauma, or incidents, prepositional phrases introduce the cause, manner, or circumstances.
patterns.domain: Medical and legal narratives, news biographies

patterns.name: Subword fragments in domain terms or proper nouns
patterns.context: Word components within technical terms or historical proper nouns; activation falls on subword fragments of “artery” and “Turkish”.

patterns.name: Historical conflicts and war-related terms
patterns.context: Narratives of war, violent conflict, or its outbreak, commemoration, or prevention.

patterns.name: Locations or objects in construction and destruction events
patterns.context: In narratives about buildings, facilities, and their construction, fencing, or destruction, activation occurs on related nouns or nearby phrases.

patterns.name: Event outcomes or report-style narratives
patterns.context: Reports or narratives state observed events, deaths, and their circumstances; triggers may be limited to local vocabulary.

patterns.name: Term sequences in disease and infection entries
patterns.context: Medical texts list pathogens, infections, or disease names; activation concentrates on some medical word sequences without forming a unified whole-word trigger.

patterns.name: Sociopolitical persecution and wartime contexts
patterns.context: Historical narratives describe escalating persecution, the outbreak of war, and the circumstances of ethnic groups.

patterns.name: Unclassifiable local triggers
patterns.context: Each occurs in only one passage, with insufficient evidence to determine whether there is a stable shared condition.

10_19.description: 激活分散于医学术语、事故与死亡叙述、建筑事件、战争冲突及零散局部词片段；“cell”、原因情境短语和战争词较突出，但没有统一可靠的触发规则。

patterns.name: 医学术语中的“cell”
patterns.context: 医学语境中，描述感染、疾病或免疫机制时出现“cell”，尤其在细胞炎、细胞介导等术语中。

patterns.name: 事件或损伤原因短语
patterns.trigger: «as»9« car»5；«as»9« the result of an accidental drowning»；«during»6« a patrol»
patterns.context: 事故、创伤或事件经过的叙述中，原因、方式或发生情境由介词短语引出。
patterns.domain: 医学与法律叙述、新闻传记

patterns.name: 领域或机构专名中的词片段
patterns.context: 专业名词或历史专名内部的词语组成部分；激活落在“artery”及“Turkish”的分词片段上。

patterns.name: 历史冲突与战争相关词
patterns.context: 叙述战争、暴力冲突或其爆发、纪念与避免等情形。

patterns.name: 建设与破坏事件中的地点或物件
patterns.context: 建筑、设施及其建造、围栏或毁坏的叙述中，激活出现在相关名词或邻近短语。

patterns.name: 事件结果或报告式叙述
patterns.context: 以报告或叙事方式陈述观察到的事件、死亡及其经过；可能只是局部词汇触发。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、法律文书、传记

patterns.name: 疾病与感染条目中的术语串
patterns.context: 医学文本列举病原体、感染或疾病名称；激活集中在部分医学词串，未形成统一的完整词触发。

patterns.name: 社会政治迫害与战争背景
patterns.context: 历史叙述中描述迫害加剧，以及战争爆发和族群处境。

patterns.name: 难以归并的局部触发
patterns.context: 各自只在单一片段出现，缺少足够证据判断是否有稳定共同条件。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to war, violent conflict, casualties, death events, and their timing, and also appears in trauma, accident, and disaster-medicine contexts; sporadic triggers include reconciliation, confessions, and narratives of massacres.

patterns.name: Violent conflicts, casualties, or deaths
patterns.context: Describes specific violent incidents such as war, gang conflict, accidents, attacks, deaths, or murders; some passages introduce them by time or context.
patterns.domain: Historical, encyclopedia, medical, and patent-background texts

patterns.name: Outbreak or timing of specific events
patterns.context: Narrates historical events or disasters occurring in a particular period; often adjacent to major events such as wars, revolutions, and plagues.

patterns.name: Injury, trauma, and medical care
patterns.context: Mentions injuries, trauma mechanisms, fractures, or triage and transport of casualties; may be medical discussion or emergency-care instructions.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, patent-background texts, and incident narratives

patterns.name: Lists of accidents and disasters
patterns.context: Lists examples of accidents, natural disasters, or hostile acts causing mass casualties.

patterns.name: Other local word-form or narrative triggers
patterns.context: Occur individually in accounts of reconciliation by shaking hands, confessions about a case, and narratives describing massacres; these local triggers cannot independently be confirmed as a stable shared pattern.

10_19.description: 主要对战争、暴力冲突、伤亡与死亡事件及其发生时点敏感，也出现在创伤、事故和灾害医疗语境；零散触发包括和解、供认及屠杀叙述。

patterns.name: 暴力冲突、伤亡或死亡事件
patterns.trigger: «bloody» «gang» «war»；«outbreak» of the «World» War；«car» or sports accidents；«bomb» explosions；«killed»；«died» in an «attempted» «prison» break；«fought»…«battle»；«assassination»
patterns.context: 描述战争、帮派冲突、事故、袭击、死亡或谋杀等具体暴力事件；有些段落以事件发生时间或背景引入。
patterns.domain: 历史、百科、医学及专利背景文本

patterns.name: 特定事件的爆发或发生时点
patterns.trigger: «at» the «outbreak» of the «World» War；«At» the «outbreak» of the «French» Revolution；«during»…«tragedy»
patterns.context: 叙述历史事件或灾祸在特定时期发生；常与战争、革命、瘟疫等重大事件相邻。

patterns.name: 受伤、创伤及医疗处置
patterns.context: 出现受伤、创伤机制、骨折或伤员分流与送医等表述，可能是医学讨论或应急处置说明。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、专利背景文本及事件叙述

patterns.name: 事故与灾害的并列举例
patterns.trigger: «mass» «casual»«ty» situations such as accidents, natural disasters and hostile acts
patterns.context: 以列举方式概括造成大量伤亡的事故、自然灾害或敌对行为。

patterns.name: 其他局部词形或叙事触发
patterns.context: 分别出现在握手和解、供认案情、描述屠杀的叙事中；这些局部触发无法单独确认为稳定的共同模式。

en.concept: Narratives of violent casualties and adverse events
en.description: Primarily sensitive to narratives involving war, violence, casualties, and death, and also responds to disease and infection, causes of death, and causal expressions; it also appears in testimony explanations and temporal placement of events, with triggers distributed across varied contexts.

patterns.name: War and violent conflict
patterns.context: When describing war, conflict, violent injury, or mass casualties; specific triggers vary and do not require the same collocation.
patterns.domain: History, medicine, social issues, fictional plots

patterns.name: Records of death and casualties
patterns.context: Explicitly records deaths, casualties, or causes of death, commonly in statistics, biographies, and legal materials.

patterns.name: Disease and infection
patterns.context: Appears in medical narratives related to infection or disease, disease classifications, or explanations of causes of death.

patterns.name: Facts, admissions, and explanations
patterns.context: Describes a person admitting facts or a character explaining the truth about an event.

patterns.name: Time points and event occurrence
patterns.context: Locates disasters, actions, or service experiences by time or stage of an event.

patterns.name: Causal and result expressions
patterns.context: Uses prepositional structures to link events, causes, or results; especially common in medical materials.

10_19.concept: 暴力伤亡与不良事件叙述
10_19.description: 主要对战争、暴力、伤亡及死亡相关叙述敏感，也响应疾病感染、死因和因果表达；另见供述解释与事件时间定位，触发词分散且语境多样。

patterns.name: 战争与暴力冲突
patterns.trigger: «bloody» «gang» war；«high» «energy» trauma；«outbreak» of the «World» War；«battle» «wounds»；«atrocities» against Dalits；killed staff
patterns.context: 描述战争、冲突、暴力伤害或大规模伤亡时；具体触发词各异，不要求同一搭配。
patterns.domain: 历史、医学、社会议题、文学情节

patterns.name: 死亡与伤亡记录
patterns.context: 明确记述死亡、伤亡或死亡原因，常见于统计、传记和法律材料。

patterns.name: 疾病与感染
patterns.context: 在感染或疾病相关的医学叙述、疾病分类或死因说明中出现。

patterns.name: 事实、承认与说明
patterns.context: 叙述人物承认事实，或角色解释事件真相。

patterns.name: 时间点与事件发生
patterns.context: 以时间或事件阶段定位灾难、行动、服役等经历。

patterns.name: 因果与结果表达
patterns.context: 以介词结构连接事件、原因或结果；医学材料中尤其常见。

en.concept: Local terms in names and legal texts
en.description: Most passages contain the name Richard in legal documents, emails, or people lists. The legal expression stands charged and Brewer in a case title also trigger strong activations, but do not fit the Richard pattern.

patterns.name: Richard in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears in case titles, opinion headers, or lists of attorneys/parties, usually next to initials or titles; also occurs as a name in email recipients and lists.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal documents

patterns.name: Richard in email headers and contact lists
patterns.context: Richard is part of a name in an email recipient field or an alphabetized contact list.

patterns.name: Richard in obituary-style web messages
patterns.context: In “Message from former CBS A Vice President Kyle Richard,” Richard is the surname of the person mentioned.

patterns.name: Emphatic activation of stands in legal discussion
patterns.context: Appears in the fixed legal expression “the crime ... of which she stands charged,” unrelated to the name Richard.

patterns.name: Brewer in a case title
patterns.context: In the party name “William R. Brewer,” activation falls on the split surname token; unrelated to Richard.
patterns.domain: Case titles in U.S. case law

10_109.concept: 姓名及法律文本中的局部词项
10_109.description: 多数段落在法律文书、邮件或人物名单中出现姓名 Richard；另有法律固定表达 stands charged 与案件标题中的 Brewer 分别触发强激活，无法归入 Richard 模式。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的 Richard 姓名
patterns.context: 出现在案件标题、判决书页眉或律师/当事人姓名列表中，通常与名字首字母或职务相邻；也见于邮件收件人和名单中的人名。

patterns.name: 邮件头及联系人列表中的 Richard
patterns.context: 邮件头的收件人字段或按姓氏排列的联系人名单中，Richard 是姓名的一部分。

patterns.name: 讣告式网页消息中的 Richard
patterns.context: “Message from former CBS A Vice President Kyle Richard”中，Richard 是消息所述人物的姓氏。
patterns.domain: 网页导航及新闻/讣告类文本

patterns.name: 法律论述中代词 stands 的强调激活
patterns.context: 出现在“the crime ... of which she stands charged”这一法律固定表达中，与人名 Richard 无关。
patterns.domain: 刑事判决书中的法律论述

patterns.name: 案件标题中的 Brewer 姓名
patterns.context: 案件当事人姓名“William R. Brewer”中，激活落在被拆分的姓氏 token 上；与 Richard 无关。
patterns.domain: 美国判例中的案件标题

en.description: Activations focus on title or sentence-initial words in several medical, public-health, and encyclopedia texts: National, Devices, Anatomy, and evidence in research prose. No clear shared semantic or syntactic feature is apparent.

patterns.name: Proper names or titles beginning with National
patterns.context: National appears at the start of a sentence or title, followed by nouns such as organizations, route numbers, holidays, or surveys; the word itself triggers across different contexts.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, general organization descriptions, public-health surveys, and medical abstracts

patterns.name: Plural form Devices
patterns.context: When the initial Dev and final ices are marked separately, the complete word Devices activates strongly; followed by a use or prepositional phrase.

patterns.name: Anatomy in a related title
patterns.context: The following subword fragment of Anatomy is prominent in the title phrase Radiographic Anatomy.

patterns.name: Evidence statements
patterns.context: Growing evidence indicates appears near the sentence beginning, with evidence most prominent; surrounding words also activate more weakly.

10_109.concept: none
10_109.description: 激活集中于若干医学、公共卫生及百科文本中的标题或句首词：National、Devices、Anatomy，以及科研表述中的 evidence；未见它们共享明确语义或句法特征。

patterns.name: National 开头的专名或标题
patterns.context: 句首或标题开头出现 National，后接机构、道路编号、节日或调查等名词；单词本身在多个不同上下文中触发。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、一般组织介绍、公共卫生调查及医学摘要

patterns.name: Devices 复数词形
patterns.context: 词首 Dev 与词尾 ices 分别标记时，完整词 Devices 显著激活；后接用途或介词短语。
patterns.domain: 医疗器械标题、专利背景

patterns.name: 解剖学相关标题词
patterns.context: Radiographic Anatomy 这一标题短语中，Anatomy 的后续子词片段激活突出。

patterns.name: 证据表述
patterns.context: 句首附近出现 Growing evidence indicates，突出的是 evidence；周围词也有较弱激活。

en.description: Activations span diverse, unrelated content: medical and biological phrases, philosophical and political encyclopedia text, website titles, and structural symbols and hardware/graphics constants in code. There is insufficient evidence for a single semantic or formal pattern.

patterns.name: molecular in medical text
patterns.context: molecular appears in a biomedical title or biographical entry; in [3] it is adjacent to highly activated “biologist,” and in [4] it modifies “chaperones.”

patterns.name: Survival outcome phrase
patterns.context: Appears in the medical phrase “Median survival” for high-grade glioma.

patterns.name: natural law discussion
patterns.context: Philosophical discussion of natural law theory as an alternative to environmental thought; activation is distributed across several words, especially “intel,” “alternative,” and “contemporary.”

patterns.name: Political office and place name
patterns.context: Encyclopedia-style title and definition introducing the president of Northern Cyprus and the role as head of state.

patterns.name: Website promotional copy
patterns.context: Title-style promotional or website section copy; a short title follows a line break.

patterns.name: Punctuation in nested structured data
patterns.context: Indentation, line breaks, and nested square/curly brackets in Github code; activation focuses on structural symbols, field quotes, and some field values.

patterns.name: Hardware register identifiers
patterns.context: Github code or hardware interface constants, using uppercase abbreviations assigned hexadecimal values.

patterns.name: Graphics library constant identifiers
patterns.context: OpenGL extension constants in Github code, composed of underscore-separated uppercase identifiers followed by hexadecimal values.

patterns.name: Epidemiological terminology
patterns.context: Academic abstract titles and discussions of behavior spreading through populations; the sentence mentions “behaviors may spread through populations”.

10_109.concept: none
10_109.description: 激活覆盖多种互不相同的内容：医学与生物学词句、哲学和政治百科文本、网站标题，以及代码中的结构符号和硬件/图形常量；没有足够证据归为单一语义或形式模式。

patterns.name: 医学文本中的 molecular
patterns.context: 生物医学标题或人物简介中出现 molecular；在[3]中紧邻高激活的“biologist”，在[4]中修饰“chaperones”。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、百科人物简介

patterns.name: 生存结局短语
patterns.context: 出现在高级别胶质瘤的“Median survival”医学短语中。

patterns.name: natural law 论述
patterns.context: 自然法理论作为环境思想替代方案的哲学论述；激活分布于句中多个词，较突出的有“intel”“alternative”“contemporary”。

patterns.name: 政治职位与地名
patterns.trigger: “President of Northern Cyprus”及“The president of Northern Cyprus”（[7]）
patterns.context: 百科式标题和定义句，介绍北塞浦路斯总统及其国家元首身份。

patterns.name: 网站宣传语
patterns.context: 标题式宣传文案或网站栏目文案；换行后出现短标题。

patterns.name: 嵌套结构化数据标点
patterns.context: Github 代码中的缩进、换行及嵌套方括号/花括号；激活集中在结构符号、字段引号和部分字段值。

patterns.name: 硬件寄存器标识符
patterns.context: Github 代码或硬件接口常量，采用大写字母缩写与十六进制数值赋值。
patterns.domain: 代码、硬件寄存器/接口定义

patterns.name: 图形库常量标识符
patterns.context: Github 代码中的 OpenGL 扩展常量，名称由下划线分隔的大写标识符组成，后接十六进制值。

patterns.name: 流行病学术语
patterns.context: 学术摘要标题及关于行为在人群中传播的讨论；句中提到“behaviors may spread through populations”。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生、行为科学摘要

en.concept: Hybrid response to words and local positions
en.description: High activations often occur on sentence-initial Do, Whenever, and Tracking, or words in specific titles and phrases. Trigger words span multiple genres; sporadic highlights also occur in code and link comments, with no unified semantic or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Do in instructions/questions
patterns.context: Do appears at the start of a sentence, followed by an imperative or question; [1] is output text in code, and [2] is Mathematica code.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including email, code, and webpage instructions

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Whenever
patterns.context: Appears at the start of an explanatory English sentence, followed by a conditional clause.

patterns.name: Tracking
patterns.context: A title-like phrase beginning with Tracking, followed by algorithms.

patterns.name: Exceptionless title
patterns.context: In the title «Exceptionless Readme», activation falls on Read; separator lines appear above and below.

patterns.name: Thanksgiving-related phrase
patterns.context: In an email body, from and Turkey Day form a holiday phrase.

patterns.name: No clear shared pattern
patterns.context: [2] is a code/math notation fragment; [9] is a colloquial comment near a link. Prominent highlighted elements are difficult to assign to the patterns above from local context.

10_109.concept: 词语与局部位置的杂合响应
10_109.description: 高激活多落在句首 Do、Whenever、Tracking，或特定标题及短语中的词；触发词横跨多种文体，另有代码和链接评论中的零散高亮，未显出统一语义或句法规律。

patterns.name: 句首 Do 指令/疑问
patterns.context: Do 出现在句首，后接祈使句或疑问句；[1] 是代码中的输出文本，[2] 是 Mathematica 代码。
patterns.domain: 邮件、代码与网页说明等多种文体

patterns.name: 句首 Whenever
patterns.context: 出现在解释用英语句子的句首，后接条件从句。

patterns.name: Tracking
patterns.context: 句首标题式短语中，后接 algorithms。

patterns.name: Exceptionless 标题
patterns.context: «Exceptionless Readme»标题中，激活落在 Read；上下方有分隔线。

patterns.name: 感恩节相关短语
patterns.context: 邮件正文中，from 与 Turkey Day 连成节假日短语。

patterns.name: 未见明确共性
patterns.context: [2] 为代码/数学记号片段；[9] 为链接附近的口语评论；显著高亮成分难以从局部上下文归入以上模式。

en.description: Activations vary: figuring out stands out in forum text; multiple code passages are sensitive to indentation, fields, and structural boundaries; book-list boundaries and token fragments of rebuttal in a legal context also occur. These are difficult to reduce to one semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Line-ending continuation cue
patterns.context: figuring is especially strong in the phrase “figuring out”; occurs when describing problem-solving, considering next steps, or career choices.

patterns.name: Indentation and structural boundaries in multilingual code
patterns.context: Indentation, underscore separators, fields/keys, and statement boundaries in code or configuration text; strong activation does not always fall on the same kind of code token.

patterns.name: Content following colons in citations or records
patterns.context: Content following colons, line breaks, list items, or fields such as names/dates in structured records.

patterns.name: Rebuttal in legal argument
patterns.context: Legal statement presenting the prosecution’s rebuttal argument; strong activation is concentrated on token fragments of rebuttal.

10_109.concept: 结构边界与分词片段
10_109.description: 激活分布不一：论坛文本中突出 figuring out；多段代码中对缩进、字段和结构边界敏感；另见书目列表边界及法律语境下 rebuttal 的分词片段，难以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 行尾延续提示
patterns.context: 短语“figuring out”中的 figuring 尤其强；出现于叙述解决问题、思考下一步或职业选择的语境。

patterns.name: 多语言代码中的缩进与结构边界
patterns.context: 代码或配置文本中的缩进、下划线分隔符、字段/键及语句边界；强激活并不总落在同一种代码 token 上。

patterns.name: 引文或记录中的冒号后内容
patterns.context: 结构化记录中冒号、换行、列表项或姓名/日期等字段后的内容。
patterns.domain: 论文书目及结构化文本

patterns.name: 法律论证中的反驳
patterns.context: 检方提出反驳论点的法律陈述；强激活集中于 rebuttal 一词的分词片段。

en.description: Activations are scattered across diverse code and text patterns: HTTP/JSON requests, date formats, indentation diagnostics, GUI and form states, editor actions, permission inputs, map controls, discount calculations, and a dash in an event title. No clear common trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: JSON requests and object fields
patterns.context: Activation near field names, string values, and punctuation in HTTP POST request configurations and JSON objects.

patterns.name: Hyphen in an event title
patterns.context: Activation at the dash connecting the event name and event category in “2012 Challenger of Dallas – Doubles”.

patterns.name: Date formats and calendar fields
patterns.context: Activation near date format strings and fields in calendar configuration objects.

patterns.name: Indentation difference report
patterns.context: Iterates through actual indentation text and compares it with expected indentation characters, reporting the position when they differ.

patterns.name: GUI controls and layout initialization
patterns.context: Creates a button and sets properties such as size and text, then initializes a grid layout.

patterns.name: Form input state update
patterns.context: An event handler reads form control values and names, then updates state with computed properties.

patterns.name: Editor cursor actions and selectors
patterns.context: When recording or replaying editor actions, specifies a target DOM selector and cursor offset.

patterns.name: Course permissions and user input
patterns.context: When handling a POST request, checks course permissions and reads webpage user input.

patterns.name: Geocoder instantiation
patterns.context: Creates an Esri geocoder and passes in a map object when the variable is empty.

patterns.name: Discount calculation and price cap
patterns.context: Calculates a discount based on coin amount and cash rate, then caps it at the total price if it exceeds that amount.

10_109.concept: none
10_109.description: 激活分散于多种代码与文本模式：HTTP/JSON 请求、日期格式、缩进诊断、GUI与表单状态、编辑器动作、权限输入、地图控件、折扣计算，以及赛事标题破折号；没有共同的明确触发特征。

patterns.name: JSON 请求与对象字段
patterns.context: HTTP POST 请求配置及 JSON 对象中，字段名、字符串值和标点附近激活。

patterns.name: 赛事标题中的连接号
patterns.context: 赛事标题“2012 Challenger of Dallas – Doubles”中，连接赛事名称与项目类别的破折号处激活。

patterns.name: 日期格式与日历字段
patterns.context: 日期格式字符串及日历配置对象的字段附近激活。
patterns.domain: 代码中的日期/日历配置

patterns.name: 缩进差异报告
patterns.context: 遍历实际缩进文本并与预期缩进字符比较，发现不同时报告位置。

patterns.name: GUI 控件与布局初始化
patterns.context: 创建按钮并设置尺寸、文本等属性，随后初始化网格布局。

patterns.name: 表单输入状态更新
patterns.context: 事件处理器读取表单控件的值和名称，并以计算属性更新状态。

patterns.name: 编辑器光标动作与选择器
patterns.context: 记录或重放编辑器动作时，指定目标 DOM 选择器和光标偏移。

patterns.name: 课程权限与用户输入
patterns.context: 处理 POST 请求时检查课程权限，并读取网页用户输入。

patterns.name: 地理编码器实例化
patterns.context: 变量为空时创建 Esri 地理编码器并传入地图对象。

patterns.name: 折扣计算与价格封顶
patterns.context: 按币数和现金汇率计算折扣，并在折扣超过总价时将其限制为总价。
patterns.domain: JavaScript 业务逻辑/价格计算

en.description: Activations span several code types, especially function or block closures, line breaks and indentation, and member calls. They also cover specific structures such as assertions, validation controls, numeric mappings, autocomplete, CSS properties, and theme colors.

patterns.name: Function or code block ending
patterns.context: Near closing brackets, function bodies, or control block endings in JavaScript, Swift, C++, and other code; often accompanied by line breaks and indentation.

patterns.name: this object properties and method calls
patterns.context: Accessing this properties or calling member methods in JavaScript object methods or callbacks, especially next to parentheses or statement endings.

patterns.name: Assertions and positive-value conditions
patterns.context: An assertion that parameter limit is greater than zero in a random-number constructor; only one example.

patterns.name: Form validation and control styling
patterns.context: Logic for validating controls and setting their background color, or highlighting controls to be validated.

patterns.name: Numeric character mapping
patterns.context: Key-value pairs, punctuation, and line breaks in a mapping between numeric characters and Indian numerals.

patterns.name: Result lists and category selection
patterns.context: In an autocomplete or selection control callback, handling a no-results message, updating a content list, and reading an item category.

patterns.name: CSS text-wrapping property
patterns.context: Configures text wrapping and word-breaking behavior in a CSS rule, near form control selectors.

patterns.name: Returning a C++ data member address
patterns.context: A C++ member function returns a pointer to a vector data member, near the end of the function.

patterns.name: CSS/Sass color variables and nested rules
patterns.context: Sets the background color to a theme variable in nested selectors in Sass/Less-style code.

10_109.concept: 代码结构与边界
10_109.description: 激活分布于多类代码：尤见函数或代码块闭合、换行缩进及成员调用；也覆盖断言、验证控件、数字映射、自动补全、CSS 属性与主题色等具体代码结构。

patterns.name: 函数或代码块结束
patterns.context: 在 JavaScript、Swift、C++ 等代码中，闭合括号、函数体或控制块结束附近；常伴随换行及缩进。

patterns.name: this 对象属性与方法调用
patterns.context: JavaScript 对象方法或回调中，访问 this 的属性、调用成员方法，尤其紧邻括号或语句结束位置。

patterns.name: 断言与正数条件
patterns.context: 随机数构造方法中，对参数 limit 作大于零的断言；仅此一例。

patterns.name: 表单验证与控件样式
patterns.context: 验证控件并设置其背景色或高亮待验证控件的逻辑中。

patterns.name: 数字字符映射
patterns.context: 数字字符与印度数字字符之间的映射表中，键值对及标点、换行附近。

patterns.name: 结果列表与分类选择
patterns.context: 自动补全或选择控件的回调中，处理无结果提示、更新内容列表并读取项目分类。

patterns.name: CSS 文本换行属性
patterns.context: CSS 规则中配置文本换行和断词行为，附近还有表单控件选择器。

patterns.name: C++ 返回数据成员地址
patterns.context: C++ 成员函数返回指向 vector 数据成员的指针，函数末尾附近。

patterns.name: CSS/Sass 颜色变量与嵌套规则
patterns.context: Sass/Less 风格的嵌套选择器中，将背景颜色设为主题变量。

en.concept: Mixed features of token fragments and demonstratives
en.description: Activations are scattered across biomedical and religious texts, often on this, gene/molecular biology terms, sequence notation, and numbers. A few proper-name fragments and a map description also occur, without a single stable theme.

patterns.name: this in biomedical text
patterns.context: this functions as a determiner or demonstrative referring to preceding gene, kinase, element, chromosome, call, etc.; spans different biomedical topics and also appears in religious prose.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, grant applications, and some religious prose

patterns.name: Genomics and transcript structure terminology
patterns.context: Activation falls on terms related to nucleic acid sequences, gene structure, transcription, or translation and their neighboring elements.

patterns.name: Numbers and quantitative expressions
patterns.context: Numbers and their units or adjacent sequence notation occur in scientific descriptions; activation mainly falls on numbers, punctuation, and abbreviation fragments.

patterns.name: Proper names and tokenized terminology fragments
patterns.context: Mixed-case abbreviations, genes, or family names are split into multiple subwords; activation is scattered across name fragments and nearby common words.

patterns.name: Demonstrative in religious context
patterns.context: this refers to preceding content about life or calling, surrounded by religious terms such as Christian, Master, and His.

patterns.name: “molecular” and related descriptions
patterns.context: Appears alongside chromosome, genetic, and physical map in a description of a fine-scale map.

10_109.concept: 分词片段与指示词的混合特征
10_109.description: 激活分散在多种生物医学与宗教文本中，常落于 this、基因/分子生物学术语、序列记号和数字；另有少量专名片段及图谱描述，未见单一稳定主题。

patterns.name: 生物医学文本中的 this
patterns.context: this 用作限定词或指示词，指向前文的 gene、kinase、element、chromosome、call 等；跨不同生物医学主题，也见于宗教散文。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、申请书及少量宗教散文

patterns.name: 基因组学与转录本结构术语
patterns.context: 激活落在核酸序列、基因结构、转录或翻译相关术语及其邻近成分上。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、基因组学论文

patterns.name: 数字与量化表达
patterns.context: 数字及其单位或相邻序列记号出现于科学说明中；强度主要落在数字、标点和缩写片段。

patterns.name: 专名与分词式术语片段
patterns.context: 大小写混合的缩写、基因或家族名称被切分成多个子词；激活散布在专名片段及附近常见词上。

patterns.name: 宗教语境中的指示词
patterns.context: this 指向作者所述的生命、召唤等前文内容，周围有 Christian、Master、His 等宗教词汇。

patterns.name: “molecular”及相关描述
patterns.context: 与 chromosome、genetic、physical map 并列，描述精细图谱。

en.concept: Biomedical proper names and symbol strings
en.description: Activations often fall on proper names and highly formatted alphanumeric strings in biomedical texts: gene/protein symbols, sequence variants, coordinates, percentages, and locus notation. Splicing, viruses, taxonomic names, and neuropeptide terminology also occur.

patterns.name: Name spellings and forms
patterns.context: Proper names, taxonomic names, and spelling explanations appear in taxonomy or nomenclature contexts; strong activation falls on name character fragments or “names”.

patterns.name: Alphanumeric fragments in gene and protein names
patterns.context: In biomedical texts, activation occurs on letter and number fragments in gene, protein, receptor, or viral component names; name boundaries and mixed-case forms are prominent.
patterns.domain: Molecular biology, biomedical papers and patents

patterns.name: DNA/RNA sequences and genetic variant notation
patterns.context: When discussing nucleotides, methylation sites, exon variants, or base substitutions, activation occurs on serialized notation made of numbers, letters, and punctuation.

patterns.name: Splice-site and transcript notation
patterns.context: Occurs around exons, splice acceptor sites, transcript analysis, and variant-induced changes in splicing.

patterns.name: Viral replication and antisense nucleic acid descriptions
patterns.context: Describes designed nucleic acid sequences complementary to viral genes or conserved regions to inhibit viral replication.

patterns.name: Promoters and transcription regulatory elements
patterns.context: Specific cis-elements in promoters and their positions are mentioned in descriptions of gene-expression regulation.

patterns.name: Neuropeptide names and amino acid lengths
patterns.context: Compares related neuropeptides or their cDNA, especially stop codons and differences in C-terminal length.

patterns.name: Retroviral structural terminology
patterns.context: Describes the structure, genome organization, and encoded products of endogenous or exogenous retroviruses.

patterns.name: Unexplained activation on biomedical gene symbols
patterns.context: The passage discusses CpG methylation; strong activation falls partly on the “5-” position and related terms. Its relation to other gene-symbol/sequence patterns is uncertain.

10_109.concept: 生物医学专名与符号串
10_109.description: 激活多落在生物医学文本中的专名及高度格式化的字母数字串：基因/蛋白符号、序列变异、坐标、百分比和位点记法；也见剪接、病毒、分类名称及神经肽术语。

patterns.name: 名称的字母拼写与词形
patterns.context: 分类学或命名法语境中出现专名、分类名称及其拼写说明；强激活落在名称字符片段或“names”上。

patterns.name: 基因与蛋白名称中的字母数字片段
patterns.context: 生物医学文本中，激活出现在基因、蛋白、受体或病毒组分名称的字母与数字片段；名称边界和大小写混合形式明显。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、生物医学论文与专利

patterns.name: DNA/RNA序列与遗传变异记法
patterns.context: 提及核苷酸、甲基化位置、外显子变异或碱基替换时，数值、字母、标点组成的序列化记法获得激活。
patterns.domain: 遗传学、表观遗传学、临床分子诊断

patterns.name: 剪接位点与转录本记法
patterns.context: 围绕外显子、剪接受体位点、转录本分析及变异导致的剪接变化出现。

patterns.name: 病毒复制与反义核酸描述
patterns.trigger: «antisense»4« RNA»5« sequence»2« complementary»2« to»3« a»4« conserved»7« region»6；«HIV»2«-»2«1»2« rev»3
patterns.context: 说明设计的核酸序列与病毒基因或保守区域互补，以抑制病毒复制。

patterns.name: 启动子与转录调控元件
patterns.trigger: «G»9«AG»6«A»4« box»2« located»5« in»2« the»2 proximal« promoter»4；«transcription»
patterns.context: 描述基因表达调控时，启动子中的特定顺式元件及其位置被提及。

patterns.name: 神经肽名称与氨基酸长度
patterns.trigger: «s»2«VT»2«-»1«II»3« cDNA»4；«neuro»1phys«ins»2« are»8« about»6« 30»9« amino»6« acids»8« longer»6
patterns.context: 比较相关神经肽或其cDNA，尤其是终止密码子及羧基端长度差异。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、神经内分泌学

patterns.name: 逆转录病毒结构术语
patterns.trigger: «retroviruses»；«L»3«TR»1« sequences»4« that»« flank»3« genes»5« encoding»3«,»2« G»9«ag»4
patterns.context: 讲述内源或外源逆转录病毒的结构、基因组组织及编码产物。
patterns.domain: 比较基因组学、病毒学论文

patterns.name: 解释不充分的生物医学基因符号激活
patterns.context: 段落讨论CpG甲基化，强激活部分落在“5-”位置及相关术语；与其他基因符号/序列模式的关系不确定。

en.description: Activations concentrate in biomedical gene and nucleic-acid research texts, especially numerical gene/protein lengths, DNA methylation, RNA splicing, HIV RNA inhibition, and terms and contexts involving gene-expression regulation, gene overlap, and frameshifts caused by deletions.

patterns.name: Genome and protein-coding lengths/numbers
patterns.context: Numerical information on the lengths or molecular weights of genes, open reading frames, proteins, or transcripts; activation often falls on numbers, units, and nearby coding terminology.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, gene and protein descriptions

patterns.name: DNA methylation and cytosine modification
patterns.context: Discusses CpG methylation, cancer-related DNA methylation, or chemical modification of cytosine.

patterns.name: RNA splicing and splice-site variants
patterns.context: Describes exons, splicing, transcript isoforms, or the effects of mutations on RNA splicing.

patterns.name: HIV-related RNA inhibition and viral genes
patterns.context: Inhibits HIV replication using antisense RNA or similar methods, or describes HIV genes and their transcripts.

patterns.name: Gene expression and regulatory screening
patterns.context: Describes gene-expression regulation, chromatin state, or identification of regulated genes following genomic screening.

patterns.name: Gene structure and transcript overlap
patterns.context: Discusses the orientation and overlapping regions of adjacent genes and their transcript features.

patterns.name: Frameshift caused by a genetic deletion
patterns.context: A disease-related deletion mutation changes the reading frame, and its translation product is predicted.

10_109.concept: 生物医学基因组与RNA机制
10_109.description: 激活集中于生物医学基因与核酸研究文本，尤其是基因/蛋白质长度数值、DNA甲基化、RNA剪接、HIV RNA抑制，以及基因表达调控、基因重叠和缺失移码等术语与上下文。

patterns.name: 基因组与蛋白质编码长度/数值
patterns.trigger: “620 nucleotides”“954 bp”“121 bp”“181 amino acids”“49 amino acid residues”“84 and 89”
patterns.context: 基因、开放阅读框、蛋白质或转录本的长度、分子量等数值信息；激活常落在数字、单位及附近编码术语上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、基因与蛋白质描述

patterns.name: DNA甲基化与胞嘧啶修饰
patterns.context: 讨论CpG甲基化、癌症相关DNA甲基化或胞嘧啶的化学修饰。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、表观遗传学

patterns.name: RNA剪接及剪接位点变异
patterns.trigger: “acceptor consensus sequence”“A> T substitution causes splicing”“alternative splicing”“RNA encoding”
patterns.context: 描述外显子、剪接、转录本异构体，或突变对RNA剪接的影响。

patterns.name: HIV相关RNA抑制与病毒基因
patterns.context: 以反义RNA等方式抑制HIV复制，或描述HIV基因及其转录本。

patterns.name: 基因表达与调控筛选
patterns.context: 叙述基因表达调控、染色质状态，或基因组筛选后识别受调控基因。

patterns.name: 基因结构与转录本重叠
patterns.trigger: “orientation of two adjacent genes”“transcripts mapping to the overlap”
patterns.context: 讨论相邻基因的方向、重叠区域及其转录本特征。

patterns.name: 遗传缺失导致移码
patterns.trigger: “1 kb deletion”“introduces a frameshift”“predicted translation product”
patterns.context: 疾病相关缺失突变造成阅读框改变，并预测其翻译产物。

en.concept: Quantification and structural description of biomolecules
en.description: Primarily responds to numerical molecular sizes and coordinates adjacent to units (bp, nt, amino acids, Da) in biomedical text, as well as descriptions of gene/transcript structure, methylation modifications, splice isoforms, and genomic statistics.

patterns.name: Nucleic acid/gene sequence lengths and coordinates
patterns.context: Describes the length, range, and units of nucleic acids, genes, transcripts, or sequence fragments in biomedical literature; numbers appear adjacent to units such as bp, nt, nucleotides, or base pairs.

patterns.name: Protein length and molecular weight
patterns.context: Describes the size of a protein or translation product, with numbers adjacent to units such as amino acids or Da; often accompanied by notes on coding, isoforms, or function.
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper abstracts and main text

patterns.name: Nucleotide modifications and methylation
patterns.context: Discusses DNA/RNA methylation or RNA modifications, with modification names, sites, proportions, and related nucleotide terminology.

patterns.name: Transcript splicing and isoform differences
patterns.context: Compares transcript variants, exon skipping, and the resulting protein isoforms or length differences.

patterns.name: Genome assembly and statistical ranges
patterns.context: Reports assembly quality, genome size, or predicted protein counts using constructions such as between…and….

patterns.name: Stop codons and tail lengths in genetic sequences
patterns.context: Compares cDNA/gene variants, describing internal stop codons and differences in protein C-terminal length.

patterns.name: Positional descriptions of gene regulatory elements
patterns.context: Reports enhancer length and upstream coordinates relative to the translation start site.
patterns.domain: Gene expression and regulation research abstracts

patterns.name: Reverse complements and overlapping adjacent genes
patterns.context: Discusses the orientation of adjacent genes, transcript mapping, and overlapping gene regions.

patterns.name: HIV-1 Nef gene structure
patterns.context: Introduces the exon count and length of a specific viral gene and its overlap with a neighboring region.

10_109.concept: 生物分子定量与结构描述
10_109.description: 主要响应生物医学文本中紧邻单位的数值化分子尺寸与坐标（bp、nt、氨基酸、Da），也响应基因/转录本结构、甲基化修饰、剪接异构体及基因组统计等描述。

patterns.name: 核酸/基因序列长度与坐标
patterns.trigger: “620 nucleotides”“954 bp”“1221 bp”“2178 base pairs”“503-528 base pairs”“21nt”
patterns.context: 生物医学文献中描述核酸、基因、转录本或序列片段的长度、区间及单位；数值与 bp、nt、nucleotides、base pairs 等单位相邻。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、基因组学论文

patterns.name: 蛋白质长度与分子量
patterns.trigger: “34863 Da”“317 amino acids”“294 amino acids”“265 amino acids”“30 amino acids longer”
patterns.context: 描述蛋白质或翻译产物的大小，数值紧邻 amino acids、Da 等单位；常伴随编码、异构体或功能说明。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文摘要与正文

patterns.name: 核苷酸修饰与甲基化
patterns.trigger: “60 to 90% of CpG dinucleotides are methylated”“5-carbon atom”“methyl-6-adenosine (m6A)”“5-methyl-cytosine (5mC)”
patterns.context: 讨论 DNA/RNA 的甲基化或 RNA 修饰，出现修饰名称、位点、比例及相关核苷酸术语。
patterns.domain: 表观遗传学、转录组学与专利背景

patterns.name: 转录本剪接与异构体差异
patterns.context: 比较转录本变体、外显子跳读及其产生的蛋白质异构体或长度差异。

patterns.name: 基因组组装与统计范围
patterns.trigger: “between two and ten contigs”“between 3.56 and 3.79 Mb”“between 3,783 and 4,067 proteins”
patterns.context: 以 between…and… 等结构报告组装质量、基因组大小或预测蛋白数量。

patterns.name: 遗传序列中的终止密码子与尾部长度
patterns.trigger: “a stop codon in the middle of … cDNA”“carboxyl termini … about 30 amino acids longer”
patterns.context: 比较 cDNA/基因变体，描述中部终止密码子及蛋白质羧基末端长度差异。
patterns.domain: 神经肽相关生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 基因调控元件的位置描述
patterns.trigger: “26 base pair enhancer located 503-528 base pairs upstream from the translation start site”
patterns.context: 报告增强子长度及其相对于翻译起始位点的上游坐标。
patterns.domain: 基因表达与调控研究摘要

patterns.name: 逆向互补与相邻基因重叠
patterns.trigger: “orientation of two adjacent genes … was reverse and complementary”“transcripts mapping to the overlap”
patterns.context: 讨论相邻基因方向、转录本映射及基因重叠区。
patterns.domain: 微生物分子生物学论文

patterns.name: HIV-1 Nef基因结构
patterns.context: 介绍特定病毒基因的外显子数、长度及与邻近区域的重叠。

en.concept: Nucleic acid sequences and modifications in molecular biology
en.description: Activation occurs primarily for nucleic acid, gene, and molecular structure terminology in biomedical text, especially sequence-length figures and methylation modifications; it also responds to TATA promoter complexes and upstream conserved regulatory regions.

patterns.name: Nucleic acid sequence lengths and gene-structure figures
patterns.context: In descriptions of genes, biomolecules, or nucleic acids, numbers appear adjacent to length units, genomic regions, or sequence-structure information; tokens near numbers show prominent activation across different passages.
patterns.domain: Molecular biology, genetics, and biomedical papers

patterns.name: TATA promoter complex
patterns.context: Discusses transcription initiation or protein binding to promoter DNA; triggers are concentrated around the TATA box and related complex terminology.

patterns.name: Upstream regulatory regions and conserved sequences
patterns.context: In the context of gene expression regulation, describes the length, conservation, and function of promoters or upstream regions.

patterns.name: RNA modification names
patterns.context: Describes chemical modifications of RNA in transcriptomics or epitranscriptomics and includes specific modification names.

patterns.name: CpG cytosine methylation
patterns.context: Describes the proportion or sites of DNA methylation in eukaryotic genomes or related chromatin effects.

10_109.concept: 分子生物学中的核酸序列与修饰
10_109.description: 激活主要见于生物医学文本中的核酸、基因与分子结构术语，尤其是序列长度数字及甲基化修饰；另对 TATA 启动子复合物和上游保守调控区有反应。

patterns.name: 核酸序列长度与基因结构数字
patterns.trigger: 数字或数字范围及单位/序列术语，如“2,530 nucleotides”“620 nucleotides”“954 bp”“12,621 bp”“23 kb”“21–25 nucleotides”
patterns.context: 基因、生物分子或核酸的描述中，数字紧邻长度单位、基因组区域或序列结构信息；不同段落中数字附近的 token 激活突出。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、遗传学与生物医学论文

patterns.name: TATA 启动子复合物
patterns.context: 讨论转录起始或蛋白质与启动子 DNA 的结合；触发集中于 TATA 盒及其相邻复合物术语。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学论文/NIH 项目文本

patterns.name: 上游调控区与保守序列
patterns.trigger: “positive domain”“several hundred base long 5' upstream sequence”“highly conserved”
patterns.context: 基因表达调控语境，描述启动子或上游区域的长度、保守性及作用。
patterns.domain: 基因调控研究/NIH 项目文本

patterns.name: RNA 修饰名称
patterns.context: 描述转录组或表观转录组中的 RNA 化学修饰，并出现具体修饰名称。

patterns.name: CpG 胞嘧啶甲基化
patterns.context: 说明真核基因组 DNA 甲基化比例、位点或相关染色质效应。
patterns.domain: 表观遗传学/专利背景文本

en.description: All passages concern biomedical genes/nucleic acids, with particular emphasis on numerical sequence and protein lengths and positions; commonly accompanied by descriptions of gene coding, transcripts, RNA, ORFs, or regulation. Also includes sporadic patterns involving transcriptional regulation, protein variants, and sentence-initial continuation after citations.

patterns.name: Nucleic acid sequence lengths and numerical values
patterns.context: Reports precise values for sequence length, protein length, molecular weight, or position in biomedical text; activation often falls on numeric fragments, especially the final digit.
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper abstracts and main text, genome annotation

patterns.name: Gene transcripts and protein-coding descriptions
patterns.context: Centers on gene structure, transcript variants, encoded products, and their lengths, often occurring with exons, nucleotide counts, or ORF predictions.

patterns.name: RNA and nucleotide definitions
patterns.context: Introduces the classes, lengths, or functions of microRNAs; passages directly mention RNA molecules and their nucleotide counts.
patterns.domain: Main text of biomedical papers and literature reviews

patterns.name: Protein variants or structural differences
patterns.context: Compares differences in protein length, structure, or isoforms resulting from coding sequences or transcripts.

patterns.name: Promoters, transcription factors, and DNA binding
patterns.context: Describes binding or interactions between regulatory elements and transcription factors, often accompanied by site numbers or sequence information.
patterns.domain: Gene expression and transcription regulation research

patterns.name: Experimental gene cloning and expression
patterns.context: Reports the cloning and overexpression of plant-derived genes and characteristics of their encoded proteins.

patterns.name: Esterase genes and ORF annotation
patterns.context: Reports esterase-coding sequences and protein properties, or ORF predictions in plasmids/genomes; numerical sequence lengths are prominent.

patterns.name: Genome overlap and viral gene structure
patterns.context: Describes the exon count and nucleotide length of viral genes and their overlap with neighboring regions.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial continuation after citation markers
patterns.context: Appears after reference links, at the beginning of a sentence or paragraph; the local fragment itself is not clearly about lengths or gene coding.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central main text and citation-marker formatting

10_109.concept: 生物分子长度与序列注释
10_109.description: 所有段落均属生物医学基因/核酸语境，尤其突出数字化的序列、蛋白质长度与位置；常见伴随基因编码、转录本、RNA、ORF或调控描述。另有零星的转录调控、蛋白变体和引用后句首衔接模式。

patterns.name: 核酸序列长度与数值
patterns.trigger: 数字及单位/计量短语，如“21»-«25 nucleotides”“7«44 bp”“620 nucleotides”“30 amino acids”“317 amino acids”“2»1«.1”
patterns.context: 生物医学文本中报告序列长度、蛋白质长度、分子量或位置等精确数值；激活常落在数字片段，尤其是数字末位。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文摘要与正文、基因组注释

patterns.name: 基因转录本与蛋白质编码描述
patterns.context: 围绕基因结构、转录本变体、编码产物及其长度展开，常与外显子、核苷酸数或 ORF 预测同现。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学与基因组学论文

patterns.name: RNA 与核苷酸定义
patterns.context: 介绍 microRNA 的类别、长度或功能；段落中直接出现 RNA 分子及其核苷酸数。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文正文与文献综述

patterns.name: 蛋白质变体或结构差异
patterns.trigger: “stop codon”“carboxyl termin[i]”“longer”“Transcript variant”“skips an in-frame exon”“shorter protein”
patterns.context: 比较编码序列或转录本导致的蛋白质长度、结构或异构体差异。

patterns.name: 启动子、转录因子与 DNA 结合
patterns.context: 描述调控元件与转录因子之间的结合或相互作用，常伴随位点编号或序列信息。
patterns.domain: 基因表达与转录调控研究

patterns.name: 实验性基因克隆与表达
patterns.trigger: “was cloned and overexpressed in Escherichia coli”
patterns.context: 报告植物来源基因的克隆、过表达及其编码蛋白特征。

patterns.name: 酯酶基因及 ORF 注释
patterns.context: 报告酯酶编码序列、蛋白属性，或质粒/基因组的 ORF 预测；数值性序列长度很突出。
patterns.domain: 生物化学与基因组注释

patterns.name: 基因组重叠与病毒基因结构
patterns.trigger: “HIV-1 Nef gene”“single exon”“620 nucleotides”“partially overlaps a 3′-”
patterns.context: 说明病毒基因的外显子数、核苷酸长度及与邻近区域的重叠。

patterns.name: 参考文献标记后的句首衔接
patterns.trigger: “the early diagnosis and prognosis of CHD.”
patterns.context: 出现在参考文献链接之后、句子或段落开头；该局部片段本身不明显属于长度或基因编码描述。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 正文与引用标记格式

en.concept: Molecular biology entities and their structural descriptions
en.description: Primarily responds to definitions or structural descriptions of genes, RNA, proteins, and nucleic acid sequences in biomedical literature, often accompanied by lengths, units, sequences, and genomic information; also covers related content such as transcriptional regulation, gene cloning, and protein-length comparisons.

patterns.name: microRNA definitions and nucleotide lengths
patterns.context: Introduces the definition, size, and function of miRNAs in paper introductions or background sections; recurs in similar definitional sentences

patterns.name: Length descriptions of genes and nucleic acid sequences
patterns.context: Describes gene structure, nucleotide sequences, or coding length; no specific biological entity is required

patterns.name: Protein complexes and promoter binding
patterns.context: Describes transcription-initiation-related protein complexes and their DNA-binding sequences

patterns.name: Gene expression regulation and promoter response elements
patterns.context: Describes hormone regulation of gene expression and response elements in promoters

patterns.name: Esterase gene cloning and sequence analysis
patterns.context: Introduces the cloning, sequence, and length of a bacterial esterase gene

patterns.name: Plant protein gene cloning and length
patterns.context: Reports the cloning and expression of a plant-derived gene, and the length of the gene or protein

patterns.name: Stop codons and protein-length comparisons
patterns.context: Compares stop codons and protein-length differences in neurohypophyseal hormone-related cDNAs

patterns.name: NPM gene genomic structure
patterns.context: Describes the genomic span, location, and expression context of the human NPM1 gene

10_109.concept: 分子生物学实体及其结构描述
10_109.description: 主要响应生物医学文献中对基因、RNA、蛋白及核酸序列的定义或结构描述，常伴随长度、单位、序列和基因组信息；也覆盖转录调控、基因克隆及蛋白长度比较等相关内容。

patterns.name: microRNA 定义与核苷酸长度
patterns.trigger: “MicroRNAs”/“microRNAs”或“miRNAs”，并出现“small non-coding RNAs”及“21”至“25 nucleotides”一类表述
patterns.context: 论文引言或背景中介绍 miRNA 的定义、大小和功能；反复出现在相似的定义句中

patterns.name: 基因与核酸序列的长度描述
patterns.context: 描述基因结构、核苷酸序列或编码长度；不要求特定生物实体
patterns.domain: 分子生物学摘要或论文

patterns.name: 蛋白质复合物与启动子结合
patterns.context: 描述转录起始相关蛋白复合物及其 DNA 结合序列

patterns.name: 基因表达调控与启动子应答元件
patterns.context: 描述激素对基因表达的调控以及启动子上的应答元件

patterns.name: 酯酶基因克隆与序列分析
patterns.context: 介绍细菌酯酶基因的克隆、序列及长度

patterns.name: 植物蛋白基因克隆与长度
patterns.context: 报告植物来源基因的克隆、表达及基因或蛋白长度

patterns.name: 终止密码子与蛋白质长度比较
patterns.context: 比较神经垂体素相关 cDNA 中止止密码子及蛋白长度差异

patterns.name: NPM 基因基因组结构
patterns.trigger: “Structure and Expression of NPM Genes”“gene spans”“genomic region”“kb”“chromosome”
patterns.context: 描述人类 NPM1 基因的基因组跨度、位置及表达背景

en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly in descriptions of genes, RNA, and their structure or length in biomedical papers: these include microRNA definitions and naming or quantitative information about genes, transcripts, exons, regulatory sequences, and protein products.

patterns.name: microRNA definitions and characteristics
patterns.context: When introducing microRNAs, describes their length, coding properties, or biological functions immediately after the name or in the same sentence

patterns.name: Nucleotide lengths of genes or transcripts
patterns.context: Describes the length of a specific gene, cDNA, or transcript; common in abstracts on gene cloning and sequence analysis

patterns.name: Quantitative descriptions of gene structure or sequences
patterns.context: Includes structural descriptions such as gene-regulatory complexes, exon counts, or promoter coordinates; need not involve nucleotide length

patterns.name: unexplained: single gene names and protein product lengths
patterns.context: Describes plant proteins or gene products; locally resembles topics such as length, microRNA definitions, and gene structure, but lacks a clear shared trigger pattern

10_109.concept: 分子生物学序列描述
10_109.description: 激活主要集中于生物医学论文中基因、RNA及其结构或长度的描述：包括microRNA定义，以及基因、转录本、外显子、调控序列和蛋白产物的命名或定量信息。

patterns.name: microRNA 定义与特征
patterns.context: 介绍 microRNAs 时，紧接名称或在同一句中描述其长度、编码属性、生物功能

patterns.name: 基因或转录本的核苷酸长度
patterns.trigger: 数字与 «bp» 或 «nucleotides»，如 «7»«44»« bp»、«133»«5»« bp»、«620»« nucleotides»、«9»«54»« bp»
patterns.context: 描述特定基因、cDNA或转录本的长度；常见于基因克隆与序列分析摘要

patterns.name: 基因结构或序列的定量描述
patterns.context: 出现基因调控复合物、外显子数或启动子坐标等结构性描述；不要求涉及核苷酸长度
patterns.domain: 分子生物学及遗传学论文

patterns.name: unexplained：单个基因名称与蛋白产物长度
patterns.context: 植物蛋白或基因产物描述；与长度、microRNA定义及基因结构等主题有局部相似，但缺少清晰的共同触发形式

en.concept: Quantification and classification markers in scientific text
en.description: Most patterns involve numbers representing molecular lengths or quantities in biomedical text, especially numbers adjacent to units such as bp, nt, bases, nucleotides, or amino acids; there are also phoneme/vowel contrasts in phonetics and one unclear instance of 29.1.

patterns.name: Biomolecular lengths and quantities
patterns.context: Describes quantitative properties such as the length or copy number of genes, transcripts, RNA, or proteins in biomedical text; numbers are commonly followed by bp, nt, bases, nucleotides, or amino acids
patterns.domain: Molecular biology, genetics, and biomedical abstracts

patterns.name: Phoneme and vowel contrasts
patterns.context: Uses vowels in different words as contrasting examples when discussing phonetic representations or speech classification
patterns.domain: Phonetics and speech recognition patent background

patterns.name: Decimal values in technical text
patterns.context: A decimal value appears in a technical sentence about a protein complex and DNA sequence; the value's referent is unclear

10_109.concept: 科学文本中的定量与分类标记
10_109.description: 多数模式是生物医学文本中数字表示的分子长度或数量，尤其数字与 bp、nt、bases、nucleotides、amino acids 等单位相连；另有语音学中的 phoneme/元音对比，以及一处含义不明的 29.1。

patterns.name: 生物分子长度与数量
patterns.trigger: “954 bp”“1221 bp”“1335 bp”“744 bp”“∼22 nucleotides”“181 amino acids”“13 bases”“21nt”及数字与单位相连的表达
patterns.context: 生物医学文本中描述基因、转录本、RNA或蛋白质的长度、拷贝数等定量属性；常见数字后接 bp、nt、bases、nucleotides 或 amino acids
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、遗传学与生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 音位与元音对比
patterns.context: 讨论语音表征或语音分类时，以不同词中的元音作为对比例子
patterns.domain: 语音学、语音识别相关专利背景

patterns.name: 技术文本中的小数数值
patterns.context: 描述蛋白质复合物与 DNA 序列的技术性语句中出现小数数值；数值所指不清
patterns.domain: 生物分子研究计划摘要

en.concept: Descriptions of technical objects and structures
