en.description: Primarily responds to biomedical sequences and descriptions of their structure, labels, and genomic locations, often with specialized terminology, sequence lengths, and experimental language; also activates for speech-sound contrasts and explanations of electronic text typography.

patterns.name: Descriptions of biological gene and protein sequences
patterns.context: Describes genes, proteins, nucleic acid sequences, cloning, or expression; often includes length, structure, annotation, or experimental information.

patterns.name: N-terminal and molecular tags/domains
patterns.context: Describes protein termini, domains, or added tags in a molecular biology context.

patterns.name: Genomic locations and regional ranges
patterns.context: Describes upstream regions, clustering, or chromosomal locations of genes.

patterns.name: Speech phonemes and vowel contrasts
patterns.context: Discusses classifying speech by acoustic features and gives examples of words with similar pronunciations.

patterns.name: Gutenberg typography and font markers
patterns.context: Explains how font, ligatures, or capitalization are represented in electronic text.

10_109.concept: 技术性对象与结构描述
10_109.description: 主要响应生物医学序列及其结构、标签、基因组定位描述，常伴随专业名词、序列长度和实验语汇；另对语音音素对比与电子文本排版说明有激活。

patterns.name: 生物基因与蛋白质序列描述
patterns.context: 描述基因、蛋白质、核酸序列、克隆或表达；常出现长度、结构、注释或实验信息。

patterns.name: N-terminal与分子标签/结构域
patterns.context: 在分子生物学语境中说明蛋白质末端、结构域或附加标签。

patterns.name: 基因组位置与区域范围
patterns.context: 说明基因的上游区域、聚集方式或染色体位置。

patterns.name: 语音音素与元音对比
patterns.context: 讨论以声学特征对语音分类，并举发音相近词作例子。

patterns.name: Gutenberg排版与字体标记
patterns.context: 解释电子文本中的字体、连字或大小写格式表示。

en.concept: Sequence and molecular biology terminology in biomedicine
en.description: Primarily responds to nucleic acid and gene terminology, sequence notation, and numerical values in biomedical text: primers/PCR, mutations and frameshifts, RNA modifications, and miRNA definitions; also includes one distinct response to blood-written words in a horror plot.

patterns.name: DNA primers and amplicons
patterns.context: Describes primers, PCR amplification, fragment lengths, or nucleic acid sequences, often with base strings and direction markers
patterns.domain: Molecular biology methods and experimental papers

patterns.name: Gene variants and sequence annotation
patterns.context: Reports mutations, splicing abnormalities, frameshifts, and resulting changes in protein products, often with HGVS-style coordinates or amino acid variant notation

patterns.name: RNA modifications and nucleotide positions
patterns.context: Lists modified nucleosides in RNA and their positions

patterns.name: miRNA definitions and length ranges
patterns.context: Gives the class, length, and biological role of small RNAs

patterns.name: Blood-written words and escape narrative
patterns.context: In a horror-film plot description, a character sees capital letters written in blood

10_109.concept: 生物医学中的序列与分子生物学术语
10_109.description: 主要响应生物医学文本中的核酸与基因术语、序列记法和数值：引物/PCR、突变与移码、RNA修饰、miRNA定义；另有一次恐怖剧情中血写大字的独立响应。

patterns.name: DNA引物与扩增片段
patterns.context: 描述引物、PCR扩增、片段长度或核酸序列，常出现碱基串及方向标记
patterns.domain: 分子生物学方法与实验论文

patterns.name: 基因变异与序列注释
patterns.context: 报告突变、剪接异常、移码及其导致的蛋白产物变化，常带有HGVS式坐标或氨基酸变异记法

patterns.name: RNA修饰与核苷酸位置
patterns.context: 列举RNA中的修饰核苷及其所在位置

patterns.name: miRNA定义与长度范围
patterns.context: 给出小RNA的类别、长度和生物学作用

patterns.name: 血字样词语及逃跑叙事
patterns.context: 恐怖片情节描述中，人物看到以血写成的大写文字

en.description: Primarily responds to gene, protein, and nucleic acid terminology in biomedicine, especially mutations, frameshifts, sequence lengths, and experimental constructs; also includes descriptions of transcript structure and activation in a passage explaining characters.

patterns.name: Gene and protein experimental descriptions
patterns.context: Describes protein/gene cloning, expression vector construction, and protein tags; also includes genomic fragment amplification and terms such as ORF and start codon.
patterns.domain: Molecular biology paper methods and experimental descriptions

patterns.name: microRNA definitions and nucleotide lengths
patterns.context: Introduces microRNAs as small noncoding RNAs and gives their length or biological role.

patterns.name: Descriptions of mutations and protein consequences
patterns.context: Describes sequence variants and resulting frameshifts, deletions, truncations, or amino acid changes; includes variant nomenclature and case tables.
patterns.domain: Genetics, clinical molecular diagnostics, and disease research

patterns.name: Gene transcript structure and start codons
patterns.context: Discusses alternative promoters, different exons or transcripts at a locus, and AUG in the reading frame.
patterns.domain: Gene expression and developmental biology papers

patterns.name: Explanations of rare characters and pronunciation markers
patterns.context: Entry-style explanations of special characters, letter case, and diacritic representations; unrelated to biomedical content.

10_109.concept: 生物分子序列与注释术语
10_109.description: 主要响应生物医学中的基因、蛋白及核酸术语，尤其突变、移码、序列长度和实验构建；另见转录结构描述，并在一段字符说明文本中激活。

patterns.name: 基因与蛋白实验描述
patterns.context: 描述蛋白/基因克隆、表达载体构建及蛋白标签；也包括基因组片段扩增、ORF、起始密码子等术语。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学论文方法与实验描述

patterns.name: microRNA定义与核苷酸长度
patterns.context: 介绍microRNA为小型非编码RNA，并给出其长度或生物学作用。

patterns.name: 突变与蛋白后果表述
patterns.context: 描述序列变异及其导致的移码、缺失、截短或氨基酸改变；包括变异命名和病例表格。
patterns.domain: 遗传学、临床分子诊断与疾病研究

patterns.name: 基因转录结构与起始密码子
patterns.context: 讨论基因座的替代启动子、不同外显子或转录本，以及阅读框中的AUG。
patterns.domain: 基因表达与发育生物学论文

patterns.name: 稀有字符及读音标记说明
patterns.trigger: “[=o] represents lower case”“[)u] represents lower case”“THORN”“ESKIMO”
patterns.context: 以词条式说明特殊字符、字母大小写及变音符号的表示方法；与生物医学内容无关。
patterns.domain: 文本/字符编码说明，古腾堡电子书

en.concept: Biomedical molecular genetics text and a few anomalies
en.description: Primarily responds to biomedical genetics and molecular biology terminology, especially gene/transcript/protein structure, mutation and variant nomenclature, and microRNA length descriptions; also includes one instance of the uppercase blood-written “RUN” in a horror narrative.

patterns.name: Protein/gene structure and expression
patterns.context: Describes gene transcripts, exons, open reading frames, protein structure, or expression constructs in biomedical text; often accompanied by variant identifiers and molecular lengths.
patterns.domain: Molecular biology, gene, and protein research papers

patterns.name: Mutation and variant nomenclature
patterns.context: Lists gene variants in genetics or disease research, often in c./p. coordinate, amino acid substitution, or nonsense mutation formats.
patterns.domain: Medical genetics and clinical research abstracts

patterns.name: microRNA definitions and lengths
patterns.context: Introduces microRNA as short noncoding RNA and gives its approximate length of 21–25 nucleotides and function.

patterns.name: Command words in a bloody scene
patterns.context: In a horror story, a word appears in capital letters written in blood, as a warning or command within the scene.

10_109.concept: 生物医学分子遗传文本及少量异常
10_109.description: 主要响应生物医学遗传与分子生物学术语，尤其基因/转录本/蛋白结构、突变变异命名及microRNA长度描述；另有一次恐怖叙事中血写的大写“RUN”。

patterns.name: 蛋白质/基因结构与表达
patterns.trigger: “protein tyrosine phosphatase”“ORF”“N-terminal His tag”“in frame AUG”“alternate promoters”“exons”“transcript variant”“isoform”“amino acids”
patterns.context: 生物医学文本中说明基因转录本、外显子、开放阅读框、蛋白结构或表达构建体；常伴随变体编号与分子长度。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、基因与蛋白研究论文

patterns.name: 突变与变异命名
patterns.context: 遗传学或疾病研究中列出基因变异，常以 c./p. 坐标、氨基酸替换或终止突变格式呈现。
patterns.domain: 医学遗传学、临床研究摘要

patterns.name: microRNA定义与长度
patterns.context: 引介 microRNA 时描述其为短的非编码 RNA，并说明约 21–25 个核苷酸的长度及功能。
patterns.domain: 生物医学综述或论文引言

patterns.name: 血腥场景中的命令词
patterns.context: 恐怖故事叙述中，词语以大写形式写在血迹上，作为场景内的警告或命令。

en.description: Activations appear across several common words and phrases: frameworks in multiple-domain contexts, the title words Episode and Enquiry, and local words in medical, technical, and email contexts. Aside from frameworks, there is no stable shared context.

patterns.name: Final-word activation on frameworks
patterns.context: Appears near the end of a phrase or sentence; marked in [1], [8], and [10].
patterns.domain: Academic text, technical Q&A, software documentation

patterns.name: Episode
patterns.context: Appears in the title information for the television show “I’ve Got a Secret”.

patterns.name: Enquiry
patterns.context: First word of a film entry title.

patterns.name: classification
patterns.context: Appears in a question about logistic regression.

patterns.name: combination
patterns.context: Appears in a review of combination treatment approaches for alcohol dependence.

patterns.name: protection
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of an abstract on T-cell line protection research.

patterns.name: energy production
patterns.context: Used with “production” to describe ketone bodies as fuel.

patterns.name: Departure/farewell wording
patterns.context: Appears in a farewell email stating the last day at Enron.

patterns.name: Unclear local activation
patterns.context: Appears in materials-science terminology for metal-organic frameworks; the specific trigger is difficult to determine from the fragment alone.

10_574.description: 激活散见于若干常见词及短语：多领域语境中的 frameworks，以及标题词 Episode、Enquiry 和医学、技术、邮件语境中的局部词语。除 frameworks 外，缺乏稳定共同上下文。

patterns.name: frameworks 的末词激活
patterns.context: 出现在短语或句子的结尾附近；在 [1]、[8]、[10] 均被标记。
patterns.domain: 学术文本、技术问答、软件文档

patterns.name: Episode
patterns.context: 出现在电视节目标题 “I’ve Got a Secret” 的标题信息中。

patterns.name: Enquiry
patterns.context: 作为电影条目标题的词首。

patterns.name: classification
patterns.context: 出现在有关逻辑回归的问句中。

patterns.name: combination
patterns.context: 出现在关于酒精依赖治疗方案组合的综述中。

patterns.name: protection
patterns.context: 出现在 T 细胞系保护研究的摘要开头。

patterns.name: energy production
patterns.context: 与 “production” 连用，描述酮体作为燃料。

patterns.name: departure/farewell wording
patterns.context: 出现在告别邮件中，说明离开 Enron 的最后一天。

patterns.name: 未明的局部激活
patterns.context: 出现在金属有机框架的材料术语中；仅凭片段难以判断具体触发因素。

en.description: Activations span several types of contexts: energy-related words in academic text, proper nouns or technical compounds, document labels and formatting symbols, title tokens, and code identifiers. Aside from local token/formatting features, no unified semantic pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Energy-related academic phrasing
patterns.context: In scientific abstracts or papers, energy co-occurs with words such as fuel, production, and activation; examples come from different research fields.

patterns.name: Proper nouns and technical terms in compounds
patterns.context: Activations fall on tokens that form parts of proper nouns, terms, or compound words; local contexts differ considerably, with no stable shared collocation.
patterns.domain: Materials science, biographical entries, programming Q&A, biomedicine, website Q&A

patterns.name: Section headings and formatting markers
patterns.context: Section markers, divider lines, and line breaks appear at the start of a document or near a heading, adjacent to following materials-science text.

patterns.name: Tokens in titles/show names
patterns.context: Multiple adjacent tokens activate in title-like phrases consisting of a person's name and a show title.

patterns.name: Abstract and question labels
patterns.context: Opening labels in abstracts or Q&A text, usually followed immediately by a line break.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and attribute assignments
patterns.context: Class names, attribute names, and assignment statements in code; identifiers often consist of multiple tokens.

10_574.description: 激活分布于多类场景：学术文本中的 energy 相关词、专名或技术复合词、文档标签与排版符号、标题词元及代码标识符。除局部词元/格式特征外，未见统一语义模式。

patterns.name: energy 相关学术表述
patterns.context: 科技摘要或论文语境中，energy 与 fuel、production、activation 等词搭配；出现于不同研究领域。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、机器学习、化学

patterns.name: 复合术语中的专名与技术词
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、术语或复合词的组成 token 上；各例局部上下文差异较大，未见稳定共同搭配。
patterns.domain: 材料科学、人物条目、编程问答、生物医学、网站问答

patterns.name: 分节标题及排版标记
patterns.context: 文档开头或标题附近，出现章节标记、分隔线和换行；与后续材料科学文字相邻。

patterns.name: 标题/节目名称中的词元
patterns.context: 人名与节目标题构成的标题式短语中，多个相邻词元有激活。

patterns.name: 摘要与问题标签
patterns.context: 摘要或问答正文的开头标签，通常紧接换行。

patterns.name: 代码标识符及属性赋值
patterns.context: 代码中类名、属性名及赋值语句，标识符常由多个 token 拼成。

en.concept: new and various local word-form features
en.description: The most stable cross-segment signal is new (appearing in all 9 segments); in addition, Enquiry, scientific term fragments, sidelines, general prose phrases, and pathology markers each show local activation, with no shared semantics or unified context apparent.

patterns.name: Activation on new
patterns.context: new is marked across multiple domains and syntactic positions; the context does not require a particular sense or fixed collocation.

patterns.name: Enquiry title word
patterns.context: Enquiry is split into subwords and appears in a film entry title and its opening text; activation is concentrated on the initial subword and stem.

patterns.name: Specific scientific term fragments
patterns.context: These are subword fragments within scientific terms across different words and domains, with no unified semantics or stable syntactic context apparent.
patterns.domain: Biomedicine, neuroscience, physics, and mass spectrometry

patterns.name: Repetition and compounds of sidelines
patterns.context: Appears in “on the sidelines” and the repeated emphasis “the sidelines of coal-fired generation,” including a word-final fragment and a repeated phrase.

patterns.name: General vocabulary and phrases in prose
patterns.context: Several ordinary words and phrases in the same passage are marked, spanning sentence openings, idioms, and proper nouns; no trigger condition consistently grouping these with other activations is apparent.

patterns.name: Disease markers and pathological expressions
patterns.context: In medical text describing metastatic patterns and immunohistochemical markers, multiple markers, disease-name fragments, and expression-related words are marked; new also appears in the same passage.

10_574.concept: new 与多种局部词形特征
10_574.description: 最稳定的跨段信号是 new（9段均出现）；此外，Enquiry、科学术语片段、sidelines、一般散文词组及病理标记各有局部激活，未显出共同语义或统一上下文。

patterns.name: new 的激活
patterns.context: 在多个领域和句法位置中，new 均被标记；上下文并不要求特定词义或固定搭配。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：摘要、论文、网页、邮件

patterns.name: Enquiry 标题词
patterns.context: 词语 Enquiry 被拆分为子词，出现在电影条目标题及其开头正文；激活集中在词首子词和词干部分。

patterns.name: 特定科学词汇片段
patterns.context: 这些是跨词汇、跨领域的科学术语内部子词片段，未见统一语义或稳定的句法上下文。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、神经科学、物理学及质谱分析

patterns.name: sidelines 的重复及复合形式
patterns.context: 出现在“on the sidelines”及重复强调的“the sidelines of coal-fired generation”中，包含词尾片段和重复词组。

patterns.name: 散文中的一般词汇与短语
patterns.trigger: «could»4« be»7« made»6…；«Looking»5« at»7；«boom»4« and»5« bust»4；«Information»5« Age»8
patterns.context: 同一段中若干普通词和短语被标记，跨越句首、习语及专名；看不出能与其他激活一致归并的触发条件。

patterns.name: 疾病标志物及病理表达
patterns.context: 在描述转移模式及免疫组化标志物的医学文字中，多个标记、病名片段和表达相关词被标记；同段另有 new。

en.description: The most consistent signal is the occurrence of “of” in fixed phrases and compound structures; the patent trademark Track®, Hear in references, and the name Hearon also trigger strong activation, with the latter two possibly reflecting coincidental word forms or tokens.

patterns.name: “of” followed by a compound
patterns.context: Activation falls on the preposition of or its split token, often inside fixed phrases, compound structures, or noun phrases; it is sometimes accompanied by a hyphen, but this is not required.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; academic, Q&A, legal, patent, and technical texts

patterns.name: Patent trademark symbol
patterns.context: Strong activation appears near the registered mark at the end of a brand name.

patterns.name: Hear in a bibliography
patterns.context: Appears in the phrase “hear an online story” in a reference; activation is concentrated on Hear.

patterns.name: Hear in a person's name
patterns.context: Appears in the patent inventor name David D. Hearon; activation crosses the subword boundary in the name.

10_574.description: 最一致的信号是“of”及其固定短语、复合结构中的出现；此外，专利商标 Track®、参考资料中的 Hear 和人名 Hearon 也触发强激活，后二者可能是词形或 token 偶合。

patterns.name: “of” 后接复合词
patterns.context: 激活落在介词 of 或其分词 token 上，多见于固定短语、复合结构或名词短语内部；有时伴随连接符，但不是必要条件。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；学术、问答、法律、专利及技术文本

patterns.name: 专利商标标记
patterns.context: 商标名末尾的注册标记附近出现较强激活。

patterns.name: 书目中的 Hear
patterns.context: 出现在参考资料中“hear an online story”这一短语，激活集中于 Hear。
patterns.domain: 百科全书参考资料／媒体链接

patterns.name: 人名中的 Hear
patterns.context: 出现在专利发明人姓名 David D. Hearon 内，激活跨越姓名的子词边界。

en.description: Activations are scattered across technical and legal texts: fly/flyback, cost and cost-effectiveness, the string En, and Recognizing; they also respond to astrophysical slow, circuit design, monitoring-sensor vocabulary, and Kubernetes template identifiers. There is no stable semantic pattern sufficient to unify these examples.

patterns.name: “fly” lexical trigger
patterns.context: The word fly appears in technical contexts: [1] has on the fly; [9] has it as part of flyback.
patterns.domain: Software license text; electronic circuit Q&A

patterns.name: Cost and cost-effectiveness terminology
patterns.context: Discussions of cost, avoided cost, or cost-effectiveness; activation focuses on cost or related compounds.
patterns.domain: Health economics abstract; energy regulatory legal text; health-monitoring patent

patterns.name: En Banc string in legal documents
patterns.context: En is followed by different continuations: in one case it forms En Banc, and in another it appears in the name Ennis; the shared trigger seems to be En after tokenization.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions and legal filings

patterns.name: Recognizing word-form fragment
patterns.context: Recognizing appears at the beginning of a sentence in legal discussion, followed by a discussion of discovery; no other similar example is apparent.

patterns.name: Slow phenomena in astrophysics
patterns.context: Discusses research related to solar flares, describing observational features such as long periods and slow propagation.

patterns.name: Path and voltage vocabulary in circuit text
patterns.context: Explains the operating range of the forward path and its design considerations; in addition to fly, several circuit terms show moderate activation.

patterns.name: Monitoring and sensor vocabulary in patent text
patterns.context: Lists health-monitoring tasks, fault identification, and sensor data acquisition; low-cost phrasing also appears.

patterns.name: Software services and license phrasing
patterns.context: Discusses conducting business without disclosing proprietary application source code, with examples of providing services on demand and PDF.

patterns.name: Helm templates and Kubernetes service identifiers
patterns.context: Template variables and a tokenized service name appear in DNS configuration.

10_574.description: 激活分散于技术与法律文本：fly/flyback、cost及成本效用、En 字串和 Recognizing；另响应天体物理 slow、电路设计、监测传感词汇及 Kubernetes 模板标识符。缺少足以统一这些模式的稳定语义。

patterns.name: “fly”词汇触发
patterns.context: 单词 fly 出现在技术语境中：[1] 为 on the fly；[9] 为 flyback 的词内部分。
patterns.domain: 软件许可文本；电子电路问答

patterns.name: 成本及成本效用术语
patterns.context: 围绕成本、避免成本或成本效用的讨论；激活重点落在 cost 或相关复合表达。
patterns.domain: 医学经济学摘要；能源监管法律文本；健康监测专利

patterns.name: 法律文书中的 En Banc 字串
patterns.context: En 后接不同续文：一处组成 En Banc，一处出现在人名 Ennis 中；共同触发似乎是分词后的 En。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决及诉讼文书

patterns.name: Recognizing 词形片段
patterns.context: 法律论述中句首出现 Recognizing，后续谈及 discovery；未见其他同类例子。

patterns.name: 天体物理中的慢速现象
patterns.context: 讨论太阳耀斑相关研究，描述长周期、低速传播等观测特征。

patterns.name: 电路文本中的路径与电压词汇
patterns.context: 说明 forward path 的运行范围及其设计注意事项；除 fly 外也有若干中等激活的电路词汇。

patterns.name: 专利文本中的监测与传感词汇
patterns.context: 列举健康监测任务、故障识别及传感器数据获取；同时出现低成本表述。

patterns.name: 软件服务与许可证表述
patterns.trigger: [1] «offering»6« paid»5« services»；«serving»4« PD»3«Fs»3« on»5« the»1« fly»10
patterns.context: 讨论在不公开自有应用源代码时开展商业活动，举例说明按需提供服务及 PDF。

patterns.name: Helm 模板与 Kubernetes 服务标识符
patterns.context: 模板变量和被切分的服务名称出现在 DNS 配置中。

en.description: Activations span various specialist terms, compound-word fragments, patent/paper citation numbers, forum sentences, and word-initial fragments; there is no stable semantic theme shared across all segments.

patterns.name: Phrase continuation and sentence-final expression
patterns.context: In a Hacker News colloquial comment, an earlier sentence poses a question; activation centers on take and the following question mark, followed by a short evaluative phrase.

patterns.name: Patent terminology, abbreviations, and technical terms
patterns.context: In patent background text, activation falls on compound technical terms, connecting structures, resource-consumption expressions, and words related to wireless systems.

patterns.name: Entomology paper citation identifier
patterns.context: In PubMed Central text, activation is strongly concentrated on insects and the number field in a reference identifier; nearby text discusses bacterial symbiosis, insect ecology, sensory modalities, and related topics.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in a game review
patterns.context: A forum comment discusses cooperative support and the gaming experience; activation falls on the tokenized fragments of co-op and the truncated fin… fragment.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in general narrative
patterns.context: In a personal anecdote about battery life, activation falls on the initial fragment of finally; the context has no apparent connection to other technical or citation patterns.

patterns.name: Neuroscience compound terms
patterns.context: In abstract-style technical phrasing, activation occurs at the beginnings or within terms such as activity-dependent, slow, and hyperpolarization.

10_574.description: 激活分布于多种专业词、复合词片段和专利/论文引用编号，也包括论坛语句及词首片段；未见所有段落共享的稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 短语续写与句末表达
patterns.context: 在 HackerNews 口语评论中，前文先提出问题，激活集中于 take 及其后的问号；后接评价性短句。

patterns.name: 专利术语、缩写及技术名词
patterns.context: 专利背景技术中，激活落在复合技术词、连接结构、资源消耗表述及无线系统相关词上。

patterns.name: 昆虫学论文引用编号
patterns.trigger: «insects»9、«insects»10，以及重复出现的 «B»数字-…-insects-… 引文串
patterns.context: PubMed Central 文本里，激活强烈集中于参考文献标识符中的 insects 和编号字段；附近讨论细菌共生、昆虫生态、感觉模态等。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及其引用

patterns.name: 游戏评论中的词内片段
patterns.context: 论坛评论谈到游戏合作支持与游戏体验；激活落在 co-op 的分词片段，以及被截断的 fin… 词片段。

patterns.name: 普通叙述中的词内片段
patterns.context: 电池寿命的个人轶事中，激活落在 finally 的词首片段；上下文与其他技术或引用模式无明显联系。

patterns.name: 神经科学复合术语
patterns.context: 摘要式专业表述中，激活位于 activity-dependent、slow、hyperpolarization 等术语开头或组成部分。

en.description: Activations are scattered across bird names, legal monetary caps, material optical properties, chargebacks, watch sizes, and specialist words and term fragments in technical papers and code; there is no consistent cross-domain semantic theme.

patterns.name: Devices, materials, and optical properties
patterns.context: Describes how SIL is manufactured, its materials, and refractive index; may also include a truncated term fragment.

patterns.name: Routers and network connections
patterns.context: Includes network terms such as ingress/egress and LSP, or connection hubs and transmission systems between power units.

patterns.name: Machine learning parameters and training
patterns.context: Discusses neural-network convolutional modules, the number of trainable parameters, and their relation to other operations.

patterns.name: Quantum state preparation and instruction sets
patterns.context: Explains how Alice uses a classical instruction set according to a probability distribution for state preparation.

patterns.name: Calling and removing callbacks
patterns.context: Code iterates over or removes callbacks that have already fired, with loop-control statements also present.

patterns.name: Refunds and chargebacks
patterns.context: Even after a merchant issues a refund or a customer changes their mind, the merchant may still face a complicated chargeback process.

patterns.name: Watch size and wrist circumference
patterns.context: Describes a product style as relatively small and suitable for customers with smaller wrists.

patterns.name: Monetary caps and per-item amounts
patterns.context: Legal text discusses the maximum allowable amount or compensation cap per item.

patterns.name: List of bird names
patterns.context: Bird species are listed with commas; strong activation occurs within several kingfisher names.

10_574.description: 激活分散于鸟名、法律金额上限、材料光学性质、拒付、腕表尺寸，以及技术论文和代码中的专业词与术语片段；没有跨领域一致的语义主题。

patterns.name: 器件、材料及光学性质
patterns.context: 描述 SIL 的制造方式、材料及折射率；也可能包含截断的术语片段。

patterns.name: 路由器及网络连接
patterns.context: 出现 ingress/egress、LSP 等网络术语，或电力单元之间的连接枢纽与传输系统。

patterns.name: 机器学习参数与训练
patterns.context: 讨论神经网络卷积模块、可训练参数数量及其与其他操作的关系。

patterns.name: 量子态制备与指令集
patterns.context: 说明 Alice 按概率分布使用经典指令集进行态制备。

patterns.name: 回调的调用与移除
patterns.context: 代码中遍历或移除已触发的回调，并出现循环控制语句。

patterns.name: 退款与拒付
patterns.context: 商户退款或改变顾客想法后，仍需面对复杂的拒付流程。

patterns.name: 手表尺寸与腕围
patterns.context: 描述产品款式相对小巧，适合腕围较小的顾客。

patterns.name: 金额上限与单件计额
patterns.context: 法律条文讨论每件物品的最高可允许金额或赔偿上限。

patterns.name: 鸟类名称列表
patterns.context: 以逗号分隔列举鸟种，多个 kingfisher 名称内部出现强激活片段。

en.description: Activations are distributed across legal citations and case-file formatting, webpages and vacation promotional copy, Hacker News quotations, and technical discussions; marked items include citation page numbers, common function words, domain terms, word-form fragments, and formatting symbols, with no stable cross-domain trigger feature apparent.

patterns.name: Inline legal citation numbers
patterns.context: In a case citation, a page number follows “at”; the same passage also contains a volume number, court name, and citation page number.

patterns.name: Function words and navigation phrasing in webpage copy
patterns.context: Multiple common conjunctions, prepositions, and related word fragments are marked in webpage introductions, directories, or promotional text.

patterns.name: Repeated phrases and punctuation in quoted text
patterns.context: A repeated sentence in a Hacker News quote block; it recurs in both the body and quotation, with markings concentrated on common words and angle brackets in the quote.

patterns.name: Emphasis words in technical discussion
patterns.context: Adverbs of degree and word-form fragments spanning tokens are marked in a discussion of engineers' work and software development.

patterns.name: Local word fragments in technical text
patterns.context: Username/text fragments appear between Q&A or comments, with activation on incomplete letter sequences; bootload and other words appear later.

patterns.name: Car-related word car
patterns.context: Refers to vehicles, crash testing, or cars in a legal context; markings cover only car and nearby word fragments.
patterns.domain: Automotive discussion; also found in legal text

patterns.name: Formatting and litigation terminology in legal documents
patterns.context: Legal materials contain causes of action, statutes, case numbers, and pagination/formatting symbols; sporadic markings fall on articles, terms, and numbers.

patterns.name: Activity and place words in vacation promotions
patterns.context: Resort promotions describe leisure activities, facilities, and locations; several activity words and imperative words are marked.

10_574.description: 激活分布于法律引文及案卷格式、网页和度假宣传文案、HN 引用与技术讨论；标记落在引文页码、常见功能词、领域词、词形片段和排版符号上，未见跨领域稳定触发特征。

patterns.name: 行内法律引文编号
patterns.context: 判例引文中的“at”后跟页码；同段还有卷号、法院名及引文页码

patterns.name: 网页文案中的功能词与导航表达
patterns.trigger: «for»5« comprehensive»2 information« on»2« autism»1«,»3« As»5«per»1«ger»1 syndrome
patterns.context: 网页介绍、目录或宣传文字中，多个常见连接词、介词及相关词片段被标记

patterns.name: 引用文本中的重复短语及标点
patterns.trigger: «>»1；« the»2« opportunity»5« to»10« access»2 the« UK»2« market»4
patterns.context: HN 引用块中的重复句子；正文与引用部分复现，标记集中在引用中的常见词和尖括号
patterns.domain: Hacker News 转载／引用文本

patterns.name: 技术讨论中的强调词
patterns.context: 讨论工程师工作与软件开发时，强调程度的副词及跨 token 的词形片段

patterns.name: 技术文本中的局部词片段
patterns.context: 问答或评论之间出现的用户名／文本片段，激活落在不完整的字母片段；后文另有 bootload 等词

patterns.name: 汽车相关词 car
patterns.context: 谈及车辆、碰撞测试或法律语境中的汽车用法；标记仅覆盖 car 及邻近词片段
patterns.domain: 汽车讨论；另见法律文本

patterns.name: 法律文书中的格式与诉讼术语
patterns.context: 法律材料中出现诉因、法案、案件编号及分页／排版符号；零散标记落在冠词、术语和编号上

patterns.name: 度假宣传中的活动与地点词
patterns.trigger: «ball»6«.»7« Play»4« as»6« you»7« enjoy»4；« Newport»3« Beach»6« resort»4
patterns.context: 度假村宣传介绍休闲活动、设施和地点；多个活动词与祈使句词语被标记

en.description: Activations are scattered across local fragments from different domains: currency symbols, URL and name fragments, chemical formula letters, code identifiers, case numbers and dense numerals, email subject words, and case-name initials; no unified semantics or stable context is apparent.

patterns.name: Currency symbol and amount
patterns.context: A news account gives the “$11 billion” amount for HP’s acquisition of Autonomy; strong activation falls on the currency symbol.

patterns.name: Surname fragment in a URL
patterns.context: Appears in the name fragment “malte-spitz” in a German news website URL.

patterns.name: Reddit fragment in a URL
patterns.context: Appears within the “reddit” path fragment of a news article URL.

patterns.name: B in a chemical formula
patterns.context: Appears in the vitamin B12-related chemical name “B12-HBI”.

patterns.name: pre fragment in code
patterns.context: Appears in the configuration or code text “preproc=False”.

patterns.name: Legal case-number digits
patterns.context: Appears in the court file number “12-109420”.

patterns.name: Price-formatting function
patterns.context: Appears in the code function name “moneyFormatFloor”; nearby code handles price text.

patterns.name: Dense numeric data
patterns.context: Values are separated by spaces and decimal points, appearing as a multiline numeric table or data record.

patterns.name: Expense in an email subject
patterns.context: Appears in the email subject “Concur Expense Document”.

patterns.name: Initials in a case name
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of the name “Kirkman” in a case citation.

10_574.description: 激活分散在不同领域的局部片段：金额符号、URL与人名片段、化学式字母、代码标识符、案号与密集数字、邮件主题词及判例姓名首字母；未见统一语义或稳定上下文。

patterns.name: 货币符号与金额
patterns.context: 新闻叙述中出现 HP 收购 Autonomy 的“$11 billion”金额；强激活落在货币符号。

patterns.name: URL 中的姓氏片段
patterns.context: 出现在德国新闻网站 URL 的人名片段“malte-spitz”。

patterns.name: URL 中的 Reddit 片段
patterns.context: 出现在新闻文章 URL 的“reddit”路径片段内。

patterns.name: 化学式中的 B
patterns.context: 出现在维生素 B12 相关化学名称“B12-HBI”中。

patterns.name: 代码中的 pre 片段
patterns.context: 出现在配置或代码文本“preproc=False”中。

patterns.name: 法律案号数字
patterns.context: 出现在法院文件编号“12-109420”中。

patterns.name: 价格格式化函数
patterns.context: 出现在代码函数名“moneyFormatFloor”中，附近代码处理价格文本。

patterns.name: 密集数字数据
patterns.context: 数值以空格和小数点分隔，呈现为多行数字表格或数据记录。

patterns.name: 邮件主题中的 Expense
patterns.context: 出现在邮件主题“Concur Expense Document”中。

patterns.name: 判例人名首字母
patterns.context: 出现在判例引用的人名“Kirkman”开头。

en.concept: Salient subwords and formatting fragments in heterogeneous text
en.description: Activations span subwords in URLs and rare proper nouns, chemical terms, code identifiers, and numbers, spaces, and punctuation in tables/YAML; a few ordinary English content words also activate. The commonality appears to be sensitivity to salient, segmented, or formatted tokens in heterogeneous text, rather than a stable semantic feature.

patterns.name: Encoded and domain fragments in URLs
patterns.context: Domains, paths, or personal names in URLs are split into multiple subwords; activations are distributed across the URL and nearby characters.

patterns.name: Numbers and separators in structured data
patterns.context: Aligned spaces, numbers, punctuation, and boundary symbols in tables, range conditions, or serialized configurations; these do not depend on natural-language semantics.
patterns.domain: Q&A formatting, code output, and Unity YAML, [4][6][9]

patterns.name: Code identifiers and mixed-case strings
patterns.context: Class names, variable names, HTML/PHP fragments, and long identifiers composed of letters, numbers, and mixed case appear in code; activations fall on subword fragments of the identifiers.

patterns.name: In-word subword segmentation and technical terms
patterns.context: Complex chemical names, abbreviations, and their punctuation are split into multiple tokens; activation is concentrated on character fragments within terms.

patterns.name: Internal fragments of proper nouns or rare words
patterns.context: Names, brands, or rare proper nouns are split into irregular subwords; evidence here is limited and overlaps with the segmentation seen in URLs/code.

patterns.name: Semantic words in ordinary English narrative
patterns.context: Some content words activate in natural-language news or comment sentences, but there is no obvious unified meaning or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Business news, forum comments, and sports news, [1][7][10]

10_574.concept: 异质文本中的显著子词与格式片段
10_574.description: 激活遍布网址和罕见专名的子词、化学术语、代码标识符，以及表格/YAML中的数字、空格和标点；少数普通英文内容词也激活。共同点更像对异质文本中显著、分段或格式化的token敏感，而非稳定语义特征。

patterns.name: URL中的编码与域名片段
patterns.context: 网址中的域名、路径或个人姓名被拆分为多个子词；激活分散在URL及其附近字符。

patterns.name: 结构化数据中的数字与分隔符
patterns.context: 表格、范围条件或序列化配置中的对齐空格、数字、标点和边界符号；不依赖自然语言语义。
patterns.domain: 问答排版、代码输出与Unity YAML，[4][6][9]

patterns.name: 代码标识符和混合大小写字符串
patterns.context: 代码中的类名、变量名、HTML/PHP片段以及由字母、数字和大小写组成的长标识符；激活落在标识符的子词片段上。

patterns.name: 词内子词切分及技术术语
patterns.context: 复杂化学名称、缩写及其标点被切成多个token；激活集中于术语内部的字符片段。

patterns.name: 专名或罕见词的内部片段
patterns.context: 姓名、品牌或罕见专名被分成不规则子词；此处证据有限，且与网址/代码中的切分现象有交叠。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道及代码字符串，[1][3][5]

patterns.name: 普通英文叙述中的语义词
patterns.context: 自然语言新闻或评论句中若干内容词会激活，但没有明显统一的词义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 商业新闻、论坛评论及体育新闻，[1][7][10]

en.description: Activations are scattered across URLs, bibliographic citations, monetary amounts, years and segmented proper nouns, technical terms, and interface quotations. They occur mostly in structured or tokenized strings, with no single stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: URL and domain fragments
patterns.context: Punctuation, numbers, and word fragments are mixed and marked in long URLs, domains, or paths; local activations concentrate on URL character sequences rather than complete semantic sentences.
patterns.domain: Web links, news sites, and HackerNews text

patterns.name: Reference numbers and citation markers
patterns.context: Bracketed reference markers, citation numbers, and their alphanumeric fragments in biomedical papers; surrounding text concerns chemistry, biology, or medicine.

patterns.name: Number, amount, and identifier formats
patterns.context: Number strings are split into tokens, especially decimals, dollar amounts, and comma-separated amounts; their specific semantics vary.
patterns.domain: Code/data text, legal and tax text

patterns.name: Numeric years and subwords in company names
patterns.context: Years and segmented proper-name subwords activate locally when describing company history; most other narrative words are unmarked.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments of car audio terminology
patterns.context: Compound names or technical terms are split and activated in hardware contexts discussing Mustang-style CVR, terminals, and connectors.

patterns.name: Quoted titles and proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Interface quotations, titles, or proper names are segmented when introducing an academic search site; academic search terms such as Chemistry, papers, and cited also appear.

10_574.concept: 结构化字符串与分词边界
10_574.description: 激活分散于网址、文献引文、数字金额、年份与专名切分、技术名词及界面引文；多出现在结构化或被分词的字符串中，但没有单一稳定的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: URL与域名片段
patterns.context: 长 URL、域名或路径中的标点、数字与词片段被混合标记；局部激活集中在网址字符序列，而非完整语义句子。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、新闻网站与 HackerNews 文本

patterns.name: 参考文献编号与引文标识
patterns.context: 生物医学论文中的方括号参考文献标记、文献编号及其字母数字片段；周围正文涉及化学、生物或医学。

patterns.name: 数字、金额与编号格式
patterns.context: 数字串被切分成 token，尤其是带小数点的数字，或美元金额及逗号分隔的金额；具体语义不一致。
patterns.domain: 代码/数据文本、法律税务文本

patterns.name: 数字年份及公司名中的子词
patterns.context: 叙述公司历史时，年份和被切分的专名子词局部激活；其余叙事词大多未标记。

patterns.name: 汽车音响术语的分词片段
patterns.context: 在讨论 Mustang 风格 CVR、接线柱和连接器的硬件语境中，复合名称或技术词被拆分并激活。
patterns.domain: 产品讨论/技术论坛文本

patterns.name: 引用标题与专名片段
patterns.context: 介绍学术搜索网站时，界面引文、标题或专名被切分；同时出现 Chemistry、papers、cited 等学术检索词。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 产品/学术搜索讨论

en.description: Activations occur in various segmented structured strings: URLs, numeric ranges, paper citations, hexadecimal signatures, code constants, and content words in book titles. Weaker activations also appear on connective expressions in academic prose.

patterns.name: URL and path fragments
patterns.context: Domains, paths, and numeric IDs in URLs or links are split into subwords; «sp» in the path is especially prominent in the first segment.

patterns.name: Numeric binning tables
patterns.context: Rows and columns in tables express numeric ranges using inequality signs and sequences of values.

patterns.name: Bibliographic and biomedical citation markers
patterns.context: Bracketed citations, reference numbers, or figure/table citations in biomedical papers; often mixed with letters, numbers, hyphens, and punctuation.

patterns.name: Hexadecimal signature strings
patterns.context: Long strings of hexadecimal characters in JSON field values, split into multiple short fragments.

patterns.name: Uppercase constant identifiers in code
patterns.context: In Java calls, package or action names appear as uppercase constants separated by underscores.

patterns.name: Words in book titles
patterns.context: Multiple English content words appear in title case in titles or repeated book names, often split into within-word subfragments.

patterns.name: Connective expressions in academic prose
patterns.context: Connects purpose, comparisons, or supplementary examples in academic explanatory sentences; a reference marker also appears at the end of the same passage.

10_574.concept: 结构化文本片段与标识符
10_574.description: 激活见于多种被切分的结构化字符串：网址、数字区间、论文引用、十六进制签名、代码常量及书名实词；另在学术论述连接词上出现较弱激活。

patterns.name: 网址与路径片段
patterns.context: URL 或链接中，域名、路径和数字 ID 被切分成子词；第1段尤其突出路径中的 «sp»。

patterns.name: 数字分箱表格
patterns.context: 表格行列中，数字区间以不等号和连续数值表示。

patterns.name: 文献与生物医学引用标识
patterns.context: 生物医学论文正文中的方括号引用、文献编号或图表引用；常与字母、数字、连字符及标点混排。

patterns.name: 十六进制签名串
patterns.context: JSON 字段值中的长串十六进制字符，按多个短片段切分。

patterns.name: 代码中的大写常量标识符
patterns.context: Java 代码调用中，包名或动作名以大写、下划线分隔的常量形式出现。

patterns.name: 书名标题词
patterns.context: 标题或重复书名中，多个英文实词以标题式大小写排列，且常被拆成词内子片段。
patterns.domain: 书籍标题/家居装修指南

patterns.name: 论文论述连接表达
patterns.context: 学术说明句中连接目的、比较关系或举例补充；同段末尾还带有参考文献标识。

en.concept: Boundaries and code strings in structured text
en.description: Primarily responds to URLs, punctuation, and segmented alphanumeric strings; also appears in bibliographic citations, product models, XML tags, table missing values, and email headers. Activations on ordinary English word fragments lack a clear explanation.

patterns.name: URL and domain fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on URL protocols, punctuation, domains, and paths; sometimes only segmented word fragments are hit.
patterns.domain: Web links, HackerNews quotations, and URLs in code

patterns.name: Numbers and numeric strings
patterns.context: Numeric strings are often embedded in structures such as URLs, product models, reference numbers, tables, or email headers; marked numeric fragments also occur.
patterns.domain: Mixed text: links, product IDs, academic citations, tables, and email metadata

patterns.name: Citation markers and reference numbers
patterns.context: Bracketed citations or reference labels surrounded by paper text.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers and their citation markers

patterns.name: Models and alphanumeric codes
patterns.context: Models or specification codes composed of letters and numbers appear in product descriptions and racing parts lists.

patterns.name: Structured markup and tags
patterns.context: XML-like tag boundaries and tag names appear next to fields such as filenames and image dimensions.
patterns.domain: Code, file metadata, or XML-formatted text

patterns.name: Missing values and comparison symbols in tables
patterns.context: Aligned table rows repeatedly contain NaN, month fields, and numeric range conditions.
patterns.domain: Tables or data output in StackExchange technical Q&A

patterns.name: Email headers and addresses
patterns.context: Fields such as software versions, SMTP, recipient/sender addresses, and message IDs appear together in mail transport headers.
patterns.domain: Enron email headers or archived email text

patterns.name: Sporadic activation on ordinary word fragments
patterns.context: Appears in ordinary English sentences and around signatures, with no clear semantic trigger shared with the other segments.

10_574.concept: 结构化文本中的边界与代码串
10_574.description: 主要响应 URL、标点和被切分的字母数字串；也常见于文献引用、产品型号、XML 标签、表格缺失值及邮件头。普通英文词片段的激活缺乏清晰解释。

patterns.name: URL 与域名片段
patterns.trigger: «http»、«://»、«www»、«.»、«/»，以及域名/路径中的 «sp»、«itz»、«de»、«blogs» 等子串
patterns.context: 激活落在 URL 的协议、标点、域名及路径各部分；有时仅命中被切分的词片段。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、HackerNews 引文及代码中的网址

patterns.name: 数字与数字化字符串
patterns.context: 数字串常嵌在 URL、产品型号、文献编号、表格或邮件头等结构中；也包括被标注的数字片段。
patterns.domain: 混合文本：链接、产品编号、学术引用、表格和邮件元数据

patterns.name: 引用标识与文献编号
patterns.context: 方括号内的文献引用或参考文献标签，周围是论文正文。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及其引文标记

patterns.name: 型号与字母数字代码
patterns.context: 字母与数字组成的型号或规格代码，出现在产品介绍和赛车部件清单中。

patterns.name: 结构化标记与标签
patterns.context: XML 类标签边界及标签名，邻接文件名和图像尺寸等字段。
patterns.domain: 代码、文件元数据或 XML 格式文本

patterns.name: 表格中的缺失值及比较符号
patterns.context: 对齐的表格行中反复出现 NaN、月份字段和数值范围条件。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答中的表格或数据输出

patterns.name: 邮件头与地址
patterns.context: 邮件传输头中，软件版本、SMTP、收件/发件地址及消息 ID 等字段相邻。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件头或邮件归档文本

patterns.name: 普通词片段的零散激活
patterns.context: 出现在普通英文句子和签名附近，未见与其他段一致的明确语义触发条件。

en.description: Activations are scattered across multiple domains: sp in URLs, code identifiers and configuration, date-time tables, legal and patent terminology, UI code, and forum wording. Apart from local word strings in individual segments, no stable cross-segment trigger pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: `.vendorCode` identifier
patterns.context: The compound identifier `vendorCode` appears twice in Java constructor parameters and `super(...)` calls; stronger activations fall on these two occurrences.

patterns.name: Weekend time-range text
patterns.context: An email lists consecutive time periods with dates, times, and CT/PT time zones; the same passage appears twice.

patterns.name: `sp` in a specific domain URL
patterns.context: Activations occur within the URL domain and path, especially `sp` in `spitz`; this does not establish a general URL pattern.

patterns.name: `Payment` in code and configuration
patterns.context: `Payment` and `SO` appear after a DLL name in a C#-style code/configuration string; `Payment` is strongly marked.

patterns.name: `approved` in gun-lock legal wording
patterns.context: When describing the purchase of a used gun and legal requirements, `approved` is strongly marked; nearby terms include `law`, `used guns`, and `lock`.

patterns.name: `pp` in the laser material name `sapphire`
patterns.context: A patent technical description refers to a type of laser; the strongest local activation falls on `pp` after tokenization.

patterns.name: Selection controls and option text
patterns.context: R-style UI code defines an experiment selection page and radio buttons; fragments such as `Want to` and `select` activate.

patterns.name: Video frame type `intra`
patterns.context: Patent text explains image reproduction components and encoded data, listing I/P-picture types.

patterns.name: Discussion of compensation and similar projects
patterns.context: A forum quotation discusses whether open-source project contributors are compensated; activations are scattered across comparison and compensation wording, without enough evidence to establish a unified trigger word.

10_574.description: 激活分散于多个领域：URL 中的 sp、代码标识符与配置、日期时间表、法律和专利术语、UI 代码及论坛措辞。除各段局部词串外，看不出跨段稳定触发模式。

patterns.name: `.vendorCode` 标识符
patterns.context: Java 构造函数参数及 `super(...)` 调用中，复合标识符 `vendorCode` 出现两次；较强激活落在这两处。

patterns.name: 周末时间区间文本
patterns.context: 邮件中列出带日期、时间及 CT/PT 时区的连续时间段；同一片段重复出现两次。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件 / 日程安排

patterns.name: 特定域名 URL 中的 `sp`
patterns.trigger: `http://www.zeit.de/datenschutz/malte-spitz-data-retention`，其中 `sp` 及相邻 URL 子串有标记
patterns.context: 激活出现在 URL 的域名和路径内部，尤其 `sp` 所在的 `spitz`；不能据此确认是一般 URL 模式。

patterns.name: 代码及配置中的 `Payment`
patterns.context: C# 风格代码/配置字符串中，`Payment` 与 `SO` 出现在 DLL 名称之后；`Payment` 标记较强。

patterns.name: 枪支锁法律措辞中的 `approved`
patterns.context: 叙述购买二手枪及法律要求时，`approved` 被强标记；周边还有 `law`、`used guns`、`lock`。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC / 枪支法律相关叙述

patterns.name: 激光材料名 `sapphire` 中的 `pp`
patterns.trigger: `Ti sapphire laser`，特别是被拆分标记的 `sa`、`pp`、`hire`
patterns.context: 专利技术描述中，短语指一种激光；最强局部激活落在分词后的 `pp`。

patterns.name: 选择控件及选项文本
patterns.context: R 风格 UI 代码定义实验选择页面和单选按钮；`Want to`、`select` 等片段激活。

patterns.name: 视频帧类型 `intra`
patterns.context: 专利文本解释图像再现部分及编码数据，列举 I/P-picture 类型。

patterns.name: 补偿与相似项目讨论
patterns.context: 论坛引文讨论开源项目贡献者是否获得补偿；激活分散在比较和补偿措辞中，缺少足以确立统一触发词的证据。

en.description: Activations are scattered across formatted text such as database errors, legal case numbers, record discussions, news links, schedule times, and code fields; there is insufficient evidence for a single semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Database error logs
patterns.context: Diagnostic messages repeatedly contain Alias, database identifiers, and Error/!!! prefixes; activations also cover function words in the error sentences.
patterns.domain: Database or software error logs in Enron emails

patterns.name: Case numbers and header formatting
patterns.context: Structured fields in court document headers, including case numbers, document numbers, page numbers, and filing dates.

patterns.name: Music album and CD discussions
patterns.context: First-person recollections of buying, collecting, or enjoying music albums, with several words around CD/album names activating.
patterns.domain: Music and record-collecting forums or comments

patterns.name: Fragmented text in links
patterns.context: Words in URLs or link titles are split into multiple tokens; the same passage also discusses trendspotter and phone-tracking.

patterns.name: Time ranges and date scheduling
patterns.context: Multiline schedules give time ranges with start/end times, weekdays, dates, and time zones.
patterns.domain: Shift schedules or calendar records in Enron emails

patterns.name: Return fields in XML/code
patterns.context: Code or configuration snippets contain XML-style tags, URL fields, and project/assembly names.

patterns.name: Split words in privacy policy links
patterns.context: Privacy- and data-retention-related words in German URL paths are split and marked; the link text and target URL are repeated.

10_574.description: 激活分散在数据库报错、法律案号、唱片讨论、新闻链接、日程时间、代码字段等格式化文本中；没有足够证据支持单一语义触发点。

patterns.name: 数据库错误日志
patterns.trigger: «Cannot» perform this operation on a closed database；«Unknown database»；«Insufficient disk space»
patterns.context: 反复出现 Alias、数据库标识及 Error/!!! 前缀的诊断信息；激活也覆盖错误句中的功能词。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的数据库或软件错误日志

patterns.name: 案卷编号与页眉格式
patterns.context: 法院文件页眉中案号、文件号、页码和提交日期等结构化字段。

patterns.name: 音乐专辑与CD讨论
patterns.context: 以第一人称回忆购买、收藏或喜爱音乐专辑，CD/专辑名周围多个词激活。
patterns.domain: 音乐、唱片收藏的论坛或评论

patterns.name: 链接中的碎片化文字
patterns.context: URL 或链接标题中的词被拆成多个 token；同段还有 trendspotter 和 phone-tracking 话题。

patterns.name: 时间区间与日期排程
patterns.context: 多行日程以起止时间、星期、日期及时区标注区间。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的排班或日程记录

patterns.name: XML/代码中的返回字段
patterns.context: 代码或配置片段包含 XML 风格标签、URL 字段及项目/程序集名称。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答中的代码

patterns.name: 隐私政策链接中的拆分词
patterns.context: 德语 URL 路径中的隐私与数据保留相关词被拆分标记，链接文本与目标 URL 重复。

en.description: Activations are distributed across different domains, often on proper nouns, segmented identifiers, and specific technical, medical, legal, or topical words; the segments lack a shared semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Word fragments in place or institution names
patterns.context: Appears in nursing center names or URL domains; activations are scattered across words and subword fragments in proper names.

patterns.name: Medical and nursing terminology
patterns.context: Medical research titles or descriptions of nursing institutions, especially drugs, treatments, facility beds, and resident information.

patterns.name: Patent citations and numbering formats
patterns.context: Patent numbers, patent document citations, or numeric citation formats; numbers are split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Repair work and invoice numbers in legal narratives
patterns.context: Legal factual narratives mention repair work, owner reference numbers, and invoice numbers.

patterns.name: Status, position, and movement in technical descriptions
patterns.context: Describes mechanical components of a device being secured, prevented from moving, or moved into a position.

patterns.name: Technical devices and user-count limits
patterns.context: Describes the purpose of a laser/pixel detection device and distinguishes single users from multiple simultaneous users.

patterns.name: Fishing- and trout-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Discusses stocking trout, fishing methods, and catches; strong activations also fall on words describing fish populations and catchability.

patterns.name: Political and economic ideology discussion
patterns.context: Compares the ability of capitalism and socialism to solve problems.

patterns.name: Persuading others to collaborate
patterns.context: Discusses the ability to get others to collaborate or participate in work; earlier text mentions an app launch and testing costs.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, project or product development

10_574.description: 激活分布在不同领域，常落于专名、切分后的编号及具体技术、医疗、法律或主题词；各段缺少统一的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 地点或机构专名中的词片段
patterns.trigger: « Health»、« And»、« Center»、« river»、« grand»、« rap»、« ids»、« com»
patterns.context: 出现在护理中心名称或网址域名中；激活分散在专名的词和子词片段上。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、机构资料、网址

patterns.name: 医疗与护理术语
patterns.trigger: « Min»、«ocy»、«cline»、«gl»、« Inhib»、« Treatment»；« nursing»、« home»、« residents»、« beds»
patterns.context: 医疗研究标题或护理机构描述中，尤其是药物、治疗、机构床位与住户信息。
patterns.domain: 医学研究、护理机构资料

patterns.name: 专利引文与编号格式
patterns.context: 专利号、专利文献引证或带数字的引用格式；编号被切分成多个 token。

patterns.name: 法律叙述中的修理工作与发票编号
patterns.trigger: « testimony»、« repair»、« work»、« pursuant»、« Invoice»、« No»、« 00»、« 174»
patterns.context: 法律事实叙述提及维修工作、业主参考号及发票编号。

patterns.name: 技术描述中的状态、位置和运动
patterns.trigger: « releasing»、« state»、« assigned»、« held»、« locked»、« moving»、« neutral»、« position»、« gear»
patterns.context: 描述装置的机械部件被固定、防止移动或进入某位置。

patterns.name: 技术装置与用户数量限制
patterns.trigger: « detector»、« on»、« screen»、« pixel»、« laser»、« invention»、« single»、« user»、« multiple»、« simultaneous»
patterns.context: 说明激光/像素检测装置的用途，并区分单用户与多个同时用户。

patterns.name: 钓鱼与鳟鱼相关词汇
patterns.trigger: « rainbow»、« trout»、« stock»、« Angl»、«ers»、« B»、«ait»、« fly»、« t»、«rolling»
patterns.context: 谈论放养鳟鱼、垂钓方式及鱼获情况；强激活也落在描述鱼类数量和可捕获性的词上。

patterns.name: 政治经济意识形态讨论
patterns.context: 比较资本主义与社会主义处理问题的能力。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、政治经济评论

patterns.name: 说服他人参与合作
patterns.trigger: « get»、« good»、« convincing»、« people»、« work»、« with»
patterns.context: 讨论让他人愿意合作或参与工作的能力；前文提到应用上线和测试费用。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、项目或产品开发

en.concept: Formatted proper names and identifier fragments
en.description: Activations are scattered across numbers and identifiers in formatted fields, as well as several specific word fragments: date-time fields, report headers, deals in URLs, technically legal, car models, and HDAC subtypes. There is no unified semantic trigger across domains.

patterns.name: Timestamp and date fields
patterns.context: Regular date, time, and time-zone fields, often including weekdays, date ranges, and multiple time-zone abbreviations
patterns.domain: Shift or time-slot records in Enron emails

patterns.name: Table column headers and totals
patterns.context: Tab-separated headers or short report fields in emails

patterns.name: The deals string in URLs
patterns.context: Hyphen-separated names of promotional pages in URL paths; activations fall on subword fragments of deals

patterns.name: Legal and technical legality
patterns.context: In sentences discussing platform banning policies and their chilling effect, emphasizes that an action is technically legal

patterns.name: pharmaceutics in reference numbers
patterns.context: Repeated paper identifiers or citation numbers in square brackets

patterns.name: Car models and model-name fragments
patterns.context: Discusses car accessories, models, and user experience; activations concentrate on model identifiers or fragments of model names

patterns.name: or encoding in reference numbers
patterns.context: Repeated citation identifiers around a discussion of CRC prognosis; activations mainly fall on alphanumeric fragments of citation numbers

patterns.name: HDAC numbers and family names
patterns.context: Discussion of HDAC subtype numbers and their sequence and structure-function relationships

10_574.concept: 格式化专名与标识符片段
10_574.description: 激活散布于格式化字段中的数字与标识符，以及若干特定词片段：日期时间、报表表头、URL 的 deals、technically legal、汽车型号和 HDAC 亚型；跨领域缺少统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 时间戳与日期字段
patterns.context: 规律化的日期、时间、时区字段，常含星期、日期范围和多个时区缩写
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的排班或时段记录

patterns.name: 表格列标题与总量
patterns.context: 邮件中的制表符分隔表头或简短报表字段

patterns.name: 网址中的 deals 字符串
patterns.context: URL 路径中连字符分隔的促销页面名称；激活落在 deals 的子词片段上

patterns.name: 法律与技术性合法
patterns.context: 讨论平台封禁策略及其寒蝉效应的句子中，强调某行为在技术上合法

patterns.name: 文献编号中的 pharmaceutics
patterns.context: 方括号内重复出现的论文标识符或引文编号

patterns.name: 汽车型号及车型词片段
patterns.context: 讨论汽车配件、车型和使用体验；激活集中在型号或车型名称片段

patterns.name: 文献编号中的 or 编码
patterns.context: CRC 预后讨论周围的重复文献标识符；激活主要落在引文编号的字母数字片段

patterns.name: HDAC 编号与家族名称
patterns.context: HDAC 亚型编号及其序列、结构功能关系的讨论
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要/分子生物学

en.description: Activations occur across varied and unrelated corpora: forum wording, patent quantities and identifiers, legal precedents, baseball narratives, fantasy jokes, e-book descriptions, and evaluations of papers. There is no stable cross-domain semantic or syntactic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: The phrase “so easy” co-occurrence
patterns.context: In “It’s not so easy to understand …”, especially “so easy” and surrounding words; both examples occur in quotation or commentary contexts.

patterns.name: Degree adverb “pretty” in cross-line quotations
patterns.context: “pretty” modifies an adjective in quoted online discussions; activations fall on pretty/common and adjacent words.

patterns.name: “technically legal” in legal qualifications
patterns.context: When discussing platform services, content, and legal boundaries, technically emphasizes that an action is legal but may still be restricted.

patterns.name: Quantity limitation in patent claims
patterns.context: Patent background describes compound structures; “or more” introduces a numerical lower bound, near technical terms such as carbon atom count and double bonds.

patterns.name: Patent document number lists
patterns.context: Multiple European patent publication numbers appear in list form, mixing digits and letters.

patterns.name: Case citations and obviousness discussion
patterns.context: After citing a decision, discusses whether a disclosed general formula would make the claimed compound obvious.

patterns.name: Batting actions in baseball narratives
patterns.context: Describes game innings, pitches, and batting; activations also fall around “ball came close”.

patterns.name: Magic and fantasy-work analogies
patterns.context: Dialogue makes a humorous comparison using magical abilities and mentions a specific fantasy character.

patterns.name: Service review and e-book device description
patterns.context: Explains how to get free apps from Amazon and describes reading e-books on a PC or other device.

patterns.name: Recency and relevance of information sources
patterns.context: Compares sources of academic paper information, distinguishing known older material from recent and relevant papers.

patterns.name: Other/unclassifiable fragments
patterns.context: Occurs separately in experiences with phone cards, road signs, medical patent background, and incomplete weather/dialogue fragments; no stable shared trigger is apparent.
patterns.domain: Mixed; forum, patent, and web text

10_574.description: 激活分布于多种互不相同的语料：论坛措辞、专利数量与编号、法律判例、棒球叙事、奇幻笑谈、电子书说明和论文评价；尚无跨领域的稳定语义或句法触发模式。

patterns.name: 同现“so easy”措辞
patterns.context: 在“It’s not so easy to understand …”中，尤其是“so easy”及其周围词；两例都出现在引用或评论语境。

patterns.name: 跨行引用中“pretty”程度副词
patterns.context: “pretty”修饰形容词，出现在引用的在线讨论中；激活落在 pretty/common 等相邻词。

patterns.name: 法律技术限定语中的“technically legal”
patterns.context: 谈论平台服务、内容与法律边界时，technically 强调某行为合法但仍可能受限。

patterns.name: 专利权利要求中的数量限定
patterns.context: 专利背景描述化合物结构；“or more”引出数值下限，附近有碳原子数、双键等技术术语。

patterns.name: 专利文献编号列表
patterns.trigger: “EP 0 … A 1”及连续逗号分隔的编号
patterns.context: 多个欧洲专利公开号按列表形式排列，编号与字母数字混排。

patterns.name: 判例引证与显而易见性论述
patterns.context: 判决引证后讨论已披露通式是否使所主张化合物显而易见。

patterns.name: 棒球叙事中的击球动作
patterns.context: 逐场叙述比赛回合、投球与击球；激活还落在“ball came close”一带。

patterns.name: 魔法与奇幻作品类比
patterns.context: 对话中以魔法能力作幽默比较，并提及具体奇幻角色。

patterns.name: 服务评价与电子书设备说明
patterns.context: 说明从 Amazon 获取免费应用，并介绍在 PC 或其他设备阅读电子书。

patterns.name: 信息来源的时间新近性与相关性
patterns.trigger: “last ten years”与“very recent but still highly relevant papers”
patterns.context: 比较学术论文信息源，区分已知的旧资料与新近且相关的论文。

patterns.name: 其他／难以归类的残片
patterns.trigger: “local SIM”“free zone signs”“DHA levels”“not your day”
patterns.context: 分别处于手机卡经历、道路标识、医学专利背景及不完整天气/对话片段中，未见稳定共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 混合；论坛、专利及网页文本

en.description: Activations include degree evaluations and colloquial judgments in forum quotations, as well as sports commentary, web links, email tables, code configuration, interface copy, and patent terminology. No single meaning spans all corpora.

patterns.name: so constructions expressing emphasis or difficulty
patterns.context: Degree adverbs such as so/pretty combine with adjectives to express evaluation or difficulty; “not so easy” is most prominent, also appearing in statements of reasons and business challenges.

patterns.name: best and team performance
patterns.context: best modifies a team's offensive or defensive performance, alongside discussion of leads, game results, and season records.

patterns.name: Google Trends URL
patterns.context: trends/explore in the URL path and its query parameters; activations are distributed across path and parameter characters.

patterns.name: EOL Deals email subject and date
patterns.context: Repeated email header/table-style fields containing EOL Deals, From, To, and dates.

patterns.name: Colloquial commentary in indented quotations
patterns.context: Reply text in HackerNews quotation format; besides degree constructions, activations fall on quotation markers, connectives, and colloquial judgments.

patterns.name: Configuration strings and IP addresses in code
patterns.context: Configuration text in code assignments containing a DLL, payment URL, and dotted-decimal address.

patterns.name: Interface descriptions and navigation links
patterns.context: Web copy introducing a dark mode feature, followed by navigation items such as help, videos, and read more.

patterns.name: Minimum decodable barcode segment
patterns.context: Patent-style technical descriptions repeatedly use minimum decodable piece and discuss barcode label dimensions.

10_574.description: 激活涵盖论坛引用中的程度评价与口语判断，也散见体育评论、网页链接、邮件表格、代码配置、界面文案和专利术语；没有贯穿全部语料的单一词义。

patterns.name: 强调程度或难易的 so 结构
patterns.trigger: [2] «It»2«'s»6« not»6« so»10« easy»6« to»6« understand；[5] «probably»6« already»5« pretty»9« common；[7] «it»6« is»6« so»7« cheap… it»3«'s»9« difficult
patterns.context: so/pretty 等程度副词与形容词构成评价或难易判断；最显著的是“not so easy”，也见于陈述原因和商业难题。

patterns.name: best 与球队表现
patterns.trigger: « best»5« defensive»3« team»7…« best»6« offensive»3« team
patterns.context: best 修饰球队攻防表现，并讨论领先优势、比赛结果和赛季战绩。

patterns.name: Google Trends URL
patterns.context: URL 路径中的 trends/explore 及其查询参数；激活分布在路径字符和参数字符上。

patterns.name: EOL Deals 邮件标题与日期
patterns.context: 重复的邮件头/表格样式字段，含 EOL Deals、From、To 和日期。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件、结构化邮件文本

patterns.name: 缩进引用中的口语评论
patterns.trigger: «>»1« However»3« because»4« it»4« is»6« so»7…；«>»1« I»3« think»3« these»3« checks»4
patterns.context: HackerNews 引用格式的回复文本；除程度结构外，激活落在引用标记、连接词及口语判断表达上。

patterns.name: 代码配置字符串与 IP 地址
patterns.context: 代码赋值中的配置文本，含 DLL、支付 URL 和点分数字地址。

patterns.name: 界面说明与导航链接
patterns.trigger: «The»2« dark»3« mode»1…«map»2«ost»2« reply»5«↵»1«|»5« video»5…« read»9« more»4
patterns.context: 介绍深色模式功能的网页文案，随后出现帮助、视频、阅读更多等导航项。
patterns.domain: 产品说明、网页界面文本

patterns.name: 条码最小可解码片段
patterns.context: 专利式技术描述中重复出现 minimum decodable piece，并讨论条码标签的尺寸。

en.description: Activations are distributed across several types of text: English word fragments, date-time fields, numbers and code identifiers, and email table labels. There is no stable semantic or syntactic theme across segments; some activations may relate to tokenization, numeric strings, and formatted text.

patterns.name: Specific subword fragments within or at the boundaries of English words
patterns.context: In ordinary English text, activations fall on words or word fragments; different semantic words may be covered within the same segment, with no stable syntactic position or lexical condition.
patterns.domain: Mixed text including news comments, sports discussions, papers, emails, and forums

patterns.name: Date and time format fields
patterns.context: Weekdays and numeric fields are marked in schedule-like time ranges consisting of dates, times, and time zones; the content of segments 3 and 4 is repeated.

patterns.name: Number, code, and identifier fragments
patterns.context: Alphanumeric configuration items, network addresses, code constants, or long identifiers; activations are scattered within fields, without consistent format boundaries.

patterns.name: Email tables and accounting labels
patterns.context: Near summary rows in email tables and email subject/field labels, accompanied by amount and date numbers.
patterns.domain: Enron emails, tables, or accounting text

10_574.concept: 格式化文本中的异质片段
10_574.description: 激活分布于多类文本：英文词片段、日期时间字段、数字与代码标识符，以及邮件表格标签。跨段没有稳定的语义或句法主题；部分激活可能与分词、数字串及格式化文本有关。

patterns.name: 英语词内部/边界的特定子词片段
patterns.context: 普通英文文本中，激活落在词语或词片段上；同一段内可能覆盖不同语义词，没有稳定的句法位置或词义条件。
patterns.domain: 新闻评论、体育讨论、论文、邮件、论坛等混合文本

patterns.name: 日期与时间格式字段
patterns.context: 日期、时间与时区构成的排班式时间区间中，星期名及数字字段被标记；第3、4段内容重复。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的日程/时间表

patterns.name: 数字、代码与标识符片段
patterns.context: 数字与字母混合的配置项、网络地址、代码常量或长标识符；激活分散于字段内部，缺乏一致格式边界。
patterns.domain: 代码、技术问答、配置文本

patterns.name: 邮件表格与账目标签
patterns.context: 邮件中的表格汇总行及邮件标题/字段附近，伴随金额和日期数字。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件、表格或账目文本

en.description: Activations are scattered across the technical use of may, C# generic list initialization and calls, specific institution/trial names and person-name fragments, values following an equals sign, and negative-pixel CSS offsets; no stable semantic pattern spans all segments.

patterns.name: may in English technical text
patterns.context: In technical descriptions or patent backgrounds, may appears in sentences describing a system’s/device’s capabilities or possibilities; both examples are accompanied by verbs such as include/be

patterns.name: List initialization terminator
patterns.context: At the end of a C# generic List initialization statement, immediately before a semicolon

patterns.name: Specific domain terms or fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall respectively on a word fragment in the name of a gynecologic oncology research institution, a clinical-trial term, and several subword fragments in a Japanese person’s name; there is no shared local semantic context
patterns.domain: NIH project descriptions and Wikipedia person entries

patterns.name: Numeric equals expression
patterns.context: An equals sign at the start of a line or in a standalone code/math expression is followed by the value 10000, then a line break

patterns.name: Assembly type call fragment
patterns.context: In C# reflection-scanning code, a call to the generic method AddAllTypesOf, with IP...ViolationHandler as the type parameter

patterns.name: CSS negative offset value
patterns.context: In a CSS background sprite image-positioning property, a hyphenated negative value and the px unit form a pixel offset

10_598.description: 激活分散在 may 的技术说明用法、C# 泛型列表初始化及调用、特定机构/试验名称和人名片段、等号后数值，以及 CSS 负像素偏移；未见贯穿所有片段的稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 英语技术文本中的 may
patterns.context: 在技术说明或专利背景中，may 位于描述某系统/设备能力或可能性的句子里；两例均伴随 include/be 等动词

patterns.name: 列表初始化结束符
patterns.context: C# 泛型 List 的 new 初始化语句末尾，紧邻分号

patterns.name: 特定领域名词或片段
patterns.context: 激活分别落在妇科肿瘤研究机构名称中的词片段、临床试验名词，以及日文人名的若干子词片段；没有共同的局部语义上下文
patterns.domain: NIH 项目描述与 Wikipedia 人名条目

patterns.name: 数字等号表达式
patterns.context: 行首或独立代码/数学表达式中的等号后接数值 10000，随后换行
patterns.domain: ArXiv 文本，具体语境不足

patterns.name: 程序集类型调用片段
patterns.context: C# 反射扫描代码中，调用 AddAllTypesOf 泛型方法，泛型参数为 IP...ViolationHandler

patterns.name: CSS 负偏移值
patterns.context: CSS background 的 sprite 图片定位属性中，连字符负值与 px 单位构成像素偏移

en.description: Activations involve numbers or formulas following an equals sign at the start of a line, patent-style may include, academic introductory wording, and the repeated proper name Lejac Residential School; these triggers differ markedly from one another.

patterns.name: Leading equals sign and number/formula
patterns.context: The equals sign is at the start of the segment, often followed by a number, formula, or equation-like content; in math problems, a period is often followed by an instruction

patterns.name: may in patent style
patterns.context: Patent background descriptions of what a device or system may include

patterns.name: Academic introductory wording
patterns.context: Stating recent research interest in the introduction of an academic paper

patterns.name: Proper name Lejac Residential School
patterns.context: The proper name is repeated after the title

10_598.description: 激活涉及行首等号后接数字或算式、专利语体的 may include、学术引言措辞，以及重复专名 Lejac Residential School；这些触发条件彼此差异明显。

patterns.name: 行首等号与数字/公式
patterns.context: 等号位于片段开头，后面常跟数值、算式或类方程内容；数学题中常以句点结束后接题目指令

patterns.name: 专利语体中的 may
patterns.context: 专利背景描述设备或系统可能包含某些部件或功能

patterns.name: 学术引言措辞
patterns.context: 学术论文引言中陈述近期研究兴趣

patterns.name: 专名 Lejac Residential School
patterns.trigger: «Le»、«Res»等词片段，且重复出现«Lejac Residential School»
patterns.context: 专名在标题后再次重复

en.description: Primarily activates on the modal may, in uses expressing possibility, capability, or potential function; there are also isolated activations on the proper-name fragment uki, like in a phrase, and Network at the start of a sentence.

patterns.name: Modal may
patterns.context: may is followed by a base-form verb or be, expressing possibility, potential function, or general capability; it is the primary activation point in multiple segments.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, medical abstracts, research texts, emails, and general expository writing

patterns.name: Specific fragment in a person’s name
patterns.context: Appears within the proper name «Masayuki Matsubara»; activation is concentrated on the name fragment rather than syntactic structure.

patterns.name: may look like construction
patterns.context: In “it may look like a red flag,” like also has strong activation in addition to may.

patterns.name: Word-initial network
patterns.context: Network security appears at the start of a sentence; increasingly in the same sentence also has moderate activation, but there is insufficient evidence for a stable collocation.
patterns.domain: Network security description in a patent background

10_598.concept: may 情态词及偶发词项
10_598.description: 主要对情态词 may 激活，涵盖可能性、能力或潜在作用等用法；另有专名片段 uki、短语中的 like，以及句首 Network 的孤立激活。

patterns.name: may 情态词
patterns.context: may 后接动词原形或 be，表达可能性、潜在功能或一般能力；在多段中是主要激活点。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、医学摘要、科研文本、邮件及一般说明文

patterns.name: 人名中的特定片段
patterns.context: 出现在专名「Masayuki Matsubara」内部，激活集中于人名片段而非句法结构。

patterns.name: may look like 搭配
patterns.context: “it may look like a red flag”中，除 may 外，对 like 也有较强激活。

patterns.name: network 词首
patterns.context: 句首出现 Network security；同句还有 increasingly 的中等激活，但未见足够证据认定为稳定搭配。
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的网络安全说明

en.description: Activations do not form a single semantic theme: strong signals recur on comes and characterized, and occur sporadically on akin, lux within subluxation, and net within botnet; the first two categories appear across scientific, medical, and news texts.

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in comes
patterns.context: The full word or substring comes appears in a sentence, often as a predicate verb; prefixes can attach before the word, as in becomes, and the word can also appear in overcomes and outcomes.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, project descriptions, and press releases

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in characterized
patterns.context: The past participle characterized functions as a predicate or modifier, often followed by by; in [4], cyclase immediately before it is also activated.

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in akin
patterns.context: In the construction “a process akin to …,” describing a process as similar to another process.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in subluxation
patterns.context: Appears in the diagnostic name extensor carpi ulnaris subluxation as part of a medical term.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in botnet
patterns.context: Refers to a botnet consisting of controlled or infected hosts; activation is concentrated on the word-final net.

10_598.description: 激活并非单一语义主题：较强信号反复落在 comes 与 characterized，也零星落在 akin、subluxation 内的 lux、botnet 内的 net；前两类跨科学、医学和新闻文本出现。

patterns.name: comes 的词尾片段
patterns.context: 完整词形或子串 comes 出现在句中，常位于谓语动词位置；前缀可接在词前，如 becomes，词也可出现在 overcomes、outcomes 中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、项目说明及新闻稿

patterns.name: characterized 的词尾片段
patterns.context: 过去分词 characterized 作谓语或修饰语，常接 by；[4] 中紧邻前面的 cyclase 也有激活。

patterns.name: akin 的词尾片段
patterns.context: 在“a process akin to …”结构中，描述过程与另一过程相似。

patterns.name: sub luxation 词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在诊断名称 extensor carpi ulnaris subluxation 中，是医学术语的一部分。

patterns.name: botnet 的词内片段
patterns.context: 指受控制或受感染主机组成的 botnet；激活集中在词尾 net。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术／网络安全

en.description: Strong activations often fall on words carrying research actions, uses, and findings in abstracts or technical descriptions; a few terms or title words are also involved: frequency, admissions, branching. The segments come from different fields and do not show a unified narrow theme.

patterns.name: Verbs in research abstracts
patterns.context: Predicates describing research content, system uses, experimental findings, or established results in research or technical introductions; the trigger is not always the same word form.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, NIH project abstracts, and biomedical abstracts

patterns.name: AC frequency phrase
patterns.context: Appears in the fixed term «Variable» «frequency» «alternating» «current».

patterns.name: admissions
patterns.context: «Ac»«ute admissions», meaning acute hospital admissions in a medical article title.

patterns.name: starch branching
patterns.context: «St»«arch» «branching» «enzymes», referring to starch-branching enzymes.

10_598.concept: 研究摘要中的信息承载词
10_598.description: 强激活多落在摘要或技术说明中承载研究动作、用途和发现的词，也包括少数术语或标题词：frequency、admissions、branching。各段领域不同，未显示统一的窄主题。

patterns.name: 研究摘要中的动词
patterns.context: 研究或技术介绍中描述研究内容、系统用途、实验发现或已确立结果的谓语；触发点不总在同一词形。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、NIH 项目摘要及生物医学摘要

patterns.name: AC 高频词组
patterns.context: 出现在固定术语 «Variable» «frequency» «alternating» «current» 中。

patterns.name: admissions
patterns.context: «Ac»«ute admissions»，即医学文章标题中的急性住院收治。

patterns.name: starch branching
patterns.context: «St»«arch» «branching» «enzymes»，涉及淀粉分支酶。

en.description: The clearest recurring clue is the substring “her” within English words, across multiple fields and with varied meanings. In the remaining segments, highlights are scattered across Japanese strings, statements of genetic harmfulness, and general research wording, making them difficult to group into a single stable pattern.

patterns.name: Substring her
patterns.context: The consecutive substring `her` occurs within an English word; no specific semantic or syntactic environment is required
patterns.domain: Cross-disciplinary English texts: condensed matter physics, medicine, genetics, theoretical physics

patterns.name: Medical variant and harmfulness descriptions involving her
patterns.context: Medical paper contexts concerning genetic variants, amino-acid properties, and predicted harmful effects

patterns.name: Local markers in Japanese interface text
patterns.context: Japanese interface copy or translated strings; their meaning does not jointly explain activations in the other segments

patterns.name: Sporadically highly activated words in general English research text
patterns.context: Narration in research abstracts describing effects or research methods; no stable, specific shared trigger condition is apparent

10_598.description: 最清楚的重复线索是英文单词内部出现子串“her”，涉及多种领域且语义各异。其余段的高亮分散在日文字符串、遗传学有害性表述及一般科研措辞中，难以归入同一稳定模式。

patterns.name: her 子串
patterns.context: 英文单词内部包含连续子串 `her`；不要求特定语义或句法环境
patterns.domain: 跨学科英文文本：凝聚态物理、医学、遗传学、理论物理

patterns.name: her 相关医学变异与有害性描述
patterns.trigger: `her`（段 [5] 中未出现；相关显著触发词为 “deleterious”）
patterns.context: 遗传变异、氨基酸性质及预测有害影响的医学论文语境

patterns.name: 日文界面文本中的局部标记
patterns.trigger: 日文字符串中的 `«»`、`»6` 等标记；可见例子包括 “許VDR訊息” 和 “御社”
patterns.context: 日语界面文案或翻译字符串；无法从词义与其他段的激活共同解释
patterns.domain: 软件翻译、日文技术问答

patterns.name: 一般英文科研文本中的零散高激活词
patterns.context: 科研摘要中描述作用或研究方法的叙述；没有显示出稳定且特异的共同触发条件

en.concept: Local technical fragments in heterogeneous text
en.description: Activations are scattered across fragments within technical terms, research methods and scale-validity terminology, medical treatment outcome statistics, biological sex determination, code variables, and paper citation markers; there is no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Word-final/in-word fragments in technical terms
patterns.context: Activation falls on local fragments of longer technical terms or identifiers; sentence meanings vary, and fragment positions are not fixed.

patterns.name: Citations and markers containing numbers
patterns.context: Activations occur near citation markers, iteration method names, or return-series labels in mathematics papers.

patterns.name: Research design and validity measurement terminology
patterns.context: Activations occur near methodological or evaluation terms in research abstracts describing interviews, clinical scales, study phases, and measurement properties.

patterns.name: Clinical outcomes and treatment statistics
patterns.context: Activations occur when medical texts report treatment, patient outcomes, or statistics listed by treatment group.

patterns.name: Biological sex determination and stages
patterns.context: Activations occur in sentences describing biological sex-determination mechanisms and the stages at which they occur.

patterns.name: Probability variable in code
patterns.context: A local fragment of the variable name stands out as C++-style code iterates over a probabilities member variable.

patterns.name: Technical suffix in application pricing discussion
patterns.context: In a HackerNews post discussing application market size and pricing models, activation is concentrated on a split word fragment; its specific meaning is difficult to relate to the other segments.

patterns.name: Cochlear stimulation and nerve fiber location
patterns.context: Activations occur in experimental descriptions comparing the locations of afferent and efferent fiber endings after mechanical or electrical stimulation of hair cells.

patterns.name: Citation/statistical fragments without a clear pattern
patterns.context: The segments may locally overlap with other patterns, but the context alone does not establish a stable trigger condition.

10_598.concept: 异质文本中的局部技术片段
10_598.description: 激活分散于技术词内部片段、研究方法与量表效度术语、医学治疗结局统计、生物性别决定，以及代码变量和论文引用标记；尚无统一语义触发点。

patterns.name: 技术词中的词尾/词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在较长技术词或标识符的局部片段上；所处句子语义各异，片段位置不固定。
patterns.domain: 跨领域技术文本与代码

patterns.name: 带数字的引用与标记
patterns.context: 数学论文中，引用标记、迭代方法名或 return 系列标签附近出现激活。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学/计算机科学论文

patterns.name: 研究设计与效度测量用语
patterns.context: 描述访谈、临床量表、研究阶段及测量属性的研究摘要中，方法学或评估术语附近激活。
patterns.domain: NIH 研究计划/临床研究

patterns.name: 临床结果与治疗统计
patterns.context: 医学文本报告治疗、患者结局或按治疗组列出的统计数据时激活。

patterns.name: 生物学性别决定与阶段
patterns.context: 描述生物体性别决定机制及其发生阶段的句子中激活。

patterns.name: 概率变量代码
patterns.context: C++ 风格代码遍历 probabilities 成员变量时，变量名局部片段突出。

patterns.name: 应用定价讨论中的技术尾缀
patterns.context: 讨论应用市场规模与定价模式的 HackerNews 帖子中，激活集中在被拆分的词片段；具体词义与其他片段难以对应。

patterns.name: 耳蜗刺激与神经纤维位置
patterns.context: 比较毛细胞机械或电刺激后传入、传出纤维末端位置的实验描述中激活。

patterns.name: 未形成明确模式的引文/统计片段
patterns.context: 片段中可能与其他模式有局部重合，但单凭上下文不能确定稳定触发条件。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 引文；医学统计摘要

en.description: Activations occur mainly in biomedical academic texts, especially clinical research methods, tissue/disease terminology, and test-performance metrics; they also respond to fragments within words, research titles, image-analysis citations, and code header-file paths, making them difficult to assign to a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Medical research terms and methods descriptions
patterns.context: Appears in results, methods, and background sentences of clinical research, pathology, or biomedical papers; involves patients, tissues, diseases, tests, or research processes.

patterns.name: Quantitative results and evaluation metrics
patterns.context: Reports performance metrics in testing or diagnostic studies, often in the same sentence as comparisons, limitations, or interpretation of results.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within medical words
patterns.context: Triggers fall within complete words or affixes and do not always align with biomedical subject matter; they may reflect word-form or fragment features.

patterns.name: Paths and filenames in code
patterns.context: Appears in C/C++ preprocessor directives and quoted header-file paths.

patterns.name: Title-case phrase in a title
patterns.context: Title case describing the translation of bench research into the clinical domain; activation is concentrated on words in the title.

patterns.name: References and paper terminology
patterns.context: A cell image-analysis paper discusses segmentation challenges and lists related work in author-year format.

10_598.description: 主要出现在生物医学学术文本，尤其是临床研究的方法、组织/疾病术语及检测性能指标；也响应词内片段、科研标题、图像分析引文，以及代码头文件路径，难以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 医学研究术语与方法描述
patterns.trigger: “post-”/“-partum”、“fetal”、“maternal”、“patients”、“tissue samples”等医学词汇，以及“defined”“recorded”“was performed”等方法描述
patterns.context: 出现在临床研究、病理学或生物医学论文的结果、方法和背景句中；涉及患者、组织、疾病、检测或研究流程。

patterns.name: 定量结果与评估指标
patterns.context: 检测或诊断研究中报告性能指标，常与比较、限制或结果解释同句出现。

patterns.name: 医学词语内部的子词片段
patterns.context: 触发落在完整词或词缀内部，并不总与生物医学主题一致；可能反映词形或片段特征。

patterns.name: 代码中的路径与文件名
patterns.context: 出现在 C/C++ 预处理指令和双引号包围的头文件路径中。

patterns.name: 标题中的大小写词组
patterns.trigger: “Multiple Perspectives On Bringing Bench top Research Into The Clinical Domain”
patterns.context: 标题式大小写，描述将台式研究转化到临床领域；激活集中于标题中的词语。

patterns.name: 参考文献引用与论文术语
patterns.context: 细胞图像分析论文讨论分割困难，并以作者年份格式列举相关工作。

en.description: Primarily responds to dense clinical or histological descriptions in biomedical papers, especially numerical, stage, sample, classification, and outcome information; it also covers less common sequencing, transplantation, and placental staining descriptions. The commonality is a specialized medical research context, but the specific triggers vary.
