patterns.name: Numbers and quantitative results in medical texts
patterns.context: Appears in research results, sample descriptions, grading scales, or measurement metrics; activation sometimes falls on words or punctuation near numbers.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers and abstracts, quantitative reporting

patterns.name: Gestational stages and developmental timing
patterns.context: Descriptions of stage-based comparisons or locations involving fetuses, placentas, or gestational tissue.
patterns.domain: Reproductive, developmental, and placental biomedical research

patterns.name: Tissue, cell, and pathological morphology descriptions
patterns.context: Involves tissue samples, cell types, histological observations, lesions, or margin features; often accompanied by testing, localization, or comparison results.

patterns.name: Clinical cohorts and patient characteristics
patterns.context: Describes patient enrollment, disease subtypes, treatment conditions, or cohort design.

patterns.name: Medical classification, grading, and scoring
patterns.context: Classifies diseases, imaging abnormalities, or tissue features into categories or grades.

patterns.name: Imaging and anatomical measurements
patterns.context: Describes imaging assessment, ocular tissue observation, or anatomical units and ranges used for measurement.

patterns.name: Survival, risk, and outcome statistics
patterns.context: Reports hazard ratios, confidence intervals, survival times, or adverse event rates.

patterns.name: Molecular testing and sequencing
patterns.context: Cloning, sequencing, or molecular sequence analysis is performed on tumor-derived material.

patterns.name: Cell components and tissue staining localization
patterns.context: Describes the distribution and intensity differences of staining in placental cell layers.

patterns.name: Treatment and transplantation abbreviations
patterns.context: Research descriptions of patients receiving high-dose chemotherapy and peripheral blood stem cell transplantation.

10_598.description: 主要响应生物医学论文中密集的临床或组织学描述，尤其是数值、阶段、样本、分类和结局信息；也覆盖少见的测序、移植及胎盘染色表述。共同点是专业医学研究语境，但具体触发内容多样。

patterns.name: 医学文本中的数字与量化结果
patterns.context: 出现在研究结果、样本描述、分级量表或测量指标中；激活点有时落在数值附近的词或标点上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与摘要，定量报告

patterns.name: 孕期阶段与发育时间
patterns.context: 围绕胎儿、胎盘或妊娠组织的阶段性比较或定位描述。

patterns.name: 影像检查与解剖测量

patterns.name: 生存、风险与结局统计

en.description: Activations are distributed across several types of biomedical text: terminology for factors, hormones, and cellular processes; segmentation of cell/brain-region compounds; and case-report and abbreviation-list formatting. Local trigger conditions are not entirely consistent across segments.

patterns.name: Factor names in biomedicine

patterns.domain: Biomedical paper abstracts and research plans

patterns.name: Trophoblast and cell-layer boundaries
patterns.context: Describes placental staining localization, especially cell types and boundaries between layers

patterns.name: Cell-cycle arrest and senescence
patterns.context: Describes post-treatment cell-cycle changes and senescent phenotypes

patterns.name: Split fragments in brain-region names
patterns.context: Lists brain regions involved in emotional stimulus tasks, especially when region names are split into subwords

patterns.name: Authorization statement at the end of a case report
patterns.context: A case report states that written informed consent is available for review by the journal editor

patterns.name: Abbreviations and definitions in an abbreviation list
patterns.context: Formatting of abbreviations, colons, line breaks, and term definitions in an abbreviation list at the end of a paper
patterns.domain: Medical paper appendices or supplementary sections

patterns.name: Follicle-stimulating hormone and its effects
patterns.context: Describes hormonal stimulation of steroid, protein hormone, or growth factor production in reproductive cells

patterns.name: Biomedical compound terms and subword boundaries
patterns.context: Terms consist of multiple morphological components and occur in discussions of hematology or tumor biology

patterns.name: Unmerged local high activations
patterns.context: Each occurs in a different research context; the available segments are insufficient to identify a shared trigger condition

10_598.description: 激活分布在多类生物医学文本中：因子、激素及细胞过程术语，细胞/脑区复合词切分，以及病例报告和缩写表格式；各段的局部触发条件并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 滋养层及细胞层边界

patterns.name: 细胞周期停滞与衰老

patterns.name: 未能归并的局部高激活

patterns.domain: 产科、造血研究及神经科学

en.description: Activations span multiple types of biomedical text: cytokines and hematopoietic growth factors, targeted cancer therapy, cell adhesion and migration, neurodevelopmental markers, and clinical research platforms and transplant reviews. Triggers are mostly localized to specialized terms.

patterns.name: Cytokines and hematopoietic growth factors
patterns.context: Discusses cytokines or growth factors and their effects on hematopoiesis, stem cells, brain injury repair, or tumor cells; triggers often occur on related terms and nearby words.

patterns.name: Targeted anticancer drugs and receptor markers
patterns.context: Contexts involving targeted therapies, drugs, or molecular receptor markers for breast cancer and other tumors.

patterns.name: Cell adhesion- and migration-related molecules
patterns.context: Describes cell-cell adhesion, receptor-ligand relationships, or tumor cell migration; activation centers on adhesion molecule and receptor names.

patterns.name: Glial cells and developmental markers
patterns.context: Describes identification of oligodendrocytes at different developmental stages and expression of precursor cell markers.

patterns.name: Clinical research registration and data platforms
patterns.context: Introduces multicenter clinical studies, registration information, or data platforms supporting research.

patterns.name: Overview of hematopoietic stem cell transplantation
patterns.context: Reviews stem cell technologies and transplant practices, and mentions patient age or treatment developments.

10_598.description: 激活覆盖多类生物医学文本：细胞因子与造血因子、靶向肿瘤治疗、细胞黏附迁移、神经发育标志物，以及临床研究平台和移植综述。多为专业术语局部触发。

patterns.name: 细胞因子与造血生长因子
patterns.trigger: “cytokines including IL-1, IL-3” “hematopoietic growth factors” “SCF” “granulocyte-colony stimulating factor” “IL-6 family of cytokines”
patterns.context: 讨论细胞因子或生长因子及其对造血、干细胞、脑损伤修复或肿瘤细胞的作用；触发常落在相关术语及其邻近词上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、造血与细胞因子研究

patterns.name: 靶向抗癌药物及受体标记
patterns.context: 乳腺癌等肿瘤的靶向治疗、药物或分子受体标记语境。

patterns.name: 细胞黏附与迁移相关分子
patterns.context: 说明细胞间黏附、受体—配体关系或肿瘤细胞迁移，激活集中于黏附分子和受体名称。
patterns.domain: 细胞生物学、肿瘤生物学

patterns.name: 神经胶质细胞与发育标志物

patterns.name: 临床研究注册与数据平台
patterns.context: 介绍多中心临床研究、注册信息或支持研究的数据平台。
patterns.domain: 临床研究、科研基础设施

patterns.name: 造血干细胞移植概述
patterns.trigger: “Stem cell technology” “hematopoietic cell transplantation” “standard therapy” “patients under the age of 55”
patterns.context: 概述干细胞技术和移植治疗实践，并提及患者年龄或治疗发展。

en.description: Primarily responds to specialized cellular and molecular terms in biomedical text, especially cytokines and IL numbers; also responds to glial/tissue markers, transplant clinical data, research platforms, and erythroid differentiation terminology.

patterns.name: Cytokines and their numbers
patterns.context: Biomedical text related to cytokines, hematopoietic growth factors, or receptors; activations center on fragments such as including, IL, and its numbers.

patterns.name: Glial cells and neural markers
patterns.context: Describes cell types, tissue localization, immunostaining markers, or antibody names, often using specialized terms and marker abbreviations.

patterns.name: Clinical research registration and collaboration platforms
patterns.context: Descriptions of research registration, database sources, and multicenter collaboration platforms.

patterns.name: Transplantation and age numbers
patterns.context: Introduces the prevalence, indications, annual volume, and patient ages for organ transplantation.

patterns.name: Erythroid differentiation and CFU-e
patterns.context: Discusses nucleoproteins, cell growth and differentiation, and the arrested differentiation state of erythroid precursor cells.

10_598.description: 主要响应生物医学文本中的专业细胞与分子术语，尤其细胞因子及IL编号；也响应胶质/组织标记、移植临床数据、研究平台和红系分化术语。

patterns.name: 细胞因子及其编号
patterns.trigger: “cytokines including IL-1, IL-3”（1）；“cytokines, including IL-6, IL-13”（4）
patterns.context: 细胞因子、造血生长因子或受体相关的生物医学文本；激活集中在 including、IL及其数字等片段。

patterns.name: 胶质细胞与神经标志物

patterns.name: 临床研究登记与合作平台

patterns.name: 移植及年龄数字

patterns.name: 红系分化与CFU-e
patterns.context: 讨论核蛋白、细胞生长分化及红系前体细胞的分化停滞状态。

en.description: Activations center on specialized terms or list-introducing words in biomedical text: marker, antibodies, drugs, growth factors, platforms, and cytokines; commonly found in lists of names or descriptions of mechanisms.

patterns.name: marker in biomedical text
patterns.context: Appears in introductions to cellular or lineage markers; includes singular marker and markers listed before or after it
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, stem cells and neural development

patterns.name: Lists of targeted drugs
patterns.context: Introduces examples of cancer therapy drugs or inhibitors, followed by drug names

patterns.name: Monoclonal antibodies
patterns.context: Describes therapeutic humanized monoclonal antibodies targeting receptors or pathways

patterns.name: Growth factors and stem cell factors
patterns.context: Growth factor names or expressions related to “growth factors”; adjacent to stem cells, brain repair, or angiogenesis
patterns.domain: Research funding abstracts and biomedical patents

patterns.name: Research platform descriptions

patterns.domain: Clinical research registration and data management

patterns.name: Cytokine and interleukin lists
patterns.context: Lists cytokines in cell culture, immune response, or thrombopoiesis contexts, often including IL numbers
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers and research funding abstracts

10_598.description: 激活集中于生物医学文本中的专业名词或列表引导词：marker、抗体、药物、生长因子、平台及细胞因子；多见于名称列举或机制说明。

patterns.name: 生物医学文本中的 marker

patterns.domain: 生物医学论文，干细胞与神经发育

patterns.name: 靶向药物列举
patterns.context: 引出癌症治疗药物或抑制剂实例，后接药物名称
patterns.domain: 专利背景，肿瘤靶向治疗

patterns.name: 单克隆抗体

patterns.name: 生长因子与干细胞因子

patterns.name: 科研平台表述

en.description: Activations center on cytokines, growth factors, cell markers, and their functions in biomedical text; also covers adjacent topics such as targeted therapy, vascular mechanics, brain repair, and angiogenesis.

patterns.name: Cytokines and interleukins
patterns.context: Discusses the effects of cytokines, receptors, or growth factors on cellular function, disease, or treatment, often naming specific factors.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, immunology, and hematology papers or grant abstracts

patterns.name: Cell types and markers
patterns.context: Lists markers, antibodies, or cell surface molecules when describing cell identity, differentiation stage, or phenotype.

patterns.name: Targeted anticancer drugs and treatment classes
patterns.context: Introduces cancer treatment approaches, drug classes, or specific targeted drugs.

patterns.name: Blood-flow shear stress and endothelial transcriptional regulation
patterns.context: Discusses arterial hemodynamic forces acting on endothelial cells and inducing transcription factors.

patterns.name: Brain injury repair and hematopoietic growth factors
patterns.context: Discusses repair strategies and growth factor combinations after chronic brain injury or stroke.

patterns.name: Angiogenesis and endothelial tube formation
patterns.context: Describes angiogenesis and endothelial cell proliferation and tube formation.
patterns.domain: Tumor or vascular biology patent background

10_598.concept: 生物医学细胞因子与细胞表型
10_598.description: 激活集中于生物医学文本中的细胞因子、生长因子、细胞标志物及其功能描述；也覆盖靶向治疗、血管力学、脑修复和血管生成等相邻专题。

patterns.name: 细胞因子与白细胞介素
patterns.context: 讨论细胞因子、受体或生长因子对细胞功能、疾病或治疗的影响，常出现具体因子名称。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、免疫学与血液学论文或基金摘要

patterns.name: 细胞类型与标志物
patterns.context: 描述细胞身份、分化阶段或表型时，列举标志物、抗体或细胞表面分子。

patterns.name: 靶向抗癌药物与治疗类别
patterns.context: 介绍癌症治疗方式、药物类别或具体靶向药。

patterns.name: 血流剪切力与内皮转录调控
patterns.context: 讨论动脉血流力学作用于内皮细胞并诱导转录因子。

patterns.name: 血管生成与内皮管形成

en.description: Primarily responds to specialized entities and terms in biomedical text, especially immune cells, cytokines, markers, and alphanumeric molecular names; also covers related expressions involving cancer treatment, angiogenesis, and clinical management.

patterns.name: Biomedical markers and molecular names
patterns.context: Appears in specialized descriptions of cell types, molecules, or biological processes, often adjacent to marker, transcription factor, or growth factor names.

patterns.name: Cytokines and immune-related terminology
patterns.context: Discussions of immune cells, cytokines, disease, or immune function, often accompanied by abbreviations, numbers, and receptor names.

patterns.name: Lists of drug and treatment names
patterns.context: Lists targeted anticancer drugs or chemotherapy regimens; drug names are often complex generic names.
patterns.domain: Cancer treatment-related patents or case reports

patterns.name: Numbered proper names and alphanumeric strings
patterns.context: Antibodies, cell-surface molecules, or factor names in biomedical text; letters and numbers are closely combined.

patterns.name: Angiogenesis-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Explains angiogenesis, endothelial cell proliferation, and formation of tubular structures in tumors or tissues.

patterns.name: Breast surgery and pathological management
patterns.context: Case descriptions of breast lesion diagnosis, surgery, and postoperative treatment.

patterns.name: Transplantation defects and cell culture
patterns.context: Discusses the effects of cytokines on hematopoietic stem cell culture or transplant outcomes.

patterns.name: Glial developmental markers
patterns.context: Discusses different developmental stages of oligodendrocytes and their marker expression.

patterns.name: Antitumor mechanisms and cell death
patterns.context: Describes the tumor microenvironment, apoptosis, or mechanisms of targeted therapy.

10_598.description: 主要响应生物医学文本中的专业实体与术语，尤其是免疫细胞、细胞因子、标记物及字母数字分子名；也覆盖肿瘤治疗、血管生成和临床处置等相关表述。

patterns.name: 生物医学标记与分子名称
patterns.context: 出现在细胞类型、分子或生物过程的专业描述中，常与标记物、转录因子或生长因子名称相邻。

patterns.name: 细胞因子及免疫相关术语
patterns.context: 免疫细胞、细胞因子、疾病或免疫功能的讨论，常伴随缩写、编号及受体名称。

patterns.name: 药物与治疗名称列表

patterns.name: 带编号的专名及字母数字串

patterns.name: 血管生成相关词汇

patterns.name: 乳腺手术与病理处置

patterns.name: 移植缺陷与细胞培养

en.description: Activations center on biomedical contexts involving VEGF and angiogenesis, stem cells and markers, cytokines, clinical trial registration, and collaborator information in papers; the patterns are not entirely unified thematically.

patterns.name: Stem cell markers and cell subsets

patterns.name: Stem cell recruitment and repair factors

patterns.name: Clinical trial and research platform registration information

patterns.name: Author names and institutional collaborations

patterns.name: Cytokine families and immune sources

10_598.description: 激活集中于生物医学语境，涉及VEGF与血管生成、干细胞及标志物、细胞因子、临床试验登记和论文中的合作机构信息；各模式并非完全同一主题。

patterns.name: 人名与机构合作署名
patterns.trigger: « University»6« of»4« Main»2«z»3；« German»5« cancer»4« Research»3« center»9
patterns.context: 研究设计背景中出现合作者姓名、机构及协作描述。

patterns.name: 细胞因子家族与免疫来源
patterns.context: 介绍细胞因子家族及其由免疫细胞或肿瘤细胞产生。

en.description: Strong responses to entity-dense text in specialized biomedical contexts, especially alphanumeric abbreviations, cells/markers, immune and tumor mechanisms, drugs, and research proper names; surrounding general scientific narrative also activates.

patterns.name: Alphanumeric abbreviations and markers in specialized biomedical text
patterns.context: Appears in sentences containing many biomedical entities and proper names, often adjacent to numbers, hyphens, Greek letters, or mixed-case forms; activations may occur on ordinary words before or after entities
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, medical research funding abstracts, and patent background

patterns.name: Angiogenesis and cancer treatment terminology
patterns.context: Appears in discussions of tumor cells, angiogenesis, treatment mechanisms, or inhibition of angiogenesis

patterns.name: Immune cells, immune markers, and immune function
patterns.context: Describes immune cell types, immunophenotypes, markers, or immune function; also includes immune-related molecular names

patterns.name: Stem cells, cancer stem cells, and their markers
patterns.context: Involves stem cell or cancer stem cell phenotypes, markers, or culture/sphere formation
patterns.domain: Stem cell research and tumor biology

patterns.name: Inflammatory factors and signaling pathways
patterns.context: Cytokines, chemokines, and signaling pathways appear in descriptions of inflammation or mechanisms of endothelial adaptation to abnormal conditions

patterns.name: Drug, compound, and targeted therapy names
patterns.context: Proper names of drugs/compounds appearing in study treatment conditions or examples of targeted therapies
patterns.domain: Pharmacology, cancer treatment, and research methods

patterns.name: Proper names of research institutions, cohorts, and clinical registrations
patterns.context: Research sources, collaborators, cohorts, or clinical trial registration information; activations occur on proper names and surrounding administrative/research descriptions
patterns.domain: Research abstracts and clinical research reports

patterns.name: General connective language and scientific narrative
patterns.context: General descriptive or connective phrases in entity-dense specialized text that do not themselves constitute a unified semantic trigger
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, abstracts, and patent prose

10_598.concept: 生物医学实体密集文本
10_598.description: 对生物医学专业语境中的实体密集文本反应明显，尤其是字母数字缩写、细胞/标记物、免疫与肿瘤机制、药物及研究专名；周围普通科学叙述也会激活。

patterns.name: 生物医学专业文本中的字母数字缩写与标记
patterns.trigger: 基因、蛋白、细胞标志物、细胞因子等缩写及其带数字/连字符形式，如“CD29”“VEGF”“PD-1”“Tfh”“NF-κB”“TCDD”“NCT101561144”
patterns.context: 出现在包含大量生物医学实体和专名的句子中，常与数字、连字符、希腊字母或大小写混合形式相邻；激活可落在实体前后的普通词上
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、医学研究资助摘要及专利背景

patterns.name: 血管生成与肿瘤治疗相关术语
patterns.context: 讨论肿瘤细胞、血管生成、治疗机制或抑制血管生成时出现

patterns.name: 免疫细胞、免疫标记与免疫功能
patterns.trigger: “immune cells”“CD4+ T cell”“exhaustion phenotype”“inhibitor molecules”“immunological memory”“Tfh”“B cells”“HLA-ABC”
patterns.context: 描述免疫细胞类型、免疫表型、标记物或免疫功能；也包括免疫相关分子名

patterns.name: 干细胞、肿瘤干细胞及其标志物
patterns.trigger: “embryonic stem cell marker”“mesenchymal stem cell markers”“sphere formation”“CSC-related markers”“CD133”“EpCAM”
patterns.context: 涉及干细胞或肿瘤干细胞表型、标志物及培养/成球现象
patterns.domain: 干细胞研究与肿瘤生物学

patterns.name: 炎症因子与信号通路
patterns.context: 炎症或内皮细胞适应异常的机制叙述中出现细胞因子、趋化因子和信号通路

patterns.name: 药物、化合物与靶向治疗名称
patterns.context: 研究处理条件或靶向治疗举例中出现的药物/化合物专名
patterns.domain: 药理学、肿瘤治疗及研究方法

patterns.name: 研究机构、队列与临床登记专名
patterns.trigger: “University of Mainz”“German cancer Research center”“Spanish centres”“UMBRA study”“NCT101561144”
patterns.context: 研究来源、协作人员、队列或临床试验登记信息；激活落在专名及相关行政/研究描述周围
patterns.domain: 科研摘要与临床研究报告

patterns.name: 普通论述连接语及一般科学叙述
patterns.trigger: “strongly positive for”“correlated with”“Another type of targeted therapy includes”“This database is supported by”
patterns.context: 专业实体密集文本中的一般描述性或连接性短语，本身不构成统一的语义触发条件
patterns.domain: 科学论文、摘要与专利说明文体

en.description: Activations occur mainly in biomedical text: angiogenic factors, cytokines and immune regulation, and stem cell/tumor cell markers and immunophenotypes; immune subtopics such as Treg and Tfh also appear. Some cohort and in vitro treatment contexts are difficult to classify.

patterns.name: Angiogenesis and VEGF factors
patterns.context: Discussions of angiogenesis, endothelial cell proliferation, or related factors; factor names may be split into tokens.
patterns.domain: Tumor biology, angiogenesis research, and related patent background

patterns.name: Cytokines and immune regulation
patterns.context: Cytokines involved in immune effects, lymphoma pathology, or hematopoietic cell culture; often accompanied by specific interleukin names.

patterns.name: Cell surface markers and immunophenotypes
patterns.context: Describes surface markers, marker expression, and immunophenotypes of stem cells or tumor cells; CD markers appear in varying separated forms.
patterns.domain: Stem cell and cell biology research

patterns.name: Stem cell-related phenotypes
patterns.context: Involves stem cell types, culture, or phenotypes; sometimes listed alongside marker detection.

patterns.name: Experimental research and researcher background
patterns.context: Describes research cohorts, collaborators, or in vitro treatments, rather than an explicit cytokine/marker theme.
patterns.domain: Research project abstracts or methods background

patterns.name: Treg and lymphoma
patterns.context: Discusses regulatory T-cell suppression of immune effects and the lymphoma-related immune environment.

patterns.name: Follicular helper T cells
patterns.context: Describes Tfh cell help for B cells and its dependence on transcription factors.

patterns.name: Unclearly classified hematopoietic transplant defects
patterns.context: Aims to identify cytokines that cause engraftment defects; its specific wording has limited connection to other fragments.

10_598.concept: 生物医学细胞与免疫研究
10_598.description: 激活主要见于生物医学文本：血管生成因子、细胞因子与免疫调节，以及干细胞/肿瘤细胞标志物和免疫表型；另见Treg、Tfh等免疫亚主题。个别队列与体外处理背景难以归类。

patterns.name: 血管生成与 VEGF 因子
patterns.context: 血管生成、内皮细胞增殖或相关因子的讨论；因子名可分词出现。
patterns.domain: 肿瘤生物学、血管生成研究及相关专利背景

patterns.name: 细胞因子与免疫调节
patterns.context: 细胞因子参与免疫效应、淋巴瘤病理或造血细胞培养；常伴具体白介素名称。
patterns.domain: 免疫学、淋巴瘤及造血研究

patterns.name: 细胞表面标志物与免疫表型
patterns.context: 描述干细胞或肿瘤细胞的表面标志、标志物表达及免疫表型；CD标志的分隔形式不一。
patterns.domain: 干细胞与细胞生物学研究

patterns.name: 干细胞相关表型
patterns.context: 涉及干细胞类别、培养或其表型；有时与标志物检测并列。

patterns.name: 实验研究与研究人员背景
patterns.context: 描述研究队列、合作人员或体外处理，而非明确的细胞因子/标志物主题。
patterns.domain: 科研项目摘要或方法背景

patterns.name: Treg 与淋巴瘤
patterns.context: 讨论调节性T细胞抑制免疫效应及淋巴瘤相关免疫环境。

patterns.name: 滤泡辅助性T细胞
patterns.context: 说明Tfh细胞对B细胞的帮助及其转录因子依赖。

patterns.name: 未清楚归类的造血移植缺陷
patterns.context: 以识别导致植入缺陷的细胞因子为研究目标；与其他片段的具体表述联系有限。

en.concept: Cell and factor research in biomedicine
en.description: Primarily responds to angiogenesis, factors such as VEGF, immune regulation, and cell markers in biomedical text; also responds to stem cell, tissue repair, and cancer research contexts. Cohort and TCDD experimental contexts are also difficult to group under a common theme.

patterns.name: Angiogenesis and related factors
patterns.context: Discusses angiogenesis, its growth factors, or related cytokine expression, measurement, and function; one instance also mentions an angiogenesis inhibitor.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, tumor and angiogenesis research, and patent background

patterns.name: Immune cell phenotypes and markers
patterns.context: Lists surface markers, expression characteristics, or cellular phenotypes of stem cells, cancer stem cells, or immune cells.
patterns.domain: Cell biology, immunology, and tumor research

patterns.name: Immune regulation and immunosuppression
patterns.context: Discusses impaired immune cell function, immunosuppressive molecules, immune-related syndromes, or the role of cytokines in tumors.
patterns.domain: Immunology, tumor immunity, and transplantation research

patterns.name: Stem cells and tissue repair
patterns.context: Involves stem cell markers, stem cell-related factors, cell sphere formation, or brain tissue repair after injury.
patterns.domain: Stem cell biology, neural repair, and tumor research

patterns.name: Research cohorts and experimental context
patterns.context: Research background involving population cohorts, collaborators, or in vitro treatments, rather than descriptions of specific molecular mechanisms.
patterns.domain: Public health, epidemiology, and research project abstracts

patterns.name: Other descriptions of cytokines and cancer
patterns.context: Describes specific cytokine families, cancer cells, and their induction of other molecular expression, but does not fit fully into a clear angiogenesis or immune pattern.

patterns.name: Radiation-related neurotoxicity
patterns.context: Describes risk assessment for children receiving radiotherapy while measuring angiogenesis-related indicators.

patterns.name: Angiogenesis processes and growth factors
patterns.context: Describes endothelial cell tube formation and the growth factors involved.

10_598.concept: 生物医学中的细胞与因子研究
10_598.description: 主要响应生物医学文本中的血管生成、VEGF等因子、免疫调节及细胞标志物；也响应干细胞、组织修复和癌症研究语境。另有队列与TCDD实验背景难以归入共同主题。

patterns.name: 血管生成及相关因子
patterns.context: 讨论血管生成、其生长因子或相关细胞因子的表达、测量及功能；并有一处提到血管生成的抑制因子。
patterns.domain: 生物医学，肿瘤、血管生成研究与专利背景

patterns.name: 免疫细胞表型与标志物
patterns.context: 列举干细胞、肿瘤干细胞或免疫细胞的表面标志物、表达特征或细胞表型。
patterns.domain: 细胞生物学、免疫学及肿瘤研究

patterns.name: 免疫调节与免疫抑制
patterns.context: 讨论免疫细胞功能受损、免疫抑制分子、免疫相关综合征或细胞因子在肿瘤中的作用。
patterns.domain: 免疫学、肿瘤免疫及移植研究

patterns.name: 干细胞与组织修复
patterns.trigger: «embryonic»6« stem»4« cell»；«mesenchymal»5« stem»3« cell»；«stem»5« cell»6« factor»；«sphere»3« formation»
patterns.context: 涉及干细胞标志、干细胞相关因子、细胞球形成，或损伤后脑组织修复。
patterns.domain: 干细胞生物学、神经修复及肿瘤研究

patterns.name: 研究队列与实验背景
patterns.trigger: «cohort»；«110 individuals»；«clinicians»；«German»6« cancer»4« Research»1« center»；«In vitro» treatment with TCDD
patterns.context: 出现人群队列、研究协作人员或体外处理的研究背景，而非具体分子机制描述。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生、流行病学及研究项目摘要

patterns.name: 细胞因子与癌症的其他表达描述
patterns.context: 描述特定细胞因子家族、癌细胞及其诱导其他分子表达，但不完全落入明确的血管生成或免疫模式。

patterns.name: 辐射相关神经毒性
patterns.context: 描述儿童接受放疗后的风险评估，同时测量血管生成相关指标。
patterns.domain: 儿科肿瘤与神经毒性研究

patterns.name: 血管生成过程与生长因子
patterns.trigger: «proliferation»；«endothelial» cells»；«tube»-»like» structures»；«fibroblast» growth» factor»；«vascular» endothelial» growth» factor»
patterns.context: 描述内皮细胞形成管状结构的过程及参与其中的生长因子。

en.description: Primarily responds to cytokines, immune regulation, stem cells, and angiogenesis-related terminology and mechanisms in biomedical text; also activates on gene expression experiments, neurotoxicity assessment, and cell marker descriptions. Data privacy statements lack an obvious shared trigger.

patterns.name: Cytokines and immune regulation
patterns.context: Discusses immune effects, Treg, biology, or cytokines and their roles in the tumor microenvironment.

patterns.name: Angiogenesis and related factors
patterns.context: Discusses angiogenesis, endothelial cells, pro-angiogenic factors, or their expression, proliferation, and migration.

patterns.name: Stem cells and hematopoietic repair
patterns.context: Describes stem cell markers, stem cell culture, transplantation, or growth factors promoting brain injury repair.

patterns.name: Gene expression and experimental procedures
patterns.context: Describes changes in gene or protein expression and the effects of experimental procedures such as knockdown on cellular phenotypes.

patterns.name: Neurotoxicity and radiation risk
patterns.context: Assesses children receiving radiation therapy and radiation-related neurotoxicity, and measures relevant biomarkers.

patterns.name: Patient data privacy and access statements
patterns.context: States that patient data cannot be made public due to privacy restrictions and provides institutional or ethics committee contact channels.

patterns.name: Chromosomal karyotype and immunophenotypic markers
patterns.context: Lists stem cell, mesenchymal stem cell, and immunological markers of cells.

patterns.name: T-cell exhaustion markers
patterns.context: Describes T-cell exhaustion phenotypes, cytotoxicity, and expression of inhibitory molecules.

10_598.concept: 生物医学细胞与生长因子
10_598.description: 主要响应生物医学文本中细胞因子、免疫调节、干细胞及血管生成相关术语和机制；也激活于基因表达实验、神经毒性评估及细胞标志物描述。数据隐私声明缺乏明显共同触发特征。

patterns.name: 细胞因子与免疫调节
patterns.context: 讨论免疫效应、Treg、生物学或肿瘤微环境中的细胞因子及其作用。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要或论文

patterns.name: 血管生成及相关因子
patterns.context: 讨论血管生成、内皮细胞、促血管生成因子或其表达、增殖和迁移。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究与专利背景

patterns.name: 干细胞与造血修复
patterns.context: 描述干细胞标志物、干细胞培养、移植或生长因子促进脑损伤修复。
patterns.domain: 细胞生物学与再生医学

patterns.name: 基因表达与实验操作
patterns.context: 描述基因或蛋白表达变化，以及敲低等实验操作对细胞表型的影响。

patterns.name: 神经毒性与辐射风险
patterns.context: 评估接受放射治疗的儿童及辐射相关神经毒性，并测量相关生物标志物。

patterns.name: 患者数据隐私与获取说明
patterns.context: 说明患者数据因隐私限制不能公开，并给出机构或伦理委员会联系渠道。

patterns.name: 染色体核型与免疫表型标记
patterns.context: 列举细胞的干细胞、间充质干细胞及免疫学标志物。
patterns.domain: 细胞表征与免疫表型研究

patterns.name: T细胞耗竭标志
patterns.context: 描述T细胞耗竭表型、细胞毒性及抑制分子表达。

en.description: Activation is most concentrated on proper nouns beginning with “United,” covering the U.S. Postal Service, courts, case law, companies, airlines, and the United Nations. Other activations occur in legal citations, personal names and strings in code, month-scheduling phrases, and medical terminology related to fetal abuse.

patterns.name: Proper nouns beginning with “United”
patterns.context: The fragment begins with United, followed by an institution, organization, company, place name, or other proper noun; punctuation and line breaks are sometimes also marked.

patterns.name: Legal citation format
patterns.context: In U.S. case citations, a volume number is followed by F.2d, a page number, a line break, and a personal name.

patterns.name: Proper nouns and strings in code
patterns.context: A personal name marked as split appears in code or a code comment, as does the string Input Filter.

patterns.name: English month phrases
patterns.context: A sentence describes arrangements for a month, then mentions a weekly budget meeting.

patterns.name: Terms related to fetal abuse
patterns.context: A medical abstract discusses physical harm to an unborn child by a pregnant woman and related reports.

10_979.description: 激活最集中于以“United”起始的各类专名，覆盖美国邮政、法院、判例、公司、航空公司和联合国；另见法律引证、代码中的人名及字符串、月份安排短语和胎儿受虐相关医学用语。

patterns.name: “United”开头的专名
patterns.context: 片段以 United 开头，后续组成机构、组织、公司、地名或专名；有时标点、换行也被标记

patterns.name: 法律引证格式
patterns.context: 美国判例引证中，卷号、F.2d、页码后接换行及人名

patterns.name: 代码中的专名与字符串
patterns.context: 代码或代码注释中出现被拆分标记的人名，以及字符串 Input Filter

patterns.name: 英文月份短语
patterns.context: 句子说明某月的安排，随后提到每周预算会议

patterns.name: 胎儿受虐相关词语
patterns.context: 医学摘要讨论孕期女性对未出生孩子的身体伤害及相关报道

en.description: The clearest shared signal is proper-noun text, especially names of institutions or organizations beginning with United. Activations also occur in name fragments, medical terminology, legal citations, and line breaks and indentation after titles, possibly reflecting several local patterns.

patterns.name: Proper nouns beginning with United
patterns.context: Text begins with United, followed by a proper noun referring to an organization, institution, company, airline, or country; no particular subsequent category is required.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, law, medical abstracts, and web text

patterns.name: Special names or category words in proper nouns
patterns.context: Occurs in proper nouns such as institution, work, or place names. Activation is scattered across name components, with no consistent lexical form.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments of biomedical terms
patterns.context: In medical abstracts, technical terms or protein names are split into multiple tokens; «processing» has the strongest activation.

patterns.name: Legal citation format
patterns.context: Sequences of volume numbers, reporter abbreviations, and page numbers in U.S. case citations.

patterns.name: Line breaks and formatting after titles
patterns.context: A line break or whitespace indentation appears after a title, case name, or institution name; activation falls on the formatting boundary.

10_979.description: 最明显的共同线索是专名文本，尤其以 United 开头的机构或组织名称；此外，名称片段、医学术语、法律引文及标题后的换行和缩进也有激活，可能反映多种局部模式。

patterns.name: United 开头的专名
patterns.context: 文本以 United 开头，后面接组织、机构、公司、航空公司或国家相关专名；未必要求特定后续类别
patterns.domain: 百科、法律、医学摘要及网页文本

patterns.name: 专名中的专用名称或类别词
patterns.trigger: «Rog»«ers» Media；«More»« Songs» to Dead Friends；«Post»« Office»；«Court» of «Appeals»
patterns.context: 出现在机构、作品或地名等专名中，激活分散在名称各部分，未见统一的词法形式

patterns.name: 生物医学术语的分词片段
patterns.context: 医学摘要中，专业词或蛋白名称被拆成多个 token；其中 «processing» 激活最强

patterns.name: 法律引文格式
patterns.context: 美国判例引文的卷号、报告集缩写和页码序列

patterns.name: 标题后的换行与排版
patterns.context: 标题、判例名或机构名后出现换行、空白缩进，激活落在排版边界上

en.description: Activations occur across local features of several kinds of structured text: nested JSON, whitespace control characters, titles in quotation marks, code syntax fragments, email forwarding headers, and medical titles. The triggering forms differ, with no stable shared meaning or single domain.

patterns.name: JSON hierarchy and fields
patterns.context: The children field appears repeatedly in a nested JSON object, followed by an id field; activation falls on quotation marks, colons, line breaks, and field structure.

patterns.name: Consecutive whitespace and control characters
patterns.context: The text consists mainly of carriage returns, line breaks, tabs, and whitespace, with almost no substantive content.

patterns.name: Paper or article titles beginning with The
patterns.context: A title in quotation marks begins with The and is followed by a topic word; one is a medical paper title, the other a general article title.

patterns.name: UTF-8/percent-decoding code
patterns.context: A PHP function or code processes URL encoding and UTF characters; a garbled byte sequence occurs earlier in the text.

patterns.name: Laravel controller request validation
patterns.context: A controller method in PHP calls validate on request data and lists field rules.

patterns.name: URL loop in asynchronous test code
patterns.context: An asynchronous JavaScript function iterates over a URL list and makes requests, in a test or scraping code snippet.

patterns.name: Forwarded email header
patterns.context: A forwarded-message separator and sender header fields appear after the email body.

patterns.name: Possessive and role description in a medical paper title
patterns.context: The title introduces the role of a clinical geneticist with a topic phrase and colon, involving parental guilt.

10_979.description: 激活分布在多种结构化文本局部：嵌套 JSON、空白控制符、引号中的标题、代码语法片段、邮件转发头及医学题名。各处触发形式不同，未见稳定共享的词义或单一领域。

patterns.name: JSON层级结构与字段
patterns.context: 嵌套 JSON 对象中连续出现 children 字段，随后进入 id 字段；激活落在引号、冒号、换行和字段结构上

patterns.name: 连续空白与控制字符
patterns.context: 文本主要由回车、换行、制表符和空白组成，几乎没有实质内容
patterns.domain: 法律文本或排版/格式数据

patterns.name: 以 The 开头的论文或文章标题
patterns.trigger: "The battered fetus syndrome"；"The Entire Mediterranean Is On Fire"
patterns.context: 引号内以 The 起始的标题，后接主题词；一个是医学论文题名，一个是一般文章标题

patterns.name: UTF-8/百分号解码代码
patterns.context: PHP 函数或代码处理 URL 编码及 UTF 字符；前文有乱码字节序列

patterns.name: Laravel 控制器请求验证
patterns.context: PHP 控制器方法中对请求数据调用 validate 并列出字段规则

patterns.name: 异步测试代码中的 URL 循环
patterns.trigger: async function main()；for (var url of urls)；try
patterns.context: JavaScript 异步函数遍历 URL 列表并发起请求，处于测试或抓取代码片段中

patterns.name: 转发邮件头
patterns.context: 邮件正文后出现转发邮件分隔线及发件人头字段

patterns.name: 医学论文标题中的所有格与角色描述
patterns.trigger: Parental guilt: The part played by the clinical geneticist
patterns.context: 标题以主题短语和冒号引出临床遗传学家的作用，涉及家长内疚

en.concept: Intra-Word Fragments and Local Word Forms
en.description: Activations are scattered. The most prominent repeated trigger is the intra-word fragment “Cit” (citizens, legal citations, company names); other triggers include several intra-word fragments, technical terms, historical narration, and sporadic occurrences of nearly, with no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: “Cit” in subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls within words or abbreviations beginning with Cit; surrounding text does not constrain it to a single meaning.
patterns.domain: Historic buildings, legal citations, and financial company texts

patterns.name: Intra-word subword fragments
patterns.context: Triggers within several complete words, with no stable shared semantics; may relate to word fragments or tokenization boundaries.

patterns.name: Fragments of compound technical terms
patterns.context: Triggers occur in word fragments of an auditory-visual-tactile synchrony term and a description of image-forming equipment.

patterns.name: “forcing” in historical narration
patterns.context: Describes a fire destroying a ballpark and equipment, forcing the team to find another place to play.

patterns.name: “nearly” and homogeneity statements
patterns.context: Modifies the degree of homogeneity of experimental samples as determined by electrophoresis.

patterns.name: “nearly” and time span
patterns.context: Modifies a time span of almost 33 years since independence.

10_979.description: 激活较分散：最突出的重复触发是词内片段“Cit”（公民、法律引证、公司名）；另有若干词内片段及技术术语、历史叙述和 nearly 等零散触发，未形成统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 分词子片段中的“Cit”
patterns.context: 激活落在以 Cit 开头的词或缩写的词内；周围文本不限定同一含义。
patterns.domain: 历史建筑、法律引证与金融公司文本

patterns.name: 词内子词片段
patterns.context: 在若干完整词的内部触发，未见稳定共同语义；可能与词片段或分词边界有关。

patterns.name: 复合技术术语片段
patterns.context: 触发在听觉-视觉-触觉同步术语及图像形成设备描述中的词片段。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、专利背景

patterns.name: 历史叙述中的“forcing”
patterns.context: 描述火灾摧毁球场和器材后，迫使球队另觅场地比赛。

patterns.name: “nearly”与均一性表述
patterns.context: 修饰实验样品在电泳判断下的均一程度。

patterns.name: “nearly”与时间跨度
patterns.context: 修饰独立以来接近 33 年的时间跨度。

en.description: Activations cover the start of an HTML document and copyright comment, sentence-initial just requests in email, legal counterclaim, gardening cardboard, an academic hearing term, and the event location Gothenburg. Apart from their local contexts, no unified trigger condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Start of an HTML document
patterns.context: Appears at the very start of a document, with the html root tag and a line break immediately following the DOCTYPE declaration; no other context is required.

patterns.name: Copyright attribution in an HTML comment
patterns.context: A copyright symbol and author name appear in an opening HTML comment; activation is especially concentrated around the name Christ(en).

patterns.name: Conversational requests or instructions beginning with just
patterns.context: Sentence-initial or utterance-initial just introduces a brief, direct request or instruction; examples ask someone to acknowledge something, make a call, or bring a check.
patterns.domain: Informal business communication in Enron email

patterns.name: claim in legal proceedings
patterns.context: Occurs in legal narration about summary judgment, litigants, and a consolidated counterclaim.

patterns.name: cardboard in a gardening context
patterns.context: Occurs in discussions of covering soil, growing strawberries, and gardening methods; the word activates much more strongly than nearby words.

patterns.name: Auditory and tactile synchrony term
patterns.context: Begins a technical phrase in an academic abstract, followed by visuo-tactile synchrony.

patterns.name: Track-and-field event location Got(h)enburg
patterns.context: Appears in an event-results entry describing the venue for the men's shot put at the 1974 European Indoor Athletics Championships.

10_979.description: 激活涵盖 HTML 文档起始及版权注释、邮件中句首 just 请求、法律 counterclaim、园艺 cardboard、学术 hearing 术语和赛事地名 Gothenburg；除各自局部语境外，看不出统一触发条件。

patterns.name: HTML 文档开头
patterns.context: 出现在文档最开头，DOCTYPE 声明后紧接 html 根标签和换行；无需其他上下文。
patterns.domain: GitHub 中的 HTML 源码

patterns.name: HTML 注释中的版权署名
patterns.context: HTML 开头注释里出现版权符号及作者姓名；激活尤其集中在姓名 Christ(en) 一带。

patterns.name: just 起始的口语请求或指令
patterns.context: 句首或话语开头的 just 引出简短直接的请求/指令；各例分别要求承认、打电话或带支票。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的非正式商务交流

patterns.name: 法律诉讼中的 claim
patterns.context: 出现在关于 summary judgment、诉讼当事人及 consolidated counterclaim 的法律叙述中。

patterns.name: 园艺语境中的 cardboard
patterns.context: 在谈论覆盖土壤、种植草莓及园艺方法时出现；该词激活显著强于邻近词。

patterns.name: 听觉与触觉同步术语
patterns.context: 作为学术摘要中的术语短语开头，后接 visuo-tactile synchrony。

patterns.name: 田径赛事地名 Got(h)enburg
patterns.context: 出现在赛事结果条目中，描述 1974 年欧洲室内田径锦标赛男子铅球的举办地。

en.description: Activations concentrate on structured and typographically salient text: legal document headers and party sections, tabular statistics, indented code, directory entries, and biomedical and French-language discussions containing specialized terms. There is no evidence that a single meaning dominates.

patterns.name: Legal document headers and titles
patterns.context: Legal document headers with court name, location, opinion title, and other details formatted with aligned spaces and line breaks.
patterns.domain: U.S. court decisions and legal documents

patterns.name: Party section in legal case documents
patterns.context: A case-caption section comprising litigants, relationships, legal roles, and aligned asterisks.

patterns.name: Tabular demographic data
patterns.context: Table rows organized by region, group description, and numeric results.
patterns.domain: Tables in medical or public health research

patterns.name: Indented program code
patterns.context: Code comments, indentation, loops, or assignment statements; snippets contain programming language markers.

patterns.name: Music catalog entries
patterns.context: A discography listing artists, album or single names, and release years line by line.

patterns.name: Herpesvirus abbreviations and biological statements
patterns.context: Statements about virus names, parenthetical abbreviations, and chronic or long-term infection characteristics.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers or NIH project text

patterns.name: French colloquial speech and phonetics discussion
patterns.context: French sentences discuss accents and compare the intonation of declarative and interrogative sentences.

10_979.description: 激活集中在结构化、排版显著的文本：法律文书页眉和当事人栏、表格统计行、缩进代码、目录条目，以及带专门术语的生物医学和法语语言讨论；没有证据显示单一词义主导。

patterns.name: 法律文书页眉与标题
patterns.trigger: “Fourth Court of Appeals”“San Antonio, Texas”“MEMORANDUM OPINION”“OPINION AND ORDER”
patterns.context: 法院名称、地点、意见标题等以对齐空格和换行排版的法律文书抬头。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决与法律文书

patterns.name: 法律案件当事人栏
patterns.trigger: “Guardian of her Minor Children”“Plaintiff”“as Parent and Legal”以及姓名和星号标记
patterns.context: 诉讼当事人、身份关系、诉讼角色与成列星号构成的案件标题区。

patterns.name: 表格化人口统计数据
patterns.trigger: “Sydney, NSW”“Students attending … public high school”及括号中的数字、百分比
patterns.context: 按地区、群体描述和数字统计结果分列的表格行。
patterns.domain: 医学或公共卫生研究中的表格

patterns.name: 缩进的程序代码
patterns.context: 代码注释、缩进、循环或赋值语句；代码片段中包含程序语言标记。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答、GitHub/SystemVerilog 代码

patterns.name: 音乐作品目录条目
patterns.context: 以艺人、专辑或单曲名称与发行年份逐行列出的唱片目录。

patterns.name: 疱疹病毒缩写与生物学陈述
patterns.context: 病毒名称、括号内缩写及其慢性或长期感染特征的陈述。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文或 NIH 项目文本

patterns.name: 法语口语与语音讨论
patterns.context: 法语句子讨论口音，并比较陈述句与疑问句语调。

en.concept: Possessive Markers and Local Word Fragments
en.description: Most passages activate on the possessive s subword, across legal, encyclopedic, medical, and academic texts. Other patterns include the ratchet fragment in patents, variable fragments in mathematical formulas, and difficult-to-classify split-word fragments in philosophical texts.

patterns.name: s after possessive apostrophes in legal text
patterns.context: The possessive marker s receives strong activation, especially in defendant’s and proper-name possessives in legal narration, and also in ordinary personal possessives. Activation often falls on the s subword after the apostrophe.
patterns.domain: Legal, academic, encyclopedic, and news narratives

patterns.name: ratchet fragment
patterns.context: The name of a mechanical part, ratchet, is split into subwords, with activation concentrated on the chet fragment; a possessive context is not required.

patterns.name: Subscripts and variable fragments in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: LaTeX-style indexed variables and equations are presented; activation is distributed across formula subwords.

patterns.name: Unexplained philpapers fragments
patterns.context: Several split-word fragments activate in a philosophy paper excerpt; their relationship to the other patterns cannot be determined from the available context.

10_979.concept: 所有格标记与局部词片段
10_979.description: 多数段落在所有格 s 子词上激活，涵盖法律、百科、医学与学术文本；另有专利中的 ratchet 词片段、数学公式变量片段，以及哲学文本中难以归类的拆词片段。

patterns.name: 法律文本中所有格撇号后的 s
patterns.context: 所有格标记 s 获得强激活；尤其出现在法律叙述中的 defendant’s、专名所有格，也见普通人物所有格。激活往往落在撇号后的 s 子词上。
patterns.domain: 法律、学术、百科及新闻叙述

patterns.name: ratchet 词片段
patterns.context: 机械部件名称 ratchet 被拆分为子词，激活集中于 chet 片段；不要求所有格语境。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的下标与变量片段
patterns.trigger: 公式中的“i”“e”“s”“f”及下标/符号片段，如“e»_{i…}”“s_i”
patterns.context: 呈现 LaTeX 风格的索引变量与等式；激活分布在公式子词上。

patterns.name: 未解释的 philpapers 片段
patterns.context: 哲学论文片段中多个被拆分的词片段激活，无法从现有上下文确认与其余模式的关系。

en.concept: Local Forms and Terminology in Legal Text
en.description: Activations occur most often in legal text, especially plea language, possessive s, procedural terms, and discussions of criminal cases. Other sporadic patterns include patent component descriptions, technology product reviews, and casual email; no unified semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Possessive markers in legal text
patterns.context: In legal documents, s after a possessive apostrophe receives strong activation; the fragment often appears with a person's name, motion, or legal matter.

patterns.name: to in plea language
patterns.context: Occurs in the fixed legal phrase pleaded guilty to, with activation primarily on to.

patterns.name: guilty in criminal legal text
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of a plea or charge in a criminal case; activation is distributed across guilty and neighboring words.

patterns.name: High-frequency function words and punctuation in legal documents
patterns.context: Occurs near sentences, quotations, or statutory names in formal judicial documents; the trigger is not limited to a single word class.

patterns.name: Patent figures and component descriptions
patterns.context: Explanatory paragraphs about figure numbers, component numbers, structures, and materials; activation is concentrated on part of a component name or technical term.

patterns.name: Software platforms and product names
patterns.context: Discusses the failure of Microsoft's phone platform and its causes, with activations near the product name and related phrases.

patterns.name: Food and casual conversation in email
patterns.context: Casual conversation describes eating and drinking, then shifts to asking how someone is doing; activation falls on several word fragments.

patterns.name: Innocence defense and evidentiary dispute
patterns.context: Discusses the defense's arguments about how the jury may use evidence and a burglary charge.

10_979.concept: 法律文本中的局部形式与术语
10_979.description: 激活最常见于法律文本，尤其是认罪表述、所有格 s、程序词及刑事案件论述；另有专利部件说明、科技产品评论和口语邮件等零散模式，未见统一词义触发。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的所有格标记
patterns.context: 在法律文书中，所有格撇号后的 s 获得强激活；片段常伴随人名、动议或诉讼事项。

patterns.name: 认罪表述中的 to
patterns.context: 出现在 pleaded guilty to 这一法律固定搭配中，激活主要落在 to。

patterns.name: 刑事法律文本中的 guilty
patterns.context: 出现在刑事案件对认罪或罪名的描述中；激活分布在 guilty 及相邻词。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的高频结构词及标点
patterns.context: 在正式司法文书的句子、引述或法条名称附近出现，触发词并不固定为单一词类。
patterns.domain: 法律判决与程序性文书

patterns.name: 专利图示与部件描述
patterns.context: 围绕图号、组件编号、结构及材料的说明性段落；激活集中于部件名或技术名词的一部分。

patterns.name: 软件平台与产品名称
patterns.context: 讨论微软手机平台失败及其原因，产品名和相关短语附近激活。

patterns.name: 口语邮件中的食物与日常聊天
patterns.context: 随意对话中描述吃喝，并转向询问近况；激活落在若干词片段上。

patterns.name: 无罪辩护与证据争议
patterns.context: 讨论辩方关于陪审团如何使用证据、以及入室盗窃指控的论点。

en.description: Activations concentrate mainly in U.S. legal text, especially criminal charges, pleas, offenses, and procedural discussion. Other patterns include policing and professional rules, medical injury, and homestead-rights disputes. Names and date fields also activate in two email passages; numbering in legal text may contribute separately.

patterns.name: Criminal charges, sentences, and procedure
patterns.context: Describes a defendant being charged, pleading guilty, offenses, or criminal case procedure, often with statutes, case numbers, or factual background.

patterns.name: Legal opinions and law enforcement rule discussions
patterns.context: Legal text explains the legal standard for temporary police detention or professional rules for lawyers and their violation.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and attorney discipline decisions

patterns.name: Personal injury and medical treatment
patterns.context: Litigation narrative describes the plaintiff's nerve injury, diagnosis, and surgical treatment.

patterns.name: Homestead-rights dispute
patterns.context: After a check distribution event, a party asserts a homestead-rights claim through a letter from counsel.

patterns.name: Names and dates in email headers
patterns.context: Names, recipients, and dates appear in email metadata or forwarded-message headers; activation falls on split name fragments and adjacent date fields.

patterns.name: Possible trigger from numeric/numbering formats
patterns.context: Ordinals, case numbers, dates, or statutory numbering appear densely in legal text; whether this is an independent trigger pattern is uncertain.

10_979.description: 激活主要集中于美国法律文本，尤其刑事指控、认罪、罪名及程序论述；另见警务与职业规则、医疗伤害、宅地权益争议。两段邮件中姓名和日期字段也有激活，法律文本内编号可能另有贡献。

patterns.name: 罪名、刑罚与刑事程序
patterns.context: 描述被告被控、认罪、罪名或刑事案件程序，常伴随法条、案号或事实背景。

patterns.name: 法律意见与执法规则论述
patterns.trigger: “reasonable suspicion”“temporary investigative detention”“officer”“Rules of Professional Conduct”
patterns.context: 法律文本阐述警方临时拘留的法律标准，或律师职业规则及其违反情形。
patterns.domain: 美国判例及律师纪律裁决

patterns.name: 人身伤害与医疗诊疗
patterns.context: 诉讼叙述原告的神经损伤、诊断及手术治疗。
patterns.domain: 民事侵权/医疗事实认定

patterns.name: 宅地权益争议
patterns.context: 支票分配事件之后，当事人通过律师函提出宅地权益主张。

patterns.name: 邮件抬头中的姓名与日期
patterns.context: 邮件元数据或转发邮件抬头中出现姓名、收件人、日期；激活落在被切分的姓名片段及相邻日期字段。

patterns.name: 可能的数字/编号格式触发
patterns.context: 法律文本中的序数、案号、日期或法条编号密集出现；是否为独立触发模式不确定。

en.concept: Entities and Event Entries in Formal Text
en.description: Activations occur in cases, charges, and procedural statements in legal decisions and statutes, as well as email disclaimers, name lists, dates, music release information, and military timelines. Some patterns may be triggered by proper nouns or formatting.

patterns.name: Legal case fact narratives
patterns.context: Occurs in factual, charging, or ruling narratives in court decisions or pleadings, often with litigants, causes of action, and legal procedure terms.

patterns.name: Statutes and definitions of unlawful conduct
patterns.context: Cites statutes and describes elements of conduct, prohibited acts, or unlawful activity.

patterns.name: Formatted procedural language in legal documents
patterns.context: Ruling, summary, or judge's opinion formats in formal decisions; appears alongside case narratives.

patterns.name: Email disclaimers
patterns.context: A notice about misdelivery and a confidentiality or no-distribution statement appears at the end of an email or in forwarded content.

patterns.name: Name lists and name tokenization
patterns.context: Names, surnames, and given names are listed with commas or semicolons, or personal names are split into subwords; contexts vary across examples.
patterns.domain: Email recipient lists, legal texts, and place-name texts

patterns.name: Month and date strings
patterns.context: Month names occur next to dates, years, or date ranges in historical events or case timelines.

patterns.name: Descriptions of criminal acts and items involved
patterns.context: Specific descriptions of theft, concealing stolen goods, tax evasion, or related criminal charges.

patterns.name: Music titles and release information
patterns.context: Describes a band's work, music video premiere, and album release date.

patterns.name: Place names and military event timelines
patterns.context: Place names and date ranges appear together in chronologically ordered accounts of historical battles or demonstrations.

10_979.concept: 正式文本中的实体与事件条目
10_979.description: 激活分布于法律判决与法条中的案件、指控及程序语句，也见邮件免责声明、姓名名单、日期、音乐发行信息和军事年表；部分模式可能由专名或格式触发。

patterns.name: 法律案件事实叙述
patterns.context: 出现在法院判决或诉讼文书的事实、指控、裁定叙述中，常伴随当事人、诉因和法律程序用语。

patterns.name: 法律条文及违法行为定义
patterns.context: 引用法条并描述行为构成、禁止事项或违法行为。

patterns.name: 法律文件中的格式化程序用语
patterns.context: 正式判决的裁定、摘要或法官意见格式；与案件叙述同时出现。

patterns.name: 邮件免责声明
patterns.trigger: “you are hereby notified”“received this transmittal in error”“strictly prohibited”等
patterns.context: 邮件末尾或转发内容中的误收通知与保密、禁止传播声明。

patterns.name: 姓名名单与人名分词
patterns.context: 姓名、姓氏与名字以逗号或分号列举，或人名被切分成子词；各例上下文不同。
patterns.domain: 邮件收件人名单、法律文本及地名文本

patterns.name: 月份和日期串
patterns.context: 历史事件或案件时间线中，月份名称与日期、年份或日期范围相邻。
patterns.domain: 法律事实叙述、百科年表

patterns.name: 犯罪行为与涉案物品表述
patterns.trigger: “theft”“concealing stolen property”“attempted evasion and defeating of income tax”等
patterns.context: 对盗窃、藏匿赃物、逃税或相关犯罪指控的具体描述。

patterns.name: 音乐作品标题与发行信息

patterns.name: 地名与军事事件年表

en.description: Primarily responds to allegations, convictions, and lists of charges in criminal justice texts, especially collocations such as charged/convicted/guilty/indicted with for/of/with and counts of; also responds to opinion-format language, plus one email misdelivery disclaimer.

patterns.name: Allegations, convictions, and lists of charges
patterns.context: Describes specific charges against a defendant, convictions, arrests, or charges involved in a case in criminal opinions or news reports; common collocations include charged/convicted/guilty/indicted/arrested with for/of/with, and counts of.
patterns.domain: U.S. criminal justice opinions, appellate opinions, and police news

patterns.name: Opinion procedures and case-format language
patterns.context: Formatting phrases such as court-opinion or judgment titles, party identities, judge signatures, and procedural history; accompanies criminal case narratives in the same passage.

patterns.name: Email misdelivery disclaimer
patterns.context: Notifies recipients that an email or transmission was sent in error and warns against reviewing, forwarding, distributing, or copying it; unrelated to criminal legal texts.

10_979.description: 主要响应刑事司法文本中对罪名的指控、定罪和列举，尤其是 charged/convicted/guilty/indicted 与 for/of/with、counts of 等搭配；也响应判决书格式语，另有一段邮件误收免责声明。

patterns.name: 罪名的指控、定罪与列举
patterns.trigger: “charged with two counts of wanton endangerment”“convictions for three counts”“guilty of … misdemeanor offense”“indicted … for the murder”“guilty of domestic battery”“arrest … for criminal mischief”“convicted … for the crime of Assault and Battery”“convicted of distribution of cocaine”“counts of second degree robbery”“count of possession”

patterns.domain: 美国刑事司法判决、上诉意见与警务新闻

patterns.name: 判决书程序与案件格式语
patterns.trigger: “UNPUBLISHED OPINION”“Appellant”“Defendant and Appellant”“PER CURIAM”“Reversed and remanded”“Before … Circuit Judges”“was … charged, tried and convicted”
patterns.context: 法院意见或判决书的标题、当事人身份、法官署名及程序经过等格式化语句；与同段的刑事案件叙述相伴。
patterns.domain: 法律判决书与上诉意见

patterns.name: 邮件误收免责声明
patterns.trigger: “you have received this transmittal in error”“any review, dissemination, distribution or copying”“you suspect that you have received this communication”
patterns.context: 通知收件人邮件或传输内容系误发，并警告不得审阅、传播、分发或复制；与刑事法律文本无关。
patterns.domain: 电子邮件免责声明/商务通信

en.concept: Criminal legal documents and case procedure
en.description: Primarily responds to legal narratives in criminal judgments concerning prosecution, charges, counts, sentencing, and procedural handling; also covers case dates and identity information. A few heterogeneous triggers include error/misdelivery notices and concatenated network-code messages.

patterns.name: Prosecution, charges, and sentencing in criminal judgments
patterns.context: Identifies the defendant, charges, trial outcome, sentence, or case facts in criminal appeals or judgments; triggers often occur near charge names, count, or words introducing prosecution facts.

patterns.name: Judgment and procedural conclusions in court opinions
patterns.context: Rulings, judge signatures, and procedural language at the beginning or end of court opinions.

patterns.name: Anomaly, error, and exception notes
patterns.context: Records an error, anomaly, or misdirected communication; one example is a program anomaly notice and another is an email disclaimer.
patterns.domain: StackExchange error logs; Enron email legal disclaimer

patterns.name: Message concatenation and sending in C/C++ network code
patterns.context: Code concatenates a client message, directory name, or newline, then sends it over a socket.

patterns.name: Dates and case identity information
patterns.context: Lists case or ruling dates, parties' names, court, or judge information in legal documents; dates are a prominent trigger.

patterns.name: Criminal case titles and charge categories
patterns.context: Lists specific offense categories or charges in criminal opinions; some charge names are split across tokens.

patterns.name: Unpublished-opinion marker
patterns.context: The first page of a judgment marks the opinion as unpublished, followed by the case title and party information.

10_979.concept: 刑事法律文书与案件程序
10_979.description: 主要响应刑事判决中起诉、罪名、罪数、判决及程序处理等法律叙述，也覆盖案件日期与身份信息；另有错误/误收提示、网络代码消息拼接等少量异质触发。

patterns.name: 刑事判决中的起诉、罪名与量刑叙述
patterns.trigger: 如 «That»10 from on or about October 26, 1973；以及 «for»9、«charged»9、«murder»9、«count»8、«indictment»3
patterns.context: 刑事上诉或判决文书中，交代被告、起诉罪名、审判结果、刑罚或案件事实；触发常落在罪名、count 前后或引入起诉事实的词语上

patterns.name: 法院意见的判决与程序结尾
patterns.context: 法院意见开头或结尾的裁判结果、法官署名及程序性处理语句

patterns.name: 异常、错误与例外说明
patterns.trigger: «Inner»«Exception»、«An error has occurred»；«transmittal in error»、«received this communication in error»

patterns.name: C/C++ 网络代码中的消息拼接与发送

patterns.name: 日期及案件身份信息
patterns.context: 法律文书中列出案件发生或裁判日期、当事人姓名、法院或法官信息；其中日期触发较突出

patterns.name: 刑事案件标题与罪名类别
patterns.context: 刑事意见中列举具体犯罪类别或罪名；有些罪名被分词切开

patterns.name: 未发表意见标记
patterns.context: 判决首页标示意见未发表，后接案件标题及当事人信息

en.description: Most snippets contain error, Exception, or anomaly messages, covering error reports, exception catching and rethrowing, stack/assertion diagnostics, and runtime logs; there is also one passage about patent air pumping.

patterns.name: Error/exception report text
patterns.context: An error or failure appears as a program execution result, API response, or command output, often with a request for help or explanatory text.
patterns.domain: Programming Q&A, APIs, and command-line documentation

patterns.name: Catching and rethrowing exceptions
patterns.context: Code catches an exception and wraps and rethrows it, or continues processing in an exception-handling branch.

patterns.name: Exception stack traces and assertion failures

patterns.name: Exception events in logs

patterns.name: Air description in patent text
patterns.context: Describes a pumping device moving air from a bladder into structures such as a housing; there is no apparent software-exception context.

10_979.description: 多数片段出现 error、Exception 或异常消息，涉及错误报告、异常捕获与重抛、堆栈/断言诊断及运行日志；另有一段专利空气泵送文本。

patterns.name: 异常捕获与重新抛出

patterns.name: 日志中的异常事件
patterns.context: 日志行记录运行时异常及其事件处理阶段。

patterns.name: 专利文本中的空气描述
patterns.context: 描述泵送装置将空气从 bladder 移入 housing 等结构；没有明显的程序异常语境。

en.description: Primarily responds to exceptions, errors, and their reporting contexts: error messages, get … error/exception, stack traces, and code that catches or throws exceptions. Two isolated cases are “injuries” in a legal context and “amount of urine” in a patent context.

patterns.name: Runtime exceptions and error reports
patterns.context: Near an exception name, error message, or error response; common in questions, logs, and stack traces.

patterns.name: Exception stack traces and locations
patterns.context: Stack frames, source files, and line numbers following an exception.

patterns.name: Code that throws or wraps exceptions
patterns.context: Code explicitly catches, throws, or wraps exceptions; includes exception types and messages.

patterns.name: Reporting exceptions in questions
patterns.context: The author describes an error or exception encountered after an operation, usually requesting debugging help.

patterns.name: Injuries in a legal judgment
patterns.context: Narrative of injuries caused by a bicycle accident; unrelated to programming exceptions.

patterns.name: Amount of urine in patent text
patterns.context: Patent description of urine reaching a collection-bag junction; not a software-error context.

10_979.description: 主要响应异常、错误及其报告语境：错误消息、get … error/exception、堆栈跟踪和捕获或抛出异常的代码。另有法律语境的“injuries”和专利语境的“amount of urine”两个孤例。

patterns.name: 运行时异常与错误报告
patterns.context: 异常名称、错误消息或错误响应附近；常见于提问、日志和堆栈跟踪。

patterns.name: 异常堆栈跟踪与位置
patterns.trigger: “--- End of stack trace from previous location where exception was thrown ---”“at … Program.cs: line 22”
patterns.context: 异常后的堆栈帧、源码文件及行号信息。

patterns.name: 抛出或包装异常的代码
patterns.context: 代码显式捕获、抛出或包装异常；包括异常类型及其消息。

patterns.name: 提问中报告异常
patterns.trigger: “I get the following code”“I get the error”“I get an exception”
patterns.context: 作者描述操作后遇到的错误或异常，通常请求排错。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的 injuries
patterns.context: 自行车事故造成伤害的叙述；与编程异常无关。

patterns.name: 专利文本中的尿液数量
patterns.context: 尿液到达收集袋接合区域的专利描述；非软件错误语境。

en.description: Most snippets are errors, exceptions, or runtime results in technical Q&A, often introduced by get/gives/return; also includes code control flow, request output, Android logs, and one legal case narrative.

patterns.name: Error reports and exception output
patterns.context: An error and its result appear in a technical problem description, log, or exception message; often accompanied by descriptions using get/gives/return.

patterns.name: Introducing results in error messages
patterns.context: The questioner says an error, response, or output occurred after an operation, often introduced by following/this.

patterns.name: Program output and request-response sequences
patterns.context: Describes multiple lines of output or a request/response order after program execution; does not necessarily contain an error.
patterns.domain: StackExchange concurrency or network programming Q&A

patterns.name: Code control flow and command handling
patterns.context: A Python command branch handles an unknown command and raises an exception.

patterns.name: Legal case parties and incident facts
patterns.context: A legal opinion lists attorneys and a judge, then recounts the cause of the case and the injuries.

patterns.name: Interleaved code and logs
patterns.context: Code is followed by Android-style logs with timestamps, process IDs, and exception content.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A and Android logs

10_979.description: 多数片段是技术问答中的错误、异常或运行结果，常由 get/gives/return 等引出；另有代码控制流、请求输出、Android 日志，以及一段法律案件叙述。

patterns.name: 报错及异常输出
patterns.context: 技术问题描述或日志、异常信息中出现错误及其结果；常伴随 get/gives/return 等描述
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、程序日志

patterns.name: 错误信息中的结果引出
patterns.trigger: “get error”“get this response”“gives me the FileNotFoundError”“return the following code”
patterns.context: 提问者说明操作后得到错误、响应或输出，常用 following/this 引出

patterns.name: 程序输出与请求响应序列
patterns.context: 描述程序运行后的多行输出或请求/响应顺序；不一定包含错误
patterns.domain: StackExchange 并发或网络编程问答

patterns.name: 代码控制流及命令处理
patterns.context: Python 命令分支中处理未知命令并抛出异常

patterns.name: 法律案件当事人与事故事实
patterns.context: 法律意见书列出代理律师、法官，并叙述案件起因与伤情

patterns.name: 代码与日志混排
patterns.context: 代码后接 Android 风格带时间戳、进程号和异常内容的日志
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答及 Android 日志

en.description: Sensitive to failures and their feedback contexts: technical Q&A often introduces an error, message, or response after an operation fails; code also contains exception throwing, catching, and error/warning response handling.

patterns.name: Reporting errors in questions
patterns.context: Describes an operation or code execution failing, then introduces an error, message, or exception.

patterns.name: Deployment failure feedback
patterns.context: Reports a failure response after running an Azure CLI deployment.

patterns.name: Error-handling code
patterns.context: Code throws or catches an exception, or reads exception information.

patterns.name: Login flow stuck
patterns.context: Describes a problem encountered when redirecting based on user type, without directly providing exception text.

patterns.name: Frontend warning/error dispatch
patterns.context: Frontend code dispatches an error response of warning type.

10_979.description: 对失败及其反馈语境敏感：技术问答常在操作失败后引出 error、message 或 response；代码中也会出现异常抛出、捕获和错误/警告响应处理。

patterns.name: 提问中报告错误
patterns.trigger: “getting the following error”“receive the following message”“receiving the error”“get the error”
patterns.context: 描述操作或代码执行失败，随后引出错误、消息或异常内容

patterns.name: 部署失败反馈
patterns.context: 执行 Azure CLI 部署后报告失败响应

patterns.name: 错误处理代码
patterns.context: 代码中抛出异常、捕获异常或读取异常信息

patterns.name: 登录流程卡住
patterns.context: 描述按用户类型重定向时遇到问题，未直接给出异常文本

patterns.name: 前端警告错误分发
patterns.context: 前端代码分发警告类型的错误响应

en.description: Primarily responds to software-error and exception-related text: the word error, error reports, exception types, and throw statements; also covers error-count labels, missing resources, network send failures, invalid lengths, and expressions introducing errors in questions.

patterns.name: Error and exception reports
patterns.context: Reports program failure in a question, log, or code; often adjacent to getting, raise, throwing, unexpected, or Invalid.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A, software logs, and error-handling code

patterns.name: Exception types and throwing
patterns.context: Code explicitly throws an exception, or the context gives a framework/language exception class name; activation also covers Error within exception names.
patterns.domain: Python, Django, and other code and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Error counts and status fields
patterns.context: Metric or label fields in configuration or serialized data; may not describe a specific failure.
patterns.domain: JSON/configuration mappings or monitoring fields in code

patterns.name: Missing files or paths
patterns.context: Error-handling logic checks whether a file, path, or resource exists and reports an error if expectations are not met.

patterns.name: Connection and send failures in error messages
patterns.context: Log/response strings describe a connection interruption or send failure while sending a request.

patterns.name: Invalid length in error messages
patterns.context: A decryption operation fails after page navigation, and the error is quoted as a problem encountered by the user.

patterns.name: Lead-in to an error question
patterns.context: First-person problem descriptions introduce a subsequent exception or error message.

10_979.description: 主要响应软件错误及异常相关文本：错误一词、错误报告、异常类型与抛出语句；也覆盖错误计数标签、资源不存在、网络发送失败、无效长度等具体消息，以及提问中引出错误的表达。

patterns.name: 错误与异常报告

patterns.context: 在提问、日志或代码中报告程序失败；常与 getting、raise、throwing、unexpected、Invalid 等词相邻。

patterns.name: 异常类型与抛出

patterns.domain: Python、Django 等代码及技术问答

patterns.name: 错误计数与状态字段
patterns.context: 配置或序列化数据中的指标、标签字段，不一定是在描述一次具体故障。
patterns.domain: 代码中的 JSON/配置映射或监控字段

patterns.name: 文件或路径不存在

patterns.name: 错误消息中的连接、发送故障

patterns.name: 错误消息中的无效长度

patterns.name: 错误提问引导语
patterns.context: 第一人称问题描述中引出后续异常或错误信息。

en.description: All snippets contain error/Error/Exception-related terms, covering error descriptions, exception text and handling code, error counts, and callback parameters; JSON, MongoDB, and network errors are specific contexts.

patterns.name: error/error object in error contexts
patterns.context: The word error appears in Q&A error descriptions, exception types, or code comments; sometimes accompanied by specific error text.

patterns.name: Connection/send failure error text
patterns.context: An exception message for a failed request send, appearing in explanations of reproducing an error or exception types.

patterns.name: JSON-related errors and exception handling

patterns.name: MongoDB query or upload errors

patterns.context: An error count appears as a statistics field in JSON-style key-value data.

patterns.name: Placeholder parameter in a program error callback

10_979.description: 所有片段都含 error/Error/Exception 相关词，涵盖报错描述、异常文本与处理代码、错误计数及回调参数；JSON、MongoDB和网络错误是具体语境。

patterns.name: 错误上下文中的 error/error 错误对象

patterns.name: MongoDB 查询或上传报错

en.description: Strongly responds to errors, exceptions, and failure reports in programming contexts, especially error text and help-seeking phrases such as “getting/doing wrong”; also covers specific JSON, MongoDB, network, Python/Spark errors, plus some error-handling code and error-localization prompts.

patterns.name: Error and exception reports
patterns.context: Error-related terms appear in exception class names, error messages, or user descriptions, often with phrases such as getting, throws, following.
patterns.domain: Programming Q&A, debugging logs, and code

patterns.name: Requesting help and describing failures
patterns.context: The questioner describes a problem or requests help locating an error, usually next to error information or a code snippet.

patterns.name: JSON operations and their errors
patterns.context: JSON is written, uploaded, or imported as a module; includes Java logs, MongoDB issues, and Django import errors.

patterns.name: MongoDB query or upload errors
patterns.context: Concerns uploading JSON to MongoDB or running queries, with errors reported.

patterns.name: Specific runtime exception stack trace
patterns.context: A TypeError traceback follows Python/Spark data-transformation code.

patterns.name: Network connection exception
patterns.context: Describes a connection closing and a send error during an HTTP request or response-stream read.

patterns.name: Code example and error-localization prompt
patterns.context: Asks someone to inspect code or a program; the snippet contains garbled and hash-like text but presents no clear error type.

10_979.description: 强烈响应编程语境中的错误、异常及故障报告，尤其是报错文本与“getting/doing wrong”等求助表述；也覆盖 JSON、MongoDB、网络、Python/Spark 等具体错误，以及少量错误处理代码和错误定位提示。

patterns.name: 错误与异常报告
patterns.context: 错误相关词出现在异常类名、报错消息或用户说明中，常伴随 getting、throws、following 等表述。
patterns.domain: 编程问答、调试日志与代码

patterns.name: 求助与描述故障
patterns.trigger: «I» am «getting»、«I»'m «getting»、«Could» you please tell me、«Can» you spot
patterns.context: 提问者说明遇到的问题或请求定位错误，通常紧邻错误信息或代码片段。

patterns.name: JSON 操作及其错误
patterns.context: JSON 被写入、上传或作为模块导入时出现；包括 Java 日志、MongoDB 问题及 Django 导入错误。

patterns.name: MongoDB 查询或上传错误
patterns.context: 围绕 MongoDB 上传 JSON 或执行查询，并报告错误。

patterns.name: 特定运行时异常堆栈
patterns.context: Python/Spark 数据转换代码后接 TypeError traceback。

patterns.name: 网络连接异常
patterns.context: HTTP 请求或读取响应流时，描述连接关闭及发送错误。

patterns.name: 应用界面错误处理代码
patterns.context: Java/Android 类中定义显示错误消息的方法，附近有 ToastUtils 调用。

patterns.name: 数据库字段与错误域信息
patterns.context: 代码涉及 place_type 字段，后接用户更新说明和错误域文本；与其他报错段的具体问题不同。

patterns.name: 代码示例与错误定位提示
patterns.context: 请求检查代码或程序，片段中含乱码及哈希状文本，但未呈现明确错误类型。

en.concept: Errors and debugging in technical Q&A
en.description: Primarily responds to error, exception, or unexpected-result explanations following code in technical Q&A; also responds to Traceback, JSON code, and help-seeking openings. One passage of legal charges does not fit these patterns.

patterns.name: Narrative requesting help with an error
patterns.context: The problem description gives code or an operation, then explains the current error, exception, or unexpected result; activation covers question and error-introducing sentences, not only specific error text.

patterns.name: Traceback error output
patterns.context: A Python interactive output starts displaying an exception traceback after a failed call; activation concentrates on Traceback and nearby content.

patterns.name: JSON-related code or question
patterns.context: JSON is the subject of a code operation, data communication, or parsing problem; JSON alone can also activate, but is usually adjacent to a failure description.

patterns.name: Java exception logs
patterns.context: Java-style exception catching and logging, emphasizing exception information from a failed JSON write.

patterns.name: List of charges in a legal indictment
patterns.context: Criminal charges and statutory bases are listed with numbers; unlike programming error contexts.

patterns.name: Technical Q&A title/problem opening
patterns.context: Briefly raises unexpected program behavior or a problem category, followed by code or error output; does not require “I am getting.”

patterns.name: Help request following code
patterns.context: Code is posted first, then the text shifts to an error, empty result, or request for help; activation occurs where code meets the natural-language question.

10_979.concept: 技术问答中的错误与调试
10_979.description: 主要响应技术问答中代码之后的报错、异常或错误结果说明，也响应 Traceback、JSON 代码与求助开场；另有一段法律指控文本无法归入这些模式。

patterns.name: 报错求助叙述
patterns.trigger: “I am getting” / “I'm getting”后接“the following error”或具体错误；以及“I am getting … Could you please tell me what mistake…”
patterns.context: 问题描述先给出代码或操作，再说明当前错误、异常或不符合预期的结果；激活覆盖提问句和错误引入句，不只限于特定错误文本。

patterns.name: Traceback 错误输出
patterns.context: Python 交互式输出中，调用失败后开始展示异常回溯；激活集中在 Traceback 及其邻近内容。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答／Python 调试

patterns.name: JSON 相关代码或问题
patterns.context: JSON 是代码操作、数据通信或解析问题的主题；单独出现 JSON 时也有激活，但通常与故障描述相邻。

patterns.name: Java 异常日志
patterns.trigger: “catch (JSON Exception e)”及“LOG.error("Exception while put to json: …”)
patterns.context: Java 风格的异常捕获和日志记录，强调写入 JSON 失败的异常信息。

patterns.name: 法律起诉书中的罪名列举
patterns.context: 以编号列举刑事指控及法条依据；和编程错误语境不同。

patterns.name: 技术问答标题／问题开场
patterns.context: 简短提出程序行为异常或问题分类，随后接代码或错误输出；不要求出现“I am getting”。

patterns.name: 代码尾部接求助说明
patterns.trigger: 代码片段结束后接“UPDATE: This is the error I am getting”或“I am getting cache as empty list”
patterns.context: 先贴代码，再转入错误、空结果或求助说明；激活出现在代码与自然语言问题衔接处。

en.description: The most prominent pattern repeated across passages is herpes/herpesvirus-related vocabulary, found in virology project materials and abstracts; there are also sporadic medical subword fragments, customer video descriptions in patents, and a blue heron nesting account, with no clear shared conditions.

patterns.name: Herpesvirus-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Directly features herpes/herpesvirus and virus types or research uses; sometimes these are longer terms in biomedical text.
patterns.domain: Virology, NIH project materials, and PubMed abstracts

patterns.name: Suffix fragments split within words
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments spanning tokenized words, but the fragments are scattered across terms for traumatic dystonia, titles, place names, and treatment-related words; no consistent lexical meaning or contextual condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Verb collocations about customer video communication
patterns.context: Patent background text describes follow-up visits or expert consultation and contrasts these with one-way video communication; activation concentrates on words such as customer and sees.

patterns.name: Blue herons and nesting sites
patterns.context: A natural-history account describes blue herons returning to their current nesting site.

10_1110.concept: herpes病毒及零散词汇
10_1110.description: 最突出且跨段重复的模式是 herpes/herpesvirus 相关词汇，见于病毒学项目材料和摘要；此外还有零散的医学词片段、专利中的客户视频描述，以及蓝鹭筑巢叙述，彼此缺乏明确共同条件。

patterns.name: 疱疹病毒相关词汇
patterns.trigger: “herpes simplex viruses”“Human herpesvirus-6”“herpesviruses”“herpes simplex virus (HSV)-based vectors”
patterns.context: 直接出现 herpes/herpesvirus 及其病毒种类或研究用途；有时是生物医学文本中的较长术语。
patterns.domain: 病毒学、NIH 项目材料及 PubMed 摘要

patterns.name: 单词内部切分的后缀片段
patterns.context: 激活落在跨子词切分的词片段上，但片段分散于创伤性肌张力障碍、标题、地名和治疗相关词中；看不出一致的词义或语境条件。

patterns.name: 涉客视频通信的动词搭配
patterns.context: 专利背景中描述回访或专家咨询，并对比单向视频通信；激活集中在 customer、sees 等词。

patterns.name: 蓝鹭及筑巢地点
patterns.context: 自然史叙述中描写蓝鹭返回当前巢址。

en.description: Strong activation primarily occurs on herpes/herpesvirus and variants, including virological forms such as HSV/HHV; other high activations are scattered across bird-name endings, medical terms, competition names, tumor phrases, place names and years, and NIH titles, with no shared semantics.

patterns.name: Herpesvirus word forms
patterns.context: Herpesvirus appears as a word or medical entity; in several passages it also appears with a hyphen or abbreviation, such as “herpesvirus-6,” “HHV-6,” and “HSV.”
patterns.domain: Biomedical text, virology, and NIH application text

patterns.name: Specific word-final fragments
patterns.context: In the bird name “great blue herons,” activation falls on a word-final fragment after tokenization; this differs from the virus context.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in medical compounds
patterns.context: “induced” is strongly activated in a medical description of trauma-induced movement disorders; the passage is not about herpesviruses.

patterns.name: speedway word form
patterns.context: Appears in the competition name “British Speedway Championship” and is repeated on the next line.

patterns.name: Oncology phrase
patterns.context: An abstract background introduces metastatic cutaneous melanoma and compares it with other solid tumors.

patterns.name: Place names and years
patterns.context: A historical account of Philippine place names and administrative divisions; high-activation markers fall on final fragments of place names and on years.

patterns.name: Budget word forms in titles
patterns.context: Budget recommendations and a Special Emphasis Panel title in NIH application text, with abbreviations and uppercase title formatting.

10_1110.concept: 疱疹病毒词形为主
10_1110.description: 主要对 herpes/herpesvirus 及其变体、HSV/HHV 等病毒学词形强激活；其余高激活分散在鸟名词尾、医学术语、赛事名、肿瘤短语、地名年份和 NIH 标题，缺乏共同语义。

patterns.name: 疱疹病毒词形
patterns.context: 疱疹病毒作为词语或医学实体出现；在若干段落中也带有连字符或缩写，如“herpesvirus-6”“HHV-6”“HSV”。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、病毒学及 NIH 申请文本

patterns.name: 特定词尾片段
patterns.context: 鸟类名称“great blue herons”中，激活落在分词后的词尾片段；与病毒语境不同。

patterns.name: 医学复合词内部片段
patterns.context: 创伤诱发的运动障碍这一医学术语描述中，“induced”强激活；该段没有疱疹病毒主题。

patterns.name: speedway 词形
patterns.context: 出现在赛事名称“British Speedway Championship”中，且在下一行重复。

patterns.name: 肿瘤学短语
patterns.context: 摘要背景中介绍转移性皮肤黑色素瘤及其与其他实体瘤的比较。

patterns.name: 地名及年份
patterns.context: 菲律宾地名与行政区划历史叙述；高激活标记落在地名末尾片段和年份。
patterns.domain: 维基百科历史／地理条目

patterns.name: 标题预算词形
patterns.context: NIH 申请文本中的预算建议及特别重点评审小组标题，夹杂缩写和大写标题格式。

en.concept: Subwords and formatting fragments in structured text
en.description: Activations are scattered across split uppercase titles, subwords within words, label fragments, webpage subscription copy, table numbers and whitespace, numbered dates, and Spanish chat; this looks more like varied responses to formatting boundaries and local subwords than a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Local spelling fragments in HTML/XML tags
patterns.context: Activation occurs at tag boundaries and on letter fragments split within them; this appears in different structures, including HTML tables and IRC pseudo-tags.
patterns.domain: Web tables, chat logs, and marked-up text

patterns.name: Uppercase titles or section labels
patterns.context: Uppercase words or phrases are split into consecutive subword fragments; these occur in titles, comment headings, and legal document section names.

patterns.name: Internal word fragments in proper nouns and technical terms
patterns.context: Longer words or names are split into subwords, with activation concentrated on internal fragments; contexts include paper titles and abstracts.

patterns.name: Webpage follow and subscription copy
patterns.context: Short webpage footer or navigation copy containing language about following, email subscriptions, or RSS subscriptions.

patterns.name: Tabular numbers and indentation whitespace
patterns.context: Numbers, field names, and values appear in whitespace-separated, row-and-column records; passage 6 also contains dates, amounts, and names in an HTML table.
patterns.domain: Energy trading data tables, web tables

patterns.name: Number and date formats
patterns.context: Years, dates, or identifiers are split and placed in formal records or table cells.

patterns.name: Spanish chat and encoding-corrupted characters
