patterns.context: An IRC conversation contains Spanish greetings and chat, interspersed with corrupted accented characters and punctuation.

patterns.name: Disease and medical entity names
patterns.context: Disease, patient, or microorganism names in medical text; activation falls on partial subwords within the names.

10_1110.concept: 结构化文本中的子词与格式片段
10_1110.description: 激活分散于拆分的大写标题、词内子词、标签片段、网页订阅文案、表格数字与空白、编号日期及西语聊天；更像对格式边界和局部子词的多种响应，而非单一语义主题。

patterns.name: HTML/XML标签中的局部拼写片段
patterns.context: 标签边界及其内部被拆分的字母片段激活；出现在表格 HTML、IRC 聊天伪标签等不同结构中。
patterns.domain: 网页表格、聊天记录及标记文本

patterns.name: 大写标题或分节标签
patterns.context: 大写词或短语被拆成连续子词片段；分别出现在标题、评论标题和法律文件分节名中。

patterns.name: 专名、术语中的词内片段
patterns.context: 较长词或名称按子词切分，激活集中在词内片段；所处语境包括论文标题及摘要。

patterns.name: 网页关注与订阅文案
patterns.context: 网页页脚或导航式短文案，包含关注、邮件订阅或 RSS 订阅表达。

patterns.name: 表格化数字与缩进空白
patterns.context: 数字、字段名与数值在空白分隔的行列式记录中出现；段 6 也有 HTML 表格日期、金额和人名。
patterns.domain: 能源交易数据表、网页表格

patterns.name: 编号与日期类格式
patterns.context: 年份、日期或编号被拆分并置于正式记录或表格单元格中。

patterns.name: 西班牙语聊天及编码异常字符
patterns.context: IRC 对话中出现西班牙语问候和聊天内容，夹杂损坏的重音字符及标点。

patterns.name: 疾病与医学实体名称
patterns.context: 医学文本中的疾病、患者或微生物名称；激活落在名称的部分子词上。

en.concept: “based” and local word forms in academic text
en.description: The most consistent trigger is based (upon/on, or after a comma), across grant text, medical and academic papers; other local patterns include virus names, personal-name titles, medical title word forms, and mathematical models.

patterns.name: Expressions meaning based on / according to
patterns.context: Appears in formal sentences stating methods, arguments, or goals; common forms are “based upon/on,” as well as “based,” after a comma.
patterns.domain: NIH grant text, medical abstracts, genetics and mathematics papers

patterns.name: HHV-6 hyphenated name
patterns.context: The beginning of the virus name and its parenthesized abbreviation; activation covers tokenized fragments such as “herpes,” “virus,” “-,” and “6.”

patterns.name: Personal names and entry titles
patterns.context: A name appears as a standalone title, followed by a line break and “may refer to” introducing disambiguation entries.

patterns.name: Periodicity and impact in a title
patterns.context: A medical-paper-title-style phrase: first describing the periodicity of susceptibility, then introducing the effects of factors such as light.

patterns.name: mistletoe word form in abstracts
patterns.context: Abstract text about plant extracts and their antitumor activity; activation concentrates on internal word segments and does not clearly fall on “based.”

patterns.name: Cardinals and models in mathematics
patterns.context: An existence statement discusses limit models and their cardinalities; it shares a form of “based” with other passages, but activation on “based” is weaker here.

10_1110.concept: 学术文本中的“based”及局部词形
10_1110.description: 最一致的触发是 based（upon/on，或逗号后），横跨资助文本、医学与学术论文；另有病毒名、人名标题、医学标题词形及数学模型等局部模式。

patterns.name: 基于／依据表达
patterns.context: 出现在陈述方法、论据或目标的正式句子中；常见形式为“based upon/on”，也有逗号后的“based,”
patterns.domain: NIH 资助文本、医学摘要、遗传学和数学论文

patterns.name: HHV-6 连字符名称
patterns.context: 病毒名称及括号内缩写的开头；激活覆盖分词后的“herpes”“virus”“-”“6”等片段

patterns.name: 人名与词条标题
patterns.context: 姓名作为独立标题，随后换行并以“may refer to”引出消歧义条目

patterns.name: 标题中的周期性与影响
patterns.context: 医学论文标题式短语：先描述易感性的周期性，再引出光照等因素的影响

patterns.name: 摘要中的 mistletoe 词形
patterns.context: 植物提取物及其抗肿瘤活性的摘要文本；激活集中在词内分段，未明显落在“based”上

patterns.name: 数学中的基数与模型
patterns.context: 存在性命题中讨论极限模型及其基数；与其他段共享“based”形式，但该处的“based”激活较弱

en.concept: Vertical-related words and several isolated words
en.description: The most prominent recognizable pattern is Vertical/vertical and vertical devices, directions, or interface elements, in texts about ventilation, patents, software, and mining. Other high activations are scattered across words for conflict, click reaction, dependent, time dependence, and species classification, without a shared context.

patterns.name: Vertical and vertical-direction words
patterns.context: Features Vertical/vertical, or directions, devices, or interface elements modified by it; capitalization is not significant, but strong activation falls mainly on Vertical itself.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: ventilation equipment, patents/computer graphics, software interfaces, mining equipment, ergonomic devices; also scientific texts

patterns.name: Words related to conflict and cognitive control
patterns.context: Describes a situation in which the ventrolateral prefrontal cortex faces a conflict between immediate and delayed value during a task.

patterns.name: Click reaction-related words
patterns.context: Mentions click reactions and their formation of covalent bonds in chemical reaction and biological-system contexts.

patterns.name: Data-sharing dependence
patterns.context: Describes users’ willingness to share health data as depending on the data’s potential uses.
patterns.domain: Health data and privacy research paper

patterns.name: Time-dependent expression
patterns.context: Modifies time in a theoretical discussion of a tachyon field and its solutions.

patterns.name: Insect species and microbiomes
patterns.context: Appears in a parenthetical list summarizing endemic Hawaiian insects and their bacterial diversity.

10_1110.concept: 垂直相关词与若干孤立词
10_1110.description: 最突出的可辨模式是 Vertical/vertical 及垂直设备、方向或界面元素，见通风、专利、软件和矿业等文本。其余高激活分散在冲突、click reaction、dependent、时间依赖及物种分类等词上，缺乏共同语境。

patterns.name: Vertical 及垂直方向相关词
patterns.context: 出现 Vertical/vertical，或其修饰的方向、设备、界面元素；大小写不敏感，但强激活主要落在 Vertical 一词上
patterns.domain: 跨领域：通风设备、专利/计算机图形、软件界面、矿业设备、人体工学设备；也有科学文本

patterns.name: 冲突与认知控制相关词
patterns.context: 描述腹外侧前额叶皮层在任务中对即时与延迟价值发生冲突的情形
patterns.domain: 神经科学/认知心理学论文

patterns.name: Click reaction 相关词
patterns.context: 在化学反应及生物体系语境中，提到 click reaction 及其形成共价键

patterns.name: 数据分享依赖关系
patterns.context: 描述用户分享健康数据的意愿取决于数据的潜在用途
patterns.domain: 健康数据与隐私研究论文

patterns.name: 时间依赖表述
patterns.context: 修饰时间，出现在 tachyon 场及其解的理论讨论中

patterns.name: insect 物种与微生物组
patterns.context: 在概述夏威夷特有昆虫及其细菌多样性的括号列举中
patterns.domain: 昆虫学/微生物生态学论文

en.description: Primarily activates on the string piece or its subword piece: this includes the noun phrase “a piece of” and the mathematical term piecewise; other sporadic triggers include click in clickbait, head in technical contexts, and dasher in refrigeration equipment terminology.

patterns.name: Literal collocation “a piece of”
patterns.context: In ordinary noun phrases, piece is followed by different objects such as a meal, material, code, or card; activation falls mainly on piece (sometimes also on piece in the subword piecewise).
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: news commentary, patents, scientific papers, programming Q&A, personal narratives

patterns.name: piece in the compound piecewise
patterns.context: piecewise appears as part of a compound in mathematical text; after piece and wise are tokenized, piece is strongly activated.

patterns.name: click subword in clickbait
patterns.context: A news headline is criticized as clickbait; high activation falls on the click subword.

patterns.name: head in patent text
patterns.context: In mechanical or logical technical contexts, refers respectively to the head slider of a disk drive and a head-cycle in a logic program; neither has an evident semantic connection to piece.

patterns.name: dasher in refrigeration equipment terminology
patterns.context: Lists available dasher types in industrial continuous freezing equipment; activation is weaker than for the main trigger.

10_1110.concept: piece 字符串模式
10_1110.description: 主要对 piece 字符串或其子词 piece 激活：涵盖“a piece of”名词短语及数学术语 piecewise；另有 clickbait 中 click、技术语境中的 head 和冷冻设备术语 dasher 等零散触发。

patterns.name: “a piece of”字面搭配
patterns.context: 普通名词短语中，piece 后接 meal、材料、代码、卡片等不同宾语；激活主要落在 piece（有时也落在子词 piecewise 的 piece）。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：新闻评论、专利、科学论文、编程问答、个人叙述

patterns.name: piecewise 复合词中的 piece
patterns.context: 数学文本中 piecewise 作为复合词的一部分；piece 与 wise 分词标记后，piece 激活较强。

patterns.name: clickbait 子词 click
patterns.context: 新闻标题被批评为吸引点击的 clickbait；高激活落在 click 子词。

patterns.name: 专利文本中的 head
patterns.context: 机械或逻辑技术语境中，分别指磁盘驱动器的 head slider，以及逻辑程序中的 head-cycle；与 piece 的出现没有明显语义联系。
patterns.domain: 专利说明书、计算机科学论文

patterns.name: 冷冻设备术语 dasher
patterns.context: 工业连续冷冻设备中列举可用的 dasher types；强度低于主要触发词。

en.description: Primarily responds to “point” denoting a specific location or key position and its contexts, including physical points, event locations, geometric points, and image positions; it also activates on the name “Jackson” in one passage.

patterns.name: “point” related to location/position [9]
patterns.context: Describes a specific location, where an event occurs, a position on a geometric object, or a coordinate in an image; sometimes preceded by “the,” and sometimes embedded in a proper noun or technical description.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: scientific papers, patents, law, mathematics, and image technology; covers [1][2][4][5][6][7][8][9][10]

patterns.name: Surname in a person’s name
patterns.context: Appears in the birth name “born Suzanne Jackson.”

10_1110.concept: 位置点
10_1110.description: 主要对表示具体位置或关键位置的“point”及其语境反应，涵盖物理点、事件地点、几何点和图像位置；另在一处对人名“Jackson”有激活。

patterns.name: “point”相关位置/位置9
patterns.context: 描述某个具体位置、事件发生处、几何对象上的位置，或图像中的坐标位置；有时前接“the”，有时嵌在专名或技术描述中。

patterns.name: 人物姓名中的姓氏
patterns.context: 出现在人物出生姓名“born Suzanne Jackson”中。

en.concept: General vocabulary describing activities and processes
en.description: Activation is distributed across scientific, legal, sports, and technical texts; common triggers are activities/tasks, as well as continuity, direction, length, or range in technical descriptions. There are also nouns related to phenomenon, composition, and numbers, in unrelated contexts.

patterns.name: Activities and their duration
patterns.context: Mentions activities, tasks, or activities of daily life; [10] also explicitly specifies duration or exercise intensity.
patterns.domain: Research projects, legal documents, sports nutrition

patterns.name: Continuous motion, extension, or length in technical processes
patterns.context: Describes the direction, continuity, size, or range of an object, material, system, or process.

patterns.name: Broad concepts or composition descriptions in scientific and technical terms
patterns.context: A noun refers to a phenomenon or describes the composition of a material; the trigger itself is broad, with no shared local collocation apparent.

patterns.name: Unspecified numeric or counting expressions
patterns.context: Number-related nouns appear in project statistics or descriptions of structural positions, with differing meanings and contexts.

10_1110.concept: 活动与过程描述中的泛化词汇
10_1110.description: 激活分布于科研、法律、运动与技术文本；常见触发是活动/任务，以及技术描述中的连续过程、方向、长度或范围。另有 phenomenon、composition 和数字相关名词，彼此语境不一。

patterns.name: 活动及其持续时间
patterns.context: 出现活动、任务或日常生活活动的表述；[10]还明确说明持续时间或运动强度。
patterns.domain: 科研项目、法律文件、运动营养

patterns.name: 技术过程中的连续运动、延伸或长度
patterns.context: 描述物体、材料、系统或过程的方向、连续性、尺寸或范围。
patterns.domain: 专利、工程技术、通信技术

patterns.name: 科学技术名词中的宽泛概念或组成描述
patterns.context: 名词指称某种现象，或说明材料的组成；触发词本身较泛，未见共同的局部搭配。
patterns.domain: 物理学论文、专利材料说明

patterns.name: 未明确的数字或计数表达
patterns.context: 数字相关名词出现在项目统计或结构位置说明中，语义及上下文不同。

en.concept: Statements of purpose and behavioral relationships
en.description: Primarily responds to expressions of purpose and activity, such as “purposes of” and “activities that”; it also activates on class action, conduct, and liability language in legal texts, and descriptions of mechanical positions and technical ranges in patents. Other contexts include regulation of women’s clothing, research projects, and partnership disputes.

patterns.name: Purpose/use phrases
patterns.context: The noun “purposes” is followed by “of” to explain the purpose of an action, regulation, or project; occurs across several fields.
patterns.domain: Law, sports commentary, public policy, research project descriptions

patterns.name: Activities and their constraints or effects
patterns.context: “activities” introduces a subsequent result or restrictive clause, describing participants’ activities and their effects.

patterns.name: Legal conduct and procedural language
patterns.context: Legal text concerning a category of lawsuit, attributable conduct, or ongoing business operations.

patterns.name: Positions/connections of mechanical components
patterns.context: Patent text describes the connections and relative positions of components such as screws, nuts, and stops.

patterns.name: Technical parameters and range width
patterns.context: A patent technical description defines the range width corresponding to a programming level.

patterns.name: Exposure and women’s clothing choices
patterns.context: Discusses women’s sportswear, sexualization, or regulation of public nudity.

patterns.name: Oversight and termination of a partnership
patterns.context: Describes the liquidation of a partnership and whether continuing operations are feasible.

patterns.name: Research project participants and further education
patterns.context: Reports the proportion of project participants who advance to graduate or professional programs, and their activities.

patterns.name: Joint criminal conduct and attribution of liability
patterns.context: Discusses the scope of defendants’ liability for others’ acts when a crime is committed jointly.

patterns.name: Disrupted business plans
patterns.context: Recounts a company requiring someone to participate in an activity, preventing them from completing a business plan.

patterns.name: Project coordination and client contact
patterns.context: Describes the administrative purpose of project staffing.

10_1110.concept: 目的与行为关系表述
10_1110.description: 主要响应“purposes of”及“activities that”等目的、活动表述；另对法律中的class action、conduct和责任措辞，以及专利机械位置、技术区间描述有激活。还覆盖女性服装规制、研究项目、合伙纠纷等语境。

patterns.name: 目的/用途短语
patterns.context: 名词“purposes”后接“of”，说明行动、规定或项目的目的；在多个领域均出现
patterns.domain: 法律、体育评论、公共政策、研究项目说明

patterns.name: 活动及其限制或效果
patterns.context: “activities”引出后续结果或限制性从句，描述参与者从事的活动及影响
patterns.domain: 研究资助说明、法律陈述

patterns.name: 法律行为与程序性措辞
patterns.context: 法律文本中围绕诉讼类别、可归责行为或持续经营的陈述

patterns.name: 机械部件的位置/连接描述
patterns.context: 专利文本描述螺杆、螺母、止挡件等部件的连接关系和相对位置

patterns.name: 技术参数与区间宽度
patterns.context: 专利技术说明中定义编程等级对应的区间宽度

patterns.name: 裸露与女性服装选择
patterns.context: 讨论女性运动服装、性化或公共场所裸露规制
patterns.domain: 哲学/体育评论、地方条例报道

patterns.name: 监督与合伙关系终止
patterns.context: 描述合伙企业清算及继续经营是否可行

patterns.name: 研究项目参与者与升学
patterns.context: 报告项目参与者升入研究生或专业项目的比例及活动

patterns.name: 犯罪共同行为及责任归属
patterns.context: 讨论共同实施犯罪时被告对他人行为的责任范围

patterns.name: 商业计划受阻
patterns.context: 叙述公司要求某人参与活动，导致其无法完成商业计划

patterns.name: 项目协调与客户接触
patterns.context: 说明项目人员配置的行政用途
patterns.domain: 公共卫生/社会工作项目说明

en.concept: Systems and processes in scientific text
en.description: Primarily responds to “systems” in scientific text, especially near in/of/by and descriptions of composition or properties; it also responds to explanations of process mechanisms and activates sporadically on various physics, nanoscience, and patent terms.

patterns.name: The word “systems”
patterns.context: Describes research subjects consisting of a type of particle, structure, or equation in scientific papers; activation concentrates on systems itself and nearby collocations such as in/of/by.

patterns.name: “process” and process explanations
patterns.context: process is followed by an explanation introduced by that or a past-participle phrase, describing a mechanism, step, or phenomenon.

patterns.name: “terminal” and terminal labels
patterns.context: In a circuit-diagram description of a floating-gate memory cell, source/drain terminal is followed by letter labels.

patterns.name: “confined” describing a constrained state
patterns.context: A system or substance is constrained to a state or region; one passage refers to an intermediate state that is permanently confined, another to chromospheric material in a confined region.

patterns.name: Mirror symmetry and chaotic systems
patterns.context: Describes geometric or dynamical properties of a system and is related to interference effects.

patterns.name: Nanostructure names
patterns.context: Discusses plasmonic nanospheres and modeling with their non-Hermitian Hamiltonian.

patterns.name: Surface species removal with a scanning tunneling microscope
patterns.context: Describes experimental steps for removing covalently bonded species from a surface using STM.

patterns.name: Solitons in nonlinear equations
patterns.context: Discusses coupled nonlinear Schrödinger equations and the generation of multi-peak solitons.

patterns.name: Quantum dots and multimode leads
patterns.context: Compares the magnitude of interference effects when quantum dots are coupled to multimode leads.

patterns.name: Electron and hole carriers
patterns.context: Discusses systems composed of a single carrier type or of both electrons and holes.

10_1110.concept: 科学文本中的系统与过程
10_1110.description: 主要响应科学文本中的 systems，尤其邻近 in/of/by 及组成、性质描述；另响应 process 的机制说明，并对多种物理、纳米科学和专利术语有零散激活。

patterns.name: “systems”一词
patterns.context: 在科学论文中描述由某类粒子、结构或方程构成的研究对象；激活集中在 systems 本身及邻近的 in/of/by 等搭配。

patterns.name: “process”及过程说明
patterns.context: process 后接 that 引导的解释或过去分词短语，说明某种机制、步骤或现象。

patterns.name: “terminal”及端子标注
patterns.context: 浮栅存储器单元的电路图说明中，source/drain terminal 后附带字母标记。

patterns.name: “confined”描述受限状态
patterns.context: 系统或物质被限制在某状态或区域；一处指中间态永久受限，另一处指色球物质处在受限区域。

patterns.name: 镜面对称与混沌系统
patterns.context: 描述系统几何或动力学性质，且与干涉效应相关。

patterns.name: 纳米结构名称
patterns.context: 讨论等离激元纳米球及其非厄米哈密顿量建模。

patterns.name: 超导隧道显微镜处理表面物种
patterns.context: 描述用 STM 从表面移除共价结合物种的实验步骤。

patterns.name: 非线性方程中的孤波
patterns.context: 讨论耦合非线性薛定谔方程及多峰孤立波的生成。

patterns.name: 量子点与多模引线
patterns.context: 比较量子点耦合多模引线时干涉效应的大小。

patterns.name: 电子与空穴载流子
patterns.context: 讨论单类及电子、空穴双类载流子构成的系统。

en.description: Activations are scattered across scientific, legal, political, and patent texts, involving processes, speed values, geographic points, systems, and descriptions of charts and geometry; no reliable unified meaning or stable syntactic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: The word process
patterns.context: “process” describes a mechanism or process, followed by an explanatory clause or name.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers: nanowire growth mechanisms and solar physics

patterns.name: Speed and numerical values
patterns.context: Speed terms are associated with statutory speed limits or experimental motion speeds.
patterns.domain: Legal provisions and exercise physiology abstracts

patterns.name: Points in geographic descriptions
patterns.context: “point” refers to a geographic location in route or boundary descriptions, near directions, distances, or place names.
patterns.domain: Legal boundary descriptions and highway route descriptions

patterns.name: The word system
patterns.context: “system” refers to a system in physical theory or a political system; the two uses differ in meaning and style.
patterns.domain: Theoretical physics papers and political commentary emails

patterns.name: Chart data and labels
patterns.context: Figure captions describe experimental data, curves, and axis scales; the strongest marker falls on a comma.

patterns.name: Geometric distances and regions
patterns.context: Describes key-shaped regions, arcs, centerlines, and the distances between them.

10_1110.concept: none
10_1110.description: 激活分散在科学、法律、政治及专利文本中，涉及过程、速度数值、地理点位、系统，以及图表和几何描述；未见可靠的统一词义或稳定句法条件。

patterns.name: process 一词
patterns.context: “process”用于描述某种机制或过程，后接解释性从句或名称。
patterns.domain: 科学论文：纳米线生长机制与太阳物理

patterns.name: 速度及数值
patterns.context: 速度词与法规中的限速数值或实验中的运动速度相连。
patterns.domain: 法律条文与运动生理学摘要

patterns.name: 地理描述中的点位
patterns.context: “point”指路线或边界描述中的地理位置，周围出现方向、距离或地名。
patterns.domain: 法律地界描述与公路路线说明

patterns.name: system 一词
patterns.context: “system”指物理理论中的系统或政治制度；两处语义和文体不同。
patterns.domain: 理论物理论文与政治评论邮件

patterns.name: 图表数据与标注
patterns.context: 图注中描述实验数据、曲线及坐标轴刻度；最强标记落在逗号上。

patterns.name: 几何距离与区域
patterns.context: 描述钥匙形状的区域、圆弧、中心线及其间距。

en.description: Activations are scattered across texts from multiple domains, often landing on terms, common words, proper names, or token fragments; sports, legal, technical, and encyclopedic content are all represented, with no reliable single semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Term or compound boundaries
patterns.context: Activations land on tokens in common words, technical terms, or compounds, especially near token boundaries, numbers, or punctuation; contextual conditions are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain texts: legal, sports, patents, biomedicine, encyclopedias, mathematics

patterns.name: Tokenization fragments and markers
patterns.context: There are also activations on token fragments adjacent to capitalization, punctuation, or numbers; these may relate to subword segmentation or special formatting, but the samples do not establish a unified condition.
patterns.domain: Web text, code licenses, patents, papers, and encyclopedic texts

patterns.name: Event or entity names
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions related to sporting events, venues, leagues, or teams; activations land on different types of words.

patterns.name: Legal and licensing language
patterns.context: Describes comment moderation, software distribution, or source code in website disclaimers or open-source licenses.

patterns.name: Structural tokens in proper names
patterns.context: Appears in an alphanumeric cell-line name; this is insufficient to determine whether the trigger is biological semantics or a subword segmentation effect.

patterns.name: Radio station format descriptions
patterns.context: Introduces a station's license coverage area and broadcast format; activations are scattered across different tokens in the sentence.

patterns.name: Quantum-state terminology
patterns.context: Introduces the vector representation of a pure quantum state in quantum information texts; high activations also occur near punctuation and mathematical symbols.

patterns.name: Building descriptions
patterns.context: Historical building entries describe architectural form and dimensions.

patterns.name: RNA interference terminology
patterns.context: Explains the mechanism by which siRNA inhibits gene expression.

patterns.name: Patent geometry descriptions
patterns.context: Describes key geometry, arcs, and distances between centerlines.

10_1110.concept: 跨领域词元/术语片段响应
10_1110.description: 激活散布于多领域文本，常落在术语、普通词、专名或词元碎片上；体育、法律、科技和百科内容均有，未见可靠的单一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 术语或复合词边界
patterns.context: 激活落在普通词、专业术语或复合词中的词元，尤其是在词元边界、数字或标点附近；上下文条件不统一。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本：法律、体育、专利、生物医学、百科、数学

patterns.name: 词元化碎片与标记
patterns.context: 对大小写、标点、数字相邻的词元片段也有激活；可能与子词切分或特殊格式有关，但无法从样本确定统一条件。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、代码许可证、专利、论文及百科文本

patterns.name: 事件或实体名称
patterns.context: 出现在体育报道的赛事、场馆、联盟或球队相关描述中；激活分别落在不同类型的词上。

patterns.name: 法律及许可措辞
patterns.context: 网站免责声明或开源许可文本中，描述评论管理、软件分发或作品源代码。
patterns.domain: 网站免责声明、软件许可证

patterns.name: 专名中的结构词元
patterns.context: 出现在细胞系名称的字母数字组合中，不能据此判断是生物学语义触发还是子词切分效应。

patterns.name: 无线电台格式描述
patterns.context: 介绍电台执照覆盖区域及广播格式；激活分散在句中不同词元。

patterns.name: 量子态术语
patterns.context: 量子信息文本中介绍纯量子态的向量表示；高激活还落在标点与数学符号附近。

patterns.name: 建筑物描述
patterns.context: 历史建筑条目描述建筑形制及尺寸。

patterns.name: RNA干扰术语
patterns.context: 解释siRNA抑制基因表达的机制。

patterns.name: 专利几何描述
patterns.context: 描述钥匙几何结构、圆弧与中心线间距。

en.concept: Word forms and common narrative fragments
en.description: Activations are scattered across words such as process/practice and their subword fragments, as well as technical terms, system, numerical changes, and patent structural descriptions; aside from some repeated word forms, there is no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Literal and morphological segmentation of process
patterns.context: Appears in sentences that introduce, name, or explain a process; strong activations cluster on different subword fragments of process, often followed by a process name or mechanism explanation.
patterns.domain: Interdisciplinary papers, medical abstracts, biology articles, and online discussions

patterns.name: The word forms practise/practice
patterns.context: Used at the beginning or within a sentence to introduce actual circumstances or implementation methods; activations land on segmented fragments of practice/practise.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments in technical terms
patterns.context: Activations occur within terms or near intraword subword boundaries, with no unified semantic or contextual condition apparent.

patterns.name: The word system
patterns.context: Refers to a research subject or model system in a physics passage; activation occurs on system.

patterns.name: Expressions comparing changes and quantities
patterns.context: Discusses changes in parameters and the numerical changes they cause, including comparisons of orders of magnitude or multiples.

patterns.name: Patent component and structural descriptions
patterns.context: Continuously describes lenses, frames, and their structural components; strong activations include descriptive phrases such as commonly referred to.

patterns.name: Patent circuit symbols and numerical relationships
patterns.context: Explains the relationship between a threshold voltage and a reference value, and the range of their difference.

10_1110.concept: 词形与常见叙述片段
10_1110.description: 激活分散于 process/practice 等词及其子词片段，也见技术术语、system、数值变化和专利结构描述；除部分词形重复外，尚无统一语义模式。

patterns.name: process 的字面及词法分段
patterns.trigger: “process”及分段形式“process”“proces”“cess”，包括 “a process”“a process called”“a process termed”“through a process”
patterns.context: 出现在介绍、命名或解释某种过程的句子中；强激活集中于 process 的不同子词片段，常接过程名称或机制说明。
patterns.domain: 跨学科论文、医学摘要、生物学文章及网络讨论

patterns.name: practise/practice 词形
patterns.context: 句首或句中用于引出实际情况、实施方式；激活落在 practice/practise 的分词片段上。

patterns.name: 技术名词的词内片段
patterns.trigger: “resetting”中的“reset”“stochastically”中的“stoch”“printing”中的“print”、以及“weaning”所在的“ventilator”语境
patterns.context: 激活出现在术语或词内子词边界附近，未见统一的语义或上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 物理学论文、专利、医学摘要

patterns.name: system 一词
patterns.context: 物理学段落中指研究对象或模型系统；激活在 system 词上。

patterns.name: 变化与数量比较表达
patterns.context: 讨论参数变化及其导致的数值变化，含量级或倍数比较。

patterns.name: 专利技术部件与结构描述
patterns.context: 连续描述镜片、镜框及其结构部件；强激活包含 commonly referred to 等描述性短语。

patterns.name: 专利电路符号与数值关系
patterns.context: 说明阈值电压与参考值的关系及其差值范围。

en.concept: Quantitative relationships and process descriptions in technical texts
en.description: Primarily responds to expressions of quantitative scaling or multiplicative relationships (especially factor and its numerical value); it also activates on systems, particle motion, and scattering in physics papers, and on professional process descriptions introduced by process in medical and biological texts.

patterns.name: Multiples and scaling factors
patterns.context: Describes a quantity scaling, changing, or being compared by a number, multiple, or ratio; the trigger often falls on factor itself or the number that follows.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, patents, mathematics, and engineering texts

patterns.name: Physical systems and particle dynamics
patterns.context: Discusses system composition, particle motion, or interactions; some examples also involve classical trajectories, scattering events, or coupling parameters.

patterns.name: Medical processes and term definitions
patterns.context: Uses process to introduce or explain a technical process name, concerning mechanical ventilation weaning and RNA interference, respectively.

10_1110.concept: 技术文本中的定量关系与过程描述
10_1110.description: 主要对定量缩放或倍数关系的表达（尤其 factor 及其数值）响应；另对物理论文中的系统、粒子运动与散射，以及医学和生物学中以 process 引出的专业过程描述有激活。

patterns.name: 倍数与比例因子
patterns.trigger: “factor”及紧邻的数值或比例，如 “factor 10”、“factor of 1/Ns”、“factor of 10”、“factor of two”
patterns.context: 描述某量按一个数值、倍数或比例缩放、变化或比较；触发常落在 factor 本身或其后的数值上。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、专利、数学与工程技术文本

patterns.name: 物理系统与粒子动力学
patterns.context: 讨论系统构成、粒子运动或相互作用；部分例子同时涉及经典轨迹、散射事件或耦合参数。

patterns.name: 医学过程与术语定义
patterns.trigger: “process called ‘weaning’”以及“process known as RNA interference”
patterns.context: 以 process 引出或解释一个专业过程名称，分别涉及机械通气撤机和 RNA 干扰。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、生物医学研究

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to “a process” and nearby expressions in scientific explanations that introduce or name a mechanism, including “known as,” “called,” and “termed,” and covers examples from different fields. There are also word-final fragments in random-reset contexts and activations near “factor of two.”

patterns.name: Naming or defining a process
patterns.context: A process phrase is followed by a name, term, or explanatory clause describing the mechanism just mentioned; it may include the indefinite article “a” or omit it ([10] “through a process that…”).
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, medical abstracts, patent backgrounds, and technical discussions

patterns.name: The word process itself
patterns.context: When describing a preceding mechanism, step, or phenomenon, markers cluster near process; in [2]–[8], the word directly activates. [10] also contains “a process that…”.
patterns.domain: Scientific and technical explanatory writing across domains, also seen in online discussions

patterns.name: Word forms or related forms of process
patterns.context: No clear “a process” naming structure is apparent; in [1], the marker falls on a word-final fragment, and the same passage also marks a number and “rate.” In [9], markers cluster around “factor of two.”
patterns.domain: [1] random process paper; [9] communication complexity paper

10_1110.concept: 过程命名表达及邻近词
10_1110.description: 主要对科学说明中引入或命名机制的“a process”及其邻近表述强烈响应，包括“known as”“called”“termed”等，也覆盖不同领域的实例。另有随机重置语境的词尾片段和“factor of two”附近激活。

patterns.name: 过程的命名或定义
patterns.trigger: “a process”后接“known as”“called”“referred to as”“termed”，或直接接描述性从句；如 [2] “a process known as ‘chromospheric evaporation’”、[4] “a process that is referred to as…”
patterns.context: 过程短语之后用名称、术语或解释性从句说明刚提到的机制；可带不定冠词“a”，也可不带冠词（[10] “through a process that…”）。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、医学摘要、专利背景及技术讨论

patterns.name: 过程一词本身
patterns.trigger: “process”，尤其是“a process”；[2]–[8]附近均标记 process
patterns.context: 描述先前机制、步骤或现象时，标记集中在 process 附近；[2]–[8]中该词直接激活。[10]亦出现“a process that…”。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的科学与技术说明文字，也见网络讨论

patterns.name: 过程词的词形或相关形式
patterns.context: 未见清楚的“a process”命名结构；[1]标记落在词尾片段，且同段还标记数值与“rate”。[9]标记集中于“factor of two”一带。
patterns.domain: [1]随机过程论文；[9]通信复杂度论文

en.description: Primarily responds to explanatory naming constructions, especially “a process” followed by known as, termed, or called; it also responds to local expressions such as phenomenon called, degree, formerly, and also called in parentheses.

patterns.name: “a process” definition construction
patterns.context: “a process” is followed by an explanatory phrase such as “known as,” “termed,” or “called,” often naming or explaining a process or mechanism; the strongest activations occur in passages 1–3, and it also appears in passages 5, 6, and 9.
patterns.domain: Scientific, medical, and patent explanatory texts

patterns.name: Naming a phenomenon or effect
patterns.context: “phenomenon” is followed by “called” and a specific name, introducing a physical phenomenon; “a process” does not appear.

patterns.name: Degree or threshold expression
patterns.context: “to a degree” introduces a degree or threshold beyond which subsequent manufacturing cannot continue; it does not fit the definition construction.

patterns.name: Retrospective note after a team name
patterns.context: A team description uses “formerly” to explain a former name or status; there is no process-definition expression.

patterns.name: Flash Cookie naming explanation
patterns.context: Parentheses explain the type of cookie collected by Flash media player and its alternate name, Local Shared Object; “called” occurs, but not “a process.”

10_1110.concept: 说明性命名与定义表达
10_1110.description: 主要响应说明性命名句式，尤其“a process”后接 known as、termed、called；也响应 phenomenon called、degree、formerly及括号中的 also called 等局部表达。

patterns.name: “a process”定义句式
patterns.context: “a process”后接说明性短语，如“known as”“termed”“called”，常在解释某种过程的名称或机制；第1–3段强度最高，第5、6、9段也出现。

patterns.name: 现象或效应的命名
patterns.context: “phenomenon”后接“called”及具体名称，介绍物理现象；未出现“a process”。

patterns.name: 程度或阈值表达
patterns.context: “to a degree”引出使后续制造无法继续的程度或阈值，不符合定义句式。

patterns.name: 球队名称之后的回顾性说明
patterns.trigger: team⁹, formerly⁸ the Southern League version⁵
patterns.context: 球队介绍中以“formerly”说明旧称或旧身份；无定义过程表达。

patterns.name: Flash Cookie称谓说明
patterns.context: 括号内解释 Flash media player 收集的 cookie 类型及其别名 Local Shared Object；虽有“called”，但没有“a process”。

en.description: Activations cover relational and explanatory wording across diverse texts: spatial regions/ranges, component structure, team sports, event coverage, physical states and mechanisms, theoretical parameters, biomedical definitions, and product comparisons; there is no single narrow topic.

patterns.name: Regions, ranges, and subdivisions
patterns.context: Describes an object's location, extent, distribution, or division into regions in space; sometimes adjacent to geographic proper names.

patterns.name: Structural components and their relationships
patterns.context: Specific components connect, extend, or fit together spatially, with dense noun phrases.

patterns.name: Teams, events, and sports results
patterns.context: Describes teams, leagues, or games; may include season performance, home venues, and team histories.

patterns.name: Date and event coverage
patterns.context: Introduces an event, talk, and its topic with a specific date.

patterns.name: States, wavefunctions, and random distributions
patterns.context: Describes a physical system and its energy distribution using mathematical symbols and state variables.

patterns.name: Naming a process or mechanism
patterns.context: Explains a physical process occurring in a particular region or names a mechanism with a technical term.

patterns.name: Roles, parameters, and nonlinear terms in theory
patterns.context: Explains the role, constant, or model term of a theoretical object, accompanied by formulas.

patterns.name: Product batches and attribute comparisons
patterns.context: Introduces a new product and differences in its attributes compared with earlier versions.

patterns.name: Biomedical definitions and functions
patterns.context: First defines a biomolecule, then describes its target and inhibitory mechanism.

10_1110.concept: 说明性关系与结构
10_1110.description: 激活覆盖多种文本中的关系与说明性措辞：空间区域/范围、部件结构、团队赛事、活动报道、物理状态与机制、理论参数、生物医学定义及产品对比；未见单一狭窄主题。

patterns.name: 区域、范围与分区
patterns.context: 描述某物在空间中的位置、范围、分布或区域划分；有时与地理专名相邻。

patterns.name: 结构部件及其相互关系
patterns.context: 具体部件按空间关系连接、延伸或适配，包含密集的名词短语。

patterns.name: 团队、赛事与体育结果
patterns.context: 叙述球队、联盟或比赛；可包括赛季表现、主场及球队沿革。

patterns.name: 日期与活动报道
patterns.context: 以具体日期介绍一场活动、演讲及其主题。
patterns.domain: 机构网站新闻/活动公告

patterns.name: 状态、波函数与随机分布
patterns.context: 以数学符号和状态变量描述物理系统及其能量分布。

patterns.name: 过程或机制的命名
patterns.context: 说明发生在特定区域的物理过程，或用术语命名机制。

patterns.name: 理论中的作用、参数与非线性项
patterns.context: 解释理论对象的作用、常数或模型项，并伴有公式。

patterns.name: 产品批次与属性对比
patterns.context: 介绍新产品及其与先前版本的属性差异。

patterns.name: 生物医学定义与功能
patterns.trigger: «Short» interfering RNAs、«designed» to suppress the «expression» of homologous «genes»
patterns.context: 先定义生物分子，再说明其靶向对象和抑制机制。

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to process and sentence constructions explaining processes or mechanisms. It also appears in unrelated contexts such as geographic subdivisions, legal abbreviation explanations, new product naming, the REM model, game content, and quantum-state distributions; these secondary patterns cannot be fully explained by a single semantic rule.

patterns.name: Process as a process marker
patterns.context: The trigger is the noun process, especially when followed by that or known as; it introduces a mechanism or step.
patterns.domain: Scientific, medical, and general explanatory texts

patterns.name: Near process and mechanism terms
patterns.context: Occurs in contexts describing how an entity changes, produces a result, or performs a function; related to process-explanation constructions, but the activation does not necessarily fall on process.

patterns.name: Geographic regions and boundaries
patterns.context: Describes regions on a planetary surface and their relative positions, extents, or subdivisions; the strongest trigger is “region.”

patterns.name: Legal names and abbreviation explanations
patterns.context: Appears when introducing a law and its abbreviation; activations cluster on “also.”

patterns.name: New product launches and naming
patterns.context: Describes a fast-food chain launching a new product, its attributes, and its name; activations cluster on “batch,” “fries,” and a comma.

patterns.name: REM model and state energies
patterns.context: Introduces model components and state energies in theoretical or mathematical physics texts; activations land near state counts and punctuation.

patterns.name: Game content and multiplayer modes
patterns.context: Introduces in-game decorations and a newly added multiplayer mode; activations cluster on “mode” and the punctuation around it.

patterns.name: Quantum states, wavefunctions, and random distributions
patterns.context: Describes states, their spatial positions, energy, and random distributions in mathematical physics; activations cluster on wavefunction, site, and distribution.

10_1110.concept: 过程及说明性术语
10_1110.description: 主要对“process”及过程机制说明句式强烈响应，也出现在地理分区、法律简称说明、新品命名、REM 模型、游戏内容和量子态分布等彼此不同的上下文；这些旁支模式无法由单一语义规则完全解释。

patterns.name: 过程标记词 process
patterns.context: 触发点是名词 process，尤其在其后接 that 或 known as 时；用于引出某种机制或步骤。
patterns.domain: 科学、医学及一般说明文

patterns.name: 过程及机制术语附近
patterns.trigger: “process”前后对机制、步骤或因果链的描述，如 “cleavage”“refold”“fusion”“damages gut microbes”“chromospheric evaporation”“RNA interference”
patterns.context: 在描述实体如何发生变化、产生结果或实现功能的上下文中；与过程说明句式相关，但激活不一定落在 process 上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、天体物理及技术说明

patterns.name: 地理区域与边界
patterns.context: 描述行星表面区域及其相对位置、范围或分区；最强触发为 “region”。

patterns.name: 法律名称和缩写说明
patterns.context: 在介绍法律及其简称时出现；激活集中在 “also”。

patterns.name: 新产品推出及命名
patterns.context: 描述快餐连锁推出新品、产品属性及命名；激活集中在 “batch”“fries”及逗号。

patterns.name: REM 模型与状态能量
patterns.context: 理论或数学物理文本中介绍模型组成及状态能量；激活落在状态数与标点附近。

patterns.name: 游戏内容与多人模式
patterns.context: 介绍游戏内装饰物及新增多人游戏模式；激活集中在 “mode”及其前后的标点。

patterns.name: 量子态、波函数与随机分布
patterns.context: 数学物理中描述态及其空间位置、能量和随机分布；激活集中在 wavefunction、site 与 distribution。

en.description: Activations tend toward structural words that introduce mechanisms, aliases, regions, sets, categories, or properties in explanatory texts; “process” and “also known as” are especially prominent, but the examples span multiple fields and syntactic contexts.

patterns.name: Process/mechanism expressions
patterns.context: Uses “a process” to introduce a biological or causal mechanism, followed by “that” and its function or result; activation clusters on process.

patterns.name: “also known as” alias explanation
patterns.context: Adds an alias, abbreviation, or trade name after a term or name; activation falls on also or nearby in the phrase.

patterns.name: Regional divisions and naming with “region”
patterns.context: Describes neighboring geographic regions and introduces a region name; this example concerns Martian landform divisions.

patterns.name: Article before an organization name
patterns.context: The article in “a new organization” activates, followed by an organization type and name.

patterns.name: Sets and variables in technical noun phrases
patterns.context: A special subset of a function appears in a mathematical physics text and is called a countable set; activation occurs on “set.”

patterns.name: Material product categories
patterns.context: Introduces a company's product types, followed by product names or uses.

patterns.name: Property description of a junction structure
patterns.context: First names Holliday junction, then introduces a property of the structure.

10_1110.concept: 说明性文本中的结构引介词
10_1110.description: 激活偏向说明性文本中引入机制、别名、区域、集合、类别或性质的结构词；尤其突出“process”和“also known as”，但涵盖多个领域与不同句法环境。

patterns.name: 过程/机制表述
patterns.context: 以“a process”引出某种生物或因果机制，后接“that”及其作用或结果；激活集中在 process。

patterns.name: “also known as”别名说明
patterns.context: 在术语或名称后补充别称、缩写或商品名；激活落在 also 或该短语附近。

patterns.name: 区域划分及“region”命名
patterns.context: 描述相邻地理区域，并引入一个区域名称；本例为火星地貌分区。

patterns.name: 组织名称前的冠词
patterns.context: “a new organization”中冠词处激活，后接组织类别及名称。

patterns.name: 专业名词短语中的集合与变量
patterns.context: 数学物理文本中出现函数的特殊子集，并称其为可数集合；激活在“set”。

patterns.name: 材料产品类别
patterns.context: 介绍某公司的产品种类，后接产品名称或用途。

patterns.name: 交界结构的性质描述
patterns.context: 先命名 Holliday junction，再引出该结构具有的性质。

en.description: The most prominent common thread is process and mechanism explanations, but activations also occur across disparate content such as diseases and biomolecules, geographic regions, physics terms, event titles, religious broadcasts, and film entries; some patterns appear in only one passage and are difficult to reduce to a single semantic category.

patterns.name: “process” and process descriptions
patterns.context: Appears in sentences explaining a mechanism, pathway, regional formation, or biological process; [1], [2], [4], and [10] are followed by that/known as/termed and similar modifiers, while [3] is «region».
patterns.domain: Primarily scientific explanatory texts, also geographic encyclopedias

patterns.name: Biomedical mechanisms and diseases
patterns.context: Life science texts describe diseases, molecular entities, and their mechanisms; especially when appearing in the same sentence or mechanism explanation as process.

patterns.name: Spatial regions and geographic subdivisions
patterns.context: Describes the distribution, extent, and regional divisions of Martian surface features.

patterns.name: “known as” naming expression
patterns.context: Uses known as to introduce a name or term; [4] introduces RNA interference, while [5] introduces an event alias.
patterns.domain: Scientific explanatory texts and encyclopedic entries

patterns.name: Year and event name
patterns.context: A year appears next to an NFL event name, formatted with a line break as an entry title and alias.

patterns.name: Projection operators and phase-space terminology
patterns.context: Technical physics passage discussing the Zwanzig projection operator and a set of slow variables.

patterns.name: Spin and graphene physics
patterns.context: Describes spin-orbit interaction, band gaps and edge states in graphene, and related physical phenomena.

patterns.name: Religious broadcasting experience
patterns.context: A biographical entry introduces a person's church activities and weekly broadcast program.

patterns.name: Film entries and production information
patterns.context: Introduces a Kannada-language film by its title, genre, director, production company, and release year.

10_1110.concept: 过程与百科说明文本
10_1110.description: 最显著的共同线索是“process”及机制说明，但激活也分布在疾病与生物分子、地理区域、物理术语、赛事标题、宗教广播和电影条目等不同内容；部分模式仅见于单段，难以归结为单一语义。

patterns.name: “process”及其过程描述
patterns.context: 出现在说明某种机制、路径、区域形成或生物学过程的句子中；[1]、[2]、[4]、[10] 后接 that/known as/termed 等限定，[3] 则是 «region»。
patterns.domain: 科学说明文为主，也包括地理百科

patterns.name: 生物医学机制与疾病
patterns.context: 生命科学文本中描述疾病、分子实体及其作用机制；尤其与 process 同句或同一机制说明中。

patterns.name: 空间区域与地理分区
patterns.context: 描述火星表面地貌的分布、覆盖范围及区域划分。

patterns.name: “known as”命名表述
patterns.context: 以 known as 引入名称或术语；[4]介绍 RNA interference，[5]介绍赛事别名。
patterns.domain: 科学说明文与百科条目

patterns.name: 年份与赛事名称
patterns.context: 年份紧邻 NFL 赛事名称，并以换行呈现条目标题及别名。

patterns.name: 投影算子与相空间术语
patterns.context: 技术性物理学段落，讨论 Zwanzig 投影算子及慢变量集合。
patterns.domain: 统计物理／数学物理百科

patterns.name: 自旋与石墨烯物理
patterns.context: 描述自旋轨道相互作用、石墨烯中的能隙和边缘态，以及相关物理现象。

patterns.name: 宗教广播经历
patterns.context: 人物传记中介绍其教会活动及每周广播节目。

patterns.name: 电影条目与制作信息
patterns.context: 以片名、类型、导演、制作方和上映年份介绍一部卡纳达语电影。

en.description: Activations are scattered across multiple text types: FYI email openings and bodies, disease terms and definitions in medical abstracts, time and sleep expressions, job responsibilities, biographies, and bibliographic titles; some time expressions, as phrases, and formatting markers are also activated, making it difficult to identify a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: FYI email opening
patterns.context: Activates when an email begins with FYI; sometimes extends to a blank line, separator, or the first sentence of the body.

patterns.name: Time-span expressions
patterns.context: Activates when describing duration, time ranges, or specific dates; several tokens in related time phrases receive strong activations.

patterns.name: As / identity or role
patterns.context: Activates when as introduces a work standard or a role or position held by a person.

patterns.name: Medical terms or disease-name fragments
patterns.context: Subword fragments within disease names in medical abstracts are activated; the examples involve terms related to two skin diseases.

patterns.name: Definitions and time units
patterns.context: A medical definition sentence explains how a condition is defined and gives the timescale over which change occurs.

patterns.name: Research objective and sleep duration
patterns.context: A research abstract labels its aim OBJECTIVE and discusses sleep deprivation and changes in sleep duration.

patterns.name: Work completion and performance standards
patterns.context: A responsibility or project-management statement describes completing work and relates it to time, budget, and quality standards.

patterns.name: Time expression in a Spanish book title or heading
patterns.context: A Spanish bibliographic title or related text contains a word meaning “time.”

patterns.name: Tone and contact information in email body
patterns.context: A short business email body describes a difficult situation or invites the recipient to get in touch.

patterns.name: Self-assessment and media criticism in email
patterns.context: An email reflects on the sender’s statements in the media, describing them as potentially too forceful or critical.

patterns.name: Location and convenience in email
patterns.context: An email mentions that something will be more convenient for the London side.

patterns.name: Person’s name and soccer position
patterns.context: A biography includes a name, date of birth, and position on the soccer field.

patterns.name: Document line breaks and email separators
patterns.context: Activates near blank lines, line breaks, or horizontal separators in emails.

10_1365.description: 激活分散于多类文本：邮件FYI开头及正文、医学摘要中的疾病词与定义、时间和睡眠表达、工作职责、人物简介、书目标题；部分时间、as短语和格式标记也被激活，难以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: FYI 邮件开头
patterns.context: 邮件以 FYI 开头时激活；有时继续延伸到空行、分隔线或正文首句。

patterns.name: 时间跨度表达
patterns.trigger: «over»« the»« last»« century»、«hours»« to»« days»、«15»« August»« 1983»
patterns.context: 描述持续时长、时间范围或具体日期时激活；相关时间短语中若干 token 得到较强激活。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、百科人物简介

patterns.name: 作为 / 身份角色
patterns.context: as 引出工作标准或人物担任的角色、位置时激活。
patterns.domain: 工作职责描述、百科人物简介

patterns.name: 医学术语或疾病名称片段
patterns.context: 医学摘要中疾病名称的词内片段被激活；此处涉及两种皮肤病相关术语。

patterns.name: 定义与时间单位
patterns.context: 医学定义句中说明某状况如何界定，并给出变化发生的时间尺度。

patterns.name: 研究目的与睡眠时长
patterns.context: 研究摘要以 OBJECTIVE 标注目的，并讨论睡眠不足及睡眠时间变化。

patterns.name: 工作完成与绩效标准
patterns.context: 职责或项目管理语句中描述完成工作，并关联时间、预算和质量标准。

patterns.name: 西班牙语书名或标题中的时间表达
patterns.context: 西班牙语书目标题或相关文本中，出现意为“时间”的词。

patterns.name: 邮箱正文中的语气与联系方式
patterns.context: 简短商务邮件正文中表达处境艰难，或邀请对方联系。

patterns.name: 邮件中的自我评价与媒体批评
patterns.context: 邮件中回顾自己在媒体上的表达，称其可能过于强硬或带有批评性。

patterns.name: 邮件中的地点与便利性
patterns.context: 邮件提到某事项将使伦敦方面更方便。

patterns.name: 人物姓名与足球位置
patterns.context: 人物简介中出现姓名、出生日期及其足球场上位置。

patterns.name: 文档换行与邮件分隔
patterns.context: 邮件中的空行、换行或横线分隔符附近激活。

en.description: Activations are scattered across medical titles and abstracts, webpage labels, all-caps headings, business emails, and narrative text; they include subword segmentation, line breaks, fixed phrases, and time expressions with “hours,” with no single stable semantic or syntactic pattern evident.

patterns.name: Boundary/disease phrase in a title
patterns.context: A medical paper title uses “Border disease virus” as the disease name, followed by a colon and subtitle.

patterns.name: Subword segmentation of a rare disease name
patterns.context: The medical term “Acne fulminans” is split into multiple subword fragments; it is followed by “coexisting with pyoderma”.

patterns.name: Form-like labels and line breaks
patterns.context: The short label “Payment method” is followed by consecutive line breaks, then fields or link text such as “Contact”.

patterns.name: Movie word and subword segmentation
patterns.context: “Movies” is split into multiple subword fragments, followed by a line break and another occurrence of “Movies”.

patterns.name: Request for comments in email
patterns.context: “Your comments are needed” requests feedback, followed by a person’s name or related information.

patterns.name: All-caps, segmented headline-style phrase
patterns.context: The all-caps phrase “MORE TROUBLES FOR COMESA” appears as a heading, with words also split into subword fragments.

patterns.name: Email prompt and place name
patterns.context: An email sentence begins with “FYI -”, says something will make things easier, and mentions London.

patterns.name: Medical-service evaluation phrase
patterns.context: A medical or health-services study discusses the relationship between patient assessment and a healthcare delivery approach.

patterns.name: Time unit in a medical title
patterns.context: A definition of acute kidney injury describes a decline in glomerular filtration rate over the period “hours to days”.

patterns.name: Narrative turn after a time unit
patterns.context: In a narrative sentence, “for a few hours” is followed by a shift to a character having started planning an escape.

10_1365.description: 激活分散于医学标题与摘要、网页标签、全大写标题、商务邮件和叙事文本；包括词内切分、换行、固定短语，以及“hours”时间表达，未见单一稳定语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 标题中的边界/疾病词组
patterns.context: 医学论文标题中，以“Border disease virus”作为病名，后接冒号和标题副标题。

patterns.name: 罕见病名的词内分段
patterns.context: “Acne fulminans”这一医学术语被拆成多个子词片段；后接“coexisting with pyoderma”。

patterns.name: 表单式标签与换行
patterns.context: 短标签“Payment method”后连续换行，再出现“Contact”等字段或链接文本。

patterns.name: 电影词及词内分段
patterns.context: “Movies”被拆成多个子词片段，之后换行并再次出现“Movies”一词。

patterns.name: 邮件中的评论请求
patterns.context: 以“Your comments are needed”请求反馈，后面跟随人物姓名或相关说明。

patterns.name: 全大写、分段的标题式短语
patterns.context: 全大写短语“MORE TROUBLES FOR COMESA”以标题形式呈现，词语还被拆成子词片段。

patterns.name: 邮件提示语及地名
patterns.trigger: «FY»3«I»5« -»5« This»9« should»3 make« things»1« easier»3 in»2« London»3« as»7
patterns.context: 以“FYI -”开头的邮件语句，说明某事会让事情更容易，并提及 London。

patterns.name: 医疗服务评估短语
patterns.trigger: «Patient»4« assessment»9« within»8 the« context»1 of« healthcare»5« delivery»3 packages
patterns.context: 医学或卫生服务研究中，讨论患者评估与医疗服务交付方案的关系。

patterns.name: 医学标题中的时间单位
patterns.context: 急性肾损伤定义句中，描述肾小球滤过率在“hours to days”这一时间范围内下降。

patterns.name: 时间单位后的叙事转折
patterns.context: 叙事句中“for a few hours”之后转入人物已经开始计划逃跑的情节。

en.concept: First-person statements and miscellaneous text features
en.description: Primarily responds to first-person “I” at the beginning of a sentence or clause, especially in personal email statements; also occurs in “I can’t” negative sentences, as well as in a few distinct patterns involving cryptocurrency terms, form-field formatting, and medical-academic phrases.

patterns.name: First-person subject I
patterns.context: First-person statements or personal expressions in emails; the verbs vary and do not form a fixed collocation.
patterns.domain: Emails, web text, and conversational narrative

patterns.name: Negative contraction can’t
patterns.context: First-person negation followed by an action or perception expression: “play”, “see”; it is unclear whether the response is specific to the contraction structure.

patterns.name: Cryptocurrency-related terms
patterns.context: Introductory material for beginners; activation is concentrated on the term following “You may be new to”.

patterns.name: Form fields and line breaks
patterns.context: Short field labels are separated by line breaks, resembling the formatting of a form or webpage.

patterns.name: Medical-academic phrase
patterns.context: A formal, nominalized phrase related to healthcare services; activation mainly falls on “assessment within”.

10_1365.concept: 第一人称陈述及杂项文本特征
10_1365.description: 主要响应句首或分句中的第一人称“I”，尤见邮件式个人陈述；另有“I can’t”否定句，以及加密货币术语、表单字段格式和医疗学术短语等少数不同模式。

patterns.name: 第一人称主语 I
patterns.trigger: “I”在 [1]–[6]、[9] 中激活，尤以“I”后接谓语的句式明显；[4] 另有“Actually I think”
patterns.context: 第一人称陈述或邮件中的个人表达；动词内容多样，并非固定搭配。
patterns.domain: 邮件、网络文本及口语化叙述

patterns.name: 否定缩写 can’t
patterns.context: 第一人称否定后接动作或感知表达：“play”“see”；不确定是否只响应缩写结构。

patterns.name: 加密货币相关词
patterns.context: 面向新手的介绍性表述；激活集中在“You may be new to”之后的术语。

patterns.name: 表单字段与断行
patterns.context: 短字段标签以换行分隔，呈现类似表单或页面文本的格式。

patterns.name: 医疗学术短语
patterns.trigger: “Patient assessment within the context of healthcare delivery”
patterns.context: 名词化、正式的医疗服务相关短语；激活主要落在“assessment within”。

en.description: All segments strongly activate on let, including let someone do/know/walk, let's, let you get back to work, and let alone; the pattern spans emails, forums, and everyday text, with no stable domain restriction.

patterns.name: Permissive/causative use of let
patterns.context: let is followed by an object and a verb or complement; the object may be a pronoun or omitted at the token boundary, as in «let»10« you»2 or «let»10« alone»
patterns.domain: Cross-domain conversational, email, and forum text

10_1365.description: 所有段都在 let 上强激活：包括 let someone do/know/walk、let's、let you get back to work，以及 let alone；跨邮件、论坛和日常文本，未见稳定领域限定。

patterns.name: let 的许可／使役用法
patterns.context: let 后接宾语及动词或补语；宾语可为代词，也可省略在 token 边界中，如 «let»10« you»2 或 «let»10« alone»
patterns.domain: 跨领域的对话、邮件与论坛文本

en.concept: Common function words and sentence fragments
en.description: Strong activations occur across a variety of conjunctions and sentence patterns: because, but, pronouns after let, as well as when, as, if, whatever, and Now; a few unrelated predicates also occur, with no consistent style or topic.

patterns.name: Word after because
patterns.context: Markers are concentrated after because, followed by it, S, I, and so on; no fixed domain is required.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, personal narratives, and technical commentary

patterns.name: Pronoun after let
patterns.context: let is immediately followed by object pronouns or names such as her, you, Tom, and him.
patterns.domain: Personal narratives, emails, commentary about people

patterns.name: Concessive or contrastive conjunction but
patterns.context: Connects preceding and following content in a sentence, often introducing contrast or elaboration; these passages also commonly have a colloquial or conversational tone.

patterns.name: Temporal clause introduced by when
patterns.context: when is followed by I first started up, narrating the temporal background of an event.

patterns.name: As in a causal explanation
patterns.context: Appears in the structure let Tom know ... as soon as ..., expressing a temporal relationship.

patterns.name: Adverb whatever
patterns.context: Introduces a concessive or general situation at the beginning of a sentence, followed by an imperative.
patterns.domain: Commentary or advice about a person

patterns.name: Conditional clause with if
patterns.context: Introduces a conditional clause about someone’s opinion, followed by you think.

patterns.name: Now in quoted narration
patterns.context: Shifts at the start of a sentence to commentary or summary of a story.

patterns.name: Sporadic activation on action or attitude predicates
patterns.context: Activation falls on predicates with different semantic and syntactic roles; no stable shared collocation is evident.

10_1365.concept: 常见功能词与句式片段
10_1365.description: 强激活散见于多种连接词和句式：because、but、let 后代词，以及 when、as、if、whatever、Now 等；另有少数不同谓词，文体和主题不统一。

patterns.name: because 后的词
patterns.context: 标记集中出现在 because 之后，后续接 it、S、I 等；不要求固定领域。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、个人叙述及技术评论

patterns.name: let 后的代词
patterns.context: let 后紧接 her、you、Tom、him 等宾语代词或人名。
patterns.domain: 个人叙述、邮件、人物评论

patterns.name: 让步或转折连接词 but
patterns.context: 在句中连接前后内容，常用于转折或补充；这些段落里还常见口语或对话语气。

patterns.name: when 引出的时间从句
patterns.context: when 后接 I first started up，叙述发生某事的时间背景。
patterns.domain: 论坛中的产品使用经历

patterns.name: 因果解释中的 as
patterns.context: 出现在 let Tom know ... as soon as ... 结构中，表示时间关系。

patterns.name: 副词 whatever
patterns.context: 句首引出让步或泛指情形，后接祈使句。

patterns.name: 条件从句 if
patterns.context: 引出对他人看法的条件从句，后接 you think。

patterns.name: 引述中的 Now
patterns.context: 句首转入对故事的评论或总结。

patterns.name: 动作或态度谓词的零散激活
patterns.context: 激活落在语义和句法角色各异的谓词上，未见稳定共同搭配。

en.description: Activations are scattered: many fall on possessive pronouns such as their/your and descriptions of interpersonal relationships, and also occur in health records, job searching, parenting and food, restaurant experiences, and astrophysics papers; forum separators, usernames, and sporadic word fragments are also activated, making it difficult to identify a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Their / your in possessive constructions
patterns.context: The pronouns refer to previously mentioned people, groups, or their belongings; they often occur before nouns and also appear in constructions such as “their former coach”.
patterns.domain: Research abstracts, sports reporting, medical titles, job-search forums

patterns.name: Accounts of pregnant women and family circumstances
patterns.context: Personal narratives involving pregnancy, parenting, family relationships, and treatment of pregnant women; pronouns introduce possession or relative clauses.

patterns.name: Associations involving food and parenting
patterns.context: When discussing feeding, parenting, or food, personal thoughts and recollections of related details occur.

patterns.name: Date and health-status records
patterns.context: Symptoms are recorded by date, along with a description of recovery to normal.

patterns.name: Job-search experience and timing
patterns.context: Asks about gaps on a résumé and the time needed to find a new position.

patterns.name: Errand, compensation, and food
patterns.context: A conversational account of helping someone at their request and receiving a meal in return.

patterns.name: Estimated value in academic research
patterns.context: A paper reports an estimate of magnetic-field strength.

patterns.name: Forum post separators and garbled usernames
patterns.context: HackerNews posts are joined by separators and usernames; activation falls on numbers, separators, or fragments related to usernames.

patterns.name: Unexplained local triggers
patterns.context: The examples lack a clear shared semantic condition; local word forms or tokenization may be responsible.

10_1365.description: 激活分散：多处落在 their/your 等领属代词及人物关系叙述，也出现在健康记录、求职、育儿饮食、餐馆经历和天体物理论文中；论坛分隔符、用户名及零散词片段也有激活，整体难归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 领属结构中的 their / your
patterns.context: 代词指向前文提及的人、群体或其所属物；常出现在名词前，也见于“their former coach”等结构。
patterns.domain: 研究摘要、体育报道、医学标题、求职论坛

patterns.name: 孕妇与家庭处境叙述
patterns.context: 涉及孕期、育儿、家庭关系及对待孕妇的个人叙述；代词引出所属或关系从句。
patterns.domain: 个人经历、社会议题叙述

patterns.name: 关于食物与育儿的联想
patterns.context: 谈论喂食、育儿或食物时，出现个人想法及对相关细节的回忆。

patterns.name: 日期与健康状况记录
patterns.trigger: «everything»10；邻近日期、蚊虫叮咬、夜间盗汗、食欲变化
patterns.context: 按日期记录症状变化，并描述恢复正常。

patterns.name: 求职经历与时间安排
patterns.context: 询问简历空档及寻找新职位所需时间。

patterns.name: 委托、报酬与食物
patterns.trigger: «wet burritos»；邻近“client promised me a meal”“a MEAL”
patterns.context: 口语化叙述一次受托帮忙及获得餐食的经历。

patterns.name: 学术研究中的估算数值
patterns.context: 论文中报告对磁场强度的估算。

patterns.name: 论坛发帖分隔符与乱码用户名
patterns.context: HackerNews 帖子间以分隔线和用户名串接；激活落在编号、分隔符或用户名相关片段上。

patterns.name: 未解释的局部触发
patterns.context: 各处缺乏共同且明确的语义条件，可能是局部词形或分词触发。

en.concept: Boundaries and fragments in structured text
en.description: Activations often occur on names, addresses, and field formatting in email headers, as well as short fragments after forum separators; Japanese characters and ordinary words in legal commentary also occur. The trigger near the byte string and line break in segment 1 is unclear.

patterns.name: Short strings after separators
patterns.context: After a horizontal separator in forum- or email-like fragments, short strings split into several subword fragments appear; activation falls mainly on these fragments.

patterns.name: Email recipient lists and names
patterns.context: In email headers or contact lists, names, recipients, and their email/organizational paths are interspersed; strong activations often fall on names, spaces, and field separators.
patterns.domain: Enron emails and email address books

patterns.name: Email header fields and punctuation
patterns.context: Sender, date, recipient, cc, and subject fields in email headers, along with punctuation and formatting characters in addresses and dates.

patterns.name: Document separators and formatting fragments
patterns.context: Line breaks, equals-sign or horizontal-line separators, and nearby short text fragments in webpages or post excerpts; these fragments do not form a stable semantic topic.

patterns.name: Japanese hiragana and katakana text
patterns.context: In Japanese sentences and subsequent technical explanations, activation is scattered across subword fragments of kana, kanji, and katakana.

patterns.name: Ordinary words in legal discussion
patterns.context: Commentary in a legal opinion discusses the Department of Justice, prosecutors, and the boundaries of legal theory; activation falls on ordinary English words, unlike the formatting cues in other patterns.

10_1365.concept: 结构化文本中的边界与碎片
10_1365.description: 激活多见于邮件头中的姓名、地址与字段格式，以及论坛分隔符后的短碎片；另见日文字符和法律评论普通词。第1段的字节串与换行附近触发原因不明。

patterns.name: 分隔符后的短字符串
patterns.context: 在类似帖子或邮件片段的横线分隔符后，出现被切分成若干子词片段的短字符串；激活主要落在这些片段上。

patterns.name: 邮件收件人名单与姓名
patterns.context: 邮件头或联系人列表中，姓名、收件人及其邮箱/组织路径交错出现；高激活常落在姓名、空格及字段分隔处。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件及邮件地址簿

patterns.name: 邮件头字段与标点
patterns.context: 邮件头中的发件人、日期、收件人、抄送和主题字段，以及地址、日期中的标点和格式字符。

patterns.name: 文档分隔符与格式化残片
patterns.context: 网页或帖子片段中换行、等号/横线分隔符及其邻近的短文本残片；这些残片不构成稳定的语义主题。

patterns.name: 日文假名与片假名文字
patterns.context: 日文句子及其后续技术说明中，激活分散在假名、汉字和片假名的子词片段上。

patterns.name: 法律论述中的普通词语
patterns.context: 法律意见讨论中，对司法部、检察官及法律理论边界的评论；激活落在普通英文词上，与其他模式的格式线索不同。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to academic document structure: paper metadata, section headings, separators, and line breaks; also responds to forwarded-email header formatting. Mathematical papers contain scattered symbols, terms, and name fragments, but their shared trigger is unclear.

patterns.name: ArXiv document structure markers
patterns.context: Near academic paper metadata and section headings, especially the title, author list, and Markdown/text separator structure before and after Introduction; activation falls on markers, line breaks, and some formatting tokens.

patterns.name: Section structure in mathematical papers
patterns.context: Papers in which headings are marked by titles, underlines, or explicit sec labels; no specific field is required.

patterns.name: Local words in mathematical discussion
patterns.context: Terms such as matrix coefficients and subdiagonal in mathematical text, or near combinatorics lemmas and names; activation is scattered across symbols and word fragments.

patterns.name: Short word fragments in paper titles/topics
patterns.context: These words occur in titles or academic text, but the topics vary widely, making it difficult to confirm a unified lexical trigger.

patterns.name: Email quotation and forwarding format
patterns.context: Original-message separators and email headers in forwarded or replied-to emails; ordinary business-email body text, thanks, or signatures also occur.

10_1365.description: 主要对学术文档的结构格式敏感：论文元数据、章节标题、分隔线和换行；另对邮件转发头格式有反应。数学论文中也出现分散的符号、术语和人名片段，但其共同触发条件不明确。

patterns.name: ArXiv 文档结构标记
patterns.context: 学术论文元数据及章节标题附近，尤其是标题、作者列表和 Introduction 前后的 Markdown/文本分隔结构；激活落在标记、换行和部分格式 token 上。

patterns.name: 数学论文中的章节结构
patterns.context: 论文以标题、下划线或显式 sec 标签标示章节的场景；不要求特定学科。

patterns.name: 数学论述中的局部词语
patterns.context: 数学正文中矩阵系数、下对角线等术语，或组合数学引理、人名附近；激活分散在符号和词语片段上。
patterns.domain: 数学论文（算子理论、组合数学）

patterns.name: 论文标题/主题中的短词片段
patterns.context: 这些词出现在标题或学术正文中，但上下文主题差异很大，难以确认存在统一词义触发条件。

patterns.name: 邮件引用与转发格式
patterns.context: 转发或回复邮件中的原始邮件分隔线和邮件头；同时出现普通商务邮件正文、致谢或签名。

en.concept: Paper structure markers and local formatting fragments
en.description: Strong activations often fall on paper structure markers, especially equals-sign heading separators; other occurrences include constants at the ends of mathematical general terms, French author declarations, text adjacent to formulas, and descriptions of people’s scientific achievements, with no single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Markdown heading underline
patterns.context: An equals-sign underline in Markdown style appears after a heading or subsection heading in the paper body; activation is concentrated on the equals-sign string.

patterns.name: Answer expression in a math problem
patterns.context: After a sequence problem asks for the nth term, a candidate general term expressed with variables and exponents follows; the strongest activation falls on the final constant «1» or «-1» in the expression.

patterns.name: Paper acknowledgment heading
patterns.context: Acknowledgments appear as an unnumbered heading at the end of the paper body or at a section transition; the heading and adjacent formatting markers are activated.

patterns.name: French paper author declaration and contribution heading
patterns.context: The declarations or author-contributions section of a French academic paper, accompanied by numbered subsection markers, equals-sign separators, and line breaks.

patterns.name: Combinatorial asymptotic constants in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: A paper cites results by Hardy–Ramanujan and Uspensky and introduces a subsequent improvement; activation occurs on English connective text near the formula.

patterns.name: Physics section heading
patterns.context: Discusses anomalous light refraction in low-pressure hydrogen gas, followed by a descriptive heading introducing the anomaly and its explanation.

patterns.name: Renormalization section heading
patterns.context: A particle-physics paper opens a section on renormalization methods with a heading, followed by the paper body.

patterns.name: Electroweak field section heading
patterns.context: After discussing physical forces such as electroweak, gluon, and gravitational forces, a section heading introduces electroweak fields.

patterns.name: Microbiologist narrative in a biography
patterns.context: A biographical account describes a scientist’s research achievements and contributions to agriculture and animal husbandry; no clear heading-separator trigger is evident.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central biographical or institutional history

patterns.name: Paper abstract heading
patterns.context: At the beginning of a paper, an unnumbered abstract heading and equals-sign underline serve as structural markers.

patterns.name: General-term question in a sequence problem
patterns.context: A natural-language question asks for a particular term of a sequence, followed by an algebraic expression; activation is weaker and does not fully match the strong activation on the final constant in the expression.

10_1365.concept: 论文结构标记与局部格式片段
10_1365.description: 强激活多落在论文结构标记上，尤其等号标题分隔线；另见数学通项式末尾常数、法语作者声明、公式邻接语及人物科研成就叙述，无法归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: Markdown 标题分隔线
patterns.context: 论文正文中的标题或小节标题后，出现 Markdown 风格的等号下划线；激活集中在等号串。

patterns.name: 数学题中的答案表达式
patterns.context: 数列题询问第 n 项后，紧接以变量和幂次表示的候选通项；最强激活落在表达式末尾的常数项「1」或「-1」。

patterns.name: 论文致谢标题
patterns.context: 论文正文末尾或章节转换处，致谢作为无编号标题出现；标题及紧邻格式标记激活。

patterns.name: 法语论文作者声明与贡献标题
patterns.trigger: 「Les auteurs ne déclarent aucun conflit d’intérêt.」「Contributions des auteurs」「{#S0006}」
patterns.context: 法语学术论文的声明或作者贡献部分，伴随编号小节标记、等号分隔线及换行。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的组合渐近常数
patterns.context: 论文引用 Hardy–Ramanujan 与 Uspensky 的结果，介绍后续改进；激活出现在公式附近的英文连接语。

patterns.name: 物理章节标题
patterns.trigger: 「Description of the anomalies and their explanations.」「{#description}」「Anomalies of the speeds」
patterns.context: 讨论低压含氢气体中的光折射异常，随后以描述性标题引出异常及解释。

patterns.name: 重整化章节标题
patterns.context: 粒子物理论文中以标题开启重整化方法章节，标题后接论文正文。

patterns.name: 电弱场章节标题
patterns.context: 讨论电弱、胶子和引力等物理力后，以章节标题引出电弱场内容。

patterns.name: 人物传记中的微生物学家叙述
patterns.trigger: 「a distinguished microbiologist」「developed new applications of microorganisms」「greatly benefited agriculture and livestock husbandry」
patterns.context: 人物经历叙述中介绍一位科学家的研究成就及农业、畜牧业贡献；未见明确标题分隔线触发。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 人物或机构史料

patterns.name: 论文摘要标题
patterns.context: 论文开头以无编号摘要标题及等号下划线作为结构标记。

patterns.name: 数列题中的通项询问
patterns.trigger: 「What is the f’th term」「What is the x’th term」及相邻数列
patterns.context: 以自然语言询问数列第几项，随后给出代数式；激活较弱，且与表达式末尾常数项的强激活不完全相同。

en.concept: Opening layout of ArXiv paper introductions
en.description: Activations are concentrated on the opening layout of ArXiv papers: title and equals-sign or hyphen separators, prefatory metadata or keywords, followed by the introduction body; some fragments also contain section anchors, authors, or address fragments.

patterns.name: Underline beneath paper introduction heading
patterns.context: After front matter in an ArXiv paper, an Introduction heading and equals-sign heading separator appear, followed by the body; this structure occurs in all segments.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, especially ArXiv LaTeX/text-converted formats

patterns.name: Section heading formatting markers
patterns.context: The heading is accompanied by an explicit anchor or section identifier in braces, unlike an ordinary heading separator; clearly appears only in segments 8 and 10.
patterns.domain: Academic document conversion text with Markdown/HTML anchors

patterns.name: Paper metadata and keywords
patterns.context: Title, authors, keywords, classification codes, or subject tags appear as front matter before or after the introduction; the subject matter varies across papers.
patterns.domain: Academic paper abstract pages, title pages, and keyword/classification information

patterns.name: Hyphen-style separator
patterns.context: Located after the paper title or front matter and before the introduction body; equals-sign separators are especially consistent, while hyphens occur in only some segments.
patterns.domain: Typesetting structure in ArXiv text dumps

patterns.name: Opening language of the introduction body
patterns.context: The first sentence of the paper body immediately follows the Introduction heading, often opening with a statement introducing the research subject or paper; vocabulary and topic vary.

patterns.name: Authors, addresses, and other front-matter fragments
patterns.context: Addresses or author information occur near paper metadata; the address in segment 1 has no clear connection to the topic, while other names belong to paper front matter.
patterns.domain: Paper front-page metadata or document-extraction fragments

10_1365.description: 激活集中于ArXiv论文的引言起始版式：标题与等号/短横线分隔、前置元数据或关键词，随后进入引言正文；个别片段还含章节锚点、作者或地址残片。

patterns.name: 论文引言标题下划线
patterns.context: ArXiv论文前置信息之后，出现 Introduction 标题及等号式标题分隔线，随后进入正文；该结构在所有片段中出现。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，尤其是 ArXiv LaTeX/文本转换格式

patterns.name: 章节标题格式标记
patterns.context: 标题伴随花括号中的显式锚点或章节标识，区别于普通标题分隔线；仅在片段8和10清楚出现。
patterns.domain: 带有 Markdown/HTML 锚点的学术文档转换文本

patterns.name: 论文元数据及关键词
patterns.context: 引言前后列出题名、作者、关键词、分类号或主题标签等论文前置信息；各篇内容领域不同。
patterns.domain: 学术论文摘要页、标题页及关键词/分类信息

patterns.name: 横线式分隔符
patterns.context: 位于论文题名或前置信息之后、引言正文之前；等号分隔符尤其稳定，短横线仅出现在部分片段。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 文本转储中的排版结构

patterns.name: 引言正文起始语
patterns.trigger: «We»3« are»3 interested« in»1 the effect；«In»2 the« paper»2« we»3 deal with；«The»1 time»1 evolution；«The»1 point»1 at infinity
patterns.context: 引言标题后紧接论文正文首句，常以介绍研究对象或论文内容的陈述句开篇；具体词汇和主题并不一致。

patterns.name: 作者姓名与地址等前置杂项
patterns.trigger: «619 Red Cedar RD, East Lansing, MI 48824, USA»；«K. Smolentsev»；«F. Fauvet»
patterns.context: 论文元数据附近出现地址或作者信息；片段1的地址与主题内容联系不明，其他姓名属于论文前置信息。
patterns.domain: 论文首页元数据或文档抽取残片

en.concept: Salience and formatting cues in academic texts
en.description: Activations occur across paper metadata and typographic boundaries, reader address and requests for help, email formatting, and degree expressions such as greatly in academic texts. Some transitional words and formatting markers also respond, with no single stable semantic trigger evident.

patterns.name: greatly and subsequent degree/result expressions
patterns.context: Used as a degree adverb before a verb or participle to express significant help, improvement, or expansion; often occurs in academic prose.
patterns.domain: Book prefaces, mathematics papers, research texts

patterns.name: Author and affiliation metadata templates
patterns.context: Author, address, email, and reference fields in paper layouts or exported text, often accompanied by line breaks, LaTeX markers, and placeholder-like hyphens.

patterns.name: Reader/requester address
patterns.context: Explanations directed at readers or direct questions; trigger words occur when inviting readers to consult references or asking for help.

patterns.name: Email exchanges and interpersonal negotiation
patterns.context: Quoted email headers, or informal exchanges discussing colleagues, plans, and opinions.

patterns.name: Conjunctions and referential words in general coherent text
patterns.context: Relational words and demonstratives that connect to preceding text within or at the beginning of a sentence; there is insufficient evidence that they form an independent, stable pattern.

patterns.name: Local markers without a clear correspondence
patterns.context: Adjacent to metadata fields or text boundaries, possibly influenced by formatting and tokenization; no consistent semantic condition can be inferred on its own.
patterns.domain: ArXiv formatted text and Q&A text

10_1365.concept: 学术文本中的显著性与格式线索
10_1365.description: 激活分布在论文元数据与排版边界、读者称呼和求助表达、邮件格式，以及学术文本中 greatly 等程度表达；也响应若干承接词和格式标记，未显示单一稳定语义触发。

patterns.name: greatly及其后续程度/结果表达
patterns.context: 在动词或分词前作程度副词，表达显著帮助、改进或扩展；常处于学术叙述中。
patterns.domain: 书籍前言、数学论文、科研文本

patterns.name: 作者与机构元数据模板
patterns.context: 论文排版或导出文本中的作者、地址、邮箱及参考文献字段，常伴随换行、LaTeX 标记和占位式连字符。

patterns.name: 读者/求助者称呼
patterns.context: 面向读者的说明或直接提问；触发词出现在邀请查阅参考文献或请求帮助的语境。
patterns.domain: 学术论文说明、StackExchange 问答

patterns.name: 邮件往来与人际协商
patterns.trigger: «Original Message»、«From»:；以及“I had to plan”“Any thoughts?”
patterns.context: 邮件引用头部，或讨论同事、计划与意见的非正式交流。

patterns.name: 一般连贯文本中的转折/指代词
patterns.context: 句内或句首承接前文的关系词、指示词；没有足够证据表明它们构成独立稳定模式。

patterns.name: 无明确对应的局部标记
patterns.trigger: 高激活还落在空格、换行、标点、破折号及 LaTeX/引用标记上
patterns.context: 与元数据字段或文本边界相邻，可能受格式和分词影响；无法单独归纳出一致语义条件。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 排版文本及问答文本

en.description: Primarily responds to paper structure and front matter metadata: authors, attribution, delimiters, institutional addresses, titles, and research statements in abstracts. It also responds strongly to formal institutional permission and expressions of thanks in book acknowledgments.

patterns.name: Author/statement metadata fields in paper abstracts or body text
patterns.context: An academic paper excerpt transitions after the abstract or body to metadata such as authors, affiliations, classifications, or references; these boundaries/fields activate strongly across multiple passages.

patterns.name: Author names and attribution lines
patterns.context: Names, footnotes, or affiliation markers listed in a paper's author field, often followed by a line break, delimiter, or affiliation.

patterns.name: Contributions or results in abstracts
patterns.context: A paper abstract or body summarizes a research question, proof, contribution, design, or physical result; activations are distributed across narrative and result words.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, computer science, engineering, physics, and economics papers

patterns.name: Paper titles and title formatting
patterns.context: Near a title, including title capitalization, formatting markers, and the following author information.

patterns.name: Address and affiliation layout lines
patterns.context: Standalone lines for affiliations, addresses, postal codes, and similar fields following author attribution, often separated by backslashes or line breaks.

patterns.name: Official institutional wording in acknowledgments/permissions
patterns.context: First-person statements that a work was created with an institution's knowledge or permission, thanking it for materials, images, or research assistance.

10_1365.description: 主要响应论文结构与前置元数据：作者、署名、分隔符、机构地址、标题及摘要中的研究陈述；另对书籍致谢中正式机构许可和感谢语有明显响应。

patterns.name: 论文摘要或正文中的作者/声明元数据字段
patterns.context: 学术论文片段在摘要或正文后转入作者、单位、分类或参考文献等元数据；多段中这些边界/字段标记激活强

patterns.name: 作者姓名与署名行
patterns.context: 论文作者字段中列出姓名、脚注或机构标记，常接换行、分隔符或单位

patterns.name: 摘要中的贡献或结果表述
patterns.context: 论文摘要或正文概述研究问题、证明、贡献、设计方案或物理结果；激活散布在叙述词和结果词上
patterns.domain: 数学、计算机、工程、物理及经济学论文

patterns.name: 论文标题及标题格式
patterns.context: 标题或题名附近，含标题大小写、格式标记及紧随的作者信息

patterns.name: 地址与机构排版行
patterns.trigger: «Department of Statistics»、«5734 S. University Ave»、«Chicago, IL 60637»、«Institute for Theoretical Physics»
patterns.context: 作者署名后的机构、地址、邮编等独立换行字段，常以反斜杠或换行分隔

patterns.name: 致谢/许可中的官方机构措辞
patterns.trigger: «with» the «knowledge» of the «War» Department…«kindly» allowed…«greatly» helped
patterns.context: 第一人称说明作品经某机构知情或许可，并感谢其提供材料、图片或研究帮助

en.description: Primarily responds to labels, delimiters, citation markers, and formatting boundaries in ArXiv paper author sections. Sporadic activations also occur in theoretical physics terminology, academic abstract phrasing, and evaluative narration in a children's literature review.

patterns.name: ArXiv author metadata and formatting
patterns.context: An author section appears after the body or abstract; activations concentrate on labels, delimiters, citation markers, and formatting boundaries, with occasional activations within names.

patterns.name: Proper nouns or terminology in mathematical physics papers
patterns.context: The body or title concerns quantum theory, dynamics, particle physics, spectral correspondence, or classification; word activations are sporadic, usually near the end of the body and the author section.
patterns.domain: Theoretical physics and mathematical physics papers

patterns.name: Academic abstract phrasing and closing punctuation
patterns.context: An academic abstract/body passage stating a proof or research result, followed by author metadata after the final punctuation.

patterns.name: Praise and audience in children's literature reviews
patterns.context: A review discusses a story and its popularity, mentioning readers, admirers, and children; activations are distributed across descriptions of evaluation and expected effects.

10_1365.concept: 学术论文元数据与边界
10_1365.description: 主要响应 ArXiv 论文作者栏的标签、分隔符、引用标记和排版边界；同时在理论物理术语、学术摘要句式及一段儿童文学评论的评价叙述中有零散激活。

patterns.name: ArXiv 作者元数据与排版
patterns.trigger: «author»:、«-» |、作者名单中的 «[^…]»、«\» 和机构行前的缩进
patterns.context: 论文正文后或摘要片段后出现作者栏；激活集中在标签、分隔符、引用标记及格式边界，姓名内部也有零星激活。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文模板与元数据

patterns.name: 数学物理论文中的专名或术语
patterns.context: 论文正文或标题涉及量子理论、动力学、粒子物理、谱对应或分类；词语激活零散，通常紧邻正文结束及作者栏。
patterns.domain: 理论物理及数学物理论文

patterns.name: 论文摘要句式与结尾标点
patterns.trigger: «In» this «note», we prove、«and» we provide、句末 «.'»
patterns.context: 陈述证明或研究结果的学术摘要/正文片段，句末标点后紧接作者元数据。

patterns.name: 儿童文学评论中的赞誉与受众
patterns.context: 评论故事及其受欢迎程度，提及读者、仰慕者和儿童；激活分布于评价和预期效果的叙述中。
patterns.domain: 维多利亚时期文学评论

en.concept: Academic document structure and formatting markers
en.description: Activations occur mainly in academic documents, especially ArXiv paper author/affiliation metadata and LaTeX/Markdown formatting structures.
