patterns.name: Code lines and statement boundaries
patterns.context: Near statements, indentation, and closing parentheses in code snippets, especially where code ends and ordinary text begins.

patterns.name: Legal document formatting and headers
patterns.context: Layout regions such as headings, dates, disclaimers, and signatures in court opinions.

patterns.name: Email headers and body layout
patterns.context: Email header fields, recipient information, or signature areas at the end of the body; strong activation is primarily on newlines.

10_1661.concept: 文本结构边界，偏好换行
10_1661.description: 各段最突出的共同点是换行及版式边界；数学文本、代码、法律文书和邮件中均有激活，公式结构、代码语句与文档字段也出现较弱激活。

patterns.name: 行尾或公式环境后的换行
patterns.context: 显著激活落在换行 token 上，常出现在数学排版、代码或文档段落边界之后；第1段还有「«/»5」等格式线索。

patterns.name: 数学公式与 LaTeX 结构
patterns.context: 数学符号、公式标记、LaTeX 环境及其周边换行；激活也分布在变量、标点和结构 token 上。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文、数学问答

patterns.name: 代码行与语句边界
patterns.context: 代码片段中的语句、缩进和闭合括号附近，尤其是代码结束后转入普通文字处。

patterns.name: 法律文档格式与页眉
patterns.context: 法院意见文本的标题、日期、免责声明和署名等版式区域。

patterns.name: 邮件头与邮件正文版式
patterns.context: 邮件头字段、收件人信息或正文末尾的签名区域，显著激活主要在换行。

en.description: All passages are code or code-adjacent text from technical Q&A. Activation is distributed around newlines and indentation, punctuation boundaries, identifiers, and property names. It spans frontend development, file handling, configuration, and multiple languages, with no single topic word or language dominating.

patterns.name: Code syntax and structural symbols
patterns.context: Activation occurs at newlines or indentation and punctuation boundaries in code snippets; it is not limited to one language, and some activation is adjacent to code tokens
patterns.domain: Multilingual code, configuration, and markup languages

patterns.name: Names and property boundaries in code
patterns.context: Near code identifiers, property names, or member-access expressions; often involving camelCase or compound names, but not a consistent specific name
patterns.domain: Source code in software development Q&A

patterns.name: JavaScript/React code and browser operations
patterns.context: Imports, UI components, browser detection, or scrolling code in frontend examples
patterns.domain: JavaScript, React, jQuery, and browser development

patterns.name: File, data, and serialization operations
patterns.context: Contexts where code reads, writes, iterates over, or processes files and data fields
patterns.domain: Node.js, PHP, Python, and data-processing code

patterns.name: Property, layout, and namespace configuration in code
patterns.context: Attributes or configuration key-value pairs describing component bindings, layout resources, or autoloading rules
patterns.domain: XAML/XML, Android, and PHP Composer configuration

patterns.name: Conditional logic and callback expressions
patterns.context: Near conditional branches, callbacks, or anonymous functions inside function bodies; reflects program control flow
patterns.domain: Example code in multiple programming languages

patterns.name: Natural-language comments/explanations in code examples
patterns.context: Comments or introductory explanations near code; specific content varies

patterns.name: Scattered HTML/template text
patterns.context: HTML fragments or template-rendering calls embedded in source code, including ordinary text fields

patterns.name: Python line-by-line file processing
patterns.context: Code that reads a text file and counts or compares values line by line

patterns.name: Idiomatic browser-detection expression
patterns.context: A JavaScript technique for browser identification using a function-string form

10_1661.description: 所有片段均为技术问答中的代码或代码邻近文本，激活分布在换行缩进、标点边界、标识符及属性名附近；涵盖前端、文件处理、配置和多种语言，未见单一主题词或语言主导。

patterns.name: 代码语法与结构符号
patterns.context: 在代码片段中，换行或缩进以及标点边界处激活；不局限于某一种语言，部分激活紧邻代码 token
patterns.domain: 多语言编程代码、配置与标记语言

patterns.name: 代码中的名称与属性边界
patterns.context: 代码标识符、属性名或成员访问表达式附近；常见于驼峰式或复合名称，但并非统一的具体名称
patterns.domain: 软件开发问答中的源代码

patterns.name: JavaScript/React 代码与浏览器操作
patterns.context: 前端示例中的导入、UI 组件、浏览器检测或滚动处理代码

patterns.name: 文件、数据与序列化操作
patterns.context: 代码读写、遍历或处理文件、数据字段的上下文

patterns.name: 代码中的属性、布局与命名空间配置
patterns.context: 以属性或配置键值描述组件绑定、布局资源或自动加载规则
patterns.domain: XAML/XML、Android 与 PHP Composer 配置

patterns.name: 条件判断与回调表达式
patterns.context: 函数体内条件分支、回调或匿名函数附近；呈现程序控制流程
patterns.domain: 多种编程语言的示例代码

patterns.name: 代码示例中的自然语言注释/说明
patterns.trigger: «//»、«now it is serial foreach loop»、«we are using latest version with closure on most recent data»、«Quick and easy browser sniff»
patterns.context: 代码附近的注释或引导说明；具体内容不相同

patterns.name: 散落的 HTML/模板文本
patterns.context: 源代码中嵌入的 HTML 片段或模板渲染调用，包含普通文本字段

patterns.name: Python 文件逐行处理
patterns.context: 读取文本文件并逐行统计、比较数值的代码

patterns.name: 特定浏览器检测惯用表达式
patterns.context: 通过函数字符串形式进行浏览器识别的 JavaScript 小技巧

en.description: Activation occurs primarily around indentation, newlines, and structural boundaries in code and markup languages, spanning JSX, HTML, Ruby, and PHP snippets. It also responds to medical table formatting, blank paragraphs in legal documents, and LaTeX mathematical definitions; no single specific word runs through all samples.

patterns.name: Structural markers in indented code
patterns.context: Located in code snippets, especially indented blocks, tags, or statement boundaries in JSX/HTML/Ruby and C-like syntax; activation is distributed across multiple tokens and is not limited to a particular identifier.

patterns.name: Table rows, columns, and numeric formatting
patterns.context: In medical statistical tables, column headings, categories, numbers, and percentages in parentheses are arranged in rows and columns.

patterns.name: Blank paragraphs in legal text
patterns.context: The legal document excerpt contains almost no visible body text, primarily paragraph spacing, newlines, and indentation; the excerpt does not establish whether more specific legal vocabulary triggers activation.

patterns.name: Mathematical formulas and their formatting
patterns.context: Formula symbols, commands, and nearby text co-occur in a LaTeX mathematical explanation defining distance or a statistic in a paper.

10_1661.concept: 结构化文本排版与边界
10_1661.description: 主要激活于代码和标记语言中的缩进、换行及结构边界，覆盖 JSX、HTML、Ruby 与 PHP 等片段；另对医学表格排版、法律文书空白段落和 LaTeX 数学定义有响应，未见单一具体词汇贯穿全部样本。

patterns.name: 缩进代码中的结构标记
patterns.trigger: 换行、缩进空格以及代码结构边界，如 «↵»、«<»、«/>»、«}»、«case»、«return»、«</»
patterns.context: 位于代码片段中，尤其是 JSX/HTML/Ruby 等标记语言或类 C 语法的缩进块、标签或语句边界；激活分布于多种 token，并不局限于某一具体标识符。

patterns.name: 表格行列与数值排版
patterns.trigger: «Primary» «tumor» «sites» «(%)»、«Oral» «cavity» «53» «(» «36» «)»，以及对齐空白与百分比数值
patterns.context: 在医学统计表格中，列标题、分类项、数字和括号百分比呈现行列式排版。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的空白段落
patterns.trigger: «UST»以及反复出现的 «↵»、制表符和缩进空白
patterns.context: 法律文档片段几乎没有可见正文，主要是段落间距、换行和缩进；无法从截取内容判定是否有更具体的法律词汇触发。

patterns.name: 数学公式及其排版
patterns.context: 在论文对距离或统计量作定义的 LaTeX 数学说明中，公式符号、命令与其附近文本共同出现。

en.description: Activation samples are scattered across HTML, scientific prose, formulas, and code. Visible triggers include temporal or stage indicators, comparison operators, Boolean assignments, and field and error-handling syntax, with no unified semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: HTML column layout markers
patterns.context: An HTML snippet defines a column container, nested div elements, and an icon span.

patterns.name: Temporal reference in academic text
patterns.context: Describes changes in tubal function at a point in time after surgery.

patterns.name: Evidence reference in a storm account
patterns.context: Explains a storm category adjustment based on observed wind speed and air pressure.

patterns.name: Patent step indicator
patterns.context: Describes a rivet structure and the process stage involving further application of tensile force.

patterns.name: Arbitrary time in mathematics
patterns.context: Defines the relationship between platelet uptake rates at two time points.

patterns.name: Greater-than comparison in code
patterns.context: Checks whether the number of request attachments is greater than zero; activation falls on and near the comparison operator.

patterns.name: Object Boolean property assignment
patterns.context: Sets the tree-node state properties of an object in succession.

patterns.name: Card metadata fields
patterns.context: Lists card information using field names and identifiers.

patterns.name: SQL query error handling
patterns.context: Outputs a database error and terminates the program when a query fails.

10_1661.description: 激活样本分散于HTML、科学叙述、公式与代码；可见触发点包括时间或阶段指示语、比较符、布尔赋值及字段和错误处理语法，未见统一的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: HTML 列布局标记
patterns.context: HTML 片段中定义列容器、嵌套 div 和图标 span。

patterns.name: 学术文本中的时间指示
patterns.context: 描述手术后某时间点的输卵管功能变化。

patterns.name: 风暴叙述中的依据指示
patterns.context: 根据观测到的风速和气压，说明风暴等级调整。

patterns.name: 专利步骤指示
patterns.context: 说明铆钉结构及进一步施加拉力时的过程阶段。

patterns.name: 数学中的任意时刻
patterns.context: 定义血小板摄取率在两个时间点上的关系。

patterns.name: 代码中的大于比较
patterns.context: 比较请求附件数量是否大于零；激活落在比较符及其附近。

patterns.name: 对象布尔属性赋值
patterns.context: 连续设置对象的树节点状态属性。

patterns.name: 卡片元数据字段
patterns.context: 以字段名和标识符列出卡片信息。

patterns.name: SQL 查询错误处理
patterns.context: 查询失败时输出数据库错误并终止程序。

en.description: Activation mainly falls on sentence-initial prepositional introductions: “On” in formal narratives and “To that end” in statements of purpose. Email time fields and mathematical numbered conditional statements also appear, all exhibiting formatted sentence-initial or field-introductory structures.

patterns.name: On in formal dates
patterns.context: A time/topic introduction at the beginning of a sentence or clause, followed by a date, referential phrase, or subject of discussion; often followed by a comma
patterns.domain: Legal decisions, court documents, and news biographies

patterns.name: Purpose introduction To that end
patterns.context: At the beginning of a sentence or within one, states that an action, test, or study aims to achieve a previously mentioned goal
patterns.domain: Regulatory explanations and medical research text

patterns.name: Email date/time field
patterns.context: In the Sent field of an email header, weekday, date, year, and time are arranged in a formatted sequence

patterns.name: Numbered condition in formal logic
patterns.context: A numbered item states a mathematical proposition as a conditional, with symbols and variables
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers or formal mathematical text

10_1661.description: 激活主要落在句首介词引介语：正式叙事中的“On”及目的表述“To that end”；另见邮件时间字段和数学编号条件句，均呈现带格式的句首/字段引导结构。

patterns.name: 正式日期中的 On
patterns.trigger: «On» 后接月份、日期和年份，如 “On June 7, 2018” “On June 3 and June 12, 1968” “On this last date” “On this occasion” “On this point”
patterns.context: 句首或分句开头的时间/话题引介语，后接日期、指代性短语或论述对象；常与逗号相连
patterns.domain: 法律判决、法院文件及新闻传记

patterns.name: 目的引介语 To that end
patterns.context: 句首或句中说明某项行动、测试或研究旨在达成前文目标
patterns.domain: 法规说明与医学研究文本

patterns.name: 邮件日期时间字段
patterns.context: 邮件头的 Sent 字段中，星期、日期、年份与时间按格式排列

patterns.name: 形式逻辑中的编号条件
patterns.context: 编号条目以条件句陈述数学命题，含符号与变量
patterns.domain: 数学论文或形式化数学文本

en.description: Activation is scattered across domains: connective structures such as and, numbers and units, medical lesions and surgery, code identifiers, error/exception text, imaging and astronomical terminology, XML tags, and CORS fields. No single semantic pattern explains all samples.

patterns.name: English connective and
patterns.context: Activation falls on and itself or on adjacent phrases and punctuation; includes coordinated nouns, clauses, and connections in technical fields
patterns.domain: Patents, medical papers, code Q&A, error logs, astronomy

patterns.name: Word form of single
patterns.context: Occurs in “a single reference burst” and “a single carrier frequency,” with repeated single and a nearby

patterns.name: Numbers, percentages, and measurements
patterns.context: Quantified statements made up of values, parentheses, units, or percentages; activation also falls near several numbers

patterns.name: Medical surgery and lesion descriptions
patterns.context: Case or study results report fractures, masses, surgery, and pathological findings; activation is distributed across disease names, anatomical terms, and narrative connectives
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts and medical case reports

patterns.name: Program identifiers and code structure
patterns.context: Code snippets composed of classes, method names, calls, and braces; activation concentrates on identifiers and some syntax tokens

patterns.name: Error and exception text
patterns.context: Error messages describing request, connection, authorization, or loading failures; activation falls on error words and their context
patterns.domain: StackExchange programming Q&A and technical logs

patterns.name: Medical imaging and tumor status
patterns.context: Reports imaging results, lesion status, and subsequent treatment

patterns.name: Astronomical observation bands
patterns.context: Describes infrared observation resolution in conjunction with optical or CO images

patterns.name: XML/HTML style markers
patterns.context: Error messages are serialized in a tagged structure, with activation spanning the vicinity of closing tags

patterns.name: HTTP cross-origin request fields
patterns.context: Explains CORS response-header restrictions on localhost upload requests

10_1661.description: 激活分散于多领域：and 等连接结构、数值与单位、医学病灶及手术、代码标识符、错误/异常文本、影像和天文术语、XML 标签及 CORS 字段；未见能解释全部样本的单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 英语连接词 and
patterns.context: 激活落在 and 本身，或与 and 相邻的短语、标点上；包括并列名词、从句和技术字段中的连接
patterns.domain: 专利、医学论文、代码问答、错误日志、天文学

patterns.name: single 的词形
patterns.context: 出现在“a single reference burst”和“a single carrier frequency”中，附近有重复的 single 及 a

patterns.name: 数字、百分数与测量值
patterns.context: 数值、括号、单位或百分比组成的量化陈述；激活也落在若干数值附近
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、天文学、医学病例

patterns.name: 医学手术与病灶叙述
patterns.context: 病例或研究结果中报告骨折、肿块、手术及病理发现；激活分布于病名、解剖词和叙述连接词
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要与医学病例报告

patterns.name: 程序标识符及代码结构
patterns.context: 类、方法名、调用和花括号组成的代码片段；激活集中在标识符及部分语法 token

patterns.name: 错误与异常文本
patterns.context: 描述请求、连接、授权或加载失败的错误消息；激活落在错误词及其上下文中
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答与技术日志

patterns.name: 医学影像与肿瘤状态
patterns.context: 报告影像检查结果、病灶状态及后续治疗

patterns.name: 天文观测波段
patterns.context: 描述红外观测分辨率，并结合光学或 CO 图像

patterns.name: XML/HTML 样式标记
patterns.context: 错误信息被序列化在带标签的结构中，激活覆盖闭合标签附近

patterns.name: HTTP 跨域请求字段
patterns.context: 解释 localhost 上传请求的 CORS 响应头限制

en.description: Activation is distributed across quantities and time expressions, body parts and injuries or medical procedures, legal proceedings and event sequences; it also includes football calls, galaxy accretion heating, and a breast cancer case. No single stable trigger word is evident.

patterns.name: Explicit quantities or timescales
patterns.context: Near numbers or quantity words, especially in descriptions of time intervals, case counts, scale, or size; trigger locations vary.
patterns.domain: News accounts, astrophysics, law, medicine, social science

patterns.name: Body parts and injury/medical procedures
patterns.context: When describing body parts, trauma, surgery, or medical examinations, often alongside specific actions, anatomical locations, or clinical outcomes.
patterns.domain: Legal findings, medical technology patents, medical abstracts and case reports

patterns.name: Legal proceedings and adjudication records
patterns.context: When legal documents describe litigation procedures, appellate review, or case records; activation sometimes falls on procedural terms or general legal language.

patterns.name: Football calls and scoring events
patterns.context: In football match reports, a referee’s decision, a disallowed goal, and a subsequent substitution form a sequence of events.

patterns.name: Matter accretion and heating during galaxy mergers
patterns.context: Describes gas entering a system during galaxy mergers and subsequent reheating.

patterns.name: Temporal sequence and dates in legal documents
patterns.context: Uses dates and intervals to establish the sequence of petitions, service, or other legal events.

patterns.name: Procedural actions and process verbs
patterns.context: Describes actions affecting an object, such as penetrating, invading, grabbing, or throwing; semantics and domains are not consistent.

patterns.name: Quantitative statistics and proportions
patterns.context: Reports case counts, proportions, or group sizes; numbers are often adjacent to statistical nouns or units.

patterns.name: Breast tumor case description
patterns.context: Describes breast cancer, refusal of biopsy, mastectomy, and characteristics of a mass in the specimen.

10_1661.description: 激活分布于数量和时间表达、身体部位及损伤或医疗操作、法律程序与事件顺序，也包括足球判罚、星系吸积加热和乳腺病例；未见单一稳定触发词。

patterns.name: 明确数量或时间尺度
patterns.context: 数字或数量词附近，尤其是时间间隔、病例数、规模或尺寸的叙述中；触发位置并不一致。
patterns.domain: 新闻叙述、天体物理、法律、医学、社会科学

patterns.name: 身体部位与损伤／医疗操作
patterns.context: 描述身体部位、创伤、手术或医学检查时，常伴随具体动作、解剖位置或临床结果。
patterns.domain: 法律事实陈述、专利医疗技术、医学摘要与病例报告

patterns.name: 法律程序与裁判记录
patterns.context: 法律文书叙述诉讼程序、上诉审查或案卷记录时；有时激活落在程序词或一般法律措辞上。

patterns.name: 足球比赛判罚与进球事件
patterns.context: 足球比赛报道中，裁判判罚、进球被判无效及后续换人构成连续事件。

patterns.name: 星系并合中的物质吸积与加热
patterns.context: 描述星系并合期间气体进入系统及随后的再加热过程。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的时间顺序与日期
patterns.context: 按日期和间隔交代请愿、送达或其他法律事件的先后顺序。

patterns.name: 程序动作与过程性动词
patterns.context: 描述穿透、侵犯、抓取或投掷等对对象产生影响的动作；语义和领域不统一。
patterns.domain: 医学／专利文本及法律事实叙述

patterns.name: 数量统计与比例报告
patterns.context: 报告病例数、比例或群体数量，数字常与统计性名词或单位相邻。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、社会科学研究

patterns.name: 乳腺肿瘤病例描述
patterns.context: 描述乳腺癌、拒绝活检、接受乳房切除及标本中的肿块特征。

en.description: Activations appear around medical measurements and masses, surgery, orthopedics, and cardiac lesions, as well as dentistry, bytes or numeric checks in code, and legal descriptions of injuries; no clear common trigger.

patterns.name: Measurement unit cm
patterns.context: Appears after a number or range to describe size, boundaries, or distance
patterns.domain: Measurements in medical papers, such as masses and radiotherapy margins

patterns.name: Numeric and decimal measurements
patterns.context: Numbers, decimal points, multiplication signs, or ranges appear alongside medical measurements

patterns.name: Medical masses and lesions
patterns.context: Refers to masses, metastases, or lesions in body tissue, often near information on location, size, examination, or treatment

patterns.name: Surgery and tissue handling
patterns.context: Describes surgery, excision, or intraoperative findings

patterns.name: Orthopedic complications and implants
patterns.context: Follow-up statistics on surgery-related fractures, prosthetic stem perforation, and bone ingrowth

patterns.name: Cardiac thrombus and embolism
patterns.context: Links renal infarction to a left ventricular thrombus source

patterns.name: Dental caries events
patterns.context: Defines caries, filling, or extraction on a tooth surface that was healthy at baseline

patterns.name: Buffer bytes and code
patterns.context: Discusses the state of the fifth byte in a buffer when too few bytes are read

patterns.name: Limb injury narrative
patterns.context: Describes being grabbed, falling, and sustaining bruises
patterns.domain: Legal statements of fact or testimony

patterns.name: JavaScript validation prompt
patterns.context: A code branch displays a prompt that the input must be numeric and returns

10_1661.description: 激活分布于医学尺寸与肿块、手术、骨科及心脏病灶，也见牙科、代码中的字节或数字校验，以及法律伤情叙述；共同触发因素不明确。

patterns.name: 计量单位 cm
patterns.context: 数字或范围后出现，描述尺寸、边界或距离
patterns.domain: 医学论文中的肿块、放疗边界等测量

patterns.name: 数值与小数尺寸
patterns.context: 数字、小数点、乘号或范围与医学测量并列

patterns.name: 医学肿块与病灶
patterns.context: 指人体组织中的肿块、转移灶或病变，常与位置、大小、检查或治疗相邻

patterns.name: 手术及组织处理
patterns.context: 描述手术、切除或术中发现

patterns.name: 骨科并发症与植入物
patterns.context: 随访统计手术相关骨折、假体柄穿孔及骨长入

patterns.name: 心脏血栓及栓塞
patterns.context: 将肾梗死与左心室血栓来源联系起来

patterns.name: 牙科龋病事件
patterns.context: 定义基线原本健康的牙面出现龋损、充填或拔除

patterns.name: 缓冲区字节与代码
patterns.context: 讨论读取字节数不足时缓冲区第五字节的状态

patterns.name: 肢体受伤叙述
patterns.context: 描述被抓、摔倒及身体出现瘀伤

patterns.name: JavaScript 校验提示
patterns.context: 代码分支中弹出输入值必须为数字的提示并返回

en.description: Primarily responds to durations and intervals formed by numerals or quantity words with time units, especially weeks; in legal documents, also covers sentence-initial Approximately…later/after. There is also an independent response to the variable k and its subscripts in mathematical formulas.

patterns.name: Duration or interval in weeks
patterns.context: A numeral, quantity word, or qualifier combines with a time unit to form a duration or interval phrase; strong responses often fall on the time unit, especially week(s), but also occur with minutes, months, and days.
patterns.domain: Legal narratives, personal accounts, forum posts, medical cases, and general narratives

patterns.name: Sentence-initial approximate time marker
patterns.context: In legal documents, a sentence begins with Approximately to introduce elapsed time, followed by later or after to describe a subsequent event.

patterns.name: Variable or index in mathematical notation
patterns.context: k appears in a mathematical formula with a subscript or as an iteration index; it is triggered only within symbolic expressions and differs from natural-language time phrases.

10_1661.description: 主要响应数词或数量词与时间单位构成的时长、间隔，尤其 weeks；法律文书中还覆盖句首 Approximately…later/after。另有数学公式中变量 k 及其下标的独立响应。

patterns.name: 以“周”为单位的时长或间隔
patterns.context: 数词、数量词或限定语与时间单位组成时长/时间间隔短语；强响应常落在时间单位，尤其 week(s)，但也见于 minutes、months、days。
patterns.domain: 法律叙述、个人经历、论坛帖子、医学病例及一般叙述

patterns.name: 句首近似时间标记
patterns.context: 法律文书中，句首以 Approximately 引出经过的时间，再接 later 或 after 描述后续事件。

patterns.name: 数学记号中的变量或指标
patterns.context: 数学公式中出现带下标或作为迭代索引的 k；只在符号表达式内部触发，和自然语言时间短语不同。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学/物理技术文本

en.description: Primarily responds to unit words in time-interval phrases, especially month, week, hour, and minutes; sporadic patterns include mathematical index k, first in programming contexts, the patent distance unit feet, and the medical measurement unit cm.

patterns.name: Conventional time-interval expressions
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on time units and unit words in interval phrases, such as month, months, week, hour, and minutes; the context typically uses after or later to indicate elapsed time since an event, often with a nearby quantity word.
patterns.domain: Narrative writing, including legal narratives, personal accounts, and medical cases

patterns.name: Mathematical iteration index k
patterns.context: The letter k is used as an iteration index in a Newton's method formula and its explanation of iteration values.

patterns.name: HTTP first-save status
patterns.context: In a description of a program issue involving HTTP status code 404 and saving HTML debugging information, first modifies save; activation falls on first.

patterns.name: Distance value
patterns.context: The number 90 and the distance unit feet form a distance expression describing the distance from a line junction to a receiver; strong activation falls on feet.
patterns.domain: Patent technical background, line length and location description

patterns.name: Medical measurement unit cm
patterns.context: cm appears in a numeric measurement of lesion size, preceded by hyphen-separated dimension numbers.

10_1661.description: 主要响应时间间隔短语中的单位词，尤其 month、week、hour、minutes；另有数学索引 k、编程语境中的 first、专利距离单位 feet、医学尺寸单位 cm 等零星模式。

patterns.name: 约定俗成的时间间隔表达
patterns.trigger: “month«10« after»”“« four»3« months»9« later»”“« week»9 after»”“« half»1« an»2« hour»9 later»”“« 50»4« minutes»9« after»”
patterns.context: 激活集中在时间单位及时间间隔短语中的单位词，如 month、months、week、hour、minutes；上下文通常以 after 或 later 表示某事发生后的时长，附近常有数量词。
patterns.domain: 法律叙事、个人叙述及医学病例等叙事文体

patterns.name: 数学迭代索引 k
patterns.context: 字母 k 用作迭代索引，出现在 Newton 方法公式及其迭代取值说明中。

patterns.name: HTTP 首次保存状态
patterns.context: 在描述请求状态码 404、保存 HTML 调试信息的程序问题时，first 修饰 save；激活落在 first。

patterns.name: 距离数值
patterns.context: 数字 90 与距离单位 feet 构成距离表达，描述线路连接点到接收端的距离；高激活落在 feet。
patterns.domain: 专利技术背景，线路长度与位置说明

patterns.name: 医学尺寸单位 cm
patterns.context: cm 出现在病灶尺寸的数字度量表达中，前接连字符分隔的尺寸数字。

en.description: Primarily responds to time expressions between events: a number or quantity word paired with a time unit, followed by later, after, thereafter, or similar words to introduce a subsequent event, especially a specific duration. Also responds to the first save and 404 status in a technical Q&A passage.

patterns.name: Event occurring after some time
patterns.context: A legal, medical, or administrative event is given first, followed by a time-interval marker introducing a subsequent event; emphasis falls on the time unit and words such as later/after/thereafter.
patterns.domain: Primarily legal narratives, with some medical cases and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Numerically expressed time interval
patterns.context: A time quantity pairs with units such as months, years, minutes, or weeks, often in a later/after/thereafter phrase; the number or quantity word receives particularly strong activation.
patterns.domain: Legal documents and medical case narratives

patterns.name: First attempt and error status in a technical process
patterns.context: Describes a program flow for saving or requesting HTML; an error occurs on the first save, followed by mention of a later working attempt; activation falls on first and related ordinal/status expressions.

10_1661.description: 主要响应事件间隔的时间表达：数字或数量词与时间单位相连，并由 later、after、thereafter 等引出后续事件，尤其突出具体时间长度。另在一段技术问答中响应首次保存及 404 状态。

patterns.name: 经过一段时间后发生事件
patterns.trigger: “Approximately four months later”, “A year later”, “More than a year thereafter”, “Approximately one month after”, “Approximately half an hour later”, “Approximately 5 minutes after”, “About two months later”, “more than a year after”, “Approximately three weeks after”
patterns.context: 先给出诉讼、医疗或行政事件，再用时间间隔标记后续事件；突出时间单位及 later/after/thereafter 等词。
patterns.domain: 主要为法律叙述，也有医学病例和技术问答

patterns.name: 数字化的时间间隔
patterns.trigger: “four months”, “A year”, “a year”, “one month”, “half an hour”, “5 minutes”, “two months”, “three weeks”
patterns.context: 时间数量与月份、年份、分钟、星期等单位相连，常处于 later/after/thereafter 短语中；数字或数量词获得特别强的激活。
patterns.domain: 法律文书及医学病例叙述

patterns.name: 技术流程中的首次尝试与错误状态
patterns.context: 描述保存或请求 HTML 的程序流程，错误在首次保存时出现，之后提及可工作的后续尝试；激活落在 first 及相关序数/状态表达上。

en.description: All passages contain time-interval expressions: elapsed time quantified in months, weeks, years, days, or minutes, followed by later/after to introduce a subsequent event; common in legal case timelines and also found in medical cases. Dates and legal or medical facts are frequent accompanying contexts.

patterns.name: After a period of time
patterns.context: Time quantifiers (month/months, week(s), year(s), days) combine with after or later, usually linking an earlier event to a subsequent one; activation concentrates around the time quantifier and the subsequent marker.
patterns.domain: Primarily legal judgment narratives, also medical case narratives

patterns.name: Legal proceedings and factual narrative
patterns.context: Judicial decisions recount proceedings, rulings, or case facts; these often occur alongside time-interval narratives, though not all instances are triggered by legal terminology itself.
patterns.domain: Legal judgments, litigation, and case background

patterns.name: Progression of time after a medical event
patterns.context: In case reports or medical records, elapsed time introduces subsequent treatment, examination, or clinical developments.
patterns.domain: Medical cases and clinical research texts

patterns.name: Dates alongside time quantifiers
patterns.context: In legal narratives, specific dates often follow or accompany time-interval expressions; dates themselves appear to have weaker activation, with the core still centered on temporal progression.

10_1661.description: 所有段落都出现时间间隔表达：以月、周、年、日或分钟量化经过时间，并用 after/later 引出后续事件；多见于法律案件时间线，也见医学病例。日期及法律、医疗事实是常见伴随语境。

patterns.name: 一段时间后
patterns.trigger: «Approximately« one»2« month»10 after»2；«Approximately« four»3« months»10 later»；«Several»2« months»9 later»；«About« two»2« months»9 later»；«Ten»2« months»9 later»；«Two»2« years»9« later»；«A»2« few»4« weeks»10« after»2；«A»2« year»9 later
patterns.context: 时间量词（month/months、week(s)、year(s)、days）与 after 或 later 连用，通常连接先前事件与后续事件；强度集中在时间量词及其后续标记附近。
patterns.domain: 以法律判决叙事为主，也见医学病例叙事

patterns.name: 法律案件程序与事实叙述
patterns.trigger: «genuine»…«issue» of material fact；«exhaustion requirement»；«petition»；«hearing»；«sentenced»；«the property was sold»
patterns.context: 司法判决中叙述程序、裁决或案件事实；常与时间间隔叙述相邻，但并非所有实例都由法律术语本身触发。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、诉讼及案件事实背景

patterns.name: 医学事件后的时间推进
patterns.trigger: «A»« few»« weeks»…« after»；«Several»« minutes»…« after»；«Two»« years»« later»
patterns.context: 病例或医疗记录中，以经过的时间引出治疗、检查或病情后续。
patterns.domain: 医学病例及临床研究文本

patterns.name: 日期与时间量词并列
patterns.context: 在法律叙述中，具体日期常紧随或伴随时间间隔表达；日期本身似有较弱激活，核心仍偏向时间推进表达。

en.concept: Events after a period of time
en.description: All passages contain time intervals expressed by numbers or general quantity words, connecting earlier and later events through later/after or nearby context; days, weeks, and months are common in legal and medical narratives.

patterns.name: Subsequent event after a time interval
patterns.context: An event or time point is stated first, followed by a subsequent event introduced by elapsed time; durations are usually specific numbers, commonly days, weeks, or months.
patterns.domain: Legal judgment narratives and medical case/paper narratives

patterns.name: Time quantifiers in phrases
patterns.context: Specific or general time quantifiers mark the interval between two events; these expressions occur at the start of a sentence or clause and connect the preceding and following narrative.

patterns.name: Numeric markers of time units
patterns.context: A time unit and number jointly express elapsed duration; some examples include “30 months” followed by “after,” or a time quantifier separated from “later.”

10_1661.concept: 经过一段时间后的事件
10_1661.description: 所有片段都出现以数字或概括量词表示的时间间隔，并以 later/after 或邻近上下文连接前后事件；常见 days、weeks、months，见于法律与医学叙事。

patterns.name: 时间间隔后续事件
patterns.trigger: 数字时间单位后接 “later” 或 “after”，尤其是 “weeks/months/days ... later/after”
patterns.context: 先陈述某事件或时间点，再用经过一段时间引出后续事件；时长通常是具体数字，常见 days、weeks、months。
patterns.domain: 法律判决叙事与医学病例/论文叙事

patterns.name: 短语中的时间量词
patterns.trigger: “A few weeks” （[1]）、“A few days” （[4]）、“Four days” （[6]）、“Three days” （[7]）、“Several months” （[8]）、“Ten months” （[9]）、“Two days” （[10]）
patterns.context: 具体或概括的时间量词标记两事件间隔；这些表达处于句首或分句开头，连接前后叙事。

patterns.name: 时间单位的数值标记
patterns.context: 时间单位与数字共同表示经过的时长；个别例子如 “30 months” 后接 “after”，或时间量词与 “later” 分开出现。

en.description: Most passages narrate elapsed time and subsequent events, with strong activation near duration words and later/prior; a recipe example involving “no pockets of flour” is also present, with no clear common trigger between the two.

patterns.name: Delayed-time expressions
patterns.context: A time interval or relative-time word is followed by an event, course of illness, or narrative development; often occurs at the start of a sentence or clause, with activation concentrated around time quantifiers (such as “days,” “minutes,” “months,” “weeks”) and “later/prior.”
patterns.domain: Narrative texts such as medical cases, legal judgments, and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Quantity units after a time interval
patterns.context: A numeral and time unit express elapsed duration, especially when followed by “after/later” or a change of events; the first passage’s “one last message” may also relate to a subsequent event after an interval, but is not a standard time quantifier.
patterns.domain: Medical and legal narratives, technical Q&A

patterns.name: Negative quantity phrase in baking instructions
patterns.context: A recipe instruction says not to leave pockets of unmixed flour in the dough; activation falls near “pockets.”

10_1661.description: 多数段落在叙述经过的时间及其后续事件，强激活落在时长词和 later/prior 附近；另有食谱中“no pockets of flour”的孤例，二者缺少明确共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 延迟时间表达
patterns.trigger: “After a short while”“Three days after”“Five minutes later”“Several months later”“A few weeks later”“Two years later”“Six months postoperatively”“Three months prior”
patterns.context: 时间间隔或相对时间词后接事件、病程或叙述进展；常出现在句首或从句中，激活集中在时间量词（如“days”“minutes”“months”“weeks”）及“later/prior”附近。
patterns.domain: 医学病例、法律判决、技术问答等叙述性文本

patterns.name: 时间间隔后的数量单位
patterns.context: 数词和时间单位构成经过时长，尤其是随后出现“after/later”或事件变化；第1段“one last message”也可能与间隔后的后续事件有关，但不是标准时间量词。
patterns.domain: 医学与法律叙述、技术问答

patterns.name: 烘焙步骤中的否定数量搭配
patterns.context: 食谱操作句中，no 后接 pockets，随后说明面团中不应残留面粉团块；触发落在“pockets”附近。

en.description: The clearest signals are months and short time/while in time expressions, as well as first indicating the start of a sequence; “no pockets of flour” in a recipe also occurs. Triggers span medical, legal, programming, and everyday narratives, with some co-occurrences or boundaries uncertain.

patterns.name: Time expressions in months
patterns.context: In clinical courses, treatment outcomes, or legal timelines, expresses the number of months elapsed or an event occurring months later.

patterns.name: Short time later
patterns.context: Introduces a subsequent event occurring soon after something; passage 2 also has “a short while” followed by a message being printed.

patterns.name: First item or event after first
patterns.context: Describes the earliest item in a sequence, an event occurring for the first time, or the first delimiter encountered while parsing input. First occurs across contexts, but its syntax and meaning are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Pockets of residue in a mixture
patterns.context: An instruction for mixing dough says not to leave clumps of unmixed flour.

patterns.name: Month suffix within a compound
patterns.context: Passage 1 contains both a calendar month and months indicating a follow-up interval; activation is concentrated on months, though the calendar-month portion also activates.

patterns.name: Other unclear triggers
patterns.context: Some activation positions do not match the time-expression or first patterns; the specific trigger cannot be determined from these excerpts alone.

10_1661.description: 最突出的线索是时间表达中的 months、short time/while，以及表示序列起点的 first；另有食谱中 no pockets of flour。触发跨医学、法律、编程与日常叙述，部分共现或边界不确定。

patterns.name: 月数时间表达
patterns.trigger: 「months」或「months later」前的数字修饰，如「30 months」「Several months」「4 months」「2 months」
patterns.context: 临床过程、治疗结局或法律事件的时间线中，表示经过的月数或事件发生于数月之后。

patterns.name: 短时间后
patterns.trigger: 「A short time after」「After a short while」及其中的「short」「time」「while」
patterns.context: 叙述某事发生后不久出现的后续事件；段2也有「a short while」后接消息打印。

patterns.name: first 后的首项或首次事件
patterns.trigger: 「first」及其相邻对象，如「the first ,」「the first time」「the first save」「the first char」「first colored」「first level」
patterns.context: 描述序列中最早的一项、首次发生的事件，或解析输入时遇到的第一个分隔符。不同语境都出现 first，但句法和含义并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 混合物中的残留口袋
patterns.context: 搅拌面团时要求不要留下未混匀的面粉团块。

patterns.name: 复合词内部的月份词尾
patterns.trigger: 「... and October 2014, showed ... Finally, 30 months after ...」中的「October」及「months」
patterns.context: 段1同时含日期月份和表示随访间隔的 months；突出表现集中在 months，但日期月份部分也有激活。

patterns.name: 其他不明触发
patterns.trigger: 未能从所给片段中可靠确定
patterns.context: 存在与时间表达或 first 模式不一致的激活位置；仅凭这些截取上下文不足以判定其具体触发条件。

en.description: Activation concentrates on temporal order and stage expressions: after several months/years, first occurrence, and a few uses of last/next indicating a next step or final occurrence; the time-interval pattern is most prominent.

patterns.name: Numeral with months
patterns.context: Describes elapsed time after an event, often in the structure numeral + time unit + later/after; also includes “4 months after”
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, legal judgments, and procedural narratives

patterns.name: Ordinal first
patterns.context: Describes the first occurrence, input, save, or event; usually occurs near an error or problem description

patterns.name: Directive word in a comment
patterns.context: In a robots.txt example comment, instructs the reader to uncomment to disallow all crawlers

patterns.name: Last in a timing context
patterns.context: After a program runs for a short time, states that it will print one final message

10_1661.description: 激活集中于时间顺序与阶段表达：经过若干月/年后、首次发生，以及少量指示下一步或最终一次的 last/next；时间间隔模式最突出。

patterns.name: 月份数词
patterns.trigger: “months”前面的数词，如 “4 months”“Several months”“30 months”“Two years”（同属时长表达）“Ten months”“four months”；激活峰值多落在数词“months”上
patterns.context: 叙述某事件发生后经过一段时间，常见结构为数词＋时间单位＋later/after；也包括“4 months after”等
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、法律判决与程序叙述

patterns.name: 序数词 first
patterns.trigger: “first”，如 “the first char”“the first time”“the first save”
patterns.context: 描述首次出现、输入、保存或发生的情况；通常与错误或问题叙述相邻

patterns.name: 注释中的指令词
patterns.trigger: “uncomment the next two lines”中的“next two”
patterns.context: robots.txt 示例注释中，指示解除注释以禁止所有爬虫
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码与配置文件注释

patterns.name: 计时语境中的 last
patterns.context: 程序运行一小段时间后，说明最终还会打印一条消息

en.description: Primarily responds to expressions describing subsequent events after a period of time, especially several months later; also appears with short intervals, timing around accidents, and ordinal instructions such as “next two lines.”

patterns.name: Events after a time interval
patterns.context: Describes several months passing after an initial event, followed by an outcome, change, or subsequent action; numbers and time units are often near the activation position.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, legal documents, and narrative Q&A

patterns.name: Other narratives following a time interval
patterns.context: Uses a duration or time point to mark event order; need not involve “months,” but still organizes the narrative around time intervals or relative time.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, martial arts accounts, legal accident narratives, and medical cases

patterns.name: Ordinal instruction in a configuration comment
patterns.context: In a robots.txt example comment, tells the reader to uncomment the next line; activation falls near “next.”

10_1661.description: 主要响应表示经过一段时间后（尤其是若干个月后）发生后续事件的时间表达；也见于短暂间隔、事故前后时间及“next two lines”这类序数指令。

patterns.name: 时间间隔后发生的事件
patterns.trigger: “months”前的数字及“months”后的“after”或“later”，如“30 months after”“4 months after”“Several months later”“four months later”“Ten months later”
patterns.context: 在描述某个起始事件之后经过数月，接着叙述结果、变化或后续行动；数字和时间单位常位于激活位置附近。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、法律文书及叙事性问答

patterns.name: 其他时间间隔后的叙事
patterns.trigger: “A short while”“A short time”“Minutes before”“A year later”
patterns.context: 以时长或时间点标记事件的先后顺序；未必涉及“months”，仍以时间间隔或相对时间组织叙事。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、武术经历、事故法律叙述、医学病例

patterns.name: 配置注释中的序数指令
patterns.context: 在 robots.txt 示例注释中，指示读者接下来要取消注释的行；激活落在“next”附近。
patterns.domain: GitHub 技术文档／代码注释

en.concept: Character fragments and boundaries in structured text
en.description: Activations occur across numbers, decimals, dates, and tabular values, as well as abbreviations, Czech subword fragments, technical titles, and line breaks or spacing in emails and legal documents; no single stable semantic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: Numbers and results in math problems
patterns.context: Activations occur near numbers or answers in math questions involving conversions, comparisons, rounding, and similar operations; often accompanied by line breaks

patterns.name: Numeric columns in tables
patterns.context: Tables or lists are arranged in columns, with many spaces and line breaks between numbers

patterns.name: Dates and date separators
patterns.context: Dates are embedded in post metadata or email timestamps

patterns.name: Identifiers mixing letters and numbers
patterns.context: Letters and numbers alternate in structured text such as uppercase abbreviations, underscore-separated identifiers, or regulation numbers
patterns.domain: Email fields, legal texts, and institutional directories

patterns.name: Czech subword fragments with diacritics
patterns.context: In line-break-separated phrases or titles, activations fall on letters with diacritics and adjacent subword fragments

patterns.name: Numbers and training words in short forum posts
patterns.context: A conversational question is followed by metadata such as a posting date; activations also involve line breaks

patterns.name: Names and formatting boundaries in email
patterns.context: Formatting boundaries where the email body transitions to a signature, address, and timestamp

patterns.name: Technical term blocks in titles
patterns.context: Several technical terms appear consecutively in titles introducing institutional projects

patterns.name: Legal headings and whitespace alignment
patterns.context: Court names, party/judge information, and legal citations are spaced for alignment

10_1745.concept: 结构化文本中的字符片段与边界
10_1745.description: 激活分布在数字、小数、日期和表格数值，也出现在缩写标识符、捷克语词片段、专业标题及邮件或法律文书的换行、空格排版处；未见单一稳定的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 数学题中的数字与结果
patterns.context: 出现在换算、比较大小、四舍五入等数学问答中，数字或答案附近激活；常伴随换行

patterns.name: 数字表格中的数值列
patterns.context: 表格或列表按列排布，数字间有大量空格与换行

patterns.name: 日期及日期分隔符
patterns.context: 日期嵌在帖子元数据或邮件时间戳中

patterns.name: 英文字母与数字混合的标识符
patterns.context: 大写缩写、下划线或法规编号等结构化文本中，字母数字交替出现
patterns.domain: 邮件字段、法律文本及机构目录

patterns.name: 捷克语带变音符号的词片段
patterns.context: 换行分隔的短语或标题中，激活落在带变音符号的字母及其相邻子词片段

patterns.name: 论坛短帖中的数字与训练词
patterns.context: 口语提问后接发帖日期等元数据；激活也涉及换行

patterns.name: 电子邮件中的人名与排版边界
patterns.context: 邮件正文转入署名、地址和时间戳的格式边界处

patterns.name: 标题中的专业术语词块
patterns.trigger: “Molecular Genetics and Epigenetics”“Microarray and Molecular Biology”
patterns.context: 机构项目介绍标题中，多个专业名词连续出现

patterns.name: 法律抬头及空白对齐
patterns.context: 法院名称、当事人/法官信息与法律引用以空格排版

en.description: Activations are scattered across within-word subword fragments, proper names, abbreviations, and identifiers; localized activations also occur in email formulae and contact language, and medical terminology. There is no unified semantic or stylistic trigger across corpora.

patterns.name: Subword fragments of specific names or word forms
patterns.context: Activations fall on specific subword fragments within names, words, or identifiers; sometimes different fragments of the same word activate consecutively, and fragment boundaries do not align with morphemes or conventional word boundaries.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: parliamentary texts, encyclopedia entries, code identifiers, general text

patterns.name: Abbreviations and uppercase alphanumeric strings
patterns.context: Occurs in all-caps abbreviations, underscore-separated identifiers, or alphanumeric strings; surrounding context provides no stable semantic explanation for the activations.
patterns.domain: Email, institutional names or place-name abbreviations, technical texts

patterns.name: Formulaic fragments in formal correspondence
patterns.context: Sentences in formal emails referencing a memo or attachment; activations concentrate on sentence-initial formulae and nearby words.

patterns.name: Contact information in email
patterns.context: A prompt to contact someone and phone number information follow FYI; several ordinary words also activate, possibly reflecting local word fragments or formatting.

patterns.name: Hyphenated or within-word medical term fragments
patterns.context: Multiple subword fragments activate consecutively within the medical term “mucopolysaccharidoses”; the abbreviation MPS in parentheses does not show equally prominent activation.

10_1745.concept: 特定子词片段与字符串
10_1745.description: 激活分散于词内子词片段、专名、缩写及标识符；邮件套语和联络语、医学术语也出现局部激活。跨语料缺少统一的语义或文体触发条件。

patterns.name: 特殊名称或词形的子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在名称、词语或标识符内部的特定子词片段上；有时同一词的不同片段连续激活，且片段边界与词素或常规词边界不一致。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：议会文本、百科条目、代码标识符、一般文本

patterns.name: 缩写及大写字母数字串
patterns.context: 出现在全大写缩写、下划线分隔标识符或字母数字串中；周围没有足以解释激活的稳定语义上下文。
patterns.domain: 邮件、机构名称或地名缩写、技术文本

patterns.name: 正式信函的套语片段
patterns.context: 正式邮件中引用备忘录或附件的句子；激活集中在句首套语及其附近词语。

patterns.name: 邮件中的联络信息
patterns.context: FYI 后提供联系某人的提示以及电话号码信息；多个普通词也有激活，可能反映局部词片段或格式。

patterns.name: 连字符或词内医学术语片段
patterns.context: 在医学名词“mucopolysaccharidoses”内部多个子词片段连续激活，括号中的缩写 MPS 未见同等突出的激活。
patterns.domain: NIH 医学/生物医学文本

en.description: Activations occur in email memos, symbols and values in mathematical formulas, source-code comment markers, tokenized fragments of encyclopedia proper names, and title terms. Triggers differ markedly across examples, with no unified semantic or syntactic feature evident.

patterns.name: Memo reference in email
patterns.context: Formal email phrasing mentions the sender’s earlier memo, a date, and an attachment; activation falls on memo.

patterns.name: Symbols and operations in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: In dense polynomial/algebraic expressions, activations are scattered around asterisks, variables, exponents, and numbers; math-question terms such as «derivative», «wrt», and «Find» also occur in nearby text, but not all activation points fall on these words.

patterns.name: Code comments and file headers
patterns.context: Located at the start of a comment after a line break, followed by a library name or copyright information; strong activation is clearly concentrated on the comment marker.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments of specific proper names
patterns.context: Proper names in encyclopedia-style line-broken text; activations concentrate at word beginnings and several internal subword fragments, with no clear semantic category shared across names.

patterns.name: Term tokenization and repeated title
patterns.context: The complete phrase “Augmented learning” reappears after a line break in a title or section heading; the fragments of each word at its first occurrence activate strongly.

10_1745.description: 激活分布在邮件中的memo、数学公式的符号和数值、源码注释起始符、百科专名的分词片段及标题术语。各处触发条件差异明显，未见统一的语义或句法特征。

patterns.name: 邮件备忘录引用
patterns.context: 正式邮件句式，提及本人先前备忘录及日期、附件；激活落在 memo。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的符号与运算
patterns.trigger: «*»、«**»、变量字母如 «r»、«q»、«n»、«f»，以及运算符和数字
patterns.context: 密集多项式/代数式中，激活分散在星号、变量、指数及数字附近；数学问句（如 «derivative»、«wrt»、«Find»）也出现在相邻文本，但并非所有激活点都落在这些词上。
patterns.domain: 数学题目及符号化表达

patterns.name: 代码注释与文件头
patterns.context: 位于换行后的注释开头，后接库名或版权信息；强激活明确集中在注释标记。

patterns.name: 特定专名的分词片段
patterns.context: 百科条目式换行内容中的专名，激活集中在词首及若干内部子词片段；不同名称不构成明显语义类别。
patterns.domain: 英文 Wikipedia 专名条目

patterns.name: 术语分词与重复标题
patterns.context: 标题或小节名中完整短语“Augmented learning”换行后再次出现；首次出现的各个词片段激活较强。
patterns.domain: 英文 Wikipedia 条目标题

en.concept: Directly addressing the reader and several word-form fragments
en.description: Primarily activates on your when directly addressing the reader; also responds to lipopolysaccharide/LPS subwords in medical contexts, the word-initial P-iv fragment, a few within-word subwords, and line breaks.

patterns.name: Second-person possessive your
patterns.context: Directly addresses the recipient or reader, referring to their schedule, judgment, approval, food, location, or circumstances; no specific sentence structure is required.
patterns.domain: Business email, forum advice, web copy, and general explanatory prose

patterns.name: Medical term lipopolysaccharide/LPS
patterns.context: Discusses endotoxin, sepsis, or lipopolysaccharide in experiments; the word is split into multiple subword tokens, and related subwords activate.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers and NIH research applications

patterns.name: Beginning of the P-iv string
patterns.context: The word begins with P followed by an iv subword; one is a Czech word and the other an English proper name/word, with different contexts and meanings.
patterns.domain: European Parliament texts, web pages, or company descriptions

patterns.name: Miscellaneous words and formatting triggers
patterns.context: Seen only in isolated contexts; may involve within-word subwords or line breaks and other local forms, with insufficient evidence to infer a shared semantic condition.

10_1745.concept: 直接称呼读者及若干词形片段
10_1745.description: 主要对直接称呼读者的 your 激活；另对医学语境中的 lipopolysaccharide/LPS 子词、词首 P-iv 片段，以及少数词内子词和换行有响应。

patterns.name: 第二人称所有格 your
patterns.trigger: «your»，以及与其相邻的内容，如「your *anticipated* schedules」「your approval」「your situation」
patterns.context: 直接称呼收件人或读者，指其日程、判断、批准、食物、所在地或处境；不要求特定句式。
patterns.domain: 商务邮件、论坛建议、网页文案及一般说明文

patterns.name: lipopolysaccharide/LPS 医学术语
patterns.context: 讨论内毒素、败血症或实验中的脂多糖；词被拆成多个子词 token，相关子词激活。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与 NIH 研究申请

patterns.name: P-iv 字符串开头
patterns.context: 词首由 P 与后续 iv 子词构成；一个是捷克语词，一个是英语专名/词，语境和含义不同。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本、网页或公司介绍

patterns.name: 杂项词语与排版触发
patterns.context: 仅见于个别上下文；可能涉及词内子词或换行等局部形式，没有足够证据归纳出共同语义条件。

en.description: The main pattern is the biochemical term “amino acid(s),” appearing across papers and contexts involving genes, proteins, and extraction; there are also bile/bile-acid-related terms and a comment about grip and wet starts.

patterns.name: The phrase amino acid
patterns.context: Scientific text contains “amino acid(s)” or modified or possessive forms; the phrase can trigger in various syntactic positions.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, molecular biology, and biochemistry papers

patterns.name: Bile-related terms
patterns.context: Biliary tract, bile acids, and related experimental or disease contexts; activation also covers nearby words.

patterns.name: High-grip description
patterns.context: Describes hard launches, rolling starts, and grip in wet conditions.

10_1745.description: 主模式是“amino acid(s)”这一生化术语，跨论文及基因、蛋白质、提取等语境出现；另有胆汁/胆汁酸相关术语，以及一段关于抓地力和湿地起步的评论。

patterns.name: amino acid短语
patterns.context: 科学文本中出现“amino acid(s)”或其修饰、所有格形式；该短语在多种句法位置均可触发。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、分子生物学及生化论文

patterns.name: 胆汁相关术语
patterns.trigger: «bile»，尤其“bile duct”“bile acids”“bile acid fed”“bile fistula”
patterns.context: 胆道、胆汁酸及其相关实验或疾病语境；激活还覆盖邻近词。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与研究计划

patterns.name: 高抓地力描述
patterns.trigger: «grip»、«hard»，以及«rolling»、«wet»；谈及 MPSS 轮胎/装备的抓地与起步表现
patterns.context: 描述硬起步、滚动起步及湿地条件下的抓地力。
patterns.domain: 非正式产品体验或评论

en.description: Most passages activate on wet, wetting, or related phrases, spanning wet surfaces, environments, materials, food, and tissue weight in different senses; there are also an alliterative phrase and an isolated strong activation on Taking.

patterns.name: wet / wetting expressions
patterns.context: “wet” or one of its word forms appears as a local descriptor of conditions, surface state, material capability, food, concrete, or tissue weight; its meaning varies across contexts.
patterns.domain: Product reviews, patents, encyclopedia entries, narrative, food reviews, medical papers

patterns.name: wet in fixed phrases
patterns.context: wet combines with a coordinated adjective or following noun in a phrase; examples include alliterative phrases, environmental conditions, and food noun phrases.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia text, patent background, food reviews

patterns.name: An anomalous passage with activation unrelated to wet
patterns.context: In an isolated, title-like phrase, activation falls on the sentence-initial Taking; no obvious wet word form is present, and there is insufficient context to explain its connection to the other passages.

10_1745.description: 多数段落在 wet、wetting 或相关短语处激活，覆盖湿润表面、环境、材料、食品及组织重量等不同含义；另有押头韵短语和孤立的 Taking 高激活。

patterns.name: wet / wetting 表达
patterns.context: “wet”或其词形作为局部描述词出现：修饰条件、表面状态、材料能力、食品、混凝土或组织重量；不同语境下语义并不相同。
patterns.domain: 产品评论、专利、百科、叙事、食品评论、医学论文

patterns.name: 固定搭配中的 wet
patterns.context: wet 与并列形容词或后续名词构成短语；其中包括押头韵短语、环境条件和食品名词短语。
patterns.domain: 百科文字、专利背景、食品评论

patterns.name: 激活不依赖 wet 的异常片段
patterns.context: 孤立标题式短语中，激活落在句首 Taking；未见明显 wet 词形，也缺乏足够上下文解释其与其他段的联系。

en.description: Strong activations occur in texts about food processing and nutrition, weight loss, fat metabolism, chemical preparations, and biomedical testing; individual triggers include the specialized phrases poppy seeds, processability, and rumen fluid, with no unified lexical pattern evident.

patterns.name: Texture and seeds in baked goods
patterns.context: A cake description mentions seeds distributed evenly, or the flavor or texture of the outer layer

patterns.name: Nutrition, processing, and calories
patterns.context: Discusses how food processing affects nutrient density, or reducing calories to manage weight
patterns.domain: Nutrition and weight-loss advice; forum and web text

patterns.name: Weight loss and metabolism promotion
patterns.context: Links supplements or increased metabolic rate to weight loss and calorie burning

patterns.name: Diet, fat, and sports nutrition
patterns.context: Discusses digestion of dietary fat, protein, and carbohydrates, or fatty-acid synthesis and experimental diets
patterns.domain: Sports nutrition advice and biomedical abstracts

patterns.name: Technical chemical names and materials
patterns.context: Chemical components or polymers in patents or drug texts, or the dried form of a pharmaceutical preparation

patterns.name: Biomedical test samples
patterns.context: Describes endotoxin testing, spike recovery, and serum or rumen-fluid samples

patterns.name: Flour improvement and dough processing
patterns.context: Explains that reducing agents break gluten disulfide bonds, thereby improving the processability of tortilla dough

10_1745.description: 强激活分布于食品加工与营养、减重、脂肪代谢、化学制剂和生物医学检测等文本；个别触发点是 poppy seeds、加工性及瘤胃液等专门词组，未见统一词面模式。

patterns.name: 烘焙食品的口感与籽粒
patterns.context: 描述蛋糕时，提及籽粒均匀分布、外层风味或口感

patterns.name: 营养与加工、热量
patterns.trigger: «processing»6« … «reduces»6« the»3« nutrient»4« density»2；«sugar»2« and»9« oil»2；«calorie»3« consumption»2
patterns.context: 讨论食物加工影响营养密度，或减少热量以控制体重
patterns.domain: 营养、减重建议；论坛与网页文本

patterns.name: 减重与代谢宣传
patterns.context: 将补充剂或提高代谢率与减重、燃烧热量联系起来

patterns.name: 饮食、脂肪与运动营养
patterns.context: 讨论膳食脂肪、蛋白质和碳水化合物的消化，或脂肪酸合成及实验饮食
patterns.domain: 运动营养建议与生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 技术性化学名称与材料
patterns.context: 专利或药物文本中的化学组分、聚合物，或药剂干燥形态

patterns.name: 生物医学检测样本
patterns.context: 描述内毒素检测、加标回收率及血清或瘤胃液样本

patterns.name: 面粉改良与面团加工
patterns.context: 说明还原剂打断谷蛋白二硫键，从而改善玉米饼面团的加工性

en.concept: Degree descriptions of technical and operational conditions
en.description: Covers operations such as heating and mixing in recipes, as well as patent descriptions of formulations, materials, processes, performance limits, and improvements; patent passages often emphasize degree or technical conditions, but no single clear term explains all activations.

patterns.name: Cooking steps and ingredient preparation
patterns.context: Sequential operations, timing, and heating conditions in recipes or cooking instructions

patterns.name: Technical effects and limitations in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: Describes material, process, or product performance, conditions, defects, and improvements, often with modifiers of degree

patterns.name: High degree or extreme properties
patterns.context: Emphasizes quantity, degree, performance, or effect in technical prose; this is not a fixed lexical trigger on its own

patterns.name: Food formulations and processing properties
patterns.context: Discusses food ingredients, texture, fat phases, or starch processing; appears in patent descriptions

patterns.name: Coatings and coating structures
patterns.context: Lists coating layers and describes properties of coating systems

patterns.name: Fluid materials and voltage conditions
patterns.context: Compares the responses of two types of fluids to temperature, impurities, or voltage

patterns.name: Detergents and fabric care
patterns.context: Introduces laundry compositions and their protective effects during washing

10_1745.concept: 技术与操作条件的程度描述
10_1745.description: 涵盖食谱中的加热、混合等操作，以及专利文本对配方、材料、工艺、性能限制和改进效果的描述；专利段常强调高低程度或技术条件，但没有单一明确词项解释全部激活。

patterns.name: 烹饪步骤与食材处理
patterns.trigger: “Mix one part powder into…”, “Microwave… boil”, “Heat… oil”, “Toast… skins begin to blacken”
patterns.context: 食谱或烹饪说明中的顺序操作、时间和加热状态

patterns.name: 专利背景中的技术效果与限制
patterns.trigger: “requires very high levels”, “great amount of time and cost”, “particularly low coat thicknesses”, “excessive impact”, “low melting point”, “high degree of stable aeration”, “high voltage”, “high shear mechanical action”, “improved protection”
patterns.context: 描述材料、工艺或产品的性能、条件、缺陷及改进效果，常伴随程度修饰语

patterns.name: 高程度或极值性质
patterns.trigger: “very high”, “great”, “low… thicknesses”, “excessive”, “high… stable aeration”, “high voltage”, “high shear”, “improved”
patterns.context: 技术叙述中对数量、程度、性能或效果作强调；单独看并非固定词汇触发

patterns.name: 食品配方与加工性质
patterns.context: 讨论食品配料、质构、脂肪相或淀粉加工；出现于专利说明

patterns.name: 涂层与涂装结构
patterns.context: 列举涂层层次并说明涂装系统性质

patterns.name: 流体材料及电压条件
patterns.trigger: “ER fluids”, “MR fluids”, “high voltage”, “lower voltage power supply”
patterns.context: 比较两类流体对温度、杂质或电压的响应

patterns.name: 洗涤剂与织物护理
patterns.context: 介绍洗衣组合物及其洗涤中的保护效果

en.description: Responds to physical properties and changes in materials and surfaces: strength, elasticity, texture, skinning, wear, bending failure, as well as heating and cooling, shaping, and formulation processing; also includes less-related examples involving hair care and recipes.

patterns.name: Material tensile properties
patterns.context: Describes tensile strength, extensibility, or elasticity of materials such as collagen, latex, and dough, and factors affecting them

patterns.name: Surface texture and shaping
patterns.context: Describes textures, skins, or granular effects formed on materials or surfaces, and their treatment

patterns.name: Heating, cooling, and temperature
patterns.context: Explains how heating or changes in ambient temperature affect materials, mixtures, or construction processes

patterns.name: Bending fatigue and wear
patterns.context: Repeated friction or bending causes edge wear, material aging, or structural failure

patterns.name: Skin or surface care
patterns.context: Mentions caring for the underlying skin when styling hair, or skinning of a coating product; the specific meanings differ

patterns.name: Manufacturing process and tools

en.concept: ards character fragments and sporadic subword features
en.description: The clearest recurring feature is activation on the ards fragment in multiple words; other sporadic patterns include word-internal fragments, numbers and punctuation, and the code constant FILTER. Activation occurs across multiple domains and cannot be explained by a single semantic topic.

patterns.name: Word-final fragments containing ards
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ards letter fragment inside complete words or phrases; the preceding word and capitalization vary, and may be a complete word or a compound identifier.
patterns.domain: Web text, paper metadata, code, email

patterns.name: Specific letter fragments within words
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across several discontinuous letter fragments within words; apart from Tow/ards, there is no clear semantic or lexical condition consistently associated with the ards pattern.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, research papers, and medical abstracts

patterns.name: Numbers and punctuation
patterns.context: Activation appears near local numbers, periods, hyphens, or operators; there is insufficient evidence for a shared contextual condition.

patterns.name: FILTER in code
patterns.context: In an OpenGL constant identifier, activation is concentrated on the final part of FILTER.

patterns.name: Unexplained sporadic fragments
patterns.context: Appears in license addresses and email body text, difficult to form a stable pattern with other activation locations.

10_1774.concept: ards 字符片段及零散子词特征
10_1774.description: 最清晰的重复特征是对多个词中的 ards 片段激活；另有词内片段、数字和标点、代码常量 FILTER 等零散模式。多种领域中均有激活，无法由单一语义主题解释。

patterns.name: 包含 ards 的词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活落在完整单词或词组内部的 ards 字母片段；片段前的词及大小写不同，可能是完整单词，也可能是复合标识符。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、论文元数据、代码、邮件

patterns.name: 单词内部的特定字母片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在词内的若干不连续字母片段；除 Tow/ards 外，与 ards 模式没有明显一致的语义或词法条件。
patterns.domain: 百科、科研论文及医学摘要

patterns.name: 序号与标点字符
patterns.context: 局部数字、句点、连字符或运算符附近出现激活；没有足够证据说明共同上下文条件。

patterns.name: 代码中的 FILTER

patterns.name: 解释不明的零散片段

en.concept: Word-initial Under, Sex, and reproductive vocabulary
en.description: Activation is concentrated on two distinct word beginnings: Under (including the complete word Understanding, and also Under natural) and Sex (including Sex work, Sex and gender, Sex pheromone); there is also one instance of sperm. patterns.name: Under-initial words and internal segmentation
patterns.context: “Under/Understanding” at the start of a sentence or title. [2]–[5] contain the complete word Understanding; in [1], Under is followed by natural and cannot be interpreted as Understanding.

patterns.name: Sex-initial words
patterns.context: Sex begins a title or phrase and is followed by different nouns or conjunctions; in [10], it combines with phe to form pheromone.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia titles, biomedical abstracts, and gender/sexual health texts

patterns.name: sperm in biology
patterns.context: Appears in “Preserved sperm in a shrimp,” describing sperm preserved inside a shrimp.

10_1774.concept: 词首 Under、Sex 及生殖词汇
10_1774.description: 激活集中于两个不同的词首：Under（含完整词 Understanding，也见 Under natural）和 Sex（含 Sex work、Sex and gender、Sex pheromone）；另有一例 sperm。整体涉及生物医学与生物学文本。

patterns.name: Under 开头及词内切分

patterns.name: Sex 词首

patterns.name: 生物学中的 sperm

en.concept: Mathematical formulas and structured text fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to dense numbers, operators, variable powers, function definitions, evaluation, and differentiation instructions in DM Mathematics problems; there are also two isolated activations: a Sudakov fragment in a paper title and an uppercase transaction-record marker.

patterns.name: Numbers and operators in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Inside or adjacent to symbolic mathematical expressions, especially polynomials, powers, and arithmetic expressions.

patterns.name: Function definitions and substitution-style problems
patterns.context: A function or variable definition is introduced with Let, followed by an expression, often with a request to Give or Calculate a function value or expression.

patterns.name: Instruction words in math problems
patterns.context: Appears after a formula to introduce an evaluation, calculation, or differentiation request.

patterns.name: Negative-coefficient polynomials and powers
patterns.context: A minus sign alternates with coefficients and variable powers in polynomial definitions or expressions.

patterns.name: Complex fractions and positive-value conditions
patterns.context: An assumption that variables are positive follows nested fractions and exponential expressions.

patterns.name: Differentiation instructions
patterns.context: Explicitly requests differentiation with respect to a specified variable, immediately following the expression to be differentiated.

patterns.name: Formulas continued across lines in math problems
patterns.context: Definitions, hints, or answer formulas in math problems continue across lines.

patterns.name: Scholar name in a paper title
patterns.context: After a backslash and line break, a paper title fragment beginning with On and containing the name Sudakov appears.

patterns.name: Transaction-record marker
patterns.context: A transaction-start marker or transaction-type fragment composed of uppercase fields.
patterns.domain: Structured financial text in Enron email

10_1774.concept: 数学公式与结构化文本片段

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的数字与运算符

patterns.name: 函数定义与代入题式
