patterns.name: 数学题目指令词
patterns.context: 出现在公式之后，引出求值、计算或求导要求。

patterns.name: 负系数多项式与幂
patterns.context: 多项式定义或运算式中，负号和系数、变量幂交替出现。

patterns.name: 复杂分式与正值条件
patterns.context: 嵌套分数和指数表达式后，附带变量为正的假设。

patterns.name: 求导指令
patterns.context: 明确要求对指定变量求导，前面紧接待求导表达式。

patterns.name: 数学题中跨行公式续接
patterns.context: 数学题的定义、提示或答案公式跨行延续。

patterns.name: 论文标题中的学者姓名
patterns.context: 反斜线与换行之后，出现以 On 开始、包含 Sudakov 姓名的论文标题片段。

patterns.name: 交易记录标记
patterns.context: 大写字段构成的交易开始标记或交易类型片段。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的结构化金融文本

en.description: The strongest shared trigger is “She” at the beginning of a sentence or paragraph, often opening a narrative with a female subject; a few activations occur inside the names “Sheri” and the string “Sheeda,” where the spelling is the same but the fragment is not a pronoun.

patterns.name: “She” at the beginning of a paragraph or sentence
patterns.context: The pronoun “She” appears at the beginning of a sentence or new paragraph, followed by a predicate; it is sometimes preceded by a line start, paragraph break, or list item. In most examples it is immediately followed by “She is/was/has/played/posed…”, but examples also include a code string and a poem.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: encyclopedia biographies, legal narratives, medical case reports, email, code, and poetry

patterns.name: “She” string in a name or word
patterns.context: “She” is not an independent pronoun, but a character fragment within a proper name; it appears in an email recipient name and a string value in code.

10_1774.description: 最强共同触发是句首或段首的“She”，常作为女性主语开启叙述；少数激活落在姓名“Sheri”和字符串“Sheeda”的内部，表面拼写相同但并非代词。

patterns.name: 段首或句首的“She”
patterns.context: 代词“She”位于句首或新段落开头，后接谓语；有时前面是行首、段落换行或列表项。多数例子中紧接“She is/was/has/played/posed…”，但也包括代码字符串及诗句中的“She”。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：百科人物简介、法律叙述、医学病例、邮件、代码及诗句

patterns.name: 姓名或词内的“She”字符串
patterns.context: “She”并非独立代词，而是专名内部的字符片段；出现在邮件收件人姓名和代码中的字符串值。
patterns.domain: 邮件元数据；StackExchange 编程文本

en.concept: Prominent word fragments at text beginnings
en.description: Activation is concentrated on words or name fragments at the beginnings of several texts (Mil, Elizabeth, Edouard, Nanoscale), with another instance on numbers and operators in a mathematical expression; the shared feature is weak.

patterns.name: Mil-initial word or name
patterns.context: A word or proper name beginning with Mil, followed by a comma, a person’s name, or a phrase; the subsequent content in [1] is fragmentary, making the complete sentence meaning difficult to determine
patterns.domain: Web text, biographical entries, or proper-name fragments

patterns.name: Elizabeth name
patterns.context: The name appears at the beginning of the text; some entries repeat the name after a line break; [6] is followed by a fragment of email body text

patterns.name: Edouard name
patterns.context: A complete personal name appears as a split token, followed by a line break and a repetition of the name’s beginning

patterns.name: Nanoscale term
patterns.context: The term appears at the beginning of a paper title, followed by a scientific topic description

patterns.name: Numbers and operators in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: A dense sequence of algebraic expressions, powers, and fractions, near instructions such as “assuming d is positive” and “Simplify”
patterns.domain: Math problems or symbolic computation text

10_1774.concept: 文本开头的显著词片段
10_1774.description: 激活集中在若干文本开头的词或姓名片段（Mil、Elizabeth、Edouard、Nanoscale），另有一段数学式中的数字与运算符；共同点较弱。

patterns.name: Mil-开头的词或姓名
patterns.context: 以 Mil 开头的词或专名，后接逗号、人物名或短语；[1] 中后续内容较零碎，难以判断完整句意
patterns.domain: 网页文本、人物条目或专名片段

patterns.name: Elizabeth 姓名
patterns.context: 姓名位于文本开头，部分条目在换行后重复姓名；[6] 后接邮件正文片段
patterns.domain: 维基百科人物条目、邮件

patterns.name: Edouard 姓名
patterns.context: 以分词形式出现的完整人名，后有换行并重复名字开头

patterns.name: Nanoscale 术语
patterns.context: 术语出现在论文标题开头，后接科学主题描述

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的数值与运算符
patterns.context: 代数式、幂和分数的密集串联，附近有“assuming d is positive”和“Simplify”等指令
patterns.domain: 数学题或符号计算文本

en.description: Activation often occurs on proper names, especially personal names and split surnames, and also on institution, publication, and historical-event names; there are also isolated activations on official titles, spending news, and a few common words, with no single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Surname fragments in personal names
patterns.context: Appears on a first name, surname, or title and surname in personal names; names are sometimes split into multiple tokens and may appear on a standalone title line or in a table.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia biographies, email, legal court records, sports results tables

patterns.name: Name fragments in proper nouns
patterns.context: Appears in multiword proper nouns such as place, institution, or publication names; it may also occur in a proper name formed by combining words or in a punning name.

patterns.name: Word-final part of a historical event name
patterns.context: A historical event name is split into multiple subword tokens; the highest activation falls on the final part of the name, «lav».

patterns.name: Officials and official titles
patterns.context: Description of a government official’s role in a news quotation; activation is concentrated on «official».

patterns.name: spending and neighboring words
patterns.context: A news description of someone’s spending habits; there are also activations related to a person’s form of address or a compound word, but it is unclear whether they share the same trigger as spending.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations on words with weak contextual links
patterns.context: Pronouns, common words, and ordinary verbs also activate in narrative or legal contexts, but there is no evidence of repetition across passages from which to derive stable trigger conditions.

patterns.name: Names in sports and results tables
patterns.context: An event name, match stage, and competitors’ names appear together in a tennis results list; names contain split tokens.

10_1774.description: 激活多见于专名，尤其人名及被拆分的姓氏，也出现于机构、刊物和历史事件名称；另有官方身份称谓、spending 新闻与少量普通词的孤立激活，未见统一稳定的语义模式。

patterns.name: 人名姓氏片段
patterns.context: 在人名的首名、姓氏或称谓与姓氏上出现；人名有时被拆成多个 token，也可能位于独立标题行或表格中。
patterns.domain: 百科人物条目、邮件、法律庭审记录、体育结果表

patterns.name: 专名中的名称片段
patterns.context: 出现在地名、机构名或刊物名等多词专名中；也可能是词语拼接形成的专名或双关人名。

patterns.name: 历史事件名称的词尾
patterns.context: 历史事件名称被拆分为多个子词 token；最高激活落在名称末尾的 «lav»。

patterns.name: 官员与官方身份称谓
patterns.context: 新闻引语中的政府官员身份描述；激活集中在 «official»。

patterns.name: spending 及其邻近词
patterns.trigger: « spending»4；« spending»5；« $»1«100»1 bills；« master»4« boxing»4« crafts»2«man»5
patterns.context: 关于某人花钱习惯的新闻描述；同时出现了与人物称呼或组合词相关的激活，但不能确定它们和 spending 是同一触发模式。

patterns.name: 弱上下文词的零散激活
patterns.trigger: « the»3« media»4« he»7；« thief»2« either»5« had»5；« it»6« he»8；« court»1« overruled»3« the»3
patterns.context: 叙述或法律语境中的代词、常见词和普通动词也有激活，但缺少跨段重复证据，难以提炼为稳定触发条件。

patterns.name: 比赛项目及结果表中的姓名
patterns.context: 网球赛事结果列表中，项目名称、比赛阶段和参赛者姓名相邻；姓名内部有拆分 token。

en.description: Primarily responds to expressions in email that introduce information with “Here is/This is,” as well as names, institutions, and occupational or business terms; a few activations occur in product copy, literary descriptions of food, and academic editorial information, possibly triggered by proper names or local word forms.

patterns.name: Email introductions with “Here is”
patterns.context: At the beginning of an email body or paragraph, “Here is/This is” introduces an attachment, résumé, list, chart, results, or self-introduction; activation is concentrated on is and nearby words.

patterns.name: Personal and institutional names
patterns.context: Proper names occur in the body text or in email addresses, recipient lists, signatures, and other locations; names are often split into multiple subword tokens. Activation is not limited to a single language or format.

patterns.name: Occupational and business terms
patterns.context: Concerns work experience, responsibilities, accounting, or business records; sometimes appears in job résumés or company operations email.

patterns.name: Product descriptions and address fragments
patterns.context: Web-style descriptions of goods or services are followed by prices, specifications, or contact addresses; activation falls on descriptive text and address fragments.

patterns.name: Descriptions of food in narrative
patterns.context: Food and people eating are described in vivid, literary language; these words do not obviously match the business-email pattern in other passages.

patterns.name: Name-dense academic editorial information
patterns.context: Latin American scholars’ names, institutional abbreviations, and editorial information are listed consecutively, with proper names and institutional terms split into subwords.

patterns.name: Fragments that cannot be grouped
patterns.context: A pattern term in a home-goods description; it has no clear shared trigger with product specifications in the same passage, email in other passages, or proper-name patterns.

10_1774.description: 主要响应邮件中以“Here is/This is”引出信息的表达，也响应姓名、机构和职业业务词；少数激活出现在商品文案、文学饮食描写及学术编辑信息中，可能由专名或局部词形触发。

patterns.name: “Here is”邮件引介
patterns.context: 邮件正文开头或段落起始，用“Here is/This is”引出附件、简历、名单、图表、结果或自我介绍；激活集中在 is 及附近词。

patterns.name: 人名与机构名
patterns.context: 专名在正文或邮件地址、收件人列表、署名等位置出现；姓名常被拆成多个子词 token。激活并不只限于单一语言或格式。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、邮件、学术书目

patterns.name: 职业与业务术语
patterns.context: 涉及工作经历、职责、会计或业务记录等职业信息；有时出现在招聘简历或公司运营邮件中。

patterns.name: 商品描述与地址片段
patterns.trigger: «Available» in white, black or brown；«Ranch»«o» Vista« Dr».
patterns.context: 商品或服务的网页式描述后接价格、规格或联系地址；激活落在描述文字、地址词片段上。

patterns.name: 叙事中的饮食描写
patterns.context: 以生动、文学化措辞描述食物及人物进食动作；这些词与其他段落的商务邮件模式不明显相同。

patterns.name: 姓名密集的学术编辑信息
patterns.context: 拉丁美洲学者姓名、机构缩写与编辑信息连续列出，专名和机构词被切分成子词。

patterns.name: 无法归并的片段
patterns.trigger: « in» a dramatic lot«us» flower« pattern»
patterns.context: 家居商品描述中的花纹用语；与同段的商品规格、其他段的邮件和专名模式缺乏明确共同触发点。

en.description: Activation is distributed across time records, proper and project names, genealogy, tent narratives, health promotion, trading ads, group oscillation, and programming identifiers; the fragments lack a stable shared semantic or syntactic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Time or continuation of a process
patterns.context: Near dates, years, or time ranges; also includes expressions describing research follow-up as ongoing with a planned end.

patterns.name: Spelling fragments in proper names and titles
patterns.context: Activation falls on words and internal fragments in proper names, organization names, or project names, often in titles, lists, or project descriptions.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, research project descriptions, web citations

patterns.name: Genealogy and historical record searches
patterns.context: Context of tracing one’s roots, finding ancestors, or searching family census records.

patterns.name: Tent-building narrative
patterns.context: Narrative in which a character owns, sets up, or uses a tent, accompanied by an outdoor activity.

patterns.name: Therapy and improvement effects
patterns.context: Discusses improvements in a child’s physical condition and possible effects of therapy; the passage also cites an organization name.
patterns.domain: Health-related web text or promotional quotation

patterns.name: Trading promotion and urgency
patterns.context: In a trading or income promotion, “now is the time” urges readers to take action.

patterns.name: JavaScript properties and event objects
patterns.context: Discusses how to determine an event’s source based on an object property; source and className appear near the code.

patterns.name: A group shifting between positions
patterns.context: Describes a group moving back and forth between two other identities, positions, or orientations.
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, organizational change and group identity

patterns.name: all in a C function name
patterns.context: A function declaration in C code, where all is part of the identifier sendall rather than a standalone word in a sentence.
patterns.domain: StackExchange programming Q&A, C/POSIX thread code

patterns.name: Parliamentary successors and names
patterns.context: A timeline-style record of who replaced a parliamentarian or other person after their death.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia biographies or parliamentary history entries

patterns.name: Research projects and grant numbers
patterns.context: Introduces funded projects, existing projects, and their numbers.

patterns.name: Research follow-up and recruitment data
patterns.context: Reports recruitment for an intervention study, the number of mutation carriers, and plans for subsequent follow-up.

10_1774.description: 激活分布于时间记录、专名与项目名、家谱、帐篷叙事、健康宣传、交易广告、群体摇摆及编程标识符等多类语境；片段间缺少稳定的共同语义或句法触发模式。

patterns.name: 时间或进程延续
patterns.context: 日期、年份或时间范围附近；也包括描述研究随访仍在持续、计划结束的表达。
patterns.domain: 百科年表、医学研究摘要

patterns.name: 专名与名称中的拼写片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、组织名或项目名的词及词内片段上，常见于标题、名单或项目介绍。
patterns.domain: 百科、科研项目说明、网页引文

patterns.name: 家谱与历史资料检索
patterns.context: 个人寻根、查找祖先或家族人口普查记录的语境。

patterns.name: 帐篷搭建叙事
patterns.context: 叙述人物拥有、搭建或使用帐篷，伴随户外活动情节。

patterns.name: 疗法与改善效果
patterns.context: 谈论儿童身体状况改善及疗法可能产生的效果；片段还引用了一个组织名。
patterns.domain: 健康相关网页或宣传引文

patterns.name: 交易宣传与时机催促
patterns.context: 交易或收入宣传中，用“现在是时候”催促读者采取行动。

patterns.name: JavaScript 属性与事件对象
patterns.context: 讨论如何依据对象属性判断事件来源，代码附近出现 source 和 className。

patterns.name: 群体在立场间摇摆
patterns.context: 描述一个群体在另外两种身份、立场或取向之间来回变化。
patterns.domain: 学术摘要，组织变革与群体身份

patterns.name: C 函数名中的 all
patterns.context: C 代码中的函数声明，all 是 sendall 标识符的一部分，而非普通句子中的独立词。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答，C/POSIX 线程代码

patterns.name: 议会替补及人物名单
patterns.context: 年表式记录议员或人物去世后由谁接替。
patterns.domain: 百科人物或议会历史条目

patterns.name: 科研项目与资助编号
patterns.context: 介绍资助项目、既有项目及其编号。

patterns.name: 研究随访与招募数据
patterns.context: 报告干预研究的招募、突变携带者人数及后续随访安排。

en.concept: Structural and temporal words across diverse contexts
en.description: Activation is distributed across multiple corpora: it often falls on copulas and function words, date/time and scheduling text, and also concerns legal removal, medicine, company activities, distance learning, and code collision checks. No single specific topic explains all examples.

patterns.name: Copulas or function-word phrases
patterns.context: Several adjacent words in a sentence are highlighted, often in copular constructions, determiners, and prepositional phrases; there is no stable single lexical item
patterns.domain: Multiple styles, including email, legal documents, and encyclopedia narratives

patterns.name: Dates and scheduling
patterns.context: Date, weekday, or time phrases used to schedule meetings and events, or to narrate case and medical appointment timing

patterns.name: Removal and its consequences
patterns.context: In a legal context, describes emergency removal of a child, whether a legal removal was timely, or its necessity

patterns.name: Medical and medical-procedure terms
patterns.context: Terms for cesarean delivery, illness, or consultation appear in medical narratives

patterns.name: Event and organization names
patterns.context: Email lists company events or event arrangements; activation also falls on nearby «ride», «Auction», and scheduling text

patterns.name: Study category and benefit eligibility
patterns.context: Discusses whether distance learning qualifies for GI Bill tuition payments

patterns.name: Game objects and collision checks in code
patterns.context: A Java-style loop iterates over objects and compares bullet and object coordinates

patterns.name: Email sign-offs and scheduling language
patterns.context: Email states meeting arrangements or that a date will be the last available date

10_1774.concept: 多样语境中的结构与时间词
10_1774.description: 激活分布于多类语料：常落在系词和功能词、日期时间与日程文字，也涉及法律移除、医疗、公司活动、远程学习及代码碰撞检查。没有一个具体主题能解释全部例子。

patterns.name: 系词或功能词短语
patterns.trigger: «is»、«was»、«this»、«the»、«for»，以及相邻短语中的普通功能词
patterns.context: 句中多个相邻词被标记，常见于系词结构、限定词和介词短语；没有稳定的单一词项
patterns.domain: 邮件、法律文书、百科叙述等多种文体

patterns.name: 日期与时间安排
patterns.context: 日期、星期或时间短语，用于安排会议、活动，或叙述案件与就医时间

patterns.name: 移除及其后果
patterns.context: 法律语境中描述儿童紧急移送、法律上的移除是否及时，或其必要性

patterns.name: 医疗和医疗程序术语
patterns.context: 医疗叙述中出现分娩手术、疾病或会诊等词

patterns.name: 活动与组织名称
patterns.context: 邮件中列举公司活动或活动安排；激活也落在邻近的«ride»、«Auction»及时间安排文字

patterns.name: 学习类别与福利资格
patterns.context: 讨论远程学习是否符合 GI Bill 学费支付资格
patterns.domain: 退伍军人福利法律文书

patterns.name: 代码中的游戏对象和碰撞检查
patterns.context: Java 风格循环中遍历对象，并比较子弹与对象的坐标

patterns.name: 邮件收尾及日程措辞
patterns.context: 邮件中说明会议安排或某日期将是最后可用日期

en.description: The strongest signal is was followed by a state judgment in legal narratives, especially statements about whether an action or procedure was necessary; there are also scheduling emails, fee tables, obstetric narratives, and several internal word fragments that do not form a single clear mechanism.

patterns.name: Judgments of necessity/non-necessity
patterns.context: In legal or formal narratives, states whether an action or procedure was necessary, often in the structure subject + was + (not) necessary; may also first state the court’s or a party’s judgment.

patterns.name: was in an action or legal state
patterns.context: The past-tense copula was is followed by an adjective, participle, or state description, often in legal reasoning or findings of fact; activation may also be near the state word.

patterns.name: was in perfect-tense constructions
patterns.context: Describes a person’s previous or ongoing residence status; activation falls on was, immediately followed by a past-perfect expression.

patterns.name: Past or future arrangements in dates/schedules
patterns.context: Email explains the sequence of meetings, leave, and available dates; there is no obvious was trigger, so this may be a weak association or incidental match.

patterns.name: Unit prices and annual billing entries
patterns.context: A fee list in legal materials itemizes years, work performed, and hourly amounts; activation falls on the internal fragment “per” in performed.

patterns.name: Surgical choices in obstetrics
patterns.context: Narrates labor, medical treatment, and the counterfactual consequences of not having a cesarean; activation falls on the internal fragment “are” in caesarean.

patterns.name: Other highlighted words outside the main pattern
patterns.context: Highlights fall on subword boundaries in words for a partner, ministerial conduct, a trial period, and performed in legal text; they show no stable shared lexical or grammatical trigger.

10_1774.description: 最突出的信号是法律叙述中 was 后接状态判断，尤其说明行动或程序是否 necessary；另有日程邮件、费用表、产科叙事及若干词内片段，未能归为同一明确机制。

patterns.name: 必要性／非必要性判断
patterns.context: 法律或正式叙述中说明某行动、程序是否必要，常见结构为主语 + was +（not）necessary；也可能先陈述法院或当事人的判断。

patterns.name: 动作或法律状态中的 was
patterns.trigger: «was»（如 “removal was untimely”“sale was appropriate”“he was deportable”）
patterns.context: 过去时系词 was 后接形容词、分词或状态描述，常见于法律论证、事实认定；激活位置也可能在状态词附近。

patterns.name: 完成时态中的 was
patterns.context: 描述某人先前或持续存在的居住状态；激活落在 was，紧接过去完成时表达。

patterns.name: 日期／日程中的过去或将来安排
patterns.trigger: “meeting is … scheduled”；“plan to be on vacation”；“this is the lastest date”
patterns.context: 邮件交代会议、休假与可用日期的先后关系；没有明显的 was 触发，可能是弱相关或偶然命中。

patterns.name: 单价与按年计费条目
patterns.trigger: “$317 per hour for 2018”“$233.00 per hour for work performed in 2018”
patterns.context: 法律材料中的费用清单，以年份、工作内容和每小时金额逐项列示；激活在 performed 的词内部分片“per”。

patterns.name: 产科中的手术选择
patterns.context: 叙述分娩过程、医疗处置及未采取剖宫产的反事实后果；激活在 caesarean 的词内部分片“are”。

patterns.name: 其他非主模式的高亮词
patterns.context: 高亮分别落在法律文本中的合伙人、部长行为、试用期及 performed 等词的子词边界，未显示稳定一致的词义或语法触发。

en.description: Activations are scattered across legal procedures and factual narratives, medical records, date scheduling, event promotions, Bulgarian adjectives, and code identifiers; there is no clear shared semantic or stylistic pattern.

patterns.name: Procedural and ruling language in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears in sentences describing litigation procedures, court orders, whether a hearing is required, or whether removal was timely; no fixed legal terminology is required.

patterns.name: Medical diagnoses and hospitalization narratives
patterns.context: Medical records or litigation evidence describing illnesses, hospitalization periods, and specialist consultations.
patterns.domain: Medical facts in FreeLaw legal materials

patterns.name: Residence and service statements in legal documents
patterns.context: Continuous-tense statements of where someone lived or currently lives, their address, and whether they received mail.

patterns.name: Scheduling and date calculation
patterns.context: Infers that a date is the last available option based on meeting and vacation dates.

patterns.name: Event tickets and purchase promotions
patterns.context: Promotes or explains online availability, ordering methods, and guarantees for event tickets.

patterns.name: Online event registration notices
patterns.context: Tells readers how to attend or register for an online event and encourages early registration.

patterns.name: Bulgarian descriptive words
patterns.context: Words in Bulgarian describing sustainability, effectiveness, and ecological or energy-related properties; activation falls on subword fragments within words.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and property access
patterns.context: JavaScript functions extracting properties from parameter objects and combining underscore-separated identifiers.

10_1774.description: 激活分散于法律程序与事实叙述、医疗记录、日期安排、活动宣传、保加利亚语形容词及代码标识符中；没有明显统一的语义或文体模式。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的程序与裁定措辞
patterns.context: 出现在描述诉讼程序、法院命令、是否需要听证或移除是否及时的句子中；不要求固定法律术语。

patterns.name: 医疗诊断及住院叙述
patterns.context: 病历或诉讼证据中描述疾病、住院时间及专科会诊。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 法律材料中的医疗事实

patterns.name: 法律文件中的居住与送达陈述
patterns.context: 以连续时态陈述某人过去或目前的居住地点、地址及收信情况。

patterns.name: 日程安排与日期推算
patterns.context: 根据会议和休假日期推断某日期是最后可选时间。

patterns.name: 活动门票与购买宣传
patterns.context: 宣传或说明活动门票的线上可用性、订购方式和保障。

patterns.name: 线上活动报名通知
patterns.context: 告知读者线上活动的观看或报名方式，并鼓励提前注册。

patterns.name: 保加利亚语描述性词语
patterns.context: 保加利亚语中描述可持续、有效及生态或能源方面特征的词语；激活落在词内子词片段。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 保加利亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 代码标识符与属性访问
patterns.context: JavaScript 函数中从参数对象取出属性，并组合下划线命名的标识符。

en.concept: Procedural and filing information in documents
en.description: Primarily responds to litigation procedures, court captions, parties, and judgment vocabulary in legal documents; other distinct patterns include German word fragments, community event notices, business schedules, and code fields.

patterns.name: Factual and procedural vocabulary in English legal documents
patterns.context: In legal opinions or litigation records, describes court procedures, party identities, rulings, or legal motions; activation is distributed across multiple legal words and related passages.

patterns.name: Section headings and layout whitespace
patterns.context: Legal document captions, headers, section headings, or layout indentation; whitespace and heading text themselves also activate.

patterns.name: Fragments within German words
patterns.context: In German philosophical discussion, activation falls on word-internal fragments in passages contrasting reason, finitude, and dogmatism.

patterns.name: Health insurance enrollment event notice
patterns.context: Notifies community members about a free event and explains preregistration requirements.

patterns.name: Emergency child custody and safety
patterns.context: A court orders emergency removal or custody due to risks to a child's health or safety.

patterns.name: Partner consent and asset sale
patterns.context: Discusses partners' consent to a public sale of real estate and related motions.

patterns.name: Sanctions and appeals in legal judgments
patterns.context: Narratives of criminal conviction, sentencing, and appellate proceedings.

patterns.name: Business event schedules and hospitality
patterns.context: Emails list times and arrangements for lunch, games, and receptions.

patterns.name: Structured code fields
patterns.context: Code or data structures create a temporary registration-period object and pass meeting and date fields.

10_1774.concept: 文书中的程序与登记信息
10_1774.description: 主要响应法律文书中的诉讼程序、法院标题、当事人及判决词汇；另见德语词内片段、社区活动通知、商务日程和代码字段等独立模式。

patterns.name: 英语法律文书中的事实与程序词汇
patterns.context: 法律判决或诉讼记录中，描述法院程序、当事人身份、裁决或法律动议；激活分布在多个法律词及相关句段中

patterns.name: 段落标题与版式空白
patterns.trigger: “FACTUAL BACKGROUND”、全大写法院标题，以及“       ”等缩进空白
patterns.context: 法律文书标题、页眉、分节标题或排版缩进处；空白和标题字样本身也有激活

patterns.name: 德语词内部片段
patterns.context: 德语哲学论述中，激活落在词内片段，句意涉及理性、有限性与教条主义的对照

patterns.name: 医疗保险登记活动通知
patterns.context: 通知社区成员参加免费活动，并说明预登记要求

patterns.name: 紧急儿童监护与安全
patterns.trigger: “emergency custody”, “ex parte order”, “immediate removal”, “children”, “health and safety”
patterns.context: 法院因儿童健康或安全风险决定紧急移除或监护

patterns.name: 合伙人同意与资产出售
patterns.context: 讨论合伙人对房地产公开出售的同意及相关动议

patterns.name: 法律判决的制裁与上诉
patterns.trigger: “found appellant guilty”, “punishment”, “60 years’ imprisonment”, “notice of appeal”
patterns.context: 刑事案件判罪、量刑及上诉程序叙述

patterns.name: 商务活动日程与招待
patterns.context: 邮件列出午餐、比赛和招待会的时间与安排

patterns.name: 结构化代码字段
patterns.context: 代码或数据结构中创建临时注册期对象，并传入会议及日期字段

en.description: Activations commonly occur on explicit numeric times, dates, and schedules, and also appear in legal procedures, hospital/care contexts, and event notices; Polish and Bulgarian parliamentary fragments may be independent word-form or number triggers that are difficult to explain through English patterns.

patterns.name: Numeric times or dates in formal text
patterns.context: Times, clock times, durations, or dates are expressed with numbers and units, often in narrative or explanatory sentences; activation is distributed across numbers, punctuation, and nearby words.
patterns.domain: Legal factual narratives, email scheduling, and schedule descriptions

patterns.name: Procedures and legal terminology in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears in formal accounts of court rulings or legal disputes involving procedures, property, and party actions; accompanied by conspicuous time-related activation, which may not be an independent trigger.

patterns.name: Hospital, health, and care contexts
patterns.context: Involves hospitalization, hospital staff, or Medicare enrollees; paragraph 2 also contains “about a week,” which may overlap with time expressions.
patterns.domain: Legal testimony narratives, community event notices

patterns.name: Appointments, event schedules, and service information
patterns.context: Explains reservations, delivery, event schedules, or registration methods, often in concise, practical notice or email style.

patterns.name: Numbered agenda items in Polish agenda text
patterns.context: Polish parliamentary text with numbers near agenda headings or items; activation falls on token fragments and numbers, with no clear shared cross-language trigger word.

patterns.name: Fragments of Bulgarian word forms
patterns.context: Bulgarian text; activation falls on subword fragments of Cyrillic words, and the available fragments are insufficient to determine specific semantic conditions.

10_1774.description: 激活常见于明确的数字时间、日期与日程安排，也见于法律程序、医院／照护和活动通知；波兰语、保加利亚语议会片段可能是独立的词形或数字触发，难以由英语模式解释。

patterns.name: 正式文本中的数字时间或日期
patterns.trigger: “at about 5:18 p.m.”、“between 3 and 7 business days”、“11:30 a.m.”、“12:00 p.m.”、“Feb 28th”、“12 hours”
patterns.context: 时间、时刻、时长或日期以数字和单位表示，常出现在叙述或说明句中；激活分布在数字、标点及邻近词上。
patterns.domain: 法律事实叙述、电子邮件安排与日程说明

patterns.name: 法律文书中的程序与法律术语
patterns.trigger: “removal was untimely”、“procedurally defective”、“public sale was appropriate”、“real estate”
patterns.context: 出现在法院判决或法律争议的正式叙述中，涉及程序、财产及当事人行动；同时伴随明显的时间激活，未必是独立触发因素。

patterns.name: 医院、健康及照护情境
patterns.trigger: “come out of the hospital”、“River Hospital”、“Medicare enrollees”
patterns.context: 涉及住院、医院工作人员或 Medicare 参保者；第 2 段还包含“about a week”，可能与时间表达重叠。
patterns.domain: 法律证词叙述、社区活动通知

patterns.name: 预约、活动安排与服务信息
patterns.trigger: “Reservations … to arrange the delivery”、“lunch at 11:30 a.m.”、“tournament”、“cocktail reception”、“Pre-registration is not required”
patterns.context: 说明预订、配送、活动日程或报名方式，常用简短实用的通知／邮件文体。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件、社区活动公告

patterns.name: 波兰语议程文本中的数字化议程条目
patterns.context: 波兰语议会文本，议程标题或条目附近出现数字；激活落在分词碎片和数字上，未见明确的跨语言共同触发词。

patterns.name: 保加利亚语词形碎片
patterns.context: 保加利亚语文本；激活落在西里尔字母词的子词片段上，现有片段不足以确定具体语义条件。

en.description: Activations are scattered across numbers and ordinal suffixes, clock times, fragments within Russian words, and a few proper names or legal terms; work schedules, travel and ticketing, and promotional content in emails, along with several other fragments, cannot be explained by a stable shared trigger.

patterns.name: Numbers and ordinal suffixes
patterns.context: In numbers, ordinal endings, or clock times, activation concentrates on digits and immediately adjacent characters such as nd/th and colons; no specific semantic context is required.

patterns.name: Fragments within Russian words
patterns.context: In Russian text, activation falls on fragmented portions within words rather than stable complete words or semantic categories.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in a ship name
patterns.context: The character fragment “ista” in the proper name Carista Express and the following name activate.

patterns.name: Time in a voyage narrative
patterns.context: When a specific time appears in a ship voyage narrative, activation occurs near the digits, colon, minutes, and am.

patterns.name: Name fragments in legal documents
patterns.context: Activation occurs near people’s names and following copulas in factual backgrounds of legal opinions; it is unclear whether this is a general name pattern.

patterns.name: Exchange-related words in legal narratives
patterns.context: In case fact narratives, exchange activates when referring to arrangements or an incomplete transaction.

patterns.name: Code markers in regular-expression examples
patterns.context: Activation occurs near example labels and numbers in Russian regular-expression explanations; its relationship to other patterns is unclear.

10_1774.description: 激活分散于数字和序数后缀、时刻、俄语词内片段及少数专名或法律词语；邮件中的工作安排、行程票务和促销内容，以及若干其他片段，无法由稳定共同触发条件解释。

patterns.name: 数字与序数后缀
patterns.context: 数字、序数词尾或时刻中，激活集中在数字及其紧邻的 nd/th、冒号等字符；不要求特定语义。

patterns.name: 俄语词内片段
patterns.context: 俄语文本中，激活落在被拆分的词语内部片段，而非稳定的完整词或语义类别。

patterns.name: 船名中的内部片段
patterns.context: 专名 Carista Express 中间的字符片段“ista”及后续名称获得激活。

patterns.name: 航行叙述中的时间
patterns.context: 船只航行叙述中出现具体时刻时，数字、冒号、分钟和 am 附近激活。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的姓名片段
patterns.context: 法律判决事实背景中的人名及其后的系词附近出现激活；是否为普遍姓名模式无法确认。

patterns.name: 法律叙述中的交换词
patterns.context: 案件事实叙述中，exchange 在提及安排或未完成交易时激活。

patterns.name: 正则表达式示例中的代码标记
patterns.context: 俄语正则表达式说明中的示例标签与编号附近激活；与其他模式的关系不明。

en.description: Covers deadlines and ruling language in court orders, legal filings and procedural headings, immigration applications, and precise deadlines and event schedules in emails. The commonality leans toward dates, times, filings, and case matters in procedural texts, but not a single trigger word.

patterns.name: Deadlines and court language in rulings
patterns.context: A deadline appears in the body of an order or ruling, or the court decides or orders something about a document; activation concentrates on dates, court instructions, and related wording.

patterns.name: Precise times and deadline requirements in emails
patterns.context: An email asks recipients to submit information by a specific time that day; punctuation and digits in the time activate most strongly.

patterns.name: Filed in legal proceedings
patterns.context: Describes a party filing an application, petition, or other legal document; appears across multiple cases and document types.

patterns.name: Procedural categories in legal document captions
patterns.context: Case captions or case titles in uppercase typography identify an original disciplinary proceeding or habeas corpus petition.

patterns.name: Applications and status adjustment in immigration cases
patterns.context: Case facts describe entry, immigration status, and applications to the government for adjustment of status.

patterns.name: Event and auction dates and times in emails
patterns.context: Promotes an event and lists its start date and time; time punctuation and digits are prominent.

10_1774.description: 涵盖法院命令中的截止日期与裁定措辞、法律文书提交及程序标题、移民申请，以及邮件中的精确截止时间和活动日程。共同点偏向程序性文本中的日期、时刻、提交和案件事项，但并非单一触发词。

patterns.name: 法庭裁定中的期限与法院措辞
patterns.context: 命令或裁定正文中出现截止日期，或法院对文书作出决定、命令时；激活集中于日期、法院指示和相关措辞。

patterns.name: 邮件中的精确时间与截止要求
patterns.trigger: “BY 2:00 PM TODAY”，尤其时间中的“:”和数字
patterns.context: 邮件要求收件人当天某一具体时刻前提交信息；时间标点和数字处激活最强。

patterns.name: 法律程序中的 filed
patterns.context: 描述当事人提交申请、请愿书或其他法律文件；多个案件和法律文书类型中均出现。

patterns.name: 法律文书标题中的程序类别
patterns.trigger: “ORIGINAL PROCEEDING IN DISCIPLINE”“ON APPLICATION FOR A WRIT OF HABEAS CORPUS”
patterns.context: 案件标题或案由以大写排印，标明原始纪律程序或人身保护令申请。

patterns.name: 移民案件中的申请及身份调整
patterns.context: 叙述入境、移民身份以及向政府申请身份调整的案件事实。

patterns.name: 邮件中的活动与拍卖日期时间
patterns.context: 宣传活动并列出开始日期和时间；时间标点及数字突出。

en.description: Activations are scattered across fragments within Polish and Hungarian words, times and judicial vocabulary in legal documents, punctuation and formatting, and an auction word in one email; no stable shared trigger explains all fragments.

patterns.name: Emphasized time/deadline expressions
patterns.context: Duration, date, or deadline information appears around trigger locations; the specific word classes triggered vary across examples, and some time expressions are unmarked.
patterns.domain: Parliamentary text, immigration law provisions, judicial opinions

patterns.name: Polish subword fragments within words
patterns.context: Activation is scattered within Polish words, mostly on token or subword fragments; no consistent meaning or syntactic position is evident.

patterns.name: Fragments within Hungarian words
patterns.context: Activation occurs within or at the ends of Hungarian words; the fragments involve different words and lack stable semantic or grammatical commonalities.

patterns.name: Local fragments in judicial documents
patterns.context: Appears in judicial records such as court opinions, sentencing hearings, or prison sentences; apart from “in,” the activated words differ.

patterns.name: Punctuation and line breaks
patterns.context: Appears in legal provisions, legal opinions, and emails; some markers correspond to layout or line breaks, with no stable condition extending beyond the genre.
patterns.domain: Legal text, emails, and formatted text

patterns.name: Auction event words in emails
patterns.context: Appears in a charity email promoting the start date of an online auction.

10_1774.description: 激活分散于波兰语、匈牙利语词内片段、法律文书的时间与司法词语、标点排版，以及一封邮件的拍卖词；未见能解释全部片段的稳定共同触发。

patterns.name: 被强调的时间/期限表达
patterns.trigger: «nadm«ier»10nie»（波兰语“过度地”）；«72»3« hours»4« advance»6« notice»4；«180»4« days»4；«July»1« 24»1, 2000
patterns.context: 触发位置周围有时长、日期或期限信息；各例中触发的具体词类并不一致，且有些时间表达未标记
patterns.domain: 议会文本、移民法条文、司法判决

patterns.name: 波兰语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在波兰语单词内部，多为分词或子词片段；未见一致的词义或句法位置

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活位于匈牙利语词内部或词尾；片段涉及不同词，缺少稳定的语义或语法共性
patterns.domain: EuroParl 匈牙利语议会文本

patterns.name: 司法文书中的局部片段
patterns.context: 出现在法院意见、量刑听证或监禁判决等司法记录中；除“in”外，激活词并不相同

patterns.name: 标点与换行
patterns.context: 出现在法律条文、法律意见及邮件文本中，部分标记对应排版或换行；没有显示稳定的文体外共同条件
patterns.domain: 法律文本、邮件及版式文本

patterns.name: 邮件中的拍卖活动词
patterns.context: 出现在慈善机构邮件对在线拍卖开始日期的宣传中

en.concept: Tendency toward legal documents and procedural narratives
en.description: Activation spans multiple languages and genres; the clearest clustering involves legal procedures, adjudicative language, and eligibility status, with additional occurrences in date scheduling, email rescheduling, and Polish discussion. It is difficult to reduce to a single semantic or stable lexical trigger.

patterns.name: Factual or judgment clauses introduced by that
patterns.context: A complete statement follows that, often describing a court order, eligibility, procedural status, or investigative conclusion; [2] instead appears near the Polish substring “danych statystycznych, które,” a superficial similarity that does not establish the same grammatical pattern.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, parliamentary speeches, and general emails

patterns.name: Legal procedures and adjudicative language
patterns.context: Legal case narratives, court orders, hearings, and criminal proceedings; includes formal adjudicative wording and procedural case records.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal documents and legal news reports

patterns.name: Months, dates, and time scheduling
patterns.context: Specific dates or relative time expressions establish when a proceeding occurred or schedule a meeting or call.

patterns.name: Eligibility, entitlement, or status determination
patterns.context: States that someone has legal capacity or qualifies for benefits.
patterns.domain: Criminal law reporting, veterans' benefits administrative records

patterns.name: Degree or inference expressions in Polish
patterns.context: Appears in parliamentary discussion such as “z danych statystycznych, które mamy dzisiaj przed sobą, jasno wynika,” meaning “clearly,” emphasizing a conclusion drawn from statistical data.

patterns.name: Polish medical protection and excessive prolongation
patterns.context: Used near “przedłużający… chronionym przed nadmiernie…,” concerning protection of patients and some form of excessive prolongation.

patterns.name: Polite postponement or follow-up in business emails
patterns.context: Reschedules a planned call and says they will get in touch later or next week.

patterns.name: Vietnamese document description text
patterns.context: A Markdown page overview describes documentation for saving the current version of a webpage; activation is distributed within Vietnamese words, with no clear feature shared with the other passages.

patterns.name: Case number and party caption format
patterns.context: Case number, parties, and state name formatted in the opening caption of a court document.

10_1774.concept: 法律文书与程序叙述倾向
10_1774.description: 激活跨越多语种与文体；较明显的聚集是法律程序、裁判措辞及资格状态，也涉及日期安排、邮件改期和波兰语论述。另有越南语文档说明。难以归结为单一语义或稳定词法触发。

patterns.name: that 引导的事实或判断从句
patterns.context: that 后接完整陈述，常说明法院命令、资格、程序状态或调查结论；[2] 中则出现于波兰语子串“danych statystycznych, które”附近，只有表面相似，不能确定同一语法模式
patterns.domain: 法律文书、议会发言及一般邮件

patterns.name: 法律程序与裁判文书措辞
patterns.context: 法律案件叙述、法院命令、听证及刑事程序；包括正式裁判用语和案情程序记录
patterns.domain: 美国法律文书及新闻法律报道

patterns.name: 月份、日期与时间安排
patterns.context: 具体日期或相对时间表达，交代程序发生时间或安排会议、通话

patterns.name: 资格、权益或状态认定
patterns.context: 说明某人具备法律能力或符合资格、可获得福利
patterns.domain: 刑事法律报道、退伍军人福利行政记录

patterns.name: 波兰语中的程度或推断表达
patterns.context: 出现在“z danych statystycznych, które mamy dzisiaj przed sobą, jasno wynika”一类议会论述中，意为“明确地”，强调由统计数据得出的结论

patterns.name: 波兰语医疗保护与过度延长
patterns.context: 用于“przedłużający… chronionym przed nadmiernie…”附近，涉及对患者的保护及某种过度延长
patterns.domain: 波兰语议会或政策论述

patterns.name: 商务邮件中的委婉延期或后续联络
patterns.context: 安排原定通话改期，并告知稍后或下周再联系

patterns.name: 越南语文档说明文字
patterns.trigger: “Trang web này lưu tài liệu của phiên bản hiện tại”
patterns.context: Markdown 页面概览中，描述网页保存当前版本的文档；激活分布在越南语词内，缺少与其他段明确共享的特征
patterns.domain: Github 文档／网页说明，越南语

patterns.name: 案号与当事人标题格式
patterns.context: 法院文书开头的案号、当事人及州名排版标题

en.description: Activations are distributed across calendar scheduling, invitations, reunions, and meeting postponements in emails, as well as court procedures, orders, and agency responsibilities in legal texts; two additional Polish passages contain fragments within words. Shared trigger features are unclear.

patterns.name: Calendar invitations and scheduling in emails
patterns.context: Scheduling information in invitations or notices, including dates, times, locations, and attendance confirmation; high activations also occur on time expressions and nearby words.

patterns.name: Ruling and order language in legal documents
patterns.context: Conditional procedural provisions, orders, rulings, and filing deadlines in court documents; activation may fall on pronouns, imperatives, dates, and legal terms.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw legal opinions and court orders

patterns.name: Legal representation and fiduciary duties
patterns.context: Legal narratives involving lawyers or agents acting for parties or clients and handling funds.

patterns.name: Fragments within Polish prose
patterns.context: Continuous Polish prose; highlights often fall on fragments within words split by tokenization, with no consistent English lexical or formatting trigger shared with other passages.

patterns.name: Party and reunion emails
patterns.context: Personal emails discuss reunions, reservations, or postcards; activation concentrates on event names and related object words.

patterns.name: Meeting postponement notices
patterns.context: An all-caps notice announces a meeting cancellation or postponement and explains that it will be rescheduled later.

10_1774.description: 激活分布于邮件中的日程、邀请、重聚会和会议延期，以及法院程序、命令、代理责任等法律文本；另见两段波兰语词内片段。共同触发特征不明确。

patterns.name: 邮件中的日历邀请与安排
patterns.trigger: «Mark your calendar»、«for Nov. 30th 6:00 pm to 9:00 pm»、«scheduled for Tuesday, March 13, 2001»、«Location information»、«confirm your attendance»
patterns.context: 邀请或通知中的日期、时间、地点、出席确认等安排信息；高激活也落在时间表达及周边词语上。

patterns.name: 法律裁定与命令措辞
patterns.trigger: «it»（“If ... hearing, it shall determine”中的 it）、«THE APPELLANT’S BRIEF WILL BE CONSIDERED BY THIS COURT»、«It is further ORDERED»、«GRANTED»、«shall be filed»
patterns.context: 法院文书中的条件性程序规定、命令、裁定及提交期限；激活可落在代词、命令语、日期和法律术语上。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 法律意见与法院命令

patterns.name: 法律代理与受托责任
patterns.trigger: «Mr. McArthur»、«shall take action»、«protect the interests»、«respondent’s clients»、«make disbursements»
patterns.context: 涉及律师或代理人对当事人、客户采取行动及处理资金的法律叙述。

patterns.name: 波兰语正文中的词内片段
patterns.context: 波兰语连续正文；高亮多落在被分词切开的词内片段，未见与其他段一致的英文词汇或格式触发。

patterns.name: 聚会与重聚会邮件
patterns.context: 私人邮件谈及重聚会、预订或明信片；激活集中在活动名称及相关物件词。

patterns.name: 会议延期通知
patterns.trigger: «ALL CURRENTLY SCHEDULED BUDGET MEETINGS ARE BEING POSTPONED»、«RESCHEDULED AT A LATER DATE»
patterns.context: 以全大写格式发布会议取消或延期，并说明之后改期。

en.description: Activation often falls on fragments within split words, commonly names, proper nouns, and long words; other scattered patterns occur in legal procedure terms, event dates and times, Russian word forms, and sports briefs and charity emails. Semantics are not uniform across domains.

patterns.name: Continuation of letter fragments within words
patterns.context: Activation falls on consecutive fragments of the same word, especially when a word is split into multiple subword tokens; the same phenomenon occurs in English, German, and other languages.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments in names and proper nouns
patterns.context: When people’s names, place names, or institution names are split into multiple tokens, individual fragments may activate; some fragments are also ordinary words.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, legal case names, and other texts rich in proper nouns

patterns.name: Procedural words in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears in case captions or formal legal documents describing case history and litigation dates; the strongest activation is concentrated on the split fragments of “Reargument.”
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions or docket captions

patterns.name: Event invitations and calendar scheduling
patterns.context: Event dates and times occur alongside invitations, with additional wording asking readers to mark their calendars.

patterns.name: Russian word-form fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on multiple fragments within Bulgarian Cyrillic words, especially fragments of the word “съществена.”

patterns.name: Scattered word fragments and phrases
patterns.context: These activations occur respectively in a sports injury brief, a charity auction promotion, and a court caption, with no consistent specific semantic trigger.
patterns.domain: Sports briefs, charity emails, legal documents

patterns.name: Philosophical terms and German morphological fragments
patterns.context: In German academic sentences discussing Kant, Bayle, and anti-skeptical thought, fragments within several philosophical proper names or terms activate.

10_1774.description: 激活多落在被拆分的词内片段，常见于人名、专名及长词；另有法律程序词、活动日期时间、俄语词形，以及体育简讯和慈善邮件中的零散片段。各领域语义并不统一。

patterns.name: 词内字母片段续写
patterns.context: 激活落在同一词的连续片段上，尤其是词被切成多个子词 token 时；同一现象见于英语、德语及其他语言文字。

patterns.name: 名字与专名中的分词片段
patterns.context: 人名、地名或机构名被拆成多个 token 时，片段可逐一激活；有些片段同时属于普通词。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、法律案名及其他专名密集文本

patterns.name: 法律文书中的程序词
patterns.context: 出现在案件标题或案件历史、诉讼程序日期等正式法律文书语境中；最强激活集中在“Reargument”的拆分片段。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决或案卷标题

patterns.name: 活动邀请与日历安排
patterns.context: 活动日期、时间及邀请事项相邻出现，另有要求读者标记日历的语句。

patterns.name: 俄语词形片段
patterns.context: 激活落在保加利亚语西里尔字母词的多个词内片段上，尤其是“съществена”一词的片段。

patterns.name: 零散词片段及短语
patterns.context: 这些激活分别出现在体育伤病简讯、慈善拍卖宣传和法院抬头中，未见一致的特定语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 体育简讯、慈善邮件、法律文书

patterns.name: 哲学术语及德语形态片段
patterns.context: 在论述康德、巴伊勒及反怀疑论思想的德语学术句子中，若干哲学专名或术语的词内片段激活。

en.description: Activations are scattered across multilingual text and often fall on fragments within words or components of compound words; Polish “jasno” appears twice, alongside scattered patterns in legal documents, medical headings, religious text, and auction notices.

patterns.name: Root word expressing clarity/emphasis
patterns.context: “jasno” means clearly or explicitly; it appears in sentences expressing a position or drawing a conclusion from data.

patterns.name: Specific segments within English compounds
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal fragments of English words, hyphenated compounds, or uppercase legal boilerplate; the specific meanings of the fragments are not uniform.

patterns.name: Fragments within Slavic words
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within Slovak, Czech, or Polish words; token boundaries do not always align with complete word meanings.

patterns.name: Auction-related word segments
patterns.context: Appears in promotional language for fundraising events and calendar dates.

10_1774.description: 激活散见于多语种文本，常落在词内片段或复合词成分；波兰语“jasno”出现两次，另有法律文书、医学标题、宗教文本及拍卖通知中的零散模式。

patterns.name: 明确/强调语气的词根
patterns.context: “jasno”意为清楚、明确；出现在表达立场或根据数据得出结论的句子中

patterns.name: 英文复合词内部的特定词段
patterns.context: 激活落在英文词、连字符复合词或大写法律程式用语的内部片段；片段间具体词义不统一

patterns.name: 斯拉夫语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在斯洛伐克语、捷克语或波兰语的词内子词段，分词边界与完整词义并不总一致
patterns.domain: 斯拉夫语议会文本、宗教文本

patterns.name: 拍卖相关词段
patterns.context: 出现在筹款活动及日历日期的宣传语中
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件、慈善活动通知

en.description: Primarily responds to “testing” and its technical, experimental, product, legal, or medical contexts; also activates on “November,” some weekday names and numbers in date lines, DENIED in legal rulings, and whitespace and line breaks in email/document layouts.

patterns.name: testing and surrounding words
patterns.context: “testing” itself is marked in [5]–[8] and [10], with stronger markings in [6], [7]–[8], and [10]; [5] concerns a statistical genetics test, [6] product testing, [7] well testing, [8] semiconductor manufacturing testing, and [10] a biomedical experiment.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain technical, legal, and medical texts

patterns.name: November in dates
patterns.context: The month November is strongly marked in date formats; it appears in [1], [2], [4], and [9]. Activation does not appear to depend strongly on a particular year or fixed date format.
patterns.domain: Email date lines, legal rulings, webpage or post timestamps

patterns.name: DENIED in rulings
patterns.context: Appears in a formal ruling sentence in which the Supreme Court denies certiorari; the subsequent “IED” is also marked. Seen only in this legal context.

patterns.name: Document layout and whitespace
patterns.context: Whitespace alignment in email content or headers, and line breaks and nearby separator lines in legal documents, are marked; [1] is especially prominent, but whitespace also appears locally in [3] and [9].

patterns.name: Other date/weekday text
patterns.context: Weekday names appear in date lines; they partially overlap with the November date pattern, but the weekdays themselves occur only in [4] and [9].

10_1778.concept: 测试与文档日期/格式特征
10_1778.description: 主要对“testing”及其技术实验、产品、法律或医学语境反应；另对日期行中的 November、部分星期和数字、法律判决中的 DENIED，以及邮件/文书排版空白与换行有激活。

patterns.name: testing及其周边词
patterns.trigger: “testing”，以及部分上下文中的 “beta testing”“operations testing”“testing whether”“testing of”
patterns.context: “testing”本身在[5]–[8]、[10]均被标记，且在[6]、[7]–[8]、[10]带有较强标记；[5]为统计遗传学检验，[6]为产品测试，[7]为井的测试，[8]为半导体制造测试，[10]为生物医学实验。
patterns.domain: 跨领域技术、法律、医学文本

patterns.name: 日期中的 November
patterns.context: 日期格式中月份 November 被强标记；[1]、[2]、[4]、[9]出现。激活并不明显取决于特定年份或固定日期格式。
patterns.domain: 邮件日期行、法律判决、网页或帖子时间戳

patterns.name: 判决中的 DENIED
patterns.context: 出现在最高法院拒绝准许上诉的正式判决句中，后续“IED”也有标记；仅见于该法律语境。

patterns.name: 文档排版与空白符
patterns.context: 邮件内容或标题中的空白对齐，以及法律文书中的换行、分隔线附近出现标记；[1]尤其突出，但空白本身也在[3]、[9]局部出现。
patterns.domain: 邮件与法律文书的格式/版面

patterns.name: 其他日期/星期文字
patterns.context: 星期名称出现在日期行；与 November 日期模式部分重合，但星期本身只有[4]、[9]。

en.description: Activation centers on “November” in dates, headers, stamps, and publication markers in legal documents, and space padding in emails; isolated cases also include repeated character sequences, a holiday poem title, and a domain options heading.

patterns.name: Month in dates
patterns.context: The month is capitalized in date formats, usually adjacent to a weekday, day, and year; it also appears after “Opinion issued” in legal opinion dates.

patterns.name: Legal document layout markers
patterns.context: Headers, stamps, or title areas of court documents, often accompanied by formatting spaces and line breaks; date patterns also occur in legal documents.

patterns.name: Space padding in email templates/headers
patterns.context: Blocks of spaces repeat, followed by email content or other fields; some excerpts also contain template markers.

patterns.name: Repeated character patterns
patterns.context: Character sequences repeat, followed by a line break and an uppercase heading; they occur in the same excerpt as date patterns and email addresses, but do not form a clear semantic condition.

patterns.name: Holiday poem title
patterns.context: Title case, ending with a line break and followed by “as written by”.

patterns.name: Website domain options heading
patterns.context: A short heading followed by a line break, then an explanation introduced by “The following domain extensions”.

10_1778.concept: 文档格式与标题标记
10_1778.description: 激活集中于日期中“November”，法律文书的页眉、盖章与出版标记，以及邮件中的空格填充；另有重复字符序列、节日诗标题和域名选项标题等孤例。

patterns.name: 日期中的月份
patterns.context: 日期格式中月份被大写，通常紧邻星期、日和年份；在法律意见日期中也出现在“Opinion issued”之后。
patterns.domain: 邮件、网页文本、法律文书

patterns.name: 法律文件版式标记
patterns.trigger: “Filed”“FILED”“NOT FOR PUBLICATION”“COURT OF APPEALS”“Opinion issued”及大量前导空格
patterns.context: 法院文件的页眉、盖章或标题区域，常伴有排版空格和换行；日期模式也见于法律文书。

patterns.name: 邮件模板/报头中的空格填充
patterns.context: 空格成块重复，后接邮件内容或其他字段；部分片段还含模板标记。

patterns.name: 重复字符图案
patterns.context: 字符序列重复出现，后接换行和大写标题；与日期和邮件地址同处一段，但不构成清楚的语义条件。

patterns.name: 节日诗标题
patterns.context: 标题式大小写并以换行结束，后接“as written by”。

patterns.name: 网站域名选项标题
patterns.context: 短标题后换行，接着以“The following domain extensions”引出说明。

en.concept: Legal document formatting and rights statements
en.description: Primarily responds to large blocks of layout whitespace in legal document headers, as well as heading markers such as the court, decision year, and publication/precedential status; also responds to “has” and proprietary rights and usage restrictions in a data disclaimer.

patterns.name: Whitespace layout in legal documents
patterns.context: Indentation and alignment whitespace before headers or titles, often appearing alongside line breaks and court-heading formats

patterns.name: Court decision headings and publication status
patterns.context: Court names, docket/year information, and markers of official publication or precedential status on the first page or in the header of a decision
patterns.domain: FreeLaw legal opinions, especially appellate court documents

patterns.name: Data usage restrictions and proprietary rights statements
patterns.context: Restrictions on the use and distribution of exchange market data and ownership statements; activation centers on “has” and related legal language

10_1778.concept: 法律文书格式与权利声明
10_1778.description: 主要响应法律文书页眉中的大段排版空白，以及法院、判决年份和发布/先例状态等标题标记；另在一段数据免责声明中响应“has”及专有权、使用限制措辞。

patterns.name: 法律文书的空白排版
patterns.context: 页眉或标题前的缩进、对齐空白，常与换行及法院标题格式同时出现

patterns.name: 法院判决标题与发布状态
patterns.trigger: 「Filed」「Washington」「2016 IL App」「[DO NOT PUBLISH]」「COURT OF APPEALS」「2018 IL App」「In the United States Court」「NOT PRECEDENTIAL」
patterns.context: 判决首页或页眉中的法院名称、案卷/年份信息，以及是否正式发布或具有先例效力的标记
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 法律判决，尤其上诉法院文书

patterns.name: 数据使用限制与专有权声明
patterns.trigger: 「Furthermore, you acknowledge that」「has exclusive and valuable property rights in this data」；同段还有「without the express written consent」
patterns.context: 对交易所市场数据的使用、传播限制及所有权声明，激活集中于「has」及相关法律措辞
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的商业/法律免责声明

en.description: All passages contain a marked \left in mathematical typesetting; most use it for a left parenthesis or brace in a formula, and a few for angle brackets. The trigger appears to be the LaTeX left delimiter rather than specific subject matter.

patterns.name: LaTeX left delimiter
patterns.context: \left appears in mathematical formulas, often paired with \right; it is sometimes followed by parentheses, braces, or other delimiters.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics/theoretical physics formulas, plus PubMed Central mathematical formulas

patterns.name: Left parentheses and braces in formulas
patterns.context: Used as delimiters enclosing an expression in a formula; activation marks \left and related delimiters.

patterns.name: Special left delimiters
patterns.context: A quantity is represented by angle brackets in an information-theoretic expression.

patterns.name: Textual left delimiter
patterns.context: Braces enclose a set of basis vectors in geometric algebra.
patterns.domain: Geometric algebra explanatory text and formulas

10_1778.concept: LaTeX 左定界符 \left
10_1778.description: 所有段落都在数学排版中出现被标记的 \left；多数用于公式内左括号或花括号，少数用于角括号。触发似乎是 LaTeX 左定界符，而非具体学科内容。

patterns.name: LaTeX 左定界符
patterns.context: 数学公式中出现 \left，常与 \right 成对；有时后接括号、花括号或其他定界符。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学/理论物理公式，另有 PubMed Central 数学公式

patterns.name: 公式中的左括号与花括号
patterns.context: 作为公式内括起表达式的定界符；激活标注落在 \left 及相关定界符处。

patterns.name: 特殊左定界符
patterns.context: 信息论表达式中以角括号表示的量。
patterns.domain: 信息论/编码理论，LaTeX 公式

patterns.name: 文本式左定界符
patterns.context: 花括号用于包住几何代数中的基向量集合。
patterns.domain: 几何代数说明文字及公式

en.description: Activation is concentrated on HTML markup, navigation-bar boundary comments, and link lists; it also appears on table headings, email header addresses, and symbolized numerical comparisons in a DNA abstract.

patterns.name: HTML navigation bar fragment
patterns.context: In HTML, after a list and a `div` close, an anchor and comment separator markers are used to skip the navigation bar; often adjacent to line breaks and ``, ``
patterns.domain: HTML page templates in GitHub source code

patterns.name: HTML table heading markers
patterns.context: Table header cells use alignment, colspan, and font-size attributes and contain bold headings
patterns.domain: HTML documents or generated API documentation in GitHub

patterns.name: HTML list links and language names
patterns.context: Hyperlinks in an HTML list point to a media preferences page, with localized language names as link text
patterns.domain: Webpages or UI localization resources in GitHub

patterns.name: HTML links and survey archive list
patterns.context: Survey or archive entries are listed as links with bracketed numbers

patterns.name: Numerical comparisons in DNA research
patterns.context: Compares changes in the number of water molecules in different drug and DNA systems, using less-than or greater-than-zero relations

patterns.name: Addresses and contacts in email headers
patterns.context: Email addresses, CC fields, or return paths appear in an email header or recipient list

10_1778.concept: 结构化文本边界与标记
10_1778.description: 激活主要集中在 HTML 标记、导航栏边界注释与链接列表；另见表格标题、邮件头地址，以及 DNA 摘要中的符号化数值比较。

patterns.name: HTML 导航栏片段
patterns.trigger: `END OF TOP NAVBAR`、`END OF BOTTOM NAVBAR`，以及 `<a name="skip.navbar.top">`、`<a id="skip.navbar.top">`、`<a name="skip.navbar.bottom">` 等
patterns.context: HTML 中列表、`div` 结束后出现用于跳过导航栏的锚点和注释分隔标记；常与换行及 ``、`` 相邻
patterns.domain: GitHub 源码中的 HTML 页面模板

patterns.name: HTML 表格标题标记
patterns.context: 表格表头单元格使用对齐、跨列和字体大小属性，包含加粗标题
patterns.domain: GitHub 中的 HTML 文档或生成式 API 文档

patterns.name: HTML 列表链接及语言名称
patterns.context: HTML 列表中的超链接，链接到媒体偏好设置页面，链接文本是本地化语言名称
patterns.domain: GitHub 中的网页或界面本地化资源

patterns.name: HTML 链接及调查归档列表
patterns.context: 以链接和方括号编号列出调查或归档条目

patterns.name: DNA 研究中的数值比较
patterns.context: 比较不同药物与 DNA 体系的水分子数变化，出现小于或大于零的关系

patterns.name: 邮件头中的地址及联系人
patterns.context: 邮件头或收件人列表中出现电子邮件地址、抄送字段或退信路径

en.concept: Proper names and marker fragments in structured text
en.description: Primarily responds to dense formatting of email recipient lists, names, and email addresses; also has local activation on HTML tags, generic type parameters, the x86_64 architecture marker, and “high-speed pursuit” in legal text.

patterns.name: Email addresses and recipient fields
patterns.context: Names, email addresses, and email header fields appear densely, especially in recipient lists or address-book-like text; activation often falls on names, parts of addresses, and separators.
patterns.domain: Enron email, email address books, or email headers

patterns.name: Angle brackets and markup language tags
patterns.context: Angle brackets enclose HTML tags at the beginning of a webpage document header.

patterns.name: Generic types and type parameters
patterns.context: Type names and angle-bracketed type parameters appear in function signatures, return values, or container declarations; they may also be adjacent to ordinary code identifiers.
patterns.domain: Programming Q&A and Java source code

patterns.name: x86_64 architecture marker in code
patterns.context: Appears as a test-platform description in a technical discussion comparing clang and gcc compilation results and instruction-count differences.

patterns.name: High-speed pursuit wording in legal rulings
patterns.context: While recounting a police pursuit and witness testimony, activation centers near the phrase “high-speed pursuit”.

10_1778.concept: 结构化文本中的专名与标记片段
10_1778.description: 主要响应邮件收件人列表、姓名与邮箱地址的密集格式；另对 HTML 标签、泛型类型参数、x86_64 架构标记及法律文本中的“high-speed pursuit”有局部激活。

patterns.name: 邮箱地址与邮件收件人字段
patterns.trigger: 邮箱地址中的 @、域名片段，以及邮件头中的 <...>、逗号分隔姓名和地址；如 «AA»«m»«iral»«i»«@»、«m»«fe»«252»«@»«air»«mail»、«From»:
patterns.context: 姓名、邮箱地址及邮件头字段密集出现，尤其在收件人列表或地址簿式文本中；激活常落在姓名、地址局部和分隔符上。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件、邮件地址簿或邮件头

patterns.name: 尖括号与标记语言标签
patterns.context: 尖括号包围 HTML 标签，处于网页文档头部的开端。
patterns.domain: 旧式 HTML 文档/源码

patterns.name: 泛型类型与类型参数
patterns.context: 类型名及尖括号类型参数出现在函数签名、返回值或容器声明中；也可能与普通代码标识符相邻。
patterns.domain: 编程问答与 Java 源码

patterns.name: 代码中的 x86_64 架构标记
patterns.context: 在比较 clang 与 gcc 编译结果、指令数差异的技术讨论中，作为测试平台说明出现。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的高速追逐表述
patterns.context: 叙述警察追逐事件及证人证言时，激活集中于短语“high-speed pursuit”附近。

en.description: Most excerpts are code, JSON, HTML, or technical text, with activation on structural symbols, fields, identifiers, and proper names; other examples include date/time-zone codes, encyclopedia links, and British political prose, with no common lexical cue.

patterns.name: Structured code and markup languages
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across field names, punctuation, indentation, tags, and code identifiers; the context is structured, parseable code or markup, not a fixed keyword.
patterns.domain: JSON, Java, JavaScript/React, Dart/Flutter, HTML, and other technical text

patterns.name: Technical proper names and identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in code fields, class names, chart titles, instruction descriptions, or webpage excerpts; the proper names vary and share no evident semantic content.
patterns.domain: Technical documentation, code, and webpage content

patterns.name: Dates, time zones, and timestamps
patterns.context: Time zones and date/time are expressed as code or data, with activation across identifiers, numbers, and time-zone strings.

patterns.name: Linked encyclopedia entry names
patterns.context: A phrase appears as Markdown link text and in a URL pointing to an English Wikipedia entry.
patterns.domain: Hacker News posts or link references

patterns.name: British politics and postal service discussion
patterns.context: Ordinary prose discusses the British Postal Services Act, privatization, and Labour critics; there is no clear code structure.

10_1778.concept: 技术与结构化文本片段
10_1778.description: 多数片段是代码、JSON、HTML或技术文本，激活落在结构符号、字段、标识符和专名上；另有日期时区代码、百科链接及英国政治散文，缺少共同词义线索。

patterns.name: 结构化代码与标记语言
patterns.trigger: JSON/代码中的标点、字段和值，如 «Feature»、«Collection»、«properties»、«class»、«public»、«import»、«<td>»、«<div»
patterns.context: 激活分散在字段名、标点、缩进、标签和代码标识符上；上下文为结构化、可解析的代码或标记文本，并非某个固定关键词。

patterns.name: 技术专名与标识符
patterns.context: 出现在代码字段、类名、图表标题、指令说明或网页片段中；专名本身种类不一，未见共同语义。
patterns.domain: 技术文档、代码与网页内容

patterns.name: 日期、时区与时间戳
patterns.context: 以代码或数据表达时区及日期时间，激活覆盖标识符、数字和时区字符串。
patterns.domain: 编程问答或日期时间数据

patterns.name: 带链接的百科条目名称
patterns.context: 词组出现在指向英文维基百科条目的 Markdown 链接文本及 URL 中。
patterns.domain: Hacker News 帖文或链接引用

patterns.name: 英国政治与邮政叙述
patterns.context: 普通散文中讨论英国邮政服务法案、私有化及工党批评者；没有明显代码结构。

en.description: Primarily responds to litigation narratives in U.S. opinions: guilty pleas and convictions, statutory sentencing, court disputes, motions, and party names; also includes political commentary focused on “Republican Party”.

patterns.name: Legal rulings and litigation arguments
patterns.context: Appears in passages describing facts, procedural history, grounds for dispute, or court analysis, often with party names, courts, statutes, and citations
patterns.domain: U.S. legal rulings, especially criminal, immigration, civil litigation, and appellate decisions

patterns.name: Legal wording on guilty pleas, convictions, and penalties
patterns.context: Describes a defendant’s guilty plea, criminal conduct, conviction, or sentencing, and related legal consequences

patterns.name: Procedural or evidentiary disputes in rulings
patterns.context: Recounts an application, objection, or disputed event raised by a party, and explains how the court or another body handled it
patterns.domain: Facts and procedural history in judicial decisions; some involve banking transaction disputes

patterns.name: Party names and possessives adjacent to legal terms
patterns.context: Legal proper names and possessives often appear next to litigation terms such as petition, motion, and argues; activation sometimes falls on name fragments, punctuation, or formatting symbols
patterns.domain: Names of people and organizations and litigation narratives in legal documents

patterns.name: Party name in political commentary
patterns.context: Repeatedly mentions a political party and comments on its relationship to a person’s position; this passage is not a legal ruling

10_1778.concept: 法律判决中的诉讼叙述
10_1778.description: 主要响应美国判决书中的诉讼叙述：认罪定罪、法条量刑、法院争议、动议及当事人姓名；另有一段以“Republican Party”为焦点的政治评论。

patterns.name: 法律判决与诉讼论述
patterns.context: 置于法院裁判的事实、程序经过、争议理由或法院分析段落中，常有当事人姓名、法院、法条和引证
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决，尤其刑事、移民、民事诉讼与上诉裁判

patterns.name: 认罪、定罪与刑罚法律语句
patterns.context: 描述被告认罪、犯罪事实、定罪或量刑，以及相关法律后果

patterns.name: 判决中的程序或证据争议
patterns.trigger: “motion to suppress”“Notice to Appear”“challenges”“trial court erred”“stop payment”
patterns.context: 叙述当事人提出的申请、异议或争议事件，并交代法院或其他机构的处理
patterns.domain: 司法裁判事实与程序史；部分涉及银行交易争议

patterns.name: 当事人姓名及所有格紧邻法律术语
patterns.context: 法律专名和所有格常紧挨 petition、motion、argues 等诉讼词汇；激活有时落在姓名片段、标点或格式符号上
patterns.domain: 法律文书中的人名、机构名与诉讼叙述

patterns.name: 政治评论中的政党名称
patterns.context: 重复提及政党，并以其与人物立场关系作评论；该段不是法律裁判

en.concept: Legal documents and structured text markers
en.description: Primarily responds to rulings, requests, parties, obligations, and statutory/citation formatting in legal decisions and litigation texts; other heterogeneous triggers include a team roster in sports reporting and a few code and JSON fields.

patterns.name: Statutory citations
patterns.context: Numbers or paragraph markers appear next to legal terms, decision citations, or statute names; occurs in legal text

patterns.name: Rulings and court actions
patterns.context: Describes how a court rules on a pleading, motion, or order in a court opinion

patterns.name: Legal claims and debt relationships
patterns.context: States a party’s claim, allegation, or debt in a legal dispute

patterns.name: Legal party names and possessives
patterns.context: Names of parties, institutions, or entities involved in a case appear in legal narratives, often with possessives or attribution of claims

patterns.name: Legal obligations and performance
patterns.context: Discusses payment, services, property improvements, or payment obligations inferred from conduct

patterns.name: Legal citations and procedural formatting
patterns.context: Near citations, paragraph breaks, court orders, and citation formatting in rulings

patterns.name: Sports team names and roster
patterns.context: Sports news context in which a player completes a suspension and can return to the team roster

patterns.name: Object properties and indentation in code
patterns.context: In JavaScript object initialization and code that checks a safe-integer condition

patterns.name: JSON fields and data records
patterns.context: Keys, values, counts, and object arrays in serialized records

10_1778.concept: 法律文书与结构化文本标记
10_1778.description: 主要响应法律判决与诉讼文本中的裁决、请求、当事人、义务及法条/引文格式；另有体育报道中的球队阵容，以及代码和JSON字段等少量异质触发。

patterns.name: 法条编号
patterns.context: 数字或段落标记紧邻法律术语、判决引文或法条名称；在法律文本中出现

patterns.name: 判决处置与法院动作
patterns.context: 法院意见中描述法院对诉状、申请或命令的裁决

patterns.name: 法律请求与债务关系
patterns.context: 法律争议中陈述当事人的请求、指控或债务

patterns.name: 法律主体名称及所有格
patterns.context: 当事人、机构或案件相关主体名称出现在法律叙述中，常带所有格或请求归属

patterns.name: 法律义务与履行
patterns.trigger: « make» payments、« promise» is « implied»、« accepted» the « improvements»
patterns.context: 讨论付款、服务、财产改良或由行为推定的付款义务

patterns.name: 法律引文与程序格式
patterns.context: 判决中的引文、段落换行、法院命令及引文格式附近

patterns.name: 体育队名及阵容
patterns.context: 球员停赛结束并可回归球队阵容的体育新闻语境

patterns.name: 代码中的对象属性与缩进
patterns.context: JavaScript 对象初始化及安全整数条件判断代码中

patterns.name: JSON字段与数据记录
patterns.context: 序列化记录中的键值字段、计数和对象数组

en.concept: Names and terms related to legal participants
en.description: Most legal passages activate on party, defendant, or group nouns and their possessives; other isolated patterns include the At isotope, a Java callback, the Keep editor, and a ship name, with no unified trigger.

patterns.name: Possessive nouns in legal text
patterns.context: In legal narratives, ’s follows a person or group noun, especially before matters in legal documents such as request, arguments, or motion; activation falls on the possessive noun and ’s.

patterns.name: Names and criminal defendant designations in legal rulings
patterns.context: A court opinion or ruling’s factual narrative includes litigants, defendants, or party designations; the word form is not always the same, and activation may fall on the designation or a name fragment.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw court opinions, including bankruptcy and criminal cases

patterns.name: Children as a litigant group
patterns.context: Claims in a constitutional lawsuit brought by schoolchildren; the passage also contains possessives and legal claims, but the noun for children is a prominent trigger.

patterns.name: At-211 isotope marker
patterns.context: In scientific descriptions of astatine isotopes and radionuclide therapy, the chemical symbol At is adjacent to isotope/anionic notation.

patterns.name: Java options callback method name
patterns.context: A coding question describes a click on an icon failing to trigger the onOptionsItemSelected() callback; activation centers on Selected in the method name and nearby parentheses.

patterns.name: Keep editor interface name
patterns.context: A question about an image display issue in a dialog mentions Keep editor; activation falls on the editor name.

patterns.name: Case property or ship name
patterns.context: Legal discussion involving immigration enforcement and forfeiture lists ship names; activation falls on the end of a proper name.

10_1778.concept: 名称与法律参与者相关词语
10_1778.description: 多数法律段落在当事人、被告或群体名词及其所有格处激活；另有 At 同位素、Java 回调、Keep 编辑器和船名等孤立模式，未见统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的所有格名词
patterns.context: 法律叙述中，所有格 ’s 紧接人或群体名词，尤其后接 request、arguments、motion 等法律文书中的事项；激活落在所有格名词及 ’s 上。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的人名与刑事被告称谓
patterns.context: 法院意见书或判决的事实叙述中，出现诉讼参与人、被告或当事人称谓；不总是同一词形，激活可落在称谓或人名片段上。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 法院判决，含破产与刑事案件

patterns.name: 儿童作为诉讼群体
patterns.context: 关于学校儿童提出的宪法诉讼主张；该段也出现所有格及法律主张，但儿童名词是突出触发点。

patterns.name: At-211 同位素标记
patterns.context: 砹同位素和放射性核素治疗的科学说明中，化学元素符号 At 与同位素/阴离子记号相邻。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 科学论文，放射化学

patterns.name: Java 选项回调方法名
patterns.context: 代码问答中，描述点击图标未触发 onOptionsItemSelected() 回调；激活集中于方法名的 Selected 及括号附近。

patterns.name: Keep 编辑器界面名称
patterns.context: 询问对话框里的图像显示问题，提及 Keep editor；激活落在编辑器名称上。

patterns.name: 案件财产或船名
patterns.context: 移民执法与没收相关法律论述中，列举船只名称；激活落在专名末尾。

en.description: Activation occurs in both types of context: class names, controls, and event identifiers in programming Q&A; and terms related to appeals, motions, judgments, claims, and arbitration in legal opinions. The domains differ, and no reliable shared trigger feature is apparent.

patterns.name: Class names and control/event identifiers in code
patterns.context: Appears in code, API names, or technical explanations adjacent to code in programming Q&A; identifiers often consist of multiple mixed-case segments and involve Java, Android, Flutter, Qt, and related technologies.

patterns.name: Legal proceedings and judicial procedure
patterns.context: Appears in court opinions or case fact narratives discussing appeals, motions, judgments, convictions, requests, claims, or arbitration; often uses formal legal language and party designations.

10_1778.concept: none
10_1778.description: 两类语境均有激活：编程问答中的类名、控件与事件标识符；法律意见中的上诉、动议、判决、索赔及仲裁术语。二者领域不同，未见可靠的共同触发特征。

patterns.name: 代码中的类名与控件/事件标识符
patterns.context: 出现在编程问答的代码、API 名称或紧邻代码的技术说明中；标识符常由多个大小写片段组成，涉及 Java、Android、Flutter、Qt 等。

patterns.name: 法律诉讼与司法程序表述
patterns.context: 出现在法院意见或案件事实叙述中，讨论上诉、动议、判决、定罪、请求、索赔或仲裁；常有正式法律文体及当事人称谓。

en.concept: Proper names and terminology markers in documents
en.description: Activation occurs mainly around Pro Se party designations and court-document fields in legal judgments; it also responds to judgment-record advertisements, programming callback names, antibody targets, and particle-decay terminology, so it cannot be assigned to a single semantic category.

patterns.name: Pro Se parties in legal judgments
patterns.context: A party appears as self-represented (pro se) in an appeal or review document; often adjacent to a name, Petitioner, or Appellant.

patterns.name: Counts or case numbers in legal judgments
patterns.context: Discusses the number of counts of conviction in a criminal judgment, or an isolated number in the judgment text; the commonality is weak.

patterns.name: Advertisement for purchasing court opinions/records
patterns.context: After describing judgment footnotes or a brief ruling, an advertisement offers the complete court record for purchase.

patterns.name: UI callback method name
patterns.context: A programming Q&A discusses an icon click failing to trigger Android's onOptionsItemSelected callback.

patterns.name: Antibody target description
patterns.context: An introduction to a medical paper discusses natalizumab and its molecular target.

patterns.name: Particle physics decays and invariants
patterns.context: Discusses B-meson decays, lepton asymmetry, and dilepton invariant mass.

patterns.name: Date/procedural headings in legal judgments
patterns.context: Near date lines and case-procedure headings in court documents.

patterns.name: Court and judge information in legal documents
patterns.context: Lists the court, circuit, or judge in a judgment heading or case narrative.

10_1778.concept: 文书中的专名与术语标记
10_1778.description: 激活主要见于法律判决中 Pro Se 当事人标记及法院文书字段；另响应判决记录广告、编程回调名、抗体靶标和粒子衰变术语，不能归为单一语义。

patterns.name: 法律判决文书中的 Pro Se 当事人
patterns.context: 法律上诉或复审文书中，当事人以自行诉讼（pro se）身份出现；常邻近姓名、Petitioner 或 Appellant。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的数量或案件计数
patterns.context: 刑事判决论述定罪罪名数量，或判决文本中的孤立编号；共同点较弱。

patterns.name: 法院意见／记录的购买广告
patterns.context: 说明判决脚注或简短裁决内容后，接购买完整法院记录的广告。

patterns.name: 界面回调方法名
patterns.context: 代码问答中，讨论点击图标未触发 Android 的 onOptionsItemSelected 回调。

patterns.name: 抗体靶标描述
patterns.context: 医学论文引言中介绍 natalizumab 及其针对的分子靶标。

patterns.name: 粒子物理衰变与不变量
patterns.context: 讨论 B 介子衰变、轻子不对称性及 dilepton 不变质量。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的日期／程序标题
patterns.context: 法院文书的日期行和案件程序标题附近。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的法院与法官信息
patterns.trigger: «Eastern»2 District of North Carolina；«District Judge»；«Fourth»4« Circuit»2
patterns.context: 判决抬头或案情段落中列出法院、巡回区或法官。

en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly in U.S. court judgments, including motions, appellate arguments, evidentiary procedures, and criminal convictions and sentencing; it also appears around callback method names and permission handling in Android Q&A. The commonality leans toward formal procedural narratives, but the technical passages do not fully fit.

patterns.name: Motions and rulings in legal judgments
patterns.context: Discusses a court or party filing, granting, or denying a motion, often in procedural history and ruling narratives.

patterns.name: Criminal convictions and sentences
patterns.context: Describes criminal charges, convictions, sentencing, or incarceration outcomes.

patterns.name: Appellate review and legal arguments
patterns.context: Evaluates claims, legal rules, and procedural issues in an appeal or review context.

patterns.name: Litigation claims, evidence, and procedural preservation
patterns.context: Discusses whether a claim was raised, whether evidence was sufficient, or whether an issue was preserved at trial.

patterns.name: Method names in StackExchange technical questions
patterns.context: An Android developer asks about a callback not firing, permission handling, or method overriding; activation occurs near code identifiers.

10_1778.concept: 程序与裁决叙述
10_1778.description: 激活主要集中于美国法院判决中的动议、上诉论证、证据程序及刑事定罪量刑；另见 Android 问答中回调方法名与权限处理。共同点偏向正式程序叙述，但技术段落不完全吻合。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的动议与裁决
patterns.context: 讨论法院或当事方提出、准许或驳回动议，常见于程序经过及裁决叙述。

patterns.name: 刑事定罪与刑罚
patterns.context: 描述刑事指控、定罪、量刑或服刑结果。

patterns.name: 上诉审查及法律论证
patterns.context: 在上诉或复议语境中评述主张、法律规则及程序问题。

patterns.name: 诉讼主张、证据与程序保全
patterns.context: 论述主张是否提出、证据是否充分，或是否在审判阶段保留争议。

patterns.name: StackExchange 技术问题中的方法名
patterns.context: Android 开发者询问回调未触发、权限处理或方法覆盖问题；代码标识符附近激活。

en.description: Activation is distributed across heterogeneous texts: Android menu and permission callbacks, drug-targeted therapy, event-source APIs, XAML UI code, and legal terms involving motions, convictions, sentencing, and supervision in judgments; there is no shared trigger word.

patterns.name: Android options menu handling
patterns.context: Asks how to navigate to the home activity after clicking the home icon in the action bar; mentions adding a menu callback and checking an android.R id.

patterns.name: Cancer receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitors
patterns.context: Discusses ER-negative disease, preclinical research, and clinical trials, describing drug intervention or prevention strategies.

patterns.name: Android runtime permission callback
patterns.context: Camera fails to open due to a permission exception; mentions requesting permission at runtime and a method that needs to be overridden.

patterns.name: HER2-targeted therapy and drug names
patterns.context: Lists targeted therapies for HER2 and its dimerization partners, including monoclonal antibodies and TKIs.

patterns.name: Event-source removal API
patterns.context: Describes trying several approaches, then removing all event sources before adding them one by one.

patterns.name: DockPanel/Home Screen markers
patterns.context: A XAML/XML snippet contains UI comments, DockPanel properties, and trigger tags.

patterns.name: Government motion in a criminal case
patterns.context: A judgment recounts that a charge was later dismissed by the district court on the government's motion, followed by remand proceedings.

patterns.name: Court-martial judgment narrative

en.description: Multiple strong activations fall on the DB letter string or its embedded forms (DBMD, InnoDB, MDB, N2DB, GDB), across medical, biological, software, and hardware texts; sporadic activations also occur in email IDs and web instructions, indicating the pattern is not tied to a single semantic category.

patterns.name: Duchenne/Becker muscular dystrophy abbreviations

patterns.name: ARALIP mutant database abbreviation
patterns.context: At the end of a database or directory name describing information about Arabidopsis acyl-lipid metabolism mutants.

patterns.name: DB in cell line names
patterns.context: Appears within the cell line name “MDBK cells”, in a biological context involving the cell cycle and replication experiments.

patterns.name: Database configuration and storage engine identifier
patterns.context: As part of a storage engine name in database server configuration instructions.

patterns.name: DB marker near message queue code
patterns.context: “MDB looks like” appears after Java message queue code; the code involves JMS, queues, and message-driven beans.

patterns.name: N2DB hardware decoding marker
patterns.context: An abbreviated label for hardware data bus buffer control, alongside N2MD, N2IO, and N2V.

patterns.name: DB in email identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in the opaque identifier string of an email Message-ID, with no visible semantic database usage.

patterns.name: GDB in paths/filenames
patterns.context: Appears in the URL path and filename of GNU debugger documentation.

patterns.name: Interface/step text not classifiable as a DB pattern
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across web-style instruction text and adjacent content; the visible excerpts contain no clear DB string or semantic association.

10_1806.description: 多处强激活落在 DB 字母串或其嵌入形式（DBMD、InnoDB、MDB、N2DB、GDB）上，横跨医学、生物学、软件与硬件文本；另有邮件 ID 和网页指令中的零散激活，说明模式并非单一语义。
