en.description: Activations are scattered across tokenized subword fragments, Virtual phrases, networking and database terminology, code punctuation, and mathematical symbols; similar surface cues occur, but semantic and stylistic differences are too large to confirm a unified trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Tokenized subwords in proper nouns
patterns.context: Proper nouns or ordinary words are split into multiple subword tokens, especially where the segmentation itself forms a salient subword fragment; «rist», «Duc», «Kom», «is», and «verse» activate strongly in the examples

patterns.name: Phrases beginning with Virtual
patterns.context: Virtual appears at the beginning of a phrase or proper noun; in the fifth excerpt it is followed by split extensible and a network name

patterns.name: Communications and networking terminology
patterns.context: Technical terms appear in descriptions related to communications and networking

patterns.name: DB fragment in proper nouns
patterns.context: The letter string DB occurs in the disease abbreviation DMD and the database proper noun MongoDB, in different contexts

patterns.name: Punctuation and formatting in code comments
patterns.context: Semicolons, hyphens, periods, and comment markers are dense near code comments or class definitions

patterns.name: Symbol patterns in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Short mathematical or typeset fragments, with variable l, minus signs, numbers, and punctuation together

10_1806.description: 激活分散于切分后的词片段、Virtual短语、网络与数据库术语、代码标点及数学符号；相似表面线索存在，但语义和文体差异大，无法确认统一触发模式。

patterns.name: 专名中的切分子词
patterns.context: 专名或普通词被分成多个子词 token，尤其是分段本身形成较突出的词片段；例中 «rist»、«Duc»、«Kom»、«is»、«verse» 激活较强
patterns.domain: 邮件、医学摘要、议会文本

patterns.name: Virtual 开头的短语
patterns.context: Virtual 出现在短语或专名开头；在第5段后接被拆分的 extensible 及网络名称

patterns.name: 通信网络技术词汇
patterns.context: 通信、网络相关描述中出现技术术语

patterns.name: 专名中的 DB 片段
patterns.context: 字母串 DB 出现在疾病缩写 DMD 与数据库专名 MongoDB 中，周围语境不同

patterns.name: 代码注释中的标点与格式
patterns.context: 代码注释或类定义附近，分号、连字符、句点及注释标记密集出现

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的符号模式
patterns.context: 简短数学或排版片段，变量 l、减号、数字与标点并列

en.concept: Multiple subword fragments and formatting features
en.description: Activations are scattered across fragments within English and Finnish words, number sequences, and academic proper nouns; medical abstracts, mathematical text, parliamentary text, and conference schedules have different triggering cues, making it difficult to attribute them to a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Number sequences
patterns.context: Consecutive Arabic numerals separated by spaces, resembling a list or numbered sequence; no other context.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within specific words
patterns.context: Activations fall on split English word fragments, especially fragments within words; semantic and morphological conditions vary across examples.
patterns.domain: English biomedical terms in PubMed abstracts and general academic vocabulary

patterns.name: Fragments within Finnish words
patterns.context: Finnish words are split into subword fragments; activations involve fragments within longer words and committee-related word forms.

patterns.name: Bisalbuminuria and bisalbuminemia word family
patterns.context: Similar terms such as bisalbuminuria and bisalbuminemia appear in medical case report titles, with activations across fragments within the words.
patterns.domain: PubMed case reports involving nephrotic syndrome

patterns.name: Local word fragments in formal mathematical text
patterns.context: Several common English word fragments and mathematical variables activate near theorems, conditions, or symbolic expressions, with no single clear trigger word.

patterns.name: Conference date and time records
patterns.context: Fragments such as the event title, date, and time activate together in a conference entry.
patterns.domain: Public health conference schedules or footnotes

patterns.name: Thromboxane and vasoconstriction terminology
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across biochemical terms such as vascular endothelium, thromboxane, constriction, and 5-hydroxytryptamine.
patterns.domain: PubMed biomedical abstracts involving the rat basilar artery

10_1806.concept: 多类词片段与格式特征
10_1806.description: 激活散布于英文及芬兰语词内片段、数字序列和学术专名中；医学摘要、数学文本、议会文本与会议日程均有不同触发线索，难以归为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 数字序列
patterns.context: 连续空格分隔的阿拉伯数字，像列表或编号序列；无其他上下文。
patterns.domain: 来源标注为 PhilPapers 的孤立文本片段

patterns.name: 特定词内的子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的英文词片段上，尤其是单词内部的片段；各段语义与词形条件并不统一。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要中的英文生物医学术语，以及一般学术词汇

patterns.name: 芬兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 芬兰语词被拆为子词片段；激活分别涉及较长词中的词内片段及委员会相关词形。

patterns.name: 白蛋白尿与白蛋白血症词族
patterns.context: 医学病例标题中出现 bisalbuminuria、bisalbuminemia 等相近术语，激活覆盖词内片段。
patterns.domain: PubMed 病例报告，涉及肾病综合征

patterns.name: 形式化数学文本中的局部词片段
patterns.context: 定理、条件或符号表达附近，多个常见英文词片段和数学变量均有激活，未见单一明确触发词。

patterns.name: 会议日期时间记录
patterns.context: 会议条目中，活动标题、日期与时间等片段同时激活。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生会议日程或脚注

patterns.name: 血栓烷与血管收缩术语
patterns.context: 激活分布在血管内皮、血栓烷、收缩及 5-hydroxytryptamine 等生化术语中。
patterns.domain: PubMed 生物医学摘要，涉及大鼠基底动脉

en.description: Most activations fall on optic: it usually refers to the optic nerve/optic chiasm, but also to optical components of intraocular lenses, optical waveguides, or the optic tectum; contexts span ophthalmology, neuroscience, and photonics, with one unexplained excerpt.

patterns.name: Optic nerve anatomy and pathology
patterns.context: Discusses the anatomy, injury, atrophy, or regeneration of retinal ganglion cells, the optic nerve, and the optic chiasm; includes ophthalmology and neuroscience literature.

patterns.name: Optic component of an intraocular lens
patterns.context: Optic refers to the optical component of an intraocular lens, not the optic nerve; appears in discussions of surgical procedures or lens design.

patterns.name: Optic in optical waveguides
patterns.context: Part of the term optical/optic waveguide, discussing connections between optical fibers and integrated waveguides; activation is annotated on optic.

patterns.name: Optic tectum-related terminology
patterns.context: Related to hypothalamic/midbrain networks and neuron teaching models; optic-tectum is a compound anatomical term.

patterns.name: Unclassifiable remaining excerpt
patterns.context: There is no obvious optic trigger in the cosmological parameter and power spectrum context, so the provided excerpt does not explain why this segment is listed as highly activated.

10_1806.description: 多数激活落在 optic：常指视神经/视交叉，也指人工晶状体光学部件、光学波导或 optic tectum；跨眼科、神经科学与光子学语境，另有一段无法解释。

patterns.name: 视神经解剖与病变
patterns.trigger: «optic»10（以及同句中的 optic nerve、optic nerve head、optic chiasm）
patterns.context: 讨论视网膜神经节细胞、视神经及视交叉的解剖、损伤、萎缩或再生；包括眼科与神经科学文献。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、眼科/神经科学

patterns.name: 人工晶状体的 optic 部件
patterns.context: optic 指人工晶状体的光学部件，而非视神经；出现在手术操作或晶状体设计讨论中。

patterns.name: 光学波导中的 optic
patterns.context: 作为 optical/optic waveguide 术语的一部分，讨论光纤与集成波导的连接；激活标注落在 optic。

patterns.name: 视顶盖神经元相关术语
patterns.context: 与下丘脑/中脑网络及神经元教学模型相关，optic-tectum 是复合解剖术语。

patterns.name: 无法明确归类的余段
patterns.trigger: “EE power spectrum”等；未见标注的 optic
patterns.context: 宇宙学参数与功率谱语境中没有明显的 optic 触发项，无法由给定片段解释该段被列为高激活的原因。

en.concept: Text dense with numbers and symbols
en.description: Activations span multiple text types: mathematical problems notably contain numbers, punctuation, variables, powers, and operators; other examples include numerical/symbolic content in scientific papers, chemical formulas, citation inequalities, physics terminology, and patent boilerplate. No trigger condition unifies all excerpts.

patterns.name: Ordinary mathematical numbers and punctuation
patterns.context: Punctuation appears adjacent to numbers in number sequences or lists; no specific mathematical content is required
patterns.domain: Mathematical text, problems, or numerical data

patterns.name: Variables in algebraic expressions
patterns.context: Variables appear in polynomial, exponential, or fractional expressions, often with problem wording such as “Determine y”, “What is the x'th term”, or “Simplify”

patterns.name: English math problem prompts
patterns.context: Introduces a calculation, simplification, or term-finding problem; tokens near some prompts activate weakly, while strong activations mainly fall on numbers, symbols, and variables

patterns.name: Minus signs and arithmetic operators
patterns.context: Operators occur between numbers, variables, or powers to form expressions; minus signs also appear in negative numbers and fractions in parentheses

patterns.name: Scientific notation and Greek symbols
patterns.context: A timescale is expressed as an approximate value and in scientific notation in a derivation of platelet half-life

patterns.name: Patent boilerplate in background descriptions
patterns.context: Describes existing vehicle designs based on patent documents; the sentence continues while describing the front-wheel structure

patterns.name: Chemical formulas and atmospheric composition of celestial bodies
patterns.context: Lists hydrocarbons detected in Titan’s atmosphere and mentions the Voyager 1 flyby

patterns.name: Citations and relational symbols in mathematical papers
patterns.context: Presents a mathematical result using author citations and inequalities, with reference markers nearby

patterns.name: Electron gas physics terminology and parameters
patterns.context: Discusses the validity range of a simulation and explains the ratio of a dimensionless parameter to particle spacing and the Bohr radius

10_1806.description: 激活覆盖多类文本：数学题中尤见数字、标点、变量、幂与运算符；另有科学论文中的数值/符号、化学式、引文不等式、物理术语及专利套语，未见能统一解释全部片段的触发条件。

patterns.name: 普通数学数字与标点
patterns.context: 数字序列或数字列表中，标点紧邻数字出现；不要求特定数学内容
patterns.domain: 数学文本、题目或数值数据

patterns.name: 代数表达式中的变量
patterns.context: 变量出现在多项式、指数或分式表达式中，常伴随“Determine y”“What is the x'th term”“Simplify”等题目措辞

patterns.name: 英文数学题目提示语
patterns.context: 引出数学计算、化简或求项的问题；部分提示语附近的 token 激活较弱，强激活主要落在数字、符号和变量上

patterns.name: 负号与算术运算符
patterns.context: 运算符夹在数字、变量或幂之间，组成算式；负号也出现在负数及括号内的分式中

patterns.name: 科学记数法与希腊符号
patterns.context: 在血小板半衰期的推导中，将时间尺度写成近似数值与科学记数法
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文中的定量计算

patterns.name: 专利背景叙述中的套语
patterns.trigger: “In recent years,”“a study about a vehicle,”“as disclosed in below-identified Patent Document 1”
patterns.context: 以专利文件为依据介绍既有车辆方案，句子在说明前轮结构处延续

patterns.name: 化学式与天体大气成分
patterns.context: 列举泰坦大气中检测到的烃类，并提及旅行者1号飞掠

patterns.name: 数学论文的引文与关系符号
patterns.context: 以作者引文和不等式陈述数学结果，周围含有参考文献标记

patterns.name: 电子气物理术语与参数
patterns.trigger: “finite temperature”“high degeneracy”“Brueckner parameter rs=a/aB”及“mean interparticle distance”
patterns.context: 讨论模拟有效性范围，并解释无量纲参数与粒子间距、玻尔半径的比值

en.description: Strong activations occur on text containing groups of algebraic power-expression simplification problems, especially power-expression answers after assumptions that variables are positive, new problems beginning with “Simplify”, and negative or fractional exponents written with **.

patterns.name: Answers to power-expression simplification problems
patterns.context: The preceding text contains an algebraic expression with variables, fractional exponents, and nested multiplication/division; variables are first declared positive, followed by the simplified power expression as the answer.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics; symbolic algebra exercises or problem solutions

patterns.name: Simplify prompt
patterns.context: Begins the next algebra simplification problem, followed by an expression with powers, variables, and parentheses; often appears after the previous answer.

patterns.name: Powers and exponent notation
patterns.context: Nested algebraic expressions use double asterisks for exponentiation; exponents are often negative or fractional, and the same variable recurs within an expression.
patterns.domain: Symbolic mathematics / machine-readable or programmatic problem text

10_1806.description: 对成组的代数幂式化简题文本有强激活，尤其是变量正值假设后的幂式答案、以“Simplify”开头的新题，以及用 ** 表示的负或分数指数。

patterns.name: 幂式化简题的答案
patterns.trigger: “assuming … is positive.” 后换行，给出形如变量的幂（如 «f»3«**(…)，«h»3«**(…)，«t»3**(…)）
patterns.context: 前文是含变量、分数指数及嵌套乘除的代数式；先声明变量为正，再输出化简后的幂式答案。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics；符号代数练习或题目解答

patterns.name: Simplify 提示
patterns.context: 作为下一道代数化简题的开头，后接含幂、变量及括号的表达式；多出现在前一道答案之后。

patterns.name: 幂与指数符号
patterns.context: 嵌套代数式把双星号用作乘方符号，指数常为负数或分数，且同一变量反复出现。
patterns.domain: 符号数学／机器可读或程序化题目文本

en.description: Primarily covers numbers, variables, and symbols in mathematical problem expressions, especially differentiation, power-expression simplification, comparison, and common-denominator problems; it also responds to paper citation numbers, digits in web date links, and numbers in ordinal decimal lists.

patterns.name: Differentiating algebraic expressions
patterns.context: A mathematical expression asks for differentiation with respect to a specified variable, or asks for a first or second derivative; activations also fall on numbers, variables, and symbols within the expression

patterns.name: Simplifying exponential expressions
patterns.context: Asks to simplify an algebraic expression containing variable powers and fractions, often with the condition that variables are positive; activations are distributed over exponents and expression numbers

patterns.name: Numerical comparison and true/false judgments
patterns.context: Asks to compare fractions or negative numbers, or determine whether a proposition is true or false; markers concentrate on values and comparison operands

patterns.name: Common denominators and least common multiples
patterns.context: Asks for the least common multiple of two numbers or the common denominator of fractions, followed by a numerical answer

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols or number strings
patterns.context: In short mathematical Q&A excerpts, activations fall on isolated symbols, numbers, or judgment words and cannot be fully assigned to a specific operation type

patterns.name: Literature citation identifiers
patterns.context: A mathematics paper cites authors and MR reference numbers; activations fall on citation markers, number identifiers, and fragments within names

patterns.name: Numbers in URLs and blog timestamps
patterns.context: Blog page metadata contains an election-related title, comment links, and timestamps; markers fall on link identifiers and date/time numbers

patterns.name: Decimals in number lists
patterns.context: Numbers are ordered and separated by colons, followed by decimal values; the context and purpose are unclear
patterns.domain: Github text, possibly a numerical table or output

10_1806.description: 主要覆盖数学题中表达式数字、变量与符号，尤其求导、幂式化简、比较及公分母问题；也响应论文引文编号、网页日期链接数字和序号小数表中的数字。

patterns.name: 代数式求导
patterns.trigger: “Differentiate”“derivative”“wrt”“with respect to”，以及多项式中被标记的数字、变量和运算符
patterns.context: 数学表达式要求对指定变量求导，或询问一阶、二阶导数；激活还落在表达式内部的数字、变量和符号上

patterns.name: 指数式化简
patterns.trigger: “Simplify”“assuming … is positive”，以及幂、分数、括号中的指数表达式
patterns.context: 要求化简含变量幂和分数的代数式，常附变量为正的条件；激活分布在指数和表达式数字上

patterns.name: 数值比较与真假判断
patterns.trigger: “Which is greater”“Which is bigger”“True”“Is … >=”，以及被比较的数值
patterns.context: 要求比较分数或负数、判断命题真假；标记集中于数值和比较对象

patterns.name: 公分母与最小公倍数
patterns.context: 询问两个数的最小公倍数或分数的公分母，问题后给出数值答案

patterns.name: 数学符号或数字串
patterns.context: 短小的数学问答片段中，激活落在孤立符号、数字或判断词上，不能完全归入具体运算类型

patterns.name: 文献引文编号
patterns.context: 数学论文引用作者和 MR 文献编号；激活落在引用标记、编号数字及姓名内部片段

patterns.name: 网址与博客时间戳数字
patterns.context: 博客页面元数据含竞选相关标题、评论链接和时间戳；标记落在链接编号与日期时间数字

patterns.name: 数字列表中的小数
patterns.context: 数字按序号排列并以冒号分隔，后接小数值；上下文用途不明
patterns.domain: Github 文本，可能为数值表或输出

en.description: Responds to descriptions of localities and institutions, including sites, buildings, facilities, and transport stations and their uses; also appears in energy policy reporting and scientific equipment descriptions. Although trigger words vary, most fall on descriptions of specific places, facilities, or infrastructure.

patterns.name: Grounds and associated facilities
patterns.context: Refers to grounds within a school, estate, or historic site used for sports, events, or training; may also appear alongside associated facilities such as a house or facilities.

patterns.name: Railway stations and service areas
patterns.context: Describes a station name, the railway line it is on, its location, service area, or function as a transport hub.

patterns.name: Buildings, houses, and their locations
patterns.context: Describes a building’s structure, history, or purpose, or its relationship to places such as a lake, street, or campus.
patterns.domain: Architecture, campus, and local encyclopedias; the first excerpt describes architectural design

patterns.name: Facilities and site amenities
patterns.context: Describes facilities owned by a property or site, and amenities for activities such as games or projects.

patterns.name: Energy policy and utilities
patterns.context: Discusses the policy context, emissions, and waste disposal of nuclear power, or the business conditions of an electric utility.

patterns.name: Scientific instruments and automation equipment
patterns.context: Introduces key equipment used to automate scientific workflows and its purpose.

10_1806.description: 响应地方与机构介绍中场地、建筑、设施及交通站点等实体和用途；也见于能源政策报道与科研设备说明，触发词虽分散，但多落在具体地点、设施或基础设施的描述中。

patterns.name: grounds及其关联设施
patterns.context: 指学校、庄园或历史地点内供运动、活动或训练使用的场地；也可能与 house、facilities 等配套设施并列出现。

patterns.name: 铁路车站与服务范围
patterns.context: 介绍车站名称、所在线路、位置、服务区域或交通枢纽功能。

patterns.name: 建筑、房屋及其地点关系
patterns.context: 描述建筑及其结构、历史、用途，或建筑与湖泊、街道、校园等地点的关系。
patterns.domain: 建筑、校园与地方百科；第1段为建筑设计叙述

patterns.name: 设施及场地配套
patterns.context: 描述地产或场所拥有的设施，以及供游戏、项目等活动使用的配套。

patterns.name: 能源政策与公用事业
patterns.context: 讨论核电的政策情境、排放与废物处置，或电力公司的经营状况。

patterns.name: 科研仪器与自动化设备
patterns.context: 介绍用于自动化科研流程的关键设备及其用途。

en.concept: Mathematical power expressions and architectural descriptions
en.description: Activations cluster in two groups: mathematical variable power-expression simplification problems and architecture-related text. The latter covers historic sites, modern residential buildings, and lakeside spatial design, across varied contexts and styles.

patterns.name: Variables and exponents in mathematical power-expression simplification problems
patterns.context: Asks to simplify variable expressions with rational exponents, multiplication/division, and nested powers; assumptions that variables are positive often follow, and then an answer or next problem is given.

patterns.name: Descriptions of historic buildings and sites
patterns.context: Encyclopedic narration describes a specific building, site, or historic facility, often including its date, architectural features, or components.

patterns.name: Architectural features of modern residential buildings
patterns.context: Introduces the floors, units, appearance, or sales context of a specific modern apartment building.

patterns.name: Spatial design relating buildings to lakeshores
patterns.context: Discusses how a building layout responds to the spatial relationship between the lakeshore and the lake.

10_1806.description: 激活集中于两类：数学变量幂式化简题，及建筑相关文字；后者涵盖历史遗址、现代住宅楼和湖岸空间设计，语境与文体各异。

patterns.name: 数学幂式化简题中的变量与指数
patterns.context: 要求化简含有理数指数、乘除和嵌套幂的变量表达式；正值假设常紧随其后，随后给出答案或下一题。

patterns.name: 历史建筑与遗址的介绍
patterns.trigger: 建筑名称及其构造、历史、保存或用途描述，如“was constructed”“battery”“courtyard”“Trajanic basilica”
patterns.context: 百科式叙述具体建筑、遗址或历史设施，常包含年代、建筑特征或组成部分。

patterns.name: 现代住宅楼的建筑特征
patterns.context: 介绍具体现代公寓楼的楼层、单元、外形或销售背景。

patterns.name: 建筑与湖岸关系的空间设计
patterns.context: 讨论建筑布局如何回应湖岸与湖泊之间的空间关系。

en.description: Primarily responds to descriptions of buildings, venues, places, and institution names in encyclopedic entries, and also appears in list-style fields; there are also clear patterns for mathematical power-expression simplification problems and patent-style descriptions of device structures, which differ substantially in style and vocabulary.

patterns.name: Proper names and descriptions of buildings/facilities
patterns.context: Encyclopedic contexts introduce a building, venue, historic site, or its use, location, and history; activations are distributed across related nouns and proper-name fragments
patterns.domain: Wikipedia architecture, history, and venue entries

patterns.name: Place and institution names
patterns.context: Encyclopedic entries describe a place, administrative area, community boundary, headquarters location, or project site; related proper-name fragments and nearby words activate
patterns.domain: Wikipedia geography, community, media network, and business entries

patterns.name: List- and table-style entries
patterns.context: Section headings, field labels, or list-style information in an encyclopedic entry, rather than continuous prose

patterns.name: Rational-power expressions and simplification instructions
patterns.context: Symbolic math problems ask for simplification or an expression; activations cluster near variables, numbers, and operators

patterns.name: Patent-style device structure descriptions
patterns.context: Technical patent prose describes component connections, relative positions, and device construction

10_1806.description: 主要响应百科条目中建筑、场馆、地点及机构专名的描述，也见于列表式字段；另有明显的数学幂式化简题和专利装置结构描述模式，三者文体与词汇差异较大。

patterns.name: 建筑/设施的专名与描述
patterns.trigger: “studios”“courtyard”“complex”“Arena”“crypt”“House”“Hotel”“Park”等设施或建筑名词，常与专名相邻
patterns.context: 百科语境中介绍建筑、场馆、历史遗址或其用途、位置和历史；激活点分布在相关名词和专名片段上
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 建筑、历史与场馆条目

patterns.name: 地名与机构名
patterns.trigger: “North Dakota”“Fargo”“Jerusalem”“Shikun Chabad”“National Highway 8”等地名、机构或区域专名
patterns.context: 百科条目陈述地点、行政区、社区边界、总部位置或项目地点；相关专名片段及其邻近词激活
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 地理、社区、媒体网络与商业条目

patterns.name: 列表与表格样式的条目
patterns.context: 百科条目中的分节标题、字段标签或列表式信息，而非连续叙述
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 条目中的列表/信息栏

patterns.name: 有理数幂表达式与化简指令
patterns.trigger: “Simplify”、变量 i、s、q，以及形如“**(-1/…)”“**(…)”的幂和分数表达式
patterns.context: 符号化数学题目中要求化简或给出表达式；激活集中在变量、数字和运算符附近

patterns.name: 专利式装置结构描述
patterns.context: 以技术专利文体描述部件连接、相对位置和装置构造
patterns.domain: USPTO Backgrounds，医疗/机械装置专利

en.concept: Responses to specific word fragments and terminology
en.description: Activations occur on mathematical variables, fragments within proper names, and technical patent terms. No single stable lexical meaning or syntactic trigger is apparent; the feature may primarily respond to specific word fragments and domain vocabulary.

patterns.name: Variable tokens in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Algebraic expressions in DM Mathematics problems, especially dense expressions involving powers, fractions, and parentheses; variable letters themselves and their repetitions are marked, across varied expression structures.

patterns.name: Fragments within proper names
patterns.context: Subword fragments within proper names or labels, appearing in university names, stadium names, and parliamentary language markers. Some activations depend on fragment boundaries rather than whole words.

patterns.name: Technical terms in patent text
patterns.context: Device components, structures, and technical objects in patent background or explanatory text; multiple nouns occur across different invention topics.

10_1806.description: 激活分布于数学变量、专名内部词片和专利技术名词，未见单一稳定的词义或句法触发条件；可能主要响应特定词片及领域词汇。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的变量 token
patterns.context: DM Mathematics 题目中的代数式，尤其是幂、分数、括号等密集表达式；变量字母本身及其重复出现被标记，表达式结构各异。

patterns.name: 专名中的词片
patterns.context: 专名或名称内部的子词片；分别出现在大学校名、体育场名称和议会语言标记中。部分标记依赖词片边界而非完整词。

patterns.name: 专利文本中的技术名词
patterns.context: 专利背景或说明性文字中的设备部件、结构及技术对象；多个名词在不同发明主题中出现。

en.concept: Specific entities and relations in structured descriptions
en.description: Activations occur in structured or explanatory text, especially descriptions of components, positions, and connections in patents. They also cover institutional addresses, building and facility lists, crisis reporting, and exponent-based algebra problems, with no stable shared vocabulary.

patterns.name: Addresses and institution names
patterns.context: Author affiliations and mailing addresses following academic paper abstracts, with institution names, place names, and address fields listed consecutively.

patterns.name: Equipment components and positional descriptions in patents
patterns.context: Patent background or specification text describing device structure, connections, positions, or fluid circuits using numbers, figure references, and component names.

patterns.name: Housing and venue facility lists
patterns.context: Descriptions of the floors, rooms, facilities, seating, and other spatial arrangements in buildings or venues, often presented as lists or promotional text.

patterns.name: Facility unavailability during a crisis
patterns.context: Accounts of medical facilities ceasing operations or being unable to provide services during a conflict or emergency.

patterns.name: Powers and variables in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Math problems asking to simplify algebraic expressions containing variables, negative exponents, and fractional exponents, with conditions on the variables.

10_1806.concept: 结构化描述中的具体实体与关系
10_1806.description: 激活见于结构化或说明性文字，尤其是专利中对部件、位置和连接的描述；也覆盖机构地址、建筑设施清单、危机报道及指数代数题，未见稳定的共同词项。

patterns.name: 地址与机构名称
patterns.trigger: “Instituto de Física, Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Sul”
patterns.context: 学术论文摘要后出现作者单位和邮寄地址，机构名、地名及地址字段连续排列。

patterns.name: 专利中的设备部件与位置描述
patterns.trigger: “pit … recessed in the floor”；“evaporator … compensation chamber”；“cylinder … fluid tube”；“connector … male housing … lock arm”；“steam supply line … heat exchanger”
patterns.context: 专利背景或说明书以编号、图号和部件名描述设备结构、连接关系、位置或流体回路。

patterns.name: 住房与场馆设施清单
patterns.trigger: “en suite bathrooms and storage areas”；“basement … cellar/games room”；“Amenities”；“seating sections”
patterns.context: 介绍建筑或场馆的楼层、房间、设施、座位等空间配置，常以清单或宣传性文字呈现。

patterns.name: 危机中的设施不可用
patterns.context: 叙述冲突或紧急情境下，某地的医疗设施停止运作或无法提供服务。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的幂与变量
patterns.context: 数学题要求化简含变量、负指数和分数指数的代数式，并附带变量条件。

en.description: Primarily responds to equipment components and facilities that are numbered, located, connected, or functionally described in technical text. It also responds to venue and residential layouts, proper names and word forms in Romanian parliamentary text, and place names and expressions of hospital incapacity in conflict reporting.

patterns.name: Components and structures in patent technical descriptions
patterns.context: Device or system structure and operation described through numbered components, positions (“lower portion”, “upper portion”, “first end”), and relations such as connection, flow, and installation; activations often fall on components, media, positions, and relational words.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent background or technical description

patterns.name: Building and residential facilities and spatial layouts
patterns.context: Descriptions of the arrangement of spaces, rooms, and facilities in venues or residences, often with details on floors, uses, quantities, or sizes.

patterns.name: Specific word forms in Romanian political news
patterns.context: Romanian sentences discussing the European Parliament’s concern for Gaza and Palestinians; activations involve proper names and Romanian word forms with diacritics.

patterns.name: Reporting on damage to medical facilities in Aleppo
patterns.context: Reports of medical facilities being unable to operate during a conflict or emergency; activations in the passage concentrate on the place name and expressions of absence or incapacity after “without”.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central humanitarian crisis or public health text

10_1806.description: 主要响应技术说明中被编号、定位、连接或描述功能的设备部件与设施；另也响应场馆和住宅空间配置、罗马尼亚语议会文本中的专名及词形，以及冲突报道中的地点和医院失能表达。

patterns.name: 专利技术描述中的部件与结构
patterns.trigger: 反复出现的部件名词及其空间/功能关系，如“station wagon”“rear region”“trunk”“floor assembly”“condenser”“vapor line”“stationary chamber portion”“suction port”“fluid flow line”“tubular body”“inlet device”“steam trap”“condensate tank”“loading dock”“pit”
patterns.context: 以编号部件、位置（“lower portion”“upper portion”“first end”）和连接、流动、安装等关系，说明设备或系统结构与运行；激活常落在部件、介质、位置和关系词上。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景或技术说明

patterns.name: 建筑房屋设施与空间配置
patterns.context: 介绍场馆或住宅中空间、房间及设施的配置，常伴随楼层、用途、数量或大小描述。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 场馆介绍、房产/住宅文案

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语政治新闻中的特定词形
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语句子讨论欧洲议会对加沙及巴勒斯坦人的关切；激活涉及专名与带变音符号的罗马尼亚语词形。

patterns.name: 阿勒颇医疗设施受损报道
patterns.trigger: “eastern part of Aleppo”“without any functioning hospitals”
patterns.context: 报道冲突或紧急情况下医疗设施无法运作；本段激活集中在地点名及“without”后的缺失/失能表达。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 人道危机或公共卫生文本

en.description: Activations span diverse entities and contexts: place names, political statements, addresses, security, venue seating, and patent structures. A few passages share references to vents, air discharge, or facility failure, but this does not explain the remaining passages.

patterns.name: Missing, non-functioning, or discharged objects
patterns.context: Expressions involving without, functioning, exhausted, discharged, and similar words describe unavailable facilities or gas discharged from a system.
patterns.domain: Humanitarian relief reports; patent technical descriptions

patterns.name: Vents and escaping air
patterns.context: In technical descriptions, vent occurs near references to air, discharge, or escape.

patterns.name: Silicon Valley in a place name
patterns.context: Focus on Silicon Valley in university campus names, place headings, and location descriptions.

patterns.name: Shikun Chabad in a place name
patterns.context: A proper name in a description of a Jerusalem neighborhood, appearing after the place heading.

patterns.name: Rio Grande do Sul in an institutional address
patterns.context: The name of a Brazilian state appears in paper author and mailing addresses.

patterns.name: Italian “suppongo” followed by a political institution
patterns.context: In an Italian parliamentary discussion, suppongo is followed by references to the European Parliament and committee oversight.

patterns.name: Security and access control in restricted areas
patterns.context: Descriptions of people entering or leaving, restricted access, or management of secure areas.

patterns.name: Park facilities and audience seating
patterns.context: Entries about sports venues list seating facilities for spectators.

patterns.name: Male and female connector housings and locking arms
patterns.context: Patents describing connector structure and its connection and locking mechanisms.

patterns.name: Threads and vent holes in dental posts
patterns.context: Dental restoration patents describing dental post fixation and air release during insertion.

10_1806.description: 激活覆盖多种互不相同的实体与语境：地点专名、政治语句、地址、安保、场馆座席及专利结构；少数片段共同涉及 vent、空气排出或设施失效，但不足以解释其余段落。

patterns.name: 缺失、未能运作或排出的对象
patterns.trigger: “without any functioning hospitals”；“air … exhausted through a stack … to the atmosphere”；“air … discharged to the atmosphere”
patterns.context: 围绕 without、functioning、exhausted、discharged 等词，描述设施不可用或气体从系统排出。
patterns.domain: 人道救援报道；专利技术说明

patterns.name: 通风口及空气逸出
patterns.trigger: “vent … to permit escape of the air”；“vent to the atmosphere”
patterns.context: 技术描述中，vent 与空气、排出或逸出过程相邻。

patterns.name: 地点名中的 Silicon Valley
patterns.context: 大学校区名称、地点标题及其位置介绍中，重点落在 Silicon Valley。

patterns.name: 地点名中的 Shikun Chabad
patterns.context: 耶路撒冷社区介绍中的专名，位于地点标题之后。

patterns.name: 机构地址中的 Rio Grande do Sul
patterns.trigger: “Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Sul”
patterns.context: 论文作者地址及邮政地址中出现巴西州名。

patterns.name: 意大利语「suppongo」后接政治机构
patterns.context: 意大利语议会讨论中，suppongo 后转入欧洲议会及委员会监督。

patterns.name: 受限区域的安保与出入控制
patterns.trigger: “Access to areas such as the unit's kitchen and secure external area”；“Visitors … bags searched”
patterns.context: 描述人员出入、限制进入或安全区域管理。

patterns.name: 公园设施与观众座席
patterns.trigger: “AutoZone Park contains several special seating sections”
patterns.context: 体育场馆条目中列举供观众使用的座席设施。

patterns.name: 连接器的公母壳体及锁臂
patterns.trigger: “male and female housings”；“male housing … has a lock arm”
patterns.context: 专利中描述连接器结构及其连接、锁定机制。

patterns.name: 牙桩中的螺纹与通气孔
patterns.trigger: “external thread”；“A vent … permit escape of the air during insertion”
patterns.context: 牙科修复专利描述牙桩固定及插入时排气。

en.description: Activations span structural descriptions of patent devices and housings, addresses and place names, “warehouse” in a station context, and accounts related to facility conditions and accessibility. These patterns cross domains, with no single stable semantic trigger apparent.

patterns.name: Device structures and components in patents
patterns.context: Descriptions of component installation, construction, position, and function within housings, tubular bodies, or connectors; often include figure labels and claim-style technical wording.

patterns.name: Place-name fragments in institutional or location names
patterns.context: Place names occur in addresses, institutional affiliations, or location descriptions; some activations fall on tokenized fragments of place names.
patterns.domain: Academic addresses or encyclopedia geography descriptions

patterns.name: The term warehouse
patterns.context: The word itself receives very strong activation in historical descriptions of railway branches and station facilities; nearby context mentions station buildings and locations.

patterns.name: Facility sanitation and accessibility
patterns.context: Accounts of poor workplace conditions, or whether medical facilities are accessible and operational in emergencies.
patterns.domain: Legal case facts, public health or humanitarian reports

10_1806.description: 激活覆盖专利中装置与壳体的结构描述、地址及地名、车站语境中的“warehouse”，以及设施条件和可达性相关叙述；这些模式跨领域，未见单一稳定语义触发。

patterns.name: 专利中的装置结构与部件
patterns.context: 描述部件在壳体、管状主体或连接器中的安装、构造、位置及功能；常含附图标号和权利要求式技术措辞。

patterns.name: 机构或地点名称中的地名片段
patterns.context: 地名出现在地址、机构署名或地点介绍中；部分触发落在切分后的地名 token 上。
patterns.domain: 学术地址或百科地理介绍

patterns.name: 仓库这一词项
patterns.context: 铁路支线、车站设施的历史描述中，词本身获得极强激活；邻近语境提及车站建筑和地点。

patterns.name: 设施卫生与无障碍状况
patterns.context: 叙述工作场所恶劣条件，或紧急情况下医疗设施是否可达、是否运作。
patterns.domain: 法律诉讼事实、公共卫生或人道主义报告

en.concept: Proper names and formatted text fragments
en.description: Activations span Romanian parliamentary passages, patent structural descriptions, encyclopedia place names and technology parks, academic addresses and equipment models, email signatures, and personal names. They often fall on tokenized proper names, terminology, numbers, and punctuation, with no unified semantic pattern apparent.

patterns.name: Marked fragments within proper names
patterns.context: Activations fall on tokenized fragments within proper names or domain terms; the trigger position varies across contexts.
patterns.domain: Parliamentary text, encyclopedias, institutional addresses, academic papers

patterns.name: Romanian word fragments
patterns.context: Romanian words are split into subwords, with activations distributed across ordinary words and fragments of proper names.

patterns.name: Structural and functional descriptions in patents
patterns.context: Technical terms and modal/copular verbs in patent background paragraphs describe components, positions, and structural relations.

patterns.name: Place and institution names
patterns.context: Place and institution names occur in geography or public-service descriptions, alongside everyday encyclopedia prose.

patterns.name: Parliamentary turns and forms of address
patterns.context: Parliamentary speeches address members or committee members and include procedural language for handing over the floor or addressing someone directly.

patterns.name: Proper names and number formats in addresses
patterns.context: Institutional abbreviations, street addresses, postal codes, and city names appear together in paper footers or address fields.

patterns.name: Names, schools, and mailing addresses
patterns.context: Email signature blocks list personal titles, departments, schools, and mailing information.

patterns.name: Microscopy equipment and models
patterns.context: Methods sections list microscopy procedures, equipment manufacturers, models, and locations.

patterns.name: Technology companies and building numbers
patterns.context: Encyclopedia descriptions of technology-company clusters and institutions occupying buildings, floors, or numbered buildings.

patterns.name: Possible word-final or sentence-boundary responses
patterns.context: Markers are distributed across punctuation, line breaks, common words, and proper names, with no clear, stable syntactic condition across the corpus.

10_1806.concept: 专名与格式化文本片段
10_1806.description: 激活分布于罗马尼亚语议会片段、专利结构描述、百科地名与科技园区、学术地址和设备型号、邮件签名及人物专名；常落在被切分的专名、术语、数字和标点上，未见统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 专名内部的标记性片段
patterns.context: 专名或领域术语中，激活落在分词后的词片段上；不同语境里触发位置并不一致。
patterns.domain: 议会文本、百科、机构地址、学术论文

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词片段
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语词语被切分成子词，激活分散在普通词及专名片段中。
patterns.domain: 罗马尼亚语欧洲议会发言

patterns.name: 专利结构与功能描述
patterns.context: 专利背景段落用技术名词和情态／系动词描述部件、位置及结构关系。

patterns.name: 地名与机构名称
patterns.context: 地理或公共服务介绍中出现地名、机构名；同时含有日常百科叙述。

patterns.name: 议会轮次与称谓
patterns.context: 议会发言中称呼议员或委员，并出现交接发言、直接致辞等程序语句。
patterns.domain: 罗马尼亚语欧洲议会记录

patterns.name: 地址中的专名与数字格式
patterns.context: 论文页脚／地址字段中，机构缩写、街道地址、邮编和城市名集中出现。

patterns.name: 姓名、学校与邮寄地址
patterns.context: 邮件签名区列出个人职衔、院系、学校及邮寄信息。

patterns.name: 显微镜设备与型号
patterns.context: 方法部分列出显微镜检查方式、设备厂商、型号和地点。

patterns.name: 科技公司与建筑编号
patterns.context: 百科描述科技公司聚集区及机构占用建筑、楼层或建筑编号。

patterns.name: 可能的词尾或句界响应
patterns.context: 标记分散在标点、换行、常见词和专名中；没有跨语料稳定的明确句法条件。

en.description: Activations often fall on proper names and their subwords, institutions or place names, and address formats. They also occur in medical institution/facility terms, parliamentary forms of address, patent functional descriptions, and pseudo-Latin fragments; there is no stable shared semantic condition across passages.

patterns.name: Institutional proper names, places, and entity names
patterns.context: Occurs in proper names or institutional addresses, often on tokenized fragments within proper names, punctuation after proper names, or city/state names in addresses; does not consistently correspond to a fixed word form.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including papers, medical materials, parliamentary records, patents, and encyclopedias

patterns.name: Institution and place address formats
patterns.context: Addresses, city and state names, and postal code formats follow academic units, companies, or institution names; activations often occur near proper-name fragments and punctuation.
patterns.domain: Author addresses and institutional source information in papers and medical materials

patterns.name: Medical and facility-related terms
patterns.context: Occurs when describing medical institutions, cells, emergency facilities, and personnel; wording varies and there is no consistent medical syntax.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, public health materials, encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Place-name or noun fragments in continuous text
patterns.context: Place names in encyclopedia or news-style prose, as well as cemetery names; activations favor subwords within proper names rather than a consistent semantic category.

patterns.name: Functional structural descriptions in patents
patterns.context: Descriptions of dental post structure and its function, material retention, and air release.

patterns.name: Romanian parliamentary speech format
patterns.context: Formal expressions in which a parliamentary chair or speaker names someone and gives them the floor; activations concentrate near forms of address and personal names.

patterns.name: English-language literature address fields
patterns.context: A correspondence address or affiliation follows the main text; activations mainly fall on Syracuse and address formats.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in pseudo-Latin text
patterns.context: In continuous pseudo-Latin placeholder text, activations occur on subword fragments within words, with no apparent shared condition with other passages.
patterns.domain: Placeholder content in web pages or Q&A text

patterns.name: Word activations not explained by a unified pattern
patterns.context: These activations are scattered across physics, patent, and biographical contexts and cannot reliably be grouped under the proper-name, address, or medical patterns above.

10_1806.description: 激活多落在专名及其子词、机构或地名和地址格式，亦见医疗机构/设施用语、议会称谓、专利功能描述及伪拉丁碎片；不同段落间没有稳定的共同语义条件。

patterns.name: 机构专名、地点与实体名称
patterns.trigger: 人名、机构名、地名等专名片段，如“Collection”“Syracuse”“Aleppo”“Nicholson”“Silicon Valley”“Mogadishu”“Ke rep esi”
patterns.context: 处在专名或机构地址中，常见于专名内部的分词片段、专名后的标点，或地址中的城市/州名；并非稳定对应某一固定词形。
patterns.domain: 论文、医学材料、议会记录、专利、百科等多种文体

patterns.name: 机构与地点地址格式
patterns.context: 学术单位、公司或机构名称后出现的地址、城市州名和邮编格式；激活常落在专名片段及标点附近。
patterns.domain: 论文和医学材料中的作者地址、机构来源信息

patterns.name: 医学与设施相关词语

Other examples include descriptions of hospital incapacity in crisis reporting, within-word pseudo-Latin fragments, and base-arithmetic operators and answers. There is no single stable lexical meaning.

en.description: Responds strongly mainly to the PHP file opening marker «<?php», extending to opening structures such as header comments, doc comments, and namespaces; sporadic within-word fragments also activate in two Slavic-language passages, without shared context.
