patterns.name: Perl parameter validation code
patterns.context: Loops over parameters and returns early when a key or data is missing.

patterns.name: C-language Q&A and program entry point
patterns.context: A C code example and header inclusion follow a StackExchange question title.

10_2024.concept: 源码文本中的结构标记
10_2024.description: 激活分布于多种源码和代码文档，常见于行首井号、C/C++头文件与下划线标识符，也涉及文件头作者信息、注释排版，以及Ruby、Perl、结构化数据中的特定语法。

patterns.name: C/C++ 头文件引用
patterns.trigger: `#include` 后接尖括号或引号中的头文件，如 `<qmath.h>`、`<stdio.h>`、`<sys/stat.h>`
patterns.context: C/C++ 源码中预处理指令；激活集中在 include 路径的开头或头文件名附近。
patterns.domain: Github C/C++ 代码；StackExchange 编程问答

patterns.name: 下划线包围的标识符
patterns.context: 下划线出现在代码标识符、宏名或项目横幅式注释中；部分例子紧邻宏定义。

patterns.name: 井号开头的代码或注释行
patterns.trigger: 行首 `#`，包括 `# Created`、`# Project`、`# This file is part of`、`# Copyright`
patterns.context: 行首井号引出预处理指令或以井号作前缀的文件头、项目说明；有时后接空行。
patterns.domain: Github 文件头、注释及预处理代码

patterns.name: 文件头中的作者与邮箱
patterns.context: 文件开头或注释中记录作者、邮箱或版权信息；激活涉及人名、尖括号及邮箱符号。

patterns.name: 源码注释横幅与装饰线
patterns.context: 文件顶部以井号注释、空格和重复符号排版的项目横幅。

patterns.name: 文档注释中的字段标题
patterns.context: 源码文件头注释中按字段列出作者、环境和修订历史，字段间有空行；随后进入条件编译代码。

patterns.name: 冻结字符串字面量标记
patterns.context: Ruby 文件开头的 magic comment，后接空行和类定义。

patterns.name: 类名及迁移相关标识符
patterns.context: Ruby 类定义中使用驼峰式业务类名，并继承迁移基类。

patterns.name: 结构化文档字段与集合数据
patterns.context: 以缩进和列表/对象结构描述集合、用户或项目及其来源 ID。
patterns.domain: Github API 或数据结构文档

patterns.name: Perl 参数校验代码
patterns.context: 循环处理参数并在缺少键或数据时提前返回。

patterns.name: C 语言问答及程序入口
patterns.context: StackExchange 问题标题后接 C 代码示例与头文件引用。

en.description: Activates mainly on underscore-separated identifiers in code and nearby declarations, assignments, and comments, and also on author emails in code file headers. Biomedical paper titles are difficult to fit into these patterns.

patterns.name: Underscores and digits in C/C++ identifiers
patterns.context: Code identifiers are split into multiple tokens, commonly in underscore-separated variable, struct, or member names; no requirement for a particular API is apparent.
patterns.domain: GitHub source code and code snippets

patterns.name: Code comments and documentation
patterns.context: Comments or documentation embedded in code describe variables, data, types, or formulas; they may appear alongside underscore-containing identifiers.
patterns.domain: Source-code comments, code documentation, and Q&A code

patterns.name: Code structure and syntax markers
patterns.context: Near declarations, preprocessor directives, member access, or assignments in source code; activations occur across multiple languages and code structures.

patterns.name: Author attribution and email
patterns.context: Copyright or creator metadata in source-file headers, with names, emails, and angle-bracket formatting.

patterns.name: Specific code identifier pcmanticore
patterns.context: Occurs in the username portion of an email address in copyright information; this proper name is one of the few triggers not sufficiently explained by common code structures or underscore-identifier patterns.

patterns.name: Compound terms in biomedical titles
patterns.context: A phrase composed of technical vocabulary appears in a paper title; it differs superficially from the other examples.

patterns.name: Visible numbers and dimension expressions
patterns.context: Numbers occur in variable names, array indices, dimensions, code parameters, or technical formulas; some may simply be part of ordinary code syntax.

10_2024.description: 主要对代码中的下划线分隔标识符及其周围的声明、赋值和注释激活，也见于代码文件头的作者邮箱。生物医学论文标题难以纳入这些模式。

patterns.name: C/C++ 标识符中的下划线与数字
patterns.context: 代码标识符被拆成多个 token，常见于下划线分隔的变量名、结构体名或成员名；未显示出必须出现某个特定 API 的条件。

patterns.name: 代码注释与文档说明
patterns.trigger: 如「/**」「Returns _path without trailing slash」「#1D list of training labels」「Channel Frequency =」
patterns.context: 注释或文档文本夹在代码中，描述变量、数据、类型或公式；可能与下划线标识符同时出现。
patterns.domain: 源码注释、代码文档及问答代码

patterns.name: 代码结构与语法标记
patterns.context: 源码中的声明、预处理指令、成员访问或赋值附近；激活跨多种语言及代码结构出现。

patterns.name: 作者署名与邮箱
patterns.trigger: 「Copyright (c) 2016 Claudiu Popa <pcmant…@gmail.com>」以及「Created by: Joerg Wunsch <joerg@FreeBSD.org>」
patterns.context: 源文件头部的版权或创建者元数据，姓名、邮箱及尖括号格式同时出现。

patterns.name: 特定代码标识符 pcmanticore
patterns.context: 出现在版权信息的邮箱用户名中；这是少数无法由常见代码结构或下划线标识符模式充分解释的专名触发。

patterns.name: 生物医学标题中的复合术语
patterns.trigger: 「Multivalent 3D Display of Glycopolymer Chains for Enhanced…」
patterns.context: 论文标题中出现由专业词汇构成的短语；与其他代码段表面上不同。

patterns.name: 可见的数字及维度表达
patterns.context: 数字出现在变量名、数组索引、维度、代码参数或技术公式中；部分数字也可能只是普通代码语法的一部分。

en.description: Activations occur mostly on underscores in code identifiers and nearby fragments, especially save-related APIs; they also appear in LaTeX labels, escaped strings, and cryptographic function names, with limited cross-domain consistency.

patterns.name: Save-related APIs and events
patterns.context: Discusses saving database records, sending save signals, or retrieving content after saving; also includes save function names in code.

patterns.name: Underscores in compound identifiers
patterns.context: Occurs within code identifiers, often adjacent to function, variable, or API names; activation falls on the underscore and surrounding fragments.

patterns.name: LaTeX structure in technical text
patterns.context: Near LaTeX commands, labels, and formula environments in mathematical papers.

patterns.name: Tabs and escaped strings in code
patterns.context: When testing string escaping and its msgid representation.

patterns.name: Specific numerical-operation naming in code
patterns.context: Declarations of signed-number addition functions and related type names in C/Rust cryptography library code.

10_2024.concept: 代码标识符与结构标记
10_2024.description: 激活多出现在代码标识符的下划线及其邻近片段，尤其是 save 相关 API；另见 LaTeX 标签、转义字符串和密码学函数名，跨领域统一规律有限。

patterns.name: save 相关 API 与事件
patterns.context: 讨论保存数据库记录、发送保存信号或保存后获取内容；也包括代码中的保存函数名。

patterns.name: 复合标识符中的下划线
patterns.trigger: «_»，尤其是«entity_delete_multiple»、«tab_width»、«sample_per_part»等标识符中的下划线
patterns.context: 出现在代码标识符内部，常与函数名、变量名或 API 名相邻；激活落在下划线及其周围片段。

patterns.name: 技术文本中的 LaTeX 结构
patterns.context: 数学论文中，LaTeX 命令、标签及公式环境附近。

patterns.name: 代码中的制表符与转义字符串
patterns.context: 测试字符串转义及其 msgid 表示时。

patterns.name: 代码中的特定数值运算命名
patterns.context: C/Rust 密码学库代码中的有符号数加法函数声明及其相关类型名。

en.description: Activations span code identifiers, Java call stacks, CSS/spelling markers, whitespace, and sporadic word fragments in scientific and web text. A few repeated fragments such as the and Mar may have local associations, but overall there is no unified semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Data-structure identifiers
patterns.context: Defines or initializes datasets and database adapters in VB/.NET code; fragments of identifiers and type names activate

patterns.name: Register variable declarations
patterns.context: Consecutive declarations of register integer variables and field reads in C/C++-style code

patterns.name: Type names in Java stack traces
patterns.context: A Java exception stack trace containing a Gson reflective type-adapter call chain

patterns.name: CSS fonts and spelling markers
patterns.context: CSS style declarations and Word-style spelling markers; split properties or marker strings appear

patterns.name: String/subword fragment “the”
patterns.context: The definite article the in ordinary English and scientific text; contexts vary widely, and activation does not consistently fall on the same meaning or topic

patterns.name: “Mar” fragment
patterns.context: One instance is in the proper name Marval, another appears near a paper citation; they may also be unrelated coincidental fragments

patterns.name: Multiple-space/indentation markers
patterns.context: Whitespace or formatting spaces near code indentation and line breaks are marked; also occurs across different content types

patterns.name: Sporadic words in English prose
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across forum/web prose and product descriptions, with no stable shared local semantic or syntactic condition

patterns.name: Mathematics/physics noun fragments
patterns.context: Descriptions in string theory papers of the worldsheet, partition function, and bosonic string field theory

patterns.name: Medical imaging and production description
patterns.context: Introduces a contrast agent for cardiopulmonary imaging and its large-scale production

patterns.name: Animal communication and food sources
patterns.context: Discusses long-distance, low-frequency communication by whales and its possible transmission of information about food

patterns.name: Automotive maintenance forum narrative
patterns.context: A car owner describes problems after cleaning rubber seals and cites an automotive detailing forum

patterns.name: Task-list recommendations
patterns.context: Discusses task-list software and the desire to move secondary tasks to the background

patterns.name: App and promotion report
patterns.context: Reports on a secondhand-sales app and information about its promotional award

10_2024.description: 激活覆盖代码标识符、Java 调用栈、CSS/拼写标记、空白，以及科学和网页文本中的零散词片段。少数重复片段如 the、Mar 可能有局部关联，但整体缺乏统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 数据结构标识符
patterns.context: VB/.NET 代码中定义或初始化数据集及数据库适配器；标识符与类型名的词片段被激活

patterns.name: 寄存器变量声明
patterns.context: C/C++ 风格代码中连续声明 register 整数变量并读取字段

patterns.name: Java 堆栈跟踪中的类型名
patterns.context: Java 异常堆栈跟踪，包含 Gson 反射式类型适配器调用链

patterns.name: CSS 字体及拼写标记
patterns.context: CSS 样式声明以及 Word 风格的拼写标记；出现被拆分的属性或标记串

patterns.name: 字符串/子词片段「the」
patterns.trigger: « the»、« the»1 bosonic；« the»9 agent；« the»1 whales
patterns.context: 普通英文及科学文本中定冠词 the；所在语境差异很大，且激活并不总落在同一词义或主题上
patterns.domain: 科学论文、医学宣传、散文

patterns.name: 「Mar」词片段
patterns.context: 一处是专名 Marval，另一处在论文引用附近出现 Mar；也可能是不同词片段偶合

patterns.name: 多词空格/缩进标记
patterns.context: 代码缩进、换行附近的空白或排版空格被标记；同时出现在不同内容类型中

patterns.name: 英文叙述中的零散词语
patterns.context: 激活散落在论坛/网页叙述、产品介绍等普通文本中，未见稳定共享的局部语义或句法条件

patterns.name: 数学/物理名词片段
patterns.context: 弦论论文中关于世界面、配分函数与玻色弦场论的描述

patterns.name: 医学成像与生产描述
patterns.context: 介绍一种用于心肺成像的造影剂及其规模化生产
patterns.domain: 医学/生物技术宣传材料

patterns.name: 动物沟通与食物来源
patterns.context: 讨论鲸鱼长距离低频通信及其可能传递食物信息

patterns.name: 汽车维护论坛叙述
patterns.context: 车主叙述清洗橡胶密封件后出现问题，并引用汽车美容论坛

patterns.name: 任务清单建议
patterns.context: 讨论任务清单软件及将次要任务移至后台的愿望

patterns.name: 应用与促销报道
patterns.context: 报道二手销售应用及其促销获奖信息

en.description: All passages contain within-word subword-fragment activations, covering URLs, proper names, ordinary words, and technical terms; the fragments and contexts vary, with no stable semantic or domain-level commonality.

patterns.name: Multiple within-word subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments within proper names, ordinary words, or technical terms, with no fixed position; sometimes multiple adjacent subwords activate consecutively. No stable syntactic position, word sense, or domain condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: URLs, papers, reviews, parliamentary records, medicine, sports, lists, and biology texts

10_2024.description: 所有段都出现词内子词片段激活，覆盖网址、专名、普通词和专业术语；片段及语境多变，未见稳定的语义或领域共性。

patterns.name: 词内多子词片段
patterns.trigger: 被标记的 token 常是单词内部的片段，如 «assets»、«change»、«I»、«cb»、«Y»、«dr»、«lx»、«Mark»、«ward»、«Planet»、«Pop»、«Merc»、«i»、«Val»、«div»、«iel»、«so»、«chain»、«likely»、«is»、«Rob»、«o»、«define»、«its»、«signaling»、«the»、«best»、«offensive»、«leads»、«Bern»、«Pierre»、«Stur»、«mit»、«ogen»、«dec»、«ap»、«crust»、«sh»
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、普通词或技术词的词内片段上，片段位置不固定；有时相邻多个子词连续激活。未见稳定的句法位置、词义或领域条件。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：网址、论文、评论、议会记录、医学、体育、名单及生物学文本

en.concept: Fragmented word forms and symbol patterns
en.description: Activations often fall on fragments of proper names or terms split by tokenization, especially forms containing shrimp-related words; other cases include formula numbers and punctuation, Italian word forms, code identifiers, immunology abbreviations, and legal case names, with no unified cross-domain semantics.

patterns.name: Fragments/subwords within proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls on split word or proper-name fragments; examples include personal names, ethnic-group names, and animal names, with no unified meaning

patterns.name: Shrimp-related words
patterns.context: High activation occurs near crustaceans, shrimp, and their taxonomic names; may also overlap with fragmented proper names

patterns.name: Popcorn in a proper name or brand
patterns.context: The Pop subword in the brand name Planet Popcorn activates strongly; surrounding text discusses popcorn products

patterns.name: Numbers and separators in formulas
patterns.context: Activation occurs near numbers, commas, slashes, and formula boundaries in mathematical expressions

patterns.name: Italian word-form fragments
patterns.context: In Italian titles and body text, activation is distributed across mixed-case word fragments

patterns.name: Code identifiers and assignment structures
patterns.context: Activation occurs near identifiers, equals signs, and explanatory text in code comments or variable declarations

patterns.name: Immunology markers and abbreviations
patterns.context: Activation occurs near alphanumeric combinations and high/low markers in cell-population phenotypes and flow-sorting abbreviations

patterns.name: Case-name fragments in legal citations
patterns.context: Name subword fragments activate in case names cited in court opinions

10_2024.concept: 碎片化词形与符号模式
10_2024.description: 激活常落在分词切开的专名或术语片段上，尤其含虾类词形；另见公式数字标点、意大利语词形、代码标识符、免疫学缩写及法律案件名，跨领域无统一语义。

patterns.name: 专名内部的碎片/子词
patterns.context: 激活落在被分词切开的词或专名片段上；对象包括人名、族名、动物名等，没有统一词义

patterns.name: 虾类相关词语
patterns.context: 甲壳动物、虾及其分类名称附近出现高激活；也可能与碎片化专名重叠

patterns.name: 专名或品牌中的 Popcorn
patterns.context: 品牌名 Planet Popcorn 中的 Pop 子词强激活，周边讨论爆米花产品

patterns.name: 公式中的数字与分隔符
patterns.context: 数学表达式中数字、逗号、斜线及公式边界附近激活

patterns.name: 意大利语词形片段
patterns.context: 意大利语标题及正文中，激活分布于大小写混杂的词片段

patterns.name: 代码标识符与赋值结构
patterns.context: 代码注释或变量声明中，标识符、等号及其说明文字附近激活
patterns.domain: 软件代码、汇编/寄存器说明

patterns.name: 免疫学标记与缩写
patterns.context: 细胞群体表型和流式分选缩写中，字母数字组合及高低标记附近激活

patterns.name: 法律引文中的案件名片段
patterns.context: 法院意见引用的案件名中，姓名子词片段激活

en.description: Activations are scattered across local fragments in URLs, proper nouns, usernames, common words, code identifiers, and medical and chemical terms. The commonality may be a specific subword/character fragment rather than a shared semantic topic.

patterns.name: Tokenized substrings in domains
patterns.context: Contiguous substrings in URLs or software names are split into tokens, especially in domains, URL paths, and project names; a consistent semantic topic is not required.

patterns.name: Local substrings in personal or proper names
patterns.context: Marked word segments occur within proper names such as people and organizations; the surrounding text is a cast list or historical narrative.

patterns.name: English suffix -fty
patterns.context: An English word-ending fragment embedded in a username; a singleton, surrounded by a Hacker News comment.

patterns.name: Task-list-related phrases
patterns.context: Discusses to-do software, priorities, and task tracking; markings include list and newline characters, and it is unclear whether the trigger is topic or formatting alone.

patterns.name: Spelling fragment related to bershop / barber
patterns.context: Appears in the word “barbershop,” describing a visit to a barbershop; only one example.

patterns.name: hydr fragment within a medical term
patterns.context: Within the medical term “hydronephrosis,” discussing diagnosis after treatment; there is a clear indication of a local-substring trigger.

patterns.name: Identifiers and symbol fragments in code
patterns.context: In JavaScript/jQuery example code, markings fall on comment symbols, URLs, and variable/identifier fragments.

patterns.name: titrant fragment in a measurement term
patterns.context: Appears in an academic abstract about chemical analysis methods and titrants; only one example.

10_2024.description: 激活分散在 URL、专名、用户名、普通词、代码标识符及医学和化学术语的局部片段；共同点可能是特定子词/字符片段，而非统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 域名中的分词/子串
patterns.context: 网址或软件名称中的连续子串被拆分标记，尤其是域名、URL 路径和项目名；不要求语义主题一致。

patterns.name: 人名或专名中的局部子串
patterns.context: 人名、组织名等专名内部出现被标记的词段；所在句为演员表或历史叙述。

patterns.name: 英语词尾 -fty
patterns.context: 嵌在用户名中的英语词尾片段，单例，周围是 Hacker News 评论。

patterns.name: 任务列表相关短语
patterns.context: 谈论待办事项软件、优先级和任务记录；标记包括 list 及换行符，不能确定是否由主题或格式单独触发。

patterns.name: 词尾 bershop / barber 相关拼写片段
patterns.context: 出现在 “barbershop” 一词中，描述去理发店；仅此一例。

patterns.name: 医学词内部的 hydr 片段
patterns.context: 医学术语“hydronephrosis”内部，讨论治疗后诊断；局部子串触发迹象较明确。

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符与符号片段
patterns.context: JavaScript/jQuery 示例代码中，标记落在注释符号、URL 和变量/标识符片段上。

patterns.name: 计量术语中的 titrant 片段
patterns.context: 出现在化学分析方法与滴定剂的学术摘要中；仅此一例。

en.description: Activations are distributed across heterogeneous fragments: URL subwords, split novel text, guy, school-grade vocabulary, sports commentary, code variables, and online opinions. No single semantic or syntactic feature spans all examples.

patterns.name: Subwords in links and URLs
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on several character fragments in URLs, domains, and paths; the specific fragments vary across links.

patterns.name: Mixed-case tokenized text
patterns.context: In literary text, words are split into multiple subwords with varying capitalization, and punctuation and newlines are also marked; activations cover many fragments.

patterns.name: guy in the middle or at the end of a sentence
patterns.context: guy appears in colloquial discussions or comments; in 4 it is the username crafty guy, while in 7 and 9 it is a common noun.

patterns.name: High-school students and study-related words
patterns.context: Narratives about high-school students, school, grades, and studying; activations cover multiple content words.

patterns.name: American football commentary vocabulary
patterns.context: Sports discussions contain words about defense, teams, fans, seasons, or games.

patterns.name: Registers and variables in low-level code
patterns.context: In code comments or assembly-like fragments, variable names, register names, assignment symbols, and technical terms all activate.

patterns.name: Informal opinions combining praise and criticism
patterns.context: A first-person online comment clarifies a joke or criticism, then expresses a positive opinion of someone.

patterns.name: Segmented numbers and hyphens
patterns.context: Scores in sports sentences appear split into numbers, a hyphen, and numbers; this local activation is weak, and it is uncertain whether it reflects an independent pattern.

10_2024.description: 激活分布于多种异质片段：网址子词、拆分的小说文本、guy、学校成绩词汇、体育评论、代码变量及网络评价；未见贯穿所有段的单一语义或句法特征。

patterns.name: 链接与网址中的子词
patterns.context: 激活集中在 URL、域名和路径的若干字符片段；不同链接中的具体片段并不一致。

patterns.name: 大小写混杂的分词文本
patterns.context: 文学文本中，单词被拆成多个大小写不一的子词，标点与换行也被标记；激活覆盖许多片段。

patterns.name: 句中或句末的 guy
patterns.context: 口语化讨论或评论中出现 guy；在 4 中是用户名 crafty guy，在 7、9 中是普通名词。

patterns.name: 高中生与学习相关词语
patterns.context: 围绕高中生、学校、成绩和学习的叙述；激活覆盖多个内容词。

patterns.name: 美式橄榄球评论词汇
patterns.context: 体育讨论中出现防守、球队、球迷、赛季或比赛等词。
patterns.domain: 体育评论（橄榄球/冰球语境）

patterns.name: 低级代码中的寄存器和变量
patterns.context: 代码注释或汇编风格片段中，变量名、寄存器名、赋值符号及技术术语均有激活。

patterns.name: 褒贬并置的非正式评价
patterns.context: 第一人称网络评论先澄清玩笑或批评，再表达对某人的正面评价。

patterns.name: 分段数字与连字符
patterns.context: 体育语句中的比分以数字、连字符和数字拆分呈现；该局部激活较弱且不确定是否有独立规律。

en.description: Activations are scattered across numeric and base-notation text, proper-name substrings, common English words, email formats, URLs, literary cheering, and Spanish chat. No single semantic trigger is consistent across examples.

patterns.name: Encoded text and marker symbols
patterns.context: Appears in base-arithmetic problems, answers, or binary-style number strings; activations fall on local digits, symbols, and prompt text.

patterns.name: Local strings in personal and proper names
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across subword fragments in proper names, personal names, company names, or URLs, with no stable shared semantic context.

patterns.name: Common English words and local phrases
patterns.context: In English narratives or expository text, common words and adjacent phrases activate at multiple positions; not limited to one fixed word.

patterns.name: Document structure and email formats
patterns.context: Appears in formatted text such as email disclaimers and forwarded-message headers; activations involve formatting markers, fields, and proper names.

patterns.name: URLs and link text
patterns.context: Links embedded in web pages or discussion posts; activations are distributed across protocols, domains, paths, and their word fragments.

patterns.name: Cheering and singing expressions
patterns.context: In literary narratives of people cheering or singing, activations fall on interjections and related action words.

patterns.name: Word fragments in Spanish chat
patterns.context: In a Spanish Ubuntu IRC conversation, a sentence about being unable to access a hard drive; activations fall on substrings within words.

patterns.name: Mixed low-intensity local activations
patterns.context: These isolated fragments show some activation, but the samples do not establish a stable, independent trigger pattern.

10_2024.description: 激活分散于数字与进位制文本、专名子串、英语常见词、邮件格式、网址、文学欢呼及西班牙语聊天，未见跨段稳定的单一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 编码文本与标记符号
patterns.trigger: “In base 9, what is -24707245 + 5?”、“In base 16, what is 4 - 124f30?”及数字片段“1101”“101”“0”
patterns.context: 出现在进位制算术题、答案或二进制样式的数字串中；激活落在数字、符号及提示语的局部。

patterns.name: 人名及专名中的局部字符串
patterns.context: 激活分散在专名、人名、公司名或网址的子词片段上，没有稳定的共同语义上下文。

patterns.name: 英语常见词与局部短语
patterns.trigger: “in prosperous suburbs”、“attend good schools”、“get excellent grades”、“pretty good”
patterns.context: 位于英语叙述或说明性文字中，常见词及相邻短语多个位置都有激活；并非只限某个固定词。

patterns.name: 文档结构与邮件格式
patterns.trigger: “This e-mail is the property of…”、“-----Original Message-----”、“From:”、“Sent:”
patterns.context: 出现在邮件免责声明及转发邮件头等格式化文本中，激活涉及格式标记、字段和专名。

patterns.name: 网址及链接文本
patterns.context: 嵌在网页或讨论帖中的链接；激活分布在协议、域名、路径及其中的词片段。

patterns.name: 欢呼及歌唱表达
patterns.context: 人物欢呼或歌唱的文学叙述中，激活落在感叹词和相关动作词上。

patterns.name: 西班牙语聊天中的词片段
patterns.context: Ubuntu IRC 西班牙语对话中，关于无法访问硬盘的句子；该处激活落在词内子串。

patterns.name: 混合低强度局部激活
patterns.context: 这些孤立片段虽有少量激活，但无法从样本中确认稳定、独立的触发模式。

en.concept: Boundary fragments in code and text
en.description: Activations are distributed across punctuation, boundaries, and identifier subwords in various code fragments, as well as common English function words and words associated with poetic meter. There is no single semantic topic; locally, activations may favor tokenization boundaries and common short fragments.

patterns.name: Code punctuation and structural boundaries
patterns.context: In code or code fragments, punctuation occurs at the boundaries of statements, calls, arguments, or blocks; examples appear across languages and positions.

patterns.name: Function words and phrase transitions in natural language
patterns.context: In ordinary English narratives, common words occur in clause transitions, expressions of degree, or predicate phrases; specific words and contexts vary considerably.

patterns.name: Meter and emphasis words in poetry
patterns.context: Verse contains words with rhythmic or emphatic functions, including Old English poetic language and interjections.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within code identifiers
patterns.context: Some fragments activate when code identifiers, package names, API names, or variable names consist of multiple morphemes; may overlap with code-structure patterns.

patterns.name: Specific vocabulary combinations in narratives
patterns.context: Continuous expressions about kinship, personal identity, or uncertain conjecture in genealogical narratives; beyond general English transitions, there is no clear shared topic.

10_2024.concept: 代码与文本的边界片段
10_2024.description: 激活分布于多种代码片段中的标点、边界和标识符子词，也见普通英语功能词及诗歌格律词；无单一语义主题，局部可能偏向分词边界与常见短片段。

patterns.name: 代码标点与结构边界
patterns.context: 代码或代码片段中，标点出现在语句、调用、参数或块的边界；不同语言和位置均有出现。

patterns.name: 自然语言中的功能词与短语衔接
patterns.context: 普通英语叙述中，常见词位于从句衔接、程度表达或谓语短语中；具体词和语境差异较大。

patterns.name: 诗歌中的格律与强调词
patterns.context: 韵文中出现带节奏或强调作用的词，包含古英语诗歌用语及感叹词。

patterns.name: 代码标识符内部的子词片段
patterns.trigger: «im»、«In»、«Inquiry»、«export»、«strip» 等标识符或路径中的片段
patterns.context: 代码标识符、包名、API 名或变量名由多个词素构成时，部分片段被激活；可能与代码结构模式重叠。

patterns.name: 叙述中的具体词汇组合
patterns.context: 家谱叙述中关于亲属关系、人物身份或不确定推测的连续表达；除一般英语衔接外没有明显共享主题。

en.description: Activations are scattered: contrastive words, discussions of intention, archaic pronouns, numeric strings, and various proper-name or string fragments all respond. Numeric problems and rare subwords are prominent, but do not form a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Contrastive or additive conjunctions
patterns.context: Appears after preceding text to introduce a contrast, conjecture, or turn in a poem; activations fall on the word but and nearby tokens.

patterns.name: Numbers and decimal strings
patterns.context: Digits and punctuation in numbers, calculations, or rounding problems; several activations fall within number strings.

patterns.name: Questions and expressions of intention
patterns.context: Questions and statements discussing plans, intentions, or judgments, especially those containing what or think.

patterns.name: Proper names or rare string fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on subword fragments in proper names, URLs, or code identifiers; there is no clear shared semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Web pages, emails, code, and personal narratives

patterns.name: Archaic second person in poetry
patterns.context: Archaic poetic lines contain second-person possessives and related words, with strong activation on local tokens.

10_2024.description: 激活分布较散：转折词、意向讨论、古体代词、数值串及多种专名或字符串片段均有响应；数值题和罕见子词较突出，但不足以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 转折或补充连接词
patterns.context: 出现在前文之后，引出转折、推测或诗句中的转折；激活落在 but 一词及邻近 token 上。

patterns.name: 数字与小数串
patterns.context: 数字、计算式或舍入题中的数字及标点；若干激活落在数字串内部。

patterns.name: 疑问与意向表达
patterns.trigger: “what’s in their agenda”“what would they like”“I really think”
patterns.context: 讨论计划、意图或判断的问句与陈述，尤其包含 what、think 等词。

patterns.name: 专名或罕见字符串片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、网址或代码标识符的子词片段上；没有明显统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 网页、邮件、代码及人物叙述

patterns.name: 诗歌中的古体第二人称
patterns.context: 古体诗行中出现第二人称所有格及相关词语，局部 token 激活较强。

en.description: Activations span math problems, code, legal texts, forums, and news, occurring on numbers and answers, in-word tokenization fragments, proper names, common words, and formatting markers. Apart from a numerically dense pattern in math exercises, the examples have no stable shared semantic or syntactic trigger.

patterns.name: Numbers and answer formats in math problems
patterns.context: Math exercises contain numbers, decimals, fractions, or unit conversions; activations are distributed across problem numbers, operation-related words, and answer numbers, rather than corresponding only to a fixed math word.

patterns.name: Local fragments within English words
patterns.context: Activations fall on words or name fragments split into multiple tokens; these examples occur in company names and business reporting, but do not yet show that a particular word sense is the trigger.

patterns.name: Time expressions and word fragments in forum narratives
patterns.context: Forum posts contain text such as times, usernames, or album names; high-activation points are scattered across these local fragments, with no clear shared semantics.

patterns.name: Various words in sports-statistic narratives
patterns.context: In accounts of player season statistics and substitution scenarios, activations involve common words, numeric statistics, and tokenized team names; they cannot be reduced to a single sports term.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments in legal texts
patterns.context: In formal legal provisions, fragments within long words activate after tokenization; nearby wording concerns property rights, airport land, and administrators.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and code structure
patterns.context: Activations appear around identifiers, preprocessor directives, and code formatting in C/C++ header files.

patterns.name: Names and place names in genealogical narratives
patterns.context: When discussing family relationships, marriage locations, and possible surnames, tokenized fragments of names and place names activate.

patterns.name: Words and punctuation in medical software recommendations
patterns.context: A forum reply quotes recommendations about hospital software and procurement channels; activations cover common words and quotation formatting, with no clear single trigger.

10_2024.description: 激活跨数学题、代码、法律文本、论坛及新闻等多种语料，落在数字和答案、词内分词片段、专名、普通词与格式标记上。除数学练习中的数值密集模式外，各段没有稳定共享的语义或句法触发条件。

patterns.name: 数学题中的数值与答案格式
patterns.context: 数学练习题里出现数字、小数、分数或单位换算；激活分布在题目数字、运算相关词及答案数字上，并不只对应某个固定数学词。

patterns.name: 英语词内的局部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分为多个 token 的词语或名称片段上；这些例子处于公司名称及商业报道语境，尚不足以表明特定词义是触发条件。

patterns.name: 论坛叙述中的时间表达及词片段
patterns.context: 论坛帖子中出现时间、用户名或专辑名称等文本；高激活点散布在这些局部片段上，缺乏明确共同语义。

patterns.name: 体育数据叙述中的多种词语
patterns.context: 球员赛季统计和补位情境中，激活涉及常见词、数字统计及分词后的队名；不能归结为单一体育术语。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的分词片段
patterns.context: 正式法律条文中，长词被拆分后其中片段激活；同时附近有关于产权、机场用地和行政人员的措辞。

patterns.name: 代码标识符与代码结构
patterns.context: C/C++ 头文件中的标识符、预处理指令及代码排版附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 家谱叙述中的人名与地名
patterns.context: 讨论家族关系、婚姻地点及可能姓氏时，姓名和地名的分词片段激活。

patterns.name: 医疗软件建议中的词语与标点
patterns.context: 论坛回复引用建议内容，涉及医院软件及采购渠道；激活覆盖普通词和引用格式，尚无清晰单一触发项。

en.description: Activations cover several structures: identifiers and syntax in code, institutional wording and case metadata in legal texts, numeric symbols in math problems, and names and family relationships in narratives; there is no clear unified trigger.

patterns.name: Lowercase letter sequences in Java package names
patterns.context: Activations concentrate around package-name components and separators, especially tokens that split continuous lowercase characters into subwords.

patterns.name: Prepositions and administrative wording in legal texts
patterns.context: Appears within the administrative title “Administrator” and near formal wording such as title and site in legal texts.

patterns.name: Numbers and symbol sequences in math problems
patterns.context: Sequences of numbers, minus signs, operators, and punctuation; some problems involve sorting or base representations.

patterns.name: C++ error handling and buffer code
patterns.context: C++ code structures involving namespaces, error-handling functions, variable declarations, and client read calls.

patterns.name: Personal names and family relationships in narratives
patterns.context: Narrative about Jess's descendants and daughter, and her participation in competitions; names and their possessive forms stand out.

patterns.name: Case citations and docket numbers
patterns.context: Sentences in legal opinions about the precedential effect of cases, containing court-rule citations and docket, document, page, and date fields.

10_2024.concept: 结构化文本中的特殊子串
10_2024.description: 激活覆盖多种结构：代码中的标识符与语法、法律文本中的机构措辞和判例元数据、数学题中的数值符号，以及叙事中的姓名和家族关系；没有明显统一触发特征。

patterns.name: Java 包名中的小写字母序列
patterns.context: 激活集中在包名各部分及分隔符附近；尤其是把连续小写字符切分成子词的标记。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的介词及行政措辞
patterns.context: 出现在行政机构称谓“Administrator”内部，及法律文本中 title、site 等正式措辞附近。

patterns.name: 数学题中的数字与符号序列
patterns.context: 数值、负号、运算符和标点组成的序列；有的题目涉及排序或进制表示。

patterns.name: C++ 错误处理与缓冲区代码
patterns.context: C++ 中的命名空间、错误处理函数、变量声明和客户端读取调用等代码结构。

patterns.name: 人物姓名与家族关系叙述
patterns.context: Jess 的后代、女儿及其参加比赛等叙述，姓名及其所有格形式突出。

patterns.name: 判例引用与案卷编号
patterns.context: 法律意见中关于判例效力的句子，包含法院规则引用及案卷、文件、页码和日期字段。

en.description: Across domains, activations occur on in-word fragments, split proper names, unusual capitalization, and numbers, punctuation, newlines, and list formatting. Trigger locations vary, with no stable semantic topic.

patterns.name: Cross-fragment subword boundaries within specific words
patterns.context: Activations often fall on fragments within proper names, technical terms, or common words, especially when words are split into multiple tokens; there is no unified rule for word meaning or position.
patterns.domain: Across sports reporting, legal narratives, novel entries, medical papers, patents, place names, and miscellaneous text

patterns.name: Periods and numbering formats
patterns.context: Appears in formats dense with punctuation and numbers, such as abbreviations, bibliographic numbers, section numbers, bracketed citations, or serial numbers.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, patents, web links, and citation formats

patterns.name: Mixed or unusual capitalization and tokenization
patterns.context: Local activations occur in uppercase words, abbreviations, or split proper names; paragraphs also include names tokenized with unusual capitalization.
patterns.domain: Sports reporting, legal texts, patent text

patterns.name: Tables and space-separated numbers
patterns.context: Numbers and spaces are arranged in table-like rows, with words interspersed among fields.

patterns.name: Newlines and document-structure markers
patterns.context: Activations occur near newlines, item boundaries, or section headings, but not every structural marker activates consistently.
patterns.domain: Web pages, encyclopedia entries, medical literature, and lists

10_2024.description: 跨多领域激活于词内片段、拆分专名、大小写异常，以及数字、标点、换行和列表格式；触发位置多样，未见稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 特定词内的跨片段子词边界
patterns.context: 激活常落在专名、术语或普通词内部的片段，尤其是词被拆成多个 token 时；但没有统一的词义或位置规则。
patterns.domain: 跨体育报道、司法叙述、小说条目、医学论文、专利、地名及杂项文本

patterns.name: 句点与编号格式
patterns.context: 出现在缩写、文献编号、标题编号、方括号引用或序号等标点和数字密集的格式中。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、专利、网页链接及引用格式

patterns.name: 大小写混合或异常分词
patterns.context: 大写词、缩写或被拆开的专名中出现局部激活；段落中也有大小写异常的姓名分词。
patterns.domain: 体育报道、司法文本、专利文字

patterns.name: 表格与空白分隔数字
patterns.context: 数字和空格排列成类似表格的行，词语夹杂在字段之间。

patterns.name: 换行及文档结构标记
patterns.context: 激活出现在换行、条目边界或章节标题附近，但并非每个结构标记都一致激活。
patterns.domain: 网页、百科条目、医学文献及列表

en.description: Activations are distributed across technical terms and code, legal citations, art bibliographies, task discussions, music performances, medical statistics, and epidemic narratives, and also occur on URLs, proper names, numbers, and tokenized word fragments; the examples lack a shared semantic trigger.

patterns.name: PHP/HipHop code and links
patterns.context: Mentions Facebook's open-source PHP implementation and includes a GitHub wiki link; activations are scattered across technical terms and URL tokens

patterns.name: Legal citations and docket fields
patterns.context: Federal appellate procedure rule citations and fields, numbers, and dates in court docket headers

patterns.name: Museums, art catalogs, and names
patterns.context: Art institutions, publications, and artist names appear in bibliographic-style entries

patterns.name: C header files and parameter descriptions
patterns.context: Code comments explain parameter conventions, followed by a C preprocessor header guard macro

patterns.name: Task lists and priorities
patterns.context: Discusses moving less important tasks to the background and recording tasks at the forefront of one's mind

patterns.name: Genode documentation link
patterns.context: A reply expresses thanks and mentions a Genode system article and developer resource link

patterns.name: Performances and musicians' names
patterns.context: Describes a live performance and mentions people such as Caleb, Elton, and Kenny Metcalf

patterns.name: Surgical group and duration statistics
patterns.context: Compares surgical times between two groups, reporting ranges and durations in minutes

patterns.name: Phrase and video URL
patterns.context: The phrase “homeopathic accident and emergency” is followed by a YouTube short link

patterns.name: SARS epidemic and hotel transmission chain
patterns.context: Describes the international spread of the SARS epidemic, case links, and a hotel that had been visited

10_2024.description: 激活分布于技术术语与代码、法律引文、艺术书目、任务讨论、音乐演出、医学统计和疫情叙述，也落在 URL、专名、数字及被切分的词片上；各段缺少共同语义触发条件。

patterns.name: PHP/HipHop 代码与链接
patterns.context: 提及 Facebook 的开源 PHP 实现，并附 GitHub wiki 链接；激活分散在技术名词和 URL token 上

patterns.name: 法律引文及案卷字段
patterns.context: 联邦上诉程序规则引文及法院案卷页眉中的字段、编号和日期

patterns.name: 博物馆、艺术目录与姓名
patterns.context: 艺术机构、出版物及艺术家姓名出现在书目式条目中

patterns.name: C 头文件与参数说明
patterns.context: 代码注释说明参数约定，随后出现 C 预处理器头文件保护宏

patterns.name: 任务清单与优先级
patterns.context: 讨论把较不重要的任务移到后台，以及记录脑中优先考虑的任务

patterns.name: Genode 文档链接
patterns.context: 回复中感谢信息，并提到 Genode 系统文章及开发者资源链接

patterns.name: 演出与音乐人姓名
patterns.context: 叙述现场演出，提到 Caleb、Elton 与 Kenny Metcalf 等人

patterns.name: 手术组别与时长统计
patterns.context: 比较两个组别的手术时间，以范围和分钟单位报告结果

patterns.name: 短语与视频网址
patterns.context: 短语“homeopathic accident and emergency”后跟 YouTube 短链接

patterns.name: SARS 疫情与酒店传播链
patterns.context: 描述 SARS 疫情的国际传播、病例关联及曾到访的酒店

en.description: Activations are distributed across segmented fragments in strings such as URLs, domains, and emails, and also occur in product names, patent numbers, proper names, medical figure-caption markers, and long number strings; the commonality is mainly local tokens in specially formatted strings rather than a single topic.

patterns.name: Letter fragments in URL/domain structures
patterns.context: Activations fall on tokenized letter fragments in domains or URLs; these include hostnames, paths, filenames, or email addresses and often occur with punctuation and numbers.
patterns.domain: Email headers, web links, technical forums

patterns.name: COOLPIX product name
patterns.context: The product name COOLPIX appears in model details and product-page text, with activations concentrated on letter fragments in the name.

patterns.name: Metropole hotel name
patterns.context: In an account of the Hong Kong SARS event, the place name Metropole Hotel is split into multiple tokens; activations are especially concentrated at the start of the name.

patterns.name: Stoop name fragment
patterns.context: The artist Peter Stoop's name appears in biographical text, with activations concentrated on the initial fragment of the surname.

patterns.name: Patent-number format
patterns.context: A Japanese patent publication number consists of a Sho era designation, digits, and hyphens; activation is strongly concentrated on the final numeric token.

patterns.name: Medical figure captions and image markers
patterns.context: In Markdown-style medical figure captions, image links, and figure-number markers, activations occur near newlines, caption text, and file identifiers.

patterns.name: Number strings and numeric answers
patterns.context: In math Q&A, long numbers are split into consecutive tokens; questions involve integer comparisons or equations, and answer digits activate strongly.

10_2024.concept: 格式化字符串片段识别
10_2024.description: 激活分布于网址、域名、邮箱等字符串的分段片段，也出现在产品名、专利号、专名、医学图注标记和长数字串；共同点主要是特殊格式字符串中的局部 token，而非单一主题。

patterns.name: URL/域名结构中的字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在域名或网址中被分词的字母片段上；包含主机名、路径、文件名或邮箱地址，常伴随标点和数字。
patterns.domain: 邮件头、网页链接、技术论坛

patterns.name: COOLPIX 产品名
patterns.context: 产品名 COOLPIX 在型号及产品页面文字中出现，激活集中于名称的字母片段。

patterns.name: Metropole 酒店名称
patterns.context: 香港 SARS 事件叙述中，地点名 Metropole Hotel 被拆分为多个 token；激活尤其集中于名称开头。

patterns.name: Stoop 姓名片段
patterns.context: 艺术家 Peter Stoop 的姓名出现在传记文字中，激活集中于姓氏开头片段。

patterns.name: 专利编号格式
patterns.context: 日本专利公告编号以 Sho 年代号、数字和连字符组成，激活强烈集中在编号末尾数字 token。

patterns.name: 医学图注与图像标记
patterns.context: Markdown 风格的医学图注、图片链接及图号标记中，换行、图注文本和文件标识附近均有激活。

patterns.name: 数字串及数值答案
patterns.context: 数学问答中，长数字被拆成连续 token；问题包含整数比较或算式，答案数字部分激活较强。

en.description: Most passages activate when send/sending is followed by a recipient or content, covering email, legal instructions, spam, text messages, and access-control signals; there are also three local exceptions: send meaning “take children,” ros in atherosclerotic, and COMM in RECOMMENDED.

patterns.name: send meaning to transmit or mail
patterns.context: send is followed by a recipient or content being sent, often with to; includes infinitive, base, and participle forms.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, email, technical explanations, narrative text

patterns.name: Embedded morphological fragment of send
patterns.context: Occurs in “who send their children to ...”, where send means taking children to school; activation is slightly weaker due to context.

patterns.name: ros substring in a proper noun
patterns.context: Occurs inside the medical term “atherosclerotic disease,” not as an independent sense of sending.

patterns.name: Fragment of an uppercase column label
patterns.context: Occurs in all-uppercase, page-like formatting labels on FreeLaw.

10_2063.description: 多数段落在 send/sending 后接收件人或内容时激活，涵盖邮件、法律指令、垃圾邮件、短信及门禁信号；另有 send 表“送孩子”、atherosclerotic 中的 ros、RECOMMENDED 中的 COMM 两个局部例外。

patterns.name: send 表示发送或寄送
patterns.context: send 后接收件对象或发送内容，常与 to 连用；包括不定式、原形和分词形式。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、邮件、技术说明、叙述性文本

patterns.name: send 的嵌入式形态片段
patterns.context: 出现在“who send their children to ...”中，send 表示送孩子去学校；受上下文影响，激活强度略低。

patterns.name: 专名中的 ros 子串
patterns.context: 出现在医学术语“atherosclerotic disease”内部，并非独立的发送词义。

patterns.name: 大写栏目标签片段
patterns.context: 出现在 FreeLaw 页面式的全大写排版标签中。

en.description: Activations are scattered across some proper nouns, medical terms (especially word forms split into multiple parts), official titles, and legal title formatting; the commonality is unclear, and some activations may be related to specific within-word token fragments.

patterns.name: Word form “Montenegrins”
patterns.context: The word is split into multiple subword tokens; one instance is followed immediately by “in Germany”, and the next line repeats the word form followed by “living in”.

patterns.name: Cros- string in a proper noun
patterns.context: The name Crosby’s is followed by “vow: No repeating '13”; activation falls on a token fragment of the name.

patterns.name: Proteinuria word form
patterns.context: The word appears in a medical sentence, followed by a note that the adult also has bisalbuminemia.

patterns.name: Atherosclerosis word form
patterns.context: The disease name occurs in medical contexts such as definitions, precursors, or lower-extremity disease; includes noun and adjective forms.

patterns.name: Official title
patterns.context: Appears as an official title in a parenthetical note about New South Wales.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia political figure or office entries

patterns.name: Plasmid-related word form
patterns.context: The beginning of the phrase Plasmid-associated aggregation.
patterns.domain: PubMed microbiology or molecular biology abstracts

patterns.name: Plasmodium genus name
patterns.context: The complete genus name is followed by berghei, in a context involving mouse infection and Anopheles mosquitoes.

patterns.name: Court of appeals decision formatting
patterns.context: Centered, all-uppercase headings and formatted blank lines in court documents.
patterns.domain: U.S. federal court of appeals legal documents

10_2063.description: 激活分散于若干专名、医学术语（尤见多段拆分的词形）、官职及法律标题版式；共同点不明确，部分激活可能与词内特定分词片段有关。

patterns.name: “Montenegrins”词形
patterns.context: 词被拆成多个子词 token；一次紧接“in Germany”，下一行重复词形并接“living in”。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人口或居住地描述

patterns.name: 专名中的 Cros- 字串
patterns.context: 姓名 Crosby’s 后接 “vow: No repeating '13”；激活落在姓名的分词片段上。
patterns.domain: 网页文本，具体文体不明

patterns.name: 蛋白尿词形
patterns.context: 医学句子中出现该词，随后说明成人同时有 bisalbuminemia。

patterns.name: 动脉粥样硬化词形
patterns.context: 该病名出现在定义、前驱因素或下肢疾病等医学语境；包括名词和形容词形式。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、NIH 医学文本

patterns.name: 官职名称
patterns.context: 作为新南威尔士州括号说明中的官职名称出现。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 政治人物或职务条目

patterns.name: Plasmid 相关词形
patterns.context: Plasmid-associated aggregation 一词的开头。
patterns.domain: PubMed 微生物或分子生物学摘要

patterns.name: 疟原虫属名
patterns.context: 完整属名后接 berghei，涉及小鼠感染及按蚊。

patterns.name: 法院上诉判决版式
patterns.context: 法院文件中居中、全大写的标题和格式化空白行。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦上诉法院法律文书

en.concept: Det word onset and document formatting features
en.description: Most passages begin with Det in paper titles, mainly Detection, with one instance of Detailed; the first passage instead responds to spaces, line breaks, and uppercase formatting in a legal document header, a different triggering mechanism.

patterns.name: Detection word onset
patterns.context: “Detection” is split into Det + ection, and the neuron responds strongly to the initial Det; it is often followed by of or and, forming research-title-like phrases.

patterns.name: Detailed word onset
patterns.context: “Detailed” is split into Det + ailed and appears in the title-like phrase “Detailed analysis of the insertion site...”; it may share an onset trigger with Detection, but the following text differs.

patterns.name: Legal document header and formatting
patterns.context: Large spaces and line breaks, an uppercase court-name header, the file marker “FILED”, and the header abbreviation “FE”; activation is distributed over whitespace and formatting structure rather than an obvious Det onset.
patterns.domain: U.S. federal court of appeals legal documents

10_2063.concept: Det 词首及文书排版特征
10_2063.description: 多数段落在论文标题中以 Det 起始，主要是 Detection，另有 Detailed；第1段则响应法律文书页眉中的空格、换行和大写排版，触发方式不同。

patterns.name: Detection 词首
patterns.context: “Detection”被拆分为 Det + ection，神经元强烈响应词首 Det；后续多接 of 或 and，形成研究标题式短语。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文标题或摘要

patterns.name: Detailed 词首
patterns.context: “Detailed”被拆分为 Det + ailed，出现在“Detailed analysis of the insertion site...”这一标题式表达中；可能与 Detection 共享词首触发，但后续词不同。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文标题或摘要

patterns.name: 法律文书页眉与排版
patterns.context: 大段空格及换行、法院名称大写页眉、文件标记“FILED”及页眉缩写“FE”；激活分布在空白和排版结构上，而非明显的 Det 词首。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦上诉法院法律文书

en.description: Primarily responds to hyphen-introduced long- compounds, commonly long-term, and also long-baseline and long-range, across physics, life sciences, and medical texts. It also activates strongly on “12” in a mathematical formula, which is difficult to relate to the main pattern.

patterns.name: long hyphenated compounds
patterns.context: The trigger position is often between long- and the following word; following words include “baseline”, “term”, and “range”, with some examples spanning tokens.
patterns.domain: Physics abstracts, life science papers, and medical abstracts/papers

patterns.name: Number 12 in a mathematical expression
patterns.context: Occurs in the formula fragment “- 12 = 3*z.”, with no nearby long- compound.

10_2063.description: 主要响应连字符引出的 long- 复合词，常见 long-term，也包括 long-baseline、long-range；跨物理、生命科学和医学文本。另对数学公式中的“12”有强激活，难与主模式联系。

patterns.name: long 连字符复合词
patterns.trigger: “long” 后接连字符（如 “long-”）并构成复合词
patterns.context: 触发位置多在 long- 与后续词之间；后续词包括 “baseline”“term”“range”，部分例子跨 token。
patterns.domain: 物理学摘要、生命科学论文及医学摘要/论文

patterns.name: 数学表达中的数字 12
patterns.context: 出现在公式片段 “- 12 = 3*z.” 中，附近没有 long- 复合词。

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to “to” in hyphen-separated phrases in URL slugs, across news, technology, and general webpage titles; also includes a range expression in a code comment and activation on “186” in repeated numbering, the latter two possibly incidental or accompanying features.

patterns.name: Hyphen-separated “to” in URL slugs
patterns.context: Occurs in a URL path or link title as part of a longer hyphen-separated slug; it need not semantically express purpose or direction.
patterns.domain: Web links, news headlines, technical articles, and code-related pages

patterns.name: Loop range in a code comment
patterns.context: A code comment describes traversal from the top of a grid to the end, with a for loop nearby.

patterns.name: High-numbered index in repeated numbered entries
patterns.context: One number fragment in a sequence of repeated entry numbers shows the strongest activation; no obvious to structure is present.

patterns.name: Non-salient or irregular triggers
patterns.context: Activation fragments include sporadic words, URL characters, or repeated entries, making stable conditions difficult to determine from the given text.

10_2063.description: 主要对 URL slug 中连字符分隔词组里的“to”强烈响应，跨新闻、技术与一般网页标题；另有代码注释中的范围表达及重复编号中的“186”激活，后两者可能是伴随或偶发特征。

patterns.name: URL slug中的连字符分词“to”
patterns.trigger: 连字符分隔的子串“-to-”，其中 to 为最高激活；如“to-using”“to-air”“to-atomic”“to-typescript”“to-bottom”“to-kill”“to-process”“to-his”“to-prepare”
patterns.context: 出现在 URL 路径或链接标题中，作为较长连字符分隔 slug 的一部分；不要求语义上表示目的或方向
patterns.domain: 网页链接、新闻标题、技术文章及代码相关页面

patterns.name: 代码注释中的循环范围
patterns.context: 代码注释描述从网格顶部到末端的遍历，附近有 for 循环

patterns.name: 重复编号条目中的高位序号
patterns.context: 连续重复的条目编号中，某个编号片段出现最强激活；未见明显的 to 结构

patterns.name: 非显著或不规则触发
patterns.trigger: “to”未呈现清晰的连字符 slug 结构；可能包括前导片段“even sink to using chemical weapons”
patterns.context: 激活片段包含零散词语、网址字符或重复条目，难以从给定文本确定稳定条件

en.description: Primarily responds to uppercase or abbreviated identifiers split into subword tokens, especially next to numbers, punctuation, field labels, or title formatting; also covers signature addresses, aligned tables, energy terminology, legal signatures, and encyclopedia links.

patterns.name: Mixed uppercase-letter and number device/system identifiers
patterns.context: Identifiers are split into multiple subword tokens; they often occur next to numbers, underscores, colons, or explanatory fields.
patterns.domain: Corporate email, energy/IT status reports, technical Q&A, legal documents, encyclopedia entries; passages 1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10

patterns.name: All-uppercase headings or table labels
patterns.context: Headings, column names, or labels appear in uppercase or title case, often in report headings after line breaks, tables, or entry structures; no specific topic is required.
patterns.domain: Operations reports, academic/bibliographic text, email, encyclopedias; passages 2, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10

patterns.name: Email signature and mailing address format
patterns.context: Contact information appears after or at the beginning of the email body, with names, titles, companies, street addresses/PO boxes, and city, state, and ZIP code listed line by line.

patterns.name: Table separators and aligned whitespace
patterns.context: Horizontal lines separate table headers from data columns, while whitespace within rows maintains table alignment.

patterns.name: Energy trading/electricity business terminology
patterns.context: In energy dispatch or market price reports, business fields and price/region constraints are presented as uppercase labels.
patterns.domain: Energy industry email or automatically generated business text; passages 8, 9

patterns.name: Hard drive interface names and version numbers
patterns.context: When discussing storage controller bottlenecks, interface names appear next to generation numbers and transfer rates.

patterns.name: Names and judge signatures in legal decisions
patterns.context: Lawyers’ names appear with uppercase surnames, followed by judicial titles and decision-document formatting.

patterns.name: Numbered entries and external links
patterns.context: Highway numbers appear alongside map website names in encyclopedia references or external links.

patterns.name: Tokenized uppercase forms of specific product/event names
patterns.context: Marketing copy or headlines use all caps, with brand/event names split into multiple subword tokens.
patterns.domain: Promotional headlines in corporate email; passage 6

10_2063.concept: 大写结构化标签与代码
10_2063.description: 主要响应大写或缩写标识符被拆成子词 token，尤其邻接数字、标点、字段标签或标题格式；也覆盖签名地址、对齐表格、能源术语、法律署名和百科链接等结构化文本。

patterns.name: 大写字母与数字混合的设备/系统标识符
patterns.trigger: 如 «AR»«DM»«ORE»、«EB»«34»、«S»«ATA»、«DEF»«ERR»«AL»、«TRANS»«_»«TYPE»、«SC»«_»«ID»、«PO»«LL»«ACK»、«NH» 等分段的大写缩写或代码
patterns.context: 标识符被切分成多个子词 token；常邻接数字、下划线、冒号或其解释性字段。
patterns.domain: 企业邮件、能源/IT状态报告、技术问答、法律文书、百科条目；段1、2、3、6、7、8、9、10

patterns.name: 全大写标题或表格标签
patterns.trigger: «SYSTEM»« OUT»«AGES»、«FAC»«ILITY»« OPER»«ATIONS»、«ITAL»«O»« TEST»«A»« S»«KE»«PT»«ISC»«HE»« AN»«T»«IN»«OM»，以及«References»、«External links»
patterns.context: 标题、栏目名或标签以大写、首字母大写形式出现，常见于换行后的报告标题、表格或条目结构；不要求特定主题。
patterns.domain: 运维报告、学术/书目文本、邮件、百科；段2、4、5、6、8、10

patterns.name: 邮件签名与邮寄地址格式
patterns.trigger: «email»、«@»、«com»、«Director Business Development»、«PO Box»、城市/州与邮编
patterns.context: 邮件正文后或开头出现姓名、职务、公司、街道/邮政信箱及城市州邮编等逐行联系信息。

patterns.name: 表格分隔线与对齐空白
patterns.context: 横线用于分隔表头与数据列，且行内空白用于保持表格对齐。

patterns.name: 能源交易/电力业务术语
patterns.trigger: «Energy Import/Export Schedule»、«E PRICE WILL BE»、«COST OF DEFICIT»、«SUB-MARKET LIMITS»
patterns.context: 能源调度或市场价格报告中，业务字段和价格/区域限制以大写标签呈现。
patterns.domain: 能源行业邮件或自动生成的业务文本；段8、9

patterns.name: 硬盘接口名称及版本数字
patterns.context: 讨论存储控制器瓶颈时，接口名称与代际编号、传输速率相邻。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的人名与法官署名
patterns.context: 律师姓名以大写姓氏出现，后接法官职衔及判决文书格式。

patterns.name: 编号与外部链接条目
patterns.context: 百科条目参考资料或外部链接中，公路编号与地图网站名称并列。

patterns.name: 特定商品/活动名称的分词大写形式
patterns.context: 营销文案或标题采用全大写，并将品牌/活动名拆成多个子词 token。
patterns.domain: 企业邮件中的促销标题；段6

en.description: Activations are distributed across structural boundaries and formatting markers, specific email/configuration/code/patent fields, and also hit “at least” and FARM BUREAU; they span domains, with no single semantic trigger evident.

patterns.name: FARM BUREAU in a legal entity list
patterns.context: Repeated as part of entity names in legal text listing multiple states and organizations.

patterns.name: Line breaks and time zone/schedule configuration fields
patterns.context: In a structured configuration file, field names and values occur next to CRLF line breaks.

patterns.name: At least once in survey statistics
patterns.context: Describes the proportion of a population reporting a behavior during a defined recall period; also includes “at least once a year”.
patterns.domain: Public health/education statistics; product maintenance instructions

patterns.name: Punctuation, spaces, and special formatting boundaries
patterns.context: Activations are scattered near line breaks, punctuation, or formatting separators, with no consistent natural-language semantic context.

patterns.name: License instructions in product or software support emails
patterns.context: Instructs recipients to contact support or call for a new key after the license expires.

patterns.name: Forwarding and urgent/important headings in email subjects
patterns.context: Email header subject lines containing forwarding markers or wording emphasizing urgency or importance.

patterns.name: Embedded firmware macros and hardware identifiers
patterns.context: Chip models, configuration items, and hardware clock parameters occur together in C code comments and macro definitions.

patterns.name: Numbered fields in patent technical text
patterns.context: Explains a servo wedge structure and uses abbreviations, parentheses, and numbered fields to label components.

patterns.name: Organization names and subject fragments in public records
patterns.context: Activation falls on tokenized organization names or email subject fragments, with no shared semantic condition evident.

patterns.name: Sporadic hits unexplained by a unified pattern
patterns.context: Appears individually in statistical sentences, product descriptions, license emails, or email bodies; despite locally recognizable patterns, they cannot be grouped under one common trigger condition.

10_2063.description: 激活分布于结构边界与格式标记、特定邮件/配置/代码/专利字段，也命中“at least”及 FARM BUREAU；跨领域，未见单一语义触发。

patterns.name: 法律实体清单中的 FARM BUREAU
patterns.context: 多个州名、组织名并列的法律文件文字中，作为实体名称的一部分重复出现。

patterns.name: 换行与时区/日程配置字段
patterns.context: 结构化配置文件中，字段名、值及 CRLF 换行符相邻。

patterns.name: 调查统计指标中的至少一次
patterns.context: 描述某人群在限定回忆期内报告某行为的比例；也出现“at least once a year”。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生/教育统计；产品保养说明

patterns.name: 标点、空格与特殊格式边界
patterns.context: 激活分散在换行、标点或格式分隔符附近；并无一致的自然语言语义上下文。
patterns.domain: 混合语料中的格式边界

patterns.name: 产品或软件支持邮件中的许可证指引
patterns.context: 告知许可证到期后联系支持方或致电以获取新密钥。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件；技术支持通知

en.concept: Terminology and formatting fragments in specialized texts

en.description: Activation cues are scattered: many hits involve normally and nearby words, while others involve numerical quantities, osteochondral medical vocabulary, code identifiers, and domain-specific expressions. Short function words are also often marked, but no unified semantic trigger condition is apparent.

patterns.name: normally / normally functioning
patterns.context: Occurs in sentences describing perfused myocardium, cell function after gene therapy, or myelin status; activation is concentrated on normally or its neighboring subwords.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, abstracts, and popular science text

patterns.name: Numbers and quantities
patterns.context: Numbers appear in specific quantities such as memory size, bone-cutting dimensions, or mailbox capacity; activation is distributed across the numbers and adjacent numeric subwords.

patterns.name: Bone- and cartilage-related medical vocabulary
patterns.context: Involves bone cutting, bone microstructure, cartilage repair, and related tissue or surgical content; activation often falls on internal subwords of related long words or nearby words.

patterns.name: Operational words or identifiers in computer code
patterns.context: Occurs in memory allocation APIs or Java GUI initialization code, with identifiers often in camel case or snake case.

patterns.name: Descriptions of nerve or tissue damage
patterns.context: Describes neuropathological changes after local injection and compares them with normal myelinated regions.

patterns.name: Breast cancer treatment data
patterns.context: Data collection and survival analysis involve patients and different treatment regimens.

patterns.name: Automatically generated mailbox capacity warning
patterns.context: Notifies users that their mailbox is nearing its capacity limit and gives the current usage.

patterns.name: Repair and regeneration statements in patents
patterns.context: Patent background describes a system for repairing damaged articular cartilage.

patterns.name: Grammatical connectors and adjacent punctuation
patterns.context: These short words are marked in sentences across multiple domains, possibly due to adjacent word boundaries, punctuation, or tokenization positions; on their own, they do not form a stable semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: GUI window layout and display
patterns.context: Code sets a window layout, adds panels, resizes the window, and displays it.

10_2063.description: 激活线索分散：多处命中 normally 及其邻近词，另有数字量值、骨软骨医学词汇、代码标识符和各类领域专属表达。短功能词也常被标记，但目前看不出统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: normally / normally functioning
patterns.context: 出现在描述灌注心肌、基因治疗后细胞功能或髓鞘状态的句子中；激活位置集中在 normally 或其相邻子词。

en.description: Primarily responds to property-setting calls in code that begin with set, often involving Android controls, list images, and layouts. There is also sporadic activation for position/size thresholds and range or definition words in medical text; their relationship is uncertain.

patterns.name: set* method calls in code
patterns.context: In Android, Java, Python/Qt, and other code, object methods set image resources, list adapters, layout parameters, control values, or settings; multiple examples combine set with a property name.

patterns.name: Control layout dimensions and content fitting
patterns.context: Discussions of ScrollView occlusion, layout height, or status bar height involve dimension parameters and fitting content to a parent container. Related to setter calls but also includes problem descriptions.

patterns.name: Positions and boundary conditions
patterns.context: Ranges are tested using positions or thresholds: code checks index boundaries, while medical text defines a condition using a birth-weight threshold.

patterns.name: List item image handling
patterns.context: Retrieves an item from a video list and sets its thumbnail; adjacent to the code setter pattern, but specifically concerns displaying list images.

patterns.name: Coverage area of medical surgical mesh
patterns.context: Describes overlap between surgical mesh and normal fascia and its extension toward the iliac crest.

patterns.name: Occurrence and gestational age in medical definitions
patterns.context: A medical paper states a stillbirth definition and gestational-age criteria; activation is scattered, with no clear connection to code setters.

patterns.name: UI touch listener
patterns.context: Android code binds a touch listener to a button and forwards touch events.

patterns.name: Text and control initialization
patterns.context: Initializes control properties such as text, font size, and frame style.

10_2063.description: 主要响应代码中以 set 开头的属性设置调用，常涉及 Android 控件、列表图像和布局；另对位置/尺寸阈值、医学文本中的范围与定义词有零散激活，彼此联系不确定。

patterns.name: 文本与控件初始化

en.description: Primarily responds to set method calls in code and the EndChar marker in vector graphic records. Other examples include numerical rounding, capacity/time units, and sporadic modal verbs and preference statements. Triggers are scattered and cannot be adequately explained by a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: set method calls in code
patterns.context: Java/Android-style objects or views followed by a dot and a method name beginning with set; set has the strongest activation in segments 1 and 2.

patterns.name: End-of-record marker in vector graphic files
patterns.context: In vector graphic or drawing data records, usually following fields such as LayerCount, Fore, and Refer.

patterns.name: Integer rounding and numeric formats
patterns.context: Math problems ask for positive or negative numbers to be rounded to a specified integer, precision, or number of digits.

patterns.name: Capacity and storage units
patterns.context: Quantities and units appear together for devices, memory, storage, or birth weight; trigger positions and meanings are not fully consistent.
patterns.domain: Consumer electronics descriptions, programming Q&A, general explanatory text, medical text

patterns.name: Duration or elapsed-time expressions
patterns.context: Numbers appear next to time units to indicate battery talk time or gestational weeks.

patterns.name: Modal verb should
patterns.context: In product performance descriptions, should introduces an expectation about battery life.

patterns.name: Modal/auxiliary verb would
patterns.context: Programming answers describe a subsequent action that needs to be taken.

patterns.name: Past perfect auxiliary had
patterns.context: In a memory management explanation, the OS has already handled memory alignment; the strongest activation is actually on already.

patterns.name: First-person preference expression
patterns.context: Expresses a strong preference in the first person while discussing a gaming experience.

patterns.name: URL or resource-locator fragment
patterns.context: The Refer field in a drawing record contains numeric coordinates or parameters; activation falls on the numeric fragment, and the specific pattern is unclear.

10_2063.description: 主要响应代码中的 set 方法调用与矢量图记录的 EndChar 标记；另见数值舍入、容量/时间单位，以及零散情态词和偏好表达。各触发分散，不能由单一语义充分解释。

patterns.name: 代码中的 set 方法调用

patterns.name: 矢量图文件记录结束标记

patterns.name: 持续时间或时长表达
patterns.context: 数字与时间单位相邻，表示电池通话时长或妊娠周数。

patterns.name: 情态词 should
patterns.context: 产品性能描述中，should 引出对电池续航的预期。

patterns.name: 情态/助动词 would
patterns.context: 编程解答中描述需要采取的后续操作。

patterns.name: 过去完成时助动词 had
patterns.context: 内存管理说明中，OS 已经完成对内存的对齐处理；强激活实际落在 already。

patterns.name: 第一人称偏好表达
patterns.context: 讨论游戏体验时以第一人称表达强烈偏好。

patterns.name: 网页地址或资源定位符片段
patterns.context: 绘图记录中 Refer 字段包含数字坐标或参数；激活落在数字片段上，具体规律不明。
patterns.domain: GitHub 图形/矢量文件数据

en.concept: Android view resources and configuration code
en.description: Primarily responds to Android Java code that looks up or configures views using R.id/R.layout, especially image resources, adapters, and visibility operations. There is also activation for Android OpenGL initialization, LayerCount record formats, and specification text containing GB capacities or durations.

patterns.name: Android view resource operations
patterns.context: Android Java code references a layout or control and sets an image, adapter, or visibility on a view.

patterns.name: Android view initialization and configuration
patterns.context: Finds and configures an Android OpenGL view.

patterns.name: Android resource identifiers
patterns.context: Constructs list items using built-in Android layout resources.

patterns.name: Android control visibility toggling
patterns.context: Changes a control's display state in Android code.

patterns.name: Android image resource binding
patterns.context: Sets an image resource on an ImageView based on a position index.

patterns.name: Capacity and duration in specification parameters
patterns.context: Lists capacity, storage space, or battery-life data in product or storage-device descriptions.

patterns.name: LayerCount data record format
patterns.context: Structured records contain a layer count, reference entry, and end marker.

10_2063.concept: Android 视图资源与配置代码
10_2063.description: 主要响应 Android Java 中以 R.id/R.layout 查找或配置视图的代码，尤其图片资源、适配器和可见性操作；另对 Android OpenGL 初始化、LayerCount 记录格式及含 GB 容量或时长的规格说明有激活。

patterns.name: Android 视图资源操作
patterns.context: Android Java 代码中引用布局或控件，并对视图设置图片、适配器或可见性。

patterns.name: Android 视图初始化与配置
patterns.context: 查找并配置 Android 的 OpenGL 视图。

patterns.name: Android 资源标识符
patterns.context: 通过 Android 内置布局资源构造列表项。

patterns.name: Android 控件可见性切换
patterns.context: 在 Android 代码中改变控件显示状态。

patterns.name: Android 图片资源绑定
patterns.context: 依据位置索引将图片资源设置到 ImageView。

patterns.name: 规格参数中的容量与时长
patterns.context: 以产品或存储设备说明的方式列出容量、存储空间或电池续航数据。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 产品说明/科普文本

patterns.name: LayerCount 数据记录格式
patterns.context: 结构化记录中出现图层数、参考条目及结束标记。

en.description: Primarily responds to Android Java Activity onCreate lifecycle code, especially @Override/protected declarations, super.onCreate, and setContentView(R.layout…). It also covers View lookup and setTag, help-seeking statements, and an unrelated phone specification description.

patterns.name: Android Activity lifecycle initialization code
patterns.context: The onCreate method in a Java Android Activity, usually a method definition and initialization code snippet; setContentView and nearby code are especially prominent across multiple segments.
patterns.domain: Code in StackExchange Android programming Q&A

patterns.name: Android annotations and method declarations
patterns.context: The annotation and access modifier immediately preceding an Activity's onCreate declaration, used to override a lifecycle method; method parameters and braces may also appear.

patterns.name: Android View lookup and tag setting
patterns.context: Adapter or ViewHolder code finds child Views by resource ID and stores the ViewHolder; onCreate need not appear.

patterns.name: Android phone specifications and battery life
patterns.context: Lists hardware and feature specifications separated by commas, ending with talk time; unrelated to Android lifecycle code.

patterns.name: Code help-seeking context
patterns.context: A StackExchange question or help request followed by or referring to Java code; related to the code help-seeking scenario, but not a stable code trigger.

10_2063.description: 主要响应 Android Java Activity 的 onCreate 生命周期代码，尤其是 @Override/protected 声明、super.onCreate 与 setContentView(R.layout…)；也覆盖 View 查找与 setTag、求助语句，以及一段无关的手机规格文案。

patterns.name: Android Activity 生命周期初始化代码
patterns.context: Java Android Activity 的 onCreate 方法，通常是方法定义及初始化代码片段；在多段中 setContentView 及其附近的代码尤为突出。
patterns.domain: StackExchange Android 编程问答中的代码

patterns.name: Android 注解与方法声明
patterns.context: 紧邻 Activity 的 onCreate 声明，作为覆写生命周期方法的注解和访问限定符；有时还出现方法参数和花括号。

patterns.name: Android View 查找与标签设置
patterns.context: Adapter 或 ViewHolder 代码中，通过资源 ID 查找子 View 并保存 ViewHolder；不要求出现 onCreate。

patterns.name: Android 手机规格与电池续航
patterns.trigger: “8 GB”, “internal memory”, “accelerometer”, “microSD cards”, “battery should last about 312 minutes”
patterns.context: 以逗号串联硬件和功能规格，末尾描述通话时间；与 Android 生命周期代码无关。
patterns.domain: 设备介绍/产品规格文案

patterns.name: 代码求助语境
patterns.trigger: “can anybody help me pleas”, “pls help me?”, “Does anyone have any advice?”
patterns.context: StackExchange 提问或求助文字，后接或提及 Java 代码；该模式与代码求助场景相关，但不是稳定的代码触发条件。

en.description: The strongest recurring pattern is Android Activity's onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) and super.onCreate call, often followed by setContentView(R.layout...). Other patterns include an Adapter's overridden getCount/getItem methods and a few ArrayList generic declarations; it is uncertain whether these edge patterns independently trigger activation.

patterns.name: Android lifecycle callback
patterns.context: Android Activity's onCreate callback declaration and call to the superclass implementation; a common form is protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) { super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);

patterns.name: Setting the Activity layout
patterns.context: Calls setContentView in onCreate and passes a layout resource under R.layout; this pattern co-occurs with the lifecycle callback but may also be a more specific local trigger

patterns.name: Adapter methods and Override
patterns.context: Methods in an Adapter class marked with @Override, including getCount and getItem; not Activity onCreate initialization code

patterns.name: Generic collection declarations
patterns.context: An ArrayList generic declaration appears in code; contexts involve either a Wi-Fi results list or a class member, but the activation pattern is not clearly explained by these declarations' shared purpose

10_2063.description: 最强且反复出现的模式是 Android Activity 的 onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) 与 super.onCreate 调用，常接 setContentView(R.layout...)。另有单例 Adapter 的 getCount/getItem 覆盖方法，以及少数 ArrayList 泛型声明；这些边缘模式是否独立触发不确定。

patterns.name: Android 生命周期回调
patterns.context: Android Activity 的 onCreate 回调声明及其调用父类实现；常见形式为 protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) { super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
patterns.domain: Java/Android 代码，主要来自 StackExchange

patterns.name: 设置 Activity 布局
patterns.context: 在 onCreate 中调用 setContentView，随后传入 R.layout 下的布局资源；该模式与生命周期回调共现，但也可能是更具体的局部触发因素

patterns.name: Adapter 方法与 Override
patterns.context: Adapter 类中被 @Override 标记的方法，包含 getCount 和 getItem；并非 Activity 的 onCreate 初始化代码

patterns.name: 泛型集合声明
patterns.context: 代码中出现 ArrayList 泛型声明；所在上下文分别涉及 wifi 结果列表或类成员，但激活模式未由这些声明的相同用途明确解释

en.concept: Quantified technical information and Java code
en.description: Activation is distributed across two distinct contexts: technical/medical/economic factual statements containing numbers, units, and comparisons, and identifiers and structural symbols in Android Java code. Negative results or limitations are common but do not cover every segment; there is no single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Numbers, units, and quantified comparisons
patterns.context: When describing dosage, incidence, device parameters, storage capacity, or economic indicators, numbers appear alongside units, percentages, or comparative expressions; segment 8 also compares an actual value with a lower nominal value.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, phone specifications and reviews, storage descriptions, economic commentary

patterns.name: Technical terms and abbreviations
patterns.context: Technical or medical terms appear alongside parameters, often in descriptions of device configurations or medical results.
patterns.domain: Medicine, consumer electronics, and product descriptions

patterns.name: Limitations, risks, and negative outcomes
patterns.context: Describes treatment effects or risks, surgical complications, limits on technical applicability, or values below expectations or comparison baselines.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, technical descriptions, product explanations, economic commentary

patterns.name: Android/Java code identifiers and calls
patterns.context: Identifiers appear as Java method calls, class names, annotations, or Android lifecycle methods, interspersed with parentheses, periods, and code indentation.

patterns.name: Code indentation, punctuation, and structural symbols
patterns.context: Appears as part of a code block, adjacent to methods, calls, or comments.
patterns.domain: Programming Q&A and code repository text

patterns.name: Incomplete or locally truncated sentences
patterns.context: Corpus excerpts are truncated mid-sentence, list, or code block; this feature may co-occur with other activation patterns and is insufficient to explain activation by itself.

10_2063.description: 激活分散于两类明显语境：带数字、单位和比较的技术/医学/经济事实陈述，以及 Android Java 代码中的标识符与结构符号。负面结果或限制常见，但不能覆盖所有段；不存在单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 数值、单位与量化比较
patterns.trigger: 数字及其量词或单位，如“18 Gy”“9 and 15%”“16GB”“1.5 GHz”“32GB”“4GB”“3.7 GB”“$2,600”“18.3 percent”
patterns.context: 在说明剂量、发生率、设备参数、存储容量或经济指标时，数字与单位、百分比或比较表达相邻；第8段还出现实际值低于标称值的比较。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、手机规格和评测、存储说明、经济评论

patterns.name: 技术名词与缩写
patterns.context: 技术或医学术语与参数共同出现，常置于设备配置或医学结果的陈述中。
patterns.domain: 医学、消费电子与产品介绍

patterns.name: 局限、风险与负面结果
patterns.context: 描述治疗剂量的效果或风险、手术并发症、技术适用范围受限，或数值低于预期/比较基准。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、技术说明、产品解释、经济评论

patterns.name: Android/Java代码标识符与调用
patterns.context: 标识符以 Java 方法调用、类名、注解或 Android 生命周期方法的形式出现，且夹杂括号、点号与代码缩进。
patterns.domain: StackExchange/GitHub 中的 Android Java 代码

patterns.name: 代码缩进、标点及结构符号
patterns.context: 作为代码块的一部分出现，与方法、调用或注释相邻。
patterns.domain: 编程问答与代码仓库文本

patterns.name: 不完整或局部截断的句子
patterns.trigger: 段尾未完成的“to bones”“and”“about”“activity”“activity”及若干被截断的代码或句子
patterns.context: 语料片段在句子、列表或代码中间截断；该特征可能与其他激活模式共现，不足以单独解释激活。

en.description: Activation shows two main local patterns: Android Java override/adapter code and statistics on complications, risks, and outcomes in medical literature. There are also two phone introductions, one listing hardware specifications and the other comparing camera configurations of HTC models.

patterns.name: Android Java adapter methods
patterns.context: Java/Android code contains overridden methods, list adapters, or click listeners; triggers cluster around method names, types, and annotations.

patterns.name: Medical complications and outcome statistics
patterns.context: Clinical studies or surgical outcome descriptions report complications, risks, mortality/morbidity, and numerical values; no particular disease or procedure is required.

patterns.name: Phone hardware specifications
patterns.context: Consumer electronics product introductions list phone specifications such as memory, storage, or processor.

patterns.name: HTC phones and camera specifications
patterns.context: Compares or introduces HTC Android phones and their camera configurations.

10_2063.concept: 代码结构与结果/规格统计
10_2063.description: 激活呈现两组主要局部模式：Android Java 重写/适配器代码，以及医学文献中并发症、风险和结局统计；另见两段手机介绍，分别列硬件规格和比较 HTC 机型相机配置。

patterns.name: Android Java 适配器方法
patterns.context: Java/Android 代码中出现重写方法、列表适配器或点击监听器；触发集中在方法名、类型与注解附近。

patterns.name: 医学并发症与结局统计
patterns.trigger: "complications"、"significantly greater"、"complication rate"、"stroke or death"、"mortality"、"morbidity"，以及伴随的百分比和统计数值
patterns.context: 临床研究或手术结果叙述中报告并发症、风险、死亡/发病率及数值；不要求特定疾病或手术。

patterns.name: 手机硬件规格
patterns.context: 消费电子产品介绍中列出手机的内存、存储或处理器等规格。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 产品评测/科技文章

patterns.name: HTC 手机与相机规格
patterns.context: 比较或介绍 HTC Android 手机及其相机配置。

en.concept: Heterogeneous subword fragments and structural patterns
en.description: Covers methods, keywords, and structural symbols in Android/Java code; numbers and units in electronic device specifications; bone marrow side effects and surgical/resection outcomes in medical text; and dates and steps in migration emails. Trigger points are not uniform across segments.

patterns.name: Android API method names and call chains
patterns.context: Android/Java code contains method fragments such as get, set, and on, usually adjacent to parentheses, objects, class names, or callback methods.

patterns.name: Java declarations and structural syntax
patterns.context: Declarations and syntax structures in Java methods, constructors, callbacks, or adapter code; activation falls on keywords, punctuation, and indentation.

patterns.name: Numbers and units in device specifications
patterns.context: Numbers, units, and model/specification fragments appear together in consumer electronics descriptions.

patterns.name: Cancer treatment and adverse reactions in medical text
patterns.context: Medical text lists chemotherapy drugs, treatment effects, or side effects; activation is concentrated on bone marrow-related words and some symptom words.
patterns.domain: Descriptions of cancer treatment in patent background

patterns.name: Gastric cancer surgery outcome descriptions
patterns.context: Paper abstracts discuss gastric cancer surgery staging, invasiveness, postoperative complications, and efficacy.

patterns.name: Liver resection and recurrence treatment outcomes
patterns.context: Paper abstracts report liver resection rates and the safety and feasibility of repeat treatment.

patterns.name: Dates and steps in migration notices
patterns.context: An email uses numbered items to explain Outlook migration dates and preparation steps users must take.

10_2063.concept: 异质性词片段与结构模式
10_2063.description: 覆盖Android/Java代码中的方法、关键字和结构符号，电子设备规格中的数字单位，以及医学文本中的骨髓副作用、手术/切除结局和迁移邮件中的日期步骤；各段触发点并不统一。

patterns.name: Android API 方法名与调用链
patterns.context: Android/Java 代码中出现 get、set、on 等方法名片段，通常邻接括号、对象、类名或回调方法。

patterns.name: Java 声明与结构性语法
patterns.context: Java 方法、构造器、回调或适配器代码中的声明和语法结构；激活落在关键字、标点及缩进上。

patterns.name: 设备规格中的数字与单位
patterns.context: 消费电子产品描述中，数字、单位及型号/规格片段相邻出现。

patterns.name: 医学肿瘤治疗与不良反应
patterns.context: 医学叙述列举化疗药物、治疗效果或副作用；激活集中于骨髓相关词及部分症状词。
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的肿瘤治疗描述

patterns.name: 胃癌手术结局描述
patterns.trigger: «low»；stage T1a gastric cancer；minimally invasive；postoperative complication rate
patterns.context: 论文摘要讨论胃癌手术分期、侵入性、术后并发症及疗效。

patterns.name: 肝脏切除与复发治疗结果
patterns.context: 论文摘要报告肝脏切除率及重复治疗的安全性、可行性。

patterns.name: 迁移通知中的时间与步骤
patterns.trigger: «m»9«igration»；THE EVENING OF : April 23rd；press the "Save My Data" button
patterns.context: 邮件以编号说明 Outlook 迁移日期和用户需执行的准备步骤。

en.description: The strongest and most repeated trigger is “undergone,” covering uses involving surgery, repair, examination, or experiencing change. There are also sporadic activations on several terms, place names, and common subword fragments, with no unified context.

patterns.name: gone through/experienced
patterns.context: Typically follows a present-perfect or past-perfect construction and refers to experiencing change, surgery, treatment, repair, investment, etc.; this is the most stable pattern.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, encyclopedias, general explanatory prose

patterns.name: Fragments in specific nouns or abbreviations
patterns.context: Activates in place names, technical terms, or concept names, with no consistent local syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, medical cases, explanations of political concepts

patterns.name: General predicates or structural words
patterns.context: Appears in accounts of marriage recognition and in sentences explaining causal relationships; each occurs only once, making conditions difficult to determine.

patterns.name: Unidentified subword fragments and proper nouns
patterns.context: Appears in word-initial segments or proper nouns, with no shared context; the reason for activation is unclear.

10_2268.concept: undergone及经历变化
10_2268.description: 最强且反复的触发是“undergone”，涵盖接受手术、修复、检查或经历变化等用法。另有若干术语、地名及普通词片段的零散激活，缺少统一上下文。

patterns.name: gone through/experienced
patterns.context: 在现在完成时或过去完成时结构中，通常后接变化、手术、治疗、修复、投资等经历；为最稳定的模式。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、百科、一般说明文

patterns.name: 特定名词或缩写中的片段
patterns.trigger: “Lag” in “Lagoon”; “The” in “The chloroplast”; “pigment” in “retinitis pigmentosa”; “liquid” in “Liquid democracy”
patterns.context: 在地名、专业术语或概念名称中激活，未见一致的局部句法条件。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、医学病例、政治概念说明

patterns.name: 一般谓词或结构词
patterns.context: 分别出现在婚姻承认的叙述和解释因果关系的句子中；各仅见一次，难以确定条件。

patterns.name: 未明词片段及专名
patterns.context: 出现在词首分词或专名中，缺乏共同上下文；激活原因不明。

en.concept: Subword fragments within specific words (especially ive)
