en.description: Activations most consistently fall on the in-word fragments ive/ational in words such as Effective, Objective, and Informational. The rest are scattered across terms, proper nouns, legal citations, sports entries, and medical-abstract word fragments, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: In-word Effect…ive fragment
patterns.context: The word is split into Effect + ive and appears at the beginning of a sentence or title-like phrase; contexts concern management, personnel handoffs, and date scheduling.

patterns.name: In-word Objective fragment
patterns.context: The word is split into Object + ive and is followed by the study objective and content.

patterns.name: In-word informational fragment
patterns.context: The word is split and used as a modifier in a travel-guide title.

patterns.name: Ball-sport terms and their context
patterns.context: Softball appears repeatedly in the title and body; the text later discusses the bombing of Darwin and Australia’s entry into World War II, with activation also falling on “Darwin”.

patterns.name: Split proper nouns or biomedical word fragments
patterns.context: Isolated subwords or term fragments with no consistent local trigger; they occur in an encyclopedia entry on chloroplast biology and a vasculitis research abstract, respectively.

patterns.name: Legal citation number fragments
patterns.context: Occurs only in the format of federal case citations at the beginning of a sentence segment.

patterns.name: He…el medical word fragment
patterns.context: Pain and weight are mentioned near the end of the abstract, followed by a repetition of “Body weight”.

10_2268.concept: 特定词内子词片段（尤其 ive）
10_2268.description: 激活最稳定地落在 Effective、Objective、Informational 等词的词内片段 ive/ational；其余分散于术语、专名、法律引文、运动条目及医学摘要词片段，未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: Effect…ive 词内片段
patterns.context: 词被拆分为 Effect + ive，出现在句首或标题式短语开头；上下文分别涉及管理、人员交接、日期安排

patterns.name: Objective 词内片段
patterns.context: 词被拆分为 Object + ive，后接研究目的和研究内容

patterns.name: informational 词内片段
patterns.context: 词被拆分，作为旅游指南标题中的修饰语

patterns.name: 球类运动词及其语境
patterns.context: 标题和正文反复出现 softball；后文讲到达尔文轰炸及澳大利亚加入二战，激活也落在“Darwin”

patterns.name: 切分的专名或生物医学词片段
patterns.context: 孤立的子词或术语片段，没有一致的局部触发条件；分别出现在叶绿体生物学条目和血管炎研究摘要中

patterns.name: 法律引文编号片段
patterns.context: 仅出现于句段起始的联邦判例引文格式中

patterns.name: He…el 医学词片段
patterns.trigger: «He»«el»«pain»；可能对应被切分的词，但无法从片段确定完整词
patterns.context: 摘要结尾附近提到疼痛与体重，随后重复“Body weight”

en.concept: Mixed subword fragments and contextual features
en.description: Activations most consistently fall on the word-initial subword Ind-, but the meanings of the following words vary widely; there are also independent responses to cloud-computing rental contexts, the Pelotas subword fragment, and the word certain in combinatorics.

patterns.name: Cloud-computing rental context
patterns.context: Describes a cloud service provider offering rentable compute instances; several related words activate together, with «can» strongest.

patterns.name: Pelotas subword fragment
patterns.context: The proper noun Pelotas is split into multiple subword fragments and repeated after a line break.

patterns.name: Words beginning with Ind-
patterns.context: The initial subword Ind activates strongly; subsequent words and contexts vary, including Indiana, Indirect, Indications, Indocyanine.

patterns.name: Combinatorics terms
patterns.context: Mathematical discussion of integers, combinatorial counting problems, and trees; «certain» is strongest.

10_2268.concept: 混合的词片段与语境特征
10_2268.description: 激活最一致地落在 Ind- 词首子词上，但其后词义跨度很大；另对云计算租赁语境、Pelotas 的子词片段及组合数学中的 certain 等词有独立响应。

patterns.name: 云计算租赁语境
patterns.context: 描述云服务提供商提供可租用的计算实例；多个相关词同时激活，«can»最强。

patterns.name: Pelotas 子词片段
patterns.context: 专名 Pelotas 被拆分为多个子词片段，且在换行后重复出现。

patterns.name: Ind- 起始词
patterns.context: 词首子词 Ind 激活很强；后续词义和语境各异，包括 Indiana、Indirect、Indications、Indocyanine。
patterns.domain: 维基百科、专利背景、医学摘要

patterns.name: 组合数学词语
patterns.context: 关于整数、组合计数问题和树的数学论述；«certain»最强。

en.concept: Academic text structure and title markers
en.description: Activations span various academic titles, section/document markers, medical research objectives and methods, and scientific prose and citations; they also occur in webpage titles and subwords of proper nouns. There is no stable single semantic trigger; the feature may combine title capitalization, structural markers, and subword/function-word characteristics.

patterns.name: Capitalized function words in titles
patterns.context: In title-like phrases, content words or sentence-initial function words are capitalized; activations concentrate near the title beginning and word boundaries.

patterns.name: First word in a title or title field
patterns.context: At the beginning of a title or structured-abstract field, title words are capitalized; may also involve the common title word “To”.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in numbers, abbreviations, and proper nouns
patterns.context: Some fragments activate when proper nouns, abbreviations, or marked literature citations are split into subwords; the trigger is unclear.
patterns.domain: Addresses/institution names, scientific papers and citations

patterns.name: Academic title and section-heading format
patterns.context: In titles or section headings, especially title capitalization, section names, and nearby Markdown/LaTeX markers.

patterns.name: Numbering and equation markers in scientific papers
patterns.context: Near appendices, equations, section headings, or paper-structure markers; marker symbols and numbering may be more relevant than the body text.

patterns.name: Title-like research objective statements
patterns.context: A structured abstract or project description begins with an objective field, followed by a research verb or objective content.

patterns.name: Clinical research participants and inclusion criteria
patterns.context: Sentences describing informed consent, clinical stability, and study inclusion/exclusion criteria.

patterns.name: Syntactic function words in academic prose
patterns.context: Common function words in academic discussion, appearing in methods, background, or results descriptions; these examples alone do not establish stable conditions.

patterns.name: Academic paragraph closure and reference markers
patterns.context: Reference citations at the end of discussion paragraphs; may respond to citation markers or paragraph-closing language.

patterns.name: Acknowledgments and document-ending separator
patterns.context: An acknowledgments heading after the paper appendix, followed by a Markdown separator line.

patterns.name: Abstract/section summary language
patterns.context: A paper summary or section overview contains a summarizing statement such as “show how…”, followed by a section heading.

patterns.name: Pharmacy clinical roles and service titles
patterns.context: A medical paper title describing pharmacy residents providing weekend antimicrobial-related services.

patterns.name: Technical terms in mathematics paper titles
patterns.context: Mathematical technical terms in a title are split into subwords; activation may relate to title format or word fragments.

patterns.name: Scientific topic terms and compound terminology
patterns.context: Scientific prose discussing the formation of two-dimensional crystals and their kinetic and thermodynamic parameters.

10_2268.concept: 学术文本结构与标题标记
10_2268.description: 激活分布在多种学术标题、章节/文档标记、医学研究目的与方法，以及科学正文和引用中；也见于网页标题和专名子词。没有稳定的单一语义触发，可能混合标题大小写、结构标记与子词/功能词特征。

patterns.name: 标题中的功能词大写
patterns.context: 标题式短语中，实词或句首功能词采用大写；激活集中在标题开头和词界附近。

patterns.name: 标题或标题字段的首词
patterns.context: 标题或结构化摘要字段的开头，标题词使用大写；也可能涉及标题中常见的“To”。

patterns.name: 数字、缩写和专名中的分词片段
patterns.context: 专名、缩写或带标记的文献引用被拆成子词时，部分片段激活；触发条件不明确。
patterns.domain: 地址/机构名称、科学论文及引用

patterns.name: 学术标题与章节标题格式
patterns.context: 标题或章节标题中，尤其是标题大小写、章节名以及标题附近的 Markdown/LaTeX 标记。

patterns.name: 科学论文中的编号与公式标记
patterns.context: 附录、公式、节标题或论文结构标记附近；标记符号及编号可能比正文更相关。

patterns.name: 标题式研究目的表述
patterns.context: 结构化摘要或项目简介以目的字段起始，随后出现研究动词或目的内容。

patterns.name: 医学研究参与者与纳入标准
patterns.context: 描述知情同意、临床稳定状态和研究纳入/排除条件的句子。

patterns.name: 学术正文中的句法功能词
patterns.context: 学术论述中的常见功能词，出现在方法、背景或结果说明中；仅凭这些例子难以确定稳定条件。

patterns.name: 学术段落收束与参考文献标记
patterns.context: 讨论段落末尾的参考文献引用，可能对引文标记或段落收束语有响应。

patterns.name: 致谢与文档结束分隔线
patterns.context: 论文附录之后的致谢标题及其后的 Markdown 分隔线。

patterns.name: 摘要/章节总结语
patterns.context: 论文总结或章节概述中，出现“show how…”等总结性陈述，随后进入章节标题。

patterns.name: 药学临床角色与服务标题
patterns.context: 医学论文标题中描述药学住院医师提供周末抗菌药物相关服务。

patterns.name: 数学论文的专业标题词
patterns.context: 标题中的数学专业术语被拆分为子词；其触发可能与标题格式或词片段有关。

patterns.name: 科学主题词与复合术语
patterns.context: 讨论二维晶体形成及其动力学、热力学参数的科学正文。

en.concept: Scientific paper text and structural markers
en.description: Activations span mathematical physics, biomedicine, and paper metadata; visible triggers include the mathematical condition x>0, title and section/book markers, scientific proper nouns and abbreviations, and specific discussion in body text. The passages have no single stable theme.

patterns.name: x>0 condition in equations or mathematical typesetting
patterns.context: Appears in LaTeX equations, especially near statements about function continuity or subsequent mathematical conclusions; this condition receives strong activation.

patterns.name: Document titles and structural markers
patterns.context: Appears near paper metadata, section headings, or Markdown/LaTeX-style structural markers; activations occur in titles, abstracts, and section boundaries.
patterns.domain: Document structure in ArXiv and biomedical papers

patterns.name: Rare or anomalous proper nouns and terms in scientific papers
patterns.context: Appears in specialized terms, abbreviations, and nearby text in biomedical or physics paper bodies; some terms themselves or their subword fragments activate.

patterns.name: References and bibliographic information
patterns.context: Appears in paper front matter or bibliography fields, including author names, reference filenames, or bibliographic labels.

patterns.name: Special word form in an unbiased-estimator title
patterns.context: Appears in an all-caps, hyphen-split paper title, which ends with a line break and abstract metadata.

patterns.name: Expository English fragments before section headings
patterns.context: Ordinary academic prose concerning costs, funding constraints, or administrative procedures; activation words are scattered through sentences rather than limited to titles.

patterns.name: Neuroscience experimental hypothesis statements
patterns.context: Compares patients, unaffected limbs, and healthy controls, and describes brain-region activation during an emotion-regulation task.

patterns.name: Random fields and Ising model terminology
patterns.context: In a mathematical physics paper, an expression is written as the partition function of a random-field Ising model.

patterns.name: Formal differential operators and discussion of continuous functions
patterns.context: Near an equation, a conclusion for positive x is given under a continuity condition.

patterns.name: Dark matter paper title and introduction
patterns.context: Appears in a paper excerpt containing bibliographic fields, a title, and an introduction section marker.

10_2268.concept: 科学论文文本与结构标记
10_2268.description: 激活分布跨数学物理、生物医学及论文元数据；可见触发包括 x>0 数学条件、标题与章节/书目标记、科学专名缩写及正文中的特定论述。段间没有单一稳定主题。

patterns.name: 公式或数学排版中的 x>0 条件
patterns.context: 出现在 LaTeX 数学公式中，尤其紧邻关于函数连续性或后续数学结论的表述；此条件字符获得很强激活。
patterns.domain: 数学论文、形式化数学排版

patterns.name: 文档标题与结构标记
patterns.context: 出现在论文元数据、章节标题或 Markdown/LaTeX 风格的结构标记附近；标题、摘要和章节边界中有激活。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 与生物医学论文的文档结构

patterns.name: 科学论文中罕见或格式异常的专名与术语
patterns.context: 出现在生物医学或物理学论文正文的专门术语、缩写及其附近；部分术语自身或分词片段激活。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与物理学论文

patterns.name: 参考文献与书目信息
patterns.context: 出现在论文前置信息或文献列表字段中，包含作者名、参考文献文件名或书目标签。
patterns.domain: 论文元数据与书目排版

patterns.name: 不偏估计标题中的特殊词形
patterns.context: 出现在全大写、带连字符拆分的论文标题中，且标题以换行和 abstract 元数据结束。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文标题/摘要头部

patterns.name: 分节标题前的论述性英文片段
patterns.context: 普通学术散文正文中，涉及成本、资金限制或行政程序；激活词分散在句中，并非只限标题。
patterns.domain: 医学/公共卫生论文正文

patterns.name: 神经科学实验假设表述
patterns.trigger: "specifically tested the hypothesis"、"schizophrenia patients"、"frontal and amygdala activation"
patterns.context: 比较患者、未患病手足与健康对照，并描述情绪调节任务中的脑区激活。
patterns.domain: 精神病学与神经影像论文

patterns.name: 随机场与 Ising 模型术语
patterns.context: 在数学物理论文中将某个表达式写成随机场 Ising 模型的配分函数。

patterns.name: 形式化微分算子与连续函数论述
patterns.context: 公式附近以连续性为条件给出对正 x 成立的结论。

patterns.name: 暗物质论文的标题与引言
patterns.trigger: "Scalar field dark matter with a cosh potential, revisited"、"Introduction"
patterns.context: 出现在带有书目字段、标题及引言章节标记的论文片段中。

en.concept: Not caring and terminology in research contexts
en.description: The most stable cue is “don’t care” across different contexts; in addition, systematic research language and biomedical terminology activate in research texts. Other scattered topics include communication, risk tradeoffs, colloquial disputes, and regulation, which are difficult to group into one pattern.

patterns.name: “care” followed by negation or an irrelevant object
patterns.context: The trigger mainly falls on care (segments 1 and 2 mark care; segments 5, 6, and 10 mark care), usually in a “don’t care” construction; across different meanings, it indicates indifference to an object or consequence, or whether something is understood.
patterns.domain: Online forums, emails, and general discussion

patterns.name: Systematic research language in research texts
patterns.context: Systematic occurs with a following noun to describe systematically identifying or reviewing a research topic; activation also extends to surrounding research terms.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research paper abstracts and body text

patterns.name: Disease, drug, and physiological mechanism terms in health research
patterns.context: Occurs in scientific discussion of alcohol use, disease mechanisms, drug candidates, or cell therapy; activations involve terms and neighboring words, with no single stable trigger word.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers and NIH project text

patterns.name: Research communication and stakeholder engagement
patterns.context: Discusses research evaluation, communication, and conveying information to non-specialists.
patterns.domain: Public health or health research papers

patterns.name: Risk-benefit tradeoffs
patterns.context: Explains a basis for choices, using drug use, fatal risks, and law as examples.

patterns.name: Colloquial dialogue and quotation format
patterns.context: Forum disputes or quoted emails contain colloquial, rebutting, and adversarial language; there is no clear shared trigger.

patterns.name: Taxi regulation and health insurance companies
patterns.context: The same paragraph mentions taxi regulations and companies managing health insurance; their relationship is unclear.

10_2268.concept: 不在意与科研语境中的术语
10_2268.description: 最稳定的线索是不同语境中的“don’t care”；此外，科研文本里系统性研究措辞及生物医学术语也有激活。另有传播、风险权衡、口语争论和监管等零散主题，难以归为一个统一模式。

patterns.name: “care”后接否定或无关对象
patterns.context: 触发主要落在 care（第1、2段标在 care；第5、6、10段标在 care），且周围多是“don’t care”结构；在不同语义中表示不在意对象、后果或理解与否。
patterns.domain: 网络论坛、邮件及一般论述

patterns.name: 科研文本中的系统性研究措辞
patterns.context: systematic 与后续名词共同出现，描述系统地识别或综述研究对象；激活还分布于周围科研术语。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究论文摘要及正文

patterns.name: 健康研究中的疾病、药物及生理机制术语
patterns.context: 处于关于酒精使用、疾病机制、药物候选物或细胞治疗的科学论述中；激活涉及术语及其邻近词，未见单一稳定触发词。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与 NIH 项目文本

patterns.name: 研究传播与利益相关者参与
patterns.context: 讨论研究评估、传播及面向非专业人士的信息表达。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生或健康研究论文

patterns.name: 风险与收益权衡
patterns.context: 说明选择依据，并以药物使用、致命风险及法律为例。

patterns.name: 口语化对话及引用格式
patterns.trigger: “That’s not a justification”及引述中的“proper English”
patterns.context: 论坛争论或邮件引用中出现口语、反驳及带有对抗性的表达；没有明确共同触发项。

patterns.name: 出租车监管与健康保险公司
patterns.context: 同一段落提到出租车规定及管理健康保险的公司；两者关系不明。

en.concept: Common expressions in relationships and discourse structure
en.description: Activations span prepositional relationship structures, emphasis and qualification, negative judgments, and pronominal expressions; local themes also include biomedical mechanisms, cognitive states, personal accounts of gaming, and inclusion-related disputes. There is no single stable lexical trigger.

patterns.name: Phrases introduced in prepositional/relational structures
patterns.context: Appears in prepositional phrases connecting domains, objects, properties, or abstract relations; specific meanings before and after it vary.
patterns.domain: Research abstracts and theoretical discussion, also forum text

patterns.name: Emphasis or focus words
patterns.context: Introduces focus, qualification, contrast, or concluding emphasis in statements; it does not always serve the same rhetorical function.

patterns.name: Negative/equative judgments of identity or state
patterns.context: Negates, distinguishes, or states a position about a state, preference, or judgment; spans academic definitions and colloquial opinions.

patterns.name: Reference and pronominal expressions
patterns.context: In forums or personal narratives, pronouns refer back to prior objects or express personal opinions or experiences.

patterns.name: Statements of mechanisms, processes, and relationships in research
patterns.context: Describes biological mechanisms, regulatory processes, relationships between research projects, or translational significance.

patterns.name: Cognition, perception, and states of consciousness
patterns.context: Discusses changes in alertness, perception, and distinctions between different states of consciousness or sleep.

patterns.name: Gaming preferences and personal confession
patterns.context: The speaker admits to liking games and says that many things in life serve the purpose of playing games.

patterns.name: Attitude expression in an inclusion-related dispute
patterns.context: Quotes and rebuts the other party’s characterization of their position as opposing inclusivity, then explains their own attitude toward inclusivity.

patterns.name: Local triggers in nonstandard or fragmentary text
patterns.context: These high-activation words are scattered across different contexts, so the samples do not establish a shared, independent semantic trigger.
patterns.domain: Forum text, political commentary, biomedical abstracts, and philosophical discussion

10_2268.concept: 关系与论述结构中的常见表达
10_2268.description: 激活分布于介词关系结构、强调与限定、否定判断及代词表达；另见生物医学机制、认知状态、游戏自述和包容性争论等局部主题，缺乏单一稳定的词义触发。

patterns.name: 介词/关系结构中的词组引出
patterns.context: 出现在介词短语中，连接领域、对象、属性或抽象关系；前后具体词义不固定。
patterns.domain: 科研摘要与理论论述，也见论坛文本

patterns.name: 强调或聚焦词
patterns.context: 在陈述中引出重点、限定、转折或总结性强调；并非总是同一种修辞功能。

patterns.name: 身份或状态的否定/等同判断
patterns.context: 对状态、偏好或判断作否定、区别或表态；跨越学术定义和口语意见表达。
patterns.domain: 科研论述、博客/论坛对话

patterns.name: 指称与代词化表达
patterns.context: 论坛或个人叙述中用代词承接前文对象、表达个人意见或经历。

patterns.name: 科研中的机制、过程与关联表述
patterns.trigger: «linking»« extrinsic»« signals»« with»« genetic»« programs»（[6]）；«mechanistic»« and»« translational»« program»（[9]）；«gene»« expression»（[10]）
patterns.context: 描述生物学机制、调控过程、研究项目之间的关联或转化意义。

patterns.name: 认知、知觉及意识状态术语
patterns.context: 讨论警觉性变化、知觉以及不同意识或睡眠状态的区别。

patterns.name: 游戏偏好与个人坦白
patterns.context: 说话者坦承喜欢游戏，并称生活中许多事情都服务于玩游戏。

patterns.name: 包容性争论中的态度表达
patterns.context: 引用并反驳对方将其立场概括为反对包容性，随后说明自己对包容性的态度。
patterns.domain: 技术项目相关论坛争论

patterns.name: 非标准或残缺文本中的局部触发
patterns.context: 这些高激活词分散在不同语境中，不能从样本中确定它们有共同、独立的语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 论坛文本、政治评论、生物医学摘要与哲学论述

en.description: Highlights concentrate on recent and the time phrases that follow it, as well as “I love” expressions of liking in forums; academic exemplification phrase “for instance,” and the Causality word fragment in a citation also appear.

patterns.name: Time modifier recent
patterns.context: Recent modifies following noun phrases such as growth, development, interest, papers, or reports; it may be preceded by degree words or other modifiers.

patterns.name: I love expressions
patterns.context: First person expresses liking in colloquial or online text, followed by that style of thinking, everything, or it.

patterns.name: Instance in an exemplification phrase
patterns.context: Occurs in the exemplification transition “for instance,” followed by a citation or example.

patterns.name: Split fragment of the term Causality
patterns.context: Located in the book-title-like citation Causality after the author name Pearl; the highlight falls on a split word fragment.

10_2268.concept: 近期性与喜爱表达
10_2268.description: 高亮集中于 recent 及其后接名词的时间短语，也集中于论坛中的“I love”喜爱表达；另见学术举例语“for instance,”和引文中的 Causality 词片段。

patterns.name: recent 的时间修饰语
patterns.context: recent 修饰后续的增长、发展、兴趣、论文或报告等名词短语；前后可有程度词或其他修饰语。

patterns.name: I love 的表达
patterns.context: 第一人称在口语或网络文本中表达喜爱，后接 that style of thinking、everything 或 it。

patterns.name: 例示语中的 instance
patterns.context: 出现在“for instance,”这一举例衔接语中，后接引用或例子。

patterns.name: 术语 Causality 的拆分片段
patterns.context: 位于作者姓名 Pearl 之后、书名式引文 Causality 之中；高亮落在被拆分的词片段上。

en.description: Primarily responds to recent and its collocations in academic literature, especially recent work/report/success/results/advances/occurrence, used to introduce background, motivation, or rationale; other general paper-abstract-style questions and methods statements are more weakly related.

patterns.name: Introducing recent literature
patterns.context: In academic text, recent modifies a study, result, advance, or event; activations concentrate on recent and adjacent words.

patterns.name: Research motivation or background setup
patterns.context: Prior work or real-world events introduced by recent are used as research motivation, background, or methodological rationale.

patterns.name: Research questions and methods in academic abstracts
patterns.context: States a paper’s contribution, proof, method, or research objective around an unresolved or understudied question; does not necessarily contain recent.

patterns.name: Evaluative statements about recent research progress
patterns.context: Describes recent results as successes, advances, or findings that can inform current work.

10_2268.concept: 近期研究背景引介
10_2268.description: 主要对学术文献中的 recent 及其搭配起反应，尤其是 recent work/report/success/results/advances/occurrence，用于引出背景、动机或依据；另有若干一般论文摘要式问题与方法陈述，关系较弱。

patterns.name: recent 文献引入
patterns.context: 学术文本中 recent 修饰某项研究、成果、进展或事件；激活集中在 recent 及其相邻词。

patterns.name: 研究动机或背景铺垫
patterns.trigger: “Motivated by” “A recent report” “Built on the recent success” “To cite a recent occurrence” “Our approach combines the recent results” “also inspired by recent advances”
patterns.context: recent 引出的既有工作或现实事件被用作研究动机、背景或方法依据。

patterns.name: 学术摘要中的研究问题与方法
patterns.trigger: “the general analytical result is still lacking” “less studied” “we show” “we provide” “an open problem”
patterns.context: 围绕尚未解决或研究不足的问题，陈述论文贡献、证明、方法或研究目标；不一定含 recent。

patterns.name: 近期研究进展的评价性表述
patterns.context: 把近期成果描述为成功、进展或可供当前工作借鉴的结果。

en.concept: Research progress and problem statements in academic texts
en.description: Strong activations often occur in formal academic or technical text, especially recent/recently describing recent progress and statements of research tasks, problems, or findings; there are also technical narratives from different fields and an NP explanation for beginners.

patterns.name: recent / recently
patterns.context: Describes recent progress, work, successes, or findings in academic or research contexts; nearby words often include “success”, “advances”, “developed”, “work”, “identified”.

patterns.name: Academic tasks and research subjects
patterns.context: Formal, explanatory academic statements concerning research tasks, questions, observations, or methods.
patterns.domain: Paper abstracts, mathematics papers, patent backgrounds

patterns.name: Explanation of NP-complete problems
patterns.context: Explains a theoretical computer science concept for beginners and gives examples such as SAT.

patterns.name: Specific technical narratives that do not form a clear group
patterns.context: The passages respectively discuss robotics, drug screening, pathogen signaling systems, and stochastic differential equations; beyond formal technical style, they share no obvious triggering content.
patterns.domain: Patents, life-science project descriptions, mathematics papers

10_2268.concept: 学术研究进展与问题陈述
10_2268.description: 强激活多见于正式学术或技术文本，尤其是 recent/recently 描述近期进展，以及陈述研究任务、问题或发现；另有不同领域的专门技术叙述和一段面向初学者的 NP 解释。

patterns.name: recent / recently
patterns.context: 在学术或研究语境中，描述近期进展、工作、成功或发现；附近常接 “success”“advances”“developed”“work”“identified”。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、科研项目说明

patterns.name: 学术任务与研究对象
patterns.context: 围绕研究任务、问题、观察或方法展开，常见正式、说明性的学术表述。
patterns.domain: 论文摘要、数学论文、专利背景

patterns.name: NP 完全问题解释
patterns.trigger: “when explaining $NP$ to someone for the first time”及“hard to avoid comparisons”
patterns.context: 面向初学者解释理论计算机科学概念，并举 SAT 等例子。

patterns.name: 未能明确归并的具体技术叙述
patterns.trigger: “impossible to use the same robotic arm”；“ion channels”；“quorum-sensing systems”；“BSDEs”
patterns.context: 各段分别讨论机器人、药物筛选、病原体信号系统及随机微分方程；除正式技术文风外，没有共同的明显触发内容。
patterns.domain: 专利、生命科学项目说明、数学论文

en.description: Activations are scattered across papers, patents, legal lists, and emails: highlighting recently in research progress, defect/existing-method wording in patent background sections, lists of legal personnel and locations, and formal apologies, along with several isolated words and phrases; there is no unified semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Research progress statements introduced by recently
patterns.context: recently appears in a sentence followed by researchers proposing, developing, or discovering something; both contexts contain the structure “We have recently…”

patterns.name: applicants have observed in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: In patent background sections, stating defects of existing devices or solutions, or the lack of a convenient approach

patterns.name: Negative evaluation of a technical solution using cumbersome
patterns.context: Describing the inconvenience of a system or method for a particular use (here, rinsing semiconductor equipment); the contrastive word however appears nearby

patterns.name: Surname-style reference Anderson after a name
patterns.context: In patent documents, near patent numbers and inventor names when listing prior art or patents

patterns.name: Statements that a method is well known in the field
patterns.context: Introducing an existing method and its standing in the field in a technical background; method names and technical-field wording appear nearby

patterns.name: Lists of legal personnel names and locations
patterns.context: Lists of lawyers, officials, or institutional personnel in legal documents, with U.S. cities and state/region abbreviations after names

patterns.name: confusion in notices of apology and inconvenience
patterns.context: After stating that an error has been identified and corrected, expressing regret for confusion or inconvenience caused to recipients

patterns.name: Other scattered paper and patent-background wording
patterns.context: Appears respectively in an introduction to graph representation learning, an issue with model order, an error-order expression, and itemized statements in patent backgrounds; no shared local trigger condition is evident
patterns.domain: ArXiv papers and USPTO patent backgrounds

10_2268.concept: none
10_2268.description: 激活分散于论文、专利、法律名单和邮件：突出 recently 的研究进展、专利背景中的缺陷/既有方法措辞、法律人员地点列举及正式道歉，并有若干孤立词句；没有统一语义触发模式。

patterns.name: recently 引导的研究进展表述
patterns.context: 句中出现 recently，后接研究者提出、开发或发现某事；两处上下文均有“We have recently…”结构

patterns.name: 专利背景中的 applicants have observed
patterns.context: 专利背景技术中，陈述现有设备或方案的缺陷、缺少便利做法

patterns.name: 技术方案的负面评价词 cumbersome
patterns.context: 描述系统或方法在特定用途（此处为冲洗半导体设备）上的不便；转折词 however 邻近

patterns.name: 人名后的姓氏式称谓 Anderson
patterns.context: 专利文献中列举既有技术或专利时，专利号及发明人姓名附近

patterns.name: 方法在领域内知名的表述
patterns.context: 技术背景介绍某种已有方法及其领域地位；邻近方法名称和技术领域措辞

patterns.name: 法律人员姓名与地点列举
patterns.context: 法律文书中的律师、官员或机构人员名单，姓名后列出美国城市及州/地区缩写

patterns.name: 道歉与不便通知中的 confusion
patterns.context: 通知说明错误已识别并纠正后，以 regret 表达对收件人造成困惑或不便的歉意

patterns.name: 其他零散论文与专利背景措辞
patterns.context: 分别出现在图表示学习的引言、模型阶数问题、误差阶表达式及专利背景的分项陈述中；未见共同的局部触发条件
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文及 USPTO 专利背景

en.concept: Problem and evaluation statements in technical backgrounds
en.description: Common in background discussions, introducing a research field, existing method, or system before identifying problems, limitations, complexity, or performance; also responding to broad-scope, evaluation, contrast, and example-related expressions. A few passages share only these writing functions.

patterns.name: Contrastive statements of problems or limitations
patterns.context: After introducing a method, system, or research background, identifying difficulties, defects, scaling bottlenecks, or unresolved problems; often includes evaluations such as however, problem, or failure.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, academic paper introductions, and technical discussions

patterns.name: Research-field and method background
patterns.context: Overview of a field, related technology, or existing method, and its research standing, applications, or background.

patterns.name: Complexity and scalability
patterns.context: Directly discussing the complexity or scalability of an algorithm or system, or evaluating complexity alongside performance.
patterns.domain: Machine learning, statistics, and computational methods

patterns.name: Broad fields or application scope
patterns.context: Emphasizing that researchers, professional sources, or applications span multiple fields, are numerous, or are widespread.
patterns.domain: Academic writing, patent backgrounds, and forum posts

patterns.name: Contrastive or additive transitions
patterns.context: Introducing a contrast, progression, or subsequent development after a statement; activation falls on a connective or nearby, but need not correspond to the same topic.
patterns.domain: Technical descriptions, papers, and informal writing

patterns.name: Evaluation of expected and actual performance
patterns.context: Evaluating whether a method, theory, or technology succeeds, performs well, or falls short of expectations.

patterns.name: Waiting to develop awareness or understanding
patterns.context: Describing how people need time to understand the impact of a paradigm shift; weakly related to other technical-background passages.

patterns.name: Examples of methods and systems
patterns.context: Expanding on a previously mentioned method, defect, or system by giving examples or lists.

10_2268.concept: 技术背景中的问题与评价论述
10_2268.description: 常见于背景论述中，介绍研究领域、既有方法或系统后，指出问题、局限、复杂度或性能；也响应范围广、评价、转折及举例等邻近表达，少数段落只共享这些写作功能。

patterns.name: 问题或局限的转折说明
patterns.trigger: “complicated by the fact” “bottleneck” “shortcomings” “cumbersome, however” “hur[d]led by” “central problem” “complex, bulky, and expensive”
patterns.context: 在介绍方法、系统或研究背景后，指出其困难、缺陷、规模瓶颈或待解决问题；常带 however、problem、failure 等评价。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、学术论文引言与技术讨论

patterns.name: 研究领域及方法背景
patterns.trigger: “in this field” “fundamental tools” “investigations about” “researches and techniques related to” “well-known”
patterns.context: 概述领域、相关技术或既有方法，并说明其研究地位、应用或背景。

patterns.name: 复杂度与可扩展性
patterns.context: 直接讨论算法或系统的复杂度、可扩展性，或将复杂度与性能并列评价。
patterns.domain: 机器学习、统计与计算方法

patterns.name: 广泛领域或应用范围
patterns.trigger: “various fields” “numerous researchers” “various sources of expertise” “widely it would be used”
patterns.context: 强调研究者、专业来源或应用范围跨领域、数量众多或传播广泛。
patterns.domain: 学术论述、专利背景及论坛文字

patterns.name: 转折或递进连接表达
patterns.context: 在陈述后引入转折、递进或后续发展；激活落在连接词或其附近，但未必对应同一主题。
patterns.domain: 技术说明、论文与非正式文字

patterns.name: 关于预期与实际表现的评价
patterns.context: 评价方法、理论或技术是否成功、表现良好或未达预期。

patterns.name: 等待形成认知或理解
patterns.trigger: “we can even get a feel for the space”
patterns.context: 描述范式变化后，人们需经过一段时间才能理解其影响；与其他技术背景段落关联较弱。

patterns.name: 方法、系统的实例陈述
patterns.context: 以举例或列举方式展开先前提及的方法、缺陷或系统。

en.description: Activations span heterogeneous phrases: negative dis- stems, evaluations of computational burden, uncertainty about terminology or statements of being a beginner, lists of disciplines, technical citations, references to luck, and differential-algebra terminology; there is no clear unified semantic or stylistic condition.

patterns.name: dis-/disappointment and negative feelings
patterns.context: The stem dis- combines with a subsequent negative-emotion word; examples describe a response as disheartening and a business outcome as disappointing

patterns.name: Computational cost and efficiency limits
patterns.context: Describing the computational burden, scope of applicability, and efficiency issues of existing solutions

patterns.name: Terminology uncertainty and self-positioning as a beginner
patterns.context: The questioner is unsure whether a term is common, or says the question may be basic and mainly concerns terminology

patterns.name: Mathematics/science field names and discipline lists
patterns.context: Scientific or academic texts listing fields, disciplines, or interdisciplinary directions
patterns.domain: Academic papers and research project abstracts

patterns.name: Terms or citation fragments in academic references
patterns.context: Reference entries containing speech recognition, neural networks, and journal names
patterns.domain: Technical literature citations in patent backgrounds

patterns.name: Statements of accidental success near luck
patterns.context: Attributing the chance of discovery or success to pure luck

patterns.name: Differential algebra statements
patterns.context: Discussing solvability, differential field towers, and specialized differential algebra content

10_2268.concept: none
10_2268.description: 激活覆盖异质短语：负面失望词干、计算负担评价、术语不确定或基础性自述、学科列举、技术引文、luck表述及微分代数术语；没有明显统一的语义或文体条件。

patterns.name: dis-/失望及负面感受
patterns.context: 词干 dis- 与后续负面情绪词组合；分别描述回应令人灰心，以及商业上失望

patterns.name: 计算成本与效率限制
patterns.trigger: «computational»8« effort»4«,»10« work»5« with»8« a»6« very»7« limited»5« and»5« inefficient»2« matrix»2
patterns.context: 描述既有方案的计算负担、适用范围和效率问题

patterns.name: 术语不确定及基础性自我定位
patterns.trigger: «just»10« missed»2；«mostly»3« a»7« matter»6« of»9« terminology»4；«quite»5« basic»4
patterns.context: 提问者不确定术语是否常见，或说明问题可能基础、主要是术语问题

patterns.name: 数学／科学领域名称与学科列举
patterns.trigger: «e»4«.»4«g»3«.,»10« computer»9« science»6«,»9« statistics»5« and»8« mathematics»6；«physical»9« and»6 biological»7« sciences»4
patterns.context: 科学或学术文本列举领域、学科或跨学科方向
patterns.domain: 学术论文与研究项目摘要

patterns.name: 学术参考文献中的术语或引文片段
patterns.trigger: «Ph»2«on»3«eme»3« recognition»2« using»5 time«-»3«delay»3« neural»3« networks»3；«IEEE»5« Trans»4«.»10 Ac«oust»1«ics»1«.»4« Speech»2
patterns.context: 参考文献条目中出现语音识别、神经网络及期刊名称
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的技术文献引文

patterns.name: luck附近的偶然成功表述
patterns.context: 把发现机会或成功归因于纯粹运气

patterns.name: 微分代数领域表述
patterns.trigger: «differential»2« algebra»2« field»4；«ascending» tower»1« of differential» fields»3
patterns.context: 讨论可解性、微分域塔及微分代数专业内容

en.description: Primarily responds to expressions of doubt, negation, questioning, and limitations of methods or claims, often appearing in first-person qualifications and technical discussions; also includes a legal-evidence passage and dis- word-form triggers, which cannot be unified into a single theme.

patterns.name: Uncertainty, doubt, and questioning
patterns.context: Expressing uncertainty or doubt about a term, claim, method, or assumption, or identifying its limitations; often accompanied by contrastive terms such as “but” or “however”

patterns.name: Negative or absent responses
patterns.context: Describing no response, not having encountered a usage, or not finding relevant information

patterns.name: Retrospection and self-qualification
patterns.context: A first-person speaker qualifies their judgment, experience, or knowledge

patterns.name: Professional technical problems, methods, or complexity
patterns.context: Discussing algorithms, computational cost, technical steps, models, or the properties and limitations of methods
patterns.domain: ArXiv academic papers and patent backgrounds

patterns.name: Legal evidence and case citations
patterns.context: Legal text stating that evidence may rebut testimony and citing case law

patterns.name: Relaying another person's view and responding with rebuttal or requests for evidence
patterns.context: First acknowledging or assuming that a claim may be true, then asking for evidence or expressing reservations

patterns.name: Research questions and limitations in academic writing
patterns.context: Introducing research questions, applicability conditions, or method defects; formal tone

patterns.name: Lexical triggers in dis- prefixed words
patterns.context: Activation falls inside negative-evaluation words with dis-, but the contexts vary, so it is unclear whether this is a stable trigger independent of doubt or negation patterns

patterns.name: Other technical discussions
patterns.context: Topics vary; these snippets alone do not establish that the topic words themselves are triggers
patterns.domain: Mathematical physics, software Q&A, and programming discussions

10_2268.concept: 质疑与局限表达
10_2268.description: 主要响应怀疑、否定、质疑及对方法或主张的局限说明，也常见于第一人称自我限定和技术论述；另有法律证据段及 dis- 词形触发，不能归并成单一主题。

patterns.name: 不确定性、怀疑与质疑
patterns.trigger: “not sure”“dubious”“I’ve never heard”“hasn’t helped”“need to see some citations”“fragile”“suffers from errors”
patterns.context: 对术语、主张、方法或假设表示不确定、怀疑，或指出其局限；常带有“but”“however”一类转折
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、问答、学术论文

patterns.name: 否定或缺失的回应
patterns.trigger: “lack of response”“not ... sure”“never heard”“never seen”“hasn’t helped”
patterns.context: 描述没有回应、没有见过某种用法，或没有找到相关信息

patterns.name: 事后反思与自我限定
patterns.trigger: “I’d need to see”“I’m a little dubious”“Perhaps I’ve just”“I’ve never”“I’m not sure”
patterns.context: 第一人称发言者限定自己的判断、经验或知识范围

patterns.name: 专业技术问题、方法或复杂度
patterns.context: 讨论算法、计算成本、技术步骤、模型或方法的性质与局限
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文与专利背景

patterns.name: 法律证据与判例引述
patterns.trigger: “objective evidence”“witness’s story”“testimony”“Anderson v. City of Bessemer City”
patterns.context: 法律文本中陈述证据可能反驳证词，并引用判例

patterns.name: 转述他人观点并提出反驳或索证
patterns.trigger: “It may be true ... but”“Perhaps ... wrong cars”“need to see some citations”
patterns.context: 先承认或假设某主张可能成立，随后要求证据或表达保留

patterns.name: 学术写作中的研究问题与限制
patterns.trigger: “The central problem”“Such problems occur”“assumption is usually valid ... but rather fragile”“suffers from errors”
patterns.context: 介绍研究问题、适用条件或方法缺陷；语气较正式

patterns.name: dis- 前缀词中的词汇触发
patterns.context: 激活落在带 dis- 的负面评价词内部，但上下文不同，不能确定是独立于怀疑或否定模式的稳定触发

patterns.name: 其他技术性讨论
patterns.context: 专业主题各异；仅凭这些片段无法确认主题词本身是触发条件
patterns.domain: 数学物理、软件问答与编程讨论

en.description: Activations are scattered across dis- negative-evaluation words, expressions of field scope, legal abbreviations and names, and a range of specialized compounds and ordinary words; aside from several local word-form and stylistic cues, no unified semantic or domain pattern emerges.

patterns.name: disingenuous word forms
patterns.context: Activation falls inside words beginning with dis- that express negative evaluation; examples include disheartening and disingenuous.

patterns.name: Field-specific expressions
patterns.context: When discussing the scope of a problem, academic fields, or branches of natural science, triggers cluster around field-scope words such as domain/field/branch and nearby expressions.
patterns.domain: Patent technology, machine learning papers, mathematics papers

patterns.name: Abbreviations in legal citations
patterns.context: Activation falls on letters and periods in state-name or legal-institution abbreviations, appearing in legal texts such as case citations or lawyer lists.

patterns.name: Compound technical terms and within-word fragments
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across local fragments of compound words, affixes, or specialized terms, surrounded by technical concepts or academic discussion; these fragments have no evident unified meaning or stable position.
patterns.domain: Science fiction/military discussion, programming, patents, academic papers

patterns.name: Legal person and place entities
patterns.context: Activations are distributed around names, city/state names, and court names, co-occurring with legal-abbreviation activations in the same passage.
patterns.domain: Lawyer lists or court information in U.S. legal documents

patterns.name: Ordinary words and phrase fragments
patterns.context: These activations fall on function words, ordinary evaluative words, field-specific content words, or different positions within phrases; the available snippets do not support a consistent trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Online discussions, academic, technical, and legal texts

10_2268.concept: none
10_2268.description: 激活分散于 dis- 负面评价词、领域范围表达、法律缩写及名称，也遍布多种专业复合词和普通词语；除若干局部词形与文体线索外，未呈现统一语义或领域模式。

patterns.name: disingenuous词形
patterns.context: 激活落在以 dis- 开头、表达负面评价的词内部；包括 disheartening 和 disingenuous。

patterns.name: 领域特定表达
patterns.trigger: «domain»8« specific»4« issue»6（第7段）；«fields»8« such»3（第8段）；«branches»6« of»8« natural»5« sciences»5（第9段）
patterns.context: 在谈论问题适用范围、学科领域或自然科学分支时，触发词集中于 domain/field/branch 等领域范围词及邻近表达。
patterns.domain: 专利技术、机器学习论文、数学论文

patterns.name: 法律引文缩写
patterns.context: 激活落在州名或法律机构缩写的字母、句点组合中，出现在判例引文或律师名单等法律文本中。

patterns.name: 复合技术术语与词内片段
patterns.context: 激活散布在复合词、词缀或专业术语的局部片段中，周围是技术概念或学术论述；这些片段未见统一词义或稳定位置。
patterns.domain: 科幻／军事论述、编程、专利、学术论文

patterns.name: 法律人名地名实体
patterns.context: 激活分布在人名、城市／州名及法院名称附近，且与同段的法律缩写激活并存。
patterns.domain: 美国法律文书中的律师名单或法院信息

patterns.name: 普通词语与短语碎片
patterns.trigger: «surprising»（第1段）；«the military»、«understands»（第2段）；«access»（第5段）；«witness’s story»、«testimony»（第6段）；«predictable»（第7段）；«great importance»、«environmental sciences»（第8段）；«various»（第9段）；«argued»（第10段）
patterns.context: 这些激活落在语法词、普通评价词、领域内容词或短语中的不同位置，现有片段不足以归纳出一致的触发条件。
patterns.domain: 跨网络讨论、学术、技术及法律文本

en.description: Primarily responds to source, basis, or method relations introduced by from, as well as data processing and academic technical discussion; also appears in physics research topics, statements of research attention, and disheartening in forum posts. Several strongly activated words lack a unified semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Research-field sources following “from”
patterns.context: Activation falls near from and its following phrase, involving researchers' origins or the sources of theories and methods; the precise semantics differ across examples.

patterns.name: data / big data and data processing
patterns.context: Discussing data entry, storage, analysis, or migration; activations occur on these words and in related sentences.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, machine learning research, technical discussions

patterns.name: Physics research topics
patterns.context: Introducing a physics field, research topic, or related method; activation does not always fall on the same physics term.

patterns.name: Statements of research importance and attention in literature
patterns.context: Academic or technical descriptions stating that a research topic is important, has attracted attention, or that a problem is increasingly being addressed.

patterns.name: Cause, source, or basis relations
patterns.context: Describing the source, basis, or means used for an interest, reasoning ability, or technical method.

patterns.name: Researchers and expansion across fields
patterns.context: Researchers from multiple fields are attracted to areas such as statistical learning; strong activation occurs near from.

patterns.name: Migration and lack of response in a forum narrative
patterns.context: A post first mentions migrating to documents, then describes receiving no replies from other hackers; strong activation is concentrated on the subword fragment heart in disheartening.

patterns.name: Scattered activations on descriptive words
patterns.context: These words occur in different contexts, and the snippets do not support a stable, shared trigger condition.

patterns.name: Explicit technical terms and reasoning statements
patterns.context: Appears in technical descriptions of different topics; beyond academic/technical style, there is no clear shared trigger condition.

10_2268.concept: 来源与技术研究论述
10_2268.description: 主要响应 from 引出的来源、依据或方法关系，以及数据处理和学术技术论述；也见于物理研究主题、研究关注度表述及论坛帖子中的 disheartening。若干强激活词缺乏统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: “from”后接研究领域来源
patterns.context: 激活落在 from 及其后续短语附近，涉及研究者的来源或理论、方法所借鉴的来源；不同例子中具体语义不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、专利技术背景

patterns.name: data / big data 与数据处理
patterns.context: 讨论数据的录入、存储、分析或迁移，触发分布在这些词及相关句子中。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、机器学习研究、技术讨论

patterns.name: 物理学研究主题
patterns.trigger: applied and fundamental physics、fluid mechanics、nonlinear classical and quantum
patterns.context: 介绍物理学领域、研究主题或相关方法；激活不总落在同一物理术语上。

patterns.name: 文献中的研究重要性与关注度表述
patterns.context: 学术或技术说明中陈述研究主题的重要性、受到关注，或某问题日益受到处理。

patterns.name: 原因、来源或依据关系
patterns.trigger: partly originates from、by exploiting、uses ... methods from
patterns.context: 描述某种兴趣、推理能力或技术方法的来源、依据或所利用的手段。

patterns.name: 研究者及领域扩展
patterns.context: 统计学习等学术领域吸引来自多个领域的研究者；from 附近强激活。

patterns.name: 迁移及缺少回应的论坛叙述
patterns.trigger: migrate to a google doc；lack of response ... from fellow hackers
patterns.context: 帖子先提到迁移到文档，随后叙述未收到其他黑客回应；强激活集中在 disheartening 的 heart 子词。

patterns.name: 描述性词汇的零散激活
patterns.context: 这些词出现在不同语境中，无法从片段建立稳定、共同的触发条件。

patterns.name: 明确技术术语及推理表述
patterns.context: 出现在不同主题的技术说明中，除学术／技术文体外没有明确共享触发条件。
patterns.domain: 物理、机器学习、知识推理研究

en.concept: Mixed features of academic contexts and negative expressions
en.description: Activations show several local patterns: methods, academic fields and theoretical terminology, as well as negative expressions of experience in HackerNews/Q&A, especially n't and never. Common connectives such as from and in also activate strongly in papers, but cannot be unified into a stable semantic rule; some snippets have no clear interpretation.

patterns.name: methods
patterns.context: “methods” describes research or technical approaches; examples include “using methods from room acoustics” and “technical methods to discover knowledge.”

patterns.name: Negative expressions of not having experienced or done something
patterns.context: Negating having seen, done, or experienced something, with activations concentrated near the contraction n't and never; contexts involve personal experience or judgment.

patterns.name: Field terminology and theory names
patterns.context: Disciplinary or theoretical statements in scientific and technical passages; triggers are scattered across room electromagnetics, physics, fluid mechanics, and quantum theory contexts.

patterns.name: Descriptions of machine learning and research fields
patterns.context: Academic statements introducing applications, research fields, or researchers' origins; trigger words are often common prepositions or field terms, with no single fixed collocation.

patterns.name: Long-distance relational words and syntactic connectives
patterns.context: Connecting sources, fields, or bases within their respective syntactic structures; no clear unified local semantic condition.

10_2268.concept: 学术语境与否定表达的混合特征
10_2268.description: 激活呈多个局部模式：methods、学术领域与理论用语，以及 HackerNews/问答中否定经历表达（尤其 n't、never）。另有 from、in 等常见连接词在论文中强激活，无法归并为稳定语义规律；部分片段无清晰解释。

patterns.name: methods
patterns.context: “methods”用于描述研究或技术手段；出现于“using methods from room acoustics”和“technical methods to discover knowledge”等表达。
patterns.domain: 专利技术背景、数据挖掘介绍

patterns.name: 未曾经历或未做过的否定表达
patterns.context: 对未见过、未做过或未经历之事的否定表达，激活集中在缩写 n't 及 never 附近；语境为个人经验或判断。

patterns.name: 领域术语及理论名称
patterns.context: 科学技术文段中的学科或理论表述；触发分散在房间电磁学、物理学、流体力学及量子理论语境。

patterns.name: 机器学习与研究领域描述
patterns.context: 介绍应用、研究领域或研究者来源的学术表述；触发词本身多为常见介词或领域词，未呈现单一固定搭配。

patterns.name: 远距离关系词与句法连接
patterns.context: 在各自句法结构中连接来源、领域或依据；没有明显统一的局部语义条件。

en.concept: Statements evaluating importance and problem status
en.description: Activations occur across multiple genres. Prominent cues include academic evaluations of research importance, attention, potential, and technical challenges; other scattered patterns include unmet needs in patents, informal evaluations of efficiency or understanding, commercial projects, and crime narratives. No unified lexical trigger is evident.

patterns.name: Statements of widespread interest and importance
patterns.context: Academic discussion emphasizes that a topic has attracted broad attention or is significant; common collocations include wide, interest/importance, years/progress.

patterns.name: Unmet needs in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: After describing an existing problem, the background section introduces a required solution using unmet need.

patterns.name: Potential and attention around technical methods
patterns.context: Introducing a technical method's capabilities, advantages, or growing attention; here, the application of CNNs to fluid mechanics.

patterns.name: Informal evaluation of efficiency
patterns.context: In a Q&A opening, using the first person to evaluate one's own lack of proficiency or efficiency at doing something.

patterns.name: Introducing foundational research topics
patterns.context: A paper introduction describes its research subject as fundamental, important, or noteworthy.

patterns.name: Criticism of lack of understanding
patterns.context: Commenting that others do not understand the author's work or the subject being discussed, in a tone of dissatisfaction.

patterns.name: Commercial companies and project reporting
patterns.context: News-style account of companies proposing or competing for large infrastructure construction projects.

patterns.name: Criminal experience and personal testimony
patterns.context: After recounting a crime, expressing the first-person witness's attitude or feelings.

patterns.name: Technology maturity and precision challenges
patterns.context: Discussing quantum technology development, equipment requirements, or engineering challenges yet to be overcome.

10_2268.concept: 评价重要性与问题状态的表述
10_2268.description: 激活分布于多种文体，较突出的线索是学术文本对研究重要性、关注度、潜力及技术挑战的评价；另有专利未满足需求、口语效率或理解评价、商业项目与犯罪叙述等零散模式，未见统一词法触发。

patterns.name: 广泛兴趣与重要性表述
patterns.context: 学术论述中强调某主题受到广泛关注或具有重要意义，常见搭配为 wide、interest/importance、years/progress。

patterns.name: 专利背景中的未满足需求
patterns.context: 背景技术描述现有问题后，以 unmet need 引出所需解决方案。

patterns.name: 技术方法的潜力与关注
patterns.context: 介绍某技术方法的能力、优势或日益受到关注；此处指 CNN 在流体力学中的应用。

patterns.name: 口语化效率评价
patterns.context: 问答开场中以第一人称评价自身做某事不够熟练或高效。

patterns.name: 基础研究主题的引介
patterns.trigger: “fundamental and wide-ranging importance”“The study of first-order phase transitions is a fascinating subject”
patterns.context: 论文导言将研究对象描述为基础、重要或引人关注的主题。

patterns.name: 缺乏理解的批评
patterns.context: 评论他人不理解作者或所讨论工作的内容，语气带有不满。

patterns.name: 商业公司与项目报道
patterns.context: 新闻式叙述公司提出或竞争大型基础设施建设项目。

patterns.name: 犯罪经历与个人见证
patterns.trigger: “these horrible crimes”“I have never felt that way”
patterns.context: 叙述犯罪事件后，以第一人称表达亲历者态度或感受。

patterns.name: 技术成熟度与精度挑战
patterns.context: 讨论量子技术的发展、设备要求或尚待克服的工程挑战。

en.description: Activations are scattered across ArXiv paper introductions and HackerNews/narrative texts, commonly appearing in academic writing about research interest, challenges, and quantum terminology, and also in colloquial uses of don’t, lack of knowledge, or unfamiliar information, as well as technical, learning, and narrative content; no single semantic trigger spans all passages.

patterns.name: Broad interest and research-importance statements in academic introductions
patterns.context: In academic paper introductions presenting a research topic, challenge, or state of the field, activations cover common function words and words such as interest, importance, and research; they are not limited to a particular technical term.
patterns.domain: ArXiv academic papers, especially physics/quantum research introductions

patterns.name: Activation on the negative contraction don’t
patterns.context: In colloquial or informal English, don’t is segmented, with activation concentrated on the contraction suffix token 't; segment 2's «haven«'t»10» also shows a similar contraction suffix, though the form is haven’t.

patterns.name: Expressions of not knowing about unfamiliar people or things
patterns.context: Local high activation occurs when informally expressing unfamiliarity, lack of understanding, or unawareness; apart from don’t, the specific words vary across passages.

patterns.name: Discussion of emerging technologies and technical applications
patterns.context: When discussing technological maturity, the relationship between technology and business, system uses, or technical capabilities, related words and surrounding function words activate; these occur in different contexts, with no single fixed collocation.
patterns.domain: ArXiv technical papers, HackerNews technology discussions

patterns.name: Advice on learning and knowledge accumulation
patterns.context: Informal advice or a summary directed at readers, discussing knowledge accumulation, learning, and their effects.

patterns.name: Open quantum systems and environmental coupling terminology
patterns.context: Quantum physics papers discuss open quantum systems, environments, and their dynamics; this pattern co-occurs with academic introductory statements about interest, but the terminology itself is not present in every academic passage.

patterns.name: Judgments about the credibility of online information sources
patterns.context: Discussing how to regard unfamiliar online authors or their opinions, emphasizing that the source is unfamiliar.

patterns.name: Complaints that managers do not understand the work
patterns.context: First-person plural narration complains that managers do not understand employees' work, while describing requirements for features and products.

patterns.name: Survival and violent events in a narrative
patterns.context: Recounting someone's survival after a terrorist attack or shooting and seeking help; high activation mainly falls on I and don’t in the narrative.

patterns.name: Standalone technology-business classification and company examples
patterns.context: Distinguishing companies primarily in technology from companies that use technology, and listing companies; in addition to the tech/business word group, proper nouns also activate.

patterns.name: Quantum device precision and fault-tolerance theory
patterns.context: Discussing precision requirements for quantum devices and quantum fault-tolerance theory.

patterns.name: Open quantum dynamics in paper metadata and titles
patterns.context: Localization, spacetime, and open quantum dynamics terminology appears in paper titles, abstracts, introductions, and other structures.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper metadata and physics abstracts

patterns.name: Descriptions of blog-system feature requirements
patterns.context: Describing requirements for a website to display recent user content and allow comments, and judging whether a blogging system meets these properties.

patterns.name: Cautious statements about trusting strangers' opinions
patterns.context: Discussing whether to believe the opinion of someone one does not know well, with a parenthetical clarification.

10_2268.concept: 英语语境中的强调性表述
10_2268.description: 激活分散在ArXiv论文引言与HackerNews/叙事文本中，常见于学术写作的研究兴趣、挑战及量子术语，也见于口语里的don’t、不了解或陌生信息，以及技术、学习和叙事内容；未见覆盖全部段落的单一语义触发。

patterns.name: 学术引言中的宽泛兴趣与研究重要性表述
patterns.context: 学术论文引言介绍研究主题、挑战或研究现状时，激活覆盖常见功能词及兴趣、重要性、研究等词；不局限于某个专业术语。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文，尤其物理/量子研究引言

patterns.name: 对否定缩写 don’t 的激活
patterns.context: 口语或非正式英文语境中，don’t 被拆分标注，激活集中在缩写后缀 token 't；段2的 «haven«'t»10» 也出现类似缩写后缀，但词形为 haven’t。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 论坛对话、Pile-CC 叙事

patterns.name: 描述陌生人或事物“不知道”的表达
patterns.context: 非正式表达不熟悉、不了解或不知情时有局部高激活；除 don’t 外，各段具体词语并不一致。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 论坛对话、Pile-CC 叙事

patterns.name: 新技术发展与技术应用的讨论
patterns.context: 谈及技术成熟、技术与商业的关系、系统用途或技术能力时，相关词和周边功能词出现激活；分属不同语境，未见单一固定搭配。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 技术论文、HackerNews 科技讨论

patterns.name: 学习与知识积累的劝诫
patterns.context: 面向读者的非正式劝诫或总结，谈知识积累、学习及其影响。

patterns.name: 量子开放系统与环境耦合术语
patterns.context: 量子物理论文中讨论开放量子系统、环境及其动力学；此模式与学术引言兴趣表述同时出现，但术语本身并非所有学术段共有。

patterns.name: 关于网络信息来源可信度的判断
patterns.context: 讨论对网上陌生作者或其意见应如何看待，强调来源不熟悉。

patterns.name: 对管理者不理解工作内容的抱怨
patterns.context: 第一人称复数叙述，抱怨管理者不了解员工工作，同时描述对功能和产品的要求。

patterns.name: 叙事中的生存与暴力事件
patterns.trigger: «How» she «survived» the «urban terrorism», the «gunshots»；“I don’t know”
patterns.context: 叙述某人经历恐怖袭击、枪击并求助后的生存情况；高激活主要落在叙述中的 I 和 don’t。

patterns.name: 单独的科技商业分类与公司举例
patterns.context: 区分主营科技的企业与使用科技的企业，并列举公司；除 tech/business 词群外，专名也有激活。

patterns.name: 量子器件精度与容错理论
patterns.context: 论述量子器件的精确度要求以及量子容错理论。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 量子计算/技术论文

patterns.name: 论文元数据与题目中的开放量子动力学
patterns.context: 论文标题、摘要引言等结构中出现局域化、时空及开放量子动力学术语。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文元数据与物理摘要

patterns.name: 对博客系统功能需求的描述
patterns.trigger: «recent» user-generated entries；«users» to comment on them；«blogging» «system»
patterns.context: 描述网站展示近期用户内容并允许评论的需求，并判断博客系统是否满足这些属性。

patterns.name: 关于信任陌生人意见的谨慎表述
patterns.context: 讨论是否应相信一位并不熟悉的人所表达的观点，带有括号式补充说明。

en.concept: English function words and discourse flow
en.description: Activations span multiple contexts: common in n't negative contractions; also found in ArXiv introductions' statements of research importance, news quotations, patent communication-technology backgrounds, and forum discussions of design evaluations and social class.

patterns.name: n't in negative contractions
patterns.context: The suffix n't in contracted negatives, especially haven’t, can’t, and don’t; these forms occur in multiple passages, but the marker falls at different positions within the word.
patterns.domain: News narratives, forum conversations, and general English text

patterns.name: Statements of research significance in academic introductions
patterns.context: ArXiv paper introductions present a research topic, long-standing interest, current challenges, or fundamental importance; activation covers a continuous span of academic discourse rather than a single technical term.

patterns.name: Quotations and changes of direction in news reports
patterns.context: News narratives include a person's statement or introduce expert judgment and reported information; the context shifts to new information after a quotation or paraphrase.

patterns.name: Communication technology descriptions in patent technical backgrounds
patterns.context: Describing applications, evolution, and technical requirements of wireless communication technologies, including line-of-sight fixed wireless and millimeter waves.

patterns.name: Personal evaluation of system-design experience
patterns.context: Using the first person to discuss designing a system collaboratively, compare approaches, and evaluate their effectiveness; this passage also contains the negative-contraction pattern.

patterns.name: Discussion of social class and background
patterns.context: Comparing upbringing with current social status and discussing whether the label “blue collar” is appropriate.

10_2268.concept: 英文功能词与论述语流
10_2268.description: 激活横跨多种语境：常见于 n't 否定缩略词；也见于ArXiv引言的研究重要性论述、新闻引述、专利通信技术背景及论坛中的设计评价和社会阶层讨论。

patterns.name: 否定式缩略词中的 n't
patterns.context: 缩略否定词中的词尾 n't，尤其 haven’t、can’t、don’t；这些形式在多个段落出现，但标记具体落在词内不同位置。
patterns.domain: 新闻叙事、论坛对话及一般英文文本

patterns.name: 学术引言的研究意义陈述
patterns.context: ArXiv论文引言中，介绍研究主题、长期关注、当前挑战或基础重要性；激活覆盖一串连续的学术论述词，并非只落在某个专门术语上。
patterns.domain: 物理学论文摘要或引言

patterns.name: 新闻报道中的引述与消息转折
patterns.context: 新闻叙述包含人物表态或引入专家判断、报道信息；上下文在引述或转述后转向新消息。

patterns.name: 专利技术背景中的通信技术描述
patterns.context: 描述无线通信技术的应用、演进和技术需求，涉及视距固定无线及毫米波。

patterns.name: 对系统设计经验的个人评价
patterns.context: 以第一人称谈多人协作设计系统，比较做法并评价其有效性；本段也出现否定缩略词模式。

patterns.name: 社会阶层与背景讨论
patterns.context: 比较成长背景与当前社会地位，并讨论“blue collar”这一称谓是否恰当。

en.description: The most prominent recurring cue is the syllable or letter sequence kin in strings such as Hodgkin, Burkinensis, Lumpkin, and Akinpelu. There are also several unrelated activations containing OT, MALT, hormonal, and other terms, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: kin in bacterial taxonomic names
patterns.context: A syllable fragment in bacterial genus and species names; the strongest point falls on kin.

patterns.name: kin in fungal toxin compound terms
patterns.context: A long compound name in a biotransformation study title; a specific word form or tokenization position may be the trigger.

patterns.name: kin in names
patterns.context: A contiguous letter fragment within a personal name, not a standalone word; the name differs from the surrounding words.
patterns.domain: Legal documents; lyrics or online text

patterns.name: kin in lymphoma terms
patterns.context: The final syllable of Hodgkin; appears in medical text related to non-Hodgkin lymphoma.
patterns.domain: Medical papers and clinical trial abstracts

patterns.name: kin in film actor names
patterns.context: An intra-word fragment in the actor surname Culkin; the activation marker actually falls on ay, which may be related to the adjacent name Culkin, but the correspondence is uncertain.

patterns.name: Oxytocin abbreviation OT
patterns.context: Activation falls on the abbreviation OT, adjacent to the full name Oxytocin; no clear connection to the kin strings in other segments.

patterns.name: Unclassified fragments
patterns.context: These activations are scattered across medical proper nouns, common words, and title fragments, and are difficult to explain through the kin word form or shared semantics.

10_2362.concept: 含 kin 字符串片段
10_2362.description: 最突出的重复线索是 Hodgkin、Burkinensis、Lumpkin、Akinpelu 等字符串中的 kin 音节或字母序列；另有多处无关激活，含 OT、MALT、hormonal 等，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: 细菌分类学名称中的 kin
patterns.context: 细菌属种名中的音节片段；最强点落在 kin。

patterns.name: 真菌毒素化合物词中的 kin
patterns.context: 生物转化研究标题中的长化合物名；可能是特定词形或分词位置触发。

patterns.name: 姓名中的 kin
patterns.context: 人名内部的连续字母片段，并非独立词；姓名与周围词语不同。
patterns.domain: 法律文书；歌词或网络文本

patterns.name: 淋巴瘤词中的 kin
patterns.context: Hodgkin 一词的末尾音节；出现在非霍奇金淋巴瘤相关医学文本中。
patterns.domain: 医学论文及临床试验摘要

patterns.name: 影片演员姓名中的 kin
patterns.context: 演员姓氏 Culkin 的词内片段；激活标记实际落在 ay，可能与紧邻姓名中的 Culkin 有关，但对应关系不确定。

patterns.name: 催产素缩写 OT
patterns.context: 激活落在缩写 OT，紧邻 Oxytocin 全称；与其他段中的 kin 字符串无明显联系。

patterns.name: 不可明确归类的片段
patterns.context: 这些激活分散在医学专名、普通词、标题片段中，难以由 kin 词形或共同语义解释。

en.concept: Subwords in academic titles and proper nouns
en.description: Activations often occur in paper titles, especially “Association between” and biomedical topics; they also appear in glutamate-related terms. Other isolated triggers include titles about new bacterial species or biotransformation, legal numbers and name fragments, and personal names and email salutations.

patterns.name: “Association between” in academic titles
patterns.context: At the start of a research title, followed by two associated variables, characteristics, or outcomes; the following content may concern disease, genes, or clinical outcomes.

patterns.name: Bacterial species identification titles
patterns.context: The phrase “Isolation and characterization” in microbiology paper titles, followed by a bacterial scientific name and a new-species marker.

patterns.name: Biotransformation titles
patterns.context: Title-style phrasing using “Bioconversion of” to introduce a compound and its transformation product.

patterns.name: Glutamate, receptors, and excitotoxicity
patterns.context: Mentions of glutamate in neuroscience text, particularly when it activates ionotropic receptors or appears in the context of excitotoxicity mechanisms.

patterns.name: Case number fragments in legal citations
patterns.context: Near court case citations or case numbers, where numbers, abbreviations, and names are tokenized; high activation falls on “666” and the name fragment “kin”.

patterns.name: Romanian names and line breaks
patterns.context: After the name “Vlad Muțiu” comes a line break and another name fragment; activation is concentrated on subwords within names.

patterns.name: Titles linking cognitive status and surgical outcomes
patterns.context: A title linking preoperative cognitive status to surgical outcomes in older patients, a clinical instance of the “Association between” title pattern.

patterns.name: Name fragments in email salutations
patterns.context: An email opens by addressing the recipient as “Luiz”, followed by a request; activation is concentrated on subwords in the name.

10_2362.description: 激活常见于论文标题，尤其“Association between”及生物医学主题；也见于谷氨酸相关术语。另有孤立触发：细菌新种/生物转化标题、法律数字与姓名片段，以及人名和邮件称呼。

patterns.name: 学术标题中的“Association between”
patterns.context: 作为研究标题开头，后接两个被关联的变量、特征或结果；后续内容可涉及疾病、基因或临床结局。

patterns.name: 细菌新种鉴定标题
patterns.context: 微生物论文标题中的分词 “Isolation and characterization”，后接细菌学名及新种标记。

patterns.name: 生物转化标题
patterns.context: 标题式表述，以 “Bioconversion of” 引出一种化合物及其转化产物。
patterns.domain: 生物化学/生物技术摘要

patterns.name: 谷氨酸与受体/兴奋毒性
patterns.context: 神经科学文字中提及谷氨酸，特别是其激活离子型受体或作为兴奋毒性机制的语境。
patterns.domain: 神经科学/NIH 项目摘要

patterns.name: 法律引文中的案号数字片段
patterns.context: 法院判例引文或案号附近，数字、缩写和姓名被切分成 token；高激活落在“666”及姓名片段“kin”。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚人名及换行
patterns.context: 人名 “Vlad Muțiu” 后换行并出现另一姓名片段；激活集中在人名内部的子词。

patterns.name: 认知状态与手术结局标题
patterns.trigger: «Association»8« between»8« Cognitive»3« Status»5« before»2« Surgery»2« and»6« Outcomes»2
patterns.context: 标题中关联术前认知状态与老年患者的手术结局，是“Association between”标题模式的临床特例。

patterns.name: 邮件称呼中的姓名片段
patterns.context: 邮件开头以姓名 “Luiz” 称呼收件人，后接请求语句；激活集中在姓名子词。

en.concept: Start string and local subword patterns
en.description: The most prominent activation pattern is the string “Start”: it often appears in the “Start Date:” field of email headers, and also in code identifiers or test code. Other activations include fragments of biomedical family names and symbols in mathematical expressions.

patterns.name: “Start Date” field
patterns.context: The beginning of a date field in a record or email header, followed by a numeric date and semicolon; date formats are usually M/D/YY or MM/DD/YY.
patterns.domain: Enron email headers or similar structured text

patterns.name: Start markers in code
patterns.context: Appears at the start of a code identifier or test code, not in a date field: followed by FontMetrics, or Test(function ...).

patterns.name: “Association” in biomedical terms
patterns.context: Part of a protein family name in a paper abstract, followed by a member number.

patterns.name: Variables and operators in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Appears in an algebraic expression with repeated multiplication terms; no “Start” or date field is present.

10_2362.concept: Start 字符串及局部子词模式
10_2362.description: 激活模式以字符串“Start”最突出：多见于邮件头的“Start Date:”字段，也见于代码标识符或测试代码。另有生物医学家族名称片段和数学表达式中的符号激活。

patterns.name: “Start Date”字段
patterns.context: 作为记录或邮件头中的日期字段开头，后接数字日期及分号；日期格式多为 M/D/YY 或 MM/DD/YY。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件头或类似结构化文本

patterns.name: 代码中的 Start 标记
patterns.context: 出现在代码标识符或测试代码开头，而非日期字段：后接 FontMetrics，或 Test(function ...)。

patterns.name: 生物医学术语中的 “Association”
patterns.context: 论文摘要中，作为蛋白质家族名称的一部分，后接成员编号。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的变量与运算符
patterns.trigger: «*»«s»，以及相邻的数字、减号和括号
patterns.context: 出现在含重复乘法项的代数表达式中；未见“Start”或日期字段。

en.description: Activations occur in vulgar colloquial language, medical papers and tables, protein terminology, email spelling, and mathematical formulas. In medical text they often fall on function words; in mathematical segments they cluster on product terms beginning with 4. No unified trigger word is apparent.

patterns.name: Emphatic word in a vulgar phrase
patterns.context: Appears in the imperative phrase “Get Off Your Ass”

patterns.name: Function words and data terms in medical papers
patterns.context: Between descriptions of methods, data, and results in biomedical abstracts or research descriptions; activations are scattered across multiple words

patterns.name: Protein terminology and amino acid descriptions
patterns.context: Describes the processing and secretion of Beta-APP and its amino-terminal peptide

patterns.name: Quoted spelling and personal names
patterns.context: In an email sentence, the quoted word allegedly is split into fragments, with the possessive name Shemin’s nearby

patterns.name: Algebraic expressions beginning with 4
patterns.context: A mathematical expression contains terms with 4 multiplied by a variable, adjacent to subtraction and other product terms

patterns.name: Head circumference and gestational age in a table
patterns.context: A table juxtaposes fetal measurements, followed by a Markdown heading separator

10_2362.description: 激活分布于粗俗口语、医学论文与表格、蛋白质术语、邮件拼写及数学式；医学文本中常落在功能词，数学段集中于以 4 开头的乘积项，未见统一触发词。

patterns.name: 粗俗短语中的强调词
patterns.context: 出现在命令式短语“Get Off Your Ass”中
patterns.domain: 网页预览/口语化或粗俗表达

patterns.name: 医学论文中的功能词与数据词
patterns.context: 生物医学摘要或研究描述中，夹在方法、数据和结果叙述之间；激活分散在多个词上

patterns.name: 蛋白质术语及氨基酸表述
patterns.context: 描述 Beta-APP 的加工、分泌及其氨基端肽

patterns.name: 带引号的拼写词与人名
patterns.context: 邮件句子中，带引号的 allegedly 被拆分，附近出现带所有格的人名 Shemin’s

patterns.name: 以 4 开头的代数式
patterns.context: 数学表达式中出现 4 乘变量的项，并与减法及其他乘积项相邻

patterns.name: 表格中的头围与孕周
patterns.context: 胎儿测量值并列呈现的表格，随后有 Markdown 标题分隔符

en.description: Activations are scattered across proper nouns and content words such as Your, film, Police, File, last, and old, spanning titles, film, news, narrative, and programming text; they cannot be grouped into a single semantic or stylistic pattern.

patterns.name: Spelling boundary in Your
patterns.context: Your appears as a complete word; before [1] it follows “Off”, before [2] it follows “Stupid”, and in [7] it appears in the title “Freeze Your Account”.
patterns.domain: Web titles, forum posts, and prose

patterns.name: Film-related words
patterns.context: film appears in film-related narration; nearby text concerns film content or works.

patterns.name: Word-initial Police
patterns.context: Police appears at the beginning of a sentence or as part of a proper noun, referring to police or a police department.

patterns.name: Word-initial File
patterns.context: Appears in the program error name “FileNotFoundError”.

patterns.name: Word-initial last
patterns.context: In the phrase “The last thing”, referring to the final thing that previously happened or was said.

patterns.name: Age suffix old
patterns.context: Appears at the end of the age expression “27-year-old”.

patterns.name: Contextual use of race
patterns.context: Adjacent to “cool” and a riding action; the context refers to horse racing or a race, not ethnicity.

patterns.name: Kumar film titles
patterns.context: The name Kumar is followed by a list of films and titles.

patterns.name: Bloodshed and rescue narrative
patterns.context: Describes a daughter being injured, police arriving, and a rescue team saving someone.

patterns.name: PayPal account freeze title
patterns.context: In the title “How to Get PayPal To Freeze Your Account”, freeze is split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Other sporadic fragments
patterns.context: Appear respectively in an adult video title, a discussion of theme park fast passes, a baseball report, and an app title; there is no evidence that these words share stable semantics.

10_2362.description: 激活分散在专名及内容词上：Your、film、Police、File、last、old 等，覆盖标题、影视、新闻、叙事与编程文本；无法归为单一语义或文体模式。

patterns.name: Your 的拼写边界
patterns.context: Your 单独作为完整词出现；在 [1] 前接 “Off”，在 [2] 前接 “Stupid”，在 [7] 前接标题中的 “Freeze Your Account”。
patterns.domain: 网页标题、论坛帖子与散文

patterns.name: 电影相关词语
patterns.context: film 出现在电影叙述中；邻近处有电影内容或电影作品讨论。

patterns.name: Police 的词首
patterns.context: Police 作为句首或专名组成部分，指警察/警察部门。

patterns.name: File 的词首
patterns.context: 出现在程序报错名称 “FileNotFoundError” 中。

patterns.name: last 的词首
patterns.context: 短语 “The last thing” 中，表示此前最后发生或说过的事。

patterns.name: old 的年龄后缀
patterns.context: 出现在年龄表达 “27-year-old” 的末尾。

patterns.name: race 的语境用法
patterns.context: 与 “cool” 和骑乘动作相邻，语境指赛马/比赛，而非种族。

patterns.name: Kumar 电影作品名
patterns.context: 人名 Kumar 后接电影列表及作品名。

patterns.name: 血腥与救援叙事
patterns.context: 描述女儿受伤、警察到场及救援队救人。

patterns.name: PayPal 账户冻结标题
patterns.context: “How to Get PayPal To Freeze Your Account” 标题中，freeze 被拆成多个 token。

patterns.name: 其余零散片段
patterns.context: 分别处于成人视频标题、主题公园快速通行讨论、棒球报道和应用程序标题中；没有证据表明这些词共享稳定语义。
patterns.domain: 网页标题、论坛、体育报道

en.description: Activations are scattered across several text types: “This” in quotations, Thanksgiving, baseball terms, and isolated instances such as day-to-day, another, squib-blasting, and coaching; there is no single stable trigger condition.

patterns.name: This at the start of a quotation
patterns.context: Direct quotations appear in paragraphs, with “This” at the start of the quotation nearby; [7] also activates on “This wasn’t...” after a quotation.
patterns.domain: Direct quotations in news and encyclopedia narratives

patterns.name: Thanksgiving
patterns.context: Appears in narratives about holiday shopping, celebrations, or holiday sports; strongly activated in [2] and [5].

patterns.name: Baseball-related terms
patterns.context: In the context of baseball games, players, or seasons; the strongest related words include “last” ([9]) and “This” ([7]).

patterns.name: Emphatic this / particular
patterns.context: Expresses the importance of a particular present moment; “this” activates more strongly than surrounding ordinary words.

patterns.name: day-to-day
patterns.context: In a hyphenated compound, activation falls on “day”, describing daily life.

patterns.name: another
patterns.context: In ordinary narration, means an additional or further thing; no stable domain-specific condition is apparent.

patterns.name: squib-blasting
patterns.context: Appears in a description of a TV comedian’s death scene; activation is concentrated in the latter part of the compound.

patterns.name: elite coaching
patterns.context: Appears in quotations about feelings toward a new home and about coaches and players.

10_2362.description: 激活分散于多类文本：引语中的“This”、Thanksgiving、棒球词语，以及day-to-day、another、squib-blasting、coaching等孤例；没有单一稳定触发条件。

patterns.name: 引语开头的 This
patterns.context: 段落中出现直接引语，激活紧邻引语开头的“This”；[7]还在引语后的“This wasn’t...”处激活。
patterns.domain: 新闻、百科叙述中的直接引语

patterns.name: Thanksgiving
patterns.context: 出现在节日购物、节庆或体育节日的叙述中；在[2]、[5]均强激活。

patterns.name: 棒球相关词语
patterns.context: 棒球比赛、球员或赛季的语境；强度最高的相关词包括“last”（[9]）及“This”（[7]）。

patterns.name: 强调性的 this / particular
patterns.context: 表达某个当下时刻的重要性；“this”激活强于前后普通词。
patterns.domain: 棒球评论中的口语引语

patterns.name: day-to-day
patterns.context: 连字符复合表达中，激活落在“day”上，描述日常生活。
patterns.domain: 电视节目介绍、娱乐新闻

patterns.name: another
patterns.context: 普通叙述中表示又一个或额外的事物，未见稳定的领域条件。

patterns.name: squib-blasting
patterns.context: 出现在对电视喜剧演员死亡场景的描写中，激活集中在复合词后半部分。
patterns.domain: 娱乐评论、影视场景描述

patterns.name: elite coaching
patterns.context: 在谈新家的感受及教练、球员的引语中出现。

en.description: Activation fragments often occur in sports and athletic descriptions, but also in evaluative quotations, time periods, condolence statements, game retrospectives, and instructions; name fragments and several incomplete contexts have no stable common cue.

patterns.name: Teams, events, and match reports
patterns.context: Mentions teams or competitors, match progress, scores, rounds, or other game details; includes both sports events and video game play
patterns.domain: Sports news, encyclopedia event entries, game reviews

patterns.name: Ball-game terms for players or matches
patterns.context: Ball-sport contexts involving hitting, equipment, field performance, or baseball baserunning and hits
patterns.domain: Baseball, snooker, golf, and other sports content

patterns.name: Evaluative intensifiers in quotations
patterns.context: Adjectives indicating degree, positive evaluation, or strong impact appear in quotations or evaluations; collocations are not fixed

patterns.name: Time or stage markers
patterns.context: Describes years, innings, match stages, opening phases, or event timing; parts of speech and contexts vary

patterns.name: Expressions of loss, comfort, and significance
patterns.context: Offers comfort after a death or major event, and includes expressions of the significance of someone’s participation
patterns.domain: Company statements, personal profiles, or emotional quotations

patterns.name: Encounter retrospectives in game narratives
patterns.context: Uses “when we last saw” to recall a hero’s previous battle, clearly in a role-playing game narrative

patterns.name: Subword fragments in player names
patterns.context: Names are split into multiple tokens; fragments appear within the names of players, coaches, or other people. There is no evidence that name subwords are a stable trigger condition

patterns.name: Disaster-related wording in company statements
patterns.context: Company executives issue statements about events causing casualties or losses and offer comfort to those affected

patterns.name: Technical operating instructions
patterns.context: Advises lowering something first, then restoring it when restarting; the device or object is unclear

patterns.name: Adjacent fragments with no clear pattern
patterns.context: Incomplete contexts or continuations from preceding text; nearby activation fragments show no stable common semantic cue
patterns.domain: Sports text, game reviews, or general commentary

10_2362.description: 激活片段多见于赛事与运动描述，也见于评价性引语、时间阶段、慰问声明、游戏回顾和操作建议；姓名碎片及若干残缺上下文缺少稳定共同线索。

patterns.name: 球队、赛事与比赛报道
patterns.trigger: “against an Ireland B team”“scored a run”“runners on first and second”“won the inaugural event”“attack shooter”
patterns.context: 出现球队或参赛者、比赛过程、比分/回合/赛况等叙述；既包括体育赛事，也包括电子游戏玩法
patterns.domain: 体育新闻、百科赛事条目、游戏评论

patterns.name: 球员或比赛中的球类术语
patterns.trigger: “the ball and hit it”“best ball”“long game”“club face”“driver”“fair”“leadoff double”
patterns.context: 球类运动语境；涉及击球、球具、球场表现，或棒球跑垒与安打
patterns.domain: 棒球、斯诺克、高尔夫等体育内容

patterns.name: 引述中的评价性强化词
patterns.trigger: “an awesome coach”“very best of this level”“great this ball”“devastating event”“grueling fight”
patterns.context: 引述或评价中出现表程度、正面评价或强烈影响的形容词；搭配并不固定
patterns.domain: 新闻引语、百科评价、论坛/评论

patterns.name: 时间或阶段的标示
patterns.context: 叙述年份、比赛局次、开始阶段或事件发生时间；词类和场景各异
patterns.domain: 新闻、百科、比赛叙述、评论

patterns.name: 失落、安慰及珍贵性表达
patterns.trigger: “loss of our colleagues, family and friends”“Life is precious”“comforting the loved ones”“his presence means a lot”“it’s priceless”
patterns.context: 谈及死亡或重大事件后的安慰，也包括表达某人参与带来的珍贵意义
patterns.domain: 公司声明、人物报道或情感性引语

patterns.name: 游戏叙事中的遭遇回顾
patterns.trigger: “when we last saw our heroes”“finished a grueling fight with Tucker’s Kobolds”
patterns.context: 以“when we last saw”回顾英雄此前经历的战斗，语境明确为角色扮演游戏式叙事

patterns.name: 球员姓名中的子词片段
patterns.context: 名字被切分为多个 token，片段本身出现在球员、教练或其他人物姓名中；没有证据表明姓名子词是稳定触发条件
patterns.domain: 体育报道、百科人物条目

patterns.name: 公司声明中的灾难事件措辞
patterns.context: 公司高管就造成伤亡或损失的事件发表声明，并安慰受影响者
patterns.domain: 新闻报道中的企业声明

patterns.name: 技术操作指令
patterns.trigger: “turn them down”“time to start up again”
patterns.context: 提醒先调低某物，再在重新启动时恢复；所指设备或对象不明

patterns.name: 无法归入明确模式的邻接片段
patterns.trigger: “retire Abrahams”“essentially an on-rails”“bit more difficult than I would like it to be”
patterns.context: 残缺或承接前文的上下文，激活片段附近未显示稳定的共同语义线索
patterns.domain: 体育文本、游戏评论或一般评论

en.description: Activations often occur in sports contexts, especially match actions, scoring leads, athletic skills, and tactical terms. There are also a few instances of main modifying stage, stay, or series, as well as sporadic activations within proper nouns or words.

patterns.name: main and the competitive stage
patterns.context: Describes someone taking part in a competitive activity while performing on a particular main stage; activation is concentrated on main

patterns.name: main and a key hockey defenseman
patterns.context: main is adjacent to stay and refers to a core defensive player on the team; activation falls on main

patterns.name: main and a game’s core series
patterns.context: main modifies series, in contrast to a spin-off
