patterns.name: Expressions related to competitive actions or performance
patterns.context: Descriptions of actions, scoring, or leads in hockey, horse racing, soccer, and other matches

patterns.name: Descriptions of athletic ability and technique
patterns.context: Describes athletes’ movements, skills, kinesiology, or tactical participation
patterns.domain: Sports encyclopedias, scouting analysis, interviews, sports medicine papers

patterns.name: Competition organization or stage terminology
patterns.context: Specialized expressions in team lineups, match stages, or tactical situations

patterns.name: Sporadic activations within names or compounds
patterns.context: Activations occur within tokenized proper nouns or words, with no shared semantic condition apparent

10_2362.concept: 体育竞技与主力/主系列表达
10_2362.description: 激活多见于体育语境，尤其比赛动作、得分领先、运动技能和战术术语；另有 main 修饰 stage、stay、series 的几例，以及若干专名或词内零散激活。

patterns.name: main 与竞技场舞台
patterns.context: 叙述某人同时参加竞技活动并在特定主舞台演出；激活集中在 main

patterns.name: main 与冰球防守主力
patterns.context: main 与 stay 连写，指球队防守核心；激活落在 main

patterns.name: main 与游戏主系列
patterns.context: main 修饰 series，与 spin-off 对照

patterns.name: 竞技动作或表现相关表达
patterns.context: 冰球、赛马、足球等比赛叙述中的动作、得分或领先描述

patterns.name: 体育能力与技术描述
patterns.context: 描述运动员动作、技能、身体运动学或战术参与
patterns.domain: 体育百科、球探分析、访谈、运动医学论文

patterns.name: 比赛组织或阶段术语
patterns.context: 球队阵容、比赛阶段或战术情境中的专门表达

patterns.name: 名称或复合词内部的零散激活
patterns.context: 激活出现在被分词切开的专名或词内部，未见共同语义条件

en.description: Activations mainly occur in sports-related text: sports, athletes, event results, and action descriptions. Strong examples include free dance in ice dancing; sports physiology, athletic equipment, injuries, and horse-racing narratives also occur.

patterns.name: Dance competition results
patterns.context: Descriptions of events, placements, or mistakes in ice dance competitions; especially prominent in segments 1 and 2.

patterns.name: Sports and athlete/event information
patterns.context: Mentions athletes, sports, eligibility, training, or exercise physiology in sports encyclopedias or research papers. Terms are scattered and may not point to the same sport.

patterns.name: Sports action and equipment control
patterns.context: A patent describes how a handheld controller simulates or controls sports actions.

patterns.name: Sports injuries and action descriptions
patterns.context: Introduces a BMX-related injury and describes a jump; this segment also contains incoherent anecdotal text.

patterns.name: Horse-racing progress
patterns.context: Describes horse positions, vying for the lead, and overtaking by race segment.

10_2362.description: 激活主要出现在体育相关文本：运动项目、运动员、赛事成绩与动作描述；强项包括冰舞的 free dance，也见体育生理、运动器材、伤病及赛马叙述。

patterns.name: 舞蹈赛事成绩
patterns.trigger: “fall in the free dance”“free dance”“short dance”“rhythm dance”
patterns.context: 花样滑冰冰舞比赛的项目、名次或失误叙述；段1、2中尤为明显。

patterns.name: 运动项目与运动员/赛事信息
patterns.context: 体育百科或研究论文中提及运动员、运动项目、参赛资格、训练或运动生理。词项分散，未必指向同一种运动。

patterns.name: 体育动作及器材控制
patterns.context: 专利描述手持控制器如何模拟或控制体育动作。

patterns.name: 体育伤病与动作叙述
patterns.context: 介绍 BMX 相关伤情，并具体描述跳跃动作；该片段还含不连贯的轶事文本。

patterns.name: 赛马比赛进程
patterns.context: 按赛段叙述赛马位置、竞逐领先及超越过程。

en.description: Activations are mainly associated with sports and athletic contexts: athletes, track and field, swimming, training tests, events, eligibility, and results. They also cover ice dance reporting, school sports lists, and a few specific sports terms.

patterns.name: Athletes in general
patterns.context: When describing athlete identity, eligibility, or performance; also includes athlete health or training contexts. Covers multiple sports in [1]–[10].
patterns.domain: Sports news, exercise science abstracts, athlete biographies

patterns.name: Track and field and running events
patterns.context: Mentions track and field, race walking, sprinting, or walking and jogging as examples of aerobic exercise; running terms and adjacent words are segmented separately.
patterns.domain: Track and field biographies, sports event reporting, sports medicine

patterns.name: Swimming and lists of sports
patterns.context: Explicitly lists event disciplines, school sports activities, or aerobic activities in exercise advice. Swimming appears in several enumeration contexts.
patterns.domain: Sports encyclopedias, school activity descriptions, sports medicine

patterns.name: Training and exercise physiology
patterns.context: Discusses endurance, exercise, strength tests, and repetitive movement in athletic training or research; activations in [3] also include dynamometry terminology, which may not share the same trigger as the others.
patterns.domain: PubMed / PubMed Central sports medicine research

patterns.name: Ice dance events and placements
patterns.context: Describes dance styles, placements, medals, or advancement in ice dance reports; “free dance” recurs in the same paragraph context.

patterns.name: Sports statistics and eligibility
patterns.context: Reports participants, events, divisions, eligibility, and results at the Olympics or other competitions, without requiring a particular sport.

patterns.name: Isolated strength-testing terminology
patterns.context: Isokinetic strength testing that measures peak muscle torque; shares a sports science background with other segments, but the terminology itself is distinctive.

patterns.name: Isolated specialized sports
patterns.context: A national team qualifies for badminton or beach volleyball; unlike most segments, which concern track and field, swimming, or ice dance.
patterns.domain: National team Olympic qualification encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Isolated sports sections and activities
patterns.context: An extracurricular activities section on a school or institutional page, where sports are one of many activities.

10_2362.description: 激活主要关联体育与运动语境：运动员、田径、游泳、训练测试、赛事项目、资格和成绩；另覆盖冰舞报道、学校体育清单及少数具体项目术语。

patterns.name: 泛指运动员
patterns.trigger: athlete / athletes / athlete 的词内片段 «lete»、«ath»
patterns.context: 描述运动员身份、参赛资格或运动表现时；也包括运动员身体状况或训练语境。覆盖 [1]–[10] 中的多种运动领域。
patterns.domain: 体育新闻、运动科学摘要、运动员传记

patterns.name: 田径及跑步项目
patterns.context: 出现田径、竞走、短跑或作为有氧锻炼举例的步行与慢跑时；跑步词与相邻词分段标注。
patterns.domain: 田径传记、体育赛事报道、运动医学

patterns.name: 游泳及运动项目清单
patterns.context: 明确列出赛事项目、学校提供的体育活动，或运动建议中的有氧项目。游泳在多种枚举语境中出现。
patterns.domain: 体育百科、学校活动介绍、运动医学

patterns.name: 训练与运动生理
patterns.context: 运动训练或研究中讨论耐力、锻炼、力量测试及重复动作；其中 [3] 的激活也包括测力测试术语，未必与其他触发完全相同。
patterns.domain: PubMed / PubMed Central 运动医学研究

patterns.name: 冰舞赛事与名次
patterns.context: 冰舞赛事报道中描述舞种、名次、奖牌或晋级；“free dance”在同一段落语境中反复出现。
patterns.domain: 花样滑冰百科赛事条目

patterns.name: 体育赛事统计与资格
patterns.trigger: «Olympic» Games、«champions»、«qualified»，及参赛人数、男女组别和队伍资格
patterns.context: 报道奥运或其他比赛的参赛者、项目、组别、资格与结果，不要求具体运动项目相同。

patterns.name: 孤立的力量测试术语
patterns.context: 测量肌肉峰值力矩的等速力量测试；与其他段落共享运动科学背景，但术语本身较独特。

patterns.name: 孤立的特殊运动项目
patterns.context: 国家代表队获得羽毛球或沙滩排球参赛资格；不同于大多数段落的田径、游泳或冰舞。
patterns.domain: 国家队奥运资格百科条目

patterns.name: 孤立的体育栏目与活动
patterns.trigger: «Sport»，随后列出学校提供的 «athlet»«ics» 等课外活动
patterns.context: 学校或机构页面的课外活动栏目，体育只是众多活动之一。

en.description: Activates mainly in sports contexts: athletes, track and endurance sports, lists of sports, exercise, specific athletic activities, and competitive events. Appears across encyclopedic, medical, patent, and other prose styles.

patterns.name: Track and athlete contexts
patterns.context: Mentions athlete categories, track and field events, or athletes doing endurance sports; sometimes linked to training or competitive performance.
patterns.domain: Sports encyclopedias, sports medicine, and nutrition research

patterns.name: Lists of sports
patterns.context: Introduces sports offered by a school, university, or institution, or lists teams’ results in different sports.

patterns.name: Specific actions or performance in sports
patterns.context: Discusses recommended exercises, use of golf-simulating equipment, or dance events and scores in figure-skating competitions.
patterns.domain: Sports medicine, patent background, and figure-skating coverage

10_2362.description: 激活集中于体育语境：运动员、田径与耐力运动，体育项目清单，以及锻炼、具体运动活动和竞赛项目；跨百科、医学、专利等文体出现。

patterns.name: 田径与运动员语境
patterns.context: 提及运动员类别、田径项目，或运动员进行耐力运动；有时与训练或比赛表现相连。
patterns.domain: 体育百科、运动医学与营养研究

patterns.name: 体育项目清单
patterns.context: 学校、大学或机构介绍所提供的体育项目，或列举团队在各项目中的成绩。

patterns.name: 运动项目中的具体动作或表现
patterns.context: 讨论建议进行的锻炼、模拟高尔夫设备的使用，或花样滑冰比赛中的舞蹈项目与成绩。
patterns.domain: 运动医学、专利背景、花样滑冰报道

en.description: Primarily responds to sports and athletics contexts, including athletes, sports, running and endurance, swimming, ball sports, event records, and training exercises. Also appears in sports medicine, school athletics, and rehabilitation narratives.

patterns.name: Athletics and sports terminology
patterns.context: Activates when discussing athletes, sports, participation, or athletic activities; the word may be split across adjacent tokens.
patterns.domain: Sports encyclopedias, school athletics profiles, sports medicine, and forum text

patterns.name: Running and endurance sports
patterns.context: Activates when mentioning sprinting, track and field, distance running, or endurance tasks; also includes sports nutrition and training-performance contexts.
patterns.domain: Track-and-field encyclopedias, sports nutrition, and physiology research

patterns.name: Swimming-related events
patterns.context: Activates when swimming appears as a competitive event, a recommended aerobic activity, or a sport pursued after rehabilitation by people with disabilities; other events linked by and may also activate.
patterns.domain: Sports history, lists of sports, health guides, and biographies

patterns.name: Ball sports and other school sports
patterns.context: Activates on sport names in lists of sports or descriptions of school-team results, with no apparent restriction to a particular sport.
patterns.domain: School activity profiles and university sports encyclopedias

patterns.name: Event results and records
patterns.context: Activates in descriptions of competitions, champions, team results, or world records in sports.

patterns.name: Sports training and skill practice
patterns.context: Activates when discussing practice of basic movements, balance, or skill training; the context need not involve formal competition.

patterns.name: Sports word forms split across tokens
patterns.context: When a word is split into subword fragments, activation may fall on fragments of words related to sports or participants; this can co-occur with a sports context but does not independently identify the trigger mechanism.

10_2362.description: 主要响应体育与运动语境，涵盖运动员、体育项目、跑步耐力、游泳、球类、赛事纪录及训练练习；也出现在运动医学、学校体育和康复叙述中。

patterns.name: athletics及体育运动术语
patterns.context: 谈论运动员、体育项目、运动参与或体育活动时激活；词可被拆成相邻 token。
patterns.domain: 体育百科、学校体育介绍、运动医学及论坛文字

patterns.name: 跑步与耐力运动
patterns.context: 提及短跑、田径、长跑或耐力任务时激活；也包括运动营养及训练表现语境。
patterns.domain: 田径百科、运动营养与生理研究

patterns.name: 游泳相关项目
patterns.context: 游泳作为比赛项目、推荐的有氧活动，或残疾人康复后参与的运动出现时激活；有时与 and 相连的其他项目也有激活。
patterns.domain: 体育史、体育项目列表、健康指南及人物传记

patterns.name: 球类及其他学校体育项目
patterns.context: 体育项目列表或校队成绩叙述中出现项目名称时激活，未见必须限定某一运动。
patterns.domain: 学校活动介绍与大学体育百科

patterns.name: 赛事成绩与纪录
patterns.context: 运动项目的比赛、冠军、团队成绩或世界纪录叙述中激活。
patterns.domain: 体育赛事及运动员百科

patterns.name: 运动训练与技能练习
patterns.context: 讨论练习基本动作、平衡或技能训练时激活；不要求语境属于正式体育比赛。

patterns.name: 跨步切分的运动词形
patterns.context: 词被拆分标注时，激活位置可能落在构成运动或参与者相关词语的子词上；该现象可能与体育语境共同出现，但不能单独确定触发机制。

en.description: Primarily responds to sports contexts, especially athletes, track and endurance sports, and names of sports. Also responds to lists of sports, event divisions, and sports-science descriptions. Some activations occur on adjacent numbers, function words, and list formatting.

patterns.name: Lists of sports
patterns.context: Sports, ball sports, or athlete names appear consecutively after a general sports category or person category.

patterns.name: Athletes and competition descriptions
patterns.context: Describes athlete identity, specialization, participation, or events; often appears in athletics, competition, or results contexts.

patterns.name: Sports event lists and division headings
patterns.context: Events or school pages group content by gender, category, or sport; sport names may appear on their own line or in headings.

patterns.name: Specific token fragments in compound sports terms
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments of sport names or categories; some words are split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Exercise-related physiology and training terms
patterns.context: In endurance sports, training, or exercise physiology research, describes the type or duration of exercise or a body part.

patterns.name: Incidental activation on general words or formatting fragments
patterns.context: Numbers, function words, punctuation, or list formatting adjacent to sports content also show weaker activation, with unclear status as independent semantic triggers.

10_2362.description: 主要响应体育语境，尤其是运动员、田径与耐力运动项目名称，也响应体育项目清单、赛事分组及运动科学描述。少量激活落在相邻数字、功能词和列表格式上。

patterns.name: 体育项目名称列举
patterns.trigger: sports on offer are «athlet»«ics»、«basketball»、«football»、«cricket»；以及 «sports figures» 后列举 hockey、golfers、baseball
patterns.context: 体育总类或人物类别之后，连续出现项目、球类或运动员名称
patterns.domain: 学校体育介绍、专利说明

patterns.name: 运动员与竞赛项目描述
patterns.context: 描述运动员身份、专长、参赛或比赛项目，常出现 athletics、比赛项目或成绩语境

patterns.name: 体育赛事名单及分组标题
patterns.context: 赛事或学校页面按性别、类别、项目分组，项目名可能单独成行或位于标题中

patterns.name: 运动项目复合词中的特定分词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在运动名称或运动类别的词片段上；有些词被拆分成多个 token

patterns.name: 与运动相关的生理/训练术语
patterns.context: 耐力运动、运动训练或运动生理研究中，描述运动类型、持续时间或身体部位

patterns.name: 一般词语或格式片段的伴随激活
patterns.trigger: «Five» «hundred» «twenty» «-»«three»、«are»、«athlet»«ics» 后的逗号，以及列表换行符 «↵»
patterns.context: 与体育内容相邻的数字、功能词、标点或列表格式也有较弱激活，难以确定其为独立语义触发

en.description: Primarily responds to sports contexts: athletes, track and endurance or sprint events, other sports, event qualification, and medals. Also covers local patterns in school athletics, judo tables, sports-science research, and patents for articulated sports figures.

patterns.name: Athletes and competitive sports contexts
patterns.context: Appears in athlete profiles, competition results, qualification categories, or descriptions of athletic performance; often adjacent to terms for events, gender, country, results, or training.
patterns.domain: Sports encyclopedias, event records, sports science

patterns.name: Track and endurance running
patterns.context: Triggered by references to running, track events, athlete specializations, or endurance-sport experiments; includes sprinting, middle- and long-distance running, and track and field in general.
patterns.domain: Track and field, sports science, athlete biographies

patterns.name: Specific sports and equipment
patterns.context: Activates when sports, sporting equipment, or categories of sports figures are listed or described; not limited to track and field.
patterns.domain: Sports encyclopedias, school athletics profiles, patent background

patterns.name: Competition and award descriptions
patterns.context: Appears when describing competition qualifications, events, championships, or medals; often accompanied by years, levels, or participant categories.

patterns.name: School or event sports activity sections
patterns.context: Sports are introduced or listed as school extracurricular activities or available options.

patterns.name: Judo qualification tables
patterns.context: Event entries list individual or team qualifications, finals, and men’s events divided by weight class in tables or sections.

patterns.name: Sports figures and movable limbs
patterns.context: Patent background gives examples of sports figures whose arms or legs can be moved using equipment such as a racket or club.
patterns.domain: Patent text, toy or model mechanism descriptions

patterns.name: Human movement conditions in sports science
patterns.context: The study concerns healthy endurance athletes and discusses lower-limb or whole-body movement; this passage is only the opening of the paper’s introduction.

10_2362.description: 主要响应体育与运动语境：运动员、田径及耐力/短跑项目、其他运动、赛事资格与奖牌；也覆盖学校体育、柔道表格、运动科学研究和运动人物模型专利等局部模式。

patterns.name: 运动员与竞技项目语境
patterns.trigger: « athletes»、« athlete»、« runner»、« sprinter»，以及 « men»«'s»« categories»
patterns.context: 在运动员简介、比赛结果、资格分类或运动表现叙述中出现；常与项目、性别、国家、成绩或训练相关词相邻。
patterns.domain: 体育百科、赛事资料、运动科学

patterns.name: 田径与耐力跑
patterns.trigger: « long»« endurance»« tasks» like« running» a« half»« marathon»；« sprint»«ing»；« middle»-«distance»« runner»；« 800»« m»；« 400»« metres»；« track» and« field»；« athlet»«ics»
patterns.context: 谈及跑步、田径项目、运动员专项或耐力运动实验时触发；既包括短跑，也包括中长跑和一般田径。
patterns.domain: 田径、运动科学、运动员传记

patterns.name: 具体体育项目与器材
patterns.trigger: « basketball»、« football»、« cricket»；« disc»«us»« throw»«er»；« swimming»；« rac»«quet»、« stick»、« club»；« hockey»、« golf»、« baseball»
patterns.context: 体育项目、运动器材或体育人物类别被列举、描述时激活，不限于田径。
patterns.domain: 体育百科、学校体育介绍、专利背景

patterns.name: 竞赛及奖项叙述
patterns.trigger: « qualified»、« competed»、« inaugural»、« won»、« title»、« gold»« medal»、« Championships»
patterns.context: 描述赛事参赛资格、比赛、冠军或奖牌等竞技经历时出现，常伴有年份、级别或参赛类别。
patterns.domain: 体育赛事报道与百科条目

patterns.name: 学校或赛事中的体育活动栏目
patterns.context: 体育作为学校课外活动或可参与项目被介绍、罗列。

patterns.name: 柔道资格表格
patterns.trigger: «Individual»« qualification»、« Team» Finals、« J»«udo»，以及 « 60»« kg»、« 66»« kg»
patterns.context: 赛事条目以表格或栏目形式列出个人/团体资格、决赛及按体重划分的男子项目。

patterns.name: 体育模型及可动肢体
patterns.trigger: « a»« rac»«quet»、« stick»、« club»，以及 « hockey»« players»、« golf»«ers»、« baseball»« players»
patterns.context: 专利背景中举例说明可借助球拍、球杆等器具活动手臂或腿的运动人物模型。
patterns.domain: 专利文本、玩具或模型机构说明

patterns.name: 运动科学中的人体运动条件
patterns.trigger: « endurance»« athletes»« performing»« lower»-«body» or « whole»-«body»« exercise»
patterns.context: 研究对象是身体健全的耐力运动员，讨论下肢或全身运动；本段仅为论文引言开头。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、运动生理学

en.description: Activation is concentrated in sports contexts: athletes, events and results, sports and training. It also covers event classification lists, school athletics, sports nutrition, and sports medicine or physiology research.

patterns.name: Athletes and sports competitions
patterns.context: Describes athlete identity, participation, results, medals, or records; includes biographies and event coverage.

patterns.name: Sports and training activities
patterns.context: Lists sports or describes training, exercise, and athletic performance.
patterns.domain: Sports medicine, training, and sports profiles

patterns.name: Sport classifications, event tables, and lists
patterns.context: Lists gender groups and sports categories in headings, line-separated lists, or table fragments.

patterns.name: School sports profiles
patterns.context: Introduces extracurricular sports offered by a school, followed by a list of sport names.

patterns.name: Sports nutrition and endurance performance

en.description: All passages are in sports or exercise contexts: athletes, sports and movements, event schedules, training programs, and athletic performance. Also includes sports medicine and nutrition research, adaptive sports, and school athletics profiles.

patterns.name: Sports, exercise, and athlete-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Describes people and activities involving sports participation, exercise, training, or competition; activation can occur on these words themselves or nearby sports, movement, and conditioning terms.
patterns.domain: Sports encyclopedias, fitness discussions, sports medicine, and nutrition research

patterns.name: Specific sports and movements
patterns.context: Lists specific sports, event disciplines, training movements, or competition categories; includes both general sports and equipment-based training and fitness exercises.

patterns.name: Athletic performance, training programs, and physiological research
patterns.context: Discusses exercise duration, intensity, training schedules, performance, or metabolism and interventions during exercise; sports terms and research descriptions co-occur.
patterns.domain: Exercise physiology, clinical research, sports nutrition

patterns.name: Wheelchair athletes and adaptive sports
patterns.context: The sport is practiced by wheelchair users and occurs near “athletes” and a spinal cord injury context.

patterns.name: Sports event lists and layout structure

patterns.domain: Sports encyclopedias, event schedules or results tables

patterns.name: Sports facilities/extracurricular sports sections
patterns.context: A school or institution introduces extracurricular activities and lists available sports.

patterns.name: Unclear trigger in an athlete biography
patterns.context: A biographical sentence introduces a retired athlete and their specialty; activation involves identity and track-and-field specialization, but there is insufficient evidence that general biographies also trigger it.

10_2362.description: 各段都处于体育或锻炼语境：涵盖运动员、项目与动作、赛事赛程、训练方案及运动表现，也包括运动医学营养研究、适应性体育和学校体育介绍。

patterns.name: 运动、锻炼与运动员相关词汇
patterns.context: 描述参与运动、锻炼、训练或竞赛的人与活动；激活可出现在这些词本身，也可出现在附近的运动项目、动作和身体训练词汇。
patterns.domain: 体育百科、健身讨论、运动医学及营养研究

patterns.name: 具体运动项目与动作
patterns.context: 列举具体运动、赛事项目、训练动作或竞赛类别；既包括普通体育项目，也包括器械训练和健身动作。
patterns.domain: 体育、健身训练、竞技运动

patterns.name: 运动表现、训练方案与生理研究

patterns.domain: 运动生理、临床研究、运动营养学

patterns.name: 轮椅运动员与适应性体育

patterns.name: 体育赛事名单与版面结构
patterns.context: 以分行标题和资格赛、决赛、性别或级别分类构成赛事赛程或结果页面，而非连续叙述。

patterns.name: 体育设施／课外体育栏目

en.description: Primarily responds to sports and their names, also covering athlete records, event medals, and training performance. A few triggers occur in wheelchair-sports research and game-related terms such as billiards and pinball.

patterns.name: Lists and classifications of sports
patterns.context: Lists or tables enumerate events, sports, gender categories, or competition qualifications; activation often falls on sport names, classification labels, and item separators.

patterns.name: Athlete biographies and competitive records
patterns.context: Biographies or list entries describe athletes’ specialties, rankings, participation, and medals; activation also occurs around names and career records.

patterns.name: Sports training and athletic performance
patterns.context: Discusses exercise schedules, training movements, endurance sports, or sports nutrition and performance; usually appears in explanatory prose rather than directories.
patterns.domain: Fitness and sports nutrition articles, forums

patterns.name: Wheelchair sports and athletes with disabilities
patterns.context: Academic papers discuss athletes with spinal cord injuries and wheelchair sports; activation occurs near sport names and athlete groups.

patterns.name: Sports-related game terminology
patterns.context: Game descriptions mention elements such as billiards and pinball; unlike the other examples, these are not real-world sports contexts but still contain specific sport or competitive-activity terms.

10_2362.description: 主要响应体育项目及其名称，也覆盖运动员履历、赛事奖牌和训练表现；少数触发于轮椅体育研究及游戏中的桌球、弹珠台等竞技项目词汇。

patterns.name: 体育项目列表与分类

patterns.context: 列表或表格中按项目罗列赛事、运动项目、性别分类或参赛资格；激活常落在项目名、分类标签及条目分隔处。

patterns.name: 运动员传记与竞技履历
patterns.context: 人物传记或名单条目描述运动员专项、排名、参赛经历和奖牌；激活也出现在姓名及履历周边。

patterns.name: 体育训练与运动表现
patterns.context: 讨论锻炼安排、训练动作、耐力运动或运动营养和表现；通常处于解释性正文，而非名录。
patterns.domain: 健身与运动营养文章、论坛

patterns.name: 轮椅体育及残疾运动员
patterns.context: 学术论文讨论脊髓损伤运动员及轮椅体育，项目名和运动员群体附近激活。

patterns.name: 体育相关游戏项目词汇

en.description: Responds to sports-related vocabulary: sports and gender categories, athlete specializations and event results in biographies, as well as sports medicine research, fitness movements, and endurance-sport nutrition. Triggering terms vary by context.

patterns.name: Lists and classifications of sports
patterns.context: Sport names appear consecutively, often arranged by gender, category, or event section on separate lines; activation highlights sport names and some classification terms.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia sports event entries, directories, or table fragments

patterns.name: Competition narratives in athlete biographies
patterns.context: Introduces athletes, their specializations, represented countries, event participation, and medal results; activation often falls on sport, event, and ranking terms.

patterns.name: Research contexts involving athletes or sports participants
patterns.context: Sports and athlete groups appear in academic discussions of correlations or physical conditions.

patterns.name: Fitness movements and sequencing
patterns.context: Describes a workout sequence that moves from a more difficult or heavier exercise to other movements.

patterns.name: Endurance sports and sports nutrition
patterns.context: Discusses prolonged exercise, running performance, and the effect of consuming carbohydrates before exercise.

10_2362.description: 对体育及运动相关词汇有反应：体育项目和性别分类、运动员传记中的专项与赛事成绩，也包括体育医学研究、健身动作和耐力运动营养；触发词随语境而变。

patterns.name: 体育项目列表与分类
patterns.context: 项目名称连续列举，常按性别、类别或赛事栏目换行排列；激活突出项目名及部分分类词

patterns.name: 运动员传记中的竞赛叙述

patterns.name: 运动员或体育参与者的研究语境

patterns.name: 健身训练动作与顺序

patterns.name: 耐力运动与运动营养
patterns.context: 讨论长时间运动、跑步表现及运动前补充碳水化合物的作用

en.description: Responds to terms related to sports contexts, including sports, divisions, athlete identity, event medals, training movements, and athletic performance. Common in sports encyclopedias, and also seen in fitness discussions and sports-science and medical texts.

patterns.name: Sport category or event heading
patterns.context: Headings, directories, or division labels, especially entries organized by gender or sport on sports pages.

patterns.name: Sports events and medal descriptions
patterns.context: Describes athletes competing in specific events or divisions or winning medals.

patterns.name: Athlete and specialty profiles
patterns.context: Biographical profiles identify someone as an athlete and state their specialty, nationality, or career history.

patterns.name: Sports and training movements
patterns.context: Lists fitness exercises consecutively, organized by difficulty or sequence.

patterns.name: Athletic ability, fitness, and endurance performance

patterns.domain: Sports coverage, health, and sports science

patterns.name: Athletes in wheelchair sports

10_2362.description: 对体育语境中的项目、组别、运动员身份、赛事奖牌、训练动作及运动表现相关词语反应；常见于体育百科，也见健身讨论与运动科学、医学文本。

patterns.name: 运动类别或项目标题

en.description: Primarily responds to sports-related vocabulary, covering athletes, sports, event results, fitness movements, and swimming activities; also responds to game and pinball terms in video game contexts.

patterns.name: Sports and athletes
patterns.context: Sports encyclopedias or coverage introduce athletes, competitions, sports, results, medals, qualifications, or sports facilities; includes track and field, badminton, basketball, volleyball, swimming, and other sports.

patterns.name: Sport names and compound terms
patterns.context: Activates on sport names or specific movement terms; may appear in event directories, athlete profiles, fitness recommendations, or descriptions of recreational activities.

patterns.name: Sports events and results
patterns.context: Contexts describing events, placements, medals, records, rankings, or competition qualifications.

patterns.name: Games and pinball elements

10_2362.description: 主要响应体育与运动相关词汇，覆盖运动员、项目、赛事成绩、健身动作及游泳活动；另在电子游戏语境中响应游戏、弹球等词。

patterns.name: 体育项目与运动员
patterns.context: 体育百科或报道中介绍运动员、比赛、项目、成绩、奖牌、资格或运动设施；包括田径、羽毛球、篮球、排球、游泳等不同项目。

patterns.name: 运动项目名称及复合词
patterns.context: 运动项目或具体运动动作词出现时激活；可出现在赛事目录、运动员介绍、健身建议或休闲活动描述中。
patterns.domain: 竞技体育、健身、游泳休闲

patterns.name: 体育赛事与成绩
patterns.trigger: “Junior Olympic Games”“Commonwealth Games”“Bronze Medal”“Silver Medal”“national champion”“top-20”等
patterns.context: 描述赛事、名次、奖牌、纪录、排名或参赛资格的语境。

patterns.name: 游戏与弹球元素
patterns.context: 电子游戏介绍中列举游戏类型、玩法元素或玩家行为；与其他段落的体育语境不同。

en.concept: Mixed subword fragments and formatting features
en.description: Activations are scattered across subwords in technical terms and proper names, common function words, code/formatting structures, and a few collocations and numbers; they span corpora and domains, with no stable, unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Cross-word boundaries / intra-word suffix fragments
patterns.context: Activations often fall on multiword terms, compounds, or intra-word fragments; sometimes they cover a continuous fragment, and sometimes only part of one is marked.

patterns.name: Specific terms or entity names
patterns.context: Subword fragments in domain terms, proper names, or identifiers may trigger activation, but these entities have no obvious semantic connection to one another.
patterns.domain: Philosophy, medicine, biomedicine, software, and code

patterns.name: Sentence-initial and function words / connectives
patterns.context: Common prepositions, articles, conjunctions, or infinitive markers also activate, usually in titles or technical phrases; they do not explain activation on their own.
patterns.domain: Paper titles, abstracts, and general text

patterns.name: Formatting markers, code structures, and line breaks
patterns.context: Line breaks, spaces, dividers, brackets, or paragraph markers activate in structured text; this is especially noticeable in formats such as code comments, references, and mailing lists.

patterns.name: Local collocations of common words
patterns.context: A few general words are marked in fixed collocations or common phrases, but there is insufficient evidence for a unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Numbers and dates/identifiers
patterns.context: Activations occur near years, times, or list numbers, possibly related to local formatting.

patterns.name: Specialized fragments in medical text
patterns.context: Biomedical vocabulary is split into subwords, with multiple fragments activating; these include diseases, experimental subjects, or examination names.

10_2447.concept: 混合的词片段与格式特征
10_2447.description: 激活分散于专业术语和专名的子词、普通功能词、代码/排版结构及少数搭配与数字；跨语料、跨领域，缺少稳定统一的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 跨词边界/词内后缀片段
patterns.trigger: 词语被切成多个子词片段并分别标记，如 «ency»10«cl»3«ical»1、«B»1«ened»5ict、«West»5« Nile»4« virus»8« infection»3
patterns.context: 激活常落在多词术语、复合词或词内片段上；有时覆盖连续片段，有时只标出其中一部分。

patterns.name: 特定术语或实体名称
patterns.trigger: «Natural»2 «Environment»1；«West Nile virus infection»；«metal-organic frameworks»、«carboxylic acid ligands»；«CommonJS Formatter»；«Visual»ization« Tool»kit
patterns.context: 领域术语、专名或标识符中的词片段可能触发，但这些实体彼此无明显语义联系。
patterns.domain: 哲学、医学、生物医学、软件与代码

patterns.name: 句首及功能词/连接语
patterns.context: 普通介词、冠词、连词或不定式标记也会激活，通常处于标题或专业短语中，不能单独解释激活。
patterns.domain: 论文标题、摘要及一般文本

patterns.name: 格式标记、代码结构与换行
patterns.context: 结构性文本中，换行、空格、分隔线、括号或段落标记出现激活；在代码注释、参考文献和邮件列表等格式中尤其明显。

patterns.name: 常见词的局部搭配
patterns.context: 少量一般词在固定搭配或常用短语中被标记，未见足够证据表明有统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 数字与日期/编号
patterns.context: 年份、时间或列表编号附近出现激活，可能与局部格式有关。

patterns.name: 医疗文本中的专门片段
patterns.context: 生物医学词汇被拆分为子词后多段激活，包含疾病、实验对象或检查名称。

en.description: Activations are scattered across subword boundaries, phrase positions such as “of,” paragraph breaks, and various proper names or technical terms; examples include biomedical, philosophical, email, encyclopedia, and mathematical texts, with no unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Syllable boundaries in split words
patterns.context: A word is split into multiple subword tokens, with activation concentrated on the final subword “amine”; the same pattern occurs twice.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers and NIH project abstracts

patterns.name: Phrase boundaries near “of”
patterns.context: “of” activates prominently in “of biomedical data” and “factor of 62 and 9”; the two phrases are from different domains.

patterns.name: Paragraph or entry separator line breaks
patterns.context: A new paragraph or list item begins after a blank line; activation also occurs on a single line break between a title and body text.

patterns.name: Encyclopedia disambiguation entry format
patterns.context: The first line is an abbreviation or entry name, followed by candidate entries introduced by “may refer to:”; paragraph separators may also activate.

patterns.name: Titles, proper names, and subword segmentation
patterns.context: When longer proper names, titles, or compounds are split into subwords, some subwords and numbers activate; these occur within the same continuous context.
patterns.domain: Philosophical literature and introductions to papal encyclicals

patterns.name: Email subject and reply format
patterns.context: The email begins with a revision-draft subject enclosed in angle brackets, followed by “Your message” and a blank line.

patterns.name: Number strings in math problems
patterns.context: A question asks for the common factors of two numbers, followed by a line break after the question mark and a numeric answer or continuation.

patterns.name: Nerve conduction research terminology
patterns.context: Discusses the comparison of conduction velocity distributions and fiber size distributions; activation falls mainly on initial subword fragments and some function words.

patterns.name: Transrectal ultrasound terminology
patterns.context: A medical abstract title concerns an examination method and organ, followed by body text about a new device; “of” and some term subwords activate.

10_2447.description: 激活分散于子词边界、of等短语位置、段落换行及多种专名或专业术语；包含生医、哲学、邮件、百科和数学文本，未见统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 拆分词中的音节边界
patterns.context: 单词被切分成多个子词 token，激活集中在词尾子词“amine”；同一模式出现两次。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与 NIH 项目摘要

patterns.name: “of”附近的短语边界
patterns.context: 在“of biomedical data”和“factor of 62 and 9”中，“of”激活明显；两个短语领域不同。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、数学题目

patterns.name: 段落或条目分隔换行
patterns.context: 连续空行后开始新段落或列表条目；另有标题与正文间的单个换行激活。

patterns.name: 百科消歧条目格式
patterns.context: 首行是缩写或词条名，随后以“may refer to:”引出候选条目；可能伴随段落分隔符激活。

patterns.name: 标题、专名和子词切分
patterns.context: 较长的专名、标题或复合词被拆成子词时，部分子词和数字获得激活；出现在同一连续上下文中。
patterns.domain: 哲学文献与教宗通谕介绍

patterns.name: 邮件主题与回复格式
patterns.context: 邮件开头含尖括号包围的修订草稿主题，随后出现“Your message”和空行。

patterns.name: 数学题目中的数字串
patterns.context: 问句要求求两个数字的公因数，问号后换行并出现数字答案或续文。

patterns.name: 神经传导研究术语
patterns.trigger: «Con»5«duction»1« velocity»1« distributions»4；“fiber size distributions”；“normal human sural nerve”
patterns.context: 讨论传导速度分布与纤维尺寸分布的比较；激活主要落在词首子词和若干功能词上。

patterns.name: 直肠超声术语
patterns.context: 医学摘要标题以检查方法和器官为主题，后接新设备相关正文；“of”及部分术语子词激活。

en.concept: Conditional statements and mathematical relation symbols
en.description: The most prominent recurring trigger is the conditional word “if,” especially when introducing mathematical or program conditions; equals signs in mathematical formulas also activate repeatedly. Other highly activating words are scattered across different domains and lack a unified explanation.

patterns.name: If in conditional sentences
patterns.context: In mathematics, code, graph explanations, or legal text, the conditional connective if is followed by a condition or judgment; this word has the strongest activation in multiple passages

patterns.name: Equals signs in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Expresses a definition, assignment, or relation in a formula, often appearing between variables, constants, and expressions

patterns.name: Other sporadic activations across domains
patterns.context: Each passage occurs in a different context, with no stable shared lexical or semantic trigger
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, code, Q&A, philosophy, law, etc.

10_2447.concept: 条件判断与数学关系符号
10_2447.description: 最突出的重复触发是条件词“if”，尤其用于引出数学或程序条件；数学公式中的等号也多次激活。其余高激活词分散于不同领域，缺少统一解释。

patterns.name: 条件句中的 if
patterns.context: 数学、代码、图形解释或法律文本中，条件连接词 if 后接条件或判定；该词在多段中激活最强

patterns.name: 数学公式中的等号
patterns.context: 公式中表达定义、赋值或关系，常出现在变量、常数与表达式之间

patterns.name: 跨多领域的其他零散激活
patterns.context: 各段在不同语境下出现，未见稳定共享的词汇或语义触发条件
patterns.domain: 百科、代码、问答、哲学与法律等

en.description: Primarily responds to scientific reports in paper style: values, errors and statistical symbols, units, comparisons between groups or time points, and the associated medical subjects and experimental measurements; also covers materials experiments and table formatting.

patterns.name: Numerical results in biomedical research
patterns.context: Paper abstracts or results sections report patient characteristics, disease grades, symptom rates, procedure times, measurements, between-group differences, or treatment outcomes; often accompanied by words such as “mean,” “patients,” and “Group”

patterns.name: Experimental measurements and materials results
patterns.context: Reports experimental measurements such as material structure, angles, or drug release, including values, error ranges, and units

patterns.name: Medical terminology and research subjects
patterns.context: Academic descriptions centered on a specific disease, patient population, or treatment; not necessarily adjacent to numerical results

patterns.name: Table and group-comparison formats
patterns.context: Presents values or correlation results side by side by group, condition, or time point
patterns.domain: Paper results tables / tables converted to text

10_2447.description: 主要响应论文式科学报告：数值、误差与统计符号、单位、组间或时间点比较，以及其中的医学对象和实验测量；也覆盖材料实验与表格格式。

patterns.name: 生物医学研究中的数值结果
patterns.context: 论文摘要或结果段中报告患者特征、疾病分级、症状比例、手术时间、测量值、组间差异或治疗结果；常伴随“mean”“patients”“Group”等词

patterns.name: 实验测量与材料结果
patterns.trigger: “angle θ”“86.7 ± 0.3°”、“release of drug”、“gastric and intestinal pH”
patterns.context: 报告材料结构、角度或药物释放等实验测量，含数值、误差范围和单位
patterns.domain: 材料/化学与药剂学论文

patterns.name: 医学术语及研究对象
patterns.context: 围绕特定疾病、患者群体或治疗展开的学术叙述；不一定紧邻数值结果

patterns.name: 表格与分组比较格式
patterns.trigger: “Group A”“Group B”、“vs”、“BECTS with ADHD”、“BECTS without ADHD”及对齐空格、换行符
patterns.context: 以组别、条件或时间点并列呈现数值或相关性结果
patterns.domain: 论文结果表格/表格转文本

en.description: All passages come from research papers. The neuron broadly responds to numbers, errors, units, and punctuation in results reporting; many instances also include wording about group comparisons, measurements, or follow-up. Topics include clinical medicine, drug materials, and physical structures, with no pattern exclusive to one field.

patterns.name: Statistical value ranges and error terms
patterns.context: Research abstracts or papers report measurements, group comparisons, sample sizes, times, proportions, or significance; activation often falls on numbers and nearby connectors, units, and punctuation.
patterns.domain: Results sections in biomedicine, clinical research, and materials/physics research

patterns.name: Results reporting and comparison wording
patterns.context: States measurements, follow-up, comparisons, and results from experimental or clinical studies, often with group, method, or metric names and quantitative data.
patterns.domain: Academic paper results sections, mainly PubMed abstracts, also including PMC full text

patterns.name: Grouped data and between-group comparison formats
patterns.context: Reports values, metrics, or results side by side for two or more groups; activation occurs near control group names and comparison markers.

patterns.name: Medical examinations and clinical metrics
patterns.context: Reports results of cardiac imaging, surgery, disease, or orthopedic measurements in clinical studies; usually occurs alongside values, group comparisons, or follow-up information.
patterns.domain: Cardiovascular, metabolic, surgical, and orthopedic medicine

patterns.name: Drug delivery and material characterization
patterns.context: Describes drug-loaded materials, nanoparticles, or drug release/characterization; quantitative results are often given as percentages, particle sizes, or charges.

patterns.name: Material/physical structures and geometric measurements
patterns.context: Reports measurements and quantitative results for directions, angles, or geometric relations in material structures.
patterns.domain: Materials science, condensed matter, or surface physics

patterns.name: Repeated measurements listed by time point
patterns.context: Paired values are listed repeatedly at multiple time points, forming a compact time-series result.

10_2447.concept: 科研结果中的定量报告
10_2447.description: 所有段落都来自科研论文，神经元普遍响应结果报告中的数字、误差、单位和标点；多处伴随组间比较、测量或随访措辞。主题涵盖临床医学、药物材料及物理结构，未见单一领域专属模式。

patterns.name: 统计数值区间与误差项
patterns.context: 科研摘要或论文中报告测量结果、组间比较、样本量、时间、比例或显著性；激活常落在数值及其前后连接符、单位、标点上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、临床研究及材料/物理研究的结果段

patterns.name: 结果报告与比较措辞
patterns.trigger: “Follow-up”“was performed”“Survival status”“revealed”“was significantly lower”“most accurate”“were followed”“Mean operative time”“was measured”“significantly higher”“respectively”
patterns.context: 陈述实验或临床研究的测量、随访、比较和结果，常伴随组别、方法或指标名称及定量数据。
patterns.domain: 学术论文结果段，主要为 PubMed 摘要，也包括 PMC 正文

patterns.name: 成组数据与组间对照格式
patterns.context: 并列报告两组或多组的数值、指标或结果；对照组名和比较标记附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 医学检查与临床指标
patterns.context: 临床研究中报告心脏影像、手术、疾病或骨科测量结果；通常与数值、组间比较或随访信息并现。
patterns.domain: 心血管、代谢、外科及骨科医学

patterns.name: 药物递送与材料表征
patterns.trigger: “FTIR studies”“IPN beads”“Fe3+”“drug”“gastric and intestinal pH”“drug loading”“PLGA NPs”“size”“charge”
patterns.context: 描述载药材料、纳米颗粒或药物释放/表征，数值结果常以百分比、粒径或电荷等形式给出。
patterns.domain: 药剂学、药物递送与生物材料

patterns.name: 材料/物理结构与几何测量
patterns.context: 报告材料结构中方向、角度或几何关系的测量及定量结果。
patterns.domain: 材料科学、凝聚态或表面物理

patterns.name: 按时间点列出的连续测量
patterns.trigger: “at 30 min”“at 45 min”“at 60 min”及其相邻的“vs”数值
patterns.context: 多个时间点重复列出成对数值，形成紧凑的时间序列结果。

en.description: Activations concentrate on operational wording in math problems: differentiating, sorting or comparing by size or distance, finding the least common multiple, classifying numbers as prime or composite, and solving equations or finding unknowns that satisfy equations. All passages are from DM Mathematics.

patterns.name: Relational words in calculus differentiation problems
patterns.context: In differentiation problems, nearby trigger words often include a function, variable, or derivative order; activation may also fall on words in the prompt such as “of” and “wrt,” rather than only on derivative.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, math problems written in natural language

patterns.name: Ordering by size and extreme-value comparison questions
patterns.context: Asks for ordering or comparison by size or distance, or for the least common multiple; trigger words vary across different phrasings.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, multiple-choice or short calculation problems

patterns.name: Prime/composite classification
patterns.context: Repeatedly asks whether integers are prime or composite and gives True/False labels.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, question-answer number theory exercises

patterns.name: Equation-solving instructions
patterns.context: An explicit instruction to solve an equation is followed by an algebraic equation.

patterns.name: Finding the value of a specified unknown
patterns.context: Asks for the value of a variable that satisfies a given higher-degree equation.

10_2447.description: 激活集中在数学题的操作性措辞：求导、按大小或距离排序比较、求最小公倍数、判定素合数，以及求解方程或满足方程的未知数。各段题目均属 DM Mathematics。

patterns.name: 微积分求导题中的关系词
patterns.context: 求导问题中，触发词附近常有函数、自变量或导数阶数；激活也可能落在题干的“of”“wrt”等词上，而非只落在 derivative 上。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics，自然语言编写的数学题

patterns.name: 大小次序与极值比较问句
patterns.context: 要求按大小、距离排序或比较，或求最小公倍数；触发词分布在不同表述中。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics，选择题或简短计算题

patterns.name: 素数／合数判定
patterns.context: 连续提出整数是否为素数或合数的问题，并给出 True/False 标签。

patterns.name: 方程求解指令
patterns.context: 出现明确的解方程指令，后接代数方程。

patterns.name: 指定未知数求值
patterns.context: 要求找出满足给定高次方程的变量取值。

en.description: Primarily responds to total counts following “total/of 10” in scientific and medical texts, as well as sample sizes, case counts, and percentages; also includes disease terminology, public-health contact statistics, scale item counts, and a number in a physics reference.

patterns.name: Counts or values after a total of 10
patterns.context: Totals, sample sizes, case counts, item counts, or demographic statistics in papers or encyclopedia descriptions; activation often falls on the number 10 or a following number, and also occurs on the word total
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, demographics, health research, patent background

patterns.name: Statistical proportions and percentages
patterns.context: Reports population shares, patient proportions, or event outcomes, often with sample sizes and statistical analysis

patterns.name: Case, patient, and paired-sample counts
patterns.context: Describes the size of research populations or observed events, usually in methods or results sections; some instances overlap with the “total of 10” quantity format

patterns.name: Medical abbreviations, diseases, and clinical research terminology
patterns.context: Diagnostic, surgical, symptom, or medical-service terms in clinical research or disease descriptions; often accompanied by numerical statistics but not forming a single disease theme
patterns.domain: Medical papers, patent background, health research

patterns.name: Volume, page, and year numbers in references
patterns.context: Journal abbreviation, volume and page information, and publication year follow an author’s name; activation falls on numbers or punctuation in the citation format

patterns.name: Gene and genetic disease descriptions
patterns.context: Introduces the inheritance pattern of sickle cell anemia and affected populations, including a prevalence rate
patterns.domain: NIH project records or disease background descriptions

patterns.name: Cohort observations and contact counts
patterns.context: Describes community healthcare data using child-years, clinic visits, or the number of contacts for health concerns

patterns.name: Scale item counts and development
patterns.context: Describes the selection and development of a health education scale and its number of items; “total of 10 15 items” exhibits a numeric format

10_2447.concept: 科学文本中的数字统计
10_2447.description: 主要在科学与医学文本中响应 total/of 10 后的总量数字，以及样本量、病例数和百分比；也见疾病术语、公共卫生接触统计、量表条目数和一例物理学参考文献数字。

patterns.name: 总数为10后的计数或数值
patterns.trigger: “total”后紧接“of”与数字 10，如 “a total of 10 334,863”“A total of 10 464 pairs”“a total of 10 5060”；也包括 “estimated total of four million”附近的 “total”
patterns.context: 论文或百科叙述中的总体、样本量、病例数、项目数或人口统计；激活常落在数字 10 或其后的数字，也见于 total 一词
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、人口统计、健康研究、专利背景

patterns.name: 统计比例与百分数
patterns.context: 报告人口占比、患者比例或事件结果，常伴有样本数及统计分析

patterns.name: 病例、患者与配对样本计数
patterns.trigger: “patients”“pairs”“episodes”“children”及其邻近计数，如 “464 pairs”“103 patients”“5060 pediatric patients”“116 patients”
patterns.context: 研究对象或观察事件的规模描述，通常出现在方法或结果段落；部分实例与 total of 10 数量格式重叠
patterns.domain: 医学摘要与公共卫生研究

patterns.name: 医学缩写、疾病与临床研究术语
patterns.context: 临床研究或疾病介绍中出现的诊断、手术、症候或医疗服务术语；多伴随数字统计，但不构成单一疾病主题
patterns.domain: 医学论文、专利背景、健康研究

patterns.name: 文献引用中的卷页与年份数字
patterns.context: 作者姓名后列出期刊缩写、卷页信息及出版年份；激活落在引用格式中的数字或标点

patterns.name: 基因与遗传疾病表述
patterns.context: 介绍镰状细胞贫血的遗传方式及受影响人群，包含患病比例
patterns.domain: NIH 项目记录或疾病背景描述

patterns.name: 队列观察与接触次数
patterns.trigger: “person-years”“contacts with skin problems”“single contact with the GP”
patterns.context: 以儿童人年、就诊接触或健康问题接触次数描述社区医疗数据
patterns.domain: 公共卫生或基层医疗研究

patterns.name: 量表条目数量与开发
patterns.context: 描述健康教育相关量表的选择、开发及条目数；“total of 10 15 items”呈现数字格式

en.description: Activations appear scattered across formal texts such as patents and paper citations, research methods and sample reports, project proposals, and legal cases; they often occur with proper names, numbers, statistics, or citation formats, but triggers and topics are not unified.

patterns.name: References and publication information
patterns.context: Bibliographic information in patent or paper citations, such as publication titles, volume/issue/page numbers, and publication dates; activation often falls on numbers, punctuation, and citation words
patterns.domain: Patent background and academic literature citations

patterns.name: Model and method names
patterns.context: When introducing computational models, algorithms, or statistical methods used for prediction or analysis

patterns.name: Matching and pairing descriptions
patterns.context: Describes matching on variables such as age and sex and reports the number of successfully matched pairs

patterns.name: Survey and total sample counts
patterns.context: Introduces survey methods, survey organizations, or research sample sizes, often with counts and demographic information

patterns.name: Recruitment and inclusion of study participants
patterns.context: The methods section describes case recruitment, inclusion counts, hospitals, and the study period

patterns.name: Project proposals and research cohorts
patterns.context: Introduces intervention study protocols, consecutive cohorts, and participating families or regions

patterns.name: Legal rules and case citations
patterns.context: Explains statutes in legal arguments and cites court cases, case citations, and principles for applying regulations

patterns.name: Database research and descriptive statistics
patterns.context: Uses a cancer database to assess patient populations and report descriptive statistics or survival estimates

10_2447.concept: 正式文本中的信息报告
10_2447.description: 激活散见于专利和论文引文、研究方法及样本报告、项目方案和法律判例等正式文本；常伴随专名、数字、统计或引用格式，但触发词与主题并不统一。

patterns.name: 参考文献与出版信息
patterns.context: 专利或论文引文中，出版物名称、卷期页码、发布日期等书目信息；激活常落在数值、标点及引文词语上
patterns.domain: 专利背景与学术文献引述

patterns.name: 模型与方法名称
patterns.trigger: « computational»、« models»、« Bayesian»、« Multilayer»、« Perceptron»、« Logistic Regression»
patterns.context: 介绍用于预测或分析的计算模型、算法或统计方法时

patterns.name: 匹配及配对描述
patterns.context: 描述按年龄、性别等变量进行匹配，并报告匹配成功的配对数时

patterns.name: 调查与样本总数
patterns.context: 介绍调查方法、调查机构或研究样本规模，常伴随人数和人口统计信息

patterns.name: 研究对象招募与纳入
patterns.trigger: « Patients and methods»、« In»« total»、« cases»、« enrolled»
patterns.context: 方法部分说明病例招募、纳入数量、医院及研究时间范围

patterns.name: 项目方案及研究队列
patterns.trigger: « proposed»、« work»、« cohorts»、« families»、« school districts»
patterns.context: 介绍干预研究方案、连续队列及参与的家庭或地区

patterns.name: 法律规则与判例引述
patterns.context: 法律论证中解释成文法，并引用法院案件、判例引文和法规适用原则

patterns.name: 数据库研究与描述性统计
patterns.context: 用癌症数据库评估患者群体，并报告描述性统计或生存估计

en.concept: Citations and quantitative annotations in formal texts
en.description: Activations primarily occur near standardized citations and identifiers in formal texts: legal cases, statutes, and procedural wording are most prominent; also found in bibliographic page numbers and sample sizes, proportions, and time statistics in medical abstracts.

patterns.name: Legal citations and procedural wording
patterns.context: In legal arguments, case facts, or judicial statements, accompanied by case law, statutes, section numbers, and citation formats; often occurs at citations or sentence continuations
patterns.domain: Case law, bankruptcy law, family law, and contract litigation texts

patterns.name: References and page-number annotations
patterns.context: Authors, titles, editions, publication information, page numbers, or bracketed numbers in bibliographies or literature citations
patterns.domain: Patent background, philosophical bibliographies, physics papers

patterns.name: Quantities and statistical descriptions in research results
patterns.context: Abstracts report research results such as sample sizes, groups, proportions, or times; activations are scattered near quantity expressions

10_2447.concept: 专业文本中的引用与量化标注
10_2447.description: 激活主要出现在专业文本的规范化引用与编号附近：法律判例、法规和程序表述最集中；另见书目页码，以及医学摘要中的样本量、比例和时间统计。

patterns.name: 法律引文与程序性表述
patterns.trigger: «-»14;« Pool»1« Markets»1«,»3« supra»2；“action will not be disturbed on appeal”；“Upon the conversion of the case to« Chapter»6 7”；“powers beyond those granted to it by statute”
patterns.context: 法律论证、案件事实或判决语句中，伴随判例、法规、章节编号和引文格式；常见于引文或句子续接处
patterns.domain: 判例、破产法、家事法及合同诉讼文本

patterns.name: 参考文献与页码标注
patterns.context: 书目或文献引用中出现作者、书名、版本、出版信息、页码或方括号编号
patterns.domain: 专利背景、哲学书目、物理学论文

patterns.name: 研究结果中的数量与统计叙述
patterns.trigger: “« 7« an»1atomic regions”；“« total»2« of»10« 250»2 cases”；“« within»1 24h”；“« 29»2%”
patterns.context: 摘要报告样本量、分组、比例或时间等研究结果；激活零散落在数量表达附近

en.description: Primarily responds to sample-size reports introduced by “A total of N” in medical abstracts, across various diseases and study designs; also includes the coefficient 10 in mathematical material and numbers and answer-separator formats in prime-factor Q&A.

patterns.name: Sample-total phrasing in research abstracts
patterns.context: When medical abstracts describe the total number of people enrolled, examined, analyzed, or diagnosed in a study; triggers concentrate on the total expression, followed by a number and a population noun

patterns.name: Tokenized form of total
patterns.context: In total-count phrasing, total may be split into tokens; activation covers total and the value 10, followed by the research sample size

patterns.name: Coefficient 10 in a polynomial
patterns.context: The coefficient 10 after a minus sign in a mathematical expression; only seen in the polynomial definition of w(y)

patterns.name: Numbers and separators in prime-factor Q&A
patterns.context: Repeated “find the prime factors of a number” questions and their answers; activation is scattered across question numbers and answer formats

10_2447.description: 主要响应医学摘要中“A total of N”引出的样本量报告，覆盖多种疾病与研究设计；另有数学材料中的系数10，以及质因数问答里的数字和答案分隔格式。

patterns.name: 研究摘要中的样本总数句式
patterns.trigger: «A» «total» «of» «10» 后接病例数或受试者数，如 «A» «total» «of» «10» 250 «cases»、182 «infants»、617 «incident cases»
patterns.context: 医学摘要描述研究纳入、检查、分析或诊断的总人数时；触发点集中在总数表达式，后接数字及人群名词

patterns.name: 分词形态的 total
patterns.context: 总数句式中 total 可能被拆分为 token；激活覆盖 total 和数值 10，数字之后接研究样本量

patterns.name: 多项式中系数 10
patterns.context: 数学表达式中负号后的系数 10；仅见于 w(y) 的多项式定义

patterns.name: 质因数问答中的数字与分隔符
patterns.trigger: «of» «9» 后的整数，以及答案中的 «2»、逗号和因数数字，如 «of» «9» 21902、«2», «4» 47
patterns.context: 重复列出“求某数的质因数”问题及其答案；激活散布在问题数字和答案格式中

en.description: Primarily responds to functions and algebraic expressions in math problems, especially function-definition equals signs, negative terms, and instructions to evaluate, differentiate, or solve equations; also responds to option labels and formula symbols. Divisibility/factor truth-value questions differ from the main pattern.

patterns.name: Mathematical predicate words
patterns.context: In questions judging divisibility or factor relationships, numbers may be split across tokens; followed by True/False.

patterns.name: Let in function definitions
patterns.context: Introduces a function definition, commonly in forms such as “Let j(b) = …” or “Let x(n) = …”; may be followed by a request to calculate, evaluate, or operate on the function.
patterns.domain: Math problems, especially functions and algebra

patterns.name: Function equals sign and expression connection
patterns.context: The defining equals sign between a function name and variable expression, followed by a polynomial or other algebraic expression.

patterns.name: Algebraic minus sign and negative terms
patterns.context: Appears in polynomials, linear functions, fractions, or evaluation expressions, connecting a negative coefficient or constant; may be related to how numbers are split into tokens.

patterns.name: Function evaluation or substitution instructions
patterns.context: Requests the value of a function at a specified input, usually immediately following a function expression or a defined function.

patterns.name: Differentiation instructions
patterns.context: Requests the derivative of a given polynomial function with respect to a specified variable.

patterns.name: Equation-solving instructions
patterns.context: Gives an equation containing a variable and asks to solve for it.

patterns.name: Equation-root instructions
patterns.context: Gives a quadratic equation in a and asks to determine its solution.

patterns.name: Denominator calculation instructions
patterns.context: Requests the common denominator of two fractions or rational expressions.

patterns.name: Letter variables in function applications
patterns.context: A letter appears as a function input or polynomial variable, often alongside exponents, coefficients, and substitution tasks.

patterns.name: Multiple-choice answer option labels
patterns.context: In math multiple-choice options, the letter label to the right of a parenthesis is activated; there is no clear semantic requirement for adjacent option content.

patterns.name: Other mathematical symbols and numeric formats
patterns.context: Formatting of fractions, multiplication, exponents, and numbers in mathematical expressions; activation may be partly affected by formula tokenization.

10_2447.description: 主要响应数学题中的函数与代数表达式，尤其函数定义等号、负项及求值、求导、解方程等指令；也响应选项标记和公式符号。因数/整除真假问答与主模式不同。

patterns.name: 数学谓词词语
patterns.context: 在判断因数或整除性的问句中，数值可能被拆分标记；后面跟 True/False。

patterns.name: 函数定义中的 Let
patterns.context: 引入函数定义，常见形式如 “Let j(b) = …” 或 “Let x(n) = …”；之后可能要求计算、求值或操作函数。
patterns.domain: 数学题，尤其函数与代数

patterns.name: 函数等号及表达式连接
patterns.context: 函数名和变量表达式之间的定义等号，后接多项式或其他代数式。

patterns.name: 代数减号与负项
patterns.context: 出现在多项式、一次函数、分式或求值表达式中，连接负系数或负常数；可能与数值切分方式有关。
patterns.domain: 代数计算与函数表达式

patterns.name: 函数求值或代入指令
patterns.context: 要求计算函数在指定输入处的值，通常紧接函数表达式或已定义函数。

patterns.name: 求导指令
patterns.context: 要求对给定多项式函数按指定变量求导。

patterns.name: 解方程指令
patterns.context: 给出含变量的等式并要求解变量。

patterns.name: 方程求根指令
patterns.context: 给出关于 a 的二次方程，要求确定其解。

patterns.name: 分母计算指令
patterns.context: 要求计算两个分数或分式的公分母。

patterns.name: 函数应用中的字母变量
patterns.context: 字母作为函数自变量或多项式变量出现，常与幂次、系数及代入任务共现。

patterns.name: 选择题答案选项标记
patterns.context: 数学题的选择题选项中，括号右侧的字母标记被激活；与相邻选项内容无明显语义要求。

patterns.name: 其他数学符号与数值格式
patterns.context: 分数、乘法、幂次和数字在数学表达式中的格式化表示；激活可能部分受公式 token 切分影响。

en.concept: Math problem instructions and relational expressions
en.description: Activations focus on math problem instructions and relational terms: wording for divisibility/factor judgments is prominent, as are templates for function substitution and evaluation, expansion, solving, sorting, and rearranging expressions in algebra tasks.

patterns.name: Verbs for truth-value judgments
patterns.context: Math problems answered with Yes/True/False, asking about divisibility or factor relationships.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics divisibility and factor judgment problems

patterns.name: Divisibility and factor relationship expressions
patterns.context: Judging whether one integer divides another, or is its factor or multiple; often co-occurs with Does/Is.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics number theory judgment problems

patterns.name: Polynomial expansion instructions
patterns.context: Requests expansion of an algebraic expression containing variables and products.

patterns.name: Function definition and substitution/evaluation template
patterns.context: Defines a function, then specifies an independent variable or input value and asks for the function value; the snippet may be truncated.

patterns.name: Equation solving
patterns.context: Gives an equation or expression containing a variable and asks for the variable's value.

patterns.name: Ordering variables by size
patterns.context: Gives several variables or values and asks for the third-largest value.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics comparison and sorting problems

patterns.name: Rearrange an expression and determine coefficients
patterns.context: Requests rewriting an algebraic expression in a specified form and finding a coefficient; context contains factors and polynomials.

10_2447.concept: 数学题指令与关系表达
10_2447.description: 激活集中于数学题指令与关系词：突出整除/因数判断的提问措辞，也见函数代入求值、展开、求解、排序和重排表达式等代数任务模板。

patterns.name: 陈述真假判断动词
patterns.context: 数学问题中以 Yes/True/False 作答，询问整除或因数关系。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的整除与因数判断题

patterns.name: 整除及因数关系表达
patterns.context: 判断一个整数是否整除另一个整数，或是否为其因数、倍数；常与 Does/Is 同现。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的数论判断题

patterns.name: 多项式展开指令
patterns.context: 要求展开含变量与乘积的代数式。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的代数运算题

patterns.name: 函数定义与代入求值模板
patterns.context: 先定义函数，再指定自变量或输入值，要求计算函数值；片段可能截断。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的函数求值题

patterns.name: 方程求解
patterns.context: 给出含变量的方程或表达式，并要求求变量值。

patterns.name: 变量大小排序
patterns.context: 给出若干变量或数值，询问第三大的值。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的比较与排序题

patterns.name: 重排表达式并确定系数
patterns.context: 要求将代数式改写成指定形式并求系数；上下文含因式与多项式。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的代数化简题

en.description: Activations focus on DM Mathematics algebra problems: commonly defining a univariate polynomial function with Let and asking for its value, as well as solving equations, transformations, comparison and sorting, remainders, and least common multiples; snippets are often consecutive problems and symbolic expressions.

patterns.name: Let introducing a function
patterns.context: Defines a univariate function using “Let,” followed by instructions to calculate, evaluate, or determine an unknown; often immediately followed by an answer and another similar problem.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics arithmetic and algebra exercises

patterns.name: Function evaluation instructions
patterns.context: After defining a function, asks for substitution of a specific value or determination of a related result; the function is often a linear or quadratic polynomial.

patterns.name: Algebraic equations and transformations
patterns.context: Requests solving an equation containing a variable or transforming a product expression containing variables; not merely function evaluation.

patterns.name: Comparison and sorting
patterns.context: Compares the sizes of variable expressions or sorts several values.

patterns.name: Integer conditions and multiple problems
patterns.context: Uses a given integer equation to infer a remainder, or finds the least common multiple of a variable and a specified integer.

patterns.name: Polynomial forms in function definitions
patterns.context: Function definitions often contain linear or quadratic polynomials and use algebraic symbols and coefficients; this pattern overlaps with problem instructions and function evaluation formats, but also occurs in subsequent problems to be solved.

patterns.name: Mixed algebraic expressions
patterns.context: Contains multivariable expressions, fractions, or expanded forms, and may not have the standard function-definition–evaluation structure.

10_2447.description: 激活集中于DM Mathematics代数题：常见Let定义单变量多项式函数并要求求值，也涉及解方程、变形、比较排序、余数与最小公倍数；片段多为连续题目和符号表达式。

patterns.name: Let 引入函数
patterns.context: 以“Let”定义单变量函数，随后给出计算、求值或确定未知量的指令；常紧接一题答案和下一道同类题。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 算术与代数练习

patterns.name: 函数求值指令
patterns.context: 在已定义函数后要求代入具体数值，或确定相关结果；函数式常为线性或二次多项式。

patterns.name: 代数方程与变形
patterns.context: 要求解含变量的方程，或对含变量的乘积表达式进行变形；不是单纯函数求值。

patterns.name: 比较与排序
patterns.context: 比较变量表达式的大小或对若干值排序。

patterns.name: 整数条件与倍数问题
patterns.trigger: “remainder when … is divided by”及“lowest common multiple”
patterns.context: 利用给出的整数等式推算余数，或求变量与指定整数的最小公倍数。

patterns.name: 函数定义中的多项式形态
patterns.trigger: «x(j) =»、«j(d) =»、«p(c) =» 等函数记号，及«**»幂次、变量与常数项
patterns.context: 函数定义常包含线性或二次多项式，并使用代数符号和系数；此模式与题目指令及函数求值格式重叠，但也见于后续待解题目。

patterns.name: 混合代数表达式
patterns.context: 出现多变量表达式、分数或展开式，未必带有标准的函数定义—求值结构。

en.description: Primarily responds to problem-bank-style algebra text: function definitions, polynomials with coefficients and exponents, and substitution/evaluation; also covers expanding products, differentiation, solving equations, and consecutive problems separated by line breaks.

patterns.name: Let in function definition and evaluation problems
patterns.context: Defines one or more functions in a math problem and asks for substitution of values, function evaluation, or further manipulation of an expression.

patterns.name: Polynomial functions and coefficients
patterns.context: A function definition consists of a linear or polynomial expression, often with multiple functions appearing consecutively in the same problem.

patterns.name: Function inputs with numbers and evaluation requests
patterns.context: A numeric value (often negative) is given in parentheses after a function name, and the function value is requested; the snippet sometimes begins partway through a problem.

patterns.name: Expand an algebraic product
patterns.context: Requests expanding a product or rewriting an expression in a specified form; marked tokens occur in various places, including parentheses, operators, and numbers.

patterns.name: Derivatives and differentiation operations
patterns.context: Asks for the first or second derivative of a function with respect to a variable; the snippet may also contain polynomial differentiation work.

patterns.name: Solve an equation containing variables
patterns.context: Gives an equation containing multiple variables or parameters and asks to solve for a specified variable.

patterns.name: Start marker for a new problem after a line break
patterns.context: Problems are concatenated in sequence, with a new function definition or exercise beginning after a line break; this may be triggered jointly by math problem formatting rather than by an independent mathematical concept.

10_2447.description: 主要响应题库式代数文本：函数定义、含系数与幂次的多项式、代入求值；也覆盖展开乘积、求导、解方程及换行分隔的连续题目。

patterns.name: 函数定义及求值题中的 Let
patterns.trigger: «Let»，常接函数名与自变量，如 «Let» x(j)« =»；随后常见 «Calculate»、«Determine» 或 «Give»
patterns.context: 数学题中定义一个或多个函数，并要求代入数值、求函数值或继续处理表达式。

patterns.name: 函数式多项式与系数
patterns.context: 函数定义由一次或多项式表达式组成，常在同一题中连续出现多个函数。
patterns.domain: 代数、函数与多项式练习

patterns.name: 带数字的函数自变量与求值请求
patterns.context: 在函数名后用括号给出数值（常为负数），要求计算函数值；片段有时从题目中途开始。

patterns.name: 展开代数乘积
patterns.trigger: «Express» 或 «Expand»，后接多个括号和含变量的因式，如 «(»47*r…)*(-»6174…»
patterns.context: 要求展开乘积或将表达式整理成指定形式；标记落在括号、运算符及数字等多种位置。
patterns.domain: 代数化简与多项式运算

patterns.name: 导数及微分运算
patterns.context: 询问某函数关于变量的一阶或二阶导数；片段中也可夹杂多项式求导工作式。

patterns.name: 解含变量的方程
patterns.context: 给出含多个变量或参数的等式，要求解指定变量。

patterns.name: 换行后的新题起始标记
patterns.trigger: «↵» 后常出现 «Let» 或计算结果/新表达式
patterns.context: 题目集合连续拼接，换行后开始新的函数定义或练习；这可能与数学题格式共同触发，而非独立数学概念。

en.description: Responds to algebra instructions and problem wording in DM Mathematics: defining a function and evaluating it, finding remainders, expanding, finding common denominators, solving equations, finding least common multiples, and testing primality. Triggers are mostly task phrases in problem statements, with no particular mathematical symbol or single operation observed.

patterns.name: Substitution and evaluation after a function definition
patterns.context: First gives a function definition with a letter as the input, often a linear or quadratic polynomial, then asks for evaluation at a specified input; sometimes the snippet shows only part of the definition or question.

patterns.name: Remainder problem wording
patterns.context: Asks for the remainder when one number is divided by another; a function definition may also appear in the context.

patterns.name: Expand an algebraic expression
patterns.context: Requests expanding an expression made up of products of multiple polynomials containing variables.

patterns.name: Fractions and common denominators
patterns.context: Gives fractions or rational expressions and asks for their common denominator; nearby content may also be another algebra problem.

patterns.name: Solve an equation for a letter
patterns.context: A univariate linear equation or system of equations containing variables, with an explicit request to find the value of a letter.

patterns.name: Least common multiple problems
patterns.context: After giving a relationship involving a variable or its coefficient, asks for the least common multiple of two quantities.

patterns.name: Primality judgments and function evaluation
patterns.context: First asks whether a number determined by an equation is prime, then gives a function definition or evaluation problem using that number as input.

10_2447.description: 响应 DM 数学题中的代数指令和问题措辞：定义函数后求值、求余数、展开、找公分母、解方程、求最小公倍数及判断素数。触发多为题干中的任务短语，未见特定数学符号或单一运算。

patterns.name: 函数定义后的代入求值
patterns.context: 先给出以字母为自变量的函数定义，常为一次或二次多项式，再要求代入指定输入求值；有时片段只呈现定义或问题的一部分。

patterns.name: 余数问题措辞
patterns.context: 询问一个数除以另一个数的余数；上下文中可同时出现函数定义。

patterns.name: 展开代数式
patterns.context: 要求展开由多个含变量多项式相乘构成的表达式。

patterns.name: 分数与公分母
patterns.context: 给出分数或分数表达式，询问其公分母；邻近内容也可能是其他代数题。

patterns.name: 解方程求字母
patterns.context: 带变量的一元线性方程或方程组，明确要求求某个字母的值。

patterns.name: 最小公倍数问题
patterns.context: 给出涉及变量或其系数的关系后，询问两个量的最小公倍数。

patterns.name: 素数判断及函数求值
patterns.context: 先判断由方程确定的数是否为素数，随后出现以该数为输入的函数定义或求值题。

en.concept: Algebra problem templates in math exercises
en.description: Primarily responds to polynomial substitution, equation solving, and function-definition templates in DM Mathematics exercises; also covers a few problems involving differentiation, primality judgments, and transitioning from substitution to least common multiples. A numeric answer often appears directly after a problem, followed by the next problem.

patterns.name: Polynomial definition and substitution problems
patterns.context: Gives a polynomial function and asks for substitution of a specified value; activation often falls near the function name, equals sign, or coefficient.
patterns.domain: Basic algebra exercises in DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Solve a linear equation
patterns.context: Asks to solve a simple linear equation, often followed immediately by the answer and then the next problem.

patterns.name: Solve or determine a variable in a polynomial equation
patterns.context: Requests finding a root or determining a variable's value; presented as a sequence of short problems and numeric answers.

patterns.name: Derivatives and differentiation operations
patterns.context: Contains a differentiation instruction, followed by a variable or polynomial expression.

patterns.name: Follow-up arithmetic task after substitution
patterns.context: First constructs an intermediate quantity by function substitution, then asks for a least common multiple; the passage also contains a polynomial definition.
patterns.domain: Mixed algebra and number theory exercises

patterns.name: Primality judgment problems
patterns.context: Asks whether a variable is prime, with the answer in True/False form; a polynomial function definition may follow nearby.

patterns.name: Repeated problem templates and answer snippets
patterns.context: Problems, answers, and the next problem are concatenated in the same passage; this is a formatting feature, often accompanying the algebra problem types above.

10_2447.concept: 数学练习题中的代数题模板
10_2447.description: 主要响应 DM Mathematics 练习题中的多项式代值、方程求解及函数定义模板；也覆盖求导、素数判断和由代值转入最小公倍数的少数题目。常见题后直接给出数值答案并继续下一题。

patterns.name: 多项式定义与代值题
patterns.context: 给出多项式函数并要求代入指定数值；激活常落在函数名、等号或系数附近。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的基础代数练习

patterns.name: 求解线性方程
patterns.trigger: “Solve … for [变量]”，以及一元一次式与等号两侧的方程
patterns.context: 要求解简单线性方程，常紧接方程给出答案并继续下一题。

patterns.name: 求解或确定多项式方程中的变量
patterns.trigger: “Determine s so that”及“Solve … y”，方程含高次幂或多项式项
patterns.context: 要求求根或确定变量值；呈现为连续的短题与数值答案。

patterns.name: 导数与微分运算
patterns.context: 出现求导相关指令，后接变量或多项式表达式。

patterns.name: 代值后的后续算术任务
patterns.trigger: “Let v be c(-6). Let z = v + … Calculate the smallest common multiple”
patterns.context: 先由函数代值构造中间量，再要求最小公倍数；段落同时包含多项式定义。

patterns.name: 素数判断题
patterns.trigger: “Is p prime?”，前文给出含 p 的等式
patterns.context: 要求判断变量是否为素数，回答以 True/False 形式出现；附近还可能接着定义多项式函数。

patterns.name: 重复题目模板与答案片段
patterns.trigger: 连续出现“Let …”或“Solve …”，题后紧接数值答案，如“↵-335”“↵15”
patterns.context: 题目、答案与下一题在同一段中串接；这是格式特征，常伴随上述代数题型。

en.description: Primarily responds to the format of math exercises that define functions or variables and request algebraic calculations, especially function substitution and evaluation; also covers adjacent problem types such as solving equations, finding common factors/multiples, finding roots, and factoring.

patterns.name: Function substitution and evaluation
patterns.context: After defining a polynomial or algebraic function, asks for its value at a specified input; common in sequences of generated problems and answers

patterns.name: Linear equation solving
patterns.context: Gives a univariate linear equation with an unknown and asks to solve for a specified variable, usually followed by the answer and next problem

patterns.name: Common factor or multiple problems
patterns.context: Asks for the greatest common factor, highest common factor, or least common multiple of numbers or expressions; the problem may follow an earlier algebraic definition
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, arithmetic and algebra exercises

patterns.name: Finding equation roots
patterns.context: First gives a quadratic equation, then asks for the value of the unknown, often continuing to the next problem after the answer

patterns.name: Polynomial factorization
patterns.context: Requests factoring a polynomial; preceding text contains algebraic expressions and answers, but may not belong to the same problem

patterns.name: Evaluating simple arithmetic expressions
patterns.context: Defines several variables or numeric expressions in sequence; some content lacks a complete question; definitions are introduced with Let

10_2447.description: 主要响应数学练习题中定义函数或变量、提出代数计算要求的格式，尤其是函数代入求值；也覆盖求解方程、求公因数/公倍数、求根和因式分解等相邻题型。

patterns.name: 代入函数求值
patterns.context: 定义多项式或代数函数后，要求计算指定输入处的函数值；常见于连续生成的题目与答案

patterns.name: 线性方程求解
patterns.context: 给出含未知数的一元线性方程，要求解出指定变量，后面通常跟答案和下一题

patterns.name: 公因数或公倍数题
patterns.trigger: «highest common factor», «greatest common factor», «smallest common multiple»
patterns.context: 询问数或表达式的最大公因数、最高公因数或最小公倍数；题干可能承接先前的代数定义
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics，算术与代数练习题

patterns.name: 方程求根
patterns.context: 先给出二次方程，再询问未知数的值，常在答案后继续下一题

patterns.name: 多项式因式分解
patterns.context: 要求对多项式进行因式分解；前文有代数式及答案，但未必属于同一题

patterns.name: 简单算术表达式求值
patterns.context: 连续定义若干变量或数值表达式，部分内容未显示完整的提问；可见以 Let 引出定义

en.concept: Symbols and operations in math problems
en.description: Primarily responds to algebraic notation in math problems (polynomials, exponents, operators, and functions), as well as problem types such as substitution/evaluation, equation solving, sequence continuation, and remainders, and common problem-statement prompts.

patterns.name: Polynomial expressions
patterns.context: An algebraic expression consisting of variables, exponents, coefficients, and operators; often appears in function definitions, simplification, or equations.

patterns.name: Substitute to evaluate a function
patterns.context: First gives a function definition, then asks for substitution of a value to evaluate the function or determine a subsequent result.

patterns.name: Polynomial equations and solving
patterns.context: Contains a polynomial equation, factorization, or explicit solving instruction.

patterns.name: Sequence continuation
patterns.context: Gives several numbers and asks for the next term; the sequence may include negative numbers or large integers.

patterns.name: Stepwise arithmetic and digit positions
patterns.context: Substitutes a function value or intermediate quantity into a subsequent expression, then asks for a particular digit or arithmetic result.

patterns.name: Remainders and division
patterns.context: Asks for the remainder when one number is divided by another; the context also defines the divisor.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, number theory/arithmetic application problems

patterns.name: Problem prompts and setup words
patterns.context: Introduces variables or requests a calculation or solution in a math problem statement; these prompts co-occur with formulas.

10_2447.concept: 数学题中的符号与运算
10_2447.description: 主要响应数学题中的代数记号（多项式、幂、运算符与函数），也覆盖代入求值、方程求解、数列续项及余数等题型和常见题干提示语。

patterns.name: 多项式表达式
patterns.context: 变量与幂、系数及运算符组成的代数式；常出现在定义函数、化简或给出方程时

patterns.name: 代入求函数值
patterns.context: 先给出函数定义，再要求代入数值求函数值或其后续结果

patterns.name: 多项式方程与求解
patterns.context: 出现多项式方程、因式分解或明确的求解指令

patterns.name: 数列续项
patterns.trigger: «What comes next«:»»、«What is the next term« in»»，后接逗号分隔的数列
patterns.context: 给出若干数值并询问下一项；数列可能含负数或较大整数

patterns.name: 逐步算术与数字位数
patterns.trigger: «Let q« be»3 c(19). Let k« =»5 q« +»9 380. What is the tens digit« of»»
patterns.context: 将函数值或中间量代入后续算式，再询问某一位数字或算术结果

patterns.name: 余数与除法
patterns.trigger: «the remainder« when»6 57 is divided« by»1 l»»
patterns.context: 询问一个数除以另一个数的余数；上下文还定义了除数

patterns.name: 题目提示语与设定词
patterns.context: 数学题干中引入变量、提出计算或求解要求；这些提示语与公式共同出现

en.description: Primarily responds to variables, polynomial terms, and operation structures in textbook-style algebra problems, covering expansion and rearrangement, function substitution/evaluation, and equation solving; also responds to corresponding problem instructions and question formats.

patterns.name: Terms in algebraic expansion and simplification expressions
patterns.context: Variables and multiplication, exponents, and addition/subtraction expressions occur densely, often with requests to expand, rearrange, or give a term's coefficient; activations fall on variables or expression components.

patterns.name: Variables and values in function evaluation problems
patterns.context: First gives a polynomial function definition, then asks for substitution of a specified input or evaluation; marked tokens concentrate on the function variable, input number, and polynomial terms.

patterns.name: Unknowns in linear equation solving problems
patterns.context: Introduces an equation with Solve and asks for a specified unknown; activations are distributed across the unknown and the equation's numbers and operation terms.

patterns.name: Math problem instructions and answer formats
patterns.context: Commands or questions in math problem statements; adjacent to symbolic calculations or numeric answers.

10_2447.description: 主要响应教材式代数题中的变量、多项式项与运算结构，涵盖展开重排、函数代入求值和解方程；也响应相应的题目指令与提问格式。

patterns.name: 代数展开与化简表达式中的项
patterns.context: 变量及乘法、幂、加减表达式密集出现，常要求展开、重排或给出某项系数；激活落在变量或表达式成分上

patterns.name: 函数求值题中的变量与数值
patterns.trigger: “Let k(b) =”“Let a(n) =”“Determine a(”“Calculate n(”“What is a?”
patterns.context: 先给出多项式函数定义，再要求代入指定输入或求值；标记集中在函数变量、输入数字及多项式项

patterns.name: 线性方程求解题中的未知量
patterns.context: 以 Solve 引出方程，要求求出指定未知数；激活分布于未知量及方程的数字、运算项

patterns.name: 数学题指令词及答案格式
patterns.context: 数学题干中的命令或提问；与符号计算或数值答案相邻

en.description: Activations focus on DM math algebra exercise text: “Expand” appears after a line break following an expression, as do function definitions, evaluation or calculation instructions, and formatting prompts after complex expressions. The latter categories have no common stable trigger substring.

patterns.name: Expand after a line break
patterns.context: A mathematical expression or simplification is followed by a line break and the imperative “Expand”; often located in the middle of a snippet.

patterns.name: Function notation in polynomial operation problems
patterns.context: A calculation/evaluation question prompted by a function definition, algebraic expression, or condition; activations cover functions and instruction words at different positions in the problem text, with no single fixed trigger word observed.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, algebra exercises and generated problem text

patterns.name: Algebraic expressions and prompts to convert forms
patterns.context: After a complex polynomial expression, asks to rewrite it in a specified form.

10_2447.description: 激活集中于 DM 数学代数练习文本：既见于表达式换行后出现的“Expand”，也见于函数定义、求值或计算指令及复杂表达式后的格式提示。后几类无共同的稳定触发子串。

patterns.name: 换行后出现 Expand
patterns.context: 数学表达式或化简内容后换行，紧接命令式“Expand”；常位于片段中部

patterns.name: 多项式运算题中的函数记号
patterns.context: 由函数定义、代数式或条件引出的计算/求值问题；激活覆盖题目文本中不同位置的函数与指令词，未显示单一固定触发词
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics，代数练习及题目生成文本

patterns.name: 代数表达式与文字转换提示
patterns.context: 复杂多项式表达式之后，要求改写成指定形式

en.concept: Heterogeneous local word forms and structures
en.description: Activations are scattered across multiple languages and styles. Clear cues include off at the end of verb phrases, English dont know, the French relative pronoun dont, mathematical expressions, and numeric strings in URLs; commas and several isolated words also occur. Overall, there is no single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: off at the end of verb phrases
