patterns.context: Appears in verb phrases preceded by “ripped,” “net,” and “lopped,” respectively. There is no clear shared semantics; beyond ending in off, the local structures differ.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, news commentary, expository prose

patterns.name: know after dont
patterns.context: In informal IRC conversations, know follows dont to express uncertainty or add clarification.

patterns.name: French dont
patterns.context: The relative pronoun dont in a French subordinate clause connects an antecedent to the following clause.

patterns.name: Numbers and variable operations in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: In equation problems, coefficients, variables, operators, and equals signs occur in combination; activations are scattered across expression tokens.

patterns.name: Numbers and path/URL identifiers
patterns.context: URLs, paths, or numeric strings in IRC text.

patterns.name: Commas and adjacent structures in sentences
patterns.context: Commas occur in English or French sentences, often alongside parentheticals, lists, or pauses between clauses; activation strength varies.
patterns.domain: Multilingual prose, forums, and expository texts

patterns.name: Locally frequent function words or syntactic positions
patterns.context: Only locally salient tokens occur in each passage, with no shared semantics or stable contextual conditions.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, commercial descriptions, automotive policy quotations

10_2958.description: 激活分散于多种语言和文体：明显线索包括动词短语末尾 off、英语 dont know、法语关系代词 dont、数学算式及网址数字串；另有逗号和若干孤立词，整体缺少单一稳定语义。

patterns.name: 动词短语末尾的 off
patterns.context: 出现在动词短语中，前面分别是“ripped”“net”“lopped”；没有明显统一语义，除均为 off 结尾外，局部结构各异。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、新闻评论、说明文

patterns.name: dont 后的 know
patterns.context: 口语化 IRC 对话中，dont 后接 know，表达不确定或补充说明。

patterns.name: 法语 dont
patterns.context: 法语从句中的关系代词 dont，连接先行词与后续从句。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的数字与变量运算
patterns.context: 方程题中系数、变量、运算符和等号交错出现；激活分散于算式 token。

patterns.name: 数字与路径/网址标识
patterns.context: IRC 文本中的网址、路径或数字串。

patterns.name: 句中逗号及其邻接结构
patterns.context: 逗号出现在英语或法语句子中，常伴随插入语、列举或句间停顿；强度不一。
patterns.domain: 多语种散文、论坛与说明文

patterns.name: 局部高频功能词或句法位置
patterns.context: 各段中仅有局部显著 token，缺乏共同语义或稳定上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、商业说明、汽车政策引述

en.description: Activations are scattered across commas, word-initial Arr-, requests in grant applications, several medical subword fragments, and forum expressions. The fragments differ substantially in overall meaning, and sporadic triggers are difficult to group.

patterns.name: Word-initial or stem “Arr-”
patterns.context: The word-initial subword token Arr is marked, while the following spelling can form different words; there is no shared semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia titles, medical abstracts, patent backgrounds

patterns.name: NIH grant application boilerplate
patterns.context: Activations cluster on requests in statements about funding, support, or study periods.

patterns.name: Punctuation and spaces
patterns.context: Commas are marked as the strongest activations, but occur only in some passages and show no stable semantic context.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within words
patterns.context: Activations fall on complete words or within-word subwords related to automotive brands, cell biology, and colloquial expressions, with no shared semantic condition.

patterns.name: Statement of no accepted criteria
patterns.context: States that no sensitive and specific biological methods or standards are currently accepted; the following text is truncated.

patterns.name: Being ripped off / overcharged expression
patterns.context: The title “How badly are we being ripped off” asks whether glasses are being excessively overpriced.

patterns.name: Other sporadic activations
patterns.context: Occur respectively in automotive titles, grant applications, medical titles, and patent backgrounds; their contexts differ, with no stable trigger condition that can be grouped.
patterns.domain: Forums, grant applications, medical abstracts, patent texts

10_2958.description: 激活分散在逗号、Arr-词首、资助申请中的 requests、若干医学词片段及论坛表达；各片段整体语义差异明显，且零散触发难以归并。

patterns.name: 词首或词干“Arr-”
patterns.context: 词首子词元 Arr 被标记，后续拼写可以构成不同单词；没有统一的语义条件。
patterns.domain: 百科标题、医学摘要、专利背景

patterns.name: NIH 资助申请套语
patterns.trigger: “This grant« proposal»1« requests»10”以及“This« proposal»…« requests»…”
patterns.context: 激活集中在 requests，出现在申请经费、支持或研究周期的陈述中。

patterns.name: 标点与空格
patterns.context: 逗号被标记为最强激活，但只在部分片段出现，未显示稳定的语义上下文。

patterns.name: 词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在完整词或词内子词上，分别涉及汽车品牌、细胞生物学和口语表达，缺少共同语义条件。

patterns.name: 无接受标准的陈述
patterns.context: 陈述目前不存在被接受的敏感且特异的生物学方法或标准；后文在截断处。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学申请文本

patterns.name: 被敲诈／宰客表达
patterns.context: 标题以“How badly are we being ripped off”询问眼镜是否被过度收费。

patterns.name: 其他零散激活
patterns.context: 分别出现在汽车标题、资助申请、医学标题及专利背景中；各自语境不同，未见可归并的稳定触发条件。
patterns.domain: 论坛、资助申请、医学摘要、专利文本

en.description: Activations occur on code markers and attributes, split word fragments, and hyphenated terms, as well as in patent backgrounds, paper titles, technical terms, and legal document headers. The commonality is weak, with both formatting and subword-fragment triggers.

patterns.name: HTML/XML tags and attribute fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on or near angle-bracket tags, tag names, attribute names, or attribute values; examples include a dialog tag with a vm title and a webpage video-container tag.

patterns.name: Split words and hyphenated compounds
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across word fragments split by the tokenizer and the hyphens between them, involving ordinary words, proper nouns, or technical terms; they are not limited to one semantic category.
patterns.domain: Patents, biomedical abstracts, and NIH research descriptions

patterns.name: Technical terms and specialized compounds
patterns.context: Multiple word fragments near specialized terms or names of materials, experimental systems, and devices show activations. This overlaps with within-word splitting but more specifically corresponds to dense technical naming.

patterns.name: Conventional/contrastive statements in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: Patent background text discusses conventional or normal cases, descriptions, and heating/cooling; activations cluster near quoted “normal” and split technical words.

patterns.name: Paper review titles and quoted titles
patterns.context: Abstracts begin with Comment on, followed by a paper title in quotation marks; activations mainly cover the quotation marks and split title fragments.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts, paper reviews, or citations

patterns.name: Publication status and header formatting in legal documents
patterns.context: Document headers begin with the uppercase, token-split declaration “NOT DESIGNATED FOR PUBLICATION,” accompanied by line breaks, spaces, and a case number.

10_2958.description: 激活分布于代码标记与属性、拆分词片段和连字符术语，也见于专利背景、论文题名、技术名词及法律文书页眉；共同点较弱，兼有格式与词片段触发。

patterns.name: HTML/XML 标记与属性片段
patterns.context: 激活落在尖括号标签、标签名、属性名或属性值附近；分别是带 vm 标题的对话框标签和网页视频容器标签。

patterns.name: 词内拆分与连字符化合物
patterns.context: 激活分布在被分词器拆开的词片段及其间的连字符上，涉及完整词、专名或技术术语；不局限于某一语义类别。
patterns.domain: 专利、生物医学摘要及 NIH 研究描述

patterns.name: 技术名词及专业复合词
patterns.context: 专业术语或材料、实验系统、器件名称附近的多个词片段都出现激活；该模式与词内拆分重叠，但更具体地对应密集的技术命名。
patterns.domain: 光子学、材料科学、生物医学研究

patterns.name: 专利背景中的常规/对比表述
patterns.context: 专利背景文字讨论常规或正常情形、描述及加热/冷却；激活集中在引述的“normal”和被拆分的技术词附近。

patterns.name: 论文评论标题及引号内题名
patterns.context: 摘要以 Comment on 开头，后接引号中的论文题名；激活主要覆盖引号及题名的拆分片段。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、论文评论或引文

patterns.name: 法律文书的出版状态与页眉排版
patterns.context: 文书页眉以大写、分词拆开的“NOT DESIGNATED FOR PUBLICATION”声明开头，伴随换行、空格及案号。

en.description: Nearly all passages show strong activation on initial cre- fragments, including crevices, creases, cremated, creams, creche, creed, crease, and crematorium; passage 6 instead targets Tre- in the German word Treffen, possibly sharing an orthographic cue.

patterns.name: Spelling fragment in crevices
patterns.context: When describing animals hiding in holes, rock crevices, and other refuges, strong activation falls on the initial subword fragment cre in crevices.

patterns.name: Shoulder creases
patterns.context: When describing a shoulder injury or posture, strong activation falls on the initial fragment cre in creases.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in cremated
patterns.context: When recounting the cremation of victims' remains, strong activation falls on the initial fragment cre in cremated.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in creams
patterns.context: When discussing ice cream recipes, processing, and stability, strong activation falls on the initial fragment cre in creams.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in creche
patterns.context: When mentioning an abandoned childcare center/nursery, activation falls on the initial fragment cre in creche.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in German Treffen
patterns.context: In German titles or meeting names, activation falls on the initial fragment Tre in Treffen; no clear English cre word is present.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in Rand's creed
patterns.context: When discussing Ayn Rand's creed, activation falls on the initial fragment cre in creed.

patterns.name: Cricket term crease
patterns.context: In cricket narratives, when a player comes to the crease (batting area), activation falls on the initial fragment cre in the word.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in crematorium
patterns.context: When mentioning a crematorium used to burn remains, activation falls on the initial fragment cre in crematorium.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in crematorium
patterns.context: When mentioning the crematorium near Mahler's grave, activation falls on the initial fragment cre in crematorium.

10_2958.description: 几乎所有段都在 cre- 起始片段处强激活，涵盖 crevices、creases、cremated、creams、creche、creed、crease、crematorium；第6段则落在德语 Treffen 的 Tre-，可能共享字形线索。

patterns.name: crevices 拼写片段
patterns.context: 在描述动物躲入洞穴、岩缝等藏身处时，强激活落在单词 crevices 的开头子词片段 cre。

patterns.name: creases 肩部褶皱
patterns.context: 描述肩部受伤或体位时，强激活落在 creases 的开头片段 cre。

patterns.name: cremated 词内片段
patterns.context: 叙述被杀者遗体火化时，强激活落在 cremated 的开头片段 cre。

patterns.name: 冰淇淋词内片段
patterns.context: 讨论冰淇淋配方、加工及稳定性时，强激活落在 creams 的开头片段 cre。

patterns.name: creche 词内片段
patterns.context: 提到被遗弃的托儿所／育婴场所时，激活落在 creche 的开头片段 cre。

patterns.name: 德语 Treffen 词内片段
patterns.context: 德语标题或会议名称中，激活落在 Treffen 的开头片段 Tre；没有明显英语 cre 词。

patterns.name: Rand 的 creed 词内片段
patterns.context: 讨论 Ayn Rand 的信条时，激活落在 creed 的开头片段 cre。

patterns.name: crease 板球术语
patterns.context: 板球叙述中，球员来到 crease（击球区）时，激活落在该词开头片段 cre。

patterns.name: crematorium 词内片段
patterns.context: 提到用于焚烧遗体的火葬场时，激活落在 crematorium 的开头片段 cre。

patterns.name: crematorium 词内片段
patterns.context: 提到 Mahler 墓旁的火葬场时，激活落在 crematorium 的开头片段 cre。

en.concept: Fragments in long proper names and compound terms
en.description: Activations mainly fall on internal fragments of longer proper names, compounds, or technical terms: the CKM name, multi-component, Bengalese, Surveys, Cabo Verde, and pathophysiologically. A few activations cannot be reliably explained by these local patterns.

patterns.name: Word fragments in Cabibbo–Kobayashi–Maskawa
patterns.context: Occurs with the CKM matrix or related weak-interaction, flavor, or CP-physics terms in particle physics; activations cluster on several subword fragments within the proper name.

patterns.name: Word fragments in multi-component
patterns.context: When describing enzymes or infrared absorption bands composed of multiple components, activations fall within the compound; no evidence is seen outside general multi-component contexts.

patterns.name: Bengalese in a species name
patterns.context: When discussing bird courtship signals and female mate choice, activations cluster near the beginning of the species name.

patterns.name: Surveys in an astronomical instrument name
patterns.context: The location in an astronomy abstract that mentions the Advanced Camera for Surveys (ACS).

patterns.name: Place name Cabo Verde
patterns.context: Appears as an island place name in a tropical cyclone track narrative.

patterns.name: Word fragments in pathophysiologically
patterns.context: Medical texts use this adverb to describe heterogeneous pathophysiological conditions; it occurs in two passages of medical text.

patterns.name: Internal fragments of intensity words/compounds
patterns.context: Activations sometimes fall on internal subwords of proper names or technical terms rather than syntactic function words; these instances show no shared semantic or stylistic conditions.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain proper names and technical terms

10_2958.concept: 长专名与复合术语片段
10_2958.description: 激活主要落在较长专名、复合词或专业术语的内部片段：CKM 名称、多组分、Bengalese、Surveys、Cabo Verde、pathophysiologically 等。少数激活无法由这些局部模式可靠解释。

patterns.name: Cabibbo–Kobayashi–Maskawa 词片段
patterns.context: 出现粒子物理中的 CKM 矩阵或相关弱相互作用、味道/CP 物理术语时；激活集中在专名内部的若干子词片段。
patterns.domain: 高能物理、粒子物理论文

patterns.name: 多组分（multi-component）词片段
patterns.context: 描述由多个组分构成的酶或红外吸收带时，激活落在复合词内部；未见于一般多组分语境之外的证据。

patterns.name: 物种名中的 Bengales(e)
patterns.trigger: «Beng»，位于 “Bengalese finches” 的物种名称中
patterns.context: 讨论鸟类求偶信号及雌鸟择偶，激活集中在物种名开头。

patterns.name: 天体仪器名中的 Surveys
patterns.context: 天文学摘要中提及 Advanced Camera for Surveys（ACS）的位置。

patterns.name: 地名 Cabo Verde
patterns.context: 热带气旋路径叙述中，作为岛屿地名出现。

patterns.name: pathophysiologically 词片段
patterns.context: 医学文本用该副词描述异质的病理生理状况；在两段医学语料中出现。

patterns.name: 强度分词/复合词内部片段
patterns.context: 激活有时落在专名或技术词的内部子词，而非句法功能词；这些实例没有显示出共同的语义或文体条件。
patterns.domain: 跨领域专名及技术术语

en.concept: Specialized compound terms in scientific papers
en.description: Activations concentrate in research and medical-science contexts, especially compound terms, disease names, study designs, treatments, and descriptions of mechanisms. Other specialized texts concern spintronics, children's public health, and pulmonary function measurements. Many activations fall on hyphenated compounds or components of technical terms.

patterns.name: Technical compounds in medical research
patterns.context: In medical or scientific papers, terms comprise multiple morphemes, directional words, or nouns; some activations fall on the morpheme after a hyphen

patterns.name: Disease and diagnosis names
patterns.context: Specific disease names appear in clinical studies, case reports, or discussions of disease mechanisms

patterns.name: Study design and trial descriptions
patterns.context: Introduces study aims, sample inclusion/exclusion, experimental tests, or ethics approval
patterns.domain: Research grant abstracts and medical papers

patterns.name: Treatment, drugs, and clinical management
patterns.context: Discusses cancer treatment sensitivity, sedative medication, and complications

patterns.name: Physiological mechanisms and molecular/immune markers
patterns.context: Explains disease through pathways, molecules, or immune factors, or describes animal model genotypes

patterns.name: Cancer staging and classification terms
patterns.context: Oncology papers specify staging criteria and versions

patterns.name: Spintronics terminology
patterns.context: Discusses spin and charge transport, conversion effects, and material properties

patterns.name: Specific populations and health behaviors
patterns.context: Studies of schoolchildren describe age, grade, and health promotion goals

patterns.name: Physiological measurements and equipment recordings
patterns.context: Describes participant testing and pulmonary function curve recordings

patterns.name: Survey of professionals
patterns.context: Reports professional physicians' practices or survey results

patterns.name: Named syndromes and lists of rare causes
patterns.context: Lists disease causes using endocrinology abbreviations and rare disease names

10_2958.concept: 科学论文中的专业复合术语
10_2958.description: 激活集中于科研及医学科学语境，尤其是复合术语、疾病名、研究设计、治疗与机制描述；另有自旋电子学、儿童公共卫生、肺功能测量等专门文本，许多激活落在连字符复合词或专业名词成分上。

patterns.name: 医学研究中的技术复合词
patterns.trigger: 技术术语内部或相邻成分间的连字符、双连字符及复合结构，如“renin--angiotensin--aldosterone”“anterior--posterior”“spin--charge”“flow--volume”
patterns.context: 医学或科学论文中，术语由多个词素、方向词或名词构成；部分激活落在连字符后的词素上

patterns.name: 疾病与诊断名称
patterns.trigger: 疾病或病理名称，如“kidney cancer”“leukemia”“glioma”“gingival enlargement”“adrenal hyperplasia”“adrenal disease”
patterns.context: 临床研究、病例报告或疾病机制讨论中出现具体病名

patterns.name: 研究设计与试验描述
patterns.trigger: “propose to initiate studies”“patients were excluded”“Aim 2 will critically test”“trial was carried out”“This study was approved”
patterns.context: 介绍研究目的、样本纳入排除、实验测试或伦理审批
patterns.domain: 科研资助摘要及医学论文

patterns.name: 治疗、药物与临床处置
patterns.trigger: “chemo/radio sensitivity”“opioid combined with a benzodiazepine for sedation”“respiratory depression”
patterns.context: 讨论癌症治疗敏感性、镇静用药及其并发症

patterns.name: 生理机制与分子/免疫标记
patterns.context: 以通路、分子或免疫因子解释疾病，或描述动物模型的基因型

patterns.name: 癌症分期与分类术语
patterns.trigger: “TNM classification”“Union for International Cancer Control”“6th edition”
patterns.context: 肿瘤学论文中交代分期标准及版本

patterns.name: 自旋电子学术语
patterns.trigger: “spin Hall angle”“spin--charge conversion”“spin and charge currents”
patterns.context: 讨论自旋与电荷输运、转换效应及材料性质
patterns.domain: 凝聚态物理/材料科学论文

patterns.name: 具体人群与健康行为
patterns.context: 学校儿童研究，描述年龄、年级及健康促进目标

patterns.name: 生理测量与设备记录
patterns.trigger: “Pulmonary function and exercise tests”“Spirometric flow--volume curves”
patterns.context: 描述受试者测试及肺功能曲线记录

patterns.name: 专业人员调查
patterns.context: 报告专业医师的实践情况或调查结果

patterns.name: 命名综合征及罕见病因列表
patterns.context: 以内分泌学缩写和罕见病名列举疾病病因
patterns.domain: 内分泌学综述或病例讨论

en.description: Primarily responds to URLs, domains, email addresses, and file paths split by punctuation, and often occurs around line breaks and forum separators near links. Numeric strings, code identifiers, a few subword fragments, and sporadic prose tokens also occur, without a unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: URL and domain components
patterns.context: Separators and domain/path fragments in URLs, email addresses, or links; often interleaved with numbers, filenames, or email usernames
patterns.domain: Email, web links, and forum text

patterns.name: Numbers and alphanumeric strings
patterns.context: Numbers embedded in email addresses, URLs, filenames, or code identifiers; not limited to any fixed number

patterns.name: Forum formatting markers before and after links
patterns.context: Line breaks, separators, or Markdown/HTML-style link markers, especially in HackerNews posts and near links

patterns.name: Email address structure
patterns.context: Multiple recipient addresses listed consecutively, with usernames and domains split by punctuation

patterns.name: Image links in URLs
patterns.context: Posts contain image URLs pointing to imgur, followed by a line break or separator

patterns.name: Technical files and code paths
patterns.context: Punctuation and identifiers are split into tokens in paths, filenames, or frontend code snippets

patterns.name: Rare spelling fragments at token boundaries
patterns.context: Ordinary words are split into multiple subwords; there is no clear shared semantic condition
patterns.domain: Astrophysics papers and forum prose/technical blogs

patterns.name: Sporadic function words or word fragments in discourse
patterns.context: Occur sporadically in coherent prose, without stable syntactic or semantic trigger conditions

10_2958.concept: 网址与结构化文本片段
10_2958.description: 主要响应被标点切分的 URL、域名、邮箱及文件路径片段，也常见于链接附近的换行和论坛分隔符；另有数字串、代码标识符、少量子词片段和零散散文 token，无法归为统一语义触发。

patterns.name: URL与域名组件
patterns.context: 网址、电子邮件地址或链接中的分隔符和域名/路径片段；常与数字、文件名或邮箱用户名交错
patterns.domain: 邮件、网页链接及论坛文本

patterns.name: 数字与字母数字串
patterns.context: 数字嵌在邮箱、网址、文件名或代码标识符中；并非只对应某一固定数字

patterns.name: 链接前后的论坛格式标记
patterns.context: 换行、分隔线或 Markdown/HTML 式链接标记处，尤其在 HackerNews 帖文及链接附近

patterns.name: 邮箱地址结构
patterns.context: 多个收件人地址连续列出，用户名和域名被标点切分

patterns.name: 网址中的图片链接
patterns.context: 帖子包含以 imgur 为目标的图片 URL，链接后接换行或分隔内容

patterns.name: 技术文件与代码路径
patterns.context: 路径、文件名或前端代码片段中，标点和标识符被拆成 token

patterns.name: 分词边界处的罕见拼写片段
patterns.context: 普通词被拆分成多个子词；没有明显统一语义条件
patterns.domain: 天体物理论文及论坛散文/技术博客

patterns.name: 话语中的零散功能词或词片段
patterns.context: 在连贯散文中零星出现，缺乏稳定的句法或语义触发条件

en.concept: Comparative relations and increases in degree
en.description: Primarily responds to comparative properties or effect descriptions introduced by greater, across research and patent texts. Passage 6 highlights relative orientation, which may be related to comparison, but the evidence is weaker.

patterns.name: Comparative greater and following attributes
patterns.context: Compares an attribute, capability, effect, degree, or performance in explanatory or argumentative statements; activation mainly falls on greater, and in a few passages extends to following words.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain research abstracts, patent backgrounds, and technical descriptions

patterns.name: Comparative relation in relative
patterns.context: Describes relative orientation between molecules in a materials science discussion; greater does not appear.

10_2958.description: 主要对 greater 引出的比较级性质或效果表述起反应，跨科研和专利文本；第6段则突出 relative orientation，可能与比较关系有关，但证据较弱。

patterns.name: greater 比较级及其后续属性
patterns.trigger: “greater”后接性质、程度或结果词，如 “greater lipophilic character”“greater hole spacing”“greater relative biological effectiveness”“greater ease”“greater interaction”“greater understanding”“greater effects”“greater selectivity”“greater yield strength”
patterns.context: 在说明或论证语句中，比较某种属性、能力、效果、程度或性能；激活主要落在 greater，个别段落也延伸到其后的词。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的科研摘要、专利背景与技术说明

patterns.name: relative 的比较关系
patterns.context: 材料科学论述中描述分子之间的相对取向；没有出现 greater。

en.concept: Comparisons and expressions of increased degree
en.description: Primarily responds to greater/greatest and contexts of enhancement, comparison, or increased degree; also activates on comparative or change expressions such as relative, most, and improvement. Other locally high responses include capability, where, provide, space/potential, and title formatting, which may not share the same semantics.

patterns.name: Comparative/increase semantics of greater
patterns.context: When comparing or describing increases, enhancement, or greater degree, especially after greater; covers biological effects, coupling convenience, removed volume, lipophilicity, molecular interactions, weight loss, research capability, and skill requirements.
patterns.domain: Patents, medicine, biochemistry, materials science, and research abstracts

patterns.name: Relative relations
patterns.context: relative introduces relative efficacy, orientation, or distribution; the referents and meanings differ.

patterns.name: Superlative degree in most
patterns.context: most modifies the highest degree or significance; once it refers to the most effective ablation conditions, and once introduces the most important result.

patterns.name: Improvement descriptions
patterns.context: Describes improvements from treatment, surgery, or formulations; the specific improvements concern radiotherapy, physiological conditions, and vesicle stability.

patterns.name: Other high-activation word: capability
patterns.context: to alone stands out when describing the ability of a chelator to bind metal tightly; it is related to the comparative expression greater nearby, but has a different trigger.

patterns.name: Other high-activation word: where
patterns.context: Introduces a condition in a relative clause in which molecular relative orientation is crucial; co-occurs with the relational expression relative in the same sentence.

patterns.name: Other high-activation word: provide
patterns.context: Describes a robotic prototype providing a means for further study; adjacent to greater investigation.

patterns.name: Other high-activation words: space / potential
patterns.context: In patent or medical technical texts, describes an inserted device forming a potential dead space and its risks.

patterns.name: Other high-activation word: introduction marker
patterns.context: A paper-structure heading and its formatting marker at the beginning of a passage; no direct connection to comparative semantics in the body text is evident.

10_2958.description: 主要对 greater/greatest 及增强、比较或程度提升语境响应；也激活 relative、most、improvement 等比较或变化表达。另有 capability、where、provide、space/potential 和标题格式等局部高响应，未必共享同一语义。

patterns.name: greater 的比较级/增加语义
patterns.context: 比较或描述增多、增强、程度更高时，尤其出现在 greater 后；涵盖生物效应、耦合便利性、去除体积、脂溶性、分子相互作用、减重、研究能力和技能要求。
patterns.domain: 专利、医学、生物化学、材料科学及科研摘要

patterns.name: relative 相对关系
patterns.context: relative 引出相对效能、相对取向或相对分布；所指对象和语义并不相同。
patterns.domain: 放射治疗、材料科学、药理学摘要

patterns.name: most 的最高程度
patterns.context: most 修饰最高程度或显著性；一次指最有效的消融条件，一次引出最重要的结果。
patterns.domain: 实验医学摘要、生物化学摘要

patterns.name: improvement 的改善表述
patterns.context: 描述治疗、手术或制剂带来的改善；具体改善对象分别为放疗、生理状况和囊泡稳定性。

patterns.name: 其他高激活词：capability
patterns.context: 在说明螯合剂紧密结合金属的能力时，to 单独突出；与邻近 greater 的比较表达有关但触发点不同。

patterns.name: 其他高激活词：where
patterns.context: 关系从句中引出分子相对取向至关重要的条件；与同句 relative 的关系表达并存。

patterns.name: 其他高激活词：provide
patterns.context: 描述机器人原型提供一种用于进一步研究的手段；与 greater investigation 相邻。

patterns.name: 其他高激活词：space / potential
patterns.context: 专利或医学技术文本中，说明插入装置形成潜在死腔及其风险。

patterns.name: 其他高激活词：introduction 标记
patterns.context: 段首论文结构标题及其格式标记；未见与正文比较语义的直接联系。

en.description: Activations concentrate on words in research and technical texts that indicate a higher degree, scale, or performance, such as greater, great, greatest, and large; they also occur in comparison and quantitative evaluation contexts. Topics span ablation, drugs, tumors, materials, and measurement.

patterns.name: Comparative or degree emphasis in greater/large
patterns.context: Emphasizes a higher or larger degree, or the greatest level, when describing efficacy, volume, relative biological effects, capability, surface area, or other attributes; no fixed syntactic position is required.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain research abstracts, patent backgrounds, and paper body text

patterns.name: Comparison targets or quantitative performance contexts
patterns.context: Centers on comparison, measurement, or performance evaluation; often occurs with greater/greatest, efficacy, or numerical metrics, but not in every passage.

10_2958.description: 激活集中于科研和技术文本中表示程度、规模或性能较高的词，如 greater、great、greatest、large，也见于比较和量化评估语境；主题横跨消融、药物、肿瘤、材料与测量。

patterns.name: greater/large 的比较级或程度强调
patterns.context: 在描述效能、体积、相对生物学效果、能力、表面积或其他属性时，强调程度较高、较大或最佳；不要求固定句法位置。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的科研摘要、专利背景和论文正文

patterns.name: 比较对象或量化性能语境
patterns.context: 围绕比较、测量或性能评估展开；常与 greater/greatest、效能或数值指标共同出现，但不是每段都出现。

en.description: Strong responses are concentrated mainly on superlative or comparative expressions such as greatest/greater, often adjacent to the quantity being compared, such as an effect, property, area, flexibility, or risk. It also responds to magnitude terms such as large and maximum, and in several passages accompanies energy transfer, dosage, or medical imaging contexts. The domain coverage is broad; the core appears to be comparative/magnitude vocabulary rather than a single topic.

patterns.name: greatest/greater comparatives
patterns.context: When comparing objects, effects, quantities, or properties, strong activation falls mainly on greatest/greater. Examples include greatest volume, greatest in vitro specificity, greater lipophilic character, greater relative biological effectiveness, greater surface area, greater flexibility, and greatest hemorrhagic risk.

patterns.name: large and size/numerical magnitude
patterns.context: Appears when describing physical quantities, absorption cross-sections, lesion size, or dosage; some examples occur directly alongside greatest/greater triggers.

patterns.name: Radiotherapy and energy-transfer terminology
patterns.context: Discusses ablation energy, energy transfer between dark matter and electrons, or the relative biological effects of targeted radiotherapy and radioisotopes; segment 6 also contains greater.
patterns.domain: Medical physics, radiation therapy, particle physics

patterns.name: Descriptions of degree or properties before greater
patterns.context: Describes the binding capacity, lipophilicity, and functionality of metal chelators; strong activation is concentrated on greater, while adjacent passages concern chelator design.

patterns.name: Imaging, lesion size, and uptake values
patterns.context: A whole-body PET scan identifies a renal pelvis lesion and reports the maximum SUV; strongly activated words are large and maximum.

patterns.name: Greatest risk
patterns.context: Describes the location of greatest puncture-related bleeding risk during scleral buckling surgery; greatest matches other comparative examples, though the risk context is distinctive.

10_2958.description: 强响应主要集中于 greatest/greater 等最高级或比较级表达，常与效果、性质、面积、灵活性或风险等被比较的量相邻；也响应 large、maximum 等量级词，并在若干段落中伴随能量转移、剂量或医学影像语境。领域跨度很大，核心更像比较/量级词汇而非单一主题。

patterns.name: greatest/greater 比较级
patterns.trigger: “greatest”或“greater”，尤其是其后紧接的度量或属性
patterns.context: 比较对象、效果、数量或性质时，强激活主要落在 greatest/greater；实例涉及 greatest volume、greatest in vitro specificity、greater lipophilic character、greater relative biological effectiveness、greater surface area、greater flexibility，以及 greatest hemorrhagic risk。
patterns.domain: 跨领域学术与技术文本

patterns.name: large 及尺寸/数值量级
patterns.trigger: “large”，如 “large optical absorption cross-section”“large FDG-avid lesion”；另有数值量级表达 “3.2”“5.1”
patterns.context: 描述物理量、吸收截面、病灶大小或剂量时出现；部分实例紧邻 greatest/greater 触发。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、材料/物理学术文本

patterns.name: 放疗与能量转移术语
patterns.context: 讨论消融能量、暗物质与电子的能量转移，或靶向放疗和放射性同位素的相对生物效应；其中 segment 6 还包含 greater。
patterns.domain: 医学物理、放射治疗、粒子物理

patterns.name: greater 之前的程度或性质描述
patterns.trigger: “tightly bind”“greater lipophilic character”“lack of excess functionality”
patterns.context: 说明金属螯合剂的结合能力、亲脂性及功能性；强激活集中在 greater，而相邻段落是螯合剂设计语境。

patterns.name: 影像与病灶大小、摄取值
patterns.context: PET 全身扫描发现肾盂病灶并报告最大 SUV；强激活词为 large、maximum。

patterns.name: 最大风险
patterns.context: 描述巩膜扣带手术中穿刺相关的出血风险最高部位；greatest 触发与其他比较级实例相符，但风险语境独特。

en.concept: Comparisons and measurement descriptions in research texts
en.description: Activations occur in biomedical research texts, particularly around comparative evaluative words such as greatest/greater; they also cover numerical, measurement, and specialist terminology. Topics vary widely across passages, with no single narrow semantic pattern.

patterns.name: greatest / greater degree expressions
patterns.context: Appears when comparing or evaluating efficacy, effects, or properties; activation is especially concentrated on greatest/greater and adjacent elements. The objects of comparison differ across passages.
patterns.domain: Medical research abstracts, research project descriptions

patterns.name: Descriptive words before quantities or measurements
patterns.context: Appears when measuring, reporting, or describing values, dimensions, or imaging parameters; triggers are scattered around numbers and their units or measured items.
patterns.domain: Results, methods, and case descriptions in medical papers

patterns.name: Specialist terminology, equipment, and abbreviations
patterns.context: Technical terms, instrument names, treatments, or disease-related nouns appear in medical or biomedical literature; no single shared term is evident.

patterns.name: Function words in structured research narratives
patterns.context: Connects entities, measurements, and properties in English research texts dense with nouns and focused on methods, results, or project goals; these common words may be triggered by local collocations rather than standalone semantics.

10_2958.concept: 科研文本中的比较与测量描述
10_2958.description: 激活出现在生物医学科研文本中，尤集中于 greatest/greater 等比较评价词；也覆盖数值、测量和专科术语周边。各段主题差异大，尚无统一的窄语义。

patterns.name: greatest / greater 程度表达
patterns.context: 出现在比较或评价某项效能、效果、特性时；激活尤其集中于 greatest/greater 及其紧邻成分。不同段落中的比较对象并不相同。
patterns.domain: 医学研究摘要、科研项目描述

patterns.name: 数量或测量值前的描述词
patterns.context: 测量、报告或描述数值、尺寸、成像参数时；触发分散在数值及其单位或被测项目附近。
patterns.domain: 医学论文中的结果、方法与病例描述

patterns.name: 专科术语、设备和缩写
patterns.context: 医学或生物医学文献中出现技术术语、仪器名、治疗名或疾病相关名词；未见单一共同术语。
patterns.domain: 生物医学科研及病例报告

patterns.name: 结构化科研叙述中的功能词
patterns.context: 名词密集、以方法、结果或项目目标为主的英文科研文本中，连接实体、测量值和属性；这些常见词可能由局部搭配而非单独语义触发。

en.description: Primarily responds to words denoting maxima, averages, or spatial scale in scientific texts and their quantitative contexts; also involves comparative increases. Astronomical numerical formatting and webpage source-code markers also appear.

patterns.name: Maximum and extreme-value expressions
patterns.context: Describes a result, risk, or effect reaching its greatest extent; often adjacent to measurements or quantitative results.

patterns.name: Averages and spatial measurements
patterns.context: Reports quantitative properties such as dimensions and spatial resolution, often followed by a specific value or unit.

patterns.name: Increase, relative elevation, or greater width
patterns.context: Compares the level of a property or describes a larger range or size; does not necessarily report a maximum.

patterns.name: Numerical formatting in astrophysics texts
patterns.context: Line breaks, formatting markers, and numbers appear near titles or metadata; no clear extreme-value word is evident.

patterns.name: HTML comments and CDN addresses
patterns.context: Conditional comments and script URLs in webpage source code; activation falls on source markers and domain fragments.

10_2958.description: 主要响应科学文本中表示最大值、平均值或空间尺度的词及其量化语境，也涉及比较性增大；另见天体物理数字格式和网页源码标记。

patterns.name: 最大值与极值表述
patterns.context: 描述某项结果、风险或效应达到最大程度；常与测量或定量结果相邻

patterns.name: 平均值与空间测量
patterns.context: 报告尺寸、空间分辨率等量化特征，常跟随具体数值或单位
patterns.domain: 材料科学与天文学论文

patterns.name: 增加、相对较高或较宽
patterns.context: 比较某性质的高低或描述范围、尺寸较大；不一定直接报告最大值
patterns.domain: 放射治疗研究与血管医学

patterns.name: 天体物理文本中的数字格式
patterns.context: 标题或元数据附近出现换行、格式标记和数值；未见明确的极值词

patterns.name: HTML注释与CDN地址
patterns.context: 网页源码中的条件注释及脚本URL；激活落在源码标记与域名片段

en.concept: Numerical and formatting markers in scientific texts
en.description: Activation samples are mixed: they commonly occur around numbers, units, coordinates, and paper-formatting remnants, and also appear in quantitative results, imaging terminology, and maximum-value expressions in scientific abstracts. There are also specialist terms from several domains, making it difficult to group them into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Numbers and markers after document separators
patterns.context: In ArXiv text, numbers, coordinates, dimensions, or formatting markers commonly occur near divider lines, blank lines, titles, or figures; activation often falls on numbers and adjacent symbols.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper metadata, formatting remnants, figures, or coordinate text

patterns.name: Scientific measurements and numerical results
patterns.context: Numbers occur next to units, experimental results, or quantitative descriptions; nearby words around numerical expressions may also trigger.
patterns.domain: Biomedical and experimental science abstracts, particle physics

patterns.name: Imaging examinations and imaging terminology
patterns.context: Appears when medical or materials research describes imaging, scans, microscopic observation, and their results.

patterns.name: Percentages or maximum-value expressions
patterns.context: Emphasizes maximum effects, efficiency, volume, values, or average dimensions in quantitative results; specific terms and sentence structures vary.

patterns.name: Field classification codes
patterns.context: Codes appear beside semicolon-separated lists in the mathematical classification metadata on the first page of an ArXiv paper.

patterns.name: Astrophysics title text
patterns.context: Astrophysics terminology appears in or near a paper title, accompanied by formatting separators.

patterns.name: Model and wave terminology
patterns.context: A paper title contains terms related to a nonlinear droplet model and waveforms, with nearby author information and dimension values.

patterns.name: Renal pelvis tumor and FDG uptake
patterns.context: A PET screening report for an asymptomatic patient describes the lesion location and uptake value.

patterns.name: Radiopharmaceutical targeting
patterns.context: Describes organ targeting and effects of a liposome-encapsulated formulation in mice.

patterns.name: Laser ablation efficiency
patterns.context: Compares ablation efficiency at different energy densities above the threshold, measured as volume removed per unit energy.

patterns.name: Nanomaterial morphology
patterns.context: Microscopic images reveal the material's dispersion state, spherical morphology, and average diameter.

patterns.name: Proton beams and experimental facilities
patterns.context: Introduces the momentum and intensity of secondary hadron beams available at a particle-beam facility.

10_2958.concept: 科学文本中的数值与格式标记
10_2958.description: 激活样本混杂：常见于数字、单位、坐标及论文排版残片，也出现在科学摘要的定量结果、成像术语和最大值表达；另有多个领域特有术语，难以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 文档分隔符后的数字与标记
patterns.context: ArXiv文本中分隔线、空行、标题或图表附近，常见数字、坐标、尺寸或格式标记；激活多落在数字及其邻接符号上。
patterns.domain: ArXiv论文元数据、排版残片、图表或坐标文本

patterns.name: 科学测量与数值结果
patterns.context: 数值与单位、实验结果或定量描述相邻；数值表达附近的词语也可能触发。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与实验科学摘要、粒子物理

patterns.name: 影像检查与成像术语
patterns.context: 医学或材料研究中描述成像、扫描、显微观察及其结果时出现。
patterns.domain: 医学影像、放射性药物、材料表征

patterns.name: 百分比或最高值表达
patterns.context: 定量结果中强调最大效应、效率、体积、数值或平均尺寸；具体术语与句式不完全一致。

patterns.name: 领域分类代码
patterns.context: ArXiv论文首页的数学分类元数据中，代码与分号分隔列表相邻。

patterns.name: 物理天文学标题文本
patterns.context: 论文题目或标题附近出现天体物理术语，并伴随排版分隔内容。

patterns.name: 模型与波动术语
patterns.context: 论文标题中出现非线性液滴模型及波形相关术语，邻近作者信息与尺寸数字。
patterns.domain: 理论物理/数学物理论文

patterns.name: 肾盂肿瘤与FDG摄取
patterns.trigger: 「tumor screening」「FDG-avid lesion」「left renal pelvis」「standard uptake value」
patterns.context: 无症状患者的PET筛查报告描述病灶位置及摄取值。

patterns.name: 放射性药物靶向
patterns.context: 描述脂质体包封制剂在小鼠中的器官靶向及效果。

patterns.name: 激光消融效率
patterns.context: 比较阈值以上不同能量密度下的消融效率，并以单位能量移除体积衡量。

patterns.name: 纳米材料形貌
patterns.context: 显微图像揭示材料分散状态、球形形貌与平均直径。

patterns.name: 质子束与实验设施
patterns.context: 介绍粒子束流设施可提供的次级强子束动量与强度。
